23	// SnapshotResult checks caller-owned immutable bytes under the source repo's
24	// policy and logical path. Data is private, never part of a public report.
25	type SnapshotResult struct {
26		Report       Report `json:"report"`
27		InputDigest  string `json:"input_digest"`
28		Cached       bool   `json:"cached"`
29		Replacements int    `json:"replacements"`
30		Data         []byte `json:"-"`
31	}
32	
33	type snapshotCache struct {
34		Key       string
35		Record    scanRecord
36		Signature string
37	}
38	
39	// SnapshotInputs binds scanner implementation, executable bytes, configuration,
40	// exceptions and private policy. A file observation is never a writer proof.
41	func (s *Service) SnapshotInputs(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
42		if err := s.prepare(ctx); err != nil {
43			return "", err
44		}
45		if err := s.checkInputs(ctx); err != nil {
46			return "", err
47		}
48		cfg, ig, err := s.scannerInputs(ctx, false)
49		if err != nil {
50			return "", err
51		}
52		var extended struct {
53			Extend struct {
54				Path string `toml:"path"`
55				URL  string `toml:"url"`
56			} `toml:"extend"`
57		}
58		if _, err = toml.Decode(string(cfg), &extended); err != nil {
59			return "", errors.New("invalid snapshot scanner configuration")
60		}
61		if extended.Extend.Path != "" || extended.Extend.URL != "" {
62			return "", errors.New("snapshot scanning needs inline gitleaks rules or useDefault; external rule includes cannot be bound safely")
63		}
64		policy, err := policyBytes(s.Policy)
65		if err != nil {
66			return "", err
67		}
68		self, err := os.Executable()
69		if err != nil {
70			return "", errors.New("cannot identify snapshot implementation")
71		}
72		selfHash, err := executableDigest(ctx, self)
73		if err != nil {
74			return "", err
75		}
76		engineHash := "disabled"
77		if s.Policy.Secrets != Off {
78			switch engine := s.Engine.(type) {
79			case Gitleaks:
80				name := engine.Binary
81				if name == "" {
82					name = "gitleaks"
83				}
84				path, e := exec.LookPath(name)
85				if e != nil {
86					return "", errors.New("gitleaks is required by the selected protection policy")
87				}
88				engineHash, err = executableDigest(ctx, path)
89			case interface{ SnapshotIdentity() string }:
90				engineHash = engine.SnapshotIdentity()
91			default:
92				return "", errors.New("scanner cannot supply snapshot identity")
93			}
94			if err != nil {
95				return "", err
96			}
97		}
98		var environment []string
99		for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
100			if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToUpper(entry), "GITLEAKS_") {
101				environment = append(environment, entry)
102			}
103		}
104		sort.Strings(environment)
105		return keyedID(s.key, "snapshot-v1", selfHash, engineHash, digest(policy), scannerDigest(cfg, ig), strings.Join(environment, "\x00")), nil
106	}
107	
108	func executableDigest(ctx context.Context, path string) (string, error) {
109		real, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
110		if err != nil {
111			return "", errors.New("scanner executable unavailable")
112		}
113		data, err := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, real, 256<<20)
114		if err != nil {
115			return "", errors.New("cannot identify scanner executable")
116		}
117		return digest(data), nil
118	}
119	
120	// InspectSnapshot never edits source files, the caller's index, or Git history.
121	// Redaction creates new bytes and then checks those bytes again. Cached entries
122	// are authenticated local scan evidence, not trusted data read from an archive.
123	func (s *Service) InspectSnapshot(ctx context.Context, file string, data []byte, redact bool) (SnapshotResult, error) {
124		result := SnapshotResult{Data: data}
125		if !validRelative(file) || len(data) > MaxFileBytes {
126			return result, errors.New("snapshot requires a supported UTF-8 text file of at most 128 MiB")
127		}
128		if issue := inspectEncoding(data); issue != nil {
129			result.Report = Report{SchemaVersion: 1, Kind: "hygiene_snapshot", Scope: "snapshot", Status: "partial", Findings: []Finding{}, Gaps: []Gap{{File: s.displayPath(file), Code: "unsupported_text_encoding", Encoding: issue}}}
130			return result, errors.New("snapshot requires supported UTF-8 text; inspect encoding coverage gap")
131		}
132		inputs, err := s.SnapshotInputs(ctx)
133		if err != nil {
134			return result, err
135		}
136		result.InputDigest = inputs
137		if s.Policy.Secrets == Off && s.Policy.Known == Off && s.Policy.Generic == Off {
138			result.Report = Report{SchemaVersion: 1, Kind: "hygiene_snapshot", Scope: "snapshot", Status: "skipped", PolicyDisabled: true, Findings: []Finding{}}
139			return result, nil
140		}
141		key := keyedID(s.key, inputs, file, digest(data))
142		dir := filepath.Join(s.Dir, "snapshots")
143		if err = privatefile.EnsureDir(dir); err != nil {
144			return result, err
145		}
146		cachePath := filepath.Join(dir, key+".json")
147		var cache snapshotCache
148		if raw, e := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, cachePath, MaxRecordBytes); e == nil {
149			info, e := os.Lstat(cachePath)
150			if e == nil {
151				e = privatefile.Check(cachePath, info, false)
152			}
153			if e != nil || json.Unmarshal(raw, &cache) != nil {
154				return result, errors.New("invalid private snapshot cache")
155			}
156			sig := cache.Signature
157			cache.Signature = ""
158			encoded, _ := json.Marshal(cache)
159			if cache.Key != key || !hmac.Equal([]byte(sig), []byte(keyedID(s.key, string(encoded)))) || cache.Record.Report.Status != "complete" {
160				return result, errors.New("snapshot cache integrity check failed")
161			}
162			result.Cached = true
163		} else if !errors.Is(e, os.ErrNotExist) {
164			return result, errors.New("snapshot cache unavailable")
165		}
166		if !result.Cached {
167			record, e := s.scanSnapshot(ctx, file, data)
168			if e != nil {
169				record.Report.Status = "partial"
170				record.Report.Gaps = append(record.Report.Gaps, Gap{Code: "snapshot_failed"})
171				result.Report = record.Report
172				return result, e
173			}
174			result.Report = record.Report
175			if fresh, e := s.SnapshotInputs(ctx); e != nil || fresh != inputs {
176				return result, ErrStale
177			}
178			cache = snapshotCache{Key: key, Record: record}
179			encoded, _ := json.Marshal(cache)
180			cache.Signature = keyedID(s.key, string(encoded))
181			encoded, _ = json.Marshal(cache)
182			if e = configedit.WritePrivate(ctx, cachePath, encoded, true); e != nil {
183				return result, e
184			}
185		}
186		result.Report = cache.Record.Report
187		if err = s.save(ctx, cache.Record.Report.ID, cache.Record); err != nil {
188			return result, err
189		}
190		if redact {
191			result.Data, result.Replacements, err = snapshotReplacement(data, cache.Record)
192			if err != nil {
193				return result, err
194			}
195			if result.Replacements > 0 {
196				checked, e := s.InspectSnapshot(ctx, file, result.Data, false)
197				if e != nil {
198					return result, e
199				}
200				result.Report = checked.Report
201			}
202		}
203		if result.Report.Blocked > 0 {
204			return result, errors.New("snapshot has blocking hygiene findings")
205		}
206		if fresh, e := s.SnapshotInputs(ctx); e != nil || fresh != inputs {
207			return result, ErrStale
208		}
209		return result, nil
210	}
211	
212	func (s *Service) scanSnapshot(ctx context.Context, file string, data []byte) (scanRecord, error) {
213		b := &scanBuilder{s: s, findings: map[string]int{}, gapSet: map[string]bool{}}
214		b.record = scanRecord{Root: s.Root, Report: Report{SchemaVersion: 1, Kind: "hygiene_snapshot", ID: newID(), RepoID: s.RepoID, Scope: "snapshot", Status: "complete", Created: time.Now().UTC(), Files: 1, Bytes: int64(len(data)), Findings: []Finding{}, PrivateRules: len(s.Policy.Rules), PublicOnly: s.PublicOnly, PolicyDigest: keyedID(s.key, policyDigest(s.Policy))}}
215		for _, rule := range s.Policy.Rules {
216			c, err := compileRule(rule)
217			if err != nil {
218				return b.record, err
219			}
220			b.compiled = append(b.compiled, c)
221		}
222		b.native(file, "", data, true)
223		if s.Policy.Secrets != Off {
224			base := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(s.Dir)), "scans")
225			if err := privatefile.EnsureDir(base); err != nil {
226				return b.record, err
227			}
228			temporary := filepath.Join(base, newID())
229			if err := privatefile.MakeDir(temporary); err != nil {
230				return b.record, err
231			}
232			defer os.RemoveAll(temporary)
233			root := filepath.Join(temporary, "snapshot")
234			if err := privatefile.MakeDir(root); err != nil {
235				return b.record, err
236			}
237			if _, err := snapshotGitBytes(ctx, root, nil, "-c", "init.templateDir=", "init", "--quiet"); err != nil {
238				return b.record, err
239			}
240			oid, err := snapshotGitBytes(ctx, root, data, "hash-object", "-w", "--stdin")
241			if err != nil {
242				return b.record, err
243			}
244			entry := []byte(fmt.Sprintf("100644 %s\t%s%c", bytes.TrimSpace(oid), file, 0))
245			if _, err = snapshotGitBytes(ctx, root, entry, "update-index", "-z", "--index-info"); err != nil {
246				return b.record, err
247			}
248			cfg, ignore, err := s.scannerInputs(ctx, false)
249			if err != nil {
250				return b.record, err
251			}
252			rows, err := s.Engine.Scan(ctx, EngineRequest{Root: root, PrivateDir: temporary, Config: cfg, Ignore: ignore})
253			if err != nil {
254				b.record.Report.Status = "partial"
255				return b.record, errors.New("snapshot scanner failed")
256			}
257			for _, d := range rows {
258				if filepath.ToSlash(d.File) != file {
259					return b.record, errors.New("scanner returned a path outside the snapshot")
260				}
261				spans := secretSpans(data, d)
262				id := b.add(d.RuleID, "secret", file, "", d.StartLine, d.Secret, s.Policy.Secrets, len(spans) > 0)
263				for _, m := range spans {
264					b.record.Edits = append(b.record.Edits, edit{id, file, m[0], m[1], "[REDACTED:" + d.RuleID + "]"})
265				}
266			}
267		}
268		for _, f := range b.record.Report.Findings {
269			if f.Disposition == string(Block) {
270				b.record.Report.Blocked++
271			}
272			if f.Disposition == string(Warn) {
273				b.record.Report.Warnings++
274			}
275		}
276		if len(b.record.Report.Gaps) > 0 {
277			b.record.Report.Status = "partial"
278			return b.record, errors.New("snapshot scan has coverage gaps")
279		}
280		return b.record, nil
281	}
282	
283	func snapshotReplacement(data []byte, record scanRecord) ([]byte, int, error) {
284		findings := map[string]Finding{}
285		for _, f := range record.Report.Findings {
286			findings[f.ID] = f
287		}
288		var candidates []edit
289		for _, e := range record.Edits {
290			f, ok := findings[e.Finding]
291			if ok && f.CanRedact && f.Disposition != "accepted" {
292				candidates = append(candidates, e)
293			}
294		}
295		priority := func(e edit) int {
296			switch findings[e.Finding].Category {
297			case "secret":
298				return 0
299			case "known":
300				return 1
301			}
302			return 2
303		}
304		sort.SliceStable(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
305			if priority(candidates[i]) != priority(candidates[j]) {
306				return priority(candidates[i]) < priority(candidates[j])
307			}
308			return candidates[i].End-candidates[i].Start > candidates[j].End-candidates[j].Start
309		})
310		var chosen []edit
311		for _, e := range candidates {
312			if e.Start < 0 || e.End > len(data) || e.Start >= e.End {
313				return nil, 0, errors.New("invalid snapshot replacement")
314			}
315			overlap := false
316			for _, prior := range chosen {
317				if e.Start < prior.End && prior.Start < e.End {
318					overlap = true
319					break
320				}
321			}
322			if !overlap {
323				chosen = append(chosen, e)
324			}
325		}
326		sort.Slice(chosen, func(i, j int) bool { return chosen[i].Start < chosen[j].Start })
327		if len(chosen) == 0 {
328			return data, 0, nil
329		}
330		var output bytes.Buffer
331		last := 0
332		for _, e := range chosen {
333			output.Write(data[last:e.Start])
334			output.WriteString(e.Replacement)
335			last = e.End
336			if output.Len() > MaxFileBytes {
337				return nil, 0, errors.New("redacted snapshot exceeds file limit")
338			}
339		}
340		output.Write(data[last:])
341		if output.Len() > MaxFileBytes {
342			return nil, 0, errors.New("redacted snapshot exceeds file limit")
343		}
344		return output.Bytes(), len(chosen), nil
345	}
346

"explicit-base: local base ref refs/heads/b509448 does not exist (restore the named local base branch); branch-relation: containment cannot be proved from exact local branch and base OIDs (restore both local refs)". Even though the branch is an ancestor of main. Also passing `dev sweep --merged-worktrees --base origin/main` gives "explicit-base: containment base refs/heads/origin/main does not exist" (remote-tracking ref treated as local branch). Separately, `dev sweep --apply --yes` computes all plans up front; after the first worktree removal, all remaining plans fail with "stale taskflow plan: fresh ... authority differs", requiring re-running sweep once per item.

The sweep apply loop (internal/cli/sweep.go or taskflow) that builds all plans first and applies sequentially; how plans are bound to "authority" (worktree list etc.), and whether there is an existing pattern for re-planning an item right before apply (e.g. Plan -> Apply per item) used elsewhere (triage batches, flowtui).

//go:build !linux && !darwin && !windows

package configedit

import (
	"errors"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
)

type Metadata struct{}

func checkDirectory(string, fs.FileInfo) error              { return nil }
func captureMetadata(string, fs.FileInfo) (Metadata, error) { return Metadata{}, nil }
func (Metadata) prepare(*os.File) error {
	return errors.New("configuration writes require a verified macOS/Linux/Android security backend")
}

func checkAncestor(string, fs.FileInfo) error { return nil }

func sameDevice(string, string, fs.FileInfo, fs.FileInfo) bool { return true }

func fileIdentity(string, fs.FileInfo) string { return "unsupported" }

func makeDirectory(path string) error                     { return os.Mkdir(path, 0o700) }
func privateRecoveryMode(_ string, info fs.FileInfo) bool { return info.Mode().Perm() == 0o700 }

func restorableMode(mode uint32) bool { return mode & ^uint32(0o777) == 0 && mode&0o022 == 0 }
//go:build windows

package configedit

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	goruntime "runtime"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf16"
	"unsafe"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/privatefile"
	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

// Metadata retains the source descriptor; it stays in private recovery only.
type Metadata struct {
	Present    bool   `json:"present"`
	Descriptor string `json:"descriptor,omitempty"`
}

func metadataHandle(path string) (windows.Handle, windows.ByHandleFileInformation, error) {
	var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	p, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, info, err
	}
	h, err := windows.CreateFile(p, windows.READ_CONTROL|windows.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, windows.FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT|windows.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, info, err
	}
	if err = windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(h, &info); err != nil || info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 {
		windows.CloseHandle(h)
		return 0, info, errors.New("unsafe Windows file identity")
	}
	return h, info, nil
}
func trustedSID(sid string) bool {
	user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
	return err == nil && (sid == user.User.Sid.String() || sid == "S-1-5-18" || sid == "S-1-5-32-544")
}
func validateDescriptor(sd *windows.SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR, parent bool) error {
	owner, _, err := sd.Owner()
	if err != nil || owner == nil || !trustedSID(owner.String()) {
		return errors.New("untrusted Windows file owner")
	}
	acl, _, err := sd.DACL()
	if err != nil || acl == nil {
		return errors.New("Windows file requires an explicit DACL")
	}
	// Ancestors may permit directory creation (the Windows volume root does).
	// The immediate publication directory must prohibit writes by other users.
	mask := windows.ACCESS_MASK(windows.WRITE_DAC | windows.WRITE_OWNER | windows.DELETE | 0x40)
	if parent {
		mask |= windows.FILE_WRITE_DATA | windows.FILE_APPEND_DATA | windows.FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES | windows.FILE_WRITE_EA
	}
	for i := uint16(0); i < acl.AceCount; i++ {
		var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
		if err := windows.GetAce(acl, uint32(i), &ace); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if ace.Header.AceFlags&windows.INHERIT_ONLY_ACE != 0 {
			continue
		}
		if ace.Header.AceType == windows.ACCESS_DENIED_ACE_TYPE {
			continue
		}
		if ace.Header.AceType != windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE {
			return errors.New("unsupported Windows access-control entry")
		}
		sid := (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&ace.SidStart)).String()
		// OWNER RIGHTS applies only to the already-validated object owner.
		if !trustedSID(sid) && sid != "S-1-3-4" && ace.Mask&(mask|windows.GENERIC_ALL|windows.GENERIC_WRITE) != 0 {
			label := "other"
			switch sid {
			case "S-1-1-0":
				label = "Everyone"
			case "S-1-5-11":
				label = "AuthenticatedUsers"
			case "S-1-5-32-545":
				label = "Users"
			case "S-1-3-0":
				label = "CreatorOwner"
			case "S-1-3-4":
				label = "OwnerRights"
			}
			return fmt.Errorf("Windows file permits foreign writes (principal=%s mask=%08x parent=%t)", label, uint32(ace.Mask), parent)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func securityAt(path string) (*windows.SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR, windows.ByHandleFileInformation, error) {
	h, info, err := metadataHandle(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, info, err
	}
	defer windows.CloseHandle(h)
	sd, err := windows.GetSecurityInfo(h, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.GROUP_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
	return sd, info, err
}
func checkAncestor(path string, _ fs.FileInfo) error {
	sd, _, err := securityAt(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = validateDescriptor(sd, false); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("ancestor level %d: %w", len(strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool { return r == '\\' || r == '/' })), err)
	}
	return nil
}
func checkDirectory(path string, _ fs.FileInfo) error {
	sd, _, err := securityAt(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return validateDescriptor(sd, true)
}
func captureMetadata(path string, expected fs.FileInfo) (Metadata, error) {
	sd, info, err := securityAt(path)
	if err != nil {
		return Metadata{}, err
	}
	current, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil || !os.SameFile(expected, current) || info.NumberOfLinks != 1 {
		return Metadata{}, ErrStale
	}
	if err = validateDescriptor(sd, true); err != nil {
		return Metadata{}, err
	}
	if info.FileAttributes & ^uint32(windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL|windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE) != 0 {
		return Metadata{}, errors.New("Windows file attributes require manual preservation")
	}
	if sacl, _, e := sd.SACL(); e != nil && !errors.Is(e, windows.ERROR_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND) || sacl != nil && sacl.AceCount > 0 {
		return Metadata{}, errors.New("Windows integrity metadata requires manual preservation")
	}
	h, opened, e := metadataHandle(path)
	if e != nil {
		return Metadata{}, e
	}
	defer windows.CloseHandle(h)
	if opened.VolumeSerialNumber != info.VolumeSerialNumber || opened.FileIndexHigh != info.FileIndexHigh || opened.FileIndexLow != info.FileIndexLow {
		return Metadata{}, ErrStale
	}
	if e = onlyDefaultStream(h); e != nil {
		return Metadata{}, e
	}

	return Metadata{Present: true, Descriptor: sd.String()}, nil
}
func (m Metadata) prepare(file *os.File) error {
	var sd *windows.SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR
	var err error
	if m.Present {
		sd, err = windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString(m.Descriptor)
	} else {
		sd, err = privatefile.Descriptor(false)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = validateDescriptor(sd, true); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if sacl, _, e := sd.SACL(); e != nil && !errors.Is(e, windows.ERROR_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND) || sacl != nil && sacl.AceCount > 0 {
		return errors.New("Windows integrity metadata requires manual preservation")
	}
	acl, _, err := sd.DACL()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	owner, _, err := sd.Owner()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	group, _, err := sd.Group()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	control, _, err := sd.Control()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	flags := windows.SECURITY_INFORMATION(windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION | windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
	if group != nil {
		flags |= windows.GROUP_SECURITY_INFORMATION
	}
	if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED != 0 {
		flags |= windows.PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION
	} else {
		flags |= windows.UNPROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION
	}
	original := windows.Handle(file.Fd())
	var originalInfo windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if err = windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(original, &originalInfo); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	name, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(file.Name())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	h, err := windows.CreateFile(name, windows.READ_CONTROL|windows.WRITE_DAC|windows.WRITE_OWNER|windows.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, windows.FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer windows.CloseHandle(h)
	var stageInfo windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(h, &stageInfo) != nil || stageInfo.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 || stageInfo.NumberOfLinks != 1 || stageInfo.VolumeSerialNumber != originalInfo.VolumeSerialNumber || stageInfo.FileIndexHigh != originalInfo.FileIndexHigh || stageInfo.FileIndexLow != originalInfo.FileIndexLow {
		return ErrStale
	}
	stageACL := acl
	var aclBuffer []byte
	if control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
		stageACL, aclBuffer, err = explicitACL(acl)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if err = windows.SetSecurityInfo(h, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, flags, owner, group, stageACL, nil); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	goruntime.KeepAlive(aclBuffer)
	actual, err := windows.GetSecurityInfo(h, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.GROUP_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if m.Present && !preservesDescriptor(actual, sd) {
		return fmt.Errorf("Windows security descriptor did not round-trip (%s)", descriptorDelta(actual, sd))
	}
	if !m.Present {
		ao, _, e := actual.Owner()
		if e != nil || !ao.Equals(owner) {
			return errors.New("private stage owner mismatch")
		}
		ac, _, e := actual.DACL()
		if e != nil || ac == nil || ac.AceCount != acl.AceCount {
			return errors.New("private stage ACL mismatch")
		}
		for i := uint16(0); i < acl.AceCount; i++ {
			var aa, wa *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
			if windows.GetAce(ac, uint32(i), &aa) != nil || windows.GetAce(acl, uint32(i), &wa) != nil {
				return errors.New("private stage ACL unavailable")
			}
			if aa.Header != wa.Header || aa.Mask != wa.Mask || !(*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&aa.SidStart)).Equals((*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&wa.SidStart))) {
				return errors.New("private stage ACL mismatch")
			}
		}

	}
	return nil
}
func sameDevice(a, b string, _, _ fs.FileInfo) bool {
	ha, ia, ea := metadataHandle(a)
	if ea != nil {
		return false
	}
	defer windows.CloseHandle(ha)
	hb, ib, eb := metadataHandle(b)
	if eb != nil {
		return false
	}
	defer windows.CloseHandle(hb)
	return ia.VolumeSerialNumber == ib.VolumeSerialNumber
}
func fileIdentity(path string, _ fs.FileInfo) string {
	h, i, err := metadataHandle(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "unavailable"
	}
	defer windows.CloseHandle(h)
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%d", i.VolumeSerialNumber, i.FileIndexHigh, i.FileIndexLow)
}
func makeDirectory(path string) error { return privatefile.MakeDir(path) }
func privateRecoveryMode(path string, info fs.FileInfo) bool {
	return privatefile.Check(path, info, true) == nil
}

// SetSecurityInfo may normalize automatic-inheritance bookkeeping. Compare
// owner/group, protection and every ordered ACE rather than SDDL formatting.
func preservesDescriptor(a, b *windows.SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR) bool {
	ao, _, ae := a.Owner()
	bo, _, be := b.Owner()
	if ae != nil || be != nil || ao == nil || bo == nil || !ao.Equals(bo) {
		return false
	}
	ag, _, ae := a.Group()
	bg, _, be := b.Group()
	if ae != nil || be != nil || (ag == nil) != (bg == nil) || ag != nil && !ag.Equals(bg) {
		return false
	}
	ac, _, ae := a.Control()
	bc, _, be := b.Control()
	if ae != nil || be != nil {
		return false
	}
	bookkeeping := windows.SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR_CONTROL(windows.SE_DACL_AUTO_INHERITED | windows.SE_DACL_AUTO_INHERIT_REQ | windows.SE_SACL_AUTO_INHERITED | windows.SE_SACL_AUTO_INHERIT_REQ)
	if ac & ^bookkeeping != bc & ^bookkeeping {
		return false
	}
	aa, _, ae := a.DACL()
	ba, _, be := b.DACL()
	if ae != nil || be != nil || aa == nil || ba == nil {
		return false
	}
	expected := make([]*windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE, ba.AceCount)
	for i := range expected {
		if windows.GetAce(ba, uint32(i), &expected[i]) != nil {
			return false
		}
	}
	cursor := 0
	for i := uint16(0); i < aa.AceCount; i++ {
		var actual *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
		if windows.GetAce(aa, uint32(i), &actual) != nil {
			return false
		}
		if cursor < len(expected) && sameACE(actual, expected[cursor], false) {
			cursor++
			continue
		}
		// Modern SetSecurityInfo may materialize redundant parent inheritance on
		// legacy unprotected descriptors. Accept only an exact permission duplicate
		// of an already-preserved explicit ACE; never new SIDs, masks or ordering.
		redundant := false
		if actual.Header.AceFlags&windows.INHERITED_ACE != 0 {
			for _, prior := range expected[:cursor] {
				if prior.Header.AceFlags&windows.INHERITED_ACE == 0 && sameACE(actual, prior, true) {
					redundant = true
					break
				}
			}
		}
		if !redundant {
			return false
		}
	}
	if cursor != len(expected) {
		return false
	}

	return true
}

// Reject alternate streams instead of losing data when replacing the main text.
func onlyDefaultStream(h windows.Handle) error {
	data := make([]byte, 64<<10)
	if err := windows.GetFileInformationByHandleEx(h, windows.FileStreamInfo, &data[0], uint32(len(data))); err != nil {
		return errors.New("Windows stream metadata cannot be verified")
	}
	offset := 0
	for count := 0; count < 1024; count++ {
		if offset+24 > len(data) {
			return errors.New("invalid Windows stream metadata")
		}
		next := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[offset:]))
		size := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[offset+4:]))
		if size%2 != 0 || size <= 0 || offset+24+size > len(data) {
			return errors.New("invalid Windows stream metadata")
		}
		units := make([]uint16, size/2)
		for i := range units {
			units[i] = binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[offset+24+i*2:])
		}
		if string(utf16.Decode(units)) != "::$DATA" {
			return errors.New("alternate Windows streams require manual preservation")
		}
		if next == 0 {
			return nil
		}
		if next < 24 || next%8 != 0 {
			return errors.New("invalid Windows stream metadata")
		}
		offset += next
	}
	return errors.New("Windows stream metadata exceeds limit")
}

func restorableMode(mode uint32) bool { return mode == 0o666 || mode == 0o444 }

func descriptorDelta(a, b *windows.SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR) string {
	ac, _, _ := a.Control()
	bc, _, _ := b.Control()
	ao, _, _ := a.Owner()
	bo, _, _ := b.Owner()
	ag, _, _ := a.Group()
	bg, _, _ := b.Group()
	aa, _, _ := a.DACL()
	ba, _, _ := b.DACL()
	owner := ao != nil && bo != nil && ao.Equals(bo)
	group := ag == nil && bg == nil || ag != nil && bg != nil && ag.Equals(bg)
	countA, countB := -1, -1
	if aa != nil {
		countA = int(aa.AceCount)
	}
	if ba != nil {
		countB = int(ba.AceCount)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("control=%04x/%04x owner_equal=%t group_equal=%t ACE_count=%d/%d", uint16(ac), uint16(bc), owner, group, countA, countB)
}

// Supplying inherited ACEs to an unprotected descriptor duplicates the parent
// inheritance. Copy only explicit entries; compare the regenerated full ACL.
func explicitACL(source *windows.ACL) (*windows.ACL, []byte, error) {
	if source == nil {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("missing source DACL")
	}
	header := unsafe.Slice((*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(source)), 8)
	data := append([]byte(nil), header...)
	count := uint16(0)
	for i := uint16(0); i < source.AceCount; i++ {
		var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
		if e := windows.GetAce(source, uint32(i), &ace); e != nil {
			return nil, nil, e
		}
		if ace.Header.AceFlags&windows.INHERITED_ACE != 0 {
			continue
		}
		size := int(ace.Header.AceSize)
		if size < 8 || len(data)+size > 65535 {
			return nil, nil, errors.New("unsupported DACL size")
		}
		data = append(data, unsafe.Slice((*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(ace)), size)...)
		count++
	}
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(data[2:4], uint16(len(data)))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(data[4:6], count)
	return (*windows.ACL)(unsafe.Pointer(&data[0])), data, nil
}

func sameACE(a, b *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE, ignoreInherited bool) bool {
	af, bf := a.Header.AceFlags, b.Header.AceFlags
	if ignoreInherited {
		af &^= windows.INHERITED_ACE
		bf &^= windows.INHERITED_ACE
	}
	return a.Header.AceType == b.Header.AceType && a.Header.AceSize == b.Header.AceSize && af == bf && a.Mask == b.Mask && (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&a.SidStart)).Equals((*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&b.SidStart)))
}

package configedit

import (
	"errors"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"syscall"
)

func checkFlags(_ *os.File, info fs.FileInfo) error {
	if info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t).Flags != 0 {
		return errors.New("configuration file flags require manual preservation")
	}
	return nil
}
//go:build linux

package configedit

import (
	"errors"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/platformfs"
	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
)

func checkFlags(file *os.File, _ fs.FileInfo) error {
	flags, err := unix.IoctlGetInt(int(file.Fd()), unix.FS_IOC_GETFLAGS)
	if err == unix.ENOTTY || err == unix.EOPNOTSUPP {
		return nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// Extents are an ordinary filesystem implementation flag. User-controlled
	// flags (including immutable, append-only and nodump) need native handling.
	if uint32(flags) & ^(0x00080000|platformfs.InheritedFileFlags()) != 0 {
		return errors.New("configuration inode flags require manual preservation")
	}
	return nil
}

75	func observeLimit(ctx context.Context, path string, limit int64) (Change, error) {

94			if next == c.anchor {
95				return c, e

97			c.anchor = next
98		}
99		root, held, err := safefile.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(path))
100		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {

140	func newWithLimits(ctx context.Context, paths []string, desired [][]byte, guards []string, fileLimit, totalLimit int, portable bool) (Plan, error) {
141		p := Plan{Changes: []Change{}, portable: portable}
142		if len(paths) != len(desired) {
143			return p, errors.New("mismatched edit paths")
144		}
145		seen := map[string]bool{}
146		totalBytes := 0
147		var deviceAnchor fs.FileInfo
148		var devicePath string
149		if len(paths) > 256 {
150			return p, errors.New("select at most 256 files per transaction")
151		}
152		for i, path := range paths {
153			if seen[path] {
154				return p, errors.New("duplicate edit path")
155			}
156			seen[path] = true
157			c, err := observeLimit(ctx, path, int64(fileLimit))
158			if err != nil {
159				return p, err
160			}
161			if deviceAnchor == nil {
162				deviceAnchor = c.anchorInfo
163				devicePath = c.anchor
164			} else if !sameDevice(devicePath, c.anchor, deviceAnchor, c.anchorInfo) {
165				return p, errors.New("configuration transitions must stay on one filesystem")
166			}
167			if c.info != nil && !sameDevice(c.Path, c.anchor, c.info, c.anchorInfo) {
168				return p, errors.New("mounted configuration file cannot be replaced")
169			}
170			totalBytes += len(c.before) + len(desired[i])
171			if totalBytes > totalLimit {
172				return p, errors.New("configuration transaction exceeds byte limit; select fewer files")
173			}
174			if len(desired[i]) > fileLimit {
175				return p, errors.New("configuration exceeds byte limit")
176			}
177			if desired[i] == nil {
178				if c.info == nil {
179					continue
180				}
181				c.Action = "remove"
182			} else {
183				c.after = append([]byte{}, desired[i]...)
184				c.AfterDigest = Digest(c.after)
185				if c.info != nil && bytes.Equal(c.before, c.after) {
186					continue
187				}
188				c.Action = "create"
189				if c.info != nil {
190					c.Action = "update"
191				}
192			}
193			p.changes = append(p.changes, c)
194			p.Changes = append(p.Changes, c)
195		}
196		for _, path := range guards {
197			c, err := observe(ctx, path)
198			if err != nil {
199				return p, err
200			}
201			p.guards = append(p.guards, c)
202		}
203		return p, nil
204	}

340					defer cancel()

385	func publish(ctx context.Context, c Change) error {
386		if err := safeParents(filepath.Dir(c.Path), true); err != nil {
387			return err
388		}
389		n, err := current(ctx, c)
390		if err != nil {
391			return err
392		}
393		root, held, err := safefile.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(c.Path))
394		if err != nil {
395			return err
396		}
397		defer root.Close()
398		if err = safefile.VerifyRoot(filepath.Dir(c.Path), held); err != nil {
399			return err
400		}
401		name := filepath.Base(c.Path)
402		switch c.Action {
403		case "create":
404			_, err = safefile.CreateNoClobberPrepared(ctx, root, name, c.after, c.mode, c.metadata.prepare)
405		case "update":
406			_, err = safefile.AtomicReplacePrepared(ctx, root, name, n.info, c.after, c.mode, c.metadata.prepare)
407		case "remove":
408			_, _, err = safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, root, name, n.info, c.limit)
409			if err == nil {
410				err = root.Remove(name)
411			}
412		default:
413			return errors.New("invalid configuration action")
414		}
415		if err != nil {
416			return err
417		}
418		return safefile.VerifyRoot(filepath.Dir(c.Path), held)
419	}

421	func writeReceipt(ctx context.Context, path string, r receipt) error {
422		b, err := json.Marshal(r)
423		if err != nil {
424			return err
425		}
426		if len(b) > maxReceiptBytes {
427			return errors.New("recovery receipt exceeds byte limit")
428		}
429		c, err := observeLimit(ctx, path, maxReceiptBytes)
430		if err != nil {
431			return err
432		}
433		c.after = b
434		c.Action = "create"
435		if c.info != nil {
436			c.Action = "update"
437		}
438		return publish(ctx, c)
439	}

441	// RestorePlan accepts only current bytes from either side of the transaction.
442	// Unpublished steps are skipped. Restore order reverses publication order.
443	func RestorePlan(ctx context.Context, recovery, id string) (Plan, error) {
444		var p Plan
445		if len(id) != 32 {
446			return p, errors.New("invalid recovery receipt")
447		}
448		if _, err := hex.DecodeString(id); err != nil {
449			return p, errors.New("invalid recovery receipt")
450		}
451		if err := validateRecovery(recovery); err != nil {
452			return p, err
453		}
454		record, err := observeLimit(ctx, filepath.Join(recovery, id+".json"), maxReceiptBytes)
455		b := record.before
456		if err != nil {
457			return p, err
458		}
459		var r receipt
460		d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(b))
461		d.DisallowUnknownFields()
462		if err = d.Decode(&r); err != nil {
463			return p, err
464		}
465		if r.Version != 1 || len(r.Images) > 1024 {
466			return p, errors.New("unsupported recovery receipt")
467		}
468		var paths []string
469		var contents [][]byte
470		for i := len(r.Images) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
471			x := r.Images[i]
472			limit := int64(maxBytes)
473			if r.Portable {
474				limit = maxTextBytes
475			}
476			n, err := observeLimit(ctx, x.Path, limit)
477			if err != nil {
478				return p, err
479			}
480			exists := n.info != nil
481			if exists == x.BeforeExists && (!exists || bytes.Equal(n.before, x.Before)) {
482				continue
483			}
484			if !x.AfterKnown || exists != x.AfterExists || exists && (!bytes.Equal(n.before, x.After) || !reflect.DeepEqual(stateOf(n), x.AfterState)) {
485				return p, fmt.Errorf("%s changed after the operation: %w", x.Path, ErrStale)
486			}
487			paths = append(paths, x.Path)
488			if x.BeforeExists {
489				contents = append(contents, append([]byte{}, x.Before...))
490			} else {
491				contents = append(contents, nil)
492			}
493		}
494		if r.Portable {
495			if len(paths) > 1 {
496				return p, errors.New("invalid portable receipt")
497			}
498			p, err = newWithLimits(ctx, paths, contents, nil, maxTextBytes, 2*maxTextBytes, true)
499		} else {
500			p, err = New(ctx, paths, contents, nil)
501		}
502		if err != nil {
503			return p, err
504		}
505		for i := range p.changes {
506			for _, x := range r.Images {
507				if x.Path == p.changes[i].Path && x.BeforeExists {
508					if !restorableMode(x.Mode) {
509						return p, errors.New("unsafe recovery file mode")
510					}
511					p.changes[i].mode = fs.FileMode(x.Mode)
512					observed := p.changes[i].metadata
513					p.changes[i].observedMetadata = &observed
514					p.changes[i].metadata = x.Metadata
515					break
516				}
517			}
518		}
519		p = p.WithLocks(r.Locks...)
520		return p, nil
521	}

523	func safeParents(path string, create bool) (resultErr error) {
524		// Root anchors may have platform aliases (/var on macOS). Validate below the
525		// resolved filesystem root, rejecting every user-controlled symlink component.
526		anchor, err := platformfs.Resolve(path)
527		if err != nil {
528			return err
529		}
530		defer func() { resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, anchor.Verify()) }()
531		rootPath := anchor.Path
532		parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(path, rootPath), string(filepath.Separator))
533		cur := rootPath
534		for _, part := range parts {
535			if part == "" {
536				continue
537			}
538			cur = filepath.Join(cur, part)
539			info, err := os.Lstat(cur)
540			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
541				if !create {
542					return nil
543				}
544				if err = makeDirectory(cur); err != nil {
545					return err
546				}
547				info, err = os.Lstat(cur)
548			}
549			if err != nil {
550				return err
551			}
552			if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" && (cur == "/var" || cur == "/tmp") && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
553				target, e := os.Readlink(cur)
554				if e == nil && (target == "private"+cur || target == "/private"+cur) {
555					continue
556				}
557			}
558			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.IsDir() {
559				return fmt.Errorf("unsafe directory %s", cur)
560			}
561			if err := checkAncestor(cur, info); err != nil {
562				return err
563			}
564		}
565		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
566		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && !create {
567			return nil
568		}
569		if err != nil {
570			return err
571		}
572		return checkDirectory(path, info)
573	}

580		}
581		for parent := path; ; parent = filepath.Dir(parent) {
582			if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(parent, ".git")); err == nil {
583				return errors.New("recovery must be outside Git")
584			}
585			if filepath.Dir(parent) == parent {
586				break
587			}
588		}
589		if info, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil && !privateRecoveryMode(path, info) {
590			return errors.New("recovery directory must have mode 0700")
591		}
592		return nil
593	}
594	func prepareRecovery(path string) error {
595		if err := validateRecovery(path); err != nil {
596			return err
597		}
598		return safeParents(path, true)
599	}
600	
601	// RequireContents binds generated output to the exact input bytes it used,
602	// closing the read/render/capture race before handing a plan to a caller.
603	func (p Plan) RequireContents(expected map[string][]byte) error {
604		for path, data := range expected {
605			found := false
606			for _, c := range append(append([]Change(nil), p.guards...), p.changes...) {
607				if c.Path == path {
608					found = true
609					if !bytes.Equal(c.before, data) {
610						return ErrStale
611					}
612				}
613			}
614			if !found {
615				return errors.New("uncaptured source dependency")
616			}
617		}
618		return nil
619	}
620	
621	// Diff renders a review-only, redacted line comparison without temporary files.
622	// It is deliberately not an apply-able patch: authority remains in Plan.
623	func (p Plan) Diff(redact func(string) string) string {
624		var out strings.Builder
625		for _, c := range p.changes {
626			fmt.Fprintf(&out, "--- %s\n+++ %s\n", c.Path, c.Path)
627			before := strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(string(c.before), "\n"), "\n")
628			after := strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(string(c.after), "\n"), "\n")
629			if c.info == nil {
630				before = nil
631			}
632			if c.Action == "remove" {
633				after = nil
634			}
635			count := len(before)
636			if len(after) > count {
637				count = len(after)
638			}
639			for i := 0; i < count; i++ {
640				if i < len(before) && i < len(after) && before[i] == after[i] {
641					continue
642				}
643				if i < len(before) {
644					fmt.Fprintf(&out, "-%d %s\n", i+1, redact(before[i]))
645				}
646				if i < len(after) {
647					fmt.Fprintf(&out, "+%d %s\n", i+1, redact(after[i]))
648				}
649			}
650		}
651		return out.String()
652	}
653	
654	// A durable after-state lets undo reject later replacement, metadata changes or
655	// edits even when another writer happens to restore the same bytes.
656	type fileState struct {
657		Identity string   `json:"identity"`
658		Mode     uint32   `json:"mode"`
659		Modified int64    `json:"modified"`
660		Digest   string   `json:"digest"`
661		Metadata Metadata `json:"metadata"`
662	}
663	
664	func stateOf(c Change) *fileState {
665		if c.info == nil {
666			return nil
667		}
668		return &fileState{fileIdentity(c.Path, c.info), uint32(c.info.Mode()), c.info.ModTime().UnixNano(), c.BeforeDigest, sourceMetadata(c)}
669	}
670	
671	// SourceToken binds private saved plans without exposing metadata or content.
672	func (p Plan) SourceToken(path string) (string, error) {
673		for _, c := range append(append([]Change(nil), p.guards...), p.changes...) {
674			if c.Path == path {
675				state := stateOf(c)
676				anchor := fileIdentity(c.anchor, c.anchorInfo)
677				if anchor == "unavailable" || state != nil && state.Identity == "unavailable" {
678					return "", ErrStale
679				}
680				b, err := json.Marshal(struct {
681					State  *fileState
682					Anchor string
683				}{state, anchor})
684				if err != nil {
685					return "", err
686				}
687				return Digest(b), nil
688			}
689		}
690		return "", errors.New("uncaptured source")
691	}
692	
693	// InspectToken captures source identity without changing files.
694	func InspectToken(ctx context.Context, path string) (string, error) {
695		c, err := observeLimit(ctx, path, maxTextBytes)
696		if err != nil {
697			return "", err
698		}
699		return (Plan{changes: []Change{c}}).SourceToken(path)
700	}
701	
702	// WritePrivate writes a bounded opaque state record using the same native
703	// metadata and identity guards, without treating it as a fleet fragment.
704	func WritePrivate(ctx context.Context, path string, data []byte, overwrite bool) error {
705		if len(data) > maxReceiptBytes {
706			return errors.New("private record exceeds byte limit")
707		}
708		parent := filepath.Dir(path)
709		info, err := os.Lstat(parent)
710		if err != nil {
711			return err
712		}
713		if err = privatefile.Check(parent, info, true); err != nil {
714			return err
715		}
716		c, err := observeLimit(ctx, path, maxReceiptBytes)
717		if err != nil {
718			return err
719		}
720		if c.info != nil {
721			if !overwrite {
722				return fs.ErrExist
723			}
724			if err = privatefile.Check(path, c.info, false); err != nil {
725				return err
726			}
727		}
728		c.mode = 0o600
729		c.after = data
730		c.AfterDigest = Digest(data)
731		c.Action = "create"
732		if c.info != nil {
733			c.Action = "update"
734		}
735		if err = publish(ctx, c); err != nil {
736			return err
737		}
738		current, err := observeLimit(ctx, path, maxReceiptBytes)
739		if err != nil || current.BeforeDigest != c.AfterDigest {
740			return ErrStale
741		}
742		return nil
743	}
744	
745	func sourceMetadata(c Change) Metadata {
746		if c.observedMetadata != nil {
747			return *c.observedMetadata
748		}
749		return c.metadata
750	}
751

48	func createNoClobberWithHooks(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode, hooks createNoClobberHooks) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
49		if root == nil {
50			return nil, errors.New("atomic create: nil root")
51		}
52		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
53			return nil, err
54		}
55		removeStage := hooks.removeStage
56		if removeStage == nil {
57			removeStage = func(root *os.Root, name string) error { return root.Remove(name) }
58		}
59		syncDirectory := hooks.syncRoot
60		if syncDirectory == nil {
61			syncDirectory = syncRoot
62		}
63		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode, hooks.prepare)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, err
66		}
67		defer func() {
68			if stagedName != "" {
69				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
70			}
71		}()
72		moved, err := platformfs.PublishNoReplace(root, stagedName, name)
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, fmt.Errorf("publish %q without replacement: %w", name, err)
75		}
76		rollbackPublication := func(cause error) error {
77			current, statErr := root.Lstat(name)
78			if statErr != nil || unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, current) {
79				return fmt.Errorf("create %q failed after publication; destination ownership is indeterminate: %w",
80					name, errors.Join(cause, statErr, ErrChanged))
81			}
82			removeErr := root.Remove(name)
83			var syncErr error
84			if removeErr == nil {
85				syncErr = syncDirectory(root)
86			}
87			if removeErr != nil {
88				return fmt.Errorf("create %q failed and publication rollback failed: %w", name, errors.Join(cause, removeErr))
89			}
90			return fmt.Errorf("create %q failed after publication and was rolled back: %w", name, errors.Join(cause, syncErr))
91		}
92		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, rollbackPublication(fmt.Errorf("verify published file: %w", err))
95		}
96		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
97			return nil, rollbackPublication(fmt.Errorf("published file does not match staging file: %w", ErrChanged))
98		}
99		if !moved {
100			if err := removeStage(root, stagedName); err != nil {
101				return nil, rollbackPublication(fmt.Errorf("remove staging link: %w", err))
102			}
103		}
104		stagedName = ""
105		published, err = root.Lstat(name)
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, rollbackPublication(fmt.Errorf("refresh published file: %w", err))
108		}
109		if err := syncDirectory(root); err != nil {
110			return nil, rollbackPublication(fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory: %w", err))
111		}
112		return published, nil
113	}

115	// CreatePrivateNoClobber is CreateNoClobber with a clamped owner-only final
116	// mode. executable is the only way to grant execute permission.
117	func CreatePrivateNoClobber(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, data []byte, executable bool) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
118		if int64(len(data)) > CompiledMaxFileBytes {
119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("file %q is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", name, len(data), CompiledMaxFileBytes, ErrFileLimit)
120		}
121		return CreateNoClobber(ctx, root, name, data, OwnerPrivateMode(executable))
122	}

124	// AtomicReplace stages and syncs data in the target directory, revalidates the
125	// existing regular file against observed, and atomically renames the staged file
126	// over it. Atomic describes publication, not a filesystem compare-and-swap: the
127	// metadata check and rename are separate syscalls. Callers performing digest-CAS
128	// must hold an exclusive cooperative operation lease, obtain observed from a
129	// fresh stable read/hash, and retain any rollback copy before invoking this
130	// primitive. It never follows a symlink or reparse point.
131	func AtomicReplace(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
132		return AtomicReplacePrepared(ctx, root, name, observed, data, finalMode, nil)
133	}

135	// AtomicReplacePrepared restores caller-validated metadata on the private stage
136	// before syncing and publishing it. prepare must not close or rename the file.
137	func AtomicReplacePrepared(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, observed fs.FileInfo, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode, prepare func(*os.File) error) (fs.FileInfo, error) {
138		if root == nil {
139			return nil, errors.New("atomic replace: nil root")
140		}
141		if observed == nil {
142			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replace %q without observed state: %w", name, ErrReplaceTarget)
143		}
144		if err := validateTargetName(name); err != nil {
145			return nil, err
146		}
147		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
148			return nil, err
149		}
150		stagedName, staged, err := stageRegular(ctx, root, data, finalMode, prepare)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, err
153		}
154		defer func() {
155			if stagedName != "" {
156				_ = root.Remove(stagedName)
157			}
158		}()
159		if err := verifyReplaceTarget(root, name, observed); err != nil {
160			return nil, err
161		}
162		if err := root.Rename(stagedName, name); err != nil {
163			return nil, fmt.Errorf("atomically replace %q: %w", name, err)
164		}
165		stagedName = ""
166		published, err := root.Lstat(name)
167		if err != nil {
168			return nil, fmt.Errorf("verify replacement %q: %w", name, err)
169		}
170		if unsafeLink(published) || !published.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(staged, published) {
171			return nil, fmt.Errorf("replacement %q does not match staging file: %w", name, ErrChanged)
172		}
173		if err := syncRoot(root); err != nil {
174			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sync destination directory after replacing %q: %w", name, err)
175		}
176		return published, nil
177	}

198	func stageRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, data []byte, finalMode fs.FileMode, prepare func(*os.File) error) (string, fs.FileInfo, error) {
199		if finalMode&^fs.ModePerm != 0 {
200			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported final file mode %s", finalMode)
201		}
202		var name string
203		var writer *os.File
204		for attempt := 0; attempt < 32; attempt++ {
205			candidate, err := randomStageName()
206			if err != nil {
207				return "", nil, err
208			}
209			writer, err = root.OpenFile(candidate, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
210			if err == nil {
211				name = candidate
212				break
213			}
214			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
215				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("create private staging file: %w", err)
216			}
217		}
218		if writer == nil {
219			return "", nil, errors.New("create private staging file: too many name collisions")
220		}
221		keep := true
222		defer func() {
223			if keep {
224				_ = writer.Close()
225				_ = root.Remove(name)
226			}
227		}()
228		if err := writer.Chmod(finalMode.Perm()); err != nil {
229			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("set staged file mode: %w", err)
230		}
231		if prepare != nil {
232			if err := prepare(writer); err != nil {
233				return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("prepare staged metadata: %w", err)
234			}
235		}
236		if err := writeAllContext(ctx, writer, data); err != nil {
237			return "", nil, err
238		}
239		if err := writer.Sync(); err != nil {
240			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("sync staged file: %w", err)
241		}
242		opened, err := writer.Stat()
243		if err != nil {
244			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("inspect staged file: %w", err)
245		}
246		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
247			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("close staged file: %w", err)
248		}
249		keep = false
250		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
251		if err != nil {
252			_ = root.Remove(name)
253			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("reopen staged file name: %w", err)
254		}
255		if unsafeLink(current) || !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !SameFileState(opened, current) {
256			_ = root.Remove(name)
257			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("staging file changed before publication: %w", ErrChanged)
258		}
259		return name, current, nil
260	}
261	
262	func validateTargetName(name string) error {
263		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
264			return fmt.Errorf("invalid atomic file name %q: %w", name, err)
265		}
266		return nil
267	}
268	
269	func writeAllContext(ctx context.Context, writer io.Writer, data []byte) error {
270		for len(data) > 0 {
271			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
272				return err
273			}
274			written, err := writer.Write(data)
275			if err != nil {
276				return err
277			}
278			if written == 0 {
279				return io.ErrShortWrite
280			}
281			data = data[written:]
282		}
283		return context.Cause(ctx)
284	}
285	
286	func randomStageName() (string, error) {
287		var random [16]byte
288		if _, err := rand.Read(random[:]); err != nil {
289			return "", fmt.Errorf("generate staging file name: %w", err)
290		}
291		return ".dev-safefile-" + hex.EncodeToString(random[:]) + ".tmp", nil
292	}

297		return createNoClobberWithHooks(ctx, root, name, data, mode, createNoClobberHooks{prepare: prepare})
298	}

// Package platformfs supplies narrowly scoped native filesystem capabilities.
package platformfs

import (
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"runtime"
)

// Anchor is a verified starting directory for a guarded path walk. Android
// apps can stat their system ancestors but cannot open them for directory reads.
// Verify rechecks the complete platform prefix; callers still guard every
// component below Path and revalidate their held directory/file identities.
type Anchor struct {
	Path   string
	verify func() error
}

func (a Anchor) Verify() error {
	if a.verify != nil {
		return a.verify()
	}
	return nil
}

func filesystemRoot(path string) Anchor {
	return Anchor{Path: filepath.VolumeName(path) + string(filepath.Separator)}
}

var appDataLabel = regexp.MustCompile(`^u:object_r:app_data_file:s0(:c[0-9]+(,c[0-9]+)*)?\x00?$`)

// KernelLabel recognizes Android's inherited app-data label. It may be observed
// and compared, never restored with setxattr or omitted from identity checks.
func KernelLabel(name string, value []byte) bool {
	return kernelLabel(runtime.GOOS, name, value)
}

func kernelLabel(goos, name string, value []byte) bool {
	return goos == "android" && name == "security.selinux" && len(value) <= 4096 && appDataLabel.Match(value)
}

// InheritedFileFlags reports read-only flags supplied by Android's filesystem.
// FS_ENCRYPT_FL describes transparent file encryption; dev never sets/clears it.
func InheritedFileFlags() uint32 {
	if runtime.GOOS == "android" {
		return 0x00000800
	}
	return 0
}
package platformfs

import (
	"errors"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

// PublishNoReplace atomically publishes a staged file within one held directory.
// moved reports whether publication consumed the staging name. Android uses
// RENAME_NOREPLACE because its app sandbox forbids hard links. Unsupported
// syscalls/filesystems fail; ordinary overwriting rename is never a fallback.
func PublishNoReplace(root *os.Root, stage, destination string) (moved bool, err error) {
	if root == nil {
		return false, errors.New("publish without replacement requires a held directory")
	}
	for _, name := range []string{stage, destination} {
		if name == "" || name == "." || name == ".." || strings.ContainsAny(name, "/\\\x00") {
			return false, errors.New("publish without replacement requires direct child names")
		}
	}
	return publishNoReplace(root, stage, destination)
}
package platformfs

import (
	"os"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

func publishNoReplace(root *os.Root, stage, destination string) (bool, error) {
	directory, err := root.Open(".")
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	defer directory.Close()
	fd := int(directory.Fd())
	err = unix.Renameat2(fd, stage, fd, destination, unix.RENAME_NOREPLACE)
	return err == nil, err
}

package platformfs

import "os"

func publishNoReplace(root *os.Root, stage, destination string) (bool, error) {
	return false, root.Link(stage, destination)
}

func Resolve(path string) (Anchor, error) { return filesystemRoot(path), nil }

//go:build darwin

package safefile

import (
	"io/fs"
	"syscall"
)

func samePlatformState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
	leftStat, leftOK := left.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
	rightStat, rightOK := right.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
	if !leftOK || !rightOK {
		return leftOK == rightOK
	}
	return leftStat.Ctimespec.Sec == rightStat.Ctimespec.Sec &&
		leftStat.Ctimespec.Nsec == rightStat.Ctimespec.Nsec
}
//go:build !windows

package privatefile

import (
	"errors"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"syscall"
)

func MakeDir(path string) error { return os.Mkdir(path, 0o700) }
func Check(_ string, info fs.FileInfo, dir bool) error {
	stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
	if !ok || stat.Uid != uint32(os.Getuid()) || info.Mode().Perm()&0o077 != 0 {
		return errors.New("private artifacts must be owned by the current user and private")
	}
	if !dir && (!info.Mode().IsRegular() || stat.Nlink != 1) {
		return errors.New("private artifact is not a single-link regular file")
	}
	return nil
}
// Package privatefile protects private state on Unix and Windows.
package privatefile

import (
	"errors"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

// EnsureDir creates private directories without following user-controlled links.
func EnsureDir(path string) error {
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
		parent := filepath.Dir(path)
		if parent == path {
			return err
		}
		if _, e := os.Lstat(parent); errors.Is(e, fs.ErrNotExist) {
			if e = EnsureDir(parent); e != nil {
				return e
			}
		}
		if err = MakeDir(path); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist) {
			return errors.New("cannot create private directory")
		}
		info, err = os.Lstat(path)
	}
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return errors.New("unsafe private directory")
	}
	return Check(path, info, true)
}
