128				map[string]string{"branch-ref": observed.branchRef, "branch-oid": observed.branchOID, "base-ref": observed.baseRef, "base-oid": observed.baseOID},
129			))
130		}
131		effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
132			EffectDeleteTask, "CAS-delete the DONE task record last", candidate.ID, true, false,
133			map[string]string{"expected-revision": record.Revision},
134		))
135	
136		confirmation := Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Retire this DONE task and its eligible local resources?"}
137		if options.DeleteBranch && mode != task.ModeDirect && candidate.Branch != candidate.Base && observed.branchExists {
138			confirmation = Confirmation{
139				Kind: ConfirmationTyped, Token: "DELETE " + candidate.Branch,
140				Prompt: "Type DELETE " + candidate.Branch + " to remove the contained local branch under this exact plan",
141			}
142		}
143		retained := retireRetainedResources(candidate, observed, noCheckout, options)
144		return PlanSpec{
145			Authority:         mergeAuthority(retireTaskAuthority(record), observed.authority()),
146			Conditions:        conditions,
147			Effects:           effects,
148			RetainedResources: retained,
149			Confirmation:      confirmation,
150			FallbackCommand:   retireFallback(candidate.ID, options),
151			Summary:           "Retire " + candidate.Title(),
152			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
153		}
154	}
155	
156	func retireTaskAuthority(record task.Record) map[string]string {
157		candidate := record.Task
158		return map[string]string{
159			"task.id": record.Task.ID, "task.revision": record.Revision,
160			"task.mode": string(candidate.EffectiveMode()), "task.state": string(candidate.State),
161			"task.repo": candidate.Repo, "task.repo-path": candidate.RepoPath,
162			"task.branch": candidate.Branch, "task.base": candidate.Base,
163			"task.worktree-path": candidate.WorktreePath,
164			"task.runtime-name":  candidate.RuntimeName, "task.runtime-handle": candidate.RuntimeHandle,
165		}
166	}
167	
168	func retireRepositoryCondition(observed destructiveObservation) Condition {
169		if observed.repoErr != nil {
170			return condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
171				observed.repoErr.Error(), "restore the exact repository before retirement")
172		}
173		return condition(ConditionRepoIdentity, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
174			"Git main "+observed.repoPath+" with common directory "+observed.gitCommonDir, "")
175	}
176	
177	func retireTaskClaimConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
178		inventoryCondition := condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
179			"task inventory is complete for retirement claim checks", "")
180		switch {
181		case observed.taskInventoryErr != nil:
182			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
183				observed.taskInventoryErr.Error(), "repair task-store inventory before retirement")
184		case len(observed.taskIncomplete) > 0:
185			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
186				strings.Join(observed.taskIncomplete, "; "), "repair every corrupt or unresolvable task record")
187		}
188	
189		var conflicting []string
190		for _, claim := range observed.taskClaims {
191			if claim.ID != candidate.ID {
192				conflicting = append(conflicting, claim.ID+" ("+claim.Reason+")")
193			}
194		}
195		claimsCondition := condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
196			"only task "+candidate.ID+" claims the retirement branch/checkout", "")
197		if len(conflicting) > 0 {
198			claimsCondition = condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
199				"also claimed by "+strings.Join(conflicting, ", "),
200				"reconcile every conflicting task before removing shared resources")
201		}
202		return []Condition{inventoryCondition, claimsCondition}
203	}
204	
205	func retireCheckoutConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
206		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
207		if noCheckout {
208			paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(false)
209			exactVerdict := VerdictMet
210			exactEvidence := "persisted DONE task records no checkout and Git has no checkout for its branch"
211			if err != nil {
212				exactVerdict = VerdictError
213				exactEvidence = err.Error()
214			} else if len(paths) > 0 {
215				exactVerdict = VerdictBlocked
216				exactEvidence = "task branch is still checked out at " + strings.Join(paths, ", ")
217			}
218			return []Condition{
219				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
220					"no recorded checkout is the narrow persisted-DONE reap case", ""),
221				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence,
222					"reconcile the discovered checkout before retirement"),
223				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
224					"no worktree removal is requested", ""),
225				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
226					"no worktree registration will be removed", ""),
227				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
228					"branch identity is proved from the local ref", ""),
229				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
230					"no checkout status is required for record-only reaping", ""),
231				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
232					"no checkout Git operation can be removed", ""),
233				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
234					"no checkout bytes will be removed", ""),
235				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
236					"no checkout path is selected", ""),
237			}
238		}
239	
240		if !observed.worktreeFound {
241			verdict := VerdictBlocked
242			evidence := "the exact recorded checkout is not registered"
243			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
244				verdict = VerdictError
245				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
246			}
247			return []Condition{
248				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "restore or reconcile the exact checkout"),
249				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree identity is unavailable", "refresh Git topology"),
250				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree kind is unavailable", "refresh Git topology"),
251				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "worktree flags are unavailable", "refresh Git topology"),
252				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout branch is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
253				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout status is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
254				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "Git operation state is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
255				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout cleanliness is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
256				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictUnknown, requirementFor(mode == task.ModeWorktree), "checkout ownership is unavailable", "refresh repository topology"),
257			}
258		}
259	
260		exactVerdict := VerdictMet
261		exactEvidence := "registered path, repository, Git common directory, and live HEAD are exact"
262		switch {
263		case observed.worktree.Path != observed.checkout:
264			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered path differs from the exact selected checkout"
265		case observed.worktree.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir:
266			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered repository identity differs from the selected repository"
267		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.headErr != nil:
268			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
269		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head:
270			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry HEAD %s differs from live HEAD %s", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
271		case mode == task.ModeWorktree && observed.locator.HeadOID != "" && observed.locator.HeadOID != observed.head:
272			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("selected HEAD %s differs from live HEAD %s", observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
273		}
274	
275		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
276		kindEvidence := "Git main checkout retained"
277		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
278			kindEvidence = "registered non-main linked worktree"
279			if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
280				kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
281				kindEvidence = "worktree task does not resolve to a non-main linked worktree"
282			}
283		} else if !observed.worktree.Worktree.Main || observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare || observed.worktree.Path != observed.repoPath {
284			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
285			kindEvidence = "branch/direct task does not resolve to the exact non-bare Git main checkout"
286		}
287	
288		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
289		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"
290		flagRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
291		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
292			flagRequirement = RequirementRequired
293			if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
294				flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
295				flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
296			}
297		}
298	
299		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
300		branchEvidence := "canonical checkout branch is irrelevant because it is retained"
301		branchRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
302		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
303			branchRequirement = RequirementRequired
304			branchEvidence = "registry, status, branch ref, and live HEAD identify " + candidate.Branch
305			switch {
306			case observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch == "":
307				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered linked worktree is detached or unnamed"
308			case observed.statusErr != nil:
309				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
310			case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != candidate.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != candidate.Branch:
311				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q expected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, candidate.Branch)
312			case observed.branchOIDErr != nil:
313				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.branchOIDErr.Error()
314			case !observed.branchExists || observed.branchOID != observed.head:
315				branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("branch exists=%t branch OID=%q live HEAD=%q", observed.branchExists, observed.branchOID, observed.head)
316			}
317		}
318	
319		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
320		statusEvidence := "canonical checkout content is retained"
321		statusRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
322		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
323		operationEvidence := "canonical checkout Git operation is retained"
324		operationRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
325		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
326		cleanEvidence := "canonical checkout bytes are retained"
327		cleanRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
328		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
329			statusRequirement, operationRequirement, cleanRequirement = RequirementRequired, RequirementRequired, RequirementRequired
330			if observed.statusErr != nil {
331				statusVerdict, statusEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
332				cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
333			} else {
334				statusEvidence = observed.status.Summary()
335				if observed.status.Dirty() {
336					cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictBlocked, observed.status.Breakdown()
337				} else {
338					cleanEvidence = "checkout is clean"
339				}
340			}
341			if observed.operationErr != nil {
342				operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictError, observed.operationErr.Error()
343			} else if observed.inProgress {
344				operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress"
345			} else {
346				operationEvidence = "no Git operation is in progress"
347			}
348		}
349	
350		harnessVerdict := VerdictMet
351		harnessEvidence := "checkout has no strict Claude harness ownership evidence"
352		harnessRequirement := RequirementAdvisory
353		if mode == task.ModeWorktree {
354			harnessRequirement = RequirementRequired
355			if observed.isHarness {
356				harnessVerdict = VerdictBlocked
357				harnessEvidence = "checkout is strictly under harness root " + observed.harness.Root
358			}
359		}
360		return []Condition{
361			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
362			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "refresh the exact checkout identity"),
363			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "reconcile the task checkout mode"),
364			condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, flagRequirement, flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the worktree registration"),
365			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, branchRequirement, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named branch and HEAD"),
366			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, statusRequirement, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
367			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, operationRequirement, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
368			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, cleanRequirement, cleanEvidence, "commit or preserve every changed byte"),
369			condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, harnessVerdict, harnessRequirement, harnessEvidence, "let the harness retire its own checkout"),
370		}
371	}
372	
373	func retireRefConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
374		baseCondition := condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
375			fmt.Sprintf("local base %s at %s", candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
376		switch {
377		case candidate.Base == "":
378			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
379				"DONE retirement requires the task's explicit local base", "record the exact local base branch")
380		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
381			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
382				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair local base observation")
383		case !observed.baseExists:
384			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
385				"local base ref "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore the named local base branch")
386		case observed.baseOID == "":
387			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
388				"local base resolved to no commit", "restore the named local base branch")
389		}
390	
391		branchCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
392			fmt.Sprintf("local branch %s at %s", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID), "")
393		if observed.branchOIDErr != nil {
394			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
395				observed.branchOIDErr.Error(), "repair local task branch observation")
396		} else if !observed.branchExists {
397			if noCheckout {
398				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
399					"local task branch is already absent for a persisted DONE task with no checkout", "")
400			} else {
401				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
402					"local task branch "+observed.branchRef+" is missing", "restore the task branch before retiring its checkout")
403			}
404		} else if observed.branchOID == "" {
405			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
406				"local task branch resolved to no commit", "restore the local task branch")
407		}
408	
409		relationCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
410			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
411		switch {
412		case observed.branchOIDErr != nil || observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
413			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
414				"branch or base ref observation failed", "repair exact local ref observation")
415		case !observed.branchExists && noCheckout:
416			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
417				"missing branch is accepted only because persisted DONE records no checkout", "")
418		case observed.containedErr != nil:
419			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
420				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local containment observation")
421		case observed.branchExists && observed.baseExists && observed.branchOIDErr == nil && observed.baseOIDErr == nil && !observed.contained:
422			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
423				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is not contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID),
424				"integrate the task branch into the named local base first")
425		case !observed.branchExists || !observed.baseExists || observed.branchOID == "" || observed.baseOID == "":
426			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
427				"containment cannot be proved from exact local branch and base OIDs", "restore both local refs")
428		}
429		return []Condition{baseCondition, branchCondition, relationCondition}
430	}
431	
432	func retireArtifactCondition(observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) Condition {
433		if noCheckout {
434			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
435				"no checkout is recorded for artifact inspection", "")
436		}
437		switch {
438		case !observed.worktreeFound:
439			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
440				"artifact readiness requires the exact linked checkout", "restore the checkout")
441		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
442			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
443				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
444		case !observed.artifact.Ready():
445			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
446				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
447		default:
448			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
449				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "")
450		}
451	}
452	
453	func retireRuntimeConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
454		if noCheckout {
455			if candidate.RuntimeName != "" || candidate.RuntimeHandle != "" {
456				return []Condition{
457					condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
458						"task has a runtime hint but no exact checkout", "reconcile or clear the runtime hint outside retirement"),
459					condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
460						"runtime coverage cannot be tied to an exact checkout", "reconcile the missing checkout"),
461					condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
462						"caller containment cannot be inspected without a checkout", "reconcile the missing checkout"),
463				}
464			}
465			return []Condition{
466				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, "no runtime hint is recorded", ""),
467				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "no checkout or runtime hint requires cleanup", ""),
468				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "no checkout can contain the caller", ""),
469			}
470		}
471		return destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed)
472	}
473	
474	func destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
475		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
476			return []Condition{
477				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
478				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime observation"),
479				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime was not inspected", "run cleanup from outside the checkout"),
480			}
481		}
482		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + runtimeName(observed.runtime) + " is available"
483		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
484			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " reports unavailable; cleanup evidence still controls"
485		}
486		if observed.cleanupErr != nil {
487			return []Condition{
488				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, "select an available backend or use the explicit external acknowledgement"),
489				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.cleanupErr.Error(), "repair runtime enumeration or use the explicit external acknowledgement"),
490				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime occupancy failed", "run cleanup from outside the checkout"),
491			}
492		}
493		occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
494		occupancyEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%d eligible runtime session(s)", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions))
495		if observed.cleanup.RuntimeUnknown {
496			occupancyEvidence = "runtime enumeration failed and the external assume-no-runtime acknowledgement is recorded"
497		}
498		if len(observed.cleanup.Blockers) > 0 {
499			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
500			occupancyEvidence = strings.Join(observed.cleanup.Blockers, "; ")
501		}
502		callerVerdict := VerdictMet
503		callerEvidence := "caller is outside the target checkout and covering runtimes"
504		if observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
505			callerVerdict = VerdictBlocked
506			callerEvidence = "caller is inside the target checkout or a covering runtime"
507		}
508		return []Condition{
509			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, ""),
510			condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop active agents and leave mixed/caller runtimes intact"),
511			condition(ConditionCallerContainment, callerVerdict, RequirementRequired, callerEvidence, "run cleanup from outside the target checkout and runtime"),
512		}
513	}
514	
515	func retireBranchDeletionCondition(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool, options RetireOptions) Condition {
516		if !options.DeleteBranch {
517			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
518				"local task branch will be retained", "")
519		}
520		if candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
521			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
522				"direct tasks never delete their branch", "retire without branch deletion")
523		}
524		if candidate.Branch == candidate.Base {
525			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
526				"task branch is the explicit base branch", "retire without deleting the base")
527		}
528		if !observed.branchExists && noCheckout {
529			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
530				"local task branch is already absent", "")
531		}
532		paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout)
533		if err != nil {
534			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
535				err.Error(), "refresh registered worktrees before branch deletion")
536		}
537		if len(paths) > 0 {
538			return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
539				"branch is checked out at "+strings.Join(paths, ", "), "switch or remove those exact checkouts first")
540		}
541		return condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
542			"ordinary git branch -d will delete only the freshly contained local branch", "")
543	}
544	
545	func retireRetainedResources(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool, options RetireOptions) []string {
546		var retained []string
547		if observed.branchExists && (!options.DeleteBranch || candidate.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect) {
548			retained = append(retained, "branch:"+candidate.Branch)
549		}
550		if candidate.EffectiveMode() != task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && observed.checkout != "" {
551			retained = append(retained, "checkout:"+observed.checkout)
552		}
553		return retained
554	}
555	
556	func retireFallback(id string, options RetireOptions) string {
557		parts := []string{"dev", "retire", shellQuote(id)}
558		if options.DeleteBranch {
559			parts = append(parts, "--delete-branch")
560		}
561		if options.CloseUnknown {
562			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
563		}
564		if options.AssumeNoRuntime {
565			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
566		}
567		if options.Timeout > 0 {
568			parts = append(parts, "--timeout", options.Timeout.String())
569		}
570		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
571	}
572	
573	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRetire(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
574		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
575			return Result{}, err
576		}
577		if approved.Action != Retire {
578			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "retire handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
579		}
580		if err := validateRetireLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
581			return Result{}, err
582		}
583		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
584		if err != nil {
585			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
586		}
587	
588		var result Result
589		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
590			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
591				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
592				if loadErr != nil {
593					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before retirement apply"}
594				}
595				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
596					return identityErr
597				}
598				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRetire(ctx, approved.Request, *record, tx.ListRecords)
599				if observeErr != nil {
600					return observeErr
601				}
602				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
603				if buildErr != nil {
604					return buildErr
605				}
606				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
607				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
608					actual := ""
609					if current != nil {
610						actual = current.Revision
611					}
612					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked retirement replan")
613				}
614				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
615					return &StalePlanError{
616						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
617						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
618						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
619						Reason:                       "fresh retirement task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or ref authority differs",
620					}
621				}
622				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
623					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
624					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh retirement conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
625				}
626	
627				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision}
628				if err := execution.prepareSubmodules(ctx); err != nil {
629					result, _ = execution.fail(err, "preserve all child repositories and retry the recursive plan")
630					return err
631				}
632				result, observeErr = execution.executeRetire(ctx, *record, observed)
633				return observeErr
634			})
635		})
636		return result, err
637	}

639	func (e *executionState) executeRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
640		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RetireOptions)
641		candidate := record.Task
642		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
643		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
644		closedRuntime := false
645		removedWorktree := false
646		deletedBranch := false
647	
648		for _, effect := range e.executionEffects() {
649			switch effect.Code {
650			case EffectCloseRuntime:
651				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, false)
652				if err != nil {
653					return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before closing any runtime")
654				}
655				baseline = fresh
656				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
657					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
658						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
659						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
660						ProcessClosures: options.ProcessClosures.Map(),
661					})
662					if closeErr != nil {
663						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
664					}
665					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
666				})
667				if err != nil {
668					e.partial = true
669					return e.fail(err, "the task and checkout remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
670				}
671				fresh, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, true)
672				if err != nil {
673					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh retirement")
674				}
675				baseline = fresh
676				closedRuntime = true
677	
678			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
679				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
680				if err != nil {
681					return e.fail(err, "the worktree was preserved; refresh every retirement safety source")
682				}
683				baseline = fresh
684				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
685					if removeErr := e.removeWithSubmodules(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout); removeErr != nil {
686						return "worktree removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact worktree %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
687					}
688					return "removed exact linked worktree without force; branch retained", nil
689				})
690				if err != nil {
691					e.partial = true
692					return e.fail(err, "inspect Git worktree registration and retained branch before retrying")
693				}
694				removedWorktree = true
695				if err := e.verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
696					return e.fail(err, "the checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact retained branch before reaping the task")
697				}
698	
699			case EffectDeleteBranch:
700				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
701					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
702				}
703				if mode != task.ModeWorktree || noCheckout {
704					fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
705					if err != nil {
706						return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before deleting the contained branch")
707					}
708					baseline = fresh
709				}
710				if err := e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, false); err != nil {
711					return e.fail(err, "branch or base authority changed; refresh retirement")
712				}
713				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
714					_, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", candidate.Branch)
715					if deleteErr != nil {
716						return "ordinary contained-branch deletion failed", fmt.Errorf("delete contained branch %s: %w", candidate.Branch, deleteErr)
717					}
718					return "deleted contained local branch " + candidate.Branch, nil
719				})
720				if err != nil {
721					e.partial = true
722					return e.fail(err, "the task record remains DONE; inspect the local branch and retry")
723				}
724				deletedBranch = true
725				exists, observeErr := e.service.gitRefState(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef)
726				if observeErr != nil {
727					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify task branch deletion: %w", observeErr), "the task remains DONE; inspect Git refs before retrying")
728				}
729				if exists {
730					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful branch deletion"), "the task remains DONE; inspect Git refs before retrying")
731				}
732				if err := e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
733					return e.fail(err, "the branch deletion completed; restore or inspect the explicit base before task reaping")
734				}
735	
736			case EffectDeleteTask:
737				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
738					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
739				}
740				if err := e.revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch); err != nil {
741					return e.fail(err, "the task remains DONE; refresh retirement from current Git/runtime state")
742				}
743				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
744					if deleteErr := e.service.taskDelete(e.tx, candidate.ID, record.Revision); deleteErr != nil {
745						return "DONE task reap failed", fmt.Errorf("delete retired task %s: %w", candidate.ID, deleteErr)
746					}
747					if _, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(candidate.ID); !errors.Is(verifyErr, task.ErrNotFound) {
748						if verifyErr == nil {
749							verifyErr = errors.New("task record still exists")
750						}
751						return "DONE task reap was not verified", fmt.Errorf("verify retired task %s deletion: %w", candidate.ID, verifyErr)
752					}
753					if err := submodule.Forget(e.service.cfg, baseline.gitCommonDir, candidate.Branch); err != nil {
754						return "task reaped; workspace intent cleanup failed", err
755					}
756					return "reaped DONE task at revision " + record.Revision, nil
757				})
758				if err != nil {
759					if _, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(candidate.ID); errors.Is(verifyErr, task.ErrNotFound) {
760						e.partial = true
761					}
762					return e.fail(err, "local cleanup may already be complete; reload and retry the CAS task reap")
763				}
764				e.snapshot = "task:deleted:" + candidate.ID + ":" + record.Revision
765				e.milestone = MilestoneRetired
766	
767			default:
768				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected Retire effect " + string(effect.Code)})
769			}
770		}
771		if e.milestone != MilestoneRetired {
772			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "retirement ended without CAS task deletion"})
773		}
774		return e.result(), nil
775	}

777	func (e *executionState) reinspectRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
778		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
779		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
780			actual := ""
781			if current != nil {
782				actual = current.Revision
783			}
784			return destructiveObservation{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed at a retirement boundary")
785		}
786		request := e.plan.Request
787		if allowRuntimeChange {
788			options := request.Options.(RetireOptions)
789			options.RuntimeFingerprint = "" // the declared close must now prove empty coverage
790			request.Options = options
791		}
792		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, request, *current, e.tx.ListRecords)
793		if err != nil {
794			return fresh, err
795		}
796		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
797			return fresh, err
798		}
799		for _, check := range []struct {
800			name          string
801			before, after string
802		}{
803			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
804			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
805			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
806			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
807			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
808			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
809			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
810			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
811		} {
812			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
813				return fresh, err
814			}
815		}
816		if allowRuntimeChange {
817			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
818				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
819			}
820		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
821			return fresh, err
822		}
823		return fresh, nil
824	}
825	
826	func (e *executionState) verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
827		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
828		if err == nil {
829			return staleBoundary("exact worktree remains registered after removal")
830		}
831		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
832			return fmt.Errorf("verify exact worktree removal: %w", err)
833		}
834		if err := e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, false); err != nil {
835			return err
836		}
837		return nil
838	}
839	
840	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireRefs(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowMissingBranch bool) error {
841		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
842		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
843		if err := compareAuthorityCategory("explicit base ref", authorityHash("base", baseline.baseRef, boolString(baseline.baseExists), baseline.baseOID, errorString(baseline.baseOIDErr)),
844			authorityHash("base", fresh.baseRef, boolString(fresh.baseExists), fresh.baseOID, errorString(fresh.baseOIDErr))); err != nil {
845			return err
846		}
847		if allowMissingBranch && fresh.branchOIDErr == nil && !fresh.branchExists {
848			return nil
849		}
850		if err := compareAuthorityCategory("task branch ref", authorityHash("branch", baseline.branchRef, boolString(baseline.branchExists), baseline.branchOID, errorString(baseline.branchOIDErr)),
851			authorityHash("branch", fresh.branchRef, boolString(fresh.branchExists), fresh.branchOID, errorString(fresh.branchOIDErr))); err != nil {
852			return err
853		}
854		if fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
855			return staleBoundary("fresh branch containment proof failed")
856		}
857		return nil
858	}
859	
860	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireBase(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
861		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
862		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, "", strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
863		return compareAuthorityCategory("explicit base ref",
864			authorityHash("base", baseline.baseRef, boolString(baseline.baseExists), baseline.baseOID, errorString(baseline.baseOIDErr)),
865			authorityHash("base", fresh.baseRef, boolString(fresh.baseExists), fresh.baseOID, errorString(fresh.baseOIDErr)),
866		)
867	}
868	
869	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch bool) error {
870		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
871		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
872			actual := ""
873			if current != nil {
874				actual = current.Revision
875			}
876			return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed before terminal retirement reap")
877		}
878		mode := record.Task.EffectiveMode()
879		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && record.Task.WorktreePath == ""
880		if removedWorktree {
881			if _, resolveErr := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout); resolveErr == nil {
882				return staleBoundary("removed linked checkout became registered again")
883			} else if !errors.Is(resolveErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
884				return resolveErr
885			}
886			if deletedBranch {
887				exists, observeErr := e.service.gitRefState(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef)
888				if observeErr != nil {
889					return fmt.Errorf("verify deleted task branch remains absent: %w", observeErr)
890				}
891				if exists {
892					return staleBoundary("deleted task branch reappeared")
893				}
894				return e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline)
895			}
896			return e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, noCheckout && !baseline.branchExists)
897		}
898		if deletedBranch {
899			return e.revalidateRetireAfterBranchDelete(ctx, record, baseline)
900		}
901		_, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
902		return err
903	}
904	
905	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireAfterBranchDelete(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
906		exists, err := e.service.gitRefState(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef)
907		if err != nil {
908			return fmt.Errorf("verify deleted task branch remains absent: %w", err)
909		}
910		if exists {
911			return staleBoundary("deleted task branch reappeared")
912		}
913		if err := e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
914			return err
915		}
916		_, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, e.plan.Request, record, e.tx.ListRecords)
917		if err != nil {
918			return err
919		}
920		for _, check := range []struct {
921			name          string
922			before, after string
923		}{
924			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
925			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
926			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
927			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
928			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
929			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
930			{"runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)},
931		} {
932			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
933				return err
934			}
935		}
936		return nil
937	}

1	# Repository hygiene
2	
3	`dev hygiene` joins optional gitleaks and pre-commit with repository policy,
4	private local identity rules and guarded text changes. It does not equate a
5	scanner finding with a confirmed credential leak.
6	
7	## Inspect and configure
8	
9	Install `gitleaks` and `pre-commit` first. Setup reports missing dependencies;
10	it does not install packages or replace a global hook silently.
11	
12	```bash
13	dev hygiene status
14	dev hygiene status --check-remote              # explicit GitHub visibility query
15	dev hygiene setup --json
16	dev hygiene setup --apply --plan <id> --yes
17	```
18	
19	Status reads the effective `core.hooksPath`, existing hook and project config.
20	A recognized hook chain is configuration evidence, not proof that every commit
21	was scanned. Hooks can be bypassed by raw Git or external tools.
22	
23	Setup adds the blocking `dev-hygiene` pre-commit hook, safe gitleaks rules and
24	`.dev-cli/hygiene.toml`. It preserves other hooks and YAML comments. Unknown
25	hook chains and conflicting same-name hooks require manual integration. An
26	existing gitleaks config is retained by default. `--migrate-hooks` permits narrow
27	recognized rule migration; `--migrate-rules` proposes whole-config replacement.
28	Review either change against custom rules first.
29	`dev repo setup --enable agent-history-hygiene` uses this same service.
30	
31	The hook checks index content. It never rewrites files or stages user changes.
32	A missing dev/gitleaks executable, invalid report or failed scan blocks it.
33	The hook runner must find a dev version that supports `hygiene` on PATH.
34	
35	Setup writes project configuration. It first respects Git's effective
36	`core.hooksPath` and keeps a recognized existing hook, including a global one;
37	it does not install or modify a global hook. Only when no hooksPath is configured
38	and the common Git directory has no pre-commit hook does it install a repository
39	hook. Missing or unverified configured hooks require manual integration, not an
40	automatic local override. There is no `--global` setup option.
41	
42	## Batch setup and gradual migration
43	
44	The normal commit path is `Git -> pre-commit -> dev hygiene scan -> gitleaks +
45	private/public privacy policy`. Setup is a separate configuration operation;
46	commits do not call setup again and do not require an agent.
47	
48	```bash
49	dev hygiene manage --all                 # choose repositories, preview, then apply
50	dev hygiene manage /path/to/a /path/to/b --json  # preview only
51	dev hygiene setup --migrate-hooks --json # one repository, narrow migration
52	```
53	
54	REPOS offers the same single/filtered-repository workflow. Repositories do not
55	need a skills lock. Plans show files, retained dependencies and blockers; choose
56	which prepared plans to apply. Shared Git repositories are processed once. A new
57	common-directory hook requires readable sibling worktree configurations, checked
58	again before installation. Unknown/custom scanner commands need manual review.
59	
60	Migration replaces only recognized equivalent `gitleaks-system` hooks. It keeps
61	specialized artifact checkers, finalizers, provenance and unrelated hooks. The
62	recognized old password expression can be updated without replacing custom rules
63	or comments; scoped/custom expressions stay unchanged. `--migrate-rules` remains
64	the separate explicit whole-config replacement. Re-scan after rule updates;
65	changed detector IDs can require fresh fixture exceptions.
66	
67	Setup and scanning require gitleaks 8.30.0 or newer compatible 8.x; CI pins 8.30.1.
68	Passive status checks presence without executing the scanner. Ensure the hook's
69	PATH resolves a dev version with hygiene support: running `./dev` alone does not
70	upgrade an older `dev` on PATH. Tools are not installed automatically.
71	
72	Batch results retain per-repository completed, blocked, skipped, stale, partial
73	or unverified states and a private receipt. Completed setup is idempotent. An
74	interruption does not roll back other repositories or authorize a blind retry.
75	The JSON batch preview contains exact child plan IDs; apply one with the existing
76	`hygiene setup --repo PATH --apply --plan ID --yes` interface.
77	
78	The staged checker itself does not mutate files. Pre-commit can temporarily stash
79	unstaged work, so wait for an artifact recorder to exit before committing its
80	checkout. This migration does not replace the entire agent-history-hygiene
81	lifecycle: `dev artifact finalize` still requires that skill's scripts for existing tracked-history handoffs; configured external archives use native snapshot checks. Keep those
82	installations and any active finalizer wiring until a separate replacement exists.
83	
84	## Choose policy
85	
86	Precedence is built-in defaults, user defaults (`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/hygiene.toml`),
87	repo policy, private local repo overrides, then explicit scan/status flags.
88	The recommended defaults are `secrets = "block"`, `known = "block"` and
89	`generic = "warn"`. Each category supports `block`, `warn` and `off`. A rule
90	may override its enabled category's disposition; category `off` disables it.
91	
92	```toml
93	version = 1
94	secrets = "block"
95	known = "block"
96	generic = "warn"
97	```
98	
99	Setting all three categories to `off` returns an explicit `skipped` result without
100	reading repository file contents or running the engine; it is not a clean scan.
101	
102	Private visibility supplies advice only. It does not silently weaken policy;
103	unknown or unsupported visibility is never treated as private. GitHub lookup
104	requires `status --check-remote`; `--remote` selects its remote (default origin).
105	
106	```bash
107	dev hygiene rules policy --known warn --generic off --json
108	dev hygiene rules apply --plan <id> --yes
109	```
110	
111	Policy/rule changes are separate reviewed plans. One invocation's scan overrides
112	are not persisted. Obtain a fresh scan using the persistent policy before
113	creating a redaction plan.
114	
115	## Local identity rules and exceptions
116	
117	```bash
118	dev hygiene rules import --from ssh --json
119	dev hygiene rules import --from ssh --select <candidate-id> --json
120	dev hygiene rules import --from local --json
121	dev hygiene rules add --id private-network --kind cidr --value-file network.txt \
122	  --replacement 192.0.2.1 --json
123	dev hygiene rules apply --plan <id> --yes
124	```
125	
126	Imports require explicit candidate selection. SSH uses the bounded static
127	OpenSSH Include closure, including literal aliases, HostName, User and key-path
128	references. It never executes `ssh -G`, `Match exec`, DNS or a remote command,
129	and never reads key material. An incomplete Include closure blocks import.
130	Common public names and generic accounts are recommendations for warnings.
131	Local import supplies home path, account, Git name and Git email candidates.
132	
133	`rules import --from machines` reads existing Tailscale/LAN and Fleet inventory
134	caches only. IPs, hostnames and remote usernames become selectable private
135	candidates; credential stores, keys, discovery commands and remote connections
136	are never queried. Observation timestamps and stale markers remain visible.
137	Missing caches are reported without creating them; incomplete/corrupt caches
138	block imports. Source changes after preview invalidate the saved import plan.
139	
140	Quoted password literals remain detectable in source files. Unquoted assignments
141	are scoped to configuration/script/prose formats, avoiding Go boolean fields and
142	variable expressions. Format-complete test/demo keys still block until a reviewed
143	exact exception is added. Do not exclude tests/docs or an entire line beside a
144	placeholder; prefer inert placeholders or construct detector fixtures at runtime.
145	
146	
147	Literal, CIDR and Go RE2 rules accept optional relative path globs. `directory/**`
148	selects descendants. Rule values come from a file or `--value-file -`; do not
149	put sensitive values in command arguments. Edit or disable existing private
150	rules through a reviewed same-ID rule plan or the private policy file.
151	
152	Private rules, HMAC identifiers, scan records and recovery are stored outside
153	Git under `paths.state_dir/hygiene/repos/<native-repo-id>/`. Linked worktrees
154	share local policy but plans remain bound to an exact checkout. Windows uses
155	protected current-user/SYSTEM ACLs; Unix uses private ownership and permissions.
156	There is no automatic deletion or export of this state.
157	
158	```bash
159	dev hygiene rules allow --report <report-id> --finding <finding-id> \
160	  --reason 'Reviewed synthetic test fixture' --json
161	```
162	
163	Local exceptions bind an exact value/rule/path finding. Shareable TOML exceptions
164	require `rule`, `path`, an anchored `pattern` and a reason. Keep private values
165	out of shareable rules. `.gitleaksignore` contains finding fingerprints, not path
166	globs. `scan --audit` ignores local finding exceptions, that file and inline
167	`gitleaks:allow`; scanner-config allowlists still apply and must be reviewed.
168	Placeholders never automatically allow an unrelated key on the same line.
169	
170	## Scan with an honest scope
171	
172	```bash
173	dev hygiene scan --scope worktree --json
174	dev hygiene scan --scope staged --json
175	dev hygiene scan --scope history --audit --timeout 40m --json
176	dev hygiene --public-only --known off --generic off scan --scope history \
177	  --range <full-from-oid>..<full-to-oid> --json
178	```
179	
180	Working-file scans include tracked files and nonignored untracked files. Already
181	tracked files remain in scope after a later `.gitignore` addition. Staged scans
182	use actual index bytes, including hidden files and partial staging. Selected
183	`--file` arguments must already belong to that scope.
184	
185	An explicit range checks versions changed in its selected commits, leaving
186	untouched older files for the full audit. History freezes locally available refs
187	(or an explicit full-OID range), includes
188	merge-only content and removed files, and never fetches implicitly. It does not
189	scan reflogs, unreachable objects, uncommitted work in other checkouts or remote
190	submodule repositories. Nonregular entries and recognized binary formats are
191	listed as exclusions from text scanning. Unsupported text encodings, unreadable
192	or oversized files, changing sources/refs, shallow history, cancellation and
193	scanner failures produce incomplete results. The per-file text limit is 128 MiB;
194	large files are never silently called clean.
195	
196	Public JSON schema 1 records status, scope, frozen refs, counts, safe finding
197	locations, dispositions, exclusions and coverage gaps. It omits source snippets
198	and credential values. Finding IDs and public file/plan digests use private HMAC
199	keys. `complete` describes the declared text scope; a blocking finding or
200	incomplete scan exits unsuccessfully. No findings is not a credential-validity
201	check. Reports may contain identifying filenames not covered by selected rules;
202	review them before sharing.
203	
204	CI uses public repository rules, without global/personal values. It cannot
205	claim to have checked private SSH identities. PR/push scans select the changed
206	commit range; manual workflow dispatch audits all locally fetched history.
207	
208	## Repair invalid UTF-8
209	
210	Warning findings alone do not block a commit. A coverage gap such as
211	`unsupported_text_encoding` makes a scan incomplete even with zero blocking
212	findings. Encoding gaps retain that code and add an `encoding` object with
213	`reason`, zero-based `byte_offset`, one-based `line`, `invalid_bytes`,
214	`invalid_sequences` (contiguous invalid runs) and optional `nul_bytes`.
215	Historical gaps also identify the observed `commit`. Diagnostics contain no
216	source excerpts. Fixing a working file does not repair old Git objects.
217	
218	```bash
219	dev hygiene repair-encoding --file .specstory/history/session.md --json
220	# Optional explicit deletion instead of the default replacement character:
221	dev hygiene repair-encoding --file notes.txt --invalid remove --json
222	# Review the private proposal; only after the exact artifact writer has exited:
223	dev hygiene repair-encoding --apply --plan <id> --yes --writer-stopped
224	# Review and stage only the intended repair, then check the actual index:
225	dev hygiene scan --scope staged --json
226	```
227	
228	The default `--invalid replace` replaces each contiguous invalid byte run with
229	one `�`; `remove` deletes that run. All valid bytes, including existing `�`,
230	UTF-8 BOMs and line endings, remain unchanged. Explicit files may be selected
231	with repeated `--file`; each source and result must fit 128 MiB, with at most
232	256 files and 192 MiB of proposed output per plan. Valid text is a no-op. Known binary extensions,
233	NUL bytes and UTF-16/32 BOMs require separate encoding review; this command does
234	not guess a legacy encoding or recover the original character.
235	
236	Repair uses signed plans, fresh file identity checks and private raw-byte
237	recovery through `dev hygiene restore`. It does not need a secret scanner.
238	Artifact edits require writer attestation and live occupancy checks, including
239	case variants and nested artifact directories. Encoding repair requires long
240	canonical path components without trailing dots/spaces or DOS short-name spellings. The hook
241	never repairs automatically. Apply changes working files only: a partially
242	staged file keeps its exact index contents, so a staged scan still fails until
243	you review and stage the repair. Do not broadly stage newly appended history.
244	Encoding repair does not redact secrets or prove a complete hygiene scan.
245	
246	## Review and apply replacements
247	
248	```bash
249	dev hygiene redact --report <report-id> --file notes.md --json
250	dev hygiene redact --report <report-id> --finding <finding-id> --json
251	dev hygiene review-path <id>                 # open privately; never paste contents
252	dev hygiene redact --apply --plan <id> --yes
253	# Only after the exact artifact writer exited:
254	dev hygiene redact --apply --plan <id> --yes --writer-stopped
255	```
256	
257	All supported regular text files may be selected. Plans bind the checkout,
258	HEAD/branch, effective policy, scanner inputs, native file identity and content.
259	They are signed private records. An edited plan or stale input requires a new
260	preview. Overlapping matches prefer secret, then known, then generic rules;
261	within a category the longer span wins. The terminal output shows paths, opaque before/after digests and replacement
262	counts. `review-path <id>` locates a private full-content proposal for human
263	inspection. Its integrity is bound to the plan; never paste that file into chat,
264	Git or CI logs. The default output does not echo the original secret.
265	
266	Apply checks the whole selection, then publishes individual guarded transactions
267	with original metadata and private recovery. It retains a partial ledger on
268	failure; never repeat an interrupted operation blindly. Index contents, Git
269	history and installed binaries are not changed. Native Windows protections are
270	specific to these opted-in text transactions; other configedit workflows retain
271	their own platform support contracts. Windows preserves owner/group/DACL
272	semantics; files with alternate streams, explicit integrity labels or special
273	attributes require manual preservation.
274	
275	```bash
276	dev hygiene restore --receipt <receipt-id> --json
277	dev hygiene restore --receipt <receipt-id> --apply --yes
278	```
279	
280	Restore refuses files replaced or edited since the recorded transaction. Artifact
281	recovery also needs `--writer-stopped`. Runtime observations reject recognized
282	writers; a disabled/unavailable runtime cannot prove process absence. The
283	post-writer attestation and source revalidation remain necessary, and raw external
284	writers remain outside dev-mediated locks.
285	
286	Use the [manual dogfood checklist](../reference/hygiene-dogfood.md) for this repo.
287	
288	For history retention, reviewed knowledge and source-package boundaries, see
289	`dev help ai-artifacts`.

191	func suggestFor(app *App, ctx context.Context, r inventory.Row, stale time.Duration, retireOptions sweepRetireOptions) []suggestion {
192		t := r.Task
193		var out []suggestion
194		current, currentErr := app.Tasks.GetRecord(t.ID)
195		if currentErr != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(current.Task, *t) {
196			detail := "task changed after the sweep inventory snapshot"
197			if currentErr != nil {
198				detail = "task could not be reloaded after the sweep inventory snapshot: " + currentErr.Error()
199			}
200			return []suggestion{{
201				row: r, reason: detail,
202				action: "rerun sweep to inspect the current task revision — not changed automatically",
203			}}
204		}
205		revision := current.Revision
206	
207		// A task whose repository is gone cannot be finished, resumed, parked or
208		// retired: every one of those resolves the repository first, and `dev done`
209		// refuses outright once the checkout is missing. Nothing else in this
210		// function reaches it either — the dead-branch rule below excludes direct
211		// mode, and the stale-worktree rule needs a recorded worktree path. Left
212		// alone, the record is unreachable by any command in the binary.
213		//
214		// Reaping removes dev's record of intent and nothing else; the branch, the
215		// commits and the remote are untouched. A live session proves the directory
216		// is there, so it is the one condition that rules this out.
217		if t.RepoPath != "" && !r.Live() && !dirExists(t.RepoPath) {
218			out = append(out, suggestion{
219				row:    r,
220				reason: fmt.Sprintf("repository %s no longer exists", config.Contract(t.RepoPath)),
221				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s (Git keeps any work; this drops only dev's record)", t.ID),
222				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
223			})
224			return out
225		}
226	
227		out = append(out, orphanSuggestions(app, r)...)
228	
229		switch {
230		// A hot task with no live session is the commonest drift: the session was
231		// closed (or the machine rebooted) without parking.
232		case t.State == task.Hot && r.StateDrift() == "no live session":
233			reason := fmt.Sprintf("hot but no live session, idle %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
234			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkWarmOptions{})
235			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
236				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded warm parking is blocked",
237					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})
238				break
239			}
240			out = append(out, suggestion{
241				row: r, reason: reason, action: fmt.Sprintf("mark %s warm", t.ID),
242				apply: func() error {
243					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
244					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
245					return err
246				},
247			})
248	
249		// A warm task nobody has touched in weeks is a candidate for cold: keeping
250		// the worktree costs disk and clutters every listing.
251		case t.State == task.Warm && r.Age() > stale:
252			reason := fmt.Sprintf("warm and untouched for %s", humanAge(r.Age()))
253			if t.EffectiveMode() == task.ModeDirect {
254				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but direct tasks cannot go cold",
255					action: "keep it warm or finish it — not changed automatically"})
256				break
257			}
258			if r.Status.Dirty() {
259				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but has uncommitted work",
260					action: "commit or `dev park --wip` before going cold — not changed automatically"})
261				break
262			}
263			if !r.Status.Synced() {
264				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + fmt.Sprintf(", not pushed (%s)", r.Status.Summary()),
265					action: fmt.Sprintf("push %s so it can go cold: dev park %s --cold --push", t.Branch, t.ID)})
266				break
267			}
268			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.ParkColdOptions{Recursive: retireOptions.recursive})
269			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
270				detail := sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)
271				out = append(out, suggestion{row: r, reason: reason + ", but guarded cold parking is blocked",
272					action: detail + " — not changed automatically"})
273				break
274			}
275			out = append(out, suggestion{
276				row:    r,
277				reason: reason + ", clean and pushed",
278				action: fmt.Sprintf("go cold: remove %s (branch and remote keep the work)", config.Contract(r.Checkout)),
279				apply: func() error {
280					result, err := session.apply(ctx, plan, flow.Approve(plan.PlanID))
281					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
282					return err
283				},
284			})
285	
286		// DONE means integrated; runtime/worktree cleanup is a separate,
287		// externally coordinated retirement step.
288		case t.State == task.Done:
289			action := fmt.Sprintf("retire runtime/worktree for %s", t.ID)
290			if retireOptions.deleteBranches && t.Branch != "" && t.Branch != t.Base {
291				action += fmt.Sprintf(" and delete %s", t.Branch)

293			session, plan, planErr := sweepTaskPlan(ctx, app, t.ID, flow.RetireOptions{
294				Recursive:    retireOptions.recursive,
295				CloseUnknown: retireOptions.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: retireOptions.assumeNoRuntime,
296				DeleteBranch: retireOptions.deleteBranches,

300					action: sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr) + " — not changed automatically"})

303			out = append(out, suggestion{
304				row: r, reason: "merged, cleanup pending", action: action,

324			out = append(out, suggestion{
325				row:    r,
326				reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch %s no longer exists", t.Branch),
327				action: fmt.Sprintf("reap the task entry %s", t.ID),
328				apply:  func() error { return sweepDeleteTask(ctx, app.Tasks, t.ID, revision) },
329			})
330			return out
331		}
332	
333		// A cold task keeps no checkout by definition: that is what going cold
334		// means. One still on disk is drift inventory already reports and nothing
335		// could act on.
336		if t.State == task.Cold && t.WorktreePath != "" && r.CheckoutExists && !r.WorktreeMissing &&
337			!r.Live() && !r.Status.Dirty() && r.Status.Synced() {
338			out = append(out, suggestion{
339				row:    r,
340				reason: "cold, but its worktree is still on disk",
341				action: fmt.Sprintf("reconcile %s with an exact guarded plan — not changed automatically", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
342			})
343		}
344	
345		// Drift that is independent of the lifecycle stage.
346		if r.WorktreeMissing && t.WorktreePath != "" {
347			wtPath := t.WorktreePath
348			out = append(out, suggestion{
349				row:    r,
350				reason: "records a worktree that git no longer knows about",
351				action: fmt.Sprintf("inspect repository-wide prune scope before clearing %s — not changed automatically", config.Contract(wtPath)),
352			})
353		}
354		return out
355	}

357	func sweepTaskPlan(ctx context.Context, app *App, id string, options flow.ActionOptions) (lifecycleSession, flow.Plan, error) {
358		session, err := newLifecycleSession(ctx, app, func() (*task.Task, error) {
359			return app.Tasks.Get(id)
360		})
361		if err != nil {
362			return lifecycleSession{}, flow.Plan{}, err
363		}
364		plan, err := session.plan(ctx, options)
365		return session, plan, err
366	}
367	
368	func sweepPlanBlocker(plan flow.Plan, err error) string {
369		if err != nil {
370			return err.Error()
371		}
372		var parts []string
373		for _, condition := range append(plan.InputConditions(), plan.BlockingConditions()...) {
374			parts = append(parts, string(condition.Code)+": "+condition.Evidence)
375		}
376		if len(parts) == 0 {
377			return "guarded plan is " + string(plan.Availability)
378		}
379		return strings.Join(parts, "; ")
380	}
381	
382	func sweepDeleteTask(ctx context.Context, store *task.Store, id, revision string) error {
383		if revision == "" {
384			return fmt.Errorf("task %s had no report-time revision; rerun sweep", id)
385		}
386		return store.DeleteIfRevision(ctx, id, revision)
387	}

389	// dirExists reports whether path is a directory that can be read right now.
390	func dirExists(path string) bool {
391		info, err := os.Stat(path)
392		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
393	}
394	
395	// orphanSuggestions handles the residue of a worktree removed while its
396	// transcript writer was still running: the path exists, Git has no record of
397	// it, and it holds only agent artifacts. Removing it is offered only once every
398	// file in it is proven byte-identical to one the repository already has.
399	func orphanSuggestions(app *App, r inventory.Row) []suggestion {
400		t := r.Task
401		if t.WorktreePath == "" || !r.WorktreeMissing || !r.CheckoutExists {
402			return nil
403		}
404		orphan, ok, err := retirement.InspectOrphan(t.WorktreePath)
405		if err != nil || !ok {
406			return nil
407		}
408		unsalvaged, err := retirement.Unsalvaged(orphan, t.RepoPath)
409		if err != nil {
410			return nil
411		}
412		if len(unsalvaged) > 0 {
413			return []suggestion{{
414				row: r,
415				reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace holding %d file(s) the repository does not have",
416					config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(unsalvaged)),
417				action: fmt.Sprintf("salvage %s first — not removed automatically", strings.Join(unsalvaged, ", ")),
418			}}
419		}
420		return []suggestion{{
421			row:    r,
422			reason: fmt.Sprintf("%s is an abandoned agent workspace git does not know", config.Contract(t.WorktreePath)),
423			action: fmt.Sprintf("remove the empty shell %s (its %d artifact file(s) are already in the repository)",
424				config.Contract(t.WorktreePath), len(orphan.Files)),
425			apply: func() error { return os.RemoveAll(t.WorktreePath) },
426		}}
427	}

429	func suggestMergedWorktrees(app *App, ctx context.Context, rows []inventory.Row, requestedBase string, options sweepRetireOptions) ([]suggestion, error) {
430		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, mustGetwd())
431		if err != nil {
432			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees requires a Git repository: %w", err)
433		}
434		if repository.IsLinkedWorktree {
435			return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees must run from the canonical checkout, not linked worktree %s", config.Contract(repository.Root))
436		}
437		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
438		if err != nil {
439			return nil, err
440		}
441		base := requestedBase
442		if base == "" {
443			base = gitx.DefaultBranch(ctx, repository.Root)
444			if status.Branch != base {
445				return nil, fmt.Errorf("--merged-worktrees defaults to %s; switch the canonical checkout to it or pass --base explicitly", base)
446			}
447		}
448		if !gitx.RefExists(ctx, repository.Root, base) {
449			return nil, fmt.Errorf("merged-worktree base %s does not resolve to a commit", base)
450		}
451	
452		claimed := make(map[string]inventory.Row)
453		for _, row := range rows {
454			if row.Task == nil || row.Checkout == "" {
455				continue
456			}
457			canonical, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(row.Checkout)
458			if canonicalErr == nil {
459				claimed[canonical] = row
460			}
461		}
462		worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, repository.Root)
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, err
465		}
466		var suggestions []suggestion
467		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
468			if worktree.Main || worktree.Bare || worktree.Detached || worktree.Branch == "" || worktree.Branch == base {
469				continue
470			}
471			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", worktree.Branch, base); err != nil {
472				continue
473			}
474			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree.Path)
475			if err != nil {
476				continue
477			}
478			if row, ok := claimed[canonical]; ok {
479				if row.Task.State == task.Done {
480					suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestFor(app, ctx, row, 0, options)...)
481					continue
482				}
483				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
484					fmt.Sprintf("task is %s; verify integration with `dev done --merged` first", row.Task.State)))
485				continue
486			}
487	
488			displayTask := &task.Task{
489				ID: task.MakeID(repository.Name, worktree.Branch), Name: worktree.Branch,
490				Repo: repository.Name, RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, Branch: worktree.Branch,
491				Base: base, WorktreePath: canonical, Mode: task.ModeWorktree, State: task.Done,
492			}
493			row := inventory.Row{Task: displayTask, Checkout: canonical, CheckoutExists: true}
494			if inventory.IsClaudeHarnessWorktree(repository.Root, canonical) {
495				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base,
496					"checkout is owned by the Claude harness"))
497				continue
498			}
499			locator, locateErr := exactUnmanagedWorktreeLocator(ctx, repository.MainRoot, canonical)
500			if locateErr != nil {
501				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, locateErr.Error()))
502				continue
503			}
504			service, serviceErr := newCLILifecycleService(app)
505			if serviceErr != nil {
506				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, serviceErr.Error()))
507				continue
508			}
509			request, requestErr := flow.NewRequest(locator, flow.RemoveCheckoutOptions{
510				Recursive:        options.recursive,
511				RequireContained: true, ContainmentBase: base,
512				DeleteContainedBranch: options.deleteBranches,
513				CloseUnknown:          options.closeUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.assumeNoRuntime,
514			})
515			if requestErr != nil {
516				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, requestErr.Error()))
517				continue
518			}
519			plan, planErr := service.Plan(ctx, request)
520			if planErr != nil || plan.Availability != flow.AvailabilityReady {
521				suggestions = append(suggestions, mergedWorktreeBlocker(row, base, sweepPlanBlocker(plan, planErr)))
522				continue
523			}
524			branch := worktree.Branch
525			action := fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s (branch %s kept)",
526				config.Contract(canonical), branch)
527			if options.deleteBranches {
528				action = fmt.Sprintf("remove merged unmanaged worktree %s and delete contained branch %s",
529					config.Contract(canonical), branch)
530			}
531			suggestions = append(suggestions, suggestion{
532				row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("untracked worktree branch is contained in %s", base), action: action,
533				apply: func() error {
534					approval := flow.Approve(plan.PlanID)
535					if plan.Confirmation.Kind == flow.ConfirmationTyped {
536						approval = flow.ApproveWithToken(plan.PlanID, plan.Confirmation.Token)
537					}
538					result, err := service.Apply(ctx, plan, approval)
539					renderLifecycleResult(app, plan, result)
540					return err
541				},
542			})
543		}
544		return suggestions, nil
545	}

547	func mergedWorktreeBlocker(row inventory.Row, base, blocker string) suggestion {
548		return suggestion{
549			row: row, reason: fmt.Sprintf("branch is contained in %s, but retirement is blocked", base),
550			action: blocker + " — not changed automatically",
551		}
552	}

554	func confirm(app *App, in *bufio.Reader, action string) bool {
555		s := app.outStyle()
556		prompt := s.prompt(action + "?")
557		lower := strings.ToLower(action)
558		if strings.Contains(lower, "delete") || strings.Contains(lower, "remove") ||
559			strings.Contains(lower, "discard") || strings.Contains(lower, "drop") {
560			prompt = s.danger(action + "?")
561		}
562		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s ", prompt, s.dim("[y/N]"))
563		line, err := in.ReadString('\n')
564		if err != nil {
565			return false
566		}
567		answer := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(line))
568		return answer == "y" || answer == "yes"
569	}
