```text
571	type ephemeralSweepOptions struct {
572		apply                  bool
573		staleDays              int
574		json                   bool
575		baseRef                string
576		baseExplicit           bool
577		yesChanged             bool
578		closeUnknownChanged    bool
579		assumeNoRuntimeChanged bool
580		deleteBranches         bool
581	}
582	
583	func runEphemeralSweep(ctx context.Context, app *App, _ *cobra.Command, options ephemeralSweepOptions) error {
584		switch {
585		case options.staleDays < 1:
586			return fmt.Errorf("--stale-days must be at least 1 for --ephemeral-worktrees")
587		case options.json && options.apply:
588			return fmt.Errorf("--json is report-only and cannot be combined with --apply")
589		case options.yesChanged:
590			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --yes; each item requires confirmation")
591		case options.closeUnknownChanged:
592			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --close-unknown")
593		case options.assumeNoRuntimeChanged:
594			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees does not accept --assume-no-runtime")
595		case options.apply && app.noRuntime:
596			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees cannot apply with --no-runtime")
597		case options.deleteBranches && !options.apply:
598			return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branches with --ephemeral-worktrees requires --apply")
599		case options.deleteBranches && (!options.baseExplicit || strings.TrimSpace(options.baseRef) == ""):
600			return fmt.Errorf("--delete-branches with --ephemeral-worktrees requires an explicit --base")
601		case options.apply && !app.interactive():
602			return fmt.Errorf("--ephemeral-worktrees --apply requires an interactive terminal")
603		}
604	
605		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
606		if err != nil || home == "" {
607			return fmt.Errorf("resolve home directory for Claude Workflow metadata")
608		}
609		service := ephemeral.NewService(
610			claudeworkflow.New(filepath.Join(home, ".claude", "projects")),
611			ephemeral.ServiceOptions{
612				Tasks: app.Tasks, Artifacts: artifactStore(app), Runtimes: ephemeralSweepRuntimes(app),
613				RuntimeDisabled: app.noRuntime,
614			},
615		)
616		report, err := service.Report(ctx, ephemeral.ReportRequest{
617			RepoPath: mustGetwd(), StaleDays: options.staleDays,
618			BaseRef: options.baseRef, BaseExplicit: options.baseExplicit, DeleteBranches: options.deleteBranches,
619		})
620		if err != nil {
621			return err
622		}
623		if options.json {
624			encoder := json.NewEncoder(app.Out)
625			encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
626			return encoder.Encode(report)
627		}
628		renderEphemeralReport(app, report)
629		if !options.apply {
630			return nil
631		}
632	
633		reader := bufio.NewReader(app.In)
634		var approved []string
635		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
636			if candidate.Classification != ephemeral.Eligible {
637				continue
638			}
639			action := "remove ephemeral worktree " + config.Contract(candidate.Path) + " (branch retained)"
640			if candidate.BranchDeletion.Requested && candidate.BranchDeletion.Safe {
641				action = "remove ephemeral worktree " + config.Contract(candidate.Path) + " and delete branch " + candidate.Branch
642			}
643			if confirm(app, reader, action) {
644				approved = append(approved, candidate.Fingerprint)
645			}
646		}
647		if len(approved) == 0 {
648			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, app.outStyle().dim("No eligible worktree was approved; nothing changed."))
649			return nil
650		}
651		result, err := service.Apply(ctx, ephemeral.ApplyRequest{Report: report, Fingerprints: approved})
652		if err != nil {
653			return err
654		}
655		renderEphemeralApply(app, result)
656		return nil
657	}
658	
659	func ephemeralSweepRuntimes(app *App) []runtime.Runtime {
660		if app.runtimeInstance != nil {
661			return []runtime.Runtime{app.runtimeInstance}
662		}
663		out := make([]runtime.Runtime, 0, 3)
664		for _, name := range []string{"herdr", "tmux", "zellij"} {
665			out = append(out, app.runtimeNamed(name))
666		}
667		return out
668	}
669	
670	func renderEphemeralReport(app *App, report ephemeral.Report) {
671		style := app.outStyle()
672		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n%s\n", style.title("Verified ephemeral worktree report (schema v1)"))
673		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "Repository: %s\n", config.Contract(report.Repository.Root))
674		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "Candidates: %d (%d eligible, %d blocked, %d unknown, %d report-only)\n",
675			report.Summary.Total, report.Summary.Eligible, report.Summary.Blocked,
676			report.Summary.Unknown, report.Summary.NotApplicable)
677		for _, capability := range report.Capabilities {
678			if !capability.Available {
679				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  capability unavailable: %s\n", capability.Name)
680			}
681		}
682		for _, candidate := range report.Candidates {
683			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "\n  %-14s %s\n", strings.ToUpper(string(candidate.Classification)), config.Contract(candidate.Path))
684			if candidate.Provider != "" {
685				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    provider=%s run=%s agent=%s workflow=%s agent-state=%s\n",
686					candidate.Provider, candidate.RunID, candidate.AgentID, candidate.WorkflowState, candidate.AgentState)
687			}
688			if candidate.LastActivityKnown {
689				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    last activity: %s\n", candidate.LastActivity.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))
690			} else {
691				fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "    last activity: unknown")
692			}
693			for _, check := range candidate.Checks {
694				if check.Classification != ephemeral.Eligible {
695					fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s: %s — %s\n", check.ID, check.Classification, check.Detail)
696				}
697			}
698			for _, action := range candidate.PlannedActions {
699				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "    %s: %s (%s)\n", action.Kind, action.Status, action.Detail)
700			}
701		}
702		if report.Summary.Eligible == 0 {
703			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nNo eligible ephemeral worktree was found; report-only entries were not changed."))
704		} else {
705			fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, style.dim("\nRe-run with --apply from an interactive terminal; every eligible item is confirmed separately."))
706		}
707	}
708	
709	func renderEphemeralApply(app *App, result ephemeral.ApplyResult) {
710		style := app.outStyle()
711		for _, item := range result.Results {
712			switch item.Status {
713			case ephemeral.ApplyRemoved:
714				branch := "branch retained"
715				if item.DeletedBranch {
716					branch = "branch deleted"
717				}
718				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s (%s)\n", style.success("removed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), branch)
719			case ephemeral.ApplyPartial:
720				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("partial:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
721			case ephemeral.ApplySkippedChanged:
722				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("skipped-changed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
723			default:
724				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "  %s %s — %s\n", style.warning("failed:"), config.Contract(item.Path), item.Detail)
725			}
726		}
727	}
```

```text
    99	func platformCaptureMetadata(path string, file *os.File, info fs.FileInfo) (fileMetadata, error) {
   100		stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
   101		if !ok {
   102			return fileMetadata{}, errors.New("file has no Unix ownership metadata")
   103		}
   104		xattrs, err := platformReadXattrs(file)
   105		if err != nil {
   106			return fileMetadata{}, err
   107		}
   108		flags, err := platformFileFlags(file)
   109		if err != nil {
   110			return fileMetadata{}, err
   111		}
   112		return fileMetadata{
   113			mode: info.Mode().Perm(), uid: int(stat.Uid), gid: int(stat.Gid), xattrs: xattrs, flags: flags,
   114		}, nil
   115	}
   116	
   117	func platformMetadataRoundTrip(metadata fileMetadata) error {
   118		if metadata.uid != os.Geteuid() {
   119			return errors.New("owner is not the current user")
   120		}
   121		groups, err := os.Getgroups()
   122		if err != nil {
   123			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current groups: %w", err)
   124		}
   125		groupAllowed := metadata.gid == os.Getegid()
   126		for _, group := range groups {
   127			groupAllowed = groupAllowed || metadata.gid == group
   128		}
   129		if !groupAllowed {
   130			return fmt.Errorf("group %d cannot be restored by the current user", metadata.gid)
   131		}
   132		if err := platformFlagsRoundTrip(metadata.flags); err != nil {
   133			return err
   134		}
   135		for name := range metadata.xattrs {
   136			if platformfs.KernelLabel(name, metadata.xattrs[name]) {
   137				continue
   138			}
   139			// Kernel security labels and POSIX ACLs often require privilege to set and
   140			// can grant access beyond mode 0600. Block before staging rather than
   141			// silently dropping or approximating them.
   142			if len(name) >= 9 && name[:9] == "security." || len(name) >= 7 && name[:7] == "system." || name == "com.apple.system.Security" {
   143				return fmt.Errorf("extended attribute %q requires manual preservation", name)
   144			}
   145		}
   146		return nil
   147	}

   160		if err := platformWriteXattrs(file, metadata.xattrs); err != nil {

    16	
    17	func platformReadXattrs(file *os.File) (map[string][]byte, error) {
    18		fd := int(file.Fd())
    19		size, err := unix.Flistxattr(fd, nil)
    20		if err != nil {
    21			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list extended attributes: %w", err)
    22		}
    23		if size == 0 {
    24			return map[string][]byte{}, nil
    25		}
    26		buffer := make([]byte, size)
    27		size, err = unix.Flistxattr(fd, buffer)
    28		if err != nil {
    29			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list extended attributes: %w", err)
    30		}
    31		attributes := make(map[string][]byte)
    32		for _, name := range strings.Split(string(buffer[:size]), "\x00") {
    33			if name == "" {
    34				continue
    35			}
    36			valueSize, err := unix.Fgetxattr(fd, name, nil)
    37			if err != nil {
    38				return nil, fmt.Errorf("read extended attribute %q: %w", name, err)
    39			}
    40			value := make([]byte, valueSize)
    41			if valueSize > 0 {
    42				read, err := unix.Fgetxattr(fd, name, value)
    43				if err != nil {
    44					return nil, fmt.Errorf("read extended attribute %q: %w", name, err)
    45				}
    46				value = value[:read]
    47			}
    48			attributes[name] = value
    49		}
    50		return attributes, nil
    51	}
    52	
    53	func platformWriteXattrs(file *os.File, attributes map[string][]byte) error {
    54		fd := int(file.Fd())
    55		names := make([]string, 0, len(attributes))
    56		for name := range attributes {
    57			names = append(names, name)
    58		}
    59		sort.Strings(names)
    60		for _, name := range names {
    61			if platformfs.KernelLabel(name, attributes[name]) {
    62				// SELinux assigns the staged file's label. Never relabel a file;
    63				// require the inherited bytes to match the observed source.
    64				value := make([]byte, len(attributes[name])+1)
    65				n, err := unix.Fgetxattr(fd, name, value)
    66				if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(value[:max(0, n)], attributes[name]) {
    67					return fmt.Errorf("inherited Android label differs from source: %w", errors.Join(ErrUnsafePath, err))
    68				}
    69				continue
    70			}
    71			if err := unix.Fsetxattr(fd, name, attributes[name], 0); err != nil {
    72				return fmt.Errorf("restore extended attribute %q: %w", name, err)
    73			}
    74		}
    75		return nil
    76	}
```

```text
    20	type permissionMetadata struct {
    21		uid        uint32
    22		gid        uint32
    23		flags      uint32
    24		attributes map[string]string
    25	}
    26	
    27	func permissionValidateAncestor(path string, info fs.FileInfo) error {
    28		stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
    29		if !ok || !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || int(stat.Uid) != os.Geteuid() {
    30			return fmt.Errorf("permission parent %s must be a direct current-user-owned directory: %w", path, ErrUnsafePath)
    31		}
    32		return nil
    33	}
    34	
    35	func permissionOpenFile(root *os.Root, name string, directory bool) (*os.File, error) {
    36		flags := os.O_RDONLY | unix.O_CLOEXEC | unix.O_NOFOLLOW | unix.O_NONBLOCK
    37		if directory {
    38			flags |= unix.O_DIRECTORY
    39		}
    40		return root.OpenFile(name, flags, 0)
    41	}
    42	
    43	func permissionReadMetadata(path string, file *os.File, info fs.FileInfo, target permissionTarget) (permissionMetadata, error) {
    44		var metadata permissionMetadata
    45		stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
    46		if !ok || int(stat.Uid) != os.Geteuid() {
    47			return metadata, fmt.Errorf("permission target %s is not owned by the current user: %w", path, ErrUnsafePath)
    48		}
    49		if !target.directory && stat.Nlink != 1 {
    50			return metadata, fmt.Errorf("permission target has multiple hard links: %w", ErrUnsafePath)
    51		}
    52		if info.Mode()&(os.ModeSetuid|os.ModeSetgid|os.ModeSticky) != 0 {
    53			return metadata, fmt.Errorf("special permission bits require manual remediation: %w", ErrManualRemediation)
    54		}
    55		metadata.uid, metadata.gid = stat.Uid, stat.Gid
    56		flags, err := platformFileFlags(file)
    57		if err != nil {
    58			return metadata, err
    59		}
    60		if err := permissionFlagsRoundTrip(flags, target.directory); err != nil {
    61			return metadata, fmt.Errorf("permission flags require manual remediation: %w", err)
    62		}
    63		metadata.flags = flags
    64		if err := permissionCheckACL(file); err != nil {
    65			return metadata, err
    66		}
    67		attributes, err := permissionAttributes(file)
    68		if err != nil {
    69			return metadata, err
    70		}
    71		metadata.attributes = attributes
    72		return metadata, nil
    73	}
    74	
    75	// Read only bounded filesystem metadata, retaining hashes rather than values.
    76	// Security/ACL attributes must be understood by a separate explicit workflow;
    77	// this repair never removes or rewrites them.
    78	func permissionAttributes(file *os.File) (map[string]string, error) {
    79		const maxMetadata = 256 << 10
    80		fd := int(file.Fd())
    81		length, err := unix.Flistxattr(fd, nil)
    82		if errors.Is(err, unix.ENOTSUP) {
    83			return nil, nil
    84		}
    85		if err != nil {
    86			return nil, err
    87		}
    88		if length > maxMetadata {
    89			return nil, fmt.Errorf("permission metadata exceeds bounds: %w", ErrManualRemediation)
    90		}
    91		names := make([]byte, length)
    92		if length > 0 {
    93			length, err = unix.Flistxattr(fd, names)
    94			if err != nil {
    95				return nil, err
    96			}
    97		}
    98		attributes := map[string]string{}
    99		total := length
   100		for _, name := range strings.Split(string(names[:length]), "\x00") {
   101			if name == "" {
   102				continue
   103			}
   104			size, err := unix.Fgetxattr(fd, name, nil)
   105			if err != nil {
   106				return nil, err
   107			}
   108			total += size
   109			if total > maxMetadata {
   110				return nil, fmt.Errorf("permission metadata exceeds bounds: %w", ErrManualRemediation)
   111			}
   112			data := make([]byte, size)
   113			if size > 0 {
   114				size, err = unix.Fgetxattr(fd, name, data)
   115				if err != nil {
   116					return nil, err
   117				}
   118			}
   119			if !platformfs.KernelLabel(name, data[:size]) && (strings.HasPrefix(name, "security.") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "system.") || name == "com.apple.system.Security") {
   120				return nil, fmt.Errorf("security attributes or ACLs require manual remediation: %w", ErrManualRemediation)
   121			}
   122			digest := sha256.Sum256(data[:size])
   123			attributes[name] = hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
   124		}
   125		return attributes, nil
   126	}
   127	
   128	func permissionDesiredMode(snapshot permissionSnapshot) (fs.FileMode, error) {
   129		before := snapshot.info.Mode().Perm()
   130		desired := fs.FileMode(0o600)
   131		if snapshot.target.directory {
   132			desired = 0o700
   133		}
   134		if snapshot.target.public {
   135			desired = before &^ 0o022
   136		}
   137		if desired&^before != 0 {
   138			return before, fmt.Errorf("repair would add owner permissions; adjust this path manually: %w", ErrManualRemediation)
   139		}
   140		return desired, nil
   141	}
   142	
   143	func permissionSameOwner(a, b fs.FileInfo) bool {
   144		left, lok := a.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
   145		right, rok := b.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
   146		return lok && rok && left.Uid == right.Uid && left.Gid == right.Gid
   147	}
   148	
   149	func permissionSameNonModeMetadata(a, b permissionMetadata) bool { return reflect.DeepEqual(a, b) }
   150	func permissionChmod(file *os.File, mode fs.FileMode) error      { return file.Chmod(mode) }
   151	func permissionSync(file *os.File) error                         { return file.Sync() }
```

```text
98	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructive(ctx context.Context, input destructiveInspectInput) (destructiveObservation, error) {
99		observed := destructiveObservation{locator: input.locator, runtime: input.runtime, runtimeErr: input.rtErr}
100		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
101			return observed, err
102		}
103	
104		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, input.locator.RepoPath)
105		if err != nil {
106			observed.repoErr = err
107			return observed, nil
108		}
109		observed.repo = repository
110		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
111		if err != nil {
112			observed.repoErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git main checkout: %w", err)
113			return observed, nil
114		}
115		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
116		if err != nil {
117			observed.repoErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory: %w", err)
118			return observed, nil
119		}
120		requestedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.RepoPath)
121		if err != nil {
122			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
123		}
124		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.GitCommonDir)
125		if err != nil {
126			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
127		}
128		if requestedRepo != observed.repoPath || requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
129			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
130				"selected repository identity changed: main %q -> %q, common directory %q -> %q",
131				requestedRepo, observed.repoPath, requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir,
132			)}
133		}
134		if filepath.IsAbs(input.locator.RepoKey) {
135			key, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.RepoKey)
136			if keyErr != nil {
137				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
138			}
139			if key != observed.gitCommonDir {
140				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected repository key no longer names the Git common directory"}
141			}
142		}
143	
144		observed.worktrees, observed.worktreesErr = s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
145		if !input.noCheckout {
146			observed.checkout, err = s.canonicalPath(input.locator.CheckoutPath)
147			if err != nil {
148				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize selected checkout: %w", err)
149			} else {
150				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
151				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
152					observed.worktreeFound = true
153					observed.observeCheckoutFacts(ctx, s)
154					if input.inspectContent && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
155						analysis, contentErr := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, input.locator.Branch, input.locator.Branch)
156						observed.contentFingerprint = analysis.Fingerprint
157						observed.contentErr = contentErr
158					}
159					observed.harness, observed.isHarness = inventory.DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
160				}
161			}
162		}
163	
164		observed.observeRefs(ctx, s, input.locator.Branch, input.base)
165		if input.inspectArtifacts && observed.worktreeFound {
166			observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
167		}
168		if !input.noCheckout && !input.skipCleanup {
169			if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
170				if observed.runtime == nil || strings.TrimSpace(observed.runtime.Name()) == "" {
171					observed.runtimeErr = errors.New("destructive inspection has no runtime backend")
172				} else {
173					observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
174					observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, input.cleanup)
175				}
176			}
177		}
178		if input.inspectTasks {
179			if input.loadTasks == nil {
180				observed.taskInventoryErr = errors.New("task inventory loader is unavailable")
181			} else {
182				observed.taskRecords, observed.taskDiagnostics, observed.taskInventoryErr = input.loadTasks()
183				if observed.taskInventoryErr == nil {
184					s.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &observed)
185				}
186			}
187		}
188		return observed, nil
189	}
190	
191	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeCheckoutFacts(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService) {
192		o.status, o.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, o.checkout)
193		o.head, o.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, o.checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")
194		o.head = strings.TrimSpace(o.head)
195		o.operation, o.inProgress, o.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, o.checkout)
196	}
197	
198	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeRefs(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService, branch, base string) {
199		o.branchRef = localBranchRef(branch)
200		if o.repoPath != "" && o.branchRef != "" {
201			o.branchExists, o.branchOIDErr = s.gitRefState(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchRef)
202			if o.branchExists && o.branchOIDErr == nil {
203				o.branchOID, o.branchOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchRef)
204			}
205		}
206		o.baseRef = localBranchRef(base)
207		if o.repoPath != "" && o.baseRef != "" {
208			o.baseExists, o.baseOIDErr = s.gitRefState(ctx, o.repoPath, o.baseRef)
209			if o.baseExists && o.baseOIDErr == nil {
210				o.baseOID, o.baseOIDErr = s.resolveRefOID(ctx, o.repoPath, o.baseRef)
211			}
212		}
213		if o.branchExists && o.branchOIDErr == nil && o.branchOID != "" &&
214			o.baseExists && o.baseOIDErr == nil && o.baseOID != "" {
215			o.contained, o.containedErr = s.isAncestor(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchOID, o.baseOID)
216		}
217	}
218	
219	func localBranchRef(branch string) string {
220		if branch == "" {
221			return ""
222		}
223		return "refs/heads/" + branch
224	}

226	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx context.Context, observed *destructiveObservation) {
227		for _, diagnostic := range observed.taskDiagnostics {
228			observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete, diagnostic.Error())
229		}
230		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
231			candidate := record.Task
232			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
233				observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
234					fmt.Sprintf("task %s is invalid: %v", candidate.ID, err))
235				continue
236			}
237	
238			pathClaim := false
239			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
240				path, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
241				if err != nil {
242					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
243						fmt.Sprintf("task %s checkout identity is unavailable: %v", candidate.ID, err))
244				} else {
245					pathClaim = path == observed.checkout
246				}
247			}
248	
249			branchClaim := false
250			if candidate.Branch == observed.locator.Branch {
251				repoMatches, complete, detail := s.taskRepositoryMatches(ctx, candidate, *observed)
252				if !complete {
253					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
254						fmt.Sprintf("task %s repository identity is unavailable: %s", candidate.ID, detail))
255				} else {
256					branchClaim = repoMatches
257				}
258			}
259	
260			if pathClaim {
261				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
262					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "exact checkout path",
263				})
264			}
265			if branchClaim {
266				reason := "exact branch in selected repository"
267				if pathClaim {
268					reason = "exact checkout path and branch in selected repository"
269					observed.taskClaims[len(observed.taskClaims)-1].Reason = reason
270					continue
271				}
272				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
273					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: reason,
274				})
275			}
276		}
277		sort.Slice(observed.taskClaims, func(i, j int) bool {
278			if observed.taskClaims[i].ID != observed.taskClaims[j].ID {
279				return observed.taskClaims[i].ID < observed.taskClaims[j].ID
280			}
281			return observed.taskClaims[i].Reason < observed.taskClaims[j].Reason
282		})
283		sort.Strings(observed.taskIncomplete)
284	}
285	
286	func (s *lifecycleService) taskRepositoryMatches(ctx context.Context, candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation) (bool, bool, string) {
287		candidatePath, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
288		if err != nil {
289			return false, false, err.Error()
290		}
291		if candidatePath == observed.repoPath {
292			return true, true, ""
293		}
294		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return false, false, err.Error()
297		}
298		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
299		if err != nil {
300			return false, false, err.Error()
301		}
302		return commonDir == observed.gitCommonDir, true, ""
303	}
304	
305	func (o destructiveObservation) branchCheckoutPaths(excludeTarget bool) ([]string, error) {
306		if o.worktreesErr != nil {
307			return nil, o.worktreesErr
308		}
309		var paths []string
310		for _, worktree := range o.worktrees {
311			if worktree.Bare || worktree.Branch != o.locator.Branch {
312				continue
313			}
314			path := worktree.Path
315			if canonical, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
316				path = filepath.Clean(canonical)
317			}
318			if excludeTarget && o.checkout != "" {
319				candidate, err := filepath.Abs(o.checkout)
320				if err == nil && filepath.Clean(candidate) == path {
321					continue
322				}
323			}
324			paths = append(paths, path)
325		}
326		sort.Strings(paths)
327		return paths, nil
328	}

330	func (o destructiveObservation) authority() map[string]string {
331		claims := make([]string, 0, len(o.taskClaims))
332		for _, claim := range o.taskClaims {
333			claims = append(claims, strings.Join([]string{claim.ID, claim.Revision, claim.Reason}, "\x00"))
334		}
335		authority := map[string]string{
336			"destructive.repo":                    o.repositoryAuthority(),
337			"destructive.checkout":                o.checkoutAuthority(),
338			"destructive.git":                     o.gitAuthority(),
339			"destructive.refs":                    o.refsAuthority(),
340			"destructive.artifact":                artifactAuthority(o.artifact, o.artifactErr),
341			"destructive.runtime":                 cleanupAuthority(o.cleanup, o.cleanupErr),
342			"destructive.runtime-backend":         runtimeName(o.runtime),
343			"destructive.runtime-error":           errorString(o.runtimeErr),
344			"destructive.runtime-available":       boolString(o.runtimeAvailable),
345			"destructive.harness":                 boolString(o.isHarness),
346			"destructive.harness-root":            o.harness.Root,
347			"destructive.task-inventory":          o.taskInventoryAuthority(),
348			"destructive.task-inventory-error":    errorString(o.taskInventoryErr),
349			"destructive.task-claims":             strings.Join(claims, "\x01"),
350			"destructive.task-incomplete":         strings.Join(o.taskIncomplete, "\x01"),
351			"destructive.worktree-list-error":     errorString(o.worktreesErr),
352			"destructive.worktree-list-authority": o.worktreeListAuthority(),
353		}
354		return authority
355	}

360			boolString(o.repo.Bare), errorString(o.repoErr),
361		)
362	}

367		)

372			stringifyStatus(o.status), errorString(o.statusErr),
373			o.head, errorString(o.headErr), o.operation, boolString(o.inProgress), errorString(o.operationErr),
374			o.contentFingerprint, errorString(o.contentErr),

378	func (o destructiveObservation) refsAuthority() string {
379		return authorityHash("taskflow-destructive-refs-v1",
380			o.branchRef, boolString(o.branchExists), o.branchOID, errorString(o.branchOIDErr),
381			o.baseRef, boolString(o.baseExists), o.baseOID, errorString(o.baseOIDErr),
382			boolString(o.contained), errorString(o.containedErr),
383		)

386	func (o destructiveObservation) taskInventoryAuthority() string {
387		values := []string{errorString(o.taskInventoryErr)}
388		values = append(values, o.taskIncomplete...)
389		for _, claim := range o.taskClaims {
390			values = append(values, claim.ID, claim.Revision, claim.Reason)
391		}
392		return authorityHash("taskflow-destructive-task-inventory-v1", values...)
393	}
394	
395	func (o destructiveObservation) worktreeListAuthority() string {
396		values := []string{errorString(o.worktreesErr), strconv.Itoa(len(o.worktrees))}
397		for _, worktree := range o.worktrees {
398			values = append(values,
399				worktree.Path, worktree.Head, worktree.Branch,
400				boolString(worktree.Detached), boolString(worktree.Bare), boolString(worktree.Main),
401				boolString(worktree.Locked), worktree.LockedReason,
402				boolString(worktree.Prunable), worktree.PrunableReason,
403			)
404		}
405		return authorityHash("taskflow-destructive-worktrees-v1", values...)
406	}
407	
408	func artifactEvidenceFromInspection(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection) string {
409		if h := inspection.History; h != nil && !h.Ready {
410			return fmt.Sprintf("%d configured history files need a verified archive", len(h.Pending))
411		}
412		if inspection.KnownEmpty {
413			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
414		}
415		states := make([]string, 0, len(inspection.Intents))
416		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
417			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
418		}
419		if len(states) == 0 {
420			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
421		}
422		return strings.Join(states, ", ")
423	}
424	
425	func mergeAuthority(base, additional map[string]string) map[string]string {
426		out := make(map[string]string, len(base)+len(additional))
427		for key, value := range base {
428			out[key] = value
429		}
430		for key, value := range additional {
431			out[key] = value
432		}
433		return out
434	}
435	
436	func destructiveConditionsReady(conditions []Condition) error {
437		if availability := AvailabilityFor(conditions); availability != AvailabilityReady {
438			var evidence []string
439			for _, current := range conditions {
440				if current.Requirement == RequirementRequired && current.Verdict != VerdictMet {
441					evidence = append(evidence, string(current.Code)+": "+current.Evidence)
442				}
443			}
444			return staleBoundary("destructive safety is no longer ready (" + strings.Join(evidence, "; ") + ")")
445		}
446		return nil
447	}
448	
449	func compareAuthorityCategory(name, before, after string) error {
450		if before != after {
451			return staleBoundary(name + " authority changed")
452		}
453		return nil
454	}
```

```text
22	func validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(locator Locator) error {
23		switch {
24		case locator.TaskID != "":
25			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged removal must not carry a TaskID", ErrInvalidRequest)
26		case locator.TaskRevision != "":
27			return fmt.Errorf("%w: unmanaged removal must not carry a task revision", ErrInvalidRequest)
28		case locator.RepoPath == "":
29			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact repository path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
30		case locator.GitCommonDir == "":
31			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact Git common directory is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
32		case locator.CheckoutPath == "":
33			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout path is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
34		case locator.Branch == "":
35			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact named branch is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
36		case locator.HeadOID == "":
37			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact checkout HEAD is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
38		case strings.TrimSpace(locator.Branch) != locator.Branch || strings.ContainsRune(locator.Branch, '\x00'):
39			return fmt.Errorf("%w: exact branch is not normalized", ErrInvalidRequest)
40		}
41		return nil
42	}

44	func (s *lifecycleService) planRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request) (PlanSpec, error) {
45		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
46			return PlanSpec{}, err
47		}
48		if err := validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(request.Locator); err != nil {
49			return PlanSpec{}, err
50		}
51		spec, _, err := s.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, request, s.tasks.ListRecords)
52		return spec, err
53	}

55	func (s *lifecycleService) observeRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, request Request, loader taskInventoryLoader) (PlanSpec, destructiveObservation, error) {
56		options := request.Options.(RemoveCheckoutOptions)
57		rt, rtErr := s.runtimeForUnmanaged()
58		cleanup := retire.Options{
59			CWD: s.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: s.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: s.callerPane,
60			CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
61			ProcessClosures: options.ProcessClosures.Map(),
62		}
63		observed, err := s.inspectDestructive(ctx, destructiveInspectInput{
64			locator: request.Locator, base: options.ContainmentBase,
65			runtime: rt, rtErr: rtErr, cleanup: cleanup,
66			inspectArtifacts: true, inspectContent: options.DiscardDirty,
67			inspectTasks: true, loadTasks: loader,
68		})
69		if err != nil {
70			return PlanSpec{}, observed, err
71		}
72		spec := s.removeCheckoutSpec(request, observed)
73		spec = s.decorateSubmodules(ctx, request, spec, observed.checkout)
74		spec.Conditions = append(spec.Conditions, retirementPreviewCondition(options.RuntimeFingerprint, observed.cleanup))
75		spec.Conditions = append(spec.Conditions, retirementIdentityPreviewCondition(options.PreviewAuthority, spec.Authority))
76		return spec, observed, nil
77	}

82			return nil, errors.New("taskflow runtime resolver returned no backend")
83		}

87	func (s *lifecycleService) removeCheckoutSpec(request Request, observed destructiveObservation) PlanSpec {
88		options := request.Options.(RemoveCheckoutOptions)
89		conditions := []Condition{retireRepositoryCondition(observed)}
90		conditions = append(conditions, removeCheckoutIdentityConditions(observed, options)...)
91		conditions = append(conditions, removeTaskInventoryConditions(observed)...)
92		conditions = append(conditions, removeContainmentConditions(observed, options)...)
93		conditions = append(conditions, removeArtifactCondition(observed))
94		conditions = append(conditions, destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed)...)
95	
96		var effects []Effect
97		if options.DiscardDirty && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
98			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
99				EffectDiscardAll, "discard every staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked change", observed.checkout, true, false,
100				map[string]string{
101					"scope": "all", "head": observed.head, "branch": observed.locator.Branch,
102					"content-fingerprint": observed.contentFingerprint,
103				},
104			))
105		}
106		if observed.runtimeErr == nil && observed.cleanupErr == nil && len(observed.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
107			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
108				EffectCloseRuntime, "close eligible runtime sessions covering the unmanaged checkout", observed.checkout, true, false,
109				map[string]string{"backend": runtimeName(observed.runtime), "sessions": fmt.Sprintf("%d", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions))},
110			))
111		}
112		effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
113			EffectRemoveWorktree, "remove the exact clean unmanaged linked checkout without force", observed.checkout, true, false,
114			map[string]string{"repo": observed.repoPath, "branch": observed.locator.Branch, "head": observed.locator.HeadOID, "force": "false", "preserve-branch": "true"},
115		))
116		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
117			effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
118				EffectDeleteBranch, "delete the freshly contained unmanaged branch under the same lock", observed.locator.Branch, true, false,
119				map[string]string{"branch-oid": observed.branchOID, "base": options.ContainmentBase, "base-oid": observed.baseOID},
120			))
121		}
122	
123		confirmation := Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Remove this unmanaged checkout while preserving its branch?"}
124		var tokenParts []string
125		if options.DiscardDirty && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
126			tokenParts = append(tokenParts, "DISCARD "+observed.checkout)
127		}
128		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
129			tokenParts = append(tokenParts, "DELETE "+observed.locator.Branch)
130		}
131		if len(tokenParts) > 0 {
132			token := strings.Join(tokenParts, " ")
133			confirmation = Confirmation{
134				Kind: ConfirmationTyped, Token: token,
135				Prompt: "Type " + token + " to approve every destructive effect in this exact plan",
136			}
137		}
138		retained := []string{"branch:" + observed.locator.Branch + "@" + observed.branchOID}
139		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
140			retained = nil
141		}
142		return PlanSpec{
143			Authority:         observed.authority(),
144			Conditions:        conditions,
145			Effects:           effects,
146			RetainedResources: retained,
147			Confirmation:      confirmation,
148			FallbackCommand:   removeCheckoutFallback(observed, options),
149			Summary:           "Remove unmanaged checkout " + observed.checkout,
150			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
151		}
152	}

154	func removeCheckoutIdentityConditions(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) []Condition {
155		if !observed.worktreeFound {
156			verdict := VerdictBlocked
157			evidence := "the exact checkout is not registered"
158			if observed.worktreeErr != nil && !errors.Is(observed.worktreeErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
159				verdict = VerdictError
160				evidence = observed.worktreeErr.Error()
161			}
162			return []Condition{
163				condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, verdict, RequirementRequired, evidence, "refresh exact worktree topology"),
164				condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout identity is unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
165				condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout kind is unavailable", "select a registered linked checkout"),
166				condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "worktree flags are unavailable", "refresh exact worktree topology"),
167				condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "branch identity is unavailable", "select a named non-detached checkout"),
168				condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "local branch ref is unavailable", "restore the exact local branch"),
169				condition(ConditionGitStatus, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git status is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
170				condition(ConditionGitOperation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "Git operation state is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
171				condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "checkout cleanliness is unavailable", "restore the exact checkout"),
172				condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "harness ownership is unavailable", "refresh the exact checkout path"),
173			}
174		}
175	
176		exactVerdict := VerdictMet
177		exactEvidence := "selected path, repository, Git common directory, and HEAD are exact"
178		switch {
179		case observed.worktree.Path != observed.checkout:
180			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered path differs from selected checkout"
181		case observed.worktree.RepositoryPath != observed.repoPath || observed.worktree.GitCommonDir != observed.gitCommonDir:
182			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered repository identity differs from selected repository"
183		case observed.headErr != nil:
184			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictError, observed.headErr.Error()
185		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Head != observed.head:
186			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Head, observed.head)
187		case observed.locator.HeadOID != observed.head:
188			exactVerdict, exactEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("selected HEAD %q differs from live HEAD %q", observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
189		}
190	
191		kindVerdict := VerdictMet
192		kindEvidence := "registered non-main, non-bare linked worktree"
193		if !observed.worktree.IsLinkedWorktree() {
194			kindVerdict = VerdictBlocked
195			kindEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("main=%t bare=%t; canonical and bare records are never removable", observed.worktree.Worktree.Main, observed.worktree.Worktree.Bare)
196		}
197	
198		flagVerdict := VerdictMet
199		flagEvidence := "worktree is unlocked and non-prunable"
200		if observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked || observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable {
201			flagVerdict = VerdictBlocked
202			flagEvidence = fmt.Sprintf("locked=%t prunable=%t", observed.worktree.Worktree.Locked, observed.worktree.Worktree.Prunable)
203		}
204	
205		branchVerdict := VerdictMet
206		branchEvidence := "registry and status identify named branch " + observed.locator.Branch
207		switch {
208		case observed.worktree.Worktree.Detached || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch == "":
209			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "registered worktree is detached or unnamed"
210		case observed.statusErr != nil:
211			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
212		case observed.status.Detached || observed.status.Branch != observed.locator.Branch || observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch != observed.locator.Branch:
213			branchVerdict, branchEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("registry=%q status=%q selected=%q", observed.worktree.Worktree.Branch, observed.status.Branch, observed.locator.Branch)
214		}
215	
216		branchRefVerdict := VerdictMet
217		branchRefEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("local %s remains at selected HEAD %s", observed.branchRef, observed.locator.HeadOID)
218		switch {
219		case observed.branchOIDErr != nil:
220			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictError, observed.branchOIDErr.Error()
221		case !observed.branchExists:
222			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "exact local branch ref does not exist"
223		case observed.branchOID != observed.locator.HeadOID || observed.branchOID != observed.head:
224			branchRefVerdict, branchRefEvidence = VerdictBlocked, fmt.Sprintf("branch OID=%q selected HEAD=%q live HEAD=%q", observed.branchOID, observed.locator.HeadOID, observed.head)
225		}
226	
227		statusVerdict := VerdictMet
228		statusEvidence := observed.status.Summary()
229		if observed.statusErr != nil {
230			statusVerdict, statusEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
231		}
232		operationVerdict := VerdictMet
233		operationEvidence := "no Git operation is in progress"
234		if observed.operationErr != nil {
235			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictError, observed.operationErr.Error()
236		} else if observed.inProgress {
237			operationVerdict, operationEvidence = VerdictBlocked, "Git operation "+observed.operation+" is in progress"
238		}
239		cleanVerdict := VerdictMet
240		cleanEvidence := "checkout is clean"
241		if observed.statusErr != nil {
242			cleanVerdict, cleanEvidence = VerdictError, observed.statusErr.Error()
243		} else if observed.status.Dirty() {
244			cleanEvidence = observed.status.Breakdown()
245			switch {
246			case !options.DiscardDirty:
247				cleanVerdict = VerdictBlocked
248				cleanEvidence += "; default removal preserves all dirty bytes"
249			case observed.contentErr != nil:
250				cleanVerdict = VerdictError
251				cleanEvidence = "dirty content fingerprint failed: " + observed.contentErr.Error()
252			case observed.contentFingerprint == "":
253				cleanVerdict = VerdictError
254				cleanEvidence = "dirty content fingerprint is unavailable"
255			default:
256				cleanEvidence += "; exact-plan content fingerprint " + observed.contentFingerprint + " will be rechecked before discard"
257			}
258		}
259	
260		harnessVerdict := VerdictMet
261		harnessEvidence := "no strict harness path evidence"
262		if observed.isHarness {
263			harnessVerdict = VerdictBlocked
264			harnessEvidence = "checkout is strictly under harness root " + observed.harness.Root
265		}
266		return []Condition{
267			condition(ConditionCheckoutPresent, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "registered checkout "+observed.checkout, ""),
268			condition(ConditionCheckoutExact, exactVerdict, RequirementRequired, exactEvidence, "refresh the exact checkout locator"),
269			condition(ConditionCheckoutLinked, kindVerdict, RequirementRequired, kindEvidence, "select a non-main linked checkout"),
270			condition(ConditionCheckoutUnlocked, flagVerdict, RequirementRequired, flagEvidence, "unlock or repair the registration; pruning is never implicit"),
271			condition(ConditionCheckoutBranch, branchVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchEvidence, "restore the exact named non-detached checkout"),
272			condition(ConditionBranchRef, branchRefVerdict, RequirementRequired, branchRefEvidence, "restore the exact local branch ref at selected HEAD"),
273			condition(ConditionGitStatus, statusVerdict, RequirementRequired, statusEvidence, "repair Git status observation"),
274			condition(ConditionGitOperation, operationVerdict, RequirementRequired, operationEvidence, "finish or abort the Git operation"),
275			condition(ConditionCheckoutClean, cleanVerdict, RequirementRequired, cleanEvidence, "commit changes or use the explicit CLI-compatible discard option"),
276			condition(ConditionHarnessOwnership, harnessVerdict, RequirementRequired, harnessEvidence, "let the harness retire its own checkout"),
277		}
278	}
279	
280	func removeTaskInventoryConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
281		inventoryCondition := condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
282			"task inventory is complete, including a successful empty inventory", "")
283		switch {
284		case observed.taskInventoryErr != nil:
285			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
286				observed.taskInventoryErr.Error(), "repair task-store inventory before proving unmanaged ownership")
287		case len(observed.taskIncomplete) > 0:
288			inventoryCondition = condition(ConditionTaskInventory, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
289				strings.Join(observed.taskIncomplete, "; "), "repair every corrupt or unresolvable task record")
290		}
291		claimsCondition := condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
292			"no task claims the exact checkout path or branch in this repository", "")
293		if len(observed.taskClaims) > 0 {
294			claims := make([]string, len(observed.taskClaims))
295			for index, claim := range observed.taskClaims {
296				claims[index] = claim.ID + " (" + claim.Reason + ")"
297			}
298			claimsCondition = condition(ConditionTaskClaims, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
299				"claimed by "+strings.Join(claims, ", "), "use managed lifecycle or reconcile the task claim")
300		}
301		return []Condition{inventoryCondition, claimsCondition}
302	}
303	
304	func removeContainmentConditions(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) []Condition {
305		if !options.RequireContained {
306			return []Condition{
307				condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
308					"unmanaged checkout removal does not require branch integration", ""),
309				condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
310					"branch is preserved regardless of containment", ""),
311				condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
312					"local branch will be retained", ""),
313			}
314		}
315		baseCondition := condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
316			fmt.Sprintf("local base %s is %s", observed.baseRef, observed.baseOID), "")
317		switch {
318		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
319			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
320				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair containment-base observation")
321		case !observed.baseExists:
322			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
323				"containment base "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore the exact local base")
324		case observed.baseOID == "":
325			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
326				"containment base resolved without an OID", "repair containment-base observation")
327		}
328		relationCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
329			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", observed.locator.Branch, observed.branchOID,
330				options.ContainmentBase, observed.baseOID), "")
331		switch {
332		case observed.containedErr != nil:
333			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
334				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local ancestry observation")
335		case !observed.branchExists || observed.branchOID == "" || !observed.baseExists || observed.baseOID == "":
336			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
337				"exact branch/base containment cannot be proved", "restore both exact local refs")
338		case !observed.contained:
339			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
340				"branch is not contained in "+options.ContainmentBase, "integrate it before contained retirement")
341		}
342		deletionCondition := condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
343			"local branch will be retained after contained checkout removal", "")
344		if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
345			deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
346				"ordinary git branch -d will run under the same repository/task lock", "")
347			if observed.locator.Branch == options.ContainmentBase {
348				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
349					"selected branch is the containment base", "retain the base branch")
350			} else if paths, err := observed.branchCheckoutPaths(true); err != nil {
351				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
352					err.Error(), "refresh worktree topology")
353			} else if len(paths) > 0 {
354				deletionCondition = condition(ConditionBranchDeletion, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
355					"branch is also checked out at "+strings.Join(paths, ", "), "remove or switch those checkouts first")
356			}
357		}
358		return []Condition{baseCondition, relationCondition, deletionCondition}
359	}
360	
361	func removeArtifactCondition(observed destructiveObservation) Condition {
362		switch {
363		case !observed.worktreeFound:
364			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
365				"artifact readiness requires the exact checkout", "restore the exact checkout")
366		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
367			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
368				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
369		case !observed.artifact.Ready():
370			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
371				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
372		default:
373			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
374				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "")
375		}
376	}
377	
378	func removeCheckoutFallback(observed destructiveObservation, options RemoveCheckoutOptions) string {
379		parts := []string{"dev", "wt", "rm", shellQuote(observed.locator.Branch)}
380		if options.RequireContained {
381			parts = []string{"dev", "retire", shellQuote(observed.checkout)}
382			if options.DeleteContainedBranch {
383				parts = append(parts, "--delete-branch")
384			}
385		} else if options.DiscardDirty {
386			parts = append(parts, "--force")
387		}
388		if options.CloseUnknown {
389			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
390		}
391		if options.AssumeNoRuntime {
392			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
393		}
394		if options.Timeout > 0 {
395			parts = append(parts, "--timeout", options.Timeout.String())
396		}
397		return strings.Join(parts, " ")
398	}

400	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
401		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
402			return Result{}, err
403		}
404		if approved.Action != RemoveCheckout {
405			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "remove-checkout handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
406		}
407		if err := validateRemoveCheckoutLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
408			return Result{}, err
409		}
410		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
411		if err != nil {
412			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
413		}
414	
415		var result Result
416		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
417			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
418				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, approved.Request, tx.ListRecords)
419				if observeErr != nil {
420					return observeErr
421				}
422				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
423				if buildErr != nil {
424					return buildErr
425				}
426				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
427					return &StalePlanError{
428						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
429						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
430						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
431						Reason:                       "fresh unmanaged Git, worktree, task, artifact, runtime, or harness authority differs",
432					}
433				}
434				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
435					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
436					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh unmanaged removal conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
437				}
438				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx}
439				result, observeErr = execution.executeRemoveCheckout(ctx, observed)
440				return observeErr
441			})
442		})
443		return result, err
444	}
445	
446	func (e *executionState) executeRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
447		if err := e.prepareSubmodules(ctx); err != nil {
448			return e.fail(err, "preserve every child repository and retry the recursive plan")
449		}
450		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RemoveCheckoutOptions)
451		closedRuntime := false
452	
453		for _, effect := range e.executionEffects() {
454			switch effect.Code {
455			case EffectDiscardAll:
456				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
457				if err != nil {
458					return e.fail(err, "refresh unmanaged removal before discarding bytes")
459				}
460				baseline = fresh
461				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
462					if discardErr := e.service.discardAll(ctx, baseline.checkout); discardErr != nil {
463						return "dirty discard may be partial", fmt.Errorf("discard exact checkout changes: %w", discardErr)
464					}
465					return "discarded all staged, unstaged, and non-ignored untracked changes", nil
466				})
467				if err != nil {
468					e.partial = true
469					return e.fail(err, "inspect every checkout byte before retrying removal")
470				}
471				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, true, false)
472				if err != nil {
473					return e.fail(err, "discard completed but a safety source changed; preserve the checkout and refresh")
474				}
475				baseline = fresh
476	
477			case EffectCloseRuntime:
478				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, false)
479				if err != nil {
480					return e.fail(err, "refresh unmanaged removal before closing any runtime")
481				}
482				baseline = fresh
483				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
484					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
485						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
486						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
487						ProcessClosures: options.ProcessClosures.Map(),
488					})
489					if closeErr != nil {
490						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
491					}
492					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
493				})
494				if err != nil {
495					e.partial = true
496					return e.fail(err, "the checkout and branch remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
497				}
498				fresh, err = e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, true)
499				if err != nil {
500					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh removal")
501				}
502				baseline = fresh
503				closedRuntime = true
504	
505			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
506				fresh, err := e.reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx, baseline, false, closedRuntime)
507				if err != nil {
508					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was preserved; refresh every safety source")
509				}
510				baseline = fresh
511				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
512					if removeErr := e.removeWithSubmodules(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout); removeErr != nil {
513						return "checkout removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact unmanaged checkout %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
514					}
515					return "removed exact clean linked checkout without force; branch preserved", nil
516				})
517				if err != nil {
518					e.partial = true
519					return e.fail(err, "inspect the exact worktree registration and preserved branch before retrying")
520				}
521				if err := e.verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
522					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact preserved local branch")
523				}
524				e.snapshot = "checkout:removed:" + baseline.checkout + ":" + baseline.branchOID
525	
526			case EffectDeleteBranch:
527				if e.snapshot == "" {
528					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before verified checkout removal"})
529				}
530				if err := e.revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
531					return e.fail(err, "the checkout was removed but the branch and task inventory changed; keep the branch and refresh")
532				}
533				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
534					if _, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", baseline.locator.Branch); deleteErr != nil {
535						return "contained branch deletion failed", deleteErr
536					}
537					return "deleted contained local branch " + baseline.locator.Branch, nil
538				})
539				if err != nil {
540					e.partial = true
541					return e.fail(err, "checkout removal remains complete; inspect the retained branch and retry")
542				}
543				exists, observeErr := e.service.gitRefState(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef)
544				if observeErr != nil {
545					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify contained branch deletion: %w", observeErr), "inspect the branch before retrying")
546				}
547				if exists {
548					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful deletion"), "inspect the branch before retrying")
549				}
550				e.snapshot += ":branch-deleted"
551	
552			default:
553				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected RemoveCheckout effect " + string(effect.Code)})
554			}
555		}
556		if e.snapshot == "" {
557			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unmanaged removal ended without verified checkout removal"})
558		}
559		return e.result(), nil
560	}
561	
562	func (e *executionState) reinspectRemoveCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowDiscard, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
563		request := e.plan.Request
564		if allowRuntimeChange {
565			options := request.Options.(RemoveCheckoutOptions)
566			options.RuntimeFingerprint = ""
567			request.Options = options
568		}
569		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRemoveCheckout(ctx, request, e.tx.ListRecords)
570		if err != nil {
571			return fresh, err
572		}
573		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
574			return fresh, err
575		}
576		for _, check := range []struct {
577			name          string
578			before, after string
579		}{
580			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
581			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
582			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
583			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
584			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
585			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
586			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
587		} {
588			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
589				return fresh, err
590			}
591		}
592		if allowDiscard {
593			if err := comparePostDiscardGit(baseline, fresh); err != nil {
594				return fresh, err
595			}
596		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()); err != nil {
597			return fresh, err
598		}
599		if allowRuntimeChange {
600			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
601				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
602			}
603		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
604			return fresh, err
605		}
606		return fresh, nil
607	}
608	
609	func comparePostDiscardGit(before, after destructiveObservation) error {
610		if after.statusErr != nil || after.status.Dirty() {
611			return staleBoundary("checkout is not clean after explicit discard")
612		}
613		beforeStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
614			before.status.Branch, boolString(before.status.Detached), before.status.Upstream,
615			fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", before.status.Behind),
616			before.head, errorString(before.headErr), before.operation, boolString(before.inProgress), errorString(before.operationErr),
617		)
618		afterStable := authorityHash("taskflow-post-discard-git-v1",
619			after.status.Branch, boolString(after.status.Detached), after.status.Upstream,
620			fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Ahead), fmt.Sprintf("%d", after.status.Behind),
621			after.head, errorString(after.headErr), after.operation, boolString(after.inProgress), errorString(after.operationErr),
622		)
623		return compareAuthorityCategory("post-discard Git identity", beforeStable, afterStable)
624	}
625	
626	func (e *executionState) revalidateUnmanagedBranchDeletion(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
627		records, diagnostics, err := e.tx.ListRecords()
628		if err != nil {
629			return err
630		}
631		claims := baseline
632		claims.taskRecords = records
633		claims.taskDiagnostics = diagnostics
634		claims.taskClaims = nil
635		claims.taskIncomplete = nil
636		e.service.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &claims)
637		if len(claims.taskIncomplete) > 0 {
638			return staleBoundary("task inventory became incomplete before branch deletion")
639		}
640		if len(claims.taskClaims) > 0 {
641			return staleBoundary("a task claimed the checkout path or branch before branch deletion")
642		}
643		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
644		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
645		if fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID || fresh.baseOID != baseline.baseOID ||
646			fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.baseOIDErr != nil || fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
647			return staleBoundary("branch or containment-base authority changed before branch deletion")
648		}
649		worktrees, err := e.service.gitWorktrees(ctx, baseline.repoPath)
650		if err != nil {
651			return err
652		}
653		for _, worktree := range worktrees {
654			if worktree.Branch == baseline.locator.Branch {
655				return staleBoundary("branch acquired another checkout before deletion")
656			}
657		}
658		return nil
659	}
660	
661	func (e *executionState) verifyUnmanagedRemoval(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {
662		_, err := e.service.resolveWorktree(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout)
663		if err == nil {
664			return staleBoundary("exact unmanaged checkout remains registered after removal")
665		}
666		if !errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {
667			return fmt.Errorf("verify exact unmanaged checkout removal: %w", err)
668		}
669		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
670		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, "")
671		if !fresh.branchExists || fresh.branchOIDErr != nil || fresh.branchOID != baseline.branchOID {
672			return staleBoundary(fmt.Sprintf("preserved local branch changed from %s to %s", baseline.branchOID, fresh.branchOID))
673		}
674		return nil
675	}
676
```

```text
package cli

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

// Markers delimit the generated block inside the skill's command reference,
// so the hand-written parts of that file survive a regeneration.
const (
	genBegin = "<!-- BEGIN GENERATED COMMANDS -->"
	genEnd   = "<!-- END GENERATED COMMANDS -->"
)

// commandReferencePath is the file `dev skill sync` maintains, relative to the
// repository root. Sync only makes sense when run from a checkout of dev
// itself — the installed binary's copy is embedded and immutable.
const commandReferencePath = "internal/skill/dev-cli/references/commands.md"

// syncCommandReference writes the generated block into the skill source, or
// reports drift when check is set.
func syncCommandReference(app *App, generated string, check bool) error {
	path, err := findSkillSource()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	current, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	updated, err := replaceBlock(string(current), generated)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", path, err)
	}

	if string(current) == updated {
		fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "command reference is current (%s)\n", commandReferencePath)
		return nil
	}
	if check {
		return errors.New("the skill's command reference is out of date — run `dev skill sync`")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(updated), 0o644); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "updated %s\n", commandReferencePath)
	fmt.Fprintln(app.Out, "rebuild dev so the embedded copy matches: go build ./cmd/dev")
	return nil
}

// replaceBlock swaps the content between the generated markers.
func replaceBlock(doc, generated string) (string, error) {
	start := strings.Index(doc, genBegin)
	end := strings.Index(doc, genEnd)
	if start < 0 || end < 0 || end < start {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("missing the %s / %s markers", genBegin, genEnd)
	}
	return doc[:start+len(genBegin)] + "\n\n" + generated + doc[end:], nil
}

// findSkillSource walks up from the working directory looking for dev's own
// checkout, so `dev skill sync` works from anywhere inside it.
func findSkillSource() (string, error) {
	dir, err := os.Getwd()
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	for {
		candidate := filepath.Join(dir, commandReferencePath)
		if _, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil {
			return candidate, nil
		}
		parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
		if parent == dir {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s not found — run `dev skill sync` from a checkout of dev-cli itself",
				commandReferencePath)
		}
```

```text
func defaultActionOptions(action Action) (ActionOptions, error) {
	switch action {
	case FetchRepository, PushBranch, FastForwardBranch:
		return SyncOptions{Operation: action}, nil
	case ParkWarm:
		return ParkWarmOptions{}, nil
	case ParkCold:
		return ParkColdOptions{}, nil
	case Resume:
		return ResumeOptions{}, nil
	case CompleteDirect:
		return CompleteDirectOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
	case CompleteFF:
		return CompleteFFOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
	case ReviewHandoff:
		return ReviewHandoffOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
	case VerifyMerged:
		return VerifyMergedOptions{Dirty: DirtyAuto}, nil
	case Retire:
		return RetireOptions{}, nil
	case Adopt:
		return AdoptOptions{}, nil
	case RemoveCheckout:
		return RemoveCheckoutOptions{}, nil
	case RefreshRemote:
		return RefreshRemoteOptions{}, nil
	case Reconcile:
		return ReconcileOptions{}, nil
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown action %q", action)
	}
}

func validateActionOptions(options ActionOptions) error {
	switch value := options.(type) {
	case SyncOptions:
		switch value.Operation {
		case FetchRepository, PushBranch, FastForwardBranch:
			return nil
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid sync operation")
	case ParkWarmOptions:
		return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
	case ParkColdOptions:
		return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
	case ResumeOptions:
		return nil
	case CompleteDirectOptions:
		return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
	case CompleteFFOptions:
		if err := validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return validateIntegrationTargetPolicy(value.IntegrationTargetPolicy)
	case ReviewHandoffOptions:
		return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
	case VerifyMergedOptions:
		return validateDirty(value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage)
	case RetireOptions:
		return validateTimeout(value.Timeout)
	case AdoptOptions:
		if value.Mode != "" && value.Mode != task.ModeWorktree {
			return fmt.Errorf("adopted checkout mode must be empty or %q, got %q", task.ModeWorktree, value.Mode)
		}
		if value.State != "" && !validState(value.State) {
			return fmt.Errorf("unknown adopted task state %q", value.State)
		}
		if value.Base != strings.TrimSpace(value.Base) || strings.ContainsRune(value.Base, '\x00') {
			return fmt.Errorf("adopted base must be normalized")
		}
		return nil
	case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
		if err := validateTimeout(value.Timeout); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if value.DeleteContainedBranch && !value.RequireContained {
			return fmt.Errorf("contained branch deletion requires containment proof")
		}
		if value.RequireContained {
			if value.ContainmentBase == "" || value.ContainmentBase != strings.TrimSpace(value.ContainmentBase) ||
				strings.ContainsRune(value.ContainmentBase, '\x00') {
				return fmt.Errorf("containment base must be a normalized nonempty branch")
			}
		} else if value.ContainmentBase != "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("containment base requires containment proof")
		}
		return nil
	case RefreshRemoteOptions:
		if !value.FetchRefs && !value.QueryReview {
			return fmt.Errorf("select fetch refs, query review, or both")
		}
		return nil
	case ReconcileOptions:
		if strings.TrimSpace(value.Name) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("a named reconciliation is required")
		}
		if value.Name != strings.TrimSpace(value.Name) {
			return fmt.Errorf("reconciliation name must be normalized")
		}
		return nil
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported options type %T", options)
	}
}

func validateTimeout(timeout time.Duration) error {
	if timeout < 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("timeout cannot be negative")
	}
	return nil
}

func appendOptionsIdentity(writer *identityWriter, options ActionOptions) {
	writer.addString("options.action", string(options.Action()))
	if isCompletionAction(options.Action()) {
		r := completionRuntimeOptions(options)
		writer.addFields("close-task-panes", r.CloseTaskPanes)
		writer.addFields("foreground-consent", r.ProgramConsent)
	}
	switch value := options.(type) {
	case ParkWarmOptions:
		writer.addString("next", value.Next)
		writer.addString("note", value.Note)
		writer.addBool("commit-wip", value.CommitWIP)
		writer.addBool("push", value.Push)
		writer.addBool("keep-session", value.KeepSession)
		appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
	case ParkColdOptions:
		writer.addString("next", value.Next)
		writer.addString("note", value.Note)
		writer.addBool("commit-wip", value.CommitWIP)
		writer.addBool("push", value.Push)
		appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
	case ResumeOptions:
		writer.addBool("fetch-refs", value.FetchRefs)
		writer.addBool("no-provision", value.NoProvision)
		writer.addBool("take-ownership", value.TakeOwnership)
	case CompleteDirectOptions:
		appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage, value.Push)
	case CompleteFFOptions:
		appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer, value.Dirty, value.CommitMessage, value.PushBase)
		writer.addString("integration-target-policy", string(value.IntegrationTargetPolicy))
	case ReviewHandoffOptions:
		writer.addString("dirty", string(value.Dirty))
		writer.addString("commit-message", value.CommitMessage)
		writer.addBool("draft", value.Draft)
		writer.addString("title", value.Title)
		writer.addString("body", value.Body)
	case VerifyMergedOptions:
		writer.addString("dirty", string(value.Dirty))
		writer.addString("commit-message", value.CommitMessage)
		writer.addString("base-ref", value.BaseRef)
		writer.addString("squash-commit", value.SquashCommit)
		writer.addBool("push-base", value.PushBase)
	case RetireOptions:
		writer.addBool("delete-branch", value.DeleteBranch)
		writer.addFields("process-closures", value.ProcessClosures)
		writer.addString("runtime-preview", value.RuntimeFingerprint)
		writer.addFields("retirement-preview", value.PreviewAuthority)
		appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
	case AdoptOptions:
		writer.addString("mode", string(value.Mode))
		writer.addString("state", string(value.State))
		writer.addString("name", value.Name)
		writer.addString("base", value.Base)
		writer.addString("owner", value.Owner)
		writer.addString("next", value.Next)
		writer.addString("note", value.Note)
		writer.addStrings("tags", value.Tags.values)
	case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
		writer.addBool("discard-dirty", value.DiscardDirty)
		writer.addFields("process-closures", value.ProcessClosures)
		writer.addString("runtime-preview", value.RuntimeFingerprint)
		writer.addFields("retirement-preview", value.PreviewAuthority)
		writer.addBool("require-contained", value.RequireContained)
		writer.addString("containment-base", value.ContainmentBase)
		writer.addBool("delete-contained-branch", value.DeleteContainedBranch)
		appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer, value.CloseUnknown, value.AssumeNoRuntime, value.Timeout)
	case RefreshRemoteOptions:
		writer.addBool("fetch-refs", value.FetchRefs)
		writer.addBool("query-review", value.QueryReview)
	case ReconcileOptions:
		writer.addString("name", value.Name)
		writer.addFields("parameters", value.Parameters)
	}
}

func appendCompletionOptionsIdentity(writer *identityWriter, dirty DirtyPolicy, message string, push bool) {
	writer.addString("dirty", string(dirty))
	writer.addString("commit-message", message)
	writer.addBool("push", push)
}

func appendRuntimeOptionsIdentity(writer *identityWriter, closeUnknown, assumeNoRuntime bool, timeout time.Duration) {
	writer.addBool("close-unknown", closeUnknown)
	writer.addBool("assume-no-runtime", assumeNoRuntime)
	writer.addInt64("timeout", int64(timeout))
}
```

```text
func TestPlanInitBlocksUnsafeMetadataWithoutWrites(t *testing.T) {
	service, paths := secureFixtureService(t, "Host old\n")
	if err := os.Chmod(paths.RootConfig, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	plan, err := service.PlanInit(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if plan.Action != ActionBlocked || !hasDiagnostic(plan.Diagnostics, "root_metadata_unsafe") {
		t.Fatalf("plan = %#v", plan)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{paths.ManagedDir, filepath.Join(paths.SSHDir, ".dev.d.lock")} {
		if _, err := os.Lstat(path); !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
			t.Fatalf("planning wrote %s: %v", path, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestInitApplyPreservesBOMCRLFOutsideBytesAndXattr(t *testing.T) {
	service, paths := secureFixtureService(t, "placeholder")
	bom := []byte{0xef, 0xbb, 0xbf}
	original := append(append([]byte{}, bom...), []byte("# top\r\nCompression yes\r\nHost old\r\n  User me\r\n")...)
	if err := os.WriteFile(paths.RootConfig, original, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	attributeName := "user.dev-cli-sshhost-test"
	attributeValue := []byte("preserve-me")
	xattrSupported := unix.Setxattr(paths.RootConfig, attributeName, attributeValue, 0) == nil

	plan, err := service.PlanInit(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if plan.Action != ActionUpdate || plan.Newline != "\r\n" || !plan.BOM {
		t.Fatalf("plan = %#v", plan)
	}
	result, err := service.ApplyInit(context.Background(), plan)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !result.Changed || result.Action != ActionUpdate {
		t.Fatalf("result = %#v", result)
	}
	got, err := os.ReadFile(paths.RootConfig)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := append(append([]byte{}, bom...), []byte("# top\r\nCompression yes\r\n"+rootIncludeLine()+"\r\nHost old\r\n  User me\r\n")...)
	if !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("root bytes:\n%q\nwant:\n%q", got, want)
	}
	info, err := os.Stat(paths.RootConfig)
	if err != nil || info.Mode().Perm() != 0o600 {
		t.Fatalf("root mode = %v, err %v", info.Mode(), err)
	}
	if xattrSupported {
		size, err := unix.Getxattr(paths.RootConfig, attributeName, nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		value := make([]byte, size)
		read, err := unix.Getxattr(paths.RootConfig, attributeName, value)
		if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(value[:read], attributeValue) {
			t.Fatalf("xattr = %q, err %v", value[:read], err)
		}
	}
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(paths.ManagedDir)
	if err != nil || len(entries) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("managed directory entries = %#v, err %v", entries, err)
	}
}
```

```text
func (s *lifecycleService) resolveRefOID(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (string, error) {
	if ref == "" {
		return "", nil
	}

	return strings.TrimSpace(value), err
```
