    17	func platformReadXattrs(file *os.File) (map[string][]byte, error) {
    18		fd := int(file.Fd())
    19		size, err := unix.Flistxattr(fd, nil)
    20		if err != nil {
    21			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list extended attributes: %w", err)
    22		}
    23		if size == 0 {
    24			return map[string][]byte{}, nil
    25		}
    26		buffer := make([]byte, size)
    27		size, err = unix.Flistxattr(fd, buffer)
    28		if err != nil {
    29			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list extended attributes: %w", err)
    30		}
    31		attributes := make(map[string][]byte)
    32		for _, name := range strings.Split(string(buffer[:size]), "\x00") {
    33			if name == "" {
    34				continue
    35			}
    36			valueSize, err := unix.Fgetxattr(fd, name, nil)
    37			if err != nil {
    38				return nil, fmt.Errorf("read extended attribute %q: %w", name, err)
    39			}
    40			value := make([]byte, valueSize)
    41			if valueSize > 0 {
    42				read, err := unix.Fgetxattr(fd, name, value)
    43				if err != nil {
    44					return nil, fmt.Errorf("read extended attribute %q: %w", name, err)
    45				}
    46				value = value[:read]
    47			}
    48			attributes[name] = value
    49		}
    50		return attributes, nil
    51	}

    53	func platformWriteXattrs(file *os.File, attributes map[string][]byte) error {
    54		fd := int(file.Fd())
    55		names := make([]string, 0, len(attributes))
    56		for name := range attributes {
    57			names = append(names, name)
    58		}
    59		sort.Strings(names)
    60		for _, name := range names {
    61			if platformfs.KernelLabel(name, attributes[name]) {
    62				// SELinux assigns the staged file's label. Never relabel a file;
    63				// require the inherited bytes to match the observed source.
    64				value := make([]byte, len(attributes[name])+1)
    65				n, err := unix.Fgetxattr(fd, name, value)
    66				if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(value[:max(0, n)], attributes[name]) {
    67					return fmt.Errorf("inherited Android label differs from source: %w", errors.Join(ErrUnsafePath, err))
    68				}
    69				continue
    70			}
    71			if err := unix.Fsetxattr(fd, name, attributes[name], 0); err != nil {
    72				return fmt.Errorf("restore extended attribute %q: %w", name, err)
    73			}
    74		}
    75		return nil
    76	}
	}
	groups, err := os.Getgroups()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("resolve current groups: %w", err)
	}
	groupAllowed := metadata.gid == os.Getegid()
	for _, group := range groups {
		groupAllowed = groupAllowed || metadata.gid == group
	}
	if !groupAllowed {
		return fmt.Errorf("group %d cannot be restored by the current user", metadata.gid)
	}
	if err := platformFlagsRoundTrip(metadata.flags); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for name := range metadata.xattrs {
		if platformfs.KernelLabel(name, metadata.xattrs[name]) {
			continue
		}
		// Kernel security labels and POSIX ACLs often require privilege to set and
		// can grant access beyond mode 0600. Block before staging rather than
		// silently dropping or approximating them.
		if len(name) >= 9 && name[:9] == "security." || len(name) >= 7 && name[:7] == "system." || name == "com.apple.system.Security" {
			return fmt.Errorf("extended attribute %q requires manual preservation", name)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func platformApplyPrivateFile(path string, file *os.File) error {
	return file.Chmod(0o600)
}

func platformApplyMetadata(path string, file *os.File, metadata fileMetadata) error {
	if err := file.Chown(metadata.uid, metadata.gid); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := file.Chmod(metadata.mode.Perm()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := platformWriteXattrs(file, metadata.xattrs); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return platformSetFileFlags(file, metadata.flags)
}

func platformVerifyMetadata(path string, file *os.File, expected fileMetadata) error {
	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	actual, err := platformCaptureMetadata(path, file, info)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if actual.mode != expected.mode || actual.uid != expected.uid || actual.gid != expected.gid || actual.flags != expected.flags || !reflect.DeepEqual(actual.xattrs, expected.xattrs) {
		return errors.New("staged Unix metadata differs from source metadata")
	}
	return nil
}

func platformSyncDirectory(path string) error {
	directory, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer directory.Close()
	return directory.Sync()
}

	after, err := file.Stat()

func readSecureFileIfExists(path string, captureMetadata bool) (fileSnapshot, error) {
	snapshot, err := readSecureFile(path, captureMetadata)
	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
		return fileSnapshot{path: path}, nil
	}
	return snapshot, err
}

func readSecureFileAtIfExists(root *os.Root, name, path string, captureMetadata bool) (fileSnapshot, error) {
	snapshot, err := readSecureFileAt(root, name, path, captureMetadata)
	return nil
}

func platformMakePrivateDirectory(path string) error {
	if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0o700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(path, 0o700); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(path)
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func platformOpenNoFollow(path string) (*os.File, error) {
	fd, err := unix.Open(path, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_CLOEXEC|unix.O_NOFOLLOW, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), path), nil
}

func platformValidatePrivateFile(path string, file *os.File, info fs.FileInfo) error {
	stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s has no Unix ownership metadata", path)
	}
	if int(stat.Uid) != os.Geteuid() {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s is not owned by the current user: %w", path, ErrUnsafePath)
	}
	if stat.Nlink != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s has %d hard links, want 1: %w", path, stat.Nlink, ErrUnsafePath)
	}
	if info.Mode().Perm() != 0o600 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s mode is %04o, want 0600: %w", path, info.Mode().Perm(), ErrUnsafePath)
	}
	return nil
}

func platformCaptureMetadata(path string, file *os.File, info fs.FileInfo) (fileMetadata, error) {
	stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t)
	if !ok {
		return fileMetadata{}, errors.New("file has no Unix ownership metadata")
	}
	xattrs, err := platformReadXattrs(file)
	if err != nil {
		return fileMetadata{}, err
	}
	flags, err := platformFileFlags(file)
	if err != nil {
		return fileMetadata{}, err
	}
	return fileMetadata{
		mode: info.Mode().Perm(), uid: int(stat.Uid), gid: int(stat.Gid), xattrs: xattrs, flags: flags,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) allowedTarget(kind, path string) bool {
	switch kind {
	case "hygiene_rules":
		return path == filepath.Join(s.Dir, "policy.toml")
	case "hygiene_setup":
		for _, rel := range []string{".pre-commit-config.yaml", ".gitleaks.toml", ".dev-cli/hygiene.toml"} {
			if path == filepath.Join(s.Root, filepath.FromSlash(rel)) {
				return true
			}
		}
	case "hygiene_repair_encoding":
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(s.Root, path)
		return err == nil && validRepairPath(filepath.ToSlash(rel))
	case "hygiene_redact":
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(s.Root, path)
		return err == nil && validRelative(filepath.ToSlash(rel))
	}
	return false
}
func (s *Service) Restore(ctx context.Context, receipt string, apply bool, o ApplyOptions) ([]configedit.Change, error) {
	plan, err := configedit.RestorePlan(ctx, filepath.Join(s.Dir, "recovery"), receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("recovery unavailable or source changed")
	}
	for _, c := range plan.Preview() {
		if !s.allowedTarget("hygiene_redact", c.Path) && !s.allowedTarget("hygiene_rules", c.Path) {
			return nil, errors.New("recovery path belongs to another checkout")
		}
	}
	if !apply {
		return plan.Preview(), nil
	}
	paths := []string{}
	for _, c := range plan.Preview() {
		paths = append(paths, c.Path)
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(s.Root, c.Path)
		if IsArtifactPath(filepath.ToSlash(rel)) && !o.WriterStopped {
			return nil, errors.New("artifact recovery requires explicit post-writer proof")
		}
	}
	err = gitx.WithLifecycleLock(ctx, s.Common, func() error {
		if o.Guard != nil {
			if e := o.Guard(ctx, s.Root, paths); e != nil {
				return e
			p.View.Status = "applying"
			if e := s.save(ctx, &p); e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if p.Binding.CaptureDir != "" {
				if e := safeWriteParent(ctx, p.Binding.CaptureDir); e != nil {
					return e
				}
				if e := privatefile.EnsureDir(p.Binding.CaptureDir); e != nil {
					return e
				}
			}
			for i, editor := range editors {
				for _, remaining := range editors[i:] {
					if e := remaining.Check(ctx); e != nil {
						return ErrStale
					}
				}
				r, e := configedit.Apply(ctx, editor, filepath.Join(s.Dir, "recovery"))
				if r.Receipt != "" {
					p.View.Recovery = append(p.View.Recovery, r.Receipt)
				}
				if e != nil {
					return errors.New("artifact setup interrupted; inspect private recovery")
				}
				p.View.Completed = append(p.View.Completed, p.View.Files[i].File)
				if e = s.save(ctx, &p); e != nil {
					return e
				}
			}
			p.View.Status = "complete"
			return s.save(ctx, &p)
		})
	})
	if err != nil && p.View.Status == "applying" {
		p.View.Status = "partial"
		_ = s.save(context.Background(), &p)
	}
	return p.View, err
}

// Settle bounds the second observation used by external manual dogfood.
func Settle(ctx context.Context) error {
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	case <-time.After(500 * time.Millisecond):
		return nil
	}
}

   151				for _, c := range v.Items {

   153				}
   154			default:

   171	func (h *hygieneCLI) guard(ctx context.Context, root string, paths []string) error {
   172		runtime := h.app.Runtime()
   173		if runtime == nil || runtime.Name() == "none" {
   174			return nil
   175		}
   176		observation, err := rt.InspectOccupancy(ctx, runtime, root, rt.OccupancyOptions{CallerWorkspaceID: os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID"), CallerPaneID: os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")})
   177		if err != nil || observation.SessionList.Err != nil || observation.AgentActivityList.Err != nil || observation.CurrentPane.Err != nil || observation.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
   178			return errors.New("cannot verify checkout writer occupancy")
   179		}
   180		artifact := false
   181		for _, p := range paths {
   182			rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, p)
   183			if err != nil {
   184				return errors.New("cannot identify artifact path for writer checks")
   185			}
   186			artifact = artifact || hygiene.IsArtifactPath(filepath.ToSlash(rel))
   187		}
   188		for _, a := range observation.Agents {
   189			if a.Blocking || artifact {
   190				return errors.New("a recognized agent still occupies the checkout; stop the writer before applying")
   191			}
   192		}
   193		return nil
   194	}
   195	func (h *hygieneCLI) apply(ctx context.Context, s *hygiene.Service, id string, yes, writerStopped bool, expectedKind string) error {
   196		p, err := s.ReadPlan(ctx, id)
   197		if err != nil {
   198			return err
   199		}
   200		if p.Kind != expectedKind {
   201			return errors.New("plan kind does not match this command")
   202		}
   203		if !yes {
   204			if !h.app.interactive() {
   205				return errors.New("review the saved plan, then use --apply --plan ID --yes")
   206			}
   207			if err = h.output(p, nil); err != nil {
   208				return err
   209			}
   210			ok, e := newPrompter(h.app).confirm("Apply this hygiene plan?", false)
   211			if e != nil {
   212				return e
   213			}
   214			if !ok {
   215				return nil
   216			}
   217		}
   218		result, err := s.Apply(ctx, id, hygiene.ApplyOptions{WriterStopped: writerStopped, Guard: h.guard})
   219		return h.output(result, err)
   220	}

   472			return []check{{"repo hygiene", checkWarn, "hook or policy coverage incomplete; run dev hygiene status / setup"}}
   473		}
   474		return []check{{"repo hygiene", checkOK, "recognized hook chain and repository policy (not a content scan)"}}
   475	}

   214	func appendOccupancyAgent(ctx context.Context, result *Occupancy, checkout checkoutIdentity, opts OccupancyOptions, activity AgentActivity) error {
   215		covered, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, checkout, activity.CWD, opts.Profile)
   216		if err != nil {
   217			return fmt.Errorf("classify recognized agent pane %s: %w", activity.PaneID, err)
   218		}
   219		if !covered {
   220			return nil
   221		}
   222		status := normalizeOccupancyStatus(activity.Status)
   223		caller := result.CallerPaneID != "" && activity.PaneID == result.CallerPaneID
   224		handle := correlatedSession(result.Sessions, activity)
   225		result.Agents = append(result.Agents, OccupancyAgent{
   226			Activity:      activity,
   227			Status:        status,
   228			SessionHandle: handle,
   229			IsCaller:      caller,
   230			Blocking:      occupancyAgentBlocks(opts, status, caller, handle != ""),
   231		})
   232		return nil
   233	}
   234	
   235	type checkoutIdentity struct {
   236		path   string
   237		git    bool
   238		linked bool
   239	}
   240	
   241	func inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx context.Context, dir string) (checkoutIdentity, error) {
   242		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(dir)
   243		if err != nil {
   244			return checkoutIdentity{}, err
   245		}
   246		repo, discoverErr := gitx.Discover(ctx, canonical)
   247		if discoverErr == nil && repo.Root != "" {
   248			root, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(repo.Root)
   249			if canonicalErr != nil {
   250				return checkoutIdentity{}, canonicalErr
   251			}
   252			return checkoutIdentity{path: root, git: true, linked: repo.IsLinkedWorktree}, nil
   253		}
   254		if discoverErr != nil && !errors.Is(discoverErr, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
   255			return checkoutIdentity{}, discoverErr
   256		}
   257		return checkoutIdentity{path: canonical}, nil
   258	}
   259	
   260	func activityCoversCheckout(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, cwd string, profile OccupancyProfile) (bool, error) {
   261		if cwd == "" {
   262			return false, fmt.Errorf("recognized agent has no cwd")
   263		}
   264		activity, err := inspectCheckoutIdentity(ctx, cwd)
   265		if err != nil {
   266			return false, err
   267		}
   268		if target.git && activity.git {
   269			if target.path == activity.path {
   270				return true, nil
   271			}
   272			if profile == OccupancyCleanup && target.linked {
   273				return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
   274			}
   275			pairs := [][2]string{{target.path, activity.path}}
   276			if profile == OccupancyStrict {
   277				pairs = append(pairs, [2]string{activity.path, target.path})
   278			}
   279			for _, pair := range pairs {
   280				inside, err := pathx.Contains(pair[0], pair[1])
   281				if err != nil {
   282					return false, err
   283				}
   284				if !inside {
   285					continue
   286				}
   287				graph, err := gitx.SubmodulesOf(ctx, pair[0])
   288				if err != nil {
   289					return false, err
   290				}
   291				for _, node := range graph.Nodes {
   292					if node.Initialized {
   293						root, err := pathx.Canonical(filepath.Join(pair[0], filepath.FromSlash(node.Path)))
   294						if err != nil {
   295							return false, err
   296						}
   297						if root == pair[1] {
   298							return true, nil
   299						}
   300					}
   301				}
   302			}
   303			return false, nil
   304		}
   305		return pathx.Contains(target.path, activity.path)
   306	}
   307	
   308	func classifyOccupancySession(ctx context.Context, target checkoutIdentity, session Session, profile OccupancyProfile) ([]Pane, []Pane, error) {
   309		panes := session.Panes
   310		if len(panes) == 0 {
   311			for i, dir := range session.Dirs {
   312				panes = append(panes, Pane{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.Handle, i), CWD: dir})
   313			}
   314		}
   315		var covering, mixed []Pane
   316		for _, pane := range panes {
   317			paths := []string{pane.CWD}
   318			if pane.Process != nil {
   319				for _, process := range pane.Process.Processes {
   320					if process.CWD != "" {
   321						paths = append(paths, process.CWD)
   322					}
   323				}
   324			}
   325			if pane.ShellCWD != "" && pane.ShellCWD != pane.CWD {
   326				paths = append(paths, pane.ShellCWD)
   327			}
   328			paneCovers, paneOutside, observed := false, false, false
   329			for _, path := range paths {
   330				if path == "" {
   331					continue
   332				}
   333				observed = true
   334				inside, err := activityCoversCheckout(ctx, target, path, profile)
   335				if err != nil {
   336					return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compare runtime pane %s path: %w", pane.ID, err)
   337				}
   338				if inside {
   339					paneCovers = true
   340				} else {
   341					paneOutside = true
   342				}
   343			}
   344			if paneCovers {
   345				covering = append(covering, pane)
   346			}
   347			if paneOutside || !observed {
   348				mixed = append(mixed, pane)
   349			}
   350		}
   351		return covering, mixed, nil
   352	}
   353	
   354	func occupancyPanePresent(panes []Pane, id string) bool {
   355		if id == "" {
   356			return false
   357		}
   358		for _, pane := range panes {
   359			if pane.ID == id {
   360				return true
   361			}
   362		}
   363		return false
   364	}
   365	
   366	func correlatedSession(sessions []OccupancySession, activity AgentActivity) string {
   367		for _, session := range sessions {
   368			if activity.WorkspaceID != "" && session.Runtime.Handle == activity.WorkspaceID {
   369				return session.Runtime.Handle
   370			}
   371			if occupancyPanePresent(session.Runtime.Panes, activity.PaneID) {
   372				return session.Runtime.Handle
   373			}
   374		}
   375		return ""
   376	}
   377	
   378	func normalizeOccupancyStatus(status string) string {
   379		status = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(status))
   380		if status == "" {
   381			return "unknown"
   382		}
   383		return status
   384	}
   385	
   386	func occupancyAgentBlocks(opts OccupancyOptions, status string, caller, correlated bool) bool {
   387		if opts.Profile != OccupancyCleanup {
   388			return !caller
   389		}
   390		// Cleanup can never close the caller or an activity that does not correlate
   391		// with a freshly listed covering session.
   392		if caller || !correlated {
   393			return true
   394		}
   395		switch status {
   396		case "idle", "done":
   397			return false
   398		case "unknown":
   399			return !opts.CloseUnknown
   400		default:
   401			return true
   402		}
   403	}

func newArtifactArchiveCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	h := &artifactHistoryCLI{app: app}
	var o agenthistory.ArchiveOptions
	var apply, yes, stopped bool
	var plan string
	c := &cobra.Command{Use: "archive", Short: "Preserve selected history in an external Git archive", Long: `Preview immutable copies of selected transcript/plan files, then commit them to the configured archive.

Source files and the source index stay unchanged. Redaction, when selected,
changes the archive copy only. No push occurs. Review the private proposal and
wait for the exact recorder to stop before applying it. Capturing a stable file
does not prove its writer has stopped. --file paths are relative to the source
repo, including when SpecStory writes to an external capture directory.`, Args: cobra.NoArgs, RunE: func(c *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
		s, e := h.service(c.Context())
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if apply {
			if plan == "" {
				return errors.New("--apply requires --plan")
			}
			p, e := s.ReadPlan(c.Context(), plan)
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if p.Kind != "artifact_archive" {
				return errors.New("plan kind does not match archive")
			}
			if e = h.confirm(p, yes); e != nil {
				return e
			}
			guard := (&hygieneCLI{app: app}).guard
			p, e = s.ApplyArchive(c.Context(), plan, agenthistory.ApplyOptions{WriterStopped: stopped, Guard: guard})
			return h.output(p, e)
		}
		if plan != "" || yes || stopped {
			return errors.New("--plan, --yes and --writer-stopped require --apply")
		}
		p, e := s.PreviewArchive(c.Context(), o)
		return h.output(p, e)
	}}
	h.bind(c)

func newArtifactCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	cmd := &cobra.Command{Use: "artifact", Short: "Manage coding-agent transcripts and plans", Long: `Preserve coding-agent conversation evidence and selected plans.

The current finalizer reads SpecStory Markdown. SpecStory is the recorder;
--session names the originating agent, such as codex:<uuid> or claude:<uuid>.
Native agent sessions and tool databases have their own backup/resume contracts.`}
	cmd.AddCommand(newArtifactFinalizeCmd(app), newArtifactListCmd(app), newArtifactDiscardCmd(app), newArtifactObserveCmd(app), newArtifactStatusCmd(app), newArtifactSetupCmd(app), newArtifactArchiveCmd(app), newArtifactFindCmd(app), newArtifactMigrateCmd(app), newArtifactSyncCmd(app), newArtifactBackupCmd(app))
	return cmd
}

func newArtifactFinalizeCmd(app *App) *cobra.Command {
	var (
		intentID      string
		runID         string
		settle        time.Duration
		ifPending     bool
		writerStopped bool
		archivePlan   string
	)
	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "finalize",
		Short: "Finalize a prepared session after its transcript writer stops",
		Args:  cobra.NoArgs,
		RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
			store := artifactStore(app)
			resolvedRunID := firstNonEmpty(runID, os.Getenv("DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID"))
			if ifPending && intentID == "" {
				if _, err := store.FindByRunID(resolvedRunID); errors.Is(err, artifact.ErrIntentNotFound) {
					return nil
				} else if err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			service := &artifact.Service{Store: store, ScanStaged: scanAgentArtifacts}
			intent, err := service.Finalize(ctxOf(), artifact.FinalizeRequest{
				IntentID: intentID, RunID: resolvedRunID, Settle: settle, WriterStopped: writerStopped, ArchivePlanID: archivePlan, Guard: (&hygieneCLI{app: app}).guard,
			})
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "FINALIZED %s\n", intent.ID)
			if intent.Destination == "archive" {
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   archive commit %s\n", shortOID(intent.ArchiveCommit))
			} else {
				fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   commit      %s\n", shortOID(intent.ArtifactCommit))
			}
			fmt.Fprintf(app.Out, "   transcript  %s\n", config.Contract(intent.TranscriptPath))
			return nil
		},
	}

// Pane is one terminal surface inside a runtime session.
type Pane struct {
	ID           string
	TabID        string
	TerminalID   string
	CWD          string
	ShellCWD     string
	Agent        string
	AgentName    string
	AgentStatus  string
	AgentSession string
	Process      *PaneProcessObservation
}

// Session is one live workspace/session of a runtime backend.
type Session struct {
	// Handle is the backend's own identifier (a herdr workspace id, a tmux
	// session name). Opaque to the rest of dev.
	Handle string
	Label  string
	// Herdr's first-class workspace identity is independent of pane cwd.
	// An observed parent/generic workspace must not be retired as a child.
	WorkspaceIdentityObserved bool
	WorkspaceCheckout         string
	WorkspaceLinked           bool
	// Dirs lists the working directories observed in this session. A session
	// can span several (multiple panes), which is why this is not a single
	// value.
	Dirs []string
	// AgentStatus is the backend's view of agent activity, when it has one:
	// "working", "idle", "done", "waiting". Empty when unsupported.
	AgentStatus string
	// AgentSessions lists resumable agent context ids, e.g. "claude:<uuid>".
	AgentSessions []string
	// Panes retain the exact runtime IDs and cwd values used for caller and
	// mixed-workspace retirement checks.
	Panes   []Pane
	Focused bool
}

// Covers reports whether the session has a pane rooted at or under dir.
		CheckoutPath string `json:"checkout_path"`
		Linked       bool   `json:"is_linked_worktree"`
	} `json:"worktree"`
}

type herdrPane struct {
	PaneID        string `json:"pane_id"`
	TabID         string `json:"tab_id"`
	TerminalID    string `json:"terminal_id"`
	WorkspaceID   string `json:"workspace_id"`
	CWD           string `json:"cwd"`
	ForegroundCWD string `json:"foreground_cwd"`
	Agent         string `json:"agent"`
	Name          string `json:"name"`
	AgentStatus   string `json:"agent_status"`
	AgentSession  *struct {
		Agent string `json:"agent"`
		Value string `json:"value"`
	} `json:"agent_session"`
}

type herdrWorktree struct {
	Path            string `json:"path"`
	Branch          string `json:"branch"`
	Label           string `json:"label"`
	OpenWorkspaceID string `json:"open_workspace_id"`
	IsLinked        bool   `json:"is_linked_worktree"`
}

// List implements Runtime. Workspaces carry no working directory of their own,
// so dev joins them against the pane list — panes are what actually have a cwd.
func (h *Herdr) List(ctx context.Context) ([]Session, error) {
	var ws struct {
		Workspaces []herdrWorkspace `json:"workspaces"`
	}
	if err := h.call(ctx, &ws, "workspace", "list"); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var ps struct {
		Panes []herdrPane `json:"panes"`
	}
	if err := h.call(ctx, &ps, "pane", "list"); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	dirs := map[string]map[string]bool{}
	agents := map[string]map[string]bool{}
	panes := map[string][]Pane{}
	for _, p := range ps.Panes {
		cwd := p.ForegroundCWD
		if cwd == "" {
			cwd = p.CWD
		}
		if dirs[p.WorkspaceID] == nil {
			dirs[p.WorkspaceID] = map[string]bool{}
		}
		for _, dir := range []string{p.CWD, cwd} {
			if dir != "" {
				dirs[p.WorkspaceID][dir] = true
			}
		}
		agentSession := ""
		if p.AgentSession != nil && p.AgentSession.Value != "" {
			agent := p.AgentSession.Agent
			if agent == "" {
				agent = p.Agent
			}
			agentSession = agent + ":" + p.AgentSession.Value
			if agents[p.WorkspaceID] == nil {
				agents[p.WorkspaceID] = map[string]bool{}
			}
			agents[p.WorkspaceID][agentSession] = true
		}
		panes[p.WorkspaceID] = append(panes[p.WorkspaceID], Pane{
			ID: p.PaneID, TabID: p.TabID, TerminalID: p.TerminalID, CWD: cwd, ShellCWD: p.CWD, Agent: p.Agent,
			AgentName: p.Name, AgentStatus: p.AgentStatus, AgentSession: agentSession,
		})
	}

	out := make([]Session, 0, len(ws.Workspaces))
	for _, w := range ws.Workspaces {
		checkout, linked := "", false
		if w.Worktree != nil {
			checkout, linked = w.Worktree.CheckoutPath, w.Worktree.Linked
		}
		out = append(out, Session{
			WorkspaceIdentityObserved: true, WorkspaceCheckout: checkout, WorkspaceLinked: linked,
			Handle:        w.WorkspaceID,
			Label:         w.Label,
			Dirs:          keys(dirs[w.WorkspaceID]),
			AgentSessions: keys(agents[w.WorkspaceID]),
			AgentStatus:   w.AgentStatus,
			Panes:         panes[w.WorkspaceID],
			Focused:       w.Focused,
		})
	}
	return out, nil
}

     1	package artifact
     2	
     3	import (
     4		"bufio"
     5		"context"

     8		"fmt"

    10		"os"
    11		"path/filepath"
    12		"regexp"
    13		"strings"
    14		"time"
    15	
    16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
    17	)
    18	
    19	var transcriptSessionLine = regexp.MustCompile(`^<!-- ([^-][^<]*) Session ([0-9a-fA-F-]+) \(`)
    20	
    21	type Transcript struct {
    22		Path      string
    23		Provider  string
    24		SessionID string
    25	}
    26	
    27	type Snapshot struct {
    28		Size    int64
    29		ModTime time.Time
    30		SHA256  string
    31	}
    32	
    33	// FindTranscript selects exactly one SpecStory transcript by its anchored
    34	// preamble session UUID. UUID mentions later in a transcript are never used.
    35	func FindTranscript(worktree, provider, sessionID string) (Transcript, error) {
    36		history := filepath.Join(worktree, ".specstory", "history")
    37		entries, err := os.ReadDir(history)
    38		if err != nil {
    39			return Transcript{}, err
    40		}
    41		var matches []Transcript
    42		for _, entry := range entries {
    43			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
    44				continue
    45			}
    46			path := filepath.Join(history, entry.Name())
    47			inside, err := pathx.Contains(history, path)
    48			if err != nil || !inside {
    49				continue
    50			}
    51			gotProvider, gotSession, err := transcriptPreamble(path)
    52			if err != nil || gotSession != sessionID || (provider != "" && gotProvider != provider) {
    53				continue
    54			}
    55			matches = append(matches, Transcript{Path: path, Provider: gotProvider, SessionID: gotSession})
    56		}
    57		switch len(matches) {
    58		case 1:
    59			return matches[0], nil
    60		case 0:
    61			return Transcript{}, fmt.Errorf("no SpecStory transcript with preamble session %s:%s", provider, sessionID)
    62		default:
    63			return Transcript{}, fmt.Errorf("multiple SpecStory transcripts have preamble session %s:%s", provider, sessionID)
    64		}
    65	}
    66	
    67	func transcriptPreamble(path string) (provider, sessionID string, err error) {
    68		file, err := os.Open(path)
    69		if err != nil {
    70			return "", "", err
    71		}
    72		defer file.Close()
    73		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(io.LimitReader(file, 16<<10))
    74		for line := 0; scanner.Scan() && line < 12; line++ {
    75			match := transcriptSessionLine.FindStringSubmatch(scanner.Text())
    76			if len(match) != 3 {
    77				continue
    78			}
    79			return normalizeProvider(match[1]), match[2], nil
    80		}
    81		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
    82			return "", "", err
    83		}
    84		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("SpecStory session preamble not found")
    85	}
    86

   100	// StableSnapshot requires the transcript bytes and metadata to remain unchanged
   101	// across a settle interval.
   102	func StableSnapshot(ctx context.Context, path string, settle time.Duration) (Snapshot, error) {
   103		if settle <= 0 {
   104			settle = 250 * time.Millisecond
   105		}
   106		first, err := snapshot(path)
   107		if err != nil {
   108			return Snapshot{}, err
   109		}
   110		select {
   111		case <-ctx.Done():
   112			return Snapshot{}, ctx.Err()
   113		case <-time.After(settle):
   114		}
   115		second, err := snapshot(path)
   116		if err != nil {
   117			return Snapshot{}, err
   118		}
   119		if first.Size != second.Size || !first.ModTime.Equal(second.ModTime) || first.SHA256 != second.SHA256 {
   120			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("transcript is still changing")
   121		}
   122		return second, nil
   123	}
   124	
   125	func snapshot(path string) (Snapshot, error) {
   126		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
   127		if err != nil {
   128			return Snapshot{}, err
   129		}
   130		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
   131			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("transcript is not a regular file")
   132		}
   133		file, err := os.Open(path)
   134		if err != nil {
   135			return Snapshot{}, err
   136		}
   137		defer file.Close()
   138		hash := sha256.New()
   139		if _, err := io.Copy(hash, file); err != nil {
   140			return Snapshot{}, err
   141		}
   142		return Snapshot{Size: info.Size(), ModTime: info.ModTime(), SHA256: hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))}, nil
   143	}

func TestHygieneCLIWriterGuardProtectsArtifactPathAliases(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("HERDR_PANE_ID", "w1:p1")
	t.Setenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID", "w1")
	repo := gittest.New(t)
	backend := &currentPaneRuntime{activityRuntime: &activityRuntime{name: "herdr", activities: []runtime.AgentActivity{{PaneID: "w1:p1", WorkspaceID: "w1", Agent: "codex", Status: "idle", CWD: repo.Root}}}, currentPane: "w1:p1"}
	cli := &hygieneCLI{app: &App{runtimeInstance: backend}}
	// The caller's ordinary checkout edits are allowed by the occupancy service;
	// artifact edits still have to protect the caller's active recorder.
	if err := cli.guard(t.Context(), repo.Root, []string{filepath.Join(repo.Root, "notes.md")}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ordinary caller edit blocked: %v", err)
	}
	for _, name := range []string{".SPECSTORY/history/session.md", ".CoDeX/session.jsonl", ".claude./plans/task.md", ".specstory /history/session.md", "member/.OpenCode/plan.md"} {
		path := filepath.Join(repo.Root, filepath.FromSlash(name))
		if err := cli.guard(t.Context(), repo.Root, []string{path}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "recognized agent still occupies") {
			t.Errorf("artifact alias bypassed occupancy: %q %v", name, err)
		}
	}
}

    98	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructive(ctx context.Context, input destructiveInspectInput) (destructiveObservation, error) {
    99		observed := destructiveObservation{locator: input.locator, runtime: input.runtime, runtimeErr: input.rtErr}
   100		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
   101			return observed, err
   102		}
   103	
   104		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, input.locator.RepoPath)
   105		if err != nil {
   106			observed.repoErr = err
   107			return observed, nil
   108		}
   109		observed.repo = repository
   110		observed.repoPath, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.MainRoot)
   111		if err != nil {
   112			observed.repoErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git main checkout: %w", err)
   113			return observed, nil
   114		}
   115		observed.gitCommonDir, err = s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
   116		if err != nil {
   117			observed.repoErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize Git common directory: %w", err)
   118			return observed, nil
   119		}
   120		requestedRepo, err := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.RepoPath)
   121		if err != nil {
   122			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested repository: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
   123		}
   124		requestedCommon, err := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.GitCommonDir)
   125		if err != nil {
   126			return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize requested Git common directory: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, err)
   127		}
   128		if requestedRepo != observed.repoPath || requestedCommon != observed.gitCommonDir {
   129			return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(
   130				"selected repository identity changed: main %q -> %q, common directory %q -> %q",
   131				requestedRepo, observed.repoPath, requestedCommon, observed.gitCommonDir,
   132			)}
   133		}
   134		if filepath.IsAbs(input.locator.RepoKey) {
   135			key, keyErr := s.canonicalPath(input.locator.RepoKey)
   136			if keyErr != nil {
   137				return observed, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize repository key: %v", ErrInvalidRequest, keyErr)
   138			}
   139			if key != observed.gitCommonDir {
   140				return observed, &StalePlanError{Reason: "selected repository key no longer names the Git common directory"}
   141			}
   142		}
   143	
   144		observed.worktrees, observed.worktreesErr = s.gitWorktrees(ctx, observed.repoPath)
   145		if !input.noCheckout {
   146			observed.checkout, err = s.canonicalPath(input.locator.CheckoutPath)
   147			if err != nil {
   148				observed.worktreeErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize selected checkout: %w", err)
   149			} else {
   150				observed.worktree, observed.worktreeErr = s.resolveWorktree(ctx, observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
   151				if observed.worktreeErr == nil {
   152					observed.worktreeFound = true
   153					observed.observeCheckoutFacts(ctx, s)
   154					if input.inspectContent && observed.statusErr == nil && observed.status.Dirty() {
   155						analysis, contentErr := s.analyzeFinish(ctx, observed.checkout, input.locator.Branch, input.locator.Branch)
   156						observed.contentFingerprint = analysis.Fingerprint
   157						observed.contentErr = contentErr
   158					}
   159					observed.harness, observed.isHarness = inventory.DetectClaudeHarnessWorktree(observed.repoPath, observed.checkout)
   160				}
   161			}
   162		}
   163	
   164		observed.observeRefs(ctx, s, input.locator.Branch, input.base)
   165		if input.inspectArtifacts && observed.worktreeFound {
   166			observed.artifact, observed.artifactErr = s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, observed.checkout)
   167		}
   168		if !input.noCheckout && !input.skipCleanup {
   169			if observed.runtimeErr == nil {
   170				if observed.runtime == nil || strings.TrimSpace(observed.runtime.Name()) == "" {
   171					observed.runtimeErr = errors.New("destructive inspection has no runtime backend")
   172				} else {
   173					observed.runtimeAvailable = observed.runtime.Available()
   174					observed.cleanup, observed.cleanupErr = s.inspectCleanup(ctx, observed.runtime, observed.checkout, input.cleanup)
   175				}
   176			}
   177		}
   178		if input.inspectTasks {
   179			if input.loadTasks == nil {
   180				observed.taskInventoryErr = errors.New("task inventory loader is unavailable")
   181			} else {
   182				observed.taskRecords, observed.taskDiagnostics, observed.taskInventoryErr = input.loadTasks()
   183				if observed.taskInventoryErr == nil {
   184					s.inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx, &observed)
   185				}
   186			}
   187		}
   188		return observed, nil
   189	}

   191	func (o *destructiveObservation) observeCheckoutFacts(ctx context.Context, s *lifecycleService) {
   192		o.status, o.statusErr = s.gitStatus(ctx, o.checkout)
   193		o.head, o.headErr = s.gitRun(ctx, o.checkout, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD^{commit}")

   195		o.operation, o.inProgress, o.operationErr = s.gitInProgress(ctx, o.checkout)

   213		if o.branchExists && o.branchOIDErr == nil && o.branchOID != "" &&
   214			o.baseExists && o.baseOIDErr == nil && o.baseOID != "" {
   215			o.contained, o.containedErr = s.isAncestor(ctx, o.repoPath, o.branchOID, o.baseOID)
   216		}

   226	func (s *lifecycleService) inspectDestructiveTaskClaims(ctx context.Context, observed *destructiveObservation) {
   227		for _, diagnostic := range observed.taskDiagnostics {
   228			observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete, diagnostic.Error())
   229		}
   230		for _, record := range observed.taskRecords {
   231			candidate := record.Task
   232			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
   233				observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
   234					fmt.Sprintf("task %s is invalid: %v", candidate.ID, err))
   235				continue
   236			}
   237	
   238			pathClaim := false
   239			if candidate.WorktreePath != "" {
   240				path, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.WorktreePath)
   241				if err != nil {
   242					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
   243						fmt.Sprintf("task %s checkout identity is unavailable: %v", candidate.ID, err))
   244				} else {
   245					pathClaim = path == observed.checkout
   246				}
   247			}
   248	
   249			branchClaim := false
   250			if candidate.Branch == observed.locator.Branch {
   251				repoMatches, complete, detail := s.taskRepositoryMatches(ctx, candidate, *observed)
   252				if !complete {
   253					observed.taskIncomplete = append(observed.taskIncomplete,
   254						fmt.Sprintf("task %s repository identity is unavailable: %s", candidate.ID, detail))
   255				} else {
   256					branchClaim = repoMatches
   257				}
   258			}
   259	
   260			if pathClaim {
   261				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
   262					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: "exact checkout path",
   263				})
   264			}
   265			if branchClaim {
   266				reason := "exact branch in selected repository"
   267				if pathClaim {
   268					reason = "exact checkout path and branch in selected repository"
   269					observed.taskClaims[len(observed.taskClaims)-1].Reason = reason
   270					continue
   271				}
   272				observed.taskClaims = append(observed.taskClaims, destructiveTaskClaim{
   273					ID: candidate.ID, Revision: record.Revision, Reason: reason,
   274				})
   275			}
   276		}
   277		sort.Slice(observed.taskClaims, func(i, j int) bool {
   278			if observed.taskClaims[i].ID != observed.taskClaims[j].ID {
   279				return observed.taskClaims[i].ID < observed.taskClaims[j].ID
   280			}
   281			return observed.taskClaims[i].Reason < observed.taskClaims[j].Reason
   282		})
   283		sort.Strings(observed.taskIncomplete)
   284	}
   285	
   286	func (s *lifecycleService) taskRepositoryMatches(ctx context.Context, candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation) (bool, bool, string) {
   287		candidatePath, err := s.canonicalPath(candidate.RepoPath)
   288		if err != nil {
   289			return false, false, err.Error()
   290		}
   291		if candidatePath == observed.repoPath {
   292			return true, true, ""
   293		}
   294		repository, err := s.gitDiscover(ctx, candidate.RepoPath)
   295		if err != nil {
   296			return false, false, err.Error()
   297		}
   298		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(repository.GitCommonDir)
   299		if err != nil {
   300			return false, false, err.Error()
   301		}
   302		return commonDir == observed.gitCommonDir, true, ""
   303	}

   305	func (o destructiveObservation) branchCheckoutPaths(excludeTarget bool) ([]string, error) {
   306		if o.worktreesErr != nil {
   307			return nil, o.worktreesErr
   308		}
   309		var paths []string
   310		for _, worktree := range o.worktrees {
   311			if worktree.Bare || worktree.Branch != o.locator.Branch {
   312				continue
   313			}
   314			path := worktree.Path
   315			if canonical, err := filepath.Abs(path); err == nil {
   316				path = filepath.Clean(canonical)
   317			}
   318			if excludeTarget && o.checkout != "" {
   319				candidate, err := filepath.Abs(o.checkout)
   320				if err == nil && filepath.Clean(candidate) == path {
   321					continue
   322				}
   323			}
   324			paths = append(paths, path)
   325		}
   326		sort.Strings(paths)
   327		return paths, nil
   328	}

   330	func (o destructiveObservation) authority() map[string]string {
   331		claims := make([]string, 0, len(o.taskClaims))
   332		for _, claim := range o.taskClaims {
   333			claims = append(claims, strings.Join([]string{claim.ID, claim.Revision, claim.Reason}, "\x00"))
   334		}
   335		authority := map[string]string{
   336			"destructive.repo":                    o.repositoryAuthority(),
   337			"destructive.checkout":                o.checkoutAuthority(),
   338			"destructive.git":                     o.gitAuthority(),
   339			"destructive.refs":                    o.refsAuthority(),
   340			"destructive.artifact":                artifactAuthority(o.artifact, o.artifactErr),
   341			"destructive.runtime":                 cleanupAuthority(o.cleanup, o.cleanupErr),
   342			"destructive.runtime-backend":         runtimeName(o.runtime),
   343			"destructive.runtime-error":           errorString(o.runtimeErr),
   344			"destructive.runtime-available":       boolString(o.runtimeAvailable),
   345			"destructive.harness":                 boolString(o.isHarness),
   346			"destructive.harness-root":            o.harness.Root,
   347			"destructive.task-inventory":          o.taskInventoryAuthority(),
   348			"destructive.task-inventory-error":    errorString(o.taskInventoryErr),
   349			"destructive.task-claims":             strings.Join(claims, "\x01"),
   350			"destructive.task-incomplete":         strings.Join(o.taskIncomplete, "\x01"),
   351			"destructive.worktree-list-error":     errorString(o.worktreesErr),
   352			"destructive.worktree-list-authority": o.worktreeListAuthority(),
   353		}
   354		return authority

   408	func artifactEvidenceFromInspection(inspection artifact.ReadinessInspection) string {
   409		if h := inspection.History; h != nil && !h.Ready {
   410			return fmt.Sprintf("%d configured history files need a verified archive", len(h.Pending))
   411		}
   412		if inspection.KnownEmpty {
   413			return "no artifact intents match the exact checkout"
   414		}
   415		states := make([]string, 0, len(inspection.Intents))
   416		for _, intent := range inspection.Intents {
   417			states = append(states, intent.Intent.ID+"="+string(intent.State))
   418		}
   419		if len(states) == 0 {
   420			return "artifact readiness is incomplete"
   421		}
   422		return strings.Join(states, ", ")
   423	}
   424	
   425	func mergeAuthority(base, additional map[string]string) map[string]string {
   426		out := make(map[string]string, len(base)+len(additional))
   427		for key, value := range base {
   428			out[key] = value
   429		}
   430		for key, value := range additional {
   431			out[key] = value
   432		}
   433		return out
   434	}

   436	func destructiveConditionsReady(conditions []Condition) error {
   437		if availability := AvailabilityFor(conditions); availability != AvailabilityReady {
   438			var evidence []string
   439			for _, current := range conditions {
   440				if current.Requirement == RequirementRequired && current.Verdict != VerdictMet {
   441					evidence = append(evidence, string(current.Code)+": "+current.Evidence)
   442				}
   443			}
   444			return staleBoundary("destructive safety is no longer ready (" + strings.Join(evidence, "; ") + ")")
   445		}
   446		return nil
   447	}

   451			return staleBoundary(name + " authority changed")
   452		}
   453		return nil
   454	}

130		}
131		effects = append(effects, NewEffect(
132			EffectDeleteTask, "CAS-delete the DONE task record last", candidate.ID, true, false,
133			map[string]string{"expected-revision": record.Revision},
134		))
135	
136		confirmation := Confirmation{Kind: ConfirmationApproval, Prompt: "Retire this DONE task and its eligible local resources?"}
137		if options.DeleteBranch && mode != task.ModeDirect && candidate.Branch != candidate.Base && observed.branchExists {
138			confirmation = Confirmation{
139				Kind: ConfirmationTyped, Token: "DELETE " + candidate.Branch,
140				Prompt: "Type DELETE " + candidate.Branch + " to remove the contained local branch under this exact plan",
141			}
142		}
143		retained := retireRetainedResources(candidate, observed, noCheckout, options)
144		return PlanSpec{
145			Authority:         mergeAuthority(retireTaskAuthority(record), observed.authority()),
146			Conditions:        conditions,
147			Effects:           effects,
148			RetainedResources: retained,
149			Confirmation:      confirmation,
150			FallbackCommand:   retireFallback(candidate.ID, options),
151			Summary:           "Retire " + candidate.Title(),
152			DisplayedAt:       s.now(),
153		}
154	}

373	func retireRefConditions(candidate task.Task, observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) []Condition {
374		baseCondition := condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
375			fmt.Sprintf("local base %s at %s", candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
376		switch {
377		case candidate.Base == "":
378			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
379				"DONE retirement requires the task's explicit local base", "record the exact local base branch")
380		case observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
381			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
382				observed.baseOIDErr.Error(), "repair local base observation")
383		case !observed.baseExists:
384			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
385				"local base ref "+observed.baseRef+" does not exist", "restore the named local base branch")
386		case observed.baseOID == "":
387			baseCondition = condition(ConditionExplicitBase, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
388				"local base resolved to no commit", "restore the named local base branch")
389		}
390	
391		branchCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
392			fmt.Sprintf("local branch %s at %s", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID), "")
393		if observed.branchOIDErr != nil {
394			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
395				observed.branchOIDErr.Error(), "repair local task branch observation")
396		} else if !observed.branchExists {
397			if noCheckout {
398				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
399					"local task branch is already absent for a persisted DONE task with no checkout", "")
400			} else {
401				branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
402					"local task branch "+observed.branchRef+" is missing", "restore the task branch before retiring its checkout")
403			}
404		} else if observed.branchOID == "" {
405			branchCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRef, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
406				"local task branch resolved to no commit", "restore the local task branch")
407		}
408	
409		relationCondition := condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
410			fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID), "")
411		switch {
412		case observed.branchOIDErr != nil || observed.baseOIDErr != nil:
413			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
414				"branch or base ref observation failed", "repair exact local ref observation")
415		case !observed.branchExists && noCheckout:
416			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
417				"missing branch is accepted only because persisted DONE records no checkout", "")
418		case observed.containedErr != nil:
419			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
420				observed.containedErr.Error(), "repair local containment observation")
421		case observed.branchExists && observed.baseExists && observed.branchOIDErr == nil && observed.baseOIDErr == nil && !observed.contained:
422			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
423				fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) is not contained in %s (%s)", candidate.Branch, observed.branchOID, candidate.Base, observed.baseOID),
424				"integrate the task branch into the named local base first")
425		case !observed.branchExists || !observed.baseExists || observed.branchOID == "" || observed.baseOID == "":
426			relationCondition = condition(ConditionBranchRelation, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
427				"containment cannot be proved from exact local branch and base OIDs", "restore both local refs")
428		}
429		return []Condition{baseCondition, branchCondition, relationCondition}
430	}

432	func retireArtifactCondition(observed destructiveObservation, noCheckout bool) Condition {
433		if noCheckout {
434			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory,
435				"no checkout is recorded for artifact inspection", "")
436		}
437		switch {
438		case !observed.worktreeFound:
439			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired,
440				"artifact readiness requires the exact linked checkout", "restore the checkout")
441		case observed.artifactErr != nil:
442			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictError, RequirementRequired,
443				observed.artifactErr.Error(), "repair artifact readiness observation")
444		case !observed.artifact.Ready():
445			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired,
446				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "finalize or explicitly discard every artifact intent")
447		default:
448			return condition(ConditionArtifactReady, VerdictMet, RequirementRequired,
449				artifactEvidenceFromInspection(observed.artifact), "")
450		}
451	}

474	func destructiveRuntimeConditions(observed destructiveObservation) []Condition {
475		if observed.runtimeErr != nil {
476			return []Condition{
477				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime backend resolution"),
478				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.runtimeErr.Error(), "repair runtime observation"),
479				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime was not inspected", "run cleanup from outside the checkout"),
480			}
481		}
482		availableEvidence := "runtime backend " + runtimeName(observed.runtime) + " is available"
483		if observed.runtime != nil && observed.runtime.Name() != "none" && !observed.runtimeAvailable {
484			availableEvidence = "runtime backend " + observed.runtime.Name() + " reports unavailable; cleanup evidence still controls"
485		}
486		if observed.cleanupErr != nil {
487			return []Condition{
488				condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, "select an available backend or use the explicit external acknowledgement"),
489				condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, VerdictError, RequirementRequired, observed.cleanupErr.Error(), "repair runtime enumeration or use the explicit external acknowledgement"),
490				condition(ConditionCallerContainment, VerdictUnknown, RequirementRequired, "runtime occupancy failed", "run cleanup from outside the checkout"),
491			}
492		}
493		occupancyVerdict := VerdictMet
494		occupancyEvidence := fmt.Sprintf("%d eligible runtime session(s)", len(observed.cleanup.Sessions))
495		if observed.cleanup.RuntimeUnknown {
496			occupancyEvidence = "runtime enumeration failed and the external assume-no-runtime acknowledgement is recorded"
497		}
498		if len(observed.cleanup.Blockers) > 0 {
499			occupancyVerdict = VerdictBlocked
500			occupancyEvidence = strings.Join(observed.cleanup.Blockers, "; ")
501		}
502		callerVerdict := VerdictMet
503		callerEvidence := "caller is outside the target checkout and covering runtimes"
504		if observed.cleanup.CallerContained {
505			callerVerdict = VerdictBlocked
506			callerEvidence = "caller is inside the target checkout or a covering runtime"
507		}
508		return []Condition{
509			condition(ConditionRuntimeAvailable, VerdictMet, RequirementAdvisory, availableEvidence, ""),
510			condition(ConditionCleanupOccupancy, occupancyVerdict, RequirementRequired, occupancyEvidence, "stop active agents and leave mixed/caller runtimes intact"),
511			condition(ConditionCallerContainment, callerVerdict, RequirementRequired, callerEvidence, "run cleanup from outside the target checkout and runtime"),
512		}
513	}

556	func retireFallback(id string, options RetireOptions) string {
557		parts := []string{"dev", "retire", shellQuote(id)}
558		if options.DeleteBranch {
559			parts = append(parts, "--delete-branch")
560		}
561		if options.CloseUnknown {
562			parts = append(parts, "--close-unknown")
563		}
564		if options.AssumeNoRuntime {
565			parts = append(parts, "--assume-no-runtime")
566		}
567		if options.Timeout > 0 {
568			parts = append(parts, "--timeout", options.Timeout.String())
569		}
570		return strings.Join(parts, " ")

573	func (s *lifecycleService) applyRetire(ctx context.Context, approved Plan) (Result, error) {
574		if err := contextError(ctx); err != nil {
575			return Result{}, err
576		}
577		if approved.Action != Retire {
578			return Result{}, &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "retire handler received " + string(approved.Action)}
579		}
580		if err := validateRetireLocator(approved.Locator); err != nil {
581			return Result{}, err
582		}
583		commonDir, err := s.canonicalPath(approved.Locator.GitCommonDir)
584		if err != nil {
585			return Result{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: canonicalize approved repository lock identity: %v", ErrInvalidPlan, err)
586		}
587	
588		var result Result
589		err = s.repoLock(ctx, commonDir, func() error {
590			return s.tasks.WithLock(ctx, func(tx *task.Tx) error {
591				record, loadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
592				if loadErr != nil {
593					return &StalePlanError{ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, Reason: "task record disappeared before retirement apply"}
594				}
595				if identityErr := validateRecordIdentity(approved.Locator, *record); identityErr != nil {
596					return identityErr
597				}
598				spec, observed, observeErr := s.observeRetire(ctx, approved.Request, *record, tx.ListRecords)
599				if observeErr != nil {
600					return observeErr
601				}
602				fresh, buildErr := BuildPlan(approved.Request, spec)
603				if buildErr != nil {
604					return buildErr
605				}
606				current, reloadErr := tx.GetRecord(approved.Locator.TaskID)
607				if reloadErr != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
608					actual := ""
609					if current != nil {
610						actual = current.Revision
611					}
612					return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task record changed during locked retirement replan")
613				}
614				if fresh.PlanID != approved.PlanID || fresh.AuthorityFingerprint != approved.AuthorityFingerprint {
615					return &StalePlanError{
616						ExpectedPlanID: approved.PlanID, ActualPlanID: fresh.PlanID,
617						ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: approved.AuthorityFingerprint,
618						ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   fresh.AuthorityFingerprint,
619						Reason:                       "fresh retirement task, Git, worktree, artifact, runtime, or ref authority differs",
620					}
621				}
622				if fresh.Availability != AvailabilityReady {
623					notReady := &PlanNotReadyError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Availability: fresh.Availability, conditions: fresh.Conditions()}
624					return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: fresh.PlanID, Reason: "fresh retirement conditions are not ready", Cause: notReady}
625				}
626	
627				execution := &executionState{service: s, plan: fresh, tx: tx, revision: record.Revision}
628				if err := execution.prepareSubmodules(ctx); err != nil {
629					result, _ = execution.fail(err, "preserve all child repositories and retry the recursive plan")
630					return err
631				}
632				result, observeErr = execution.executeRetire(ctx, *record, observed)
633				return observeErr
634			})
635		})
636		return result, err
637	}

639	func (e *executionState) executeRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
640		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RetireOptions)
641		candidate := record.Task
642		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()
643		noCheckout := mode == task.ModeWorktree && candidate.WorktreePath == ""
644		closedRuntime := false
645		removedWorktree := false
646		deletedBranch := false
647	
648		for _, effect := range e.executionEffects() {
649			switch effect.Code {
650			case EffectCloseRuntime:
651				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, false)
652				if err != nil {
653					return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before closing any runtime")
654				}
655				baseline = fresh
656				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
657					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{
658						CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane,
659						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
660						ProcessClosures: options.ProcessClosures.Map(),
661					})
662					if closeErr != nil {
663						return "runtime closure may be partial", closeErr
664					}
665					return fmt.Sprintf("closed %d %s session(s)", inspection.ClosedSessions, runtimeName(baseline.runtime)), nil
666				})
667				if err != nil {
668					e.partial = true
669					return e.fail(err, "the task and checkout remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
670				}
671				fresh, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, true)
672				if err != nil {
673					return e.fail(err, "runtime state changed after closure; preserve the checkout and refresh retirement")
674				}
675				baseline = fresh
676				closedRuntime = true
677	
678			case EffectRemoveWorktree:
679				fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
680				if err != nil {
681					return e.fail(err, "the worktree was preserved; refresh every retirement safety source")
682				}
683				baseline = fresh
684				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
685					if removeErr := e.removeWithSubmodules(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.checkout); removeErr != nil {
686						return "worktree removal may be partial", fmt.Errorf("remove exact worktree %s: %w", baseline.checkout, removeErr)
687					}
688					return "removed exact linked worktree without force; branch retained", nil
689				})
690				if err != nil {
691					e.partial = true
692					return e.fail(err, "inspect Git worktree registration and retained branch before retrying")
693				}
694				removedWorktree = true
695				if err := e.verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
696					return e.fail(err, "the checkout removal completed; restore or reconcile the exact retained branch before reaping the task")
697				}
698	
699			case EffectDeleteBranch:
700				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
701					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "branch deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
702				}
703				if mode != task.ModeWorktree || noCheckout {
704					fresh, err := e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)
705					if err != nil {
706						return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before deleting the contained branch")
707					}
708					baseline = fresh
709				}
710				if err := e.revalidateRetireRefs(ctx, baseline, false); err != nil {
711					return e.fail(err, "branch or base authority changed; refresh retirement")
712				}
713				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
714					_, deleteErr := e.service.gitRun(ctx, baseline.repoPath, "branch", "-d", "--", candidate.Branch)
715					if deleteErr != nil {
716						return "ordinary contained-branch deletion failed", fmt.Errorf("delete contained branch %s: %w", candidate.Branch, deleteErr)
717					}
718					return "deleted contained local branch " + candidate.Branch, nil
719				})
720				if err != nil {
721					e.partial = true
722					return e.fail(err, "the task record remains DONE; inspect the local branch and retry")
723				}
724				deletedBranch = true
725				exists, observeErr := e.service.gitRefState(ctx, baseline.repoPath, baseline.branchRef)
726				if observeErr != nil {
727					return e.fail(fmt.Errorf("verify task branch deletion: %w", observeErr), "the task remains DONE; inspect Git refs before retrying")
728				}
729				if exists {
730					return e.fail(errors.New("local branch still exists after successful branch deletion"), "the task remains DONE; inspect Git refs before retrying")
731				}
732				if err := e.revalidateRetireBase(ctx, baseline); err != nil {
733					return e.fail(err, "the branch deletion completed; restore or inspect the explicit base before task reaping")
734				}
735	
736			case EffectDeleteTask:
737				if mode == task.ModeWorktree && !noCheckout && !removedWorktree {
738					return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "task deletion reached before linked worktree removal"})
739				}
740				if err := e.revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch); err != nil {
741					return e.fail(err, "the task remains DONE; refresh retirement from current Git/runtime state")
742				}
743				err := e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
744					if deleteErr := e.service.taskDelete(e.tx, candidate.ID, record.Revision); deleteErr != nil {
745						return "DONE task reap failed", fmt.Errorf("delete retired task %s: %w", candidate.ID, deleteErr)
746					}
747					if _, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(candidate.ID); !errors.Is(verifyErr, task.ErrNotFound) {
748						if verifyErr == nil {
749							verifyErr = errors.New("task record still exists")
750						}
751						return "DONE task reap was not verified", fmt.Errorf("verify retired task %s deletion: %w", candidate.ID, verifyErr)
752					}
753					if err := submodule.Forget(e.service.cfg, baseline.gitCommonDir, candidate.Branch); err != nil {
754						return "task reaped; workspace intent cleanup failed", err
755					}
756					return "reaped DONE task at revision " + record.Revision, nil
757				})
758				if err != nil {
759					if _, verifyErr := e.tx.GetRecord(candidate.ID); errors.Is(verifyErr, task.ErrNotFound) {
760						e.partial = true
761					}
762					return e.fail(err, "local cleanup may already be complete; reload and retry the CAS task reap")
763				}
764				e.snapshot = "task:deleted:" + candidate.ID + ":" + record.Revision
765				e.milestone = MilestoneRetired

767			default:
768				return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "unexpected Retire effect " + string(effect.Code)})
769			}
770		}
771		if e.milestone != MilestoneRetired {
772			return e.fail(&InvalidPlanError{PlanID: e.plan.PlanID, Reason: "retirement ended without CAS task deletion"})
773		}
774		return e.result(), nil
775	}

777	func (e *executionState) reinspectRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, allowRuntimeChange bool) (destructiveObservation, error) {
778		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
779		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
780			actual := ""
781			if current != nil {
782				actual = current.Revision
783			}
784			return destructiveObservation{}, staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed at a retirement boundary")
785		}
786		request := e.plan.Request
787		if allowRuntimeChange {
788			options := request.Options.(RetireOptions)
789			options.RuntimeFingerprint = "" // the declared close must now prove empty coverage
790			request.Options = options
791		}
792		spec, fresh, err := e.service.observeRetire(ctx, request, *current, e.tx.ListRecords)
793		if err != nil {
794			return fresh, err
795		}
796		if err := destructiveConditionsReady(spec.Conditions); err != nil {
797			return fresh, err
798		}
799		for _, check := range []struct {
800			name          string
801			before, after string
802		}{
803			{"repository", baseline.repositoryAuthority(), fresh.repositoryAuthority()},
804			{"checkout", baseline.checkoutAuthority(), fresh.checkoutAuthority()},
805			{"Git", baseline.gitAuthority(), fresh.gitAuthority()},
806			{"refs", baseline.refsAuthority(), fresh.refsAuthority()},
807			{"artifact", artifactAuthority(baseline.artifact, baseline.artifactErr), artifactAuthority(fresh.artifact, fresh.artifactErr)},
808			{"harness", authorityHash("harness", boolString(baseline.isHarness), baseline.harness.Root), authorityHash("harness", boolString(fresh.isHarness), fresh.harness.Root)},
809			{"task inventory", baseline.taskInventoryAuthority(), fresh.taskInventoryAuthority()},
810			{"worktree list", baseline.worktreeListAuthority(), fresh.worktreeListAuthority()},
811		} {
812			if err := compareAuthorityCategory(check.name, check.before, check.after); err != nil {
813				return fresh, err
814			}
815		}
816		if allowRuntimeChange {
817			if fresh.cleanupErr != nil || !fresh.cleanup.Ready() || fresh.cleanup.CallerContained || len(fresh.cleanup.Sessions) > 0 {
818				return fresh, staleBoundary("runtime coverage is not proven empty after closure")
819			}
820		} else if err := compareAuthorityCategory("runtime", cleanupAuthority(baseline.cleanup, baseline.cleanupErr), cleanupAuthority(fresh.cleanup, fresh.cleanupErr)); err != nil {
821			return fresh, err
822		}
823		return fresh, nil
824	}

826	func (e *executionState) verifyRemovedCheckout(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation) error {

829			return staleBoundary("exact worktree remains registered after removal")
830		}

840	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireRefs(ctx context.Context, baseline destructiveObservation, allowMissingBranch bool) error {
841		fresh := destructiveObservation{repoPath: baseline.repoPath}
842		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, baseline.locator.Branch, strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
843		if err := compareAuthorityCategory("explicit base ref", authorityHash("base", baseline.baseRef, boolString(baseline.baseExists), baseline.baseOID, errorString(baseline.baseOIDErr)),
844			authorityHash("base", fresh.baseRef, boolString(fresh.baseExists), fresh.baseOID, errorString(fresh.baseOIDErr))); err != nil {
845			return err
846		}
847		if allowMissingBranch && fresh.branchOIDErr == nil && !fresh.branchExists {
848			return nil
849		}
850		if err := compareAuthorityCategory("task branch ref", authorityHash("branch", baseline.branchRef, boolString(baseline.branchExists), baseline.branchOID, errorString(baseline.branchOIDErr)),
851			authorityHash("branch", fresh.branchRef, boolString(fresh.branchExists), fresh.branchOID, errorString(fresh.branchOIDErr))); err != nil {
852			return err
853		}
854		if fresh.containedErr != nil || !fresh.contained {
855			return staleBoundary("fresh branch containment proof failed")
856		}
857		return nil
858	}

862		fresh.observeRefs(ctx, e.service, "", strings.TrimPrefix(baseline.baseRef, "refs/heads/"))
863		return compareAuthorityCategory("explicit base ref",
864			authorityHash("base", baseline.baseRef, boolString(baseline.baseExists), baseline.baseOID, errorString(baseline.baseOIDErr)),
865			authorityHash("base", fresh.baseRef, boolString(fresh.baseExists), fresh.baseOID, errorString(fresh.baseOIDErr)),
866		)

869	func (e *executionState) revalidateRetireTerminal(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation, closedRuntime, removedWorktree, deletedBranch bool) error {
870		current, err := e.tx.GetRecord(record.Task.ID)
871		if err != nil || current.Revision != record.Revision {
872			actual := ""
873			if current != nil {

875			}
876			return staleTaskRevision(record.Revision, actual, "task changed before terminal retirement reap")

882				return staleBoundary("removed linked checkout became registered again")
883			} else if !errors.Is(resolveErr, gitx.ErrWorktreeNotFound) {

885			}

900		}
901		_, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, closedRuntime)

903	}

package taskflow

func retirementPreviewCondition(expected string, inspection retire.Inspection) Condition {
	if expected != "" && expected != inspection.Fingerprint() {
		return condition("runtime-preview-current", VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired, "retirement preview is stale: runtime topology or foreground programs changed", "review the current runtime before authorizing cleanup")
	}
	return condition("runtime-preview-current", VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "retirement runtime matches its approved preview", "")
}

// RetirementPreviewAuthority keeps task/Git/artifact and child ownership bound across
// interactive permissions and caller handoff, independently of runtime consent.
func RetirementPreviewAuthority(plan Plan) Fields {
	fields := make(map[string]string)
	for key, value := range plan.AuthorityFields() {
		// Submodule facts survive the handoff; recursive disposal is a separate
		// approval selected by the wizard, not an observed identity.
		if strings.HasPrefix(key, "task.") || strings.HasPrefix(key, "destructive.") && !strings.HasPrefix(key, "destructive.runtime") ||
			key == "submodules" || key == "submodule-intent" || key == "submodule-claims" {
			fields[key] = value
		}
	}
	return NewFields(fields)
}

func retirementIdentityPreviewCondition(expected Fields, actual map[string]string) Condition {
	for _, field := range expected.Entries() {
		if actual[field.Key] != field.Value {
			return condition("retirement-preview-current", VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired, "retirement preview is stale: "+field.Key+" changed", "refresh the exact task, Git and artifact preview before cleanup")
		}
	}
	return condition("retirement-preview-current", VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "task, Git and artifact ownership match the retirement preview", "")
}

// blanket flag manufactures these acknowledgements.
type CompletionRuntimeOptions struct {
	CloseTaskPanes Fields
	ProgramConsent Fields
}

func (r CompletionRuntimeOptions) clone() CompletionRuntimeOptions {
	return CompletionRuntimeOptions{CloseTaskPanes: r.CloseTaskPanes.clone(), ProgramConsent: r.ProgramConsent.clone()}
}

	switch v := options.(type) {
	case CompleteDirectOptions:

	case CompleteFFOptions:
		return v.Runtime
	case ReviewHandoffOptions:
		return v.Runtime
	case VerifyMergedOptions:
		return v.Runtime
	}
	return CompletionRuntimeOptions{}
}

func cloneEffects(effects []Effect) []Effect {
	out := make([]Effect, len(effects))
	for index, effect := range effects {
		out[index] = effect.Clone()
	}
	return out
}

func filterConditions(conditions []Condition, keep func(Condition) bool) []Condition {
	out := make([]Condition, 0, len(conditions))
	for _, condition := range conditions {
		if keep(condition) {
			out = append(out, condition)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func requestIdentity(request Request) string {
	writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-request-v1")
	appendRequestIdentity(writer, request)
	return writer.sumHex()
}

func computePlanIdentity(plan Plan) (string, string) {
	writer := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-authority-v1")
	appendRequestIdentity(writer, plan.Request)
	writer.addString("plan.action", string(plan.Action))
	writer.addString("plan.source", string(plan.Source))
	writer.addString("plan.target", string(plan.Target))
	writer.addBool("plan.has-persisted-transition", plan.HasPersistedTransition)
	writer.addBool("plan.state-preserving", plan.StatePreserving)
	writer.addBool("plan.removes-task", plan.RemovesTask)
	writer.addString("plan.expected-milestone", string(plan.ExpectedMilestone))
	writer.addFields("plan.authority", plan.authority)
	writer.addInt64("plan.condition-count", int64(len(plan.conditions)))
	for index, condition := range plan.conditions {
		prefix := "plan.condition." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
		writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(condition.Code))
		writer.addString(prefix+"verdict", string(condition.Verdict))
		writer.addString(prefix+"requirement", string(condition.Requirement))
		writer.addString(prefix+"evidence", condition.Evidence)
		writer.addString(prefix+"remediation", condition.Remediation)
	}
	writer.addInt64("plan.effect-count", int64(len(plan.effects)))
	for index, effect := range plan.effects {
		prefix := "plan.effect." + strconv.Itoa(index) + "."
		writer.addString(prefix+"code", string(effect.Code))
		writer.addString(prefix+"description", effect.Description)
		writer.addString(prefix+"target", effect.Target)
		writer.addBool(prefix+"destructive", effect.Destructive)
		writer.addBool(prefix+"network", effect.Network)
		writer.addFields(prefix+"details", effect.Details)
	}
	writer.addStrings("plan.retained", plan.retained.values)
	writer.addString("plan.confirmation-kind", string(plan.Confirmation.Kind))
	writer.addString("plan.confirmation-token", plan.Confirmation.Token)
	authorityFingerprint := "sha256:" + writer.sumHex()

	planWriter := newIdentityWriter("taskflow-plan-v1")
	planWriter.addString("authority-fingerprint", authorityFingerprint)
	return authorityFingerprint, "plan:" + planWriter.sumHex()
}
