171	func (e *executionState) prepareSubmodules(ctx context.Context) error {
172		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
173			if effect.Code == effectVerifySubmodules {
174				return e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
175					root := e.plan.Locator.CheckoutPath
176					recursive, cleanup := recursiveRequest(e.plan.Request)
177					var p *submodule.Removal
178					var err error
179					if cleanup {
180						p, err = submodule.InspectRemoval(ctx, e.service.cfg, root, recursive, submoduleIntegrationRequired(e.plan.Request))
181					} else {
182						p, err = submodule.InspectPublication(ctx, e.service.cfg, root, isCompletionAction(e.plan.Action))
183					}
184					if err != nil {
185						return "", err
186					}
187					if p == nil {
188						return "", fmt.Errorf("submodule graph disappeared")
189					}
190					if p.Graph.Fingerprint != e.plan.AuthorityFields()["submodules"] || p.Revision != e.plan.AuthorityFields()["submodule-intent"] {
191						return "", &StalePlanError{Reason: "submodule graph or intent changed"}
192					}
193					if err := e.checkSubmoduleClaims(ctx, p, false); err != nil {
194						return "", err
195					}
196					claimHash, err := e.service.submoduleClaims(ctx, p.Graph, e.plan.Locator.TaskID)
197					if err != nil {
198						return "", err
199					}
200					if claimHash != e.plan.AuthorityFields()["submodule-claims"] {
201						return "", &StalePlanError{Reason: "child task/artifact authority changed"}
202					}
203					if err := p.VerifyRemote(ctx); err != nil {
204						return "", err
205					}
206					e.submoduleRemoval = p
207					return "verified fresh remote reachability for every child repository", nil
208				})
209			}
210		}
211		return nil
212	}
213	
214	func (e *executionState) checkSubmoduleClaims(ctx context.Context, p *submodule.Removal, afterClose bool) error {
215		hash, err := e.service.submoduleClaims(ctx, p.Graph, e.plan.Locator.TaskID)
216		if err != nil {
217			return err
218		}
219		if hash != e.plan.AuthorityFields()["submodule-claims"] {
220			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "child task/artifact authority changed"}
221		}
222		if !afterClose {
223			return nil
224		}
225		rt := e.service.defaultRuntime()
226		if e.plan.Locator.TaskID != "" {
227			record, err := e.service.tasks.GetRecord(e.plan.Locator.TaskID)
228			if err != nil {
229				return err
230			}
231			rt, err = e.service.runtimeFor(record.Task)
232			if err != nil {
233				return err
234			}
235		}
236		options := retire.Options{CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane}
237		switch o := e.plan.Request.Options.(type) {
238		case RetireOptions:
239			options.CloseUnknown = o.CloseUnknown
240			options.AssumeNoRuntime = o.AssumeNoRuntime
241		case ParkColdOptions:
242			options.CloseUnknown = o.CloseUnknown
243			options.AssumeNoRuntime = o.AssumeNoRuntime
244		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
245			options.CloseUnknown = o.CloseUnknown
246			options.AssumeNoRuntime = o.AssumeNoRuntime
247		}
248		paths := []string{p.Graph.Root}
249		for _, n := range p.Graph.Nodes {
250			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(p.Graph.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Path)))
251		}
252		for _, path := range paths {
253			live, err := e.service.inspectCleanup(ctx, rt, path, options)
254			if err != nil {
255				return err
256			}
257			if !live.Ready() || len(live.Sessions) > 0 {
258				return fmt.Errorf("submodule workspace %s has live or unknown runtime coverage", path)
259			}
260		}
261		return nil
262	}

264	func (e *executionState) removeWithSubmodules(ctx context.Context, repo, checkout string) error {
265		return e.submoduleRemoval.Apply(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, _ string) error {
266			return e.checkSubmoduleClaims(ctx, e.submoduleRemoval, true)
267		}, func() error { return e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, repo, checkout, false) })
268	}

17	// Recover restores interrupted cleanup. A previous remote proof never
18	// authorizes deletion of the quarantined data during recovery.
19	func Recover(ctx context.Context, journalPath string, check func(context.Context, string) error, dryRun bool) error {
20		journalPath, err := filepath.Abs(journalPath)
21		if err != nil {
22			return err
23		}
24		area := filepath.Dir(journalPath)
25		if filepath.Base(journalPath) != "journal.json" || !strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Base(area), ".dev-submodule-retirement-") {
26			return errors.New("not a submodule removal journal")
27		}
28		held, areaIdentity, err := safefile.OpenRoot(area)
29		if err != nil {
30			return err
31		}
32		info, err := held.Lstat("journal.json")
33		if err != nil {
34			held.Close()
35			return err
36		}
37		data, _, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, held, "journal.json", info, 1024*1024)
38		held.Close()
39		if err != nil {
40			return err
41		}
42		area, err = pathx.Canonical(area)
43		if err != nil {
44			return err
45		}
46		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(area, areaIdentity); err != nil {
47			return err
48		}
49		var j removalJournal
50		if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &j); err != nil {
51			return err
52		}
53		if j.Version != 1 || j.Root == "" || j.GitDir == "" || j.Repository == "" || j.Branch == "" || j.Head == "" {
54			return errors.New("incomplete removal journal")
55		}
56		if filepath.Dir(j.Root) != filepath.Dir(area) {
57			return errors.New("journal is not beside its recorded worktree")
58		}
59		r, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, j.Repository)
60		if err != nil {
61			return err
62		}
63		if inside, err := pathx.Contains(r.MainRoot, j.Root); err != nil || inside {
64			return errors.New("recovery target is inside the canonical repository")
65		}
66		if inside, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(r.GitCommonDir, "worktrees"), j.GitDir); err != nil || !inside {
67			return errors.New("journal Git directory is not private worktree metadata")
68		}
69		for _, m := range j.Moves {
70			if filepath.Dir(m.To) != area || (!strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Base(m.To), "checkout-") && filepath.Base(m.To) != "git-modules") {
71				return errors.New("journal contains an unsafe quarantine path")
72			}
73			inside, err := pathx.Contains(j.Root, m.From)
74			if err != nil {
75				return err
76			}
77			if m.From == j.Root || (!inside && m.From != filepath.Join(j.GitDir, "modules")) {
78				return errors.New("journal contains an unsafe restore path")
79			}
80		}
81		if dryRun {
82			return nil
83		}
84		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
85		if err != nil {
86			return err
87		}
88		if inside, err := pathx.Contains(j.Root, cwd); err != nil || inside {
89			return errors.New("recover from outside the target worktree")
90		}
91		return gitx.WithLifecycleLock(ctx, r.GitCommonDir, func() error {
92			if check != nil {
93				if err := check(ctx, j.Root); err != nil {
94					return err
95				}
96			}
97			if _, err := os.Lstat(j.Root); os.IsNotExist(err) {
98				head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, r.MainRoot, "rev-parse", "refs/heads/"+j.Branch)
99				if err != nil || head != j.Head {
100					return errors.New("retained outer branch changed; recovery requires inspection")
101				}
102				if err := gitx.AddWorktree(ctx, r.MainRoot, j.Root, j.Branch, j.Head); err != nil {
103					return err
104				}
105			} else if err != nil {
106				return err
107			}
108			current, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, j.Root)
109			if err != nil {
110				return err
111			}
112			head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, j.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
113			if err != nil {
114				return err
115			}
116			if !current.IsLinkedWorktree || current.GitDir != j.GitDir || head != j.Head {
117				return errors.New("original worktree identity was reused; quarantine retained")
118			}
119			for i := len(j.Moves) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
120				if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(area, areaIdentity); err != nil {
121					return err
122				}
123				m := j.Moves[i]
124				info, err := os.Lstat(m.To)
125				if os.IsNotExist(err) {
126					continue
127				}
128				if err != nil {
129					return err
130				}
131				if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
132					return errors.New("quarantined directory identity changed")
133				}
134				if existing, err := os.Lstat(m.From); err == nil {
135					if !m.Empty || !existing.IsDir() || existing.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
136						return fmt.Errorf("restore path reused: %s; quarantine retained", m.From)
137					}
138					if err := os.Remove(m.From); err != nil {
139						return fmt.Errorf("restore path is not empty: %s; quarantine retained", m.From)
140					}
141				} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
142					return err
143				}
144				if err := os.Rename(m.To, m.From); err != nil {
145					return fmt.Errorf("restore %s: %w; journal retained", m.From, err)
146				}
147			}
148			if _, err := gitx.SubmodulesOf(ctx, j.Root); err != nil {
149				return err
150			}
151			if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(area, areaIdentity); err != nil {
152				return err
153			}
154			return os.RemoveAll(area)
155		})
156	}

221	// AddWorktree creates a linked worktree at path.
222	//
223	// When branch already exists it is checked out; otherwise it is created from
224	// base. Passing an explicit base matters: without one git branches from the
225	// *current* HEAD, so a worktree created while standing on feature/A would
226	// silently inherit feature/A's commits.
227	func AddWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path, branch, base string) error {
228		exists := BranchExists(ctx, dir, branch)
229		args := []string{"worktree", "add"}
230		if exists {
231			args = append(args, path, branch)
232		} else {
233			args = append(args, "-b", branch, path)
234			if base != "" {
235				args = append(args, base)
236			}
237		}
238		_, err := run(ctx, dir, args...)
239		return err
240	}
241	
242	// MoveWorktree relocates a linked worktree through Git so the shared
243	// administrative metadata keeps pointing at the checkout's new path. dir may
244	// be any checkout of the same repository.
245	func MoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, source, destination string) error {
246		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "move", source, destination)
247		return err
248	}
249	
250	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
251	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
252	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
253		// A generic force flag never authorizes deleting a child repository's
254		// refs/objects. The recursive lifecycle stages those only after proof.
255		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
256			g, err := SubmodulesOf(ctx, path)
257			if err != nil {
258				return err
259			}
260			for _, n := range g.Nodes {
261				if n.Initialized || n.State != "uninitialized" {
262					return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s requires guarded --recursive cleanup", n.Path)
263				}
264			}
265			if r, err := Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
266				if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(r.GitDir, "modules")); err == nil {
267					return errors.New("private submodule Git data requires guarded --recursive cleanup")
268				}
269			}
270		}
271		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
272		if err != nil {
273			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
274		}
275		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)
276		if err != nil {
277			return fmt.Errorf("compare current directory with worktree %s: %w", path, err)
278		}
279		if inside {
280			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove worktree %s while the caller is inside it", path)
281		}
282		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
283		if force {
284			args = append(args, "--force")
285		}
286		args = append(args, path)
287		_, err = run(ctx, dir, args...)
288		return err
289	}
290	
291	// PruneWorktrees clears administrative entries for checkouts whose directories
292	// were deleted behind git's back.
293	func PruneWorktrees(ctx context.Context, dir string) error {
294		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "worktree", "prune")
295		return err
296	}

298	// BranchExists reports whether a local branch of that name exists.
299	func BranchExists(ctx context.Context, dir, branch string) bool {
300		if branch == "" {
301			return false
302		}
303		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+branch)
304		return err == nil
305	}

307	// RefState reports whether any ref or commit-ish resolves while preserving
308	// observation failures. A normal rev-parse exit 1 with no diagnostic is an
309	// authoritative missing ref; every other failure remains an error.

1	// Package artifact finalizes agent transcripts only after their writer exits.
2	package artifact
3	
4	import (
5		"fmt"
6		"regexp"
7		"strings"
8		"time"
9	)
10	
11	const SchemaVersion = 1
12	
13	type Status string
14	
15	const (
16		Armed      Status = "armed"
17		Finalizing Status = "finalizing"
18		Finalized  Status = "finalized"
19		Failed     Status = "failed"
20		// Discarded records an operator's explicit decision that an intent can
21		// never be finalized — its transcript is gone, or its HEAD no longer
22		// exists. It is deliberately distinct from Finalized: nothing was
23		// committed, and the record survives to say so.
24		Discarded Status = "discarded"
25	)
26	
27	// Intent is a durable handoff from an active agent to an external finalizer.
28	type Intent struct {
29		SchemaVersion      int      `json:"schema_version"`
30		ID                 string   `json:"id"`
31		RunID              string   `json:"run_id"`
32		Provider           string   `json:"provider"`
33		SessionID          string   `json:"session_id"`
34		TaskID             string   `json:"task_id,omitempty"`
35		RepoPath           string   `json:"repo_path"`
36		GitCommonDir       string   `json:"git_common_dir"`
37		WorktreePath       string   `json:"worktree_path"`
38		Branch             string   `json:"branch"`
39		Base               string   `json:"base,omitempty"`
40		Head               string   `json:"head"`
41		PlanPaths          []string `json:"plan_paths,omitempty"`
42		UnrelatedArtifacts []string `json:"unrelated_artifacts,omitempty"`
43		AllowLarge         bool     `json:"allow_large,omitempty"`
44		Destination        string   `json:"destination,omitempty"`
45		ArchivePolicy      string   `json:"archive_policy,omitempty"`
46		ArchiveStateDir    string   `json:"archive_state_dir,omitempty"`
47		ArchivePlanID      string   `json:"archive_plan_id,omitempty"`
48		ArchiveCommit      string   `json:"archive_commit,omitempty"`
49	
50		Status         Status    `json:"status"`
51		TranscriptPath string    `json:"transcript_path,omitempty"`
52		ArtifactCommit string    `json:"artifact_commit,omitempty"`
53		FailureCode    string    `json:"failure_code,omitempty"`
54		SessionEndedAt time.Time `json:"session_ended_at,omitempty"`
55		CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`
56		UpdatedAt      time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
57	}
58	
59	var (
60		idPattern      = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$`)
61		sessionPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+:[0-9a-fA-F-]{16,}$`)
62	)
63	
64	func (i Intent) Validate() error {
65		if i.Destination != "" && i.Destination != "archive" {
66			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported artifact destination")
67		}
68		if i.Destination == "archive" && (i.ArchiveStateDir == "" || i.ArchivePolicy == "") {
69			return fmt.Errorf("archive intent lacks policy/state binding")
70		}
71		switch {
72		case i.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion:
73			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported artifact intent schema %d", i.SchemaVersion)
74		case !idPattern.MatchString(i.ID):
75			return fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent id %q", i.ID)
76		case i.RunID == "" || !idPattern.MatchString(i.RunID):
77			return fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact run id %q", i.RunID)
78		case i.Provider == "" || i.SessionID == "":
79			return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent needs provider and session id")
80		case i.RepoPath == "" || i.WorktreePath == "" || i.GitCommonDir == "":
81			return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent needs repository, worktree and git common-dir paths")
82		case i.Branch == "" || i.Head == "":
83			return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent needs branch and head")
84		}
85		if !sessionPattern.MatchString(i.Provider + ":" + i.SessionID) {
86			return fmt.Errorf("invalid agent session %q", i.Provider+":"+i.SessionID)
87		}
88		switch i.Status {
89		case Armed, Finalizing, Finalized, Failed, Discarded:
90			return nil
91		default:
92			return fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent status %q", i.Status)
93		}
94	}
95	
96	func ParseSession(value string) (provider, sessionID string, err error) {
97		provider, sessionID, ok := strings.Cut(strings.TrimSpace(value), ":")
98		provider = strings.ToLower(provider)
99		if !ok || !sessionPattern.MatchString(provider+":"+sessionID) {
100			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("invalid session %q: want provider:uuid", value)
101		}
102		return provider, sessionID, nil
103	}
104

1	package artifact
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"crypto/rand"
6		"encoding/hex"
7		"encoding/json"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io"
11		"io/fs"
12		"os"
13		"path/filepath"
14		"sort"
15		"strings"
16		"time"
17	
18		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/lockx"
19	)
20	
21	var ErrIntentNotFound = errors.New("artifact intent not found")
22	
23	// Store keeps one strict JSON intent per finalization handoff.
24	type Store struct {
25		Dir   string
26		clock func() time.Time
27		newID func() string
28	}
29	
30	func NewStore(dir string) *Store {
31		return &Store{Dir: dir, clock: time.Now, newID: randomID}
32	}
33	
34	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".json") }
35	
36	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
37		if intent == nil {
38			return fmt.Errorf("create nil artifact intent")
39		}
40		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
41			candidate := *intent
42			if candidate.ID == "" {
43				candidate.ID = s.newID()
44			}
45			candidate.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
46			candidate.Status = Armed
47			now := s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
48			candidate.CreatedAt, candidate.UpdatedAt = now, now
49			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
50				return err
51			}
52			if _, err := os.Stat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
53				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s already exists", candidate.ID)
54			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return err
56			}
57			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
58				return err
59			}
60			*intent = candidate
61			return nil
62		})
63	}
64	
65	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Intent, error) {
66		if !idPattern.MatchString(id) {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent id %q", id)
68		}
69		file, err := os.Open(s.path(id))
70		if err != nil {
71			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
72				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s: %w", id, ErrIntentNotFound)
73			}
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		defer file.Close()
77		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
78		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
79		var intent Intent
80		if err := decoder.Decode(&intent); err != nil {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
82		}
83		if err := ensureJSONEOF(decoder); err != nil {
84			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
85		}
86		if intent.ID != id {
87			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent filename %s disagrees with id %s", id, intent.ID)
88		}
89		if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
90			return nil, err
91		}
92		return &intent, nil
93	}
94	
95	func (s *Store) List() ([]Intent, error) {
96		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
97		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
98			return nil, nil
99		}
100		if err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		var intents []Intent
104		for _, entry := range entries {
105			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
106				continue
107			}
108			intent, err := s.Get(strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json"))
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			intents = append(intents, *intent)
113		}
114		sort.Slice(intents, func(i, j int) bool { return intents[i].CreatedAt.Before(intents[j].CreatedAt) })
115		return intents, nil
116	}
117	
118	func (s *Store) FindByRunID(runID string) (*Intent, error) {
119		intents, err := s.List()
120		if err != nil {
121			return nil, err
122		}
123		for i := range intents {
124			if intents[i].RunID == runID {
125				return &intents[i], nil
126			}
127		}
128		return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact run %s: %w", runID, ErrIntentNotFound)
129	}
130	
131	func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, mutate func(*Intent) error) error {
132		if mutate == nil {
133			return fmt.Errorf("artifact update needs a mutation")
134		}
135		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
136			intent, err := s.Get(id)
137			if err != nil {
138				return err
139			}
140			if err := mutate(intent); err != nil {
141				return err
142			}
143			intent.UpdatedAt = s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
144			if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
145				return err
146			}
147			return s.write(*intent)
148		})
149	}
150	
151	func (s *Store) write(intent Intent) error {
152		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o700); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, ".intent-*.tmp")
156		if err != nil {
157			return err
158		}
159		name := tmp.Name()
160		defer os.Remove(name)
161		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
162			tmp.Close()
163			return err
164		}
165		encoder := json.NewEncoder(tmp)
166		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
167		if err := encoder.Encode(intent); err != nil {
168			tmp.Close()
169			return err
170		}
171		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
172			tmp.Close()
173			return err
174		}
175		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
176			return err
177		}
178		return os.Rename(name, s.path(intent.ID))
179	}
180	
181	func ensureJSONEOF(decoder *json.Decoder) error {
182		var extra any
183		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
184			return nil
185		} else if err != nil {
186			return err
187		}
188		return fmt.Errorf("multiple JSON values")
189	}
190	
191	func randomID() string {
192		var raw [12]byte
193		if _, err := rand.Read(raw[:]); err != nil {
194			return fmt.Sprintf("intent-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
195		}
196		return "intent-" + hex.EncodeToString(raw[:])
197	}
198

92				if statErr == nil && (!info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0) {

197	func validateSubmodulePath(root, rel string) error {
198		if rel == "" || rel == "." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) || strings.Contains(rel, "\\") || filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(rel)) != rel || strings.HasPrefix(rel, "../") {
199			return fmt.Errorf("invalid submodule path %q", rel)
200		}
201		p := root
202		for _, part := range strings.Split(rel, "/") {
203			p = filepath.Join(p, part)
204			info, err := os.Lstat(p)
205			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
206				return nil
207			}
208			if err != nil {
209				return err
210			}
211			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
212				return fmt.Errorf("submodule path %s crosses a symlink", rel)
213			}
214		}
215		return nil
216	}

218	func submoduleEntries(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]SubmoduleNode, error) {
219		index, err := run(ctx, dir, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z")
220		if err != nil {
221			return nil, err
222		}
223		var entries []SubmoduleNode
224		for _, record := range nulLines(index) {
225			meta, path, ok := strings.Cut(record, "\t")
226			f := strings.Fields(meta)
227			if !ok || len(f) != 3 || f[0] != "160000" {
228				continue
229			}
230			if f[2] != "0" {
231				return nil, fmt.Errorf("conflicted gitlink %s", path)
232			}
233			entries = append(entries, SubmoduleNode{Path: path, Gitlink: f[1]})
234		}
235		if len(entries) == 0 {
236			return entries, nil
237		}
238		// Read the indexed .gitmodules, not a mutable working file or inherited
239		// global configuration. Names and paths are NUL-safe.
240		modules, err := run(ctx, dir, "config", "--null", "--blob", ":.gitmodules", "--get-regexp", `^submodule\..*\.(path|url)$`)
241		if err != nil {
242			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read indexed .gitmodules: %w", err)
243		}
244		paths, urls := map[string]string{}, map[string]string{}
245		for _, record := range nulLines(modules) {
246			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(record, "\n")
247			if !ok {
248				return nil, errors.New("invalid .gitmodules entry")
249			}
250			if strings.HasSuffix(key, ".path") {
251				paths[strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "submodule."), ".path")] = value
252			}
253			if strings.HasSuffix(key, ".url") {
254				urls[strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "submodule."), ".url")] = value
255			}
256		}
257		for i := range entries {
258			matches := 0
259			for name, path := range paths {
260				if path == entries[i].Path {
261					matches++
262					entries[i].Name = name
263					entries[i].URL = urls[name]
264				}
265			}
266			if matches != 1 || entries[i].URL == "" {
267				return nil, fmt.Errorf("gitlink %s has no unique .gitmodules mapping", entries[i].Path)
268			}
269		}
270		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Path < entries[j].Path })
271		return entries, nil
272	}

274	// InitSubmodules only materializes missing checkouts. Existing content/HEADs
275	// are never reset. Each level uses command-scoped configuration so shared
276	// superproject config is not rewritten by submodule init.
277	func InitSubmodules(ctx context.Context, dir string) (SubmoduleGraph, error) {
278		for {
279			g, err := SubmodulesOf(ctx, dir)
280			if err != nil {
281				return g, err
282			}
283			changed := false
284			for _, n := range g.Nodes {
285				if n.Initialized {
286					continue
287				}
288				if n.State != "uninitialized" {
289					return g, fmt.Errorf("submodule %s: %s", n.Path, strings.Join(n.Blockers, "; "))
290				}
291				parent := filepath.Join(g.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Parent))
292				url, err := resolveSubmoduleURL(ctx, parent, n.URL)
293				if err != nil {
294					return g, err
295				}
296				key := "submodule." + n.Name
297				_, err = run(ctx, parent, "-c", key+".url="+url, "-c", key+".active=true", "-c", key+".update=checkout", "submodule", "update", "--init", "--checkout", "--", relativeSubmodulePath(n))
298				if err != nil {
299					return g, fmt.Errorf("initialize submodule %s; checkout retained (retry dev submodule init)", n.Path)
300				}
301				changed = true
302			}
303			if !changed {
304				return g, nil
305			}
306		}
307	}
308	
309	func relativeSubmodulePath(n SubmoduleNode) string {
310		if n.Parent == "" {
311			return n.Path
312		}
313		return strings.TrimPrefix(n.Path, n.Parent+"/")
314	}
315	
316	func resolveSubmoduleURL(ctx context.Context, parent, url string) (string, error) {
317		if url == "" || strings.HasPrefix(url, "-") || strings.ContainsAny(url, "\x00\r\n") {
318			return "", errors.New("invalid submodule source URL")
319		}
320		if !strings.HasPrefix(url, "./") && !strings.HasPrefix(url, "../") {
321			return url, nil
322		}
323		base, err := run(ctx, parent, "remote", "get-url", "origin")
324		if err != nil {
325			return "", errors.New("relative submodule URL requires an origin remote")
326		}
327		// Git resolves relative submodule URLs against the repository URL itself.
328		for strings.HasPrefix(url, "../") {
329			url = strings.TrimPrefix(url, "../")
330			i := strings.LastIndex(strings.TrimSuffix(base, "/"), "/")
331			if i < 0 {
332				return "", errors.New("cannot resolve relative submodule URL")
333			}
334			base = base[:i]
335		}
336		return strings.TrimSuffix(base, "/") + "/" + strings.TrimPrefix(url, "./"), nil
337	}
338	
339	// SubmoduleSourceURL resolves only the declared gitlink source, not a child
340	// checkout's potentially redirected origin.
341	func SubmoduleSourceURL(ctx context.Context, parent, url string) (string, error) {
342		return resolveSubmoduleURL(ctx, parent, url)
343	}

1	// Package safefile provides held-root filesystem operations for untrusted
2	// relative paths. It keeps traversal relative to os.Root handles, rejects links
3	// and special files, revalidates filesystem identity, and detects observable
4	// source mutation while reading.
5	package safefile
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"
12		"io/fs"
13		"os"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"

17	
18	var (
19		// ErrChanged reports that a named root, child, or file no longer identifies
20		// the object observed by the caller.
21		ErrChanged = errors.New("filesystem object changed")
22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.
24		ErrUnsafeType = errors.New("unsafe filesystem object type")
25		// ErrFileLimit reports a regular file whose bytes exceed the read policy.
26		ErrFileLimit = errors.New("file size limit exceeded")

28	
29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}
63	
64	// OpenChildRoot opens one child directory through parent and proves that its
65	// name still identifies the held directory.
66	func OpenChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
67		if parent == nil {
68			return nil, nil, errors.New("open child root: nil parent")
69		}
70		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
71			return nil, nil, err
72		}
73		before, err := parent.Lstat(name)
74		if err != nil {
75			return nil, nil, err
76		}
77		if unsafeLink(before) {
78			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q is a symlink or reparse point: %w", name, ErrUnsafeType)
79		}
80		if !before.IsDir() {
81			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a directory: %w", name, ErrUnsafeType)
82		}
83		child, err := parent.OpenRoot(name)
84		if err != nil {
85			return nil, nil, err
86		}
87		held, err := child.Stat(".")
88		if err != nil {
89			_ = child.Close()
90			return nil, nil, err
91		}
92		current, err := parent.Lstat(name)
93		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
94			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
95			_ = child.Close()
96			if err != nil {
97				return nil, nil, err
98			}
99			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q changed while opening: %w", name, ErrChanged)
100		}
101		return child, held, nil
102	}
103	
104	// VerifyRoot proves that path still names the previously held root directory.
105	func VerifyRoot(path string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {
106		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
107		if err != nil {
108			return err
109		}
110		if expected == nil || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() || !os.SameFile(expected, current) {
111			return fmt.Errorf("root path changed: %w", ErrChanged)
112		}
113		return nil
114	}
115	
116	// VerifyChildRoot proves that name below parent still names the previously held
117	// child directory.
118	func VerifyChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {
119		if parent == nil {
120			return errors.New("verify child root: nil parent")
121		}
122		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
123			return err
124		}
125		current, err := parent.Lstat(name)
126		if err != nil {
127			return err
128		}
129		if expected == nil || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() || !os.SameFile(expected, current) {
130			return fmt.Errorf("component %q changed: %w", name, ErrChanged)
131		}
132		return nil
133	}
134	
135	// ReadStableRegular reads one child file while proving that the directory name,
136	// opened descriptor, and final directory name all identify the expected regular
137	// file with unchanged observable metadata. maxBytes must be non-negative; zero
138	// means unbounded. Supplying the FileInfo from an earlier directory listing
139	// detects replacement or mutation between selection and opening.
140	func ReadStableRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
141		if root == nil {
142			return nil, nil, errors.New("read stable file: nil root")
143		}
144		if maxBytes < 0 {
145			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("negative maximum file size: %w", ErrFileLimit)
146		}
147		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
148			return nil, nil, err
149		}
150		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, nil, err
153		}
154		if expected == nil {
155			expected = before
156		}
157		if unsafeLink(before) || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
158			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is not a regular file: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
159		}
160		if !sameStableSourceState(expected, before) {
161			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed before opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
162		}
163		if maxBytes > 0 && before.Size() > maxBytes {
164			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", before.Size(), maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
165		}
166	
167		file, err := openRegularForRead(root, name)
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, nil, err
170		}
171		defer file.Close()
172		opened, err := file.Stat()
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, nil, err
175		}
176		if unsafeLink(opened) || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(expected, opened) {
177			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
178		}
179		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, nil, err
182		}
183		if unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, current) {
184			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
185		}
186	
187		data, err := readAllContext(ctx, file, maxBytes)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, nil, err
190		}
191		after, err := file.Stat()
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, nil, err
194		}
195		current, err = root.Lstat(name)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, nil, err
198		}
199		if unsafeLink(after) || unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, after) ||
200			!sameStableSourceState(after, current) || after.Size() != int64(len(data)) {
201			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed during read: %w", ErrChanged)
202		}
203		return data, opened, nil
204	}
205	
206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}
213	
214	func sameStableSourceState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)
216	}
217	
218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}
243	
244	func unsafeLink(info fs.FileInfo) bool {
245		return info != nil && (info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || isReparsePoint(info))
246	}

14	// ReadStablePath walks held directory handles and rejects links in every
15	// user-controlled component, then verifies the chain after reading. Only the
16	// fixed macOS /var and /tmp platform aliases may be resolved.
17	func ReadStablePath(ctx context.Context, path string, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
18		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) || filepath.Clean(path) != path {
19			return nil, errors.New("stable read requires a clean absolute path")
20		}
21		if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
22			for _, alias := range []string{"/var", "/tmp"} {
23				if strings.HasPrefix(path, alias+"/") {
24					target, e := os.Readlink(alias)
25					if e == nil && (target == "private"+alias || target == "/private"+alias) {
26						path = "/private" + path
27					}
28				}
29			}
30		}
31		anchor, err := platformfs.Resolve(path)
32		if err != nil {
33			return nil, err
34		}
35		base := anchor.Path
36		parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(path, base), string(filepath.Separator)), string(filepath.Separator))
37		if len(parts) == 0 || len(parts) > 128 {
38			return nil, ErrUnsafeType
39		}
40		root, info, err := OpenRoot(base)
41		if err != nil {
42			return nil, err
43		}
44		defer root.Close()
45		type edge struct {
46			parent *os.Root
47			name   string
48			info   fs.FileInfo
49		}
50		var edges []edge
51		current := root
52		for _, part := range parts[:len(parts)-1] {
53			next, id, e := OpenChildRoot(current, part)
54			if e != nil {
55				return nil, e
56			}
57			defer next.Close()
58			edges = append(edges, edge{current, part, id})
59			current = next
60		}
61		data, _, err := ReadStableRegular(ctx, current, parts[len(parts)-1], nil, limit)
62		if err != nil {
63			return nil, err
64		}
65		for _, e := range edges {
66			if err = VerifyChildRoot(e.parent, e.name, e.info); err != nil {
67				return nil, err
68			}
69		}
70		if err = VerifyRoot(base, info); err != nil {
71			return nil, err
72		}
73		if err := anchor.Verify(); err != nil {
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		return data, nil
77	}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15		"unicode"
16		"unicode/utf8"
17	
18		"golang.org/x/text/cases"
19		"golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm"
20	)
21	
22	var (
23		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
24		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
25		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
26		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
27		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
28		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
29		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
30		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
31		// ErrNotPortable reports a relative path that cannot be represented safely
32		// and with the same meaning on supported Unix and Windows filesystems.
33		ErrNotPortable = errors.New("path is not portable")
34		// ErrPathCollision reports distinct spellings that identify the same path on
35		// a case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystem.
36		ErrPathCollision = errors.New("portable path collision")
37		// ErrPathLimit reports a portable path that exceeds an explicit policy limit.
38		ErrPathLimit = errors.New("portable path limit exceeded")
39	)
40	
41	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
42	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
43	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
44	// before creating or moving anything into it.
45	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
46		if path == "" {
47			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
48		}
49		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
50		if err != nil {
51			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
52		}
53		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
54	
55		probe := absolute
56		var missing []string
57		for {
58			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
59			if err == nil {
60				slices.Reverse(missing)
61				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
62				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
63			}
64			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
65				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
66			}
67			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
68			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
69			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
70			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
71			// still-missing suffix.
72			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
73				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
74				if readErr != nil {
75					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
76				}
77				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
78					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
79				}
80				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
81					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
82				}
83				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
84				if resolveErr != nil {
85					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
86				}
87				slices.Reverse(missing)
88				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
89				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
90			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
91				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
92			}
93			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
94			if parent == probe {
95				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
96			}
97			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
98			probe = parent
99		}
100	}
101	
102	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
103	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
104	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
105	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
106		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
107			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
108		}
109		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
110		if err != nil {
111			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
112		}
113		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
114		if err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
116		}
117	
118		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
119		if err != nil {
120			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
121			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
122			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
123			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
124		}
125		switch {
126		case rel == ".":
127			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
128		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
129			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
130		default:
131			return canonicalCandidate, nil
132		}
133	}
134	
135	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
136	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
137	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
138		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
139		if err == nil {
140			return true, nil
141		}
142		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
143			return false, nil
144		}
145		return false, err
146	}
147	
148	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
149	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
150		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
151		if err != nil {
152			return false, err
153		}
154		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
155		if err != nil {
156			return false, err
157		}
158		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
159			return true, nil
160		}
161		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
162	}
163	
164	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
165	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
166	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
167	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
168		switch {
169		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
170			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
171		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
172			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
173		case component == "." || component == "..":
174			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
175		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
176			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
177		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
178			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
179		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
180			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
181		default:
182			return nil
183		}
184	}
185	
186	// PortablePathLimits bounds the encoded path, each encoded component, and path
187	// depth. Zero means unbounded for that field; negative values are invalid.
188	// File-count and byte-size ceilings live in safefile because they describe a
189	// collection of files rather than a path.
190	type PortablePathLimits struct {
191		MaxPathBytes      int
192		MaxComponentBytes int
193		MaxDepth          int
194	}
195	
196	// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
197	// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
198	// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
199	// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
200	// invalid UTF-8.
201	func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
202		if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
203			return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
204		}
205		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
206			return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
207		}
208		if value == "" {
209			return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)
210		}
211		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
212			return fmt.Errorf("path contains a backslash path separator: %w", ErrNotPortable)
213		}
214		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || driveQualified(value) {
215			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is absolute, drive-qualified, or UNC: %w", value, ErrNotPortable)
216		}
217		if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
218			return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)
219		}
220		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
221		if limits.MaxDepth > 0 && len(components) > limits.MaxDepth {
222			return fmt.Errorf("path has %d components; maximum is %d: %w", len(components), limits.MaxDepth, ErrPathLimit)
223		}
224		for _, component := range components {
225			if component == ".." {
226				return fmt.Errorf("path contains parent traversal: %w", ErrTraversal)
227			}
228			if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
229				return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
230			}
231		}
232		return nil
233	}
234	
235	// ValidatePortableComponent applies the per-component part of
236	// ValidatePortableSlashPath. maxBytes may be zero for no size limit.
237	func ValidatePortableComponent(component string, maxBytes int) error {
238		if maxBytes < 0 {
239			return fmt.Errorf("negative component limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
240		}
241		if !utf8.ValidString(component) {
242			return fmt.Errorf("component contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
243		}
244		if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
245			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", err, ErrNotPortable)
246		}
247		if maxBytes > 0 && len(component) > maxBytes {
248			return fmt.Errorf("component is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(component), maxBytes, ErrPathLimit)
249		}
250		if strings.IndexFunc(component, isPortableControl) >= 0 {
251			return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
252		}
253		windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
254		if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {
255			return fmt.Errorf("path contains reserved Git metadata: %w", ErrNotPortable)
256		}
257		if windowsAlias != component {
258			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q has a trailing dot or space and is not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
259		}
260		if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
261			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
262		}
263		if windowsReservedName(component) {
264			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q is a reserved Windows device name: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
265		}
266		return nil
267	}
268	
269	// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
270	// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
271	// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
272	func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
273		type collisionNode struct {
274			spelling string
275			first    string
276			children map[string]*collisionNode
277		}
278		root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
279		for _, value := range paths {
280			if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
281				return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
282			}
283			current := root
284			for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
285				key := portableCollisionKey(component)
286				next, exists := current.children[key]
287				if exists && next.spelling != component {
288					return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",
289						next.first, value, next.spelling, component, ErrPathCollision)
290				}
291				if !exists {
292					next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
293					current.children[key] = next
294				}
295				current = next
296			}
297		}
298		return nil
299	}
300	
301	func portableCollisionKey(component string) string {
302		return norm.NFC.String(cases.Fold().String(norm.NFC.String(component)))
303	}
304	
305	func isPortableControl(r rune) bool {
306		return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
307	}
308	
309	func windowsReservedName(component string) bool {
310		base := component
311		if dot := strings.IndexByte(base, '.'); dot >= 0 {
312			base = base[:dot]
313		}
314		base = strings.TrimRight(base, " ")
315		upper := strings.ToUpper(base)
316		switch upper {
317		case "CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "CONIN$", "CONOUT$", "CLOCK$":
318			return true
319		}
320		if len([]rune(upper)) != 4 {
321			return false
322		}
323		runes := []rune(upper)
324		prefix := string(runes[:3])
325		if prefix != "COM" && prefix != "LPT" {
326			return false
327		}
328		last := runes[3]
329		return last >= '1' && last <= '9' || last == '¹' || last == '²' || last == '³'
330	}
331	
332	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
333	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
334	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
335	// single component.
336	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
337		if len(components) == 0 {
338			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
339		}
340		for i, component := range components {
341			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
342				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
343			}
344		}
345		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
346		if err != nil {
347			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
348		}
349		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
350	}

352	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
353		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
354			return false
355		}
356		letter := component[0]
357		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
358	}

360	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
361		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
362			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
363		}) {
364			if component == ".." {
365				return true
366			}
367		}
368		return false
369	}

14	// Repo is a scratch repository under t.TempDir().
15	type Repo struct {
16		T    *testing.T
17		Root string
18	}
19	
20	// New initialises a repository with one commit on branch "main".
21	func New(t *testing.T) *Repo {
22		t.Helper()
23		// Windows hands back an 8.3 short path (C:\Users\RUNNER~1\...) that git then
24		// reports in its long form, so canonicalize once up front.
25		tempDir := t.TempDir()
26		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(tempDir); err == nil {
27			tempDir = resolved
28		}
29		root := filepath.Join(tempDir, "repo")
30		if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o755); err != nil {
31			t.Fatal(err)
32		}
33		r := &Repo{T: t, Root: root}
34		r.Git("init", "--initial-branch=main")
35		// Identity and signing are configured locally so the test never depends on
36		// (or is broken by) the developer's global git config.
37		r.Git("config", "user.email", "dev@example.test")
38		r.Git("config", "user.name", "dev test")
39		r.Git("config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
40		// Keep line endings and symlinks byte-for-byte on every platform; the
41		// Windows CI runner defaults core.autocrlf to true.
42		r.Git("config", "core.autocrlf", "false")
43		r.Git("config", "core.symlinks", "true")
44		r.Write("README.md", "# test repo\n")
45		r.Git("add", "README.md")
46		r.Git("commit", "-m", "chore: initial commit")
47		return r
48	}
49	
50	// Git runs a git command in the repo root and fails the test on error.

53		return r.GitIn(r.Root, args...)
54	}

58		r.T.Helper()
59		cmd := exec.Command("git", args...)
60		cmd.Dir = dir
61		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
62			"GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL="+os.DevNull, // ignore the developer's ~/.gitconfig
63			"GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM="+os.DevNull,
64			"GIT_AUTHOR_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
65			"GIT_COMMITTER_DATE=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
66		)
67		out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()

11	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
12	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
13	type Repo struct {
14		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
15		Root string
16		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory. A linked worktree has
17		// its own entry below the shared common directory.
18		GitDir string
19		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
20		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
21		GitCommonDir string
22		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
23		Name string
24		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
25		// the main checkout.
26		IsLinkedWorktree bool
27		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
28		MainRoot string
29		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
30		Bare bool
31	}

33	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
34	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
35	
36	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
37	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
38		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
39		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
40		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
41			"rev-parse",
42			"--path-format=absolute",
43			"--show-toplevel",
44			"--git-dir",
45			"--git-common-dir",
46			"--is-bare-repository",
47		)
48		if err != nil {
49			return Repo{}, err
50		}
51		f := lines(out)
52		r := Repo{}
53		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
54		switch len(f) {
55		case 4:
56			r.Root = f[0]
57			r.GitDir = f[1]
58			r.GitCommonDir = f[2]
59			r.Bare = f[3] == "true"
60		case 3:
61			r.GitDir = f[0]
62			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
63			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
64		default:
65			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
66		}
67	
68		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
69		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
70		if r.Bare {
71			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
72		} else if r.GitDir == r.GitCommonDir {
73			// A normal checkout may use --separate-git-dir, so the common directory's
74			// parent is not necessarily the working-tree root.
75			r.MainRoot = r.Root
76		} else {
77			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
78			// Absorbed submodules keep their repository below the superproject's
79			// modules directory. Its parent is metadata, not a checkout.
80			if configured, configErr := run(ctx, dir, "config", "--file", filepath.Join(r.GitCommonDir, "config"), "--get", "core.worktree"); configErr == nil && configured != "" {
81				if !filepath.IsAbs(configured) {
82					configured = filepath.Join(r.GitCommonDir, configured)
83				}
84				r.MainRoot = filepath.Clean(configured)
85			}
86			probe, probeErr := run(ctx, r.MainRoot, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--show-toplevel", "--git-common-dir")
87			fields := lines(probe)
88			if probeErr != nil || len(fields) != 2 || !sameCanonicalPath(fields[1], r.GitCommonDir) {
89				return Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("cannot verify main checkout for Git common directory %s", r.GitCommonDir)
90			}
91			r.MainRoot = fields[0]
92		}
93		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.GitDir != r.GitCommonDir
94		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
95		if r.Bare {
96			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
97			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
98			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
99				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
100			}
101		}
102		return r, nil
103	}
104	
105	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
106	// a full Discover.
107	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
108		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
109		return err == nil
110	}
111	
112	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
113	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
114	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
115	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
116	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
117		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
118			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
119				return b
120			}
121		}
122		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
123			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
124				return cand
125			}
126		}
127		return ""
128	}
129	
130	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).
131	func Remote(ctx context.Context, dir, name string) string {
132		if name == "" {
133			name = "origin"
134		}
135		out, err := run(ctx, dir, "remote", "get-url", name)
136		if err != nil {
137			return ""
138		}
139		return out
140	}
141	
142	// RemoteFromConfig reads one remote URL directly from a Git common directory.
143	// It is the zero-process path used by whole-machine inventory, where spawning
144	// `git remote get-url` once per repo dominated startup. Includes and URL
145	// rewriting are deliberately not evaluated; callers that need Git's complete
146	// semantics should use Remote instead.
147	func RemoteFromConfig(commonDir, name string) string {
148		if commonDir == "" {
149			return ""
150		}
151		if name == "" {
152			name = "origin"
153		}
154		b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(commonDir, "config"))
155		if err != nil {
156			return ""
157		}
158		want := `remote "` + name + `"`
159		section := ""
160		for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(b), "\n") {
161			line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
162			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || strings.HasPrefix(line, ";") {
163				continue
164			}
165			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.HasSuffix(line, "]") {
166				section = strings.TrimSpace(line[1 : len(line)-1])
167				continue
168			}
169			if section != want {
170				continue
171			}
172			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
173			if ok && strings.TrimSpace(key) == "url" {
174				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(value), `"`)
175			}
176		}
177		return ""
178	}

44	// Dirty reports uncommitted work of any kind.

50	// Synced reports a branch that is published and exactly level with upstream.

53	// Summary renders the compact, starship-like column used throughout dev:
54	//
55	//	⇕⇡2⇣1 =1 +3 !2 ?4
56	//
57	// Divergence, conflicts, staged, unstaged and untracked paths remain separate
58	// so "dirty" says how and by how much, rather than collapsing to one ●.
59	func (s Status) Summary() string {
60		var parts []string
61		switch {
62		case s.Ahead > 0 && s.Behind > 0:
63			parts = append(parts, "⇕⇡"+strconv.Itoa(s.Ahead)+"⇣"+strconv.Itoa(s.Behind))
64		case s.Ahead > 0:
65			parts = append(parts, "⇡"+strconv.Itoa(s.Ahead))
66		case s.Behind > 0:
67			parts = append(parts, "⇣"+strconv.Itoa(s.Behind))
68		}
69		if s.Conflicted > 0 {
70			parts = append(parts, "="+strconv.Itoa(s.Conflicted))
71		}
72		if s.Staged > 0 {

80		}
81		if len(parts) == 0 {

83				return "local"

85			return "clean"

21			if e != nil || commit != intent.ArchiveCommit {
22				return nil, errors.New("finalized archive receipt is unavailable")
23			}
24			return intent, nil
25		}
26		if err = s.revalidate(ctx, intent); err != nil {
27			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "git-drift", err)
28		}
29		policy, err := h.PolicyFingerprint(ctx)
30		if err != nil || policy != intent.ArchivePolicy {
31			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "policy-drift", errors.New("archive policy changed after preparation"))
32		}

34			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-unproven", errors.New("archive finalization requires post-writer proof"))

36		planID := intent.ArchivePlanID

38			if planID != "" && planID != request.ArchivePlanID {
39				return nil, errors.New("this intent already has an archive plan; inspect its receipt before replacing the handoff")

41			planID = request.ArchivePlanID

43		if planID == "" {

46			}

48			if e != nil {

94	func copyLifecycleFixtureTree(source, target string) error {
95		return filepath.Walk(source, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, walkErr error) error {
96			if walkErr != nil {
97				return walkErr
98			}
99			relative, err := filepath.Rel(source, path)
100			if err != nil {
101				return err
102			}
103			destination := filepath.Join(target, relative)
104			if info.IsDir() {
105				return os.MkdirAll(destination, info.Mode().Perm())
106			}
107			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
108				link, err := os.Readlink(path)
109				if err != nil {
110					return err
111				}
112				return os.Symlink(link, destination)
113			}
114			data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
115			if err != nil {
116				return err
117			}
118			return os.WriteFile(destination, data, info.Mode().Perm())
119		})
120	}

15	// PlanSpec is action-handler construction input. Authority holds additional
16	// exact identities such as status, runtime, artifact, or remote fingerprints.
17	// BuildPlan copies every map and slice.
18	type PlanSpec struct {
19		Authority         map[string]string
20		Conditions        []Condition
21		Effects           []Effect
22		RetainedResources []string
23		Confirmation      Confirmation

29	// Plan is an immutable-by-interface proposal bound to one request and one
30	// authority fingerprint. Collection accessors always return copies.
31	type Plan struct {
32		PlanID                 string
33		AuthorityFingerprint   string
34		Request                Request
35		Locator                Locator
36		Action                 Action
37		Source                 task.State
38		Target                 task.State
39		HasPersistedTransition bool
40		StatePreserving        bool
41		RemovesTask            bool
42		Availability           Availability
43		Confirmation           Confirmation
44		ExpectedMilestone      Milestone
45		FallbackCommand        string
46		Summary                string
47		DisplayedAt            time.Time
48	
49		authority  Fields
50		conditions []Condition
51		effects    []Effect
52		retained   StringList
53	}
54	
55	// BuildPlan validates graph legality, derives availability, and seals a plan's
56	// deterministic authority fingerprint and PlanID.
57	func BuildPlan(request Request, spec PlanSpec) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid request", Cause: err}
61		}
62		if err := spec.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
63			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
64		}
65		conditions := append([]Condition(nil), spec.Conditions...)
66		if err := validateConditions(conditions); err != nil {
67			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
68		}
69		effects := cloneEffects(spec.Effects)
70		if err := validateEffects(effects); err != nil {
71			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
72		}
73		authority := NewFields(spec.Authority)
74		if err := validateAuthority(authority); err != nil {
75			return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
76		}
77	
78		plan := Plan{
79			Request: normalized.Clone(), Locator: normalized.Locator, Action: normalized.Action,
80			Source:       normalized.Locator.State,
81			Availability: AvailabilityFor(conditions), Confirmation: spec.Confirmation,
82			FallbackCommand: spec.FallbackCommand, Summary: spec.Summary, DisplayedAt: spec.DisplayedAt,
83			authority: authority, conditions: conditions, effects: effects,
84			retained: NewStringList(spec.RetainedResources...),
85		}
86		if isTransitionAction(plan.Action) {
87			rule, transitionErr := RequireTransition(plan.Locator.Mode, plan.Locator.State, plan.Action)
88			if transitionErr != nil {
89				return Plan{}, &InvalidPlanError{Reason: "invalid transition", Cause: transitionErr}
90			}
91			plan.HasPersistedTransition = true
92			plan.Target = rule.Target
93			plan.StatePreserving = rule.StatePreserving
94			plan.RemovesTask = rule.RemovesTask
95			plan.ExpectedMilestone = rule.Milestone
96		} else {
97			switch plan.Action {
98			case Adopt:
99				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneAdopted
100			case Reconcile:
101				plan.ExpectedMilestone = MilestoneReconciled
102			}
103		}
104		plan.AuthorityFingerprint, plan.PlanID = computePlanIdentity(plan)
105		return plan.Clone(), nil
106	}
107	
108	// Clone returns a plan with independent request, map, and slice storage.
109	func (p Plan) Clone() Plan {
110		p.Request = p.Request.Clone()
111		p.authority = p.authority.clone()
112		p.conditions = append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...)
113		p.effects = cloneEffects(p.effects)
114		p.retained = p.retained.clone()
115		return p
116	}
117	
118	// AuthorityFields returns a mutable copy of the extra authority identities.
119	func (p Plan) AuthorityFields() map[string]string { return p.authority.Map() }
120	
121	// Conditions returns the ordered conditions as a mutable copy.
122	func (p Plan) Conditions() []Condition { return append([]Condition(nil), p.conditions...) }
123	
124	// Effects returns independent copies of the ordered effects.
125	func (p Plan) Effects() []Effect { return cloneEffects(p.effects) }
126	
127	// RetainedResources returns the resources intentionally left after Apply.
128	func (p Plan) RetainedResources() []string { return p.retained.Values() }
129	
130	// InputConditions returns required operator input without conflating it with a
131	// safety override.
132	func (p Plan) InputConditions() []Condition {
133		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
134			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired && condition.Verdict == VerdictNeedsInput
135		})
136	}
137	
138	// BlockingConditions returns every required, non-input condition that prevents
139	// READY. Advisory conditions are intentionally absent.
140	func (p Plan) BlockingConditions() []Condition {
141		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
142			return condition.Requirement == RequirementRequired &&
143				condition.Verdict != VerdictMet && condition.Verdict != VerdictNeedsInput
144		})
145	}
146	
147	// AdvisoryConditions returns non-authorizing evidence for display.
148	func (p Plan) AdvisoryConditions() []Condition {
149		return filterConditions(p.conditions, func(condition Condition) bool {
150			return condition.Requirement == RequirementAdvisory
151		})
152	}
153	
154	// Validate proves that a plan is structurally consistent and still carries its
155	// original deterministic identity. It performs no live observations.
156	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
157		if p.PlanID == "" || p.AuthorityFingerprint == "" {
158			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "plan identity is missing"}
159		}
160		if !p.Action.Valid() {
161			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("unknown action %q", p.Action)}
162		}
163		if p.Request.Action != p.Action {
164			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request action and plan action differ"}
165		}
166		if p.Request.Locator != p.Locator {
167			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request locator and plan locator differ"}
168		}
169		if p.Request.Options == nil {
170			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "normalized request options are missing"}
171		}
172		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(p.Request)
173		if err != nil {
174			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request is no longer valid", Cause: err}
175		}
176		if requestIdentity(normalized) != requestIdentity(p.Request) {
177			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "request options are not normalized"}
178		}
179		if err := p.Confirmation.Validate(); err != nil {
180			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid confirmation", Cause: err}
181		}
182		if err := validateConditions(p.conditions); err != nil {
183			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid conditions", Cause: err}
184		}
185		if err := validateEffects(p.effects); err != nil {
186			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid effects", Cause: err}
187		}
188		if err := validateAuthority(p.authority); err != nil {
189			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "invalid authority", Cause: err}
190		}
191		if err := validatePlanTransition(p); err != nil {
192			return &InvalidPlanError{PlanID: p.PlanID, Reason: "transition metadata is inconsistent", Cause: err}
193		}
194	
195		authorityFingerprint, planID := computePlanIdentity(p)
196		if authorityFingerprint != p.AuthorityFingerprint {
197			return &StalePlanError{
198				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
199				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
200				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
201				Reason:                       "authority fields, effects, or conditions changed",
202			}
203		}
204		if planID != p.PlanID {
205			return &StalePlanError{
206				ExpectedPlanID: p.PlanID, ActualPlanID: planID,
207				ExpectedAuthorityFingerprint: p.AuthorityFingerprint,
208				ActualAuthorityFingerprint:   authorityFingerprint,
209				Reason:                       "PlanID does not match its authority fingerprint",
210			}

13	func retirementPreviewCondition(expected string, inspection retire.Inspection) Condition {
14		if expected != "" && expected != inspection.Fingerprint() {
15			return condition("runtime-preview-current", VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired, "retirement preview is stale: runtime topology or foreground programs changed", "review the current runtime before authorizing cleanup")
16		}
17		return condition("runtime-preview-current", VerdictMet, RequirementRequired, "retirement runtime matches its approved preview", "")
18	}
19	
20	// RetirementPreviewAuthority keeps task/Git/artifact and child ownership bound across
21	// interactive permissions and caller handoff, independently of runtime consent.
22	func RetirementPreviewAuthority(plan Plan) Fields {
23		fields := make(map[string]string)
24		for key, value := range plan.AuthorityFields() {
25			// Submodule facts survive the handoff; recursive disposal is a separate
26			// approval selected by the wizard, not an observed identity.
27			if strings.HasPrefix(key, "task.") || strings.HasPrefix(key, "destructive.") && !strings.HasPrefix(key, "destructive.runtime") ||
28				key == "submodules" || key == "submodule-intent" || key == "submodule-claims" {
29				fields[key] = value
30			}
31		}
32		return NewFields(fields)
33	}
34	
35	func retirementIdentityPreviewCondition(expected Fields, actual map[string]string) Condition {
36		for _, field := range expected.Entries() {
37			if actual[field.Key] != field.Value {
38				return condition("retirement-preview-current", VerdictBlocked, RequirementRequired, "retirement preview is stale: "+field.Key+" changed", "refresh the exact task, Git and artifact preview before cleanup")

71	func CloseableTaskPanes(mode task.CheckoutMode, occupancy runtime.Occupancy) map[string]string {
72		eligible := make(map[string]string)
73		if mode != task.ModeWorktree || occupancy.Backend != "herdr" || occupancyObservationError(occupancy, nil) != nil {
74			return eligible
75		}
76		for _, agent := range occupancy.Agents {
77			if agent.IsCaller || (agent.Status != "idle" && agent.Status != "done") {
78				continue
79			}
80			for _, session := range occupancy.Sessions {
81				if session.Runtime.Handle != agent.SessionHandle || len(session.Mixed) > 0 || runtime.WorkspaceProtection(session.Runtime, occupancy.Target) != "" {
82					continue
83				}
84				for _, pane := range session.Panes {
85					if pane.ID != agent.Activity.PaneID || pane.Agent != agent.Activity.Agent || pane.AgentStatus != agent.Status {
86						continue
87					}
88					if pane.Process != nil && (pane.Process.State == runtime.ProcessUnknown || pane.Process.Error != "") {
89						continue

122	// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one checkout,
123	// including intents whose exact checkout moved but stable Git identity matches.
124	// It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
125	// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
126	// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
127	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
128		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
129		if ctx == nil {
130			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
131			inspection.ObservationError = err
132			return inspection, err
133		}
134		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
135			inspection.ObservationError = err
136			return inspection, err
137		}
138		if store == nil {
139			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
140			inspection.ObservationError = err
141			return inspection, err
142		}
143	
144		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
145		if err != nil {
146			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
147			inspection.ObservationError = err
148			return inspection, err
149		}
150		inspection.Checkout = canonical
151	
152		intents, err := store.List()
153		if err != nil {
154			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
155			inspection.ObservationError = err
156			return inspection, err
157		}
158		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
159			inspection.ObservationError = err
160			return inspection, err
161		}
162	
163		matched := make([]Intent, 0, len(intents))
164		unmatched := make([]Intent, 0, len(intents))
165		for _, intent := range intents {
166			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
167				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
168				break
169			}
170			intentCheckout, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
171			if canonicalErr != nil {
172				canonicalErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, canonicalErr)
173				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, canonicalErr)
174				continue
175			}
176			if intentCheckout == canonical {
177				matched = append(matched, intent)
178			} else {
179				unmatched = append(unmatched, intent)
180			}
181		}
182	
183		if len(unmatched) > 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil {
184			identity, available, identityErr := inspectReadinessCheckoutIdentity(ctx, canonical)
185			if identityErr != nil {
186				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, identityErr)

214		}
215	
216		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
217		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
