35	不支援 `.gitmodules` 的 filter／working-tree encoding。
36	
37	Wizard 提供 `pinned`／`default-branch`，非互動預設 pinned。`--ref` 僅在 pinned
38	模式選擇已取得的 commit／tag／branch；省略時使用新增當次 default branch 的
39	commit。Default-branch 模式建立 tracking branch，不假設名稱為 `main`。兩種模式
40	都 stage 固定 gitlink，不設定 `update --remote` 政策、不改變日後 clone／worktree
41	的初始化方式，也不自動建立 task-member intent。需要任務分支時另用
42	`dev submodule develop`。
43	
44	`--submodules=recursive|none` 覆蓋 parent 的有效初始化設定，只處理新子 repo 的
45	後代。只 stage `.gitmodules` 與新 gitlink，不 commit／push／建立 runtime，也不
46	修改其他 checkout 共用的 submodule 設定。非互動變更須有來源與 `--yes`；`--json`
47	不開提示。`--dry-run` 不連線、不寫入，尚未解析的 ref 明確顯示為待解析。
48	
49	JSON 包含 `operation`、`parent`、`source`、相對 `path`、`checkout`、選用 `ref`、
50	`submodules`、`phase`、`git_dir`、選用 `head`／`branch`、`staged` 與選用 `warnings`。
51	Phase 區分 `planned`、`not-added`、`clone-incomplete`、`cloned`、`added-unstaged`、
52	`added`、`initialization-incomplete`、`complete`；失敗回傳非零並保留部分結果。
53	Clone／ref／staging 失敗可能留下檔案或 metadata：先檢查回報的精確路徑，必要時
54	手動完成 metadata／staging，再於新子 repo 內用 `dev submodule init` 重試缺少的
55	後代。不覆蓋重跑 add、不強制刪除殘留 clone；retirement 專用的 `recover` 不是
56	新增流程的復原指令。
57	
58	REPOS／REMOTE 的 `y u` 可複製網路 clone URL：REPOS 使用選中 checkout 的 origin，
59	或要求選擇其餘 remote；REMOTE 使用 CloneURL，其次 SSHURL。不拿瀏覽器網頁 URL
60	代替，也不為了複製而 fetch。
61	
62	## 初始化與開發
63	
64	```bash
65	dev repo clone owner/dotfiles-all
66	dev start dotfiles-all --task platform-change --base main \
67	  --submodule dotfiles --submodule dotfiles-windows
68	# 在新的 managed worktree 中：
69	dev submodule status
70	dev submodule develop another/module --submodule-base another/module=origin/main
71	```
72	
73	Clone 與建立 worktree 預設遞迴初始化。子 repo 停在外層 gitlink 指定的 commit，
74	呈現 detached HEAD，這是可重現的起點。選中的子 repo 才從同一個 commit 建立
75	與外層同名的 task branch；不覆寫或默默接管既有分支。Direct／branch-only
76	模式不自動切換子 repo 分支。
77	
78	```toml
79	[submodules]
80	init = "recursive" # 或 "none"
81	develop = ["dotfiles", "dotfiles-windows"]
82	```
83	
84	全域設定與 `.dev-cli/config.toml` 都支援這些欄位。明確旗標／wizard 選擇優先於
85	repo 設定，再優先於全域設定；clone 取得外層後才讀取其 repo 設定。
86	`--submodules=none` 略過初始化；`--no-provision` 只略過環境設定，不略過 Git
87	初始化。工具不會自動把子 repo 推進到最新 main。
88	
89	`dev submodule init --dry-run` 僅做本地檢查。實際 init 可連線取得缺少的
90	checkout，但保留既有 HEAD 與 dirty 內容；未初始化卻非空的目錄會被阻擋。
91	初始化失敗會保留部分成果、回傳失敗，並停止 runtime handoff／agent dispatch。
92	先重試初始化，再繼續環境設定。
93	
94	## 由內而外整合
95	
96	跨平台修改先完成各子 repo 的 commit、整合與 push，再一起 stage 對應 gitlinks
97	並提交外層。依 `dotfiles-all` 的規則，同時修改兩個平台時，用一個外層 pointer
98	commit 記錄兩個 gitlinks 與相關跨 repo 文件。
99	
100	Manager 負責驗證前提，不自動替內層 commit／push／merge。外層 `--push` 不代表
101	遞迴推送子 repo；gitlink 更新與衝突解決仍是明確操作。
102	
103	`dev status`、`dev repo context`、`dev ls --json` 與 repository UI evidence
104	會顯示子 repo 狀態；`dev submodule status --json` 提供完整本地 graph。
105	未初始化、無法確認或讀取失敗都不等於 clean，這些讀取不會 fetch／查詢遠端。
106	
107	## 暫停與回收
108	
109	從目標 checkout 及 runtime 外執行：
110	
111	```bash
112	dev park platform-change --cold --push --recursive
113	dev resume platform-change --fetch
114	# 外層 task 已整合後：
115	dev retire platform-change --recursive
116	dev sweep --merged-worktrees --recursive # 先看報告
117	```
118	
119	Cold 要求工作已提交、推送且可重建，但不要求已合併。Retire 另要求選中的子 repo
120	已整合至紀錄的 base。Workspace 成員意圖以獨立版本化紀錄保存，避免舊 task TOML
121	寫入者抹掉新欄位；resume 依 gitlink 重建選中的任務分支。
122	
123	`--recursive` 明確授權刪除工作區專屬的子 clone，包含其私有 refs／objects。
124	外層分支預設保留；canonical 與共享 repository 不會被連帶刪除。不提供此旗標時，
125	若仍有子 repo，會阻擋外層移除；`--force` 不略過內層保存證明。`dev flow` 有明確
126	的 managed／unmanaged checkout 遞迴動作，done 清理流程也會詢問是否包含子 repo。
127	
128	變更前會以當次遠端 refs 與隔離 fetch 證明各子 repo 可由指定 origin 重建，不能
129	只看 origin 存在或 ahead=0。未發布 refs、reflog／unreachable 的本地獨有物件、
130	stash、dirty／untracked／ignored 內容、未完成 artifacts、其他 task、runtime
131	活動與額外子 worktree 都會阻擋。Filtered／LFS 資料、sparse／partial 布局，或
132	無完整保存證明的私有 Git 設定／檔案也會阻擋。要求完整遞迴證明前，先初始化缺少
133	的子 repo。
134	
135	子 repo origin 必須符合其宣告來源；遠端失敗或 refs 在證明期間變動就停止。
136	Raw Git／外部 writer，以及之後發生的遠端歷史刪除，仍在 dev 合作式鎖與當次
137	證明的保證範圍之外。
138	
139	## 中斷恢復
140	
141	子 checkout 由深至淺移到同檔案系統的私有暫存區，原處保留空 gitlink 目錄，再以
142	不帶 force 的 Git 操作移除外層。不使用 `submodule deinit` 改寫共享設定。
143	
144	每次移動都有同步保存的 journal。外層移除失敗時，只在原位置未被占用的情況下
145	恢復；程序中斷或路徑被重用則保留暫存資料，並回報精確的 `journal.json`：
146	
147	```bash
148	dev submodule recover /exact/.dev-submodule-retirement-ID/journal.json --dry-run
149	dev submodule recover /exact/.dev-submodule-retirement-ID/journal.json
150	```
151	
152	Recover 用於恢復，不沿用舊證明刪除資料。外層 checkout 已移除時，只有保留的分支
153	仍指向紀錄的 commit 才能重建；被重用或非空的恢復位置會阻擋。恢復後重新執行一般
154	遞迴清理，取得新的計畫與遠端證明。
155	
156	升級後重新載入 shell integration，才能使用 done 後的遞迴 handoff；舊 wrapper
157	會拒絕新動作，不會猜測如何執行。

1	---
2	description: Choose where agent history belongs, preserve useful decisions and keep transcripts out of source distributions.
3	authority: project
4	status: evolving
5	minimum_version: v0.2.33

8	
9	# AI artifacts: what to keep, archive, and ship
10	
11	Keep useful decisions, choose where transcripts live, and ship product inputs.
12	
13	## Decide by purpose
14	
15	| Material | Purpose | Usual treatment |
16	|---|---|---|
17	| Code, tests, current specs and docs | Current behavior and contracts | Maintain with the project |
18	| Reviewed plans, decisions and pitfalls | Requirements, rationale and lessons | Keep concise, with status and context |
19	| Raw transcripts, draft plans and tool output | Evidence of the development process | Choose per repository: track, archive elsewhere, or keep local |
20	| Native sessions and tool databases | Resume state, indexes or curation records | Follow each tool's backup contract |
21	
22	AI authorship alone does not determine where a file belongs. Promote useful
23	conclusions into the project's existing docs, decisions, backlog or pitfalls;
24	old transcripts are historical evidence, not current instructions. Do not ask
25	future contributors to read every exploratory conversation to understand code.
26	
27	## Four independent choices
28	
29	1. Does this material belong in the source repository's Git history?
30	2. Where is the durable copy, and how will another machine obtain it?
31	3. Should that copy be checked, redacted, or explicitly stored without scanning?
32	4. Does the material belong in a source distribution or installed product?
33	
34	A private experiment can keep raw chats in Git. A public or long-lived project
35	can keep reviewed decisions in Git and transcripts in a separate private Git
36	repository. A private destination does not itself change hygiene policy: choose
37	it explicitly. An unscanned copy is preserved evidence, not a clean scan.
38	
39	## SpecStory: capture is separate from publication
40	
41	SpecStory is the current transcript integration. The originating agent is the
42	provider, for example `codex:<uuid>` or `claude:<uuid>`; SpecStory is the recorder.
43	Its Markdown export is not the native agent session and does not guarantee resume.
44	
45	SpecStory can write per-worktree `.specstory/history/` files or use an explicit
46	`--output-dir`. Preserve project and session identity when combining histories.
47	A shared flat directory does not by itself retain project attribution. Tools
48	such as Lore have their own metadata and curation state; do not assume all of
49	their databases can be discarded and reconstructed from Markdown.
50	
51	For the existing tracked-history workflow:
52	
53	```bash
54	dev hygiene status
55	dev hygiene scan --scope staged --json
56	dev prepare --session codex:<uuid>
57	# After the exact recorder has stopped, from outside its checkout:
58	dev artifact finalize --intent <id> --writer-stopped
59	```
60	
61	Preparation does not stop the writer. Never repeatedly redact a file that a
62	recorder is still rewriting from its native source. `dev hygiene redact` requires
63	an exact reviewed plan; artifact writes additionally require post-writer proof.
64	Private recovery and a stable byte snapshot do not prove that a process exited.
65	
66	The shared artifact writer guard covers hygiene redact/repair-encoding/restore/
67	manage and artifact finalize/archive/migrate. Other recognized live agents
68	covering the checkout always block, including idle/done agents. The calling
69	agent is exempt when Herdr's exact session ID (`agent_session` kind `id`, not a
70	title) differs from every target artifact's valid UUID in its actual
71	SpecStory-generated anchored preamble. Only `.specstory/history/*.md` supplies
72	this proof, not filenames or UUIDs later in the text. Plans or unprovable transcripts require global
73	`--allow-shared-checkout`: an explicit assertion of disjoint ownership after the
74	writer exits, never an automatic retry flag. Unknown caller identity needs
75	that explicit attestation. An identified caller-owned live transcript is refused
76	even with the override. Post-writer proof and source revalidation remain
77	required; restore checks the receipt's exact paths.
78	
79	If history is ignored, ordinary code commits need not scan it. An already tracked
80	file remains tracked after adding `.gitignore`: removing it from the index is a
81	separate reviewed operation. Keep or archive ignored history before deleting its
82	worktree; ignored does not mean disposable or backed up.
83	
84	## Choose and apply repository policy
85	
86	No policy means existing behavior is unchanged. `track` retains the existing
87	source-commit finalizer, `archive` preserves selected evidence in a separate Git
88	checkout, and `unmanaged` leaves retention to the user. Sources are `specstory`
89	(recorder Markdown) or `files` (explicit source-relative exports/plans).
90	
91	```bash
92	# Create the ordinary archive repository separately; configure its Git identity.
93	git init -b main /path/to/history
94	# Explicit private raw preservation; choose check or redact when wanted.
95	dev artifact setup --mode archive --source specstory --archive /path/to/history \
96	  --protection off --json
97	dev artifact setup --apply --plan <id> --yes
98	dev artifact status
99	# The same planner through repository setup:
100	dev repo setup --artifacts --mode unmanaged --json
101	```
102	
103	Setup edits only reviewed policy, local binding, ignore and export files; it
104	never untracks, commits, pushes or installs tools. `repo setup --artifacts` is
105	separate from a scaffold plan. Apply there with `--artifacts --apply --plan <id>
106	--yes`. Review and commit shared policy changes yourself.
107	
108	The shareable `.dev-cli/artifacts.toml` contains the stable project ID, retention
109	mode, source and literal paths. The archive path and protection binding stay in
110	private host state. Bind a cloned project to the desired archive on each host;
111	do not infer project identity from a folder basename or current branch.
112	
113	`--capture project` keeps normal per-worktree recorder output. `--capture external`
114	sets a checkout-specific local SpecStory output directory outside Git. It requires
115	untracked native config and enabled local Markdown export; tracked/complex config
116	requires manual review. Run setup in each new external-capture checkout. Existing
117	cloud settings and native session stores remain under SpecStory's control.
118	
119	## Preserve copies, then find them
120	
121	```bash
122	dev artifact archive --session codex:<uuid> --json
123	# Inspect the private review directory, then after the recorder exits:
124	dev artifact archive --apply --plan <id> --yes --writer-stopped
125	dev artifact find --session codex:<uuid>
126	dev artifact find --commit <full-source-commit-id>
127	dev artifact find 'literal search text' --all
128	```
129	
130	For `--source files`, select exact configured paths with repeated `--file`.
131	Inventory is bounded to 10,000 files and each operation to 256 selected files;
132	current snapshots are limited to 128 MiB per file. Oversized or unsafe inputs
133	fail explicitly. Search reads committed records on the archive's current branch;
134	`--all` includes its other projects. Results contain locations and line numbers,
135	not snippets; no network, native history crawl or agent resume occurs.
136	
137	Archive commits contain ordinary snapshot files and metadata under `projects/`.
138	The metadata binds project/session, original and stored content digests and the
139	source commit. Source files and source index bytes stay untouched. The project
140	archive gets text/ident exclusions so CRLF and literal bytes survive Git; custom
141	content filters such as encryption, LFS or encoding transforms require the
142	archive's native workflow and are never silently bypassed. Existing Git hooks
143	still run. Archive access controls and off-host backups remain the operator's
144	responsibility.
145	
146	`off` saves raw input without a scanner. `check` uses enabled source-repository
147	hygiene policy. `redact` proposes replacements on the copy and checks the result
148	again. Disabled categories remain disabled; skipped is not clean. Blocking
149	reports contain safe finding IDs for the existing `dev hygiene rules allow`
150	workflow. Exact fixture exceptions need review and a reason. Snapshot scans
151	support inline gitleaks rules and useDefault, not external rule-file includes.
152	
153	Unchanged bytes reuse signed local scan evidence only when the path, policy,
154	exceptions, scanner inputs and executables match. Changed bytes or rules rescan.
155	Partial scans never pass. Review original/copy payloads privately; raw recovery,
156	reports and receipts stay under `paths.state_dir`, outside Git and cache clearing.
157	Filenames and metadata can still identify people or systems: review before sharing.
158	
159	After committing product/policy changes, `dev prepare` also supports an archive
160	policy. Off/check finalization creates the exact archive copy after writer exit.
161	For redact, preview and review `artifact archive` first, then pass its ID to
162	`artifact finalize --archive-plan <id> --writer-stopped`. Reviewed plans should
163	be committed with product changes; prepared SpecStory archive handoffs select one
164	exact transcript. Old intents keep their original destination and requirements.
165	The tracked-history finalizer still uses the compatibility skill's scripts.
166	
167	Retirement checks signed archive receipts and current ignored capture bytes.
168	New or changed evidence blocks cleanup until preserved. Local archive durability
169	is distinct from remote sync; ordinary status and readiness never query a remote.
170	
171	## Explicit Git synchronization and original backups
172	
173	```bash
174	dev artifact sync --push --json       # preview contacts the configured remote
175	dev artifact sync --apply --plan <id> --yes
176	dev artifact sync --pull --json       # separate pull preview; fast-forward only
177	
178	dev artifact migrate --mode untrack --path .specstory/history --json
179	dev artifact migrate --apply --plan <id> --yes --writer-stopped
180	
181	dev artifact migrate --mode split --path .specstory/history --json
182	dev artifact migrate --apply --plan <id> --yes
183	# Optional: publish the original named refs to a separate empty destination.
184	dev artifact backup <completed-migration-id> --remote <git-url> --json
185	dev artifact backup --apply --plan <backup-plan-id> --yes
186	```
187	
188	Untrack saves original refs and selected working files, edits ignore rules and
189	removes only selected index entries. Other staged/unstaged work remains intact;
190	existing prepared handoffs must be resolved first. Untracking does not itself
191	configure future archive capture.
192	
193	Split requires git-filter-repo and complete local history. It produces verified
194	`original.bundle`, `original.git`, `history.git`, `filtered.git`, both commit maps,
195	selected working snapshots in `current/`, and a migration manifest. Every mapped
196	tree is checked against the selected-path projection. Empty commits/merge topology
197	and message bytes are retained; rewritten signatures cannot remain valid. A
198	restore clone verifies the original bundle. Neither source refs nor remotes change.
199	Raw backups are not a hygiene audit. Other worktrees' uncommitted files, reflogs,
200	unreachable objects, LFS payloads and submodule repositories are outside coverage.
201	Detached tips need a recovery ref before migration.
202	
203	Backup publication sends frozen named refs with empty-ref leases. Selected
204	uncommitted working snapshots stay in local `current/`; they are not in the Git
205	remote backup. Archive sync pins the reviewed destination and branch: push proves
206	ancestry before an exact lease, pull only fast-forwards. Resolve divergence with
207	native Git; dev does not force-overwrite or synthesize merges.
208	
209	Private operation ledgers retain partial effects, output and recovery paths.
210	After interruption inspect those paths and the remote, then prepare a new plan;
211	never blindly replay a partial operation. Original-remote cutover, release/tag
212	migration and force-with-lease publication of filtered history are separate,
213	operator-coordinated actions.
214	
215	## Distribution, untracking and history migration
216	
217	| Action | Effect | Earlier commits |
218	|---|---|---|
219	| `.gitattributes` `export-ignore` | Exclude selected paths from `git archive` source packages | Unchanged |
220	| Ignore and untrack | Stop including new versions in source commits; retain working files | Unchanged |
221	| Filter a separate repository copy | Build replacement history without selected paths | Different commit IDs in that copy |
222	
223	For example, this excludes chats from source archives while leaving them in Git:
224	
225	```gitattributes
226	/.specstory export-ignore
227	/.specstory/** export-ignore
228	```
229	
230	Verify the exported source still builds, including embedded resources. Packaging
231	systems have separate inclusion rules; an archive exclusion is not a universal
232	package filter. New rules affect new tagged snapshots, not old immutable tags.
233	
234	When an experiment becomes a maintained project, first inventory and verify a
235	recoverable original. Build and validate filtered history in a separate copy,
236	retain commit mappings, and separately coordinate remote replacement, tags,
237	releases and other clones/worktrees. A bundle covers selected Git objects/refs,
238	not automatically dirty files, LFS objects or submodule repositories.
239	
240	Sync, version control and backup are separate. A synchronized deletion is still
241	a deletion. Restoring a Markdown export is not restoring the native agent state.
242	Confirmed leaked credentials require revocation or rotation; filtering Git does
243	not revoke them or remove copies held by other people and services.
244	
245	See `dev help hygiene` for scanning and reviewed redaction, `dev help retirement`
246	for post-writer handoffs, `dev help repositories` for setup, and `dev help storage`
247	for durable data versus caches.
248

10	# AI 產物：保存、封存與發行
11	
12	保留有用的決策，選擇聊天保存位置，讓發行包只包含產品需要的內容。
13	離線可讀 `dev help ai-artifacts`，`dev help artifact` 與
14	`dev help specstory` 也會開啟同一份指南。
15	
16	## 依用途決定
17	
18	| 內容 | 用途 | 常見做法 |
19	|---|---|---|
20	| Code、tests、目前有效的 spec 與 docs | 實際行為與契約 | 隨專案維護 |
21	| 經審閱的 plans、決策與 pitfalls | 需求、理由與經驗 | 精簡保存，標示狀態與背景 |
22	| Raw transcripts、草稿與工具輸出 | 開發過程的證據 | 每個 repo 選擇進 Git、外存或只留本機 |
23	| Native sessions 與工具資料庫 | Resume、索引或知識整理狀態 | 依各工具的備份契約處理 |
24	
25	AI 作者身分本身不決定檔案的用途。有價值的結論整理到既有 docs、
26	decisions、backlog 或 pitfalls。舊 transcript 是歷史證據，不是目前的
27	操作指令；不應要求維護者重讀全部聊天才能理解程式。
28	
29	## 四個獨立選擇
30	
31	1. 內容是否進 source repo 的 Git history？
32	2. 可長期保存的副本在哪裡，其他機器如何取得？
33	3. 保存前要檢查、脫敏，或明確選擇不掃描？
34	4. 內容是否應進入原始碼發行包或安裝成品？
35	
36	Private 快速實驗可保留原稿；公開或長期專案可把審閱後的知識放在
37	source repo，聊天放在另一個 private Git repo。Private 目的地不會自動
38	改變 hygiene policy；未掃描的副本是保留下來的證據，不代表掃描通過。
39	
40	## SpecStory：紀錄與發布分開
41	
42	目前的 transcript 整合是 SpecStory。`codex:<uuid>` 或 `claude:<uuid>`
43	描述原始 agent，SpecStory 是 recorder。Markdown 匯出不等於 native
44	session，也不保證能 resume。
45	
46	SpecStory 可在各 worktree 的 `.specstory/history/` 寫入，或明確指定
47	`--output-dir`。合併 histories 時保留 project/session 身分；單一平面
48	目錄不會自動保留專案歸屬。Lore 等工具另有 metadata 與知識整理紀錄，
49	不能假設所有資料庫都可由 Markdown 重建。
50	
51	既有「history 進 Git」流程：
52	
53	```bash
54	dev hygiene status
55	dev hygiene scan --scope staged --json
56	dev prepare --session codex:<uuid>
57	# 精確的 recorder 停止後，從 checkout 外執行：
58	dev artifact finalize --intent <id> --writer-stopped
59	```
60	
61	Prepare 不會停止 writer。不要反覆脫敏仍被 recorder 從 native source
62	重寫的檔案。`dev hygiene redact` 使用審閱後的精確 plan；artifact 修改
63	還需 writer 結束的證據。暫時穩定的 bytes 不能證明 process 已退出。
64	
65	Hygiene redact／repair-encoding／restore／manage 與 artifact finalize／archive／
66	migrate 共用 artifact writer guard。涵蓋此 checkout 的其他已辨識 live agent
67	一律阻擋，包含 idle／done。只有 Herdr 回報呼叫者的確切 session ID（`agent_session`
68	kind 為 `id`，不是 title），且每個目標 artifact 實際由 SpecStory 產生的固定
69	preamble 都含合法且不同的 UUID 時，才豁免呼叫者。這項證明只適用 `.specstory/history/*.md`，不採信檔名或
70	內文後段提到的 UUID。Plans 或無法證明歸屬的 transcript 需全域
71	`--allow-shared-checkout`，明確聲明 writer 已退出且檔案歸屬互不重疊；不可自動
72	加上它重試。呼叫者身分未知時仍需這項明確聲明；已識別為呼叫者自己的 live
73	transcript 即使有 override 也拒絕。
74	Writer 已結束的證據與來源重新驗證仍不可省略；restore 檢查 receipt 的確切路徑。
75	
76	Ignored history 不必參與一般 code commit 的掃描；但已 tracked 的檔案
77	不會因新增 `.gitignore` 就停止追蹤。移出 index 是獨立操作。刪除
78	worktree 前保留或封存 history；ignored 不等於可丟棄或已備份。
79	
80	## 選擇並套用 repository policy
81	
82	沒有 policy 時維持既有行為。`track` 使用原本的 source commit finalizer；
83	`archive` 把證據存進另一個 Git checkout；`unmanaged` 由使用者自行管理。
84	來源是 `specstory` Markdown，或明確選取匯出檔／plan 的 `files`。
85	
86	```bash
87	# 先用一般 Git 建立 archive，設定好 Git identity。
88	git init -b main /path/to/history
89	# 明確選擇 private 原稿保存；也可選 check 或 redact。
90	dev artifact setup --mode archive --source specstory --archive /path/to/history \
91	  --protection off --json
92	dev artifact setup --apply --plan <id> --yes
93	dev artifact status
94	# Repository setup 使用同一個 planner：
95	dev repo setup --artifacts --mode unmanaged --json
96	```
97	
98	Setup 只修改審閱過的 policy、本機 binding、ignore 與 export 規則，不會
99	untrack、commit、push 或安裝工具。`repo setup --artifacts` 與 scaffold 是
100	分開的 plan；可用 `--artifacts --apply --plan <id> --yes` 套用。共享 policy
101	變更由使用者審閱後自行 commit。
102	
103	`.dev-cli/artifacts.toml` 保存穩定 project ID、策略、來源與 literal 路徑；
104	archive 路徑及保護設定留在 private host state。每台機器為 clone 綁定想用的
105	archive，不以 folder basename 或目前 branch 猜測 project 身分。
106	
107	`--capture project` 沿用每個 worktree 的 recorder 目錄。`--capture external`
108	則設定 checkout 專屬、repo 外的 SpecStory 目錄，需要未 tracked 的 native
109	config，且本機 Markdown 匯出已啟用。Tracked 或複雜 config 需人工審閱；每個
110	新的 external-capture checkout 都要 setup。Cloud 設定與 native session
111	儲存仍由 SpecStory 管理。
112	
113	## 封存副本與查找
114	
115	```bash
116	dev artifact archive --session codex:<uuid> --json
117	# 私下審閱 proposal，recorder 結束後：
118	dev artifact archive --apply --plan <id> --yes --writer-stopped
119	dev artifact find --session codex:<uuid>
120	dev artifact find --commit <full-source-commit-id>
121	dev artifact find 'literal search text' --all
122	```
123	
124	`--source files` 使用可重複的 `--file` 選取已設定範圍內的精確檔案。盤點上限
125	10,000 個檔案，每次最多選 256 個；目前 snapshot 上限每檔 128 MiB。過大或
126	不安全的輸入會明確失敗。Search 讀取 archive 目前 branch 的 committed
127	records；`--all` 包含其中其他 project。輸出只有 metadata、位置與行號，不顯示
128	snippet，不 fetch、不遍歷 native agent 目錄，也不 resume agent。
129	
130	Archive 的 `projects/` 保存普通檔案與 metadata，關聯 project/session、原稿
131	及保存版本的 digest、source commit。原檔與 source index 不變。專案 archive
132	的 `.gitattributes` 停用 snapshot/record 的 text 與 ident 轉換，保留 CRLF
133	及原始 bytes；加密、LFS 或編碼 filters 需走該 archive 的 native workflow，
134	不會默默繞過。既有 Git hooks 仍會執行。Archive 的存取權與異機備份由使用者管理。
135	
136	`off` 不要求 scanner，原樣保存；`check` 使用 source repo 已啟用的 hygiene
137	policy；`redact` 提出副本替換並重新檢查結果。停用的類別仍停用，skipped 不等於
138	clean。阻擋 report 提供安全 finding ID，可用既有 `dev hygiene rules allow`
139	流程處理；fixture exception 仍需精確範圍、審閱與理由。Snapshot 支援 inline
140	規則及 useDefault，不支援外部 gitleaks rule-file includes。
141	
142	只有 bytes、路徑、policy、exceptions、scanner inputs 與 executables 一致，
143	才重用有簽章的本機掃描結果。內容或規則改變就重掃，不完整掃描不能通過。原稿、
144	副本與 recovery 留在 Git 外的 `paths.state_dir`，不隨 cache clear 刪除。
145	檔名與 metadata 仍可能識別個人或系統，分享前應審閱。
146	
147	Product／policy changes commit 後，`dev prepare` 也支援 archive policy。
148	Off/check 可在 writer 結束後直接 finalize。Redact 要先審閱 `artifact archive`
149	的 plan，再用 `artifact finalize --archive-plan <id> --writer-stopped`。
150	經審閱的 plans 跟 product changes commit；prepared SpecStory archive handoff
151	只選一份精確 transcript。舊 intents 保留原目的地與要求，tracked-history
152	finalizer 仍使用 compatibility skill scripts。
153	
154	Retirement 重新驗證 archive receipt 與目前 ignored capture bytes。新內容或
155	缺失 receipt 會阻擋清理。本機持久保存與 remote sync 是不同狀態；一般 status
156	與 readiness 不會查詢 remote。
157	
158	## 明確的 Git 同步與原版備份
159	
160	```bash
161	dev artifact sync --push --json       # preview 會查詢設定的 remote
162	dev artifact sync --apply --plan <id> --yes
163	dev artifact sync --pull --json       # 另一個 preview，只允許 fast-forward
164	
165	dev artifact migrate --mode untrack --path .specstory/history --json
166	dev artifact migrate --apply --plan <id> --yes --writer-stopped
167	
168	dev artifact migrate --mode split --path .specstory/history --json
169	dev artifact migrate --apply --plan <id> --yes
170	# 可選：把原版 named refs 發布到另一個空目的地。
171	dev artifact backup <completed-migration-id> --remote <git-url> --json
172	dev artifact backup --apply --plan <backup-plan-id> --yes
173	```
174	
175	Untrack 保存原始 refs 與選定的目前檔案、編輯 ignore、只移除選定的 index
176	entries。其他 staged／unstaged 工作保留；必須先處理既有 prepared handoffs。
177	Untrack 本身不設定今後的自動封存策略。
178	
179	Split 需要 git-filter-repo 與完整本機歷史。產出經驗證的 `original.bundle`、
180	`original.git`、`history.git`、`filtered.git`、兩份 commit map、`current/`
181	工作檔 snapshot 與 manifest。每個 mapped tree 都與精確路徑投影比對，保留
182	empty commits、merge topology 與 message bytes；改寫後的簽章無法維持有效。
183	會實際從 bundle clone 驗證恢復。Source refs 與 remotes 均不修改。
184	
185	Raw backup 不是 hygiene audit。其他 worktrees 的未提交檔案、reflogs、
186	unreachable objects、LFS payloads 與 submodule repositories 不在範圍內。
187	Detached tip 必須先有 recovery ref。
188	
189	Backup publication 用 empty-ref lease 發布 frozen named refs；未提交工作檔
190	留在本機 `current/`，不會進入 Git remote backup。Sync 綁定審閱的目的地與
191	branch；push 先證明 ancestry 再用精確 lease，pull 僅 fast-forward。Divergence
192	交給 native Git 處理，dev 不會強制覆寫或生成 merge。
193	
194	Private ledger 保留 partial effects、output 與 recovery 路徑。中斷後先檢查
195	資料與 remote，再建立新 plan，不盲目重試 partial operation。原 remote 切換、
196	release/tag 遷移，以及 filtered history 的 force-with-lease 發布另行協調。
197	
198	## 發行排除、停止追蹤與歷史遷移
199	
200	| 操作 | 效果 | 先前 commits |
201	|---|---|---|
202	| `.gitattributes` 的 `export-ignore` | 從 `git archive` 發行包排除指定路徑 | 不變 |
203	| Ignore 加上 untrack | 後續 source commit 不再加入新版本，工作檔保留 | 不變 |
204	| 在獨立副本過濾歷史 | 產生不含指定路徑的替代歷史 | 副本中的 commit ID 改變 |
205	
206	保留 Git history、排除 source archive 的例子：
207	
208	```gitattributes
209	/.specstory export-ignore
210	/.specstory/** export-ignore
211	```
212	
213	驗證匯出的原始碼仍可編譯，包含所有 embedded resources。其他打包系統
214	有自己的 inclusion rules；這不是所有 package 都適用的排除機制。
215	新規則影響新的 tagged snapshot，不改變已發布的 immutable tags。
216	
217	實驗轉正式專案時，先盤點並驗證可回復的原版，再於獨立副本產生及驗證
218	過濾後歷史，保留 commit mapping。替換 remote、tags、releases 與其他
219	clones/worktrees 的切換另行協調。Git bundle 不自動包含未提交檔案、
220	LFS objects 或 submodule repositories。
221	
222	同步、版本控制與備份各有不同用途。同步刪除仍是刪除；恢復 Markdown
223	也不是恢復 native agent state。確認憑證外洩時需撤銷或輪替，改寫 Git
224	不會讓憑證失效，也無法移除其他人或服務持有的副本。
225	
226	掃描與脫敏操作見 [Repository hygiene](hygiene.md)。Writer 與清理契約
227	見 `dev help retirement`，setup 見 `dev help repositories`，持久資料與
228	快取分類見 `dev help storage`。
229

package safefile

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/pathx"
)

// RemoveEmptyChildDir removes only the reviewed empty directory, never a file
// substituted at its name. Traversal and identity checks use held roots. Native
// directory-only deletion also rejects late content. External writers do not
// share our locks: Unix cannot atomically compare an inode and rmdir its name.
func RemoveEmptyChildDir(ctx context.Context, parent *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {
	if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if expected == nil || unsafeLink(expected) || !expected.IsDir() {
		return fmt.Errorf("remove empty directory needs a normal directory identity: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
	}
	child, info, err := OpenChildRoot(parent, name)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer child.Close()
	if !os.SameFile(info, expected) {
		return ErrChanged
	}
	file, err := child.Open(".")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	err = verifyEmptyDirectory(file)
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if err := errors.Join(err, closeErr); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := VerifyChildRoot(parent, name, expected); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return removeEmptyChildDirNative(ctx, parent, name, expected)
}

func verifyEmptyDirectory(file *os.File) error {
	names, err := file.Readdirnames(1)
	if len(names) != 0 {
		return errors.New("directory is not empty")
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		if err == nil {
			return io.ErrNoProgress
		}
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

1	---
2	description: Retire an integrated dev-cli worktree and runtime safely, from outside the workspace being removed.
3	authority: project
4	status: stable
5	verified_on: 2026-09-17
6	---
7	
8	# Agent-safe retirement
9	
10	Submodule workspaces require explicit `--recursive` approval to dispose their independent child clones after fresh remote proof. Children leave before the outer worktree; canonical/shared Git and the outer branch remain. Interrupted cleanup retains a recovery journal. See [Submodule workspaces](submodule-workspaces.md).
11	
12	Recursive cleanup preserves the version-2 coordinator's caller and foreground-program consent checks. Child graph, workspace intent and artifact ownership remain bound to the approved preview; changed child refs or state require a new preview before runtime closure or removal.
13	
14	A `dev` change stream reaches full retirement only after an external caller closes its runtime and removes its worktree — a feature agent must never destroy the checkout or runtime containing its own process.
15	
16	## Three milestones, not one
17	
18	Completion is three separate milestones, and the persisted task state `done` now means the middle one, not the last:
19	
20	```text
21	READY     exact transcript preserved in its chosen destination after writer exit
22	MERGED    branch integrated; runtime/worktree may still exist
23	RETIRED   runtime absent, worktree removed, optional branch deleted, task reaped
24	```
25	
26	`hot`, `warm`, `cold`, and `done` remain the only persisted task states — `done` means MERGED, with cleanup possibly still pending. It does **not** mean the runtime or worktree has already been deleted.
27	
28	## Commands
29	
30	| Command | What it does |
31	|---|---|
32	| `dev prepare --session <provider:uuid> --plan <path>` | Arms post-writer artifact finalization without closing the running agent. Product changes must already be committed; the transcript itself is deliberately not staged yet. |
33	| `dev artifact finalize --run-id "$DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID" --if-pending --writer-stopped` | Preserves the exact stable transcript in the intent's source-commit or external-archive destination after its writer stops. `--if-pending` no-ops silently when no armed intent matches the run id; `--writer-stopped` confirms the outer wrapper has returned. |
34	| `dev done --ff` | Rebases the task branch onto its base and fast-forwards it locally. Records MERGED and retains worktree/branch; explicitly selected task-pane closures are reported separately. |
35	| `dev done --pr` | Pushes the branch and opens a pull/merge request through an available forge CLI. The task stays under review, not MERGED. |
36	| `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>` | Verifies an externally merged branch is contained in `<ref>` and records MERGED. |
37	| `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref> --confirm-squash <merge-commit>` | Same, but for a squash merge: attests that the named commit, already proven contained in `<ref>`, represents the feature branch. This is an operator assertion dev cannot verify on its own. |
38	| `dev artifact discard <intent> --yes` | Records that an intent can never be finalized — its transcript was never written, or its HEAD is gone after a rebase — so it stops blocking integration and retirement. It commits and recovers nothing, prints exactly what is being abandoned, and refuses an intent that is still `armed`, because finalization is the path that preserves a transcript. |
39	| `dev retire [task-or-worktree] [--base <ref>] [--close-unknown] [--assume-no-runtime] [--delete-branch] [--timeout <duration>]` | Re-resolves every covering runtime session, refuses active agents and mixed-purpose workspaces, waits for closure, revalidates Git state, and only then removes the linked worktree without force. Deletes the task record only after every requested step succeeds. |
40	| `dev flow [repo]` | Preview UI for an exact DONE task: Enter builds a revision-bound Retire plan, then approval applies it. Branch deletion requires the displayed typed token. |
41	| `dev sweep --merged-worktrees [--base <ref>] [--apply] [--yes] [--close-unknown] [--assume-no-runtime] [--delete-branches]` | From the canonical checkout, reports (and, with `--apply`, retires) both task-tracked and unmanaged linked worktrees whose branches are already contained in the base. |
42	| `dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees [--stale-days <n>] [--json]` | From a canonical non-bare checkout, emits a strict Claude Workflow V1 report; JSON schema 1 is report-only. |
43	| `dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --apply [--delete-branches --base <ref>]` | Requires a TTY and per-item confirmation, then revalidates each approved fingerprint under the common-dir cleanup lock before plain non-force removal. |
44	
45	A dirty checkout does not fail here: `dev done` classifies it against the base
46	first, offering commit or discard interactively, or taking an explicit
47	`--dirty` policy from a script. See
48	[Change-stream workflow](change-stream-workflow.md) for that wizard. The
49	`--keep-worktree` flag on `dev done` warns as a no-op; `--delete-branch`
50	fails and points at `dev retire --delete-branch`.
51	
52	If fast-forward is blocked by unrelated dirty bytes in the canonical checkout,
53	the interactive wizard can preserve them with an exact stash+restore
54	transaction. It restores staged state and untracked files after integration;
55	dirty submodules and nested repositories still require independent handling.
56	
57	After a bare interactive `dev done` reaches MERGED, its cleanup step performs
58	a read-only retirement preview and asks whether to keep, retire, or retire and
59	delete the contained branch. Covering Herdr panes and recognized agent states
60	are shown before approval. Caller-owned Herdr workspaces use a fresh exact-pane
61	external coordinator; working/blocked/waiting agents and mixed workspaces are
62	never overridden.
63	
64	For a read-only explanation before acting, render or open the generic
65	`workspace-closeout` recipe from the exact checkout:
66	
67	```bash
68	dev prompt render workspace-closeout .
69	dev prompt open workspace-closeout . --agent my-agent
70	```
71	
72	The recipe includes the full retirement audit, but its result is advisory.
73	`eligible` and a merged PR never authorize cleanup; an external `dev retire`
74	still recollects and revalidates every gate. If `dev done --ff` or
75	`dev git pull-rebase` stops at a conflict, use `prompt open` only to discuss the
76	semantic resolution, then explicitly continue/abort Git and rerun the lifecycle
77	command. See [Prompt handoffs](prompt-handoffs.md).
78	
79	## Normal local flow
80	
81	From the feature worktree:
82	
83	```bash
84	# Commit product changes first. Do not stage the moving transcript.
85	dev prepare --session claude:<uuid> --plan .claude/plans/task.md
86	# Exit the agent normally so SpecStory can write its final Markdown.
87	```
88	
89	The outer `specstory run` wrapper then calls:
90	
91	```bash
92	dev artifact finalize --run-id "$DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID" --if-pending --writer-stopped
93	```
94	
95	An external main/integration workspace finishes the job:
96	
97	```bash
98	dev done <task> --ff
99	dev retire <task> --delete-branch
100	```
101	
102	`dev done` only integrates and records MERGED. `dev retire` re-resolves every runtime pane, closes eligible sessions, waits for them to disappear, revalidates Git, and removes the worktree without force.
103	
104	In `dev flow`, Retire shows conditions, effects, retained resources, and the CLI
105	fallback before approval. Apply locks and reloads the task revision plus exact
106	repository/worktree/ref/runtime/artifact authority, repeats safety checks after
107	runtime closure and before removal, and deletes the task record last. A later
108	failure preserves a step ledger and recovery; completed effects are not called
109	rolled back.
110	
111	## Choose the containment base
112	
113	`dev retire --base <ref>` overrides the containment target for a DONE task or
114	linked worktree without changing recorded task intent. Resolution checks a local
115	branch (`refs/heads/X`), then a remote-tracking branch (`refs/remotes/X`, such as
116	`origin/main`), then a commit. Fully qualified branch refs keep their named kind.
117	Apply re-resolves the same input and requires the same kind, ref and commit OID;
118	a moved base or a newly created same-name branch makes the reviewed plan stale.
119	Remote-tracking refs are local observations, not an implicit fetch.
120	
121	Without an override, task retirement keeps its recorded base. A recorded
122	fork-point commit is never silently replaced by the default branch: if it cannot
123	prove integration, retirement stays blocked with `pass --base <branch>` guidance.
124	After `dev done --merged --base-ref X`, cleanup hints, the cleanup wizard and the
125	external coordinator carry X forward as `dev retire --base X <task>`. If a shell
126	handoff cannot carry the override, dev prints the external command instead.
127	
128	Optional `--delete-branch` still runs ordinary `git branch -d`, whose own merged
129	check uses the branch's upstream or HEAD, not `--base`. Against a non-HEAD base,
130	branch deletion can therefore fail after the worktree was removed; the branch
131	and DONE task remain, and the result reports partial completion.
132	
133	## Pull-request flow
134	
135	```bash
136	dev done <task> --pr
137	# after CI/review and a commit-preserving merge
138	git fetch origin
139	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main
140	dev retire --base origin/main <task> --delete-branch
141	```
142	
143	A squash merge is not ancestry-equivalent, so it needs an explicit operator attestation:
144	
145	```bash
146	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main --confirm-squash <merge-commit>
147	```
148	
149	This proves only that the named squash commit is contained in the base; the operator is asserting that it actually represents the feature branch.
150	
151	## Refusal conditions
152	
153	`retire.Inspect` refuses to proceed whenever any of the following hold, and it re-checks after closing sessions rather than trusting a stale view:
154	
155	- the caller's current directory is the target checkout or below it;
156	- the caller's `HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID`, `HERDR_PANE_ID`, or `TMUX_PANE` identifies a runtime session that covers the target;
157	- a covering runtime workspace also contains panes outside the target (mixed-purpose workspace);
158	- any covering agent status is `working`, `running`, `busy`, `blocked`, or `waiting` — **never overridable, by any flag**;
159	- agent status is empty or `unknown`, **unless** the caller passes `--close-unknown` from outside the target;
160	- agent status is unrecognized (anything outside the known set) — always blocks;
161	- runtime enumeration itself fails, **unless** the caller passes `--assume-no-runtime`.
162	
163	`--close-unknown` and `--assume-no-runtime` only relax fail-closed *observations* (an unreadable status, a runtime list that could not be enumerated). Neither flag ever bypasses caller containment or an active-agent state. `retirement.Service.Retire` also revalidates the target's identity, Git ancestry, in-progress Git operations (`gitx.InProgress`, checking `MERGE_HEAD`, `CHERRY_PICK_HEAD`, `REVERT_HEAD`, `BISECT_LOG`, `rebase-merge`, `rebase-apply`, `sequencer` — not `REBASE_HEAD`, which Git leaves behind after a rebase completes), and worktree cleanliness after runtime sessions close — reality may have changed while a runtime was draining, so no earlier proof carries across that boundary.
164	
165	## Periodic cleanup with sweep
166	
167	```bash
168	dev sweep --merged-worktrees
169	# Present the exact candidates/blockers to the user and ask for approval.
170	dev sweep --merged-worktrees --apply --yes
171	```
172	
173	This surfaces both task-tracked DONE worktrees and unmanaged linked worktrees whose named branches are already contained in the base — run it from the canonical checkout. It reports before applying: containment alone is never permission. Dirty Git state, a pending or unreachable artifact, a locked or prunable worktree registration, an in-progress Git operation, and the same runtime refusal conditions as `dev retire` all still block cleanup. Branches remain after retirement by default; pass `--delete-branches` only when the user separately approved deleting them.
174	
175	`dev sweep --base <ref>` also forwards the selected base to DONE task retirement;
176	`--merged-worktrees` uses its verified base for managed tasks as well as unmanaged
177	checkouts. Reviewed retire/remove plans bind worktree-list authority only to the
178	same branch or paths equal to, containing, or nested under the target. Removing
179	an unrelated sibling no longer invalidates the rest of an approved
180	`--apply --yes` batch. A same-branch checkout or target lock/HEAD change still
181	makes the plan stale; containment and all other guards remain required.
182	
183	### Verified Claude Workflow ephemeral cleanup
184	
185	Claude Workflow turn-scoped worktrees have a separate strict V1 path:
186	
187	```bash
188	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --stale-days 14
189	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --json
190	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --apply
191	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --apply --delete-branches --base main
192	```
193	
194	The command runs only from a canonical non-bare checkout. Its bounded,
195	fixed-depth adapter reads private metadata under `~/.claude/projects`, verifies
196	validated workflow/agent IDs, exact canonical worktree mapping,
197	`spawnedWithWorktree`, `isolation=worktree`, and matching journal linkage, but
198	never decodes or emits prompts, scripts, logs, result bodies, or transcript
199	content. Unknown add-only fields are tolerated; wrong required types, path
200	mismatch, duplicate claims, unsafe/symlink/reparse/group-or-world-writable
201	metadata, source mutation, bound exhaustion, and future/conflicting/unparseable
202	time fail closed.
203	
204	V1 terminal liveness requires workflow `completed|killed`, matching agent `done`,
205	one journal `started` and `result`, and no same-ID resumed transcript. A killed
206	workflow with no result, progress, or a resume is `unknown` regardless of age;
207	there is no attestation bypass. `--stale-days` measures provider inactivity,
208	defaults to 14, and has a minimum of 1.
209	
210	Current-provider ownership is not proved by path continuity. Apply additionally
211	requires provider-observed branch, HEAD, common-dir, and an opaque non-replayable
212	registration generation matching the live registry. Claude Code 2.1.259 records
213	none of those Git identity facts, so current Claude claims report
214	`provider-git-identity: unknown` and remain report-only even when `--apply` is
215	requested. This prevents stale terminal metadata from attaching to a replacement
216	checkout at the same path. A path, branch convention, or reusable GitDir pathname
217	must never be treated as the missing generation.
218	
219	The independent safety audit also requires a present, registered, non-main,
220	named, unlocked, non-prunable linked worktree with exact common-dir, live branch,
221	registry HEAD, and live HEAD agreement. Staged, unstaged, conflicted, untracked,
222	ignored, or recursively inspected submodule content blocks cleanup, as do Git
223	operations, task claims, unsafe artifact intents, caller containment, unknown
224	runtime inventory, or any covering runtime. Missing, prunable, unregistered, and
225	orphan paths remain report only.
226	
227	JSON schema 1 contains only normalized identity/state/time, Git/path/branch/HEAD
228	facts, checks, actions, diagnostics, fingerprints, and counts. It is report-only.
229	Apply rejects `--yes`, `--close-unknown`, `--assume-no-runtime`, `--no-runtime`,
230	and JSON; it requires a terminal and confirms each item. Under a common-dir
231	cleanup lock it rediscovers the repository and recollects provider, Git, task,
232	artifact, runtime, and caller proof immediately before each removal. A changed
233	fingerprint is `skipped-changed`.
234	
235	Removal uses plain `git worktree remove` without force and verifies both path and
236	registration are gone. It never closes sessions, prunes, deletes Claude metadata,
237	or rescues/stashes/commits dirty work. The named branch survives by default, so
238	unique commits remain recoverable. Optional deletion separately requires
239	`--delete-branches --base <ref>`, unchanged base/branch tips, containment, zero
240	unique commits, and ordinary `git branch -d`; any failure after removal keeps the
241	branch and reports partial completion.
242	
243	## Safety boundaries
244	
245	Raw `git worktree remove --force` and configured external tools bypass dev entirely — never run them from an agent that occupies the target. dev's guarantee is only for dev-mediated paths; it cannot stop an operator or script from calling Git directly.
246	
247	Normal task-backed retirement and the exact unmanaged path form of `dev retire`
248	use `internal/taskflow`; the latter requires contained removal. Some `sweep`
249	record-only/orphan-salvage actions remain outside taskflow. Existing
250	CLI acknowledgement flags remain compatible; the flow preview intentionally
251	offers none of them.
252	
253	A real Codex session once deleted its own registered worktree and branch from another checkout. Herdr kept the workspace and terminal alive because a Unix process can hold an open cwd inode after the path is unlinked, and SpecStory then recreated the same path containing only `.specstory/` content. The shell looked alive but was no longer a Git checkout:
254	
255	```text
256	failed to reload config: No such file or directory
257	fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
258	```
259	
260	Treat `runtime alive + Git registration absent + artifact-only path` as an orphan that needs transcript salvage and external reconciliation — **never** as RETIRED.
261	
262	`dev sweep` now recognises that shape rather than leaving it to be spotted by eye. When a task records a checkout that exists but Git does not register, and the directory holds nothing but agent artifact folders, sweep reports it as an abandoned agent workspace. It offers to remove it only when every file inside is byte-identical to one the repository already has; anything that differs is listed as salvage work and left untouched, including by `--apply`.
263	
264	Byte equality rather than mere presence is the point. A transcript writer that outlives its worktree usually flushes a longer final version than the copy committed earlier, so a same-named file in the repository is not evidence that the tail was saved.
265

282	## Task worktree scope
283	
284	Worktree-mode `dev start --focus -t <name>` creates a linked checkout; `--focus`
285	only changes focus. Finishing that task preserves its parent/canonical agent
286	sessions and other tasks' tabs. A recognized parent agent in any state blocks
287	FF: recheck after handling it independently in Herdr, choose PR, or cancel.
288	When integration is already proven and only retirement remains, a parent agent
289	does not prevent cleanup of the separate child worktree.
290	
291	The interactive finish plan may select exact idle/done **task-worktree** agent
292	panes for closure. Nothing closes until final Apply approval. Parent, other
293	checkout, mixed, or unverified Herdr workspaces are protected even when a pane
294	has changed into the target directory. If they still cover the worktree,
295	retirement stops and identifies the preserved panes. Working/blocked/waiting
296	agents remain blockers. General foreground programs (an editor, server, or
297	test command) require a separate FF confirmation: files in the displayed
298	checkout will change while those programs continue running. `--yes` does not
299	supply that confirmation; non-interactive calls requiring it stop.
300	
301	Interactive `dev done` cleanup and standalone `dev retire` share a preview of
302	the target, retained resources, workspace/tab/pane IDs, agent states, and
303	foreground program names, PIDs and directories. Closing known non-agent
304	programs requires typing `CLOSE <workspace-id>` for each affected workspace,
305	then approving the final retirement. `--close-unknown` does not authorize
306	known program termination. Only a proven foreground shell is labeled as such;
307	unavailable process evidence is shown as unknown, never idle. Herdr provides
308	foreground evidence; other backends keep their existing explicitly qualified
309	unknown-runtime policy. Background jobs are **not inspected** and may also stop
310	when their terminal closes. Raw argv and environment values are not displayed.
311	
312	Approvals bind exact task/checkout, terminal topology and program fingerprints.
313	A changed program, new tab or moved pane requires a refreshed preview. The
314	single-use version-2 coordinator handoff waits for the exact launching dev PID
315	to exit and verifies the original pane has returned to its foreground shell;
316	a replacement program is not exempt. Old handoffs must be recreated. Final
317	cancellation before Apply changes nothing; failures after effects begin list
318	completed closures and retained resources. Raw Git and Herdr actions remain
319	outside dev's locks and revalidation guarantees.
320	
321	## External history archives
322	
323	Configured archive mode uses the same post-writer handoff, preserving one exact
324	SpecStory transcript in a separate Git checkout. Reviewed plans belong with the
325	product commit. Redaction copies require a reviewed `--archive-plan`; old intents
326	retain their source-commit lane. Cleanup verifies archive receipts and ignored
327	capture bytes, and refuses changed or missing evidence. See [AI artifacts](ai-artifacts.md).

22	Completion 分成三個獨立里程碑，且目前 persisted task state 的 `done` 對應的是中間那個，不是最後一個：
23	
24	```text
25	READY     writer 離開後，exact transcript 保存到選定目的地
26	MERGED    branch 已整合；runtime/worktree 可能仍存在
27	RETIRED   runtime 已消失、worktree 已移除、可選擇刪除 branch、task 已 reap
28	```
29	
30	`hot`、`warm`、`cold`、`done` 仍是唯一的 persisted task state——`done` 代表 MERGED，cleanup 可能仍待執行，**不代表** runtime 或 worktree 已經被刪除。

114	分支（`refs/remotes/X`，例如 `origin/main`），最後才是 commit。完整分支 ref
115	維持指名的類型。Apply 重新解析同一輸入，要求類型、ref 與 commit OID 完全一致；
116	base 移動或新增同名分支都會使已審閱 plan 過期。Remote-tracking ref 是本機觀測，
117	不會暗中 fetch。
118	
119	未指定 override 時，task retirement 沿用記錄的 base。記錄為 fork-point commit
120	時，絕不暗中改用預設分支；若無法證明整合，仍會阻擋並提示 `pass --base <branch>`。
121	`dev done --merged --base-ref X` 會將 X 帶入 cleanup 提示、wizard 與外部
122	coordinator，對應命令是 `dev retire --base X <task>`。若 shell handoff 無法攜帶
123	該 override，dev 會改為列出從外部執行的命令。
124	
125	可選的 `--delete-branch` 仍執行一般 `git branch -d`；Git 自己的 merged 檢查使用
126	分支的 upstream 或 HEAD，不是 `--base`。因此對非 HEAD base 清理時，可能已移除
127	worktree 卻無法刪除分支；分支與 DONE task 會保留，結果回報部分完成。
128	
129	## Pull-request 流程
130	
131	```bash
132	dev done <task> --pr
133	# CI/review 完成，且以保留 commit 的方式 merge 之後
134	git fetch origin
135	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main
136	dev retire --base origin/main <task> --delete-branch
137	```
138	
139	Squash merge 並不等同於 ancestry-equivalent，因此需要明確的 operator attestation：
140	
141	```bash
142	dev done <task> --merged --base-ref origin/main --confirm-squash <merge-commit>
143	```
144	
145	這只證明所指名的 squash commit 被包含在 base 中；operator 是在斷言它確實代表這條 feature branch。
146	
147	## 拒絕條件
148	
149	只要符合以下任一條件，`retire.Inspect` 就會拒絕繼續執行；且它會在關閉 session 後重新檢查，而不是信任過期的視圖：
150	
151	- 呼叫者目前所在目錄就是 target checkout 或其下層；
152	- 呼叫者的 `HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID`、`HERDR_PANE_ID` 或 `TMUX_PANE` 對應到一個涵蓋 target 的 runtime session；
153	- 某個涵蓋 target 的 runtime workspace 同時也包含 target 以外的 pane（mixed-purpose workspace）；
154	- 任何涵蓋中的 agent status 為 `working`、`running`、`busy`、`blocked` 或 `waiting`——**任何 flag 都無法 override**；
155	- Agent status 為空或 `unknown`，**除非**呼叫者從 target 外部傳入 `--close-unknown`；
156	- Agent status 無法辨識（不在已知集合內）——一律阻擋；
157	- Runtime enumeration 本身失敗，**除非**呼叫者傳入 `--assume-no-runtime`。
158	
159	`--close-unknown` 與 `--assume-no-runtime` 只放寬 fail-closed 的*觀測結果*（無法讀取的 status、無法列舉的 runtime list）。這兩個 flag 都絕不會 bypass caller containment 或 active-agent state。`retirement.Service.Retire` 在 runtime session 關閉後，也會重新驗證 target identity、Git ancestry、進行中的 Git operation（`gitx.InProgress`，檢查 `MERGE_HEAD`、`CHERRY_PICK_HEAD`、`REVERT_HEAD`、`BISECT_LOG`、`rebase-merge`、`rebase-apply`、`sequencer`；不含 `REBASE_HEAD`，因為 Git 在 rebase 完成後仍會保留它）以及 worktree 是否 clean——因為 runtime draining 期間現實可能已改變，先前的驗證結果不會跨越這個邊界沿用。
160	
161	Taskflow Apply 也不信任畫面時的 snapshot：它鎖定 canonical repository/task store、重新讀取 task revision 與 authority fingerprint，並在 runtime closure、worktree removal、optional branch deletion 與最後 task reap 前逐段 revalidate。Result ledger 依序保留 `ATTEMPTED`/`COMPLETED`/`FAILED`；若前段 cleanup 已完成而後段失敗，會回報 partial success 與 recovery，而不宣稱 rollback。
162	
163	## 用 sweep 做定期 cleanup
164	
165	```bash
166	dev sweep --merged-worktrees
167	# 把確切的 candidates/blockers 呈現給使用者，並徵求核可。
168	dev sweep --merged-worktrees --apply --yes
169	```
170	
171	這會同時列出 task-tracked 的 DONE worktree，以及 named branch 已被 base 包含的 unmanaged linked worktree——請從 canonical checkout 執行。它會先回報再套用：containment 本身絕不等於許可。Dirty 的 Git state、pending 或無法到達的 artifact、locked 或 prunable 的 worktree registration、進行中的 Git operation，以及與 `dev retire` 相同的 runtime 拒絕條件，都仍會阻擋 cleanup。Retirement 完成後預設保留 branch；只有在使用者另外核可刪除時，才加上 `--delete-branches`。
172	
173	`dev sweep --base <ref>` 也會把選定 base 傳入 DONE task retirement；
174	`--merged-worktrees` 對 managed task 與 unmanaged checkout 都使用已驗證的 base。
175	已審閱 retire／remove plan 的 worktree-list authority 只涵蓋同分支，或路徑與
176	目標相同、包含目標、位於目標之下的 worktree。先移除無關的 sibling 不再使
177	`--apply --yes` 批次剩餘項目過期；同分支新增 checkout 或目標 lock／HEAD 改變
178	仍會使 plan 過期。Containment 與其他安全檢查仍不可省略。
179	
180	### 經驗證的 Claude Workflow ephemeral cleanup
181	
182	Claude Workflow 的 turn-scoped worktree 使用另一條 strict V1 路徑：
183	
184	```bash
185	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --stale-days 14
186	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --json
187	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --apply
188	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --apply --delete-branches --base main
189	```
190	
191	此 command 只能從 canonical non-bare checkout 執行。Bounded、fixed-depth adapter
192	只讀取 `~/.claude/projects` 下的 private metadata，驗證 workflow/agent ID、exact
193	canonical worktree mapping、`spawnedWithWorktree`、`isolation=worktree` 與 matching
194	journal linkage；絕不 decode 或輸出 prompt、script、log、result body 或 transcript
195	content。Unknown add-only fields 可接受；required type 錯誤、path mismatch、duplicate
196	claim、不安全／symlink／reparse／group-or-world-writable metadata、讀取中 mutation、
197	bound exhaustion，以及 future/conflicting/unparseable time 都會 fail closed。
198	
199	V1 terminal liveness 要求 workflow 為 `completed|killed`、matching agent 為 `done`、
200	journal 同時有一筆 `started` 與 `result`，且不存在 same-ID resumed transcript。
201	Killed 但沒有 result、progress，或已 resume 的狀態無論多舊都維持 `unknown`；沒有
202	attestation bypass。`--stale-days` 衡量 provider inactivity，預設 14，最小 1。
203	
204	Path continuity 無法證明 current-provider ownership。Apply 另外要求 provider-observed
205	branch、HEAD、common-dir 與 opaque non-replayable registration generation 都和 live
206	registry 一致。Claude Code 2.1.259 不會記錄這些 Git identity facts，因此目前 Claude
207	claim 會回報 `provider-git-identity: unknown`，即使要求 `--apply` 也只供 report。
208	這可防止 stale terminal metadata 綁到同一路徑的 replacement checkout。Path、branch
209	convention 或可重用的 GitDir pathname 都不能取代缺少的 generation。
210	
211	獨立 safety audit 還要求 worktree present、registered、non-main、named、unlocked、
212	non-prunable，並且 common-dir、live branch、registry HEAD、live HEAD 完全一致。
213	Staged、unstaged、conflicted、untracked、ignored 或 recursively inspected submodule
214	content 都會阻擋；Git operation、task claim、不安全 artifact intent、caller
215	containment、unknown runtime inventory 或任何 covering runtime 也會阻擋。Missing、
216	prunable、unregistered 與 orphan path 僅供 report。
217	
218	JSON schema 1 只包含 normalized identity/state/time、Git/path/branch/HEAD facts、
219	checks、actions、diagnostics、fingerprints 與 counts，且只供 report。Apply 拒絕
220	`--yes`、`--close-unknown`、`--assume-no-runtime`、`--no-runtime` 與 JSON；它要求
221	terminal 並逐項確認。在 common-dir cleanup lock 下，每次 remove 前都會重新 discover
222	repository，並重新收集 provider、Git、task、artifact、runtime 與 caller proof；
223	fingerprint 改變時回報 `skipped-changed`。
224	
225	Removal 使用 plain `git worktree remove`、不加 force，並驗證 path 與 registration 都已
226	消失。它不會關閉 session、prune、刪除 Claude metadata，或 rescue/stash/commit dirty
227	work。Named branch 預設保留，因此 unique commits 仍可復原。Optional deletion 另外要求
228	`--delete-branches --base <ref>`、unchanged base/branch tips、containment、zero unique
229	commits 與 ordinary `git branch -d`；remove 後任何 failure 都會保留 branch，並回報
230	partial completion。
231	
232	## 安全邊界
233	
234	原始的 `git worktree remove --force` 會完全繞過 dev——絕不要在佔用 target 的 agent 中執行它。dev 的保證僅止於：沒有任何 dev-mediated 路徑會執行 forced removal；它無法阻止 operator 或 script 直接呼叫 Git。Bare dashboard 的 configured `[[tui.tools]]` command 同樣是任意 external-tool escape boundary，不會繼承 Flow 的 PlanID、conditions、ledger 或 revalidation。
235	
236	一般 task-backed retirement 與 exact unmanaged path 形式的 `dev retire` 都使用 `internal/taskflow`；後者要求 contained removal。部分 `sweep` record-only/orphan-salvage actions 仍在 taskflow 之外。既有 CLI acknowledgement flags 維持相容，但 Flow preview 不提供其中任何一個；不能把本頁的 shared planner claim 擴張到所有 historical cleanup path。
237	
238	曾經真實發生過：一個 Codex session 從另一個 checkout 刪除了自己已註冊的 worktree 與 branch。Herdr 仍讓該 workspace 與 terminal 保持存活，因為 Unix process 在路徑被 unlink 之後仍可持有開啟中的 cwd inode；接著 SpecStory 又在同一路徑重新建立、但內容只剩 `.specstory/`。這個 shell 看起來還活著，但已經不再是一個 Git checkout：
239	
240	```text
241	failed to reload config: No such file or directory
242	fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git
243	```
244	
245	請把「runtime 存活 + Git registration 不存在 + artifact-only path」視為需要 transcript salvage 與外部 reconciliation 的 orphan——**絕不能**視為 RETIRED。
246	
247	`dev sweep` 現在會自行辨識這個形狀，不再只能靠人眼察覺。當某個 task 記錄的 checkout 存在、但 Git 並未註冊它，且該目錄裡只有 agent artifact 資料夾時，sweep 會將它回報為 abandoned agent workspace。只有在其中每個檔案都與 repository 已有的檔案 byte-identical 時，sweep 才會提議移除；任何內容不同的檔案都會被列為 salvage 工作並保持原狀，`--apply` 也不會動它。
248	
249	這裡採用 byte equality 而非僅檢查檔案是否存在，正是重點所在。比 worktree 活得更久的 transcript writer，通常會 flush 出比先前 commit 版本更長的最終稿，因此 repository 中存在同名檔案並不能證明結尾內容已被保存。
250

268	## Task worktree scope
269	
270	Worktree 模式的 `dev start --focus -t <name>` 會建立 linked checkout；`--focus`
271	只負責切換焦點。完成該 task 會保留 parent／canonical agent session 與其他 task
272	的 tabs。Parent 有任何狀態的 recognized agent 都會阻擋 FF：先獨立透過 Herdr
273	處理再重新檢查、改走 PR，或取消。若 integration 已證明完成而只剩 retirement，
274	parent agent 不會阻擋獨立 child worktree 的清理。
275	
276	Interactive finish plan 可以選擇關閉 **task worktree** 中 exact idle/done agent
277	pane，但最後核可 Apply 前不會關閉任何 pane。Parent、其他 checkout、mixed 或
278	無法確認歸屬的 Herdr workspace 都會保留，即使其中 pane 已切換到目標目錄。
279	這些 workspace 仍有 pane 使用 worktree 時，retire 會阻擋並列出須保留的 pane。
280	Working／blocked／waiting agent 仍不可強制關閉。一般前景程序（編輯器、server、
281	測試指令）則需要另外確認 FF 將更新畫面所列 checkout 的檔案，程序仍繼續執行。
282	`--yes` 不提供這項授權；需要此確認的 non-interactive 呼叫會停止。
283	
284	Interactive `dev done` cleanup 與獨立 `dev retire` 共用預覽，列出目標、保留資源、
285	workspace／tab／pane ID、agent 狀態，以及前景程序名稱、PID、目錄。終止已知的
286	非 agent 程序，必須對每個受影響 workspace 輸入 `CLOSE <workspace-id>`，再核可
287	最後的 retirement。`--close-unknown` 不授權終止已知程序。只有證明 shell 位於前景
288	才會這樣標示；觀測失敗顯示 unknown，不冒充 idle。Herdr 提供前景資訊；其他
289	backend 維持原有明確標示的 unknown-runtime 政策。**背景 jobs 未檢查**，關閉
290	terminal 可能一併停止它們。畫面不輸出完整 argv 或環境變數。
291	
292	授權綁定精確 task／checkout、terminal topology 與程序 fingerprint。程序替換、
293	新增 tab 或移動 pane 都需要重新預覽。單次使用的 version-2 coordinator handoff
294	會等待本次 dev PID 結束，並驗證原 pane 已回到前景 shell；新程序不會繼承 caller
295	豁免。舊 handoff 需要重建。Apply 前最後取消不產生變更；開始執行後若失敗，會
296	如實列出已完成的關閉及保留資源。Raw Git／Herdr 操作仍在 dev 的鎖與再驗證
297	保證之外。
298	
299	## 外部 history archives
300	
301	Archive mode 使用同一套 post-writer handoff，把精確的 SpecStory transcript
302	存進另一個 Git checkout。審閱過的 plans 跟 product changes commit。Redact
303	副本需提供審閱過的 `--archive-plan`；舊 intents 保留 source-commit 流程。
304	清理會驗證 archive receipt 與 ignored capture bytes，拒絕已改變或缺失的
305	證據。詳見 [AI 產物](ai-artifacts.md)。

```text
1	# Worktrees
2	
3	Submodule workspaces initialize recursively at committed gitlinks by default.
4	Use `--submodules=none` to skip, or `start --submodule PATH` to select children
5	for task branches. `dev submodule status/init/develop/recover` inspects, prepares
6	and restores child checkouts. Explicit `--recursive` cleanup verifies child
7	remote recovery before removing their private clones and the outer worktree;
8	canonical repositories and the outer branch are retained.
9	
10	A worktree is a second working directory for the same repository: its own
11	files, its own checked-out branch, sharing one history and one remote.
12	
13	## What they are actually for
14	
15	**Preventing two writers from editing the same files at once.** Not feature
16	management — that is what branches are for.
17	
18	So the question is never "how many agents am I running?" It is:
19	
20	> Could these two writers touch the same file?
21	
22	- Different files, one goal → one checkout is fine. Several agents, several
23	  panes, one branch.
24	- Different *approaches* to the same problem → one worktree each, so they can
25	  be compared and the loser discarded.
26	- Anything where the file ranges are unknown → worktrees.
27	
28	## Who owns which worktree
29	
30	| Kind | Owner | Where | Lifetime |
31	|---|---|---|---|
32	| Feature, fix, experiment, handoff | `dev` | `~/Worktrees/<repo>/<slug>` | until external retirement |
33	| Harness-owned turn-scoped isolation | Claude Code | `.claude/worktrees/` | owned by that harness; no transcript-relocation guarantee |
34	
35	**Might you review or return to the code/history/plan later → `dev`.**
36	
37	Never put a long-lived worktree inside the repository. Every file watcher,
38	language server, indexer and `rg` run in the outer repo then sees a second copy
39	of the whole tree.
40	
41	## Commands
42	
43	```bash
44	dev wt create feat/auth --base main   # create at the configured path
45	dev wt list                           # every worktree of this repo
46	dev wt open feat/auth                 # open an existing one
47	dev wt rm feat/auth                   # remove the checkout; branch survives
48	dev wt provision                      # re-run setup on an existing checkout
49	```
50	
51	## Always pass a base
52	
53	```bash
54	dev wt create fix/orderbook --base main
55	```
56	
57	Without `--base`, dev uses the repository's default branch. Passing it
58	explicitly is still preferred for scripts and agent-driven creation because
59	the intended committed starting point stays reviewable in the command.
60	
61	## Worktrees created directly in Herdr
62	
63	Herdr's **New worktree** action is allowed. Git registers that checkout with
64	the canonical repository, so dev can display it as an external worktree as
65	long as the canonical repo is discoverable through `paths.scan_roots` or
66	`paths.repo_paths`—even
67	when the checkout lives under `~/.herdr/worktrees` and that directory is not a
68	scan root.
69	
70	It remains deliberately unmanaged: dev does not silently create a task, move
71	the checkout, or run provisioning. If the work becomes durable, opt in:
72	
73	```bash
74	dev wt provision /path/to/worktree  # optional: env files + dependencies
75	dev adopt                           # report candidates; changes nothing
76	dev adopt --apply                   # record the selected candidates as tasks
77	```
78	
79	Until adoption, `dev park`, `dev resume`, and `dev done` have no task lifecycle
80	to operate on. Use `dev start` when that lifecycle is wanted from the outset.
81	
82	`dev flow [repo]` also shows every registered checkout. An eligible unmanaged
83	linked row offers plan-first **Adopt** (task metadata only; bytes stay untouched)
84	and **Remove Checkout** (clean, non-force, branch always preserved). Canonical,
85	harness, locked/prunable, task-claimed, or ambiguous rows have no destructive
86	path. Flow does not prune repository-wide stale registrations; inspect and repair
87	those explicitly.
88	
89	## A worktree starts empty of everything untracked
90	
91	No `node_modules`, no `.venv`, no `.env`. `dev` fixes this on create:
92	
93	- copies the gitignored files listed in `worktree.include`;
94	- symlinks anything in `worktree.link` (opt-in);
95	- runs `post_create`, detected from lockfiles when set to `"auto"`.
96	
97	Only files that are **both listed and gitignored** are copied. A tracked file
98	is already in the checkout on the correct branch — copying the other branch's
99	version over it would be wrong.
100	
101	## Removing one
102	
103	```bash
104	dev wt rm feat/auth
105	```
106	
107	Never deletes the branch. A dirty checkout needs an explicit `--force`, and
108	that refusal is the feature, not an obstacle.
109	
110	If a directory was deleted behind Git's back, the registration is a recovery
111	case. Inspect repository-wide `git worktree prune` scope before applying it;
112	`dev flow` reports the drift and does not prune implicitly.
113
```

1	# Agent-safe retirement
2	
3	A process must not delete the worktree that contains its own current directory.
4	The terminal can remain visible after Unix unlinks the path, but config reloads,
5	relative files and new subprocesses then fail. Herdr still showing a pane does
6	not mean the Git checkout is healthy.
7	
8	Use three separate milestones:
9	
10	1. **READY** — commit product work, run `dev prepare`, then exit normally so the
11	   post-SpecStory finalizer can preserve the exact final transcript in its selected source-commit or external-archive destination. A manual
12	   external finalizer must pass `--writer-stopped`; a Claude SessionEnd observer
13	   can provide the same durable proof without staging during teardown.
14	2. **MERGED** — `dev done --ff`, or external-merge verification with
15	   `dev done --merged --base-ref <ref>`, records DONE. Explicit and
16	   non-interactive completion keeps worktree/branch; selected interactive task
17	   pane closures are reported separately. Bare interactive
18	   completion may continue into a separately confirmed cleanup preview.
19	3. **RETIRED** — from outside the target workspace run `dev retire`. It closes
20	   eligible runtime sessions, waits until they disappear, revalidates Git, and
21	   removes the worktree without force.
22	
23	`dev flow [repo]` exposes Retire only for an exact DONE task. It first shows
24	conditions, ordered effects, resources retained, and a fallback command; branch
25	deletion is a separate typed option. Apply reloads the exact task revision and
26	Git/worktree/ref/runtime/artifact identity under locks, repeats safety checks
27	after runtime closure and before removal, and deletes the task record last.
28	Completed steps remain visible if a later step fails; no rollback is implied.
29	
30	## Choose the containment base
31	
32	`dev retire --base <ref>` overrides the containment target for a DONE task or
33	linked worktree without changing recorded task intent. Resolution checks a local
34	branch (`refs/heads/X`), then a remote-tracking branch (`refs/remotes/X`, such as
35	`origin/main`), then a commit. Fully qualified branch refs keep their named kind.
36	Apply re-resolves the same input and requires the same kind, ref and commit OID;
37	a moved base or a newly created same-name branch makes the reviewed plan stale.
38	Remote-tracking refs are local observations, not an implicit fetch.
39	
40	Without an override, task retirement keeps its recorded base. A recorded
41	fork-point commit is never silently replaced by the default branch: if it cannot
42	prove integration, retirement stays blocked with `pass --base <branch>` guidance.
43	After `dev done --merged --base-ref X`, cleanup hints, the cleanup wizard and the
44	external coordinator carry X forward as `dev retire --base X <task>`. If a shell
45	handoff cannot carry the override, dev prints the external command instead.
46	
47	Optional `--delete-branch` still runs ordinary `git branch -d`, whose own merged
48	check uses the branch's upstream or HEAD, not `--base`. Against a non-HEAD base,
49	branch deletion can therefore fail after the worktree was removed; the branch
50	and DONE task remain, and the result reports partial completion.
51	
52	Retirement never overrides `working`, `blocked`, or `waiting` agents. Unknown
53	status needs external `--close-unknown`. A workspace containing panes outside
54	the target is mixed-purpose and must be reorganized or closed manually.
55	
56	The bare interactive `dev done` cleanup preview shows those workspace panes and
57	agent states before offering keep, retire, or retire plus branch deletion. If
58	the target is the caller's Herdr workspace, dev creates a fresh exact-root-pane
59	workspace in the canonical checkout and hands a short-lived, single-use intent
60	to that external coordinator. It revalidates task, checkout HEAD, runtime
61	fingerprint, and the full ordinary retirement plan before closing anything.
62	
63	Before MERGED, parent/canonical agents are preserved and block FF: recheck,
64	choose PR, or cancel. Exact idle/done task-worktree panes can be selected for
65	closure, but only final Apply closes them. Other active agents remain blockers.
66	General foreground programs require independent FF file-change consent while
67	they keep running. Interactive done/retire cleanup lists workspace/tab/pane IDs
68	and program names/PIDs/directories. Known programs require CLOSE <workspace-id>
69	and final retirement approval; --close-unknown does not grant this consent.
70	A foreground shell is not proof of no background jobs: those are not inspected.
71	Parent/mixed workspaces remain open. Cancellation before Apply closes nothing;
72	partial failures list completed closures. Old coordinator handoffs must be
73	recreated; version 2 verifies the launching PID has returned to a shell. If the canonical
74	integration checkout is dirty, dev lists its paths and offers PR handoff,
75	typed-`DROP` guarded discard, or cancel. It never silently commits unrelated
76	canonical bytes.
77	
78	Raw `git worktree remove --force` and configured external tools bypass these
79	protections. Do not use them on an agent-owned checkout. Existing expert CLI
80	acknowledgements remain available, but the flow preview deliberately omits dirty
81	discard, shared-writer/takeover, and unknown-runtime overrides.
82	
83	Task-backed `dev retire` and exact unmanaged path retirement use taskflow
84	(the latter requires contained removal). Some record-only/orphan-salvage `sweep`
85	reconciliation paths remain separate; not every cleanup uses the same planner.
86	
87	From the canonical main checkout, `dev sweep --merged-worktrees` reports both
88	tracked and unmanaged linked worktrees whose named branches are contained in
89	main. Review the exact candidates and blockers first; apply only after user
90	confirmation. Worktree retirement keeps branches unless `--delete-branches`
91	was separately requested.
92	
93	`dev sweep --base <ref>` also forwards the selected base to DONE task retirement;
94	`--merged-worktrees` uses its verified base for managed tasks as well as unmanaged
95	checkouts. Reviewed retire/remove plans bind worktree-list authority only to the
96	same branch or paths equal to, containing, or nested under the target. Removing
97	an unrelated sibling no longer invalidates the rest of an approved
98	`--apply --yes` batch. A same-branch checkout or target lock/HEAD change still
99	makes the plan stale; containment and all other guards remain required.
100	
101	Claude Workflow turn-scoped worktrees have a separate strict V1 audit:
102	
103	```bash
104	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees [--stale-days 14] [--json]
105	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --apply
106	dev sweep --ephemeral-worktrees --apply --delete-branches --base main
107	```
108	
109	Run it only from the canonical non-bare checkout. The report verifies one exact
110	bounded mapping under `~/.claude/projects`, terminal workflow plus done agent,
111	matching journal start/result, no same-ID resumed transcript, provider inactivity,
112	and every live Git/task/artifact/runtime/caller fact. `killed` without a child
113	result, progress, resume, missing/prunable/unregistered/orphan paths, dirty or
114	ignored content, and unknown evidence are never apply-eligible. JSON is
115	schema-version-1 report-only; apply rejects `--yes`, `--close-unknown`,
116	`--assume-no-runtime`, and `--no-runtime`, requires a TTY, and confirms each
117	candidate.
118	
119	Provider ownership also needs provider-observed branch, HEAD, common-dir, and an

121	2.1.259 does not record that identity, so its claims report

124	
125	Apply locks the Git common directory, recollects all proof, and requires the same

129	Deleting it is separate: `--delete-branches` requires explicit `--base`, unchanged
130	tips, containment, zero unique commits, and ordinary `git branch -d`.
