532	type moveRecord struct {
533		From  string `json:"from"`
534		To    string `json:"to"`
535		Empty bool   `json:"empty_placeholder"`
536	}
537	type removalJournal struct {
538		Version    int          `json:"version"`
539		Root       string       `json:"root"`
540		GitDir     string       `json:"git_dir"`
541		Repository string       `json:"repository"`
542		Branch     string       `json:"branch"`
543		Head       string       `json:"head"`
544		Moves      []moveRecord `json:"moves"`
545		Removed    bool         `json:"outer_removed"`
546	}
547	
548	// Apply stages child data reversibly, leaves empty gitlinks, and invokes the
549	// existing guarded non-force outer removal. A receipt is synced before every
550	// rename. Failed operations restore original paths only when still unclaimed.
551	func (p *Removal) Apply(ctx context.Context, check func(context.Context, string) error, removeOuter func() error) error {
552		if p == nil {
553			return removeOuter()
554		}
555		if !p.observed || !p.cleanupConsent || p.publication || p.layout == nil {
556			return errors.New("recursive removal requires a complete safe observation and explicit cleanup consent")
557		}
558		if !p.remoteVerified || len(p.remoteRefs) != len(p.initialized) {
559			return errors.New("recursive removal has no fresh remote proof")
560		}
561		for _, n := range p.initialized {
562			if _, ok := p.remoteRefs[n.Path]; !ok || n.CommonDir == "" {
563				return errors.New("recursive removal has an incomplete child proof or identity")
564			}
565		}
566		if len(p.initialized) == 0 {
567			return p.applyEmpty(ctx, check, removeOuter)
568		}
569		// Same lock namespace as taskflow. Parent is already locked by the caller.
570		nodes := append([]gitx.SubmoduleNode(nil), p.initialized...)
571		sort.Slice(nodes, func(i, j int) bool { return nodes[i].CommonDir < nodes[j].CommonDir })
572		var leases []*lockx.Lease
573		defer func() {
574			for i := len(leases) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
575				leases[i].Close()
576			}
577		}()
578		for _, n := range nodes {
579			lease, err := lockx.AcquireDir(ctx, filepath.Join(n.CommonDir, "dev-taskflow"), "submodule repository")
580			if err != nil {
581				return err
582			}
583			leases = append(leases, lease)
584		}
585		if err := p.revalidateLocal(ctx, p.layout); err != nil {
586			return err
587		}
588		for _, n := range nodes {
589			child := filepath.Join(p.Graph.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Path))
590			if check != nil {
591				if err := check(ctx, child); err != nil {
592					return err
593				}
594			}
595			refs, err := gitx.Run(ctx, child, "ls-remote", "--refs", "origin")
596			if err != nil || refs != p.remoteRefs[n.Path] {
597				return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s remote proof is stale", n.Path)
598			}
599			if err := inspectPrivateState(ctx, child, n.GitDir); err != nil {
600				return err
601			}
602		}
603		// Claims and empty-node layout are checked after remote/private-state reads
604		// too, immediately before the first local effect.
605		if check != nil {
606			if err := check(ctx, p.Graph.Root); err != nil {
607				return err
608			}
609		}
610		if err := p.revalidateLocal(ctx, p.layout); err != nil {
611			return err
612		}
613		area, err := os.MkdirTemp(filepath.Dir(p.Graph.Root), ".dev-submodule-retirement-")
614		if err != nil {
615			return err
616		}
617		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, p.Graph.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
618		if err != nil {
619			return err
620		}
621		journal := removalJournal{Version: 1, Root: p.Graph.Root, GitDir: p.Repository.GitDir, Repository: p.Repository.MainRoot, Branch: p.Workspace.Branch, Head: head}
622		journalPath := filepath.Join(area, "journal.json")
623		persist := func() error { return writeJSON(journalPath, journal) }
624		placeholders := map[string]os.FileInfo{}
625		rollback := func(cause error) error {
626			for i := len(journal.Moves) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
627				m := journal.Moves[i]
628				if _, err := os.Lstat(m.To); os.IsNotExist(err) {
629					continue
630				}
631				if _, err := os.Lstat(m.From); err == nil {
632					if !m.Empty {
633						return fmt.Errorf("%w; original path reused; inspect %s", cause, journalPath)
634					}
635					parent, _, err := safefile.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(m.From))
636					if err != nil {
637						return fmt.Errorf("%w; cannot restore; inspect %s", cause, journalPath)
638					}
639					err = safefile.RemoveEmptyChildDir(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), parent, filepath.Base(m.From), placeholders[m.From])
640					parent.Close()
641					if err != nil {
642						return fmt.Errorf("%w; cannot restore; inspect %s", cause, journalPath)
643					}
644				}
645				if err := os.Rename(m.To, m.From); err != nil {
646					return fmt.Errorf("%w; restore failed; inspect %s", cause, journalPath)
647				}
648			}
649			os.RemoveAll(area)
650			return cause
651		}
652		move := func(from, to string, empty bool) error {
653			if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(from, p.roots[from]); err != nil {
654				return err
655			}
656			journal.Moves = append(journal.Moves, moveRecord{From: from, To: to, Empty: empty})
657			if err := persist(); err != nil {
658				return err
659			}
660			if err := os.Rename(from, to); err != nil {
661				return err
662			}
663			if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(to, p.roots[from]); err != nil {
664				return err
665			}
666			if empty {
667				if err := os.Mkdir(from, 0755); err != nil {
668					return err
669				}
670				info, err := os.Lstat(from)
671				if err != nil {
672					return err
673				}
674				placeholders[from] = info
675			}
676			return nil
677		}
678		// Children leave first; parent moves retain their empty placeholders.
679		for i := len(p.initialized) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
680			n := p.initialized[i]
681			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
682				return rollback(err)
683			}
684			if err := move(filepath.Join(p.Graph.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Path)), filepath.Join(area, fmt.Sprintf("checkout-%d", i)), true); err != nil {
685				return rollback(err)
686			}
687		}
688		// Release file handles before moving private admin directories on Windows.
689		for i := len(leases) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
690			if err := leases[i].Close(); err != nil {
691				return rollback(err)
692			}
693		}
694		if err := move(filepath.Join(p.Repository.GitDir, "modules"), filepath.Join(area, "git-modules"), false); err != nil {
695			return rollback(err)
696		}
697		if err := inspectModuleStorage(filepath.Join(area, "git-modules"), p.Graph.Nodes, filepath.Join(p.Repository.GitDir, "modules")); err != nil {
698			return rollback(err)
699		}
700		if err := p.verifyStagedLayout(ctx, journal.Moves); err != nil {
701			return rollback(err)
702		}
703		if err := removeOuter(); err != nil {
704			return rollback(err)
705		}
706		journal.Removed = true
707		if err := persist(); err != nil {
708			return fmt.Errorf("outer removed; cleanup receipt retained at %s: %w", journalPath, err)
709		}
710		if err := os.RemoveAll(area); err != nil {
711			return fmt.Errorf("outer removed; private submodule data retained at %s: %w", journalPath, err)
712		}
713		return nil
714	}
715

143	func (s *lifecycleService) submoduleClaims(ctx context.Context, g gitx.SubmoduleGraph, parentTask string) (string, error) {
144		records, diagnostics, err := s.tasks.ListRecords()
145		if err != nil || len(diagnostics) > 0 {
146			return "unknown", errors.Join(fmt.Errorf("child task inventory is incomplete"), err)
147		}
148		var intents []artifact.Intent
149		for _, n := range g.Nodes {
150			if !n.Initialized {
151				if s.artifacts == nil {
152					return "unknown", fmt.Errorf("submodule %s artifact inventory is unavailable", n.Path)
153				}
154				intents, err = s.artifacts.List()
155				if err != nil {
156					return "unknown", fmt.Errorf("submodule %s artifact observation: %w", n.Path, err)
157				}
158				break // One strict listing serves all empty/absent child paths.
159			}
160		}
161		var evidence []string
162		var blockers []error
163		for _, n := range g.Nodes {
164			child := filepath.Join(g.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Path))
165			for _, record := range records {
166				if record.Task.ID == parentTask {
167					continue
168				}
169				for _, path := range []string{record.Task.RepoPath, record.Task.WorktreePath} {
170					if path == "" {
171						continue
172					}
173					inside, err := pathx.Contains(child, path)
174					if err != nil {
175						return "unknown", err
176					}
177					if inside {
178						evidence = append(evidence, record.Task.ID+":"+record.Revision)
179						blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Errorf("%s is claimed by task %s", n.Path, record.Task.ID))
180						break
181					}
182				}
183			}
184			if !n.Initialized {
185				for _, intent := range intents {
186					matched := false
187					for _, path := range []string{intent.WorktreePath, intent.RepoPath} {
188						if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
189							return "unknown", fmt.Errorf("submodule %s artifact intent %s has non-absolute ownership", n.Path, intent.ID)
190						}
191						inside, err := pathx.Contains(child, path)
192						if err != nil {
193							return "unknown", fmt.Errorf("submodule %s artifact intent %s identity: %w", n.Path, intent.ID, err)
194						}
195						matched = matched || inside
196					}
197					if matched {
198						// Preserve identity/status/receipt authority even for discarded
199						// intents. Do not ask Git at an empty path: it finds the parent.
200						data, err := json.Marshal(intent)
201						if err != nil {
202							return "unknown", fmt.Errorf("submodule %s artifact intent %s: %w", n.Path, intent.ID, err)
203						}
204						evidence = append(evidence, n.Path+":"+string(data))
205						if intent.Status != artifact.Discarded {
206							blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Errorf("empty submodule %s is claimed by artifact intent %s", n.Path, intent.ID))
207						}
208					}
209				}
210				continue
211			}
212			inspection, err := s.inspectArtifacts(ctx, s.artifacts, child)
213			evidence = append(evidence, n.Path+":"+artifactAuthority(inspection, err))
214			if err != nil {
215				blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Errorf("submodule %s artifact observation: %w", n.Path, err))
216			} else if !inspection.Ready() {
217				blockers = append(blockers, fmt.Errorf("submodule %s has unfinished artifacts", n.Path))
218			}
219		}
220		sort.Strings(evidence)
221		return authorityHash("submodule-claims", evidence...), errors.Join(blockers...)
222	}

236	func (e *executionState) prepareSubmodules(ctx context.Context) error {
237		for _, effect := range e.plan.Effects() {
238			if effect.Code == effectVerifySubmodules {
239				return e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
240					root := e.plan.Locator.CheckoutPath
241					recursive, cleanup := recursiveRequest(e.plan.Request)

243					var err error
244					if cleanup {
245						p, err = submodule.InspectRemoval(ctx, e.service.cfg, root, recursive, submoduleIntegrationRequired(e.plan.Request))
246					} else {
247						p, err = submodule.InspectPublication(ctx, e.service.cfg, root, isCompletionAction(e.plan.Action))
248					}
249					if err != nil {
250						return "", err
251					}
252					if p == nil {
253						return "", fmt.Errorf("submodule graph disappeared")
254					}
255					if p.Graph.Fingerprint != e.plan.AuthorityFields()["submodules"] || p.Revision != e.plan.AuthorityFields()["submodule-intent"] ||
256						(cleanup && p.LayoutFingerprint != e.plan.AuthorityFields()["submodule-removal"]) {
257						return "", &StalePlanError{Reason: "submodule graph, removal layout or intent changed"}
258					}
259					if err := e.checkSubmoduleClaims(ctx, p, false); err != nil {
260						return "", err
261					}
262					claimHash, err := e.service.submoduleClaims(ctx, p.Graph, e.plan.Locator.TaskID)
263					if err != nil {
264						return "", err
265					}
266					if claimHash != e.plan.AuthorityFields()["submodule-claims"] {
267						return "", &StalePlanError{Reason: "child task/artifact authority changed"}
268					}
269					if err := p.VerifyRemote(ctx); err != nil {
270						return "", err
271					}
272					e.submoduleRemoval = p
273					if cleanup && p.InitializedCount() == 0 {
274						return "verified empty submodule layout and child ownership locally", nil
275					}
276					return "verified fresh remote reachability for every initialized child repository", nil
277				})
278			}
279		}
280		return nil
281	}

283	func (e *executionState) checkSubmoduleClaims(ctx context.Context, p *submodule.Removal, afterClose bool) error {
284		hash, err := e.service.submoduleClaims(ctx, p.Graph, e.plan.Locator.TaskID)
285		if err != nil {
286			return err
287		}
288		if hash != e.plan.AuthorityFields()["submodule-claims"] {
289			return &StalePlanError{Reason: "child task/artifact authority changed"}
290		}
291		if !afterClose {
292			return nil
293		}
294		rt := e.service.defaultRuntime()
295		if e.plan.Locator.TaskID != "" {
296			record, err := e.service.tasks.GetRecord(e.plan.Locator.TaskID)
297			if err != nil {
298				return err
299			}
300			rt, err = e.service.runtimeFor(record.Task)
301			if err != nil {
302				return err
303			}
304		}
305		options := retire.Options{CWD: e.service.cwd, CallerWorkspaceID: e.service.callerWorkspace, CallerPaneID: e.service.callerPane}
306		switch o := e.plan.Request.Options.(type) {
307		case RetireOptions:
308			options.CloseUnknown = o.CloseUnknown
309			options.AssumeNoRuntime = o.AssumeNoRuntime
310		case ParkColdOptions:
311			options.CloseUnknown = o.CloseUnknown
312			options.AssumeNoRuntime = o.AssumeNoRuntime
313		case RemoveCheckoutOptions:
314			options.CloseUnknown = o.CloseUnknown
315			options.AssumeNoRuntime = o.AssumeNoRuntime
316		}
317		paths := []string{p.Graph.Root}
318		for _, n := range p.Graph.Nodes {
319			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(p.Graph.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Path)))
320		}
321		for _, path := range paths {
322			live, err := e.service.inspectCleanup(ctx, rt, path, options)
323			if err != nil {
324				return err
325			}
326			if !live.Ready() || len(live.Sessions) > 0 {
327				return fmt.Errorf("submodule workspace %s has live or unknown runtime coverage", path)
328			}
329		}
330		return nil
331	}
332	
333	func (e *executionState) removeWithSubmodules(ctx context.Context, repo, checkout string) error {
334		err := e.submoduleRemoval.Apply(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, _ string) error {
335			return e.checkSubmoduleClaims(ctx, e.submoduleRemoval, true)
336		}, func() error { return e.service.removeWorktree(ctx, repo, checkout, false) })
337		var pruned *submodule.PrunedDirectoriesError
338		if errors.As(err, &pruned) {
339			e.partial = true
340			e.recovery = append(e.recovery, "Empty submodule administration directories were pruned: "+strings.Join(pruned.Paths, ", ")+". Outer cleanup is incomplete; refresh the plan before retrying.")
341		}
342		return err
343	}

345	// Human-facing summaries use the same graph without making remote requests.
346	func submoduleSummary(nodes []gitx.SubmoduleNode) string {
347		var paths []string
348		for _, n := range nodes {
349			paths = append(paths, n.Path)
350		}
351		return strings.Join(paths, ", ")

46	// SubmodulesOf never fetches and never descends across an unverified Git root.
47	func SubmodulesOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (SubmoduleGraph, error) {
48		r, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
49		if err != nil {
50			return SubmoduleGraph{}, err
51		}
52		g := SubmoduleGraph{Root: r.Root, Nodes: []SubmoduleNode{}}
53		g.RootIdentity, err = submoduleDirectoryIdentity(r.Root)
54		if err != nil {
55			return g, err
56		}
57		seen := map[string]bool{}
58		var walk func(string, string, int) error
59		walk = func(root, parent string, depth int) error {
60			if depth > 32 || len(g.Nodes) > 1024 {
61				return errors.New("submodule graph exceeds inspection limit")
62			}
63			identity, err := Discover(ctx, root)
64			if err != nil {
65				return err
66			}
67			if !sameCanonicalPath(identity.Root, root) {
68				return fmt.Errorf("%s is not an exact submodule checkout", root)
69			}
70			if seen[identity.GitDir] {
71				return fmt.Errorf("repeated submodule Git directory %s", identity.GitDir)
72			}
73			seen[identity.GitDir] = true
74			entries, err := submoduleEntries(ctx, root)
75			if err != nil {
76				return err
77			}
78			for _, entry := range entries {
79				if err := validateSubmodulePath(root, entry.Path); err != nil {
80					return err
81				}
82				rel := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(parent, entry.Path))
83				child, err := pathx.CanonicalChild(root, filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(entry.Path)))
84				if err != nil {
85					return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s: %w", rel, err)
86				}
87				n := SubmoduleNode{Path: rel, Parent: parent, Name: entry.Name, URL: entry.URL, Gitlink: entry.Gitlink, State: "uninitialized"}
88				info, statErr := os.Lstat(child)
89				if statErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
90					return gError(rel, statErr)
91				}
92				if statErr == nil && (!info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0) {
93					return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s is not a regular directory", rel)
94				}
95				_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(child, ".git"))
96				if markerErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(markerErr) {
97					return gError(rel, markerErr)
98				}
99				if os.IsNotExist(markerErr) {
100					if statErr == nil {
101						contents, err := os.ReadDir(child)
102						if err != nil {
103							return gError(rel, err)
104						}
105						if len(contents) != 0 {
106							n.State = "unknown"
107							n.Blockers = append(n.Blockers, "uninitialized directory contains files")
108						}
109					}
110					g.Nodes = append(g.Nodes, n)
111					continue
112				}
113				cr, err := Discover(ctx, child)
114				if err != nil || !sameCanonicalPath(cr.Root, child) {
115					return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s has invalid checkout identity", rel)
116				}
117				n.Initialized, n.State, n.GitDir, n.CommonDir = true, "available", cr.GitDir, cr.GitCommonDir
118				n.CheckoutIdentity, err = submoduleDirectoryIdentity(child)
119				if err != nil {
120					return err
121				}
122				n.GitIdentity, err = submoduleDirectoryIdentity(cr.GitDir)
123				if err != nil {
124					return err
125				}
126				n.HEAD, err = run(ctx, child, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
127				if err != nil {
128					return gError(rel, err)
129				}
130				raw, err := run(ctx, child, "status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=all", "--ignore-submodules=none", "-z")
131				if err != nil {
132					return gError(rel, err)
133				}
134				n.Status = statusFromOutput(child, raw)
135				n.Branch = n.Status.Branch
136				ignored, err := run(ctx, child, "ls-files", "--others", "--ignored", "--exclude-standard", "-z")
137				if err != nil {
138					return gError(rel, err)
139				}
140				n.Ignored = nonEmptyNULRecords(ignored)
141				if n.HEAD != n.Gitlink {
142					n.Blockers = append(n.Blockers, "HEAD differs from parent gitlink")
143				}
144				if n.Status.Dirty() {
145					n.Blockers = append(n.Blockers, "uncommitted content")
146				}
147				if n.Ignored > 0 {
148					n.Blockers = append(n.Blockers, "ignored content")
149				}
150				if operation, active, err := InProgress(child); err != nil {
151					return gError(rel, err)
152				} else if active {
153					n.Blockers = append(n.Blockers, "Git operation: "+operation)
154				}
155				if exists, err := RefState(ctx, child, "refs/stash"); err != nil {
156					return gError(rel, err)
157				} else if exists {
158					n.Blockers = append(n.Blockers, "stash requires independent preservation")
159				}
160				g.Nodes = append(g.Nodes, n)
161				if err := walk(child, rel, depth+1); err != nil {
162					return err
163				}
164			}
165			return nil
166		}
167		if err := walk(r.Root, "", 0); err != nil {
168			return g, err
169		}
170		// Include local refs and content, not only status counts: a same-count edit
171		// or newly created local branch must invalidate cleanup authority.
172		h := sha256.New()
173		h.Write([]byte(g.RootIdentity))
174		data, _ := json.Marshal(g.Nodes)
175		h.Write(data)
176		for _, n := range g.Nodes {
177			h.Write([]byte(n.URL))

180			}
181			root := filepath.Join(g.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Path))
182			for _, args := range [][]string{{"for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)"}, {"reflog", "show", "--all", "--format=%H"}, {"diff", "--binary", "HEAD", "--", "."}} {
183				out, err := run(ctx, root, args...)
184				if err != nil {
185					return g, err
186				}
187				h.Write([]byte(out))
188				h.Write([]byte{0})
189			}
190		}
191		g.Fingerprint = hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))
192		return g, nil
193	}

195	func gError(path string, err error) error { return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s: %w", path, err) }

197	func validateSubmodulePath(root, rel string) error {
198		if rel == "" || rel == "." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) || strings.Contains(rel, "\\") || filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(rel)) != rel || strings.HasPrefix(rel, "../") {
199			return fmt.Errorf("invalid submodule path %q", rel)
200		}
201		p := root
202		for _, part := range strings.Split(rel, "/") {
203			p = filepath.Join(p, part)
204			info, err := os.Lstat(p)
205			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
206				return nil
207			}
208			if err != nil {
209				return err
210			}
211			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
212				return fmt.Errorf("submodule path %s crosses a symlink", rel)
213			}
214		}
215		return nil
216	}
217	
218	func submoduleEntries(ctx context.Context, dir string) ([]SubmoduleNode, error) {
219		index, err := run(ctx, dir, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z")
220		if err != nil {
221			return nil, err
222		}
223		var entries []SubmoduleNode
224		for _, record := range nulLines(index) {
225			meta, path, ok := strings.Cut(record, "\t")
226			f := strings.Fields(meta)
227			if !ok || len(f) != 3 || f[0] != "160000" {
228				continue
229			}
230			if f[2] != "0" {
231				return nil, fmt.Errorf("conflicted gitlink %s", path)
232			}
233			entries = append(entries, SubmoduleNode{Path: path, Gitlink: f[1]})
234		}
235		if len(entries) == 0 {
236			return entries, nil
237		}
238		// Read the indexed .gitmodules, not a mutable working file or inherited
239		// global configuration. Names and paths are NUL-safe.
240		modules, err := run(ctx, dir, "config", "--null", "--blob", ":.gitmodules", "--get-regexp", `^submodule\..*\.(path|url)$`)
241		if err != nil {
242			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read indexed .gitmodules: %w", err)
243		}
244		paths, urls := map[string]string{}, map[string]string{}
245		for _, record := range nulLines(modules) {
246			key, value, ok := strings.Cut(record, "\n")
247			if !ok {
248				return nil, errors.New("invalid .gitmodules entry")
249			}
250			if strings.HasSuffix(key, ".path") {
251				paths[strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "submodule."), ".path")] = value
252			}
253			if strings.HasSuffix(key, ".url") {
254				urls[strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(key, "submodule."), ".url")] = value
255			}
256		}
257		for i := range entries {
258			matches := 0
259			for name, path := range paths {
260				if path == entries[i].Path {
261					matches++
262					entries[i].Name = name
263					entries[i].URL = urls[name]
264				}
265			}
266			if matches != 1 || entries[i].URL == "" {
267				return nil, fmt.Errorf("gitlink %s has no unique .gitmodules mapping", entries[i].Path)
268			}
269		}
270		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool { return entries[i].Path < entries[j].Path })
271		return entries, nil
272	}
273	
274	// InitSubmodules only materializes missing checkouts. Existing content/HEADs
275	// are never reset. Each level uses command-scoped configuration so shared
276	// superproject config is not rewritten by submodule init.
277	func InitSubmodules(ctx context.Context, dir string) (SubmoduleGraph, error) {
278		for {
279			g, err := SubmodulesOf(ctx, dir)
280			if err != nil {
281				return g, err
282			}
283			changed := false
284			for _, n := range g.Nodes {
285				if n.Initialized {
286					continue
287				}
288				if n.State != "uninitialized" {
289					return g, fmt.Errorf("submodule %s: %s", n.Path, strings.Join(n.Blockers, "; "))
290				}
291				parent := filepath.Join(g.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Parent))
292				url, err := resolveSubmoduleURL(ctx, parent, n.URL)
293				if err != nil {
294					return g, err
295				}
296				key := "submodule." + n.Name
297				_, err = run(ctx, parent, "-c", key+".url="+url, "-c", key+".active=true", "-c", key+".update=checkout", "submodule", "update", "--init", "--checkout", "--", relativeSubmodulePath(n))
298				if err != nil {
299					return g, fmt.Errorf("initialize submodule %s; checkout retained (retry dev submodule init)", n.Path)
300				}
301				changed = true
302			}
303			if !changed {
304				return g, nil
305			}
306		}
307	}
308	
309	func relativeSubmodulePath(n SubmoduleNode) string {
310		if n.Parent == "" {
311			return n.Path
312		}
313		return strings.TrimPrefix(n.Path, n.Parent+"/")
314	}
315	
316	func resolveSubmoduleURL(ctx context.Context, parent, url string) (string, error) {
317		if url == "" || strings.HasPrefix(url, "-") || strings.ContainsAny(url, "\x00\r\n") {
318			return "", errors.New("invalid submodule source URL")
319		}
320		if !strings.HasPrefix(url, "./") && !strings.HasPrefix(url, "../") {
321			return url, nil
322		}
323		base, err := run(ctx, parent, "remote", "get-url", "origin")
324		if err != nil {
325			return "", errors.New("relative submodule URL requires an origin remote")
326		}
327		// Git resolves relative submodule URLs against the repository URL itself.
328		for strings.HasPrefix(url, "../") {
329			url = strings.TrimPrefix(url, "../")
330			i := strings.LastIndex(strings.TrimSuffix(base, "/"), "/")
331			if i < 0 {
332				return "", errors.New("cannot resolve relative submodule URL")
333			}
334			base = base[:i]
335		}
336		return strings.TrimSuffix(base, "/") + "/" + strings.TrimPrefix(url, "./"), nil
337	}
338	
339	// SubmoduleSourceURL resolves only the declared gitlink source, not a child
340	// checkout's potentially redirected origin.
341	func SubmoduleSourceURL(ctx context.Context, parent, url string) (string, error) {
342		return resolveSubmoduleURL(ctx, parent, url)
343	}

22			return "", err

26		}

21		ErrChanged = errors.New("filesystem object changed")
22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.
24		ErrUnsafeType = errors.New("unsafe filesystem object type")
25		// ErrFileLimit reports a regular file whose bytes exceed the read policy.
26		ErrFileLimit = errors.New("file size limit exceeded")
27	)
28	
29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}
63	
64	// OpenChildRoot opens one child directory through parent and proves that its
65	// name still identifies the held directory.
66	func OpenChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
67		if parent == nil {
68			return nil, nil, errors.New("open child root: nil parent")
69		}
70		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
71			return nil, nil, err
72		}
73		before, err := parent.Lstat(name)
74		if err != nil {
75			return nil, nil, err
76		}
77		if unsafeLink(before) {
78			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q is a symlink or reparse point: %w", name, ErrUnsafeType)
79		}
80		if !before.IsDir() {
81			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a directory: %w", name, ErrUnsafeType)
82		}
83		child, err := parent.OpenRoot(name)
84		if err != nil {
85			return nil, nil, err
86		}
87		held, err := child.Stat(".")
88		if err != nil {
89			_ = child.Close()
90			return nil, nil, err
91		}
92		current, err := parent.Lstat(name)
93		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
94			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
95			_ = child.Close()
96			if err != nil {
97				return nil, nil, err
98			}
99			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("component %q changed while opening: %w", name, ErrChanged)
100		}
101		return child, held, nil
102	}
103	
104	// VerifyRoot proves that path still names the previously held root directory.
105	func VerifyRoot(path string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {
106		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
107		if err != nil {
108			return err
109		}
110		if expected == nil || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() || !os.SameFile(expected, current) {
111			return fmt.Errorf("root path changed: %w", ErrChanged)
112		}
113		return nil
114	}
115	
116	// VerifyChildRoot proves that name below parent still names the previously held
117	// child directory.
118	func VerifyChildRoot(parent *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {
119		if parent == nil {
120			return errors.New("verify child root: nil parent")
121		}
122		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
123			return err
124		}
125		current, err := parent.Lstat(name)
126		if err != nil {
127			return err
128		}
129		if expected == nil || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() || !os.SameFile(expected, current) {
130			return fmt.Errorf("component %q changed: %w", name, ErrChanged)
131		}
132		return nil
133	}
134	
135	// ReadStableRegular reads one child file while proving that the directory name,
136	// opened descriptor, and final directory name all identify the expected regular
137	// file with unchanged observable metadata. maxBytes must be non-negative; zero
138	// means unbounded. Supplying the FileInfo from an earlier directory listing
139	// detects replacement or mutation between selection and opening.
140	func ReadStableRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
141		if root == nil {
142			return nil, nil, errors.New("read stable file: nil root")
143		}
144		if maxBytes < 0 {
145			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("negative maximum file size: %w", ErrFileLimit)
146		}
147		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
148			return nil, nil, err
149		}
150		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, nil, err
153		}
154		if expected == nil {
155			expected = before
156		}
157		if unsafeLink(before) || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
158			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is not a regular file: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
159		}
160		if !sameStableSourceState(expected, before) {
161			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed before opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
162		}
163		if maxBytes > 0 && before.Size() > maxBytes {
164			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", before.Size(), maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
165		}
166	
167		file, err := openRegularForRead(root, name)
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, nil, err
170		}
171		defer file.Close()
172		opened, err := file.Stat()
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, nil, err
175		}
176		if unsafeLink(opened) || !opened.Mode().IsRegular() || !sameStableSourceState(expected, opened) {
177			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
178		}
179		current, err := root.Lstat(name)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, nil, err
182		}
183		if unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, current) {
184			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed while opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
185		}
186	
187		data, err := readAllContext(ctx, file, maxBytes)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, nil, err
190		}
191		after, err := file.Stat()
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, nil, err
194		}
195		current, err = root.Lstat(name)
196		if err != nil {
197			return nil, nil, err
198		}
199		if unsafeLink(after) || unsafeLink(current) || !sameStableSourceState(opened, after) ||
200			!sameStableSourceState(after, current) || after.Size() != int64(len(data)) {
201			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed during read: %w", ErrChanged)
202		}
203		return data, opened, nil
204	}
205	
206	// SameFileState compares identity, mode, size, and modification time. Stable
207	// reads and observed-target replacement additionally compare platform change
208	// time where the operating system exposes it.
209	func SameFileState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
210		return left != nil && right != nil && os.SameFile(left, right) &&
211			left.Mode() == right.Mode() && left.Size() == right.Size() && left.ModTime().Equal(right.ModTime())
212	}
213	
214	func sameStableSourceState(left, right fs.FileInfo) bool {
215		return SameFileState(left, right) && samePlatformState(left, right)
216	}
217	
218	func readAllContext(ctx context.Context, reader io.Reader, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
219		var data []byte
220		buffer := make([]byte, 64*1024)
221		for {
222			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
223				return nil, err
224			}
225			read, err := reader.Read(buffer)
226			if read > 0 {
227				if maxBytes > 0 && int64(read) > maxBytes-int64(len(data)) {
228					return nil, fmt.Errorf("source exceeds %d bytes: %w", maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
229				}
230				data = append(data, buffer[:read]...)
231			}
232			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
233				return data, nil
234			}
235			if err != nil {
236				return nil, err
237			}
238			if read == 0 {
239				return nil, io.ErrNoProgress
240			}
241		}
242	}
243	
244	func unsafeLink(info fs.FileInfo) bool {
245		return info != nil && (info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || isReparsePoint(info))
246	}

71	func CloseableTaskPanes(mode task.CheckoutMode, occupancy runtime.Occupancy) map[string]string {
72		eligible := make(map[string]string)
73		if mode != task.ModeWorktree || occupancy.Backend != "herdr" || occupancyObservationError(occupancy, nil) != nil {
74			return eligible
75		}

78				continue
79			}

81				if session.Runtime.Handle != agent.SessionHandle || len(session.Mixed) > 0 || runtime.WorkspaceProtection(session.Runtime, occupancy.Target) != "" {
82					continue
83				}
84				for _, pane := range session.Panes {
85					if pane.ID != agent.Activity.PaneID || pane.Agent != agent.Activity.Agent || pane.AgentStatus != agent.Status {
86						continue
87					}

89						continue
90					}

234			return nil

1	// Package lockx provides cross-platform advisory filesystem locks.
2	//
3	// It is a leaf package on purpose. Both the catalog store and Git transaction
4	// code need to serialize mutations, and neither should have to depend on the
5	// other to get a lock.
6	package lockx
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"errors"
11		"fmt"
12		"os"
13		"path/filepath"
14		"sync"
15	)
16	
17	// Lease holds one acquired directory lock until Close. Close is idempotent.
18	type Lease struct {
19		lock  *fileLock
20		label string
21		once  sync.Once
22		err   error
23	}
24	
25	// AcquireDir acquires the same cross-process lock used by WithDir. The lock file
26	// lives beside dir rather than inside it, so locking never adds a file to the
27	// directory being protected.
28	func AcquireDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string) (*Lease, error) {
29		if ctx == nil {
30			ctx = context.Background()
31		}
32		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
33			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
34		}
35		absoluteDir, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
36		if err != nil {
37			return nil, fmt.Errorf("make %s directory absolute for lock: %w", label, err)
38		}
39		canonicalDir, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(absoluteDir)
40		if err != nil {
41			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s directory for lock: %w", label, err)
42		}
43		lockPath := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(canonicalDir), "."+filepath.Base(canonicalDir)+".lock")
44		lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
45		if err != nil {
46			return nil, fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
47		}
48		return &Lease{lock: lock, label: label}, nil
49	}
50	
51	// Close releases the acquired directory lock.
52	func (l *Lease) Close() error {
53		if l == nil {
54			return nil
55		}
56		l.once.Do(func() {
57			if err := l.lock.Close(); err != nil {
58				l.err = fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", l.label, err)
59			}
60		})
61		return l.err
62	}
63	
64	// WithDir runs operation while holding an exclusive lock for dir.
65	func WithDir(ctx context.Context, dir, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
66		if operation == nil {
67			return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
68		}
69		if ctx == nil {
70			ctx = context.Background()
71		}
72		lease, err := AcquireDir(ctx, dir, label)
73		if err != nil {
74			return err
75		}
76		defer func() { err = errors.Join(err, lease.Close()) }()
77		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
78			return err
79		}
80		return operation()
81	}
82	
83	// WithFile runs operation while holding an explicit advisory lock file. Its
84	// parent must already exist; no directory is created as a side effect.
85	func WithFile(ctx context.Context, path, label string, operation func() error) (err error) {
86		if operation == nil {
87			return fmt.Errorf("%s lock requires an operation", label)
88		}
89		if ctx == nil {
90			ctx = context.Background()
91		}
92		absolutePath, err := filepath.Abs(path)
93		if err != nil {
94			return fmt.Errorf("make %s lock path absolute: %w", label, err)
95		}
96		canonicalParent, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(filepath.Dir(absolutePath))
97		if err != nil {
98			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize %s lock parent: %w", label, err)
99		}
100		lockPath := filepath.Join(canonicalParent, filepath.Base(absolutePath))
101		lock, err := acquire(ctx, lockPath)
102		if err != nil {
103			return fmt.Errorf("acquire %s lock: %w", label, err)
104		}
105		defer func() {
106			if releaseErr := lock.Close(); releaseErr != nil {
107				err = errors.Join(err, fmt.Errorf("release %s lock: %w", label, releaseErr))
108			}
109		}()
110		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
111			return err
112		}
113		return operation()
114	}

1	// Package pathx provides the path-safety checks shared by filesystem lifecycle
2	// operations. The checks are strict: a destination must be below its root, not
3	// merely share a string prefix with it, and symlinks are resolved before that
4	// decision is made.
5	package pathx
6	
7	import (
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"io/fs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"slices"
14		"strings"
15		"unicode"
16		"unicode/utf8"
17	
18		"golang.org/x/text/cases"
19		"golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm"
20	)
21	
22	var (
23		// ErrOutsideRoot reports a path that does not resolve below the requested root.
24		ErrOutsideRoot = errors.New("path is outside root")
25		// ErrRoot reports an operation that named the root itself rather than a child.
26		ErrRoot = errors.New("path is the root itself")
27		// ErrTraversal reports an explicit .. component in an unclean input path.
28		ErrTraversal = errors.New("path contains parent traversal")
29		// ErrInvalidComponent reports a value that is not one filesystem component.
30		ErrInvalidComponent = errors.New("invalid path component")
31		// ErrNotPortable reports a relative path that cannot be represented safely
32		// and with the same meaning on supported Unix and Windows filesystems.
33		ErrNotPortable = errors.New("path is not portable")
34		// ErrPathCollision reports distinct spellings that identify the same path on
35		// a case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystem.
36		ErrPathCollision = errors.New("portable path collision")
37		// ErrPathLimit reports a portable path that exceeds an explicit policy limit.
38		ErrPathLimit = errors.New("portable path limit exceeded")
39	)
40	
41	// Canonical returns an absolute, clean path with symlinks resolved. If the final
42	// path does not exist yet, it resolves the nearest existing ancestor and then
43	// appends the missing suffix. This is the form needed to validate a destination
44	// before creating or moving anything into it.
45	func Canonical(path string) (string, error) {
46		if path == "" {
47			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonical path: empty path")
48		}
49		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
50		if err != nil {
51			return "", fmt.Errorf("make %q absolute: %w", path, err)
52		}
53		absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
54	
55		probe := absolute
56		var missing []string
57		for {
58			resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(probe)
59			if err == nil {
60				slices.Reverse(missing)
61				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
62				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
63			}
64			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
65				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: %w", path, err)
66			}
67			// EvalSymlinks reports ErrNotExist both for a genuinely missing component
68			// and for a symlink whose target is missing. Treating the latter as an
69			// ordinary lexical suffix would make an escape look as though it remained
70			// below its root. Resolve the link target explicitly before appending the
71			// still-missing suffix.
72			if info, lstatErr := os.Lstat(probe); lstatErr == nil && info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
73				target, readErr := os.Readlink(probe)
74				if readErr != nil {
75					return "", fmt.Errorf("read unresolved symlink %q: %w", probe, readErr)
76				}
77				if hasParentTraversal(target) {
78					return "", fmt.Errorf("unresolved symlink %q target %q: %w", probe, target, ErrTraversal)
79				}
80				if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
81					target = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(probe), target)
82				}
83				resolved, resolveErr := Canonical(target)
84				if resolveErr != nil {
85					return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve target of %q: %w", probe, resolveErr)
86				}
87				slices.Reverse(missing)
88				parts := append([]string{resolved}, missing...)
89				return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(parts...)), nil
90			} else if lstatErr != nil && !errors.Is(lstatErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
91				return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect unresolved path %q: %w", probe, lstatErr)
92			}
93			parent := filepath.Dir(probe)
94			if parent == probe {
95				return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve %q: no existing ancestor: %w", path, err)
96			}
97			missing = append(missing, filepath.Base(probe))
98			probe = parent
99		}
100	}

102	// CanonicalChild returns candidate in canonical form when it resolves strictly
103	// below root. It rejects root itself, lexical .. traversal, sibling-prefix
104	// confusion, and paths that escape through a symlink.
105	func CanonicalChild(root, candidate string) (string, error) {
106		if hasParentTraversal(candidate) {
107			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrTraversal)
108		}
109		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
110		if err != nil {
111			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
112		}
113		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
114		if err != nil {
115			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize candidate: %w", err)
116		}
117	
118		rel, err := filepath.Rel(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
119		if err != nil {
120			// Rel only fails when the two paths cannot be expressed relative to one
121			// another — most often different Windows volumes. That is a definitive
122			// "not below root", not a filesystem error to surface.
123			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
124		}
125		switch {
126		case rel == ".":
127			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q: %w", candidate, ErrRoot)
128		case filepath.IsAbs(rel), rel == "..", strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)):
129			return "", fmt.Errorf("%q is not below %q: %w", candidate, root, ErrOutsideRoot)
130		default:
131			return canonicalCandidate, nil
132		}
133	}
134	
135	// IsChild reports whether candidate resolves strictly below root. Policy
136	// rejections are returned as false without hiding filesystem errors.
137	func IsChild(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
138		_, err := CanonicalChild(root, candidate)
139		if err == nil {
140			return true, nil
141		}
142		if errors.Is(err, ErrOutsideRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrRoot) || errors.Is(err, ErrTraversal) {
143			return false, nil
144		}
145		return false, err
146	}
147	
148	// Contains reports whether candidate is root itself or resolves below it.
149	func Contains(root, candidate string) (bool, error) {
150		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
151		if err != nil {
152			return false, err
153		}
154		canonicalCandidate, err := Canonical(candidate)
155		if err != nil {
156			return false, err
157		}
158		if canonicalRoot == canonicalCandidate {
159			return true, nil
160		}
161		return IsChild(canonicalRoot, canonicalCandidate)
162	}

164	// ValidateComponent requires a non-empty relative value containing exactly one
165	// path component. Both slash styles are rejected so state synced between Unix
166	// and Windows cannot acquire a different meaning on another host.
167	func ValidateComponent(component string) error {
168		switch {
169		case strings.TrimSpace(component) == "":
170			return fmt.Errorf("empty component: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
171		case strings.ContainsRune(component, '\x00'):
172			return fmt.Errorf("component contains NUL: %w", ErrInvalidComponent)
173		case component == "." || component == "..":
174			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is reserved: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
175		case filepath.IsAbs(component) || filepath.VolumeName(component) != "" || driveQualified(component):
176			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is absolute or drive-qualified: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
177		case strings.ContainsAny(component, `/\\`):
178			return fmt.Errorf("component %q contains a path separator: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
179		case filepath.Clean(component) != component || filepath.Base(component) != component:
180			return fmt.Errorf("component %q is not a single clean name: %w", component, ErrInvalidComponent)
181		default:
182			return nil
183		}

189	// collection of files rather than a path.
190	type PortablePathLimits struct {
191		MaxPathBytes      int
192		MaxComponentBytes int
193		MaxDepth          int

196	// ValidatePortableSlashPath accepts only a non-empty, clean, slash-separated
197	// relative path that retains exactly one meaning on Unix and Windows. It rejects
198	// Git metadata aliases, platform-specific separators and volumes, Windows
199	// device names and invalid characters, trailing dots/spaces, controls, and
200	// invalid UTF-8.
201	func ValidatePortableSlashPath(value string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
202		if limits.MaxPathBytes < 0 || limits.MaxComponentBytes < 0 || limits.MaxDepth < 0 {
203			return fmt.Errorf("negative portable path limit: %w", ErrPathLimit)
204		}
205		if !utf8.ValidString(value) {
206			return fmt.Errorf("path contains invalid UTF-8: %w", ErrNotPortable)
207		}
208		if value == "" {
209			return fmt.Errorf("path is empty: %w", ErrNotPortable)
210		}
211		if strings.ContainsRune(value, '\\') {
212			return fmt.Errorf("path contains a backslash path separator: %w", ErrNotPortable)
213		}
214		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || filepath.IsAbs(value) || filepath.VolumeName(value) != "" || driveQualified(value) {
215			return fmt.Errorf("path %q is absolute, drive-qualified, or UNC: %w", value, ErrNotPortable)
216		}
217		if limits.MaxPathBytes > 0 && len(value) > limits.MaxPathBytes {
218			return fmt.Errorf("path is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", len(value), limits.MaxPathBytes, ErrPathLimit)
219		}
220		components := strings.Split(value, "/")
221		if limits.MaxDepth > 0 && len(components) > limits.MaxDepth {
222			return fmt.Errorf("path has %d components; maximum is %d: %w", len(components), limits.MaxDepth, ErrPathLimit)
223		}
224		for _, component := range components {
225			if component == ".." {
226				return fmt.Errorf("path contains parent traversal: %w", ErrTraversal)
227			}
228			if err := ValidatePortableComponent(component, limits.MaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
229				return fmt.Errorf("path component %q: %w", component, err)
230			}
231		}
232		return nil
233	}

251			return fmt.Errorf("path component contains control characters: %w", ErrNotPortable)
252		}
253		windowsAlias := strings.TrimRight(component, ". ")
254		if strings.EqualFold(windowsAlias, ".git") {
255			return fmt.Errorf("path contains reserved Git metadata: %w", ErrNotPortable)
256		}
257		if windowsAlias != component {
258			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q has a trailing dot or space and is not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
259		}
260		if strings.ContainsAny(component, `<>:"|?*`) {
261			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q contains characters that are not portable to Windows: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
262		}
263		if windowsReservedName(component) {
264			return fmt.Errorf("path component %q is a reserved Windows device name: %w", component, ErrNotPortable)
265		}
266		return nil
267	}
268	
269	// ValidatePortablePathSet validates every path and rejects collisions at any
270	// component boundary after Unicode normalization and full Unicode case folding.
271	// Exact duplicate paths are left to the caller's type/cardinality policy.
272	func ValidatePortablePathSet(paths []string, limits PortablePathLimits) error {
273		type collisionNode struct {
274			spelling string
275			first    string
276			children map[string]*collisionNode
277		}
278		root := &collisionNode{children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
279		for _, value := range paths {
280			if err := ValidatePortableSlashPath(value, limits); err != nil {
281				return fmt.Errorf("portable path %q: %w", value, err)
282			}
283			current := root
284			for _, component := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
285				key := portableCollisionKey(component)
286				next, exists := current.children[key]
287				if exists && next.spelling != component {
288					return fmt.Errorf("paths %q and %q collide on case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing filesystems at %q and %q: %w",
289						next.first, value, next.spelling, component, ErrPathCollision)
290				}
291				if !exists {
292					next = &collisionNode{spelling: component, first: value, children: map[string]*collisionNode{}}
293					current.children[key] = next
294				}
295				current = next
296			}
297		}
298		return nil
299	}
300	
301	func portableCollisionKey(component string) string {
302		return norm.NFC.String(cases.Fold().String(norm.NFC.String(component)))
303	}
304	
305	func isPortableControl(r rune) bool {
306		return unicode.IsControl(r) || unicode.Is(unicode.Cf, r)
307	}
308	
309	func windowsReservedName(component string) bool {
310		base := component
311		if dot := strings.IndexByte(base, '.'); dot >= 0 {
312			base = base[:dot]
313		}
314		base = strings.TrimRight(base, " ")
315		upper := strings.ToUpper(base)
316		switch upper {
317		case "CON", "PRN", "AUX", "NUL", "CONIN$", "CONOUT$", "CLOCK$":
318			return true
319		}
320		if len([]rune(upper)) != 4 {
321			return false
322		}
323		runes := []rune(upper)
324		prefix := string(runes[:3])
325		if prefix != "COM" && prefix != "LPT" {
326			return false
327		}
328		last := runes[3]
329		return last >= '1' && last <= '9' || last == '¹' || last == '²' || last == '³'
330	}
331	
332	// JoinChild validates every component, joins it below root, and returns the
333	// canonical destination. It is suitable for paths such as
334	// <project-root>/<category>/<name>, where each user-supplied value must remain a
335	// single component.
336	func JoinChild(root string, components ...string) (string, error) {
337		if len(components) == 0 {
338			return "", fmt.Errorf("join child: no components: %w", ErrRoot)
339		}
340		for i, component := range components {
341			if err := ValidateComponent(component); err != nil {
342				return "", fmt.Errorf("component %d: %w", i, err)
343			}
344		}
345		canonicalRoot, err := Canonical(root)
346		if err != nil {
347			return "", fmt.Errorf("canonicalize root: %w", err)
348		}
349		return CanonicalChild(canonicalRoot, filepath.Join(append([]string{canonicalRoot}, components...)...))
350	}
351	
352	func driveQualified(component string) bool {
353		if len(component) < 2 || component[1] != ':' {
354			return false
355		}
356		letter := component[0]
357		return letter >= 'a' && letter <= 'z' || letter >= 'A' && letter <= 'Z'
358	}
359	
360	func hasParentTraversal(path string) bool {
361		for _, component := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool {
362			return r == '/' || r == '\\'
363		}) {
364			if component == ".." {
365				return true
366			}
367		}
368		return false
369	}
370

func emptyRemovalFixture(t *testing.T, gitlink string) (config.Config, *gittest.Repo, string, string) {
	t.Helper()
	t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL", os.DevNull)
	t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM", os.DevNull)
	t.Setenv("GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL", "file")
	parent := gittest.New(t)
	if gitlink != "" {
		child := gittest.New(t)
		parent.Git("submodule", "add", child.Root, gitlink)
		parent.Git("commit", "-am", "test: empty gitlink cleanup")
	}
	root := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "empty-worktree")
	if err := gitx.AddWorktree(t.Context(), parent.Root, root, "empty-worktree", "HEAD"); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	repo, err := gitx.Discover(t.Context(), root)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	cfg := config.Default()
	cfg.Paths.StateDir = t.TempDir()
	return cfg, parent, root, filepath.Join(repo.GitDir, "modules")
}

func TestCleanupRegressionSubmoduleNeverInitialized(t *testing.T) {
	for _, childState := range []string{"absent", "empty"} {
		for _, storage := range []string{"absent", "empty", "scaffolding"} {
			t.Run(childState+"-"+storage, func(t *testing.T) {
				cfg, parent, root, modules := emptyRemovalFixture(t, "child")
				if childState == "absent" {
					if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(root, "child")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				}
				if storage != "absent" {
					path := modules
					if storage == "scaffolding" { path = filepath.Join(modules, "unused", "nested") }
					if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
					if err := gitx.RemoveWorktree(t.Context(), parent.Root, root, false); err == nil { t.Fatal("ordinary modules-root guard weakened") }
				}
				preview, err := submodule.InspectRemoval(t.Context(), cfg, root, false, false)
				if err == nil || preview == nil || preview.LayoutFingerprint == "" { t.Fatalf("missing recursive/layout gate: %+v %v", preview, err) }
				if err := preview.VerifyRemote(t.Context()); err == nil { t.Fatal("non-consented observation authorized remote proof") }
				called := false
				if err := preview.Apply(t.Context(), nil, func() error { called = true; return nil }); err == nil || called { t.Fatal("non-consented observation authorized cleanup") }
				p, err := submodule.InspectRemoval(t.Context(), cfg, root, true, false)
				if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				if p.LayoutFingerprint != preview.LayoutFingerprint || p.InitializedCount() != 0 { t.Fatal("consent changed local layout authority") }
				// No child network, temporary proof repository or quarantine is needed.
				t.Setenv("GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL", "none")
				proofTemp := t.TempDir()
				t.Setenv("TMPDIR", proofTemp)
				t.Setenv("TMP", proofTemp)
				t.Setenv("TEMP", proofTemp)
				if err := p.VerifyRemote(t.Context()); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				checks := 0
				if err := p.Apply(t.Context(), func(context.Context, string) error { checks++; return nil }, func() error {
					return gitx.RemoveWorktree(t.Context(), parent.Root, root, false)
				}); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				if checks == 0 { t.Fatal("zero-child final callback omitted") }
				if _, err := os.Lstat(root); !os.IsNotExist(err) { t.Fatalf("outer remains: %v", err) }
				if !gitx.BranchExists(t.Context(), parent.Root, "empty-worktree") { t.Fatal("outer branch deleted") }
				entries, err := os.ReadDir(proofTemp)
				if err != nil || len(entries) != 0 { t.Fatalf("all-empty cleanup created proof data: %v %v", entries, err) }
				areas, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(root), ".dev-submodule-retirement-*"))
				if len(areas) != 0 { t.Fatalf("all-empty cleanup quarantined data: %v", areas) }
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestCleanupRegressionSubmoduleZeroGitlinksStorage(t *testing.T) {
	for _, storage := range []string{"absent", "empty", "scaffolding", "orphan"} {
		t.Run(storage, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg, parent, root, modules := emptyRemovalFixture(t, "")
			if storage != "absent" {
				path := modules
				if storage == "scaffolding" || storage == "orphan" { path = filepath.Join(modules, "old", "nested") }
				if err := os.MkdirAll(path, 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				if storage == "orphan" {
					if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(path, "HEAD"), []byte("keep"), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				}
			}
			preview, previewErr := submodule.InspectRemoval(t.Context(), cfg, root, false, false)
			if storage == "absent" {
				if preview != nil || previewErr != nil { t.Fatalf("absent should be no-op: %+v %v", preview, previewErr) }
				return
			}
			if previewErr == nil { t.Fatal("administration cleanup implicitly authorized") }
			p, err := submodule.InspectRemoval(t.Context(), cfg, root, true, false)
			if storage == "orphan" {
				if err == nil { t.Fatal("orphan data accepted") }
				if p != nil {
					if err := p.VerifyRemote(t.Context()); err == nil { t.Fatal("incomplete observation authorized proof") }
					called := false
					if err := p.Apply(t.Context(), nil, func() error { called = true; return nil }); err == nil || called { t.Fatal("incomplete observation authorized cleanup") }
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil || p == nil { t.Fatalf("scaffolding rejected: %v", err) }
			if err := p.VerifyRemote(t.Context()); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			if err := p.Apply(t.Context(), nil, func() error { return gitx.RemoveWorktree(t.Context(), parent.Root, root, false) }); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		})
	}
}

func TestCleanupRegressionSubmoduleEmptyUnsafeData(t *testing.T) {

					if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, ".gitignore"), []byte("child/keep\n"), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				}
				if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(child, "keep"), []byte("keep"), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

				if err := os.Mkdir(filepath.Join(child, "user-directory"), 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

				if err := p.Apply(t.Context(), nil, func() error { called = true; return nil }); err == nil || called { t.Fatal("unsafe nonnil plan authorized effects") }
			}
		})
	}
}

	for _, kind := range []string{"new-file", "new-directory", "empty-replaced", "absent-present", "ancestor-present", "ancestor-replaced", "initialized", "root-replaced", "admin-replaced", "admin-added", "symlink"} {

			}
			if kind == "ancestor-present" {
				if err := os.RemoveAll(filepath.Join(root, "deps")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }

			switch kind {
			case "new-file": err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(child, "keep"), []byte("keep"), 0600)
			case "new-directory": err = os.Mkdir(filepath.Join(child, "keep"), 0700)
			case "empty-replaced", "admin-replaced", "root-replaced", "ancestor-replaced":
				path := child
				if kind == "admin-replaced" { path = modules }
				if kind == "root-replaced" { path = root }
				if kind == "ancestor-replaced" { path = filepath.Dir(child) }
				if err := os.Rename(path, path+"-original"); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				err = os.Mkdir(path, 0700)
			case "absent-present": err = os.Mkdir(child, 0700)

		})
	}
}

11	func TestCleanupRegressionEmptyDirectoryRemoval(t *testing.T) {
12		for _, kind := range []string{"empty", "nonempty", "file", "replaced-directory", "symlink", "cancelled"} {
13			t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
14				base := t.TempDir()
15				path := filepath.Join(base, "child")
16				if err := os.Mkdir(path, 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
17				root, _, err := OpenRoot(base)
18				if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
19				defer root.Close()
20				expected, err := root.Lstat("child")
21				if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
22				ctx := t.Context()
23				switch kind {
24				case "nonempty":
25					if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(path, "keep"), []byte("keep"), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
26				case "file", "replaced-directory", "symlink":
27					if err := os.Rename(path, filepath.Join(base, "original")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
28					switch kind {
29					case "file": err = os.WriteFile(path, []byte("keep"), 0600)
30					case "replaced-directory": err = os.Mkdir(path, 0700)
31					case "symlink":
32						err = os.Symlink(t.TempDir(), path)
33						if err != nil { t.Skipf("symlink creation unavailable: %v", err) }
34					}
35					if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
36				case "cancelled":
37					var cancel context.CancelFunc
38					ctx, cancel = context.WithCancel(ctx)
39					cancel()
40				}
41				err = RemoveEmptyChildDir(ctx, root, "child", expected)
42				if kind == "empty" {
43					if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
44					if _, err := os.Lstat(path); !os.IsNotExist(err) { t.Fatalf("directory remains: %v", err) }
45				} else {
46					if err == nil { t.Fatalf("accepted %s", kind) }
47					if _, err := os.Lstat(path); err != nil { t.Fatalf("removed protected path: %v", err) }
48				}
49			})
50		}
51	}

69	// The backend's final context check provides a deterministic external-writer
70	// interleaving immediately after identity checks and before native deletion.
71	// Value intentionally does not expose an embedded cancelCtx to context.Cause.
72	type directoryMutationContext struct {
73		context.Context
74		mutate func()
75	}
76	func (c *directoryMutationContext) Value(any) any { return nil }
77	func (c *directoryMutationContext) Err() error {
78		if c.mutate != nil {
79			mutate := c.mutate
80			c.mutate = nil
81			mutate()
82		}
83		return nil
84	}

94				defer root.Close()
95				expected, err := root.Lstat("child")
96				if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
97				mutated := false
98				ctx := &directoryMutationContext{Context: context.Background(), mutate: func() {
99					mutated = true
100					if kind == "file" {
101						if err := os.Rename(path, filepath.Join(base, "reviewed")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
102						if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("keep"), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
103					} else if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(path, "keep"), []byte("keep"), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
104				}}

106				if !mutated { t.Fatalf("native deletion did not reach the race boundary: %v", err) }

113				if readErr != nil || string(data) != "keep" { t.Fatalf("late file was removed: %q %v (delete: %v)", data, readErr, err) }
114			})

44		if err := validateRecordIdentity(request.Locator, *record); err != nil {
45			return PlanSpec{}, err

47		spec, _, err := s.observeRetire(ctx, request, *record, s.tasks.ListRecords)
48		if err != nil {

50		}
51		current, err := s.tasks.GetRecord(request.Locator.TaskID)

54		}
55		if current.Revision != record.Revision {

11	const SchemaVersion = 1
12	
13	type Status string
14	
15	const (
16		Armed      Status = "armed"
17		Finalizing Status = "finalizing"
18		Finalized  Status = "finalized"
19		Failed     Status = "failed"
20		// Discarded records an operator's explicit decision that an intent can
21		// never be finalized — its transcript is gone, or its HEAD no longer
22		// exists. It is deliberately distinct from Finalized: nothing was
23		// committed, and the record survives to say so.
24		Discarded Status = "discarded"
25	)

27	// Intent is a durable handoff from an active agent to an external finalizer.
28	type Intent struct {
29		SchemaVersion      int      `json:"schema_version"`
30		ID                 string   `json:"id"`
31		RunID              string   `json:"run_id"`
32		Provider           string   `json:"provider"`

38		Branch             string   `json:"branch"`
39		Base               string   `json:"base,omitempty"`
40		Head               string   `json:"head"`
41		PlanPaths          []string `json:"plan_paths,omitempty"`
42		UnrelatedArtifacts []string `json:"unrelated_artifacts,omitempty"`
43		AllowLarge         bool     `json:"allow_large,omitempty"`
44		Destination        string   `json:"destination,omitempty"`
45		ArchivePolicy      string   `json:"archive_policy,omitempty"`
46		ArchiveStateDir    string   `json:"archive_state_dir,omitempty"`
47		ArchivePlanID      string   `json:"archive_plan_id,omitempty"`
48		ArchiveCommit      string   `json:"archive_commit,omitempty"`
49	
50		Status         Status    `json:"status"`
51		TranscriptPath string    `json:"transcript_path,omitempty"`
52		ArtifactCommit string    `json:"artifact_commit,omitempty"`
53		FailureCode    string    `json:"failure_code,omitempty"`
54		SessionEndedAt time.Time `json:"session_ended_at,omitempty"`
55		CreatedAt      time.Time `json:"created_at"`

59	var (

61		sessionPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+:[0-9a-fA-F-]{16,}$`)

64	func (i Intent) Validate() error {
65		if i.Destination != "" && i.Destination != "archive" {
66			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported artifact destination")
67		}
68		if i.Destination == "archive" && (i.ArchiveStateDir == "" || i.ArchivePolicy == "") {
69			return fmt.Errorf("archive intent lacks policy/state binding")

77			return fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact run id %q", i.RunID)
78		case i.Provider == "" || i.SessionID == "":
79			return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent needs provider and session id")
80		case i.RepoPath == "" || i.WorktreePath == "" || i.GitCommonDir == "":
81			return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent needs repository, worktree and git common-dir paths")
82		case i.Branch == "" || i.Head == "":
83			return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent needs branch and head")
84		}
85		if !sessionPattern.MatchString(i.Provider + ":" + i.SessionID) {
86			return fmt.Errorf("invalid agent session %q", i.Provider+":"+i.SessionID)
87		}
88		switch i.Status {
89		case Armed, Finalizing, Finalized, Failed, Discarded:
90			return nil
91		default:
92			return fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent status %q", i.Status)
93		}
94	}
95	
96	func ParseSession(value string) (provider, sessionID string, err error) {
97		provider, sessionID, ok := strings.Cut(strings.TrimSpace(value), ":")
98		provider = strings.ToLower(provider)
99		if !ok || !sessionPattern.MatchString(provider+":"+sessionID) {
100			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("invalid session %q: want provider:uuid", value)
101		}
102		return provider, sessionID, nil
103	}

95	func (s *Store) List() ([]Intent, error) {
96		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)

98			return nil, nil
99		}

101			return nil, err

103		var intents []Intent
104		for _, entry := range entries {

106				continue
107			}
108			intent, err := s.Get(strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json"))
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			intents = append(intents, *intent)
113		}
114		sort.Slice(intents, func(i, j int) bool { return intents[i].CreatedAt.Before(intents[j].CreatedAt) })
115		return intents, nil
116	}

132		if mutate == nil {

134		}
135		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
136			intent, err := s.Get(id)
137			if err != nil {
138				return err
139			}
140			if err := mutate(intent); err != nil {
141				return err
142			}
143			intent.UpdatedAt = s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
144			if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
145				return err
146			}
147			return s.write(*intent)
148		})

151	func (s *Store) write(intent Intent) error {
152		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o700); err != nil {
153			return err
154		}
155		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(s.Dir, ".intent-*.tmp")
156		if err != nil {
157			return err
158		}
159		name := tmp.Name()
160		defer os.Remove(name)
161		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
162			tmp.Close()
163			return err
164		}
165		encoder := json.NewEncoder(tmp)
166		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
167		if err := encoder.Encode(intent); err != nil {
168			tmp.Close()
169			return err
170		}
171		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
172			tmp.Close()
173			return err
174		}

242	// MoveWorktree relocates a linked worktree through Git so the shared
243	// administrative metadata keeps pointing at the checkout's new path. dir may
244	// be any checkout of the same repository.
245	func MoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, source, destination string) error {

250	// RemoveWorktree removes a linked worktree checkout. It never deletes the
251	// branch — that is a separate, explicit decision.
252	func RemoveWorktree(ctx context.Context, dir, path string, force bool) error {
253		// A generic force flag never authorizes deleting a child repository's
254		// refs/objects. The recursive lifecycle stages those only after proof.
255		if _, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil {
256			g, err := SubmodulesOf(ctx, path)
257			if err != nil {
258				return err
259			}
260			for _, n := range g.Nodes {
261				if n.Initialized || n.State != "uninitialized" {
262					return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s requires guarded --recursive cleanup", n.Path)
263				}
264			}
265			if r, err := Discover(ctx, path); err == nil {
266				if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(r.GitDir, "modules")); err == nil {
267					return errors.New("private submodule Git data requires guarded --recursive cleanup")
268				}
269			}
270		}
271		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
272		if err != nil {
273			return fmt.Errorf("resolve current directory before removing worktree: %w", err)
274		}
275		inside, err := pathx.Contains(path, cwd)
276		if err != nil {
277			return fmt.Errorf("compare current directory with worktree %s: %w", path, err)
278		}
279		if inside {
280			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to remove worktree %s while the caller is inside it", path)
281		}
282		args := []string{"worktree", "remove"}
283		if force {
284			args = append(args, "--force")
285		}
286		args = append(args, path)
287		_, err = run(ctx, dir, args...)
288		return err
289	}

302		}

307	// RefState reports whether any ref or commit-ish resolves while preserving
308	// observation failures. A normal rev-parse exit 1 with no diagnostic is an
309	// authoritative missing ref; every other failure remains an error.
310	func RefState(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) (bool, error) {
311		if ref == "" {
312			return false, nil
313		}
314		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", ref+"^{commit}")
315		if err == nil {
316			return true, nil
317		}
318		var commandErr *Error
319		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
320		if errors.As(err, &commandErr) && errors.As(commandErr.Err, &exitErr) &&
321			exitErr.ExitCode() == 1 && strings.TrimSpace(commandErr.Stderr) == "" {
322			return false, nil
323		}
324		return false, err
325	}
326	
327	// RefExists is the compatibility predicate for callers where probe failure is
328	// intentionally equivalent to absence. Guarded lifecycle code uses RefState.
329	func RefExists(ctx context.Context, dir, ref string) bool {
330		exists, _ := RefState(ctx, dir, ref)
331		return exists
332	}

657	func (e *executionState) executeRetire(ctx context.Context, record task.Record, baseline destructiveObservation) (Result, error) {
658		options := e.plan.Request.Options.(RetireOptions)
659		candidate := record.Task
660		mode := candidate.EffectiveMode()

671					return e.fail(err, "refresh retirement before closing any runtime")
672				}
673				baseline = fresh
674				err = e.run(effect, func() (string, error) {
675					inspection, closeErr := e.service.closeAndWait(ctx, baseline.runtime, baseline.checkout, retire.Options{

677						CloseUnknown: options.CloseUnknown, AssumeNoRuntime: options.AssumeNoRuntime, Timeout: options.Timeout,
678						ProcessClosures: options.ProcessClosures.Map(),

682					}

684				})

687					return e.fail(err, "the task and checkout remain; inspect runtime occupancy before retrying")
688				}
689				fresh, err = e.reinspectRetire(ctx, record, baseline, true)
690				if err != nil {

package submodule_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/config"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/gitx/gittest"
	"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/submodule"
)

func mixedRemovalFixture(t *testing.T, nested bool) (config.Config, *gittest.Repo, string, string) {
	t.Helper()
	t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL", os.DevNull)
	t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM", os.DevNull)
	t.Setenv("GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL", "file")
	leaf, child, parent := gittest.New(t), gittest.New(t), gittest.New(t)
	empty := "empty"
	if nested {
		child.Git("submodule", "add", leaf.Root, "empty")
		child.Git("commit", "-am", "test: nested empty gitlink")
		empty = "child/empty"
	} else {
		parent.Git("submodule", "add", leaf.Root, "empty")
	}
	parent.Git("submodule", "add", child.Root, "child")
	parent.Git("commit", "-am", "test: mixed gitlinks")
	root := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "mixed")
	if err := gitx.AddWorktree(t.Context(), parent.Root, root, "mixed", "HEAD"); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	// Initialize exactly the outer child, not its nested leaf or sibling.
	if _, err := gitx.Run(t.Context(), root, "-c", "submodule.child.url="+child.Root, "-c", "submodule.child.active=true", "submodule", "update", "--init", "--checkout", "--", "child"); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	cfg := config.Default()
	cfg.Paths.StateDir = t.TempDir()
	return cfg, parent, root, filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(empty))
}

func TestCleanupRegressionSubmoduleMixedInitializedEmptyRollback(t *testing.T) {
	for _, nested := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "siblings"
		if nested { name = "nested" }
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg, parent, root, empty := mixedRemovalFixture(t, nested)
			before, err := os.Stat(empty)
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			p, err := submodule.InspectRemoval(t.Context(), cfg, root, true, false)
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			if len(p.Graph.Nodes) != 2 || p.InitializedCount() != 1 { t.Fatalf("wrong initialized subset: %+v", p.Graph) }
			if err := p.VerifyRemote(t.Context()); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			cause := errors.New("outer failed")
			if err := p.Apply(t.Context(), nil, func() error { return cause }); !errors.Is(err, cause) { t.Fatalf("rollback: %v", err) }
			after, err := os.Stat(empty)
			if err != nil || !os.SameFile(before, after) { t.Fatalf("empty child not retained exactly: %v", err) }
			g, err := gitx.SubmodulesOf(t.Context(), root)
			if err != nil || len(g.Nodes) != 2 || !g.Nodes[0].Initialized { t.Fatalf("initialized clone not restored: %+v %v", g, err) }
			// Lease creation/closure is intentionally not a user layout change.
			fresh, err := submodule.InspectRemoval(t.Context(), cfg, root, true, false)
			if err != nil || fresh.LayoutFingerprint != p.LayoutFingerprint { t.Fatalf("lease/rollback changed layout authority: %v", err) }
			if err := fresh.VerifyRemote(t.Context()); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			if err := fresh.Apply(t.Context(), nil, func() error { return gitx.RemoveWorktree(t.Context(), parent.Root, root, false) }); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			if _, err := os.Stat(root); !os.IsNotExist(err) { t.Fatal("mixed outer remains", err) }
		})
	}
}

func TestCleanupRegressionSubmoduleMixedLateEmptyData(t *testing.T) {
	for _, nested := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "siblings"
		if nested { name = "nested" }
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg, _, root, empty := mixedRemovalFixture(t, nested)
			p, err := submodule.InspectRemoval(t.Context(), cfg, root, true, false)
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			if err := p.VerifyRemote(t.Context()); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			called := false
			err = p.Apply(t.Context(), func(context.Context, string) error {
				return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(empty, "keep"), []byte("keep"), 0600)
			}, func() error { called = true; return nil })
			if err == nil || called { t.Fatalf("late empty-child data accepted: %v", err) }
			data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(empty, "keep"))
			if err != nil || string(data) != "keep" { t.Fatal("late data removed", err) }
			if _, err := gitx.Discover(t.Context(), filepath.Join(root, "child")); err != nil { t.Fatal("initialized child moved before revalidation", err) }
			areas, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(root), ".dev-submodule-retirement-*"))
			if len(areas) != 0 { t.Fatal("late data caused staging", areas) }
		})
	}
}

func TestCleanupRegressionSubmoduleDeinitializedRetainedStore(t *testing.T) {
	cfg, _, _, root := removalFixture(t)
	child := filepath.Join(root, "child")
	// Test-only deinitialization: retain every private Git byte but remove the
	// disposable fixture checkout. Empty is unsafe when its clone still exists.
	if err := os.RemoveAll(child); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if err := os.Mkdir(child, 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if _, err := submodule.InspectRemoval(t.Context(), cfg, root, true, false); err == nil { t.Fatal("deinitialized retained store was treated as empty") }
}

func TestCleanupRegressionSubmoduleMixedRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	cfg, parent, root, _ := mixedRemovalFixture(t, true)
	p, err := submodule.InspectRemoval(t.Context(), cfg, root, true, false)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if err := p.VerifyRemote(t.Context()); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	func() {
		defer func() { if recover() == nil { t.Error("interruption not reached") } }()
		_ = p.Apply(t.Context(), nil, func() error {
			if err := gitx.RemoveWorktree(t.Context(), parent.Root, root, false); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			panic("fixture interruption after outer removal")
		})
	}()
	journals, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(root), ".dev-submodule-retirement-*", "journal.json"))
	if err != nil || len(journals) != 1 { t.Fatalf("journal missing: %v %v", journals, err) }
	if err := submodule.Recover(t.Context(), journals[0], nil, false); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	g, err := gitx.SubmodulesOf(t.Context(), root)
	if err != nil || len(g.Nodes) != 2 || !g.Nodes[0].Initialized || g.Nodes[1].Initialized { t.Fatalf("mixed recovery: %+v %v", g, err) }
}

35	// NewService copies handlers so later mutation of the caller's map cannot

37	func NewService(handlers Handlers) *Service {
38		copied := make(map[Action]Handler, len(handlers))
39		for action, handler := range handlers {
40			copied[action] = handler
41		}
42		return &Service{handlers: copied}
43	}

49		if s == nil || s.locateTask == nil {
50			return Locator{}, ErrLocatorUnavailable
51		}
52		return s.locateTask(ctx, taskID)
53	}

55	// Plan validates and freezes a request, delegates action-specific observations,
56	// then centrally builds the immutable plan.
57	func (s *Service) Plan(ctx context.Context, request Request) (Plan, error) {
58		normalized, err := normalizeRequest(request)
59		if err != nil {
60			return Plan{}, err
61		}
62		handler, ok := s.handlers[normalized.Action]
63		if !ok || handler.Plan == nil {
64			return Plan{}, &HandlerUnavailableError{Action: normalized.Action, Stage: "plan"}
65		}
66		spec, err := handler.Plan(ctx, normalized.Clone())
67		if err != nil {
68			return Plan{}, err
69		}
70		return BuildPlan(normalized, spec)
71	}

77		frozen := plan.Clone()
