181	// NewLifecycleService installs the concrete guarded parking, resume, and
182	// completion handlers. Actions without complete policy implementations remain
183	// unavailable rather than falling back to an unsafe generic executor.
184	func NewLifecycleService(input LifecycleConfig) (*Service, error) {
185		implementation, err := newLifecycleImplementation(input)
186		if err != nil {
187			return nil, err
188		}
189		service := NewService(Handlers{
190			ParkWarm:       implementation.handler(ParkWarm),
191			ParkCold:       implementation.handler(ParkCold),
192			Resume:         implementation.handler(Resume),
193			CompleteDirect: implementation.handler(CompleteDirect),
194			CompleteFF:     implementation.handler(CompleteFF),
195			ReviewHandoff:  implementation.handler(ReviewHandoff),
196			VerifyMerged:   implementation.handler(VerifyMerged),
197			Retire:         implementation.retireHandler(),
198			Adopt:          implementation.adoptHandler(),
199			RemoveCheckout: implementation.removeCheckoutHandler(),
200			RefreshRemote:  implementation.refreshRemoteHandler(),
201		})
202		service.locateTask = implementation.locateExactTask
203		return service, nil
204	}
205	
206	func newLifecycleImplementation(input LifecycleConfig) (*lifecycleService, error) {
207		if input.Tasks == nil {
208			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle service requires a task store")
209		}
210		if input.Artifacts == nil {
211			return nil, errors.New("taskflow lifecycle service requires an artifact store")
212		}
213		if err := input.Config.Validate(); err != nil {
214			return nil, fmt.Errorf("taskflow lifecycle config: %w", err)
215		}
216	
217		host := strings.TrimSpace(input.Host)
218		if host == "" {
219			host = config.Hostname()
220		}

583	func effectCodes(plan Plan) []EffectCode {

592	func mustGitCommand(t *testing.T, dir string, args ...string) string {
593		t.Helper()
594		var command *exec.Cmd
595		if len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "init" && len(args) >= 3 && args[1] == "--bare" {
596			command = exec.Command("git", args...)
597			command.Dir = dir
598		} else if len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "init" && len(args) >= 3 && args[1] == "-b" {
599			command = exec.Command("git", args...)
600			command.Dir = dir
601		} else {
602			commandArgs := append([]string{"-C", dir}, args...)
603			command = exec.Command("git", commandArgs...)
604		}
605		output, err := command.CombinedOutput()
606		if err != nil {
607			t.Fatalf("git in %s %s: %v\n%s", dir, strings.Join(args, " "), err, output)
608		}
609		return strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
610	}

		DefaultRuntime: func() runtime.Runtime { return rt }, NamedRuntime: func(string) runtime.Runtime { return rt },
		Host: "test-host", CWD: f.root, CallerWorkspaceID: "test-caller-workspace", CallerPaneID: "test-caller-pane",

func TestCleanupRegressionSubmoduleEmptyRetirementAndConsentPreview(t *testing.T) {
	for _, state := range []string{"empty", "absent", "scaffolding"} {
		t.Run(state, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := emptySubmoduleLifecycleFixture(t)
			if state == "absent" {
				if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(f.worktree, "child")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			}
			if state == "scaffolding" {
				repo, err := gitx.Discover(t.Context(), f.worktree)
				if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(repo.GitDir, "modules", "old", "empty"), 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			}
			preview, err := f.service.Plan(t.Context(), f.request(t, RetireOptions{}))
			if err != nil || preview.Availability == AvailabilityReady { t.Fatalf("recursive consent missing: %v %+v", err, preview.Conditions()) }
			authority := RetirementPreviewAuthority(preview)
			if authority.Map()["submodule-removal"] == "" { t.Fatal("preview omitted empty layout authority") }
			p, err := f.service.Plan(t.Context(), f.request(t, RetireOptions{Recursive: true, PreviewAuthority: authority}))
			if err != nil || p.Availability != AvailabilityReady { t.Fatalf("unchanged consent preview stale: %v %+v", err, p.Conditions()) }
			for _, effect := range p.Effects() {
				if effect.Code == effectVerifySubmodules && effect.Network { t.Fatal("empty local observation mislabeled as network proof") }
			}
			t.Setenv("GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL", "none")
			result, err := f.service.Apply(t.Context(), p, Approve(p.PlanID))
			if err != nil || result.Milestone != MilestoneRetired || result.PartialSuccess { t.Fatalf("retire empty: %v %+v", err, result) }
			if _, err := f.tasks.Get(f.record.Task.ID); !errors.Is(err, task.ErrNotFound) { t.Fatal("task not retired", err) }
			if _, err := os.Stat(f.worktree); !os.IsNotExist(err) { t.Fatal("outer remains", err) }
		})
	}
}

func TestCleanupRegressionSubmodulePreviewBindsAbsentAndEmptyIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mutation := range []string{"absence-presence", "replace-empty", "new-admin"} {
		t.Run(mutation, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := emptySubmoduleLifecycleFixture(t)
			child := filepath.Join(f.worktree, "child")
			if mutation == "absence-presence" {
				if err := os.Remove(child); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			}
			preview, err := f.service.Plan(t.Context(), f.request(t, RetireOptions{}))
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			before := mustGitCommand(t, f.worktree, "status", "--porcelain")
			switch mutation {
			case "absence-presence":
				if err := os.Mkdir(child, 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			case "replace-empty":
				if err := os.Rename(child, filepath.Join(f.root, "old-empty")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				if err := os.Mkdir(child, 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			case "new-admin":
				repo, err := gitx.Discover(t.Context(), f.worktree)
				if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				if err := os.Mkdir(filepath.Join(repo.GitDir, "modules"), 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			}
			if after := mustGitCommand(t, f.worktree, "status", "--porcelain"); before != after { t.Fatal("fixture changed parent status") }
			p, err := f.service.Plan(t.Context(), f.request(t, RetireOptions{Recursive: true, PreviewAuthority: RetirementPreviewAuthority(preview)}))
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			c, exists := conditionByCode(p, "retirement-preview-current")
			if !exists || c.Verdict != VerdictBlocked || !strings.Contains(c.Evidence, "submodule-removal") { t.Fatalf("changed layout consent accepted: %+v", p.Conditions()) }
		})
	}
}

func TestCleanupRegressionSubmoduleEmptyArtifactClaims(t *testing.T) {
	for _, scope := range []string{"exact", "subtree", "source", "unrelated"} {
		for _, status := range []artifact.Status{artifact.Armed, artifact.Finalized, artifact.Discarded} {
			t.Run(scope+"-"+string(status), func(t *testing.T) {
				f := emptySubmoduleLifecycleFixture(t)
				child := filepath.Join(f.worktree, "child")
				checkout, source := child, f.repo
				switch scope {
				case "subtree": checkout = filepath.Join(child, "nested", "missing")
				case "source": checkout, source = filepath.Join(f.root, "other"), child
				case "unrelated": checkout = filepath.Join(f.root, "unrelated")
				}
				impl := submoduleTestImplementation(t, f, LifecycleHooks{InspectArtifacts: func(context.Context, *artifact.Store, string) (artifact.ReadinessInspection, error) {
					t.Fatal("Git artifact readiness called for empty child")
					return artifact.ReadinessInspection{}, nil
				}})
				g, err := gitx.SubmodulesOf(t.Context(), f.worktree)
				if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				before, err := impl.submoduleClaims(t.Context(), g, f.record.Task.ID)
				if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
				emptySubmoduleIntent(t, f, checkout, source, status)
				after, err := impl.submoduleClaims(t.Context(), g, f.record.Task.ID)
				blocked := scope != "unrelated" && status != artifact.Discarded
				if (err != nil) != blocked { t.Fatalf("claims blocked=%t error=%v", blocked, err) }
				if scope == "unrelated" && before != after { t.Fatal("unrelated intent changed child authority") }
				if scope != "unrelated" && before == after { t.Fatal("matching intent (including discarded) omitted from authority") }
			})
		}
	}
}

Base directory for this skill: /Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/dev-cli/.claude/skills/agent-history-hygiene

# Agent history hygiene

Preserve selected agent evidence under the repository's chosen policy. Read
`dev help ai-artifacts` and `dev artifact status` when supported: source tracking,
external archive, protection and distribution are separate choices. Commit
reviewed project knowledge; do not force-add raw history under archive/unmanaged
policy. Verify repository protection from the effective hook chain.

## Prefer the shared dev workflow

When the installed dev supports `hygiene`, use its domain for setup, scans,
private rules and reviewed text changes:

```bash
dev hygiene status
dev hygiene setup --json
dev hygiene setup --apply --plan <id> --yes
dev hygiene scan --scope staged --json
dev hygiene scan --scope history --audit --timeout 40m --json
```

`pre-commit` and `gitleaks` are needed for this repository hook recipe. An explicitly unscanned archive copy needs neither. A global `core.hooksPath` can be
correct, but its script may skip all checks when repository configs are absent.
The shared setup preserves existing hooks/comments and refuses an unverified
chain. Repository new/setup's `agent-history-hygiene` initializer uses this same
service. New default hooks block; they do not rewrite or stage files.

Per-repo secret/known/generic policy supports block/warn/off, with private local
overrides and exact reasoned exceptions. Private visibility is advice, never an
automatic exemption. SSH imports are static and reviewed: no DNS, login, Match
exec, private-key reads or rule-value export. Personal rules stay outside Git;
CI checks public rules and must state the missing personal coverage.

Read the bundled dev reference `references/hygiene.md` through `dev help hygiene`
or the public hygiene guide before rule changes or redaction. The CLI supports
all regular text, rather than treating transcripts as the only leak surface.

## Preserve the review trail

1. Identify the exact provider/session UUID from the transcript preamble. Never
   select another session just because its file is newest.
2. Commit product changes and reviewed plans. Follow the selected retention
   policy for raw history; do not broadly stage every agent directory.
3. Use `dev prepare --session provider:uuid` and finalization after its writer
   exits when that lifecycle applies. Byte stability alone is not writer proof.
4. Scan exact staged content. Partial staging must not accidentally stage
   unrelated working-copy edits.
5. In archive mode, raw history may be ignored but must be preserved before
   checkout disposal. In track mode, retain the existing exact-session workflow.
   Exclude conversation evidence from product source archives independently.

Do not close, restart or spawn agents to make hygiene checks pass without the
applicable authorization. A new agent without SpecStory does not stop an older
writer. Preserve the user's original task while offering additional cleanup.

## Reviewed redaction

```bash
dev hygiene redact --report <report-id> --file <reviewed-file> --json
# After reviewing, and after the exact artifact writer exited:
dev hygiene redact --apply --plan <plan-id> --yes --writer-stopped
```

Plans bind native file identity, contents, policy and checkout state. Stale,
modified or partial plans are not authority to overwrite current data. Keep
private recovery and rerun scans/tests after source or configuration changes.
The running transcript is left for a manual external trigger after its writer
stops. No automatic history rewrite, agent launch, commit, push or cleanup occurs.

## External archive workflow

`dev artifact setup` and `dev repo setup --artifacts` preview explicit per-repo
policy. `archive --session provider:uuid` or `--file` creates reviewed snapshots;
apply only after the exact recorder exits. Off/check/redact affect the copy,
not the live source or its index. A disabled scan is recorded as skipped.
Checked snapshots produce masked finding IDs for reasoned fixture exceptions.

Commit reviewed plans with product work before `dev prepare`. New archive intents
bind the destination and policy; redact finalization requires a reviewed
`--archive-plan`. Old tracked intents retain the compatibility scripts below.
Keep those installations while any tracked workflow still depends on them.

`artifact find` reads local committed archive records. Sync and original-backup
publication are explicit Git operations; they never transfer native session DBs.
`artifact migrate` can untrack after verified backup or build separate original,
history and filtered Git copies with commit maps. It never force-pushes source
refs. For historical exposure, use the remediation section rather than treating
path removal as a secret audit. Private raw recovery is not cache.

## Legacy scripts

The scripts remain explicit compatibility utilities. Prefer dev for new setup
and partial-staging-safe edits; a separately published remote redactor hook has
its own version and is not silently updated by dev.

- `find-session.sh --json`: locate candidate transcript/plan metadata.
- `stage-agent-artifacts.sh --session-only --dry-run`: inspect exact staging;
  without session-only it may include other dirty artifacts, so use cautiously.
- `scan-staged.sh`: masked JSON-lines locations only, never raw Match/Secret.
  Exit 0 means clean; 20 means candidate findings; legacy `--redact` selects
  exit 10 but only masks output, never modifies files. Exit 30 means missing
  gitleaks; 40 means scanner/JSON/required-parser failure; 2 means not in Git.
- `assets/redact_secrets.py --fix`: explicit legacy artifact mutation. Scanner
  failure is an error, not an empty result; console output uses full sentinels.
  This utility can restage, so use the reviewed dev flow for partial staging.
- `bootstrap-project.sh`: legacy installer; new default templates require dev
  hygiene. Its old `--migrate` targets the separately published remote redactor,
  not the new dev policy migration. Prefer `dev hygiene setup`.

SpecStory may already redact on write, but provider behavior/version is not proof
that every secret class or artifact directory is covered. Preserve existing
`[REDACTED:<rule-id>]` markers. An inert marker must never exempt another secret
on the same line. `.gitleaksignore` contains exact finding fingerprints, not
file/path globs. Portable pattern exceptions need a narrow rule/path/match scope.

## Confirmed historical exposures

Read [remediation](references/remediation.md). First distinguish fixtures,
examples and scanner candidates from confirmed credentials. Revoke/rotate a
confirmed exposed credential at its provider before considering Git history.

Shared main and immutable release tags stay unchanged in ordinary hygiene work.
Correct HEAD in a new commit, and assess old commits, tags, PR references, forks,
clones, caches and distribution artifacts separately. A force push does not erase
all copies or revoke a credential. Personal names, Git author metadata and filenames
also need an explicit impact assessment; text replacement does not rewrite them.

Never echo matching bytes or raw process arguments into a chat to investigate a
finding. Use rule IDs, safe locations and private local reports. Keep raw reports,
recovery images and personal identity dictionaries outside Git and CI logs.

## Validation

Run the skill's fixture tests for redactor/scan-wrapper changes. For dev changes,
run native hygiene/storage/text-transaction tests and the real hook test:

```bash
python scripts/test-hygiene-hooks.py --dev <absolute-built-dev>
```

It uses an isolated HOME/repository and synthetic credentials. Validate same-line
placeholder bypasses, hidden files, partial staging, missing/malformed scanner
results, writer/stale-plan refusal and private recovery. Synchronize embedded
bootstrap assets and both locales of public documentation.

## Summary

Prepare **v0.2.39** with hygiene reporting and guarded cleanup fixes.

- Add `dev hygiene report`: stored per-checkout summaries, severity/occurrence ordering, rule/file/category filters, finding drill-down, and a documented JSON contract. Masked values are public; bounded full-value reviews remain private. Preserve partial scan receipts and exact private file identities.
- Fix macOS kernel-managed provenance during guarded replacements and retain underlying repair/recovery errors.
- Add explicit `dev retire --base`; forward verified bases through sweep and cleanup handoffs. Scope worktree authority so unrelated sibling removal does not stale an entire approved batch.
- Allow a calling agent to work on another session's stopped artifacts only under verified session proof or explicit disjoint-ownership attestation; identified own live transcripts stay protected.
- Filter unrelated artifact intents by repository identity before requiring moved-checkout branch identity, fixing false blockers on detached submodules.
- Support locally proven empty submodule cleanup and reviewed empty administration pruning, retaining native directory-only deletion, initialized-child recovery proofs, claim checks, layout revalidation, and partial-result reporting.

## Safety and compatibility

- `--recursive` is still required. Dirty parents, retained/deinitialized child stores, orphan data, ignored files, symlinks/reparse points, and relevant ownership claims remain blockers.
- No forced cleanup, implicit initialization/downloads, automatic missing-gitlink restoration, alternates bypass, or squash/ancestry substitution.
- Add a required native Windows cleanup-regression gate; broad advisory Windows results are not treated as proof.
- The PR excludes unpublished chat-backup commits, new transcript/plan changes, and private feedback input. Existing installation binaries and other working sessions were not modified.
- Synchronize English/zh-TW documentation, embedded help, bundled skill, changelog, and recommended install pins.

## Validation

- [x] Both original isolated cleanup diagnostics reproduced before the fixes and pass afterward.
- [x] Cleanup regression tests with race detection: artifact, submodule, safefile, taskflow.
- [x] `go test -race -timeout 20m ./...`
- [x] `go vet ./...` and Go formatting checks.
- [x] `make e2e`
- [x] Windows and Android cross-compilation; native Windows execution is enforced by this PR's CI gate.
- [x] `make skill-sync` / `make skill-check`
- [x] Strict documentation source/build/site checks.
- [x] Public-only secret scan of the exact publication range: complete, 133 files, 0 blocking / 0 warning findings. This does not claim personal-rule or full historical coverage.

After checks pass, merge with a merge commit to preserve ancestry, then tag the exact merged commit and verify release assets/checksums and Homebrew publication.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

34		}

38			Attributes: windows.OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE,
39		}

41		var status windows.IO_STATUS_BLOCK
42		// No delete-on-close: nothing may be deleted before type, identity and

44		// OPEN_REPARSE_POINT opens (and below rejects) rather than follows a link.
45		if err := windows.NtCreateFile(&handle, windows.FILE_GENERIC_READ|windows.DELETE,
46			&attributes, &status, nil, 0,
47			windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
48			windows.FILE_OPEN, windows.FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE|windows.FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT|windows.FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT,

1	package safefile

3	import (
4		"context"

14	// RemoveEmptyChildDir removes only the reviewed empty directory, never a file
15	// substituted at its name. Traversal and identity checks use held roots. Native
16	// directory-only deletion also rejects late content. External writers do not
17	// share our locks: Unix cannot atomically compare an inode and rmdir its name.
18	func RemoveEmptyChildDir(ctx context.Context, parent *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo) error {
19		if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
20			return err
21		}
22		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
23			return err
24		}
25		if expected == nil || unsafeLink(expected) || !expected.IsDir() {
26			return fmt.Errorf("remove empty directory needs a normal directory identity: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
27		}
28		child, info, err := OpenChildRoot(parent, name)
29		if err != nil {
30			return err
31		}
32		defer child.Close()
33		if !os.SameFile(info, expected) {
34			return ErrChanged
35		}
36		file, err := child.Open(".")
37		if err != nil {
38			return err
39		}
40		err = verifyEmptyDirectory(file)
41		closeErr := file.Close()
42		if err := errors.Join(err, closeErr); err != nil {
43			return err
44		}
45		if err := VerifyChildRoot(parent, name, expected); err != nil {
46			return err
47		}
48		return removeEmptyChildDirNative(ctx, parent, name, expected)
49	}
50	
51	func verifyEmptyDirectory(file *os.File) error {
52		names, err := file.Readdirnames(1)
53		if len(names) != 0 {
54			return errors.New("directory is not empty")
55		}
56		if !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
57			if err == nil {
58				return io.ErrNoProgress
59			}
60			return err
61		}
62		return nil
63	}

12	func Descriptor(dir bool) (*windows.SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR, error) {
13		user, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
14		if err != nil {
15			return nil, err
16		}
17		flags := ""
18		if dir {
19			flags = "OICI"
20		}
21		sid := user.User.Sid.String()
22		return windows.SecurityDescriptorFromString("O:" + sid + "D:P(A;" + flags + ";FA;;;" + sid + ")(A;" + flags + ";FA;;;SY)")
23	}
24	func MakeDir(path string) error {
25		descriptor, err := Descriptor(true)
26		if err != nil {
27			return err
28		}
29		pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
30		if err != nil {
31			return err
32		}
33		attrs := windows.SecurityAttributes{Length: uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(windows.SecurityAttributes{})), SecurityDescriptor: descriptor}
34		return windows.CreateDirectory(pointer, &attrs)
35	}
36	func Check(path string, _ fs.FileInfo, dir bool) error {
37		pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
38		if err != nil {
39			return err
40		}
41		flags := uint32(windows.FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT)
42		if dir {
43			flags |= windows.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS
44		}
45		handle, err := windows.CreateFile(pointer, windows.READ_CONTROL|windows.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, flags, 0)
46		if err != nil {
47			return errors.New("private artifact identity unavailable")
48		}
49		defer windows.CloseHandle(handle)
50		var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
51		if windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(handle, &info) != nil || info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 || !dir && info.NumberOfLinks != 1 {
52			return errors.New("unsafe private artifact identity")
53		}
54		descriptor, err := windows.GetSecurityInfo(handle, windows.SE_FILE_OBJECT, windows.OWNER_SECURITY_INFORMATION|windows.DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION)
55		if err != nil {
56			return err
57		}
58		current, err := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().GetTokenUser()
59		if err != nil {
60			return err
61		}
62		owner, _, err := descriptor.Owner()
63		if err != nil || !owner.Equals(current.User.Sid) {
64			return errors.New("private artifact owner differs from current user")
65		}
66		control, _, err := descriptor.Control()
67		if err != nil || control&windows.SE_DACL_PROTECTED == 0 {
68			return errors.New("private artifacts require a protected DACL")
69		}
70		acl, _, err := descriptor.DACL()
71		if err != nil || acl == nil || acl.AceCount != 2 {
72			return errors.New("private artifacts require current-user and SYSTEM access only")
73		}
74		seen := map[string]bool{}
75		for i := uint16(0); i < acl.AceCount; i++ {
76			var ace *windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE
77			if windows.GetAce(acl, uint32(i), &ace) != nil || ace.Header.AceType != windows.ACCESS_ALLOWED_ACE_TYPE {
78				return errors.New("unsupported feedback ACL")
79			}
80			sid := (*windows.SID)(unsafe.Pointer(&ace.SidStart)).String()
81			if sid != current.User.Sid.String() && sid != "S-1-5-18" {
82				return errors.New("feedback ACL grants another identity")
83			}
84			seen[sid] = true
85		}
86		if len(seen) != 2 {
87			return errors.New("feedback ACL is incomplete")
88		}
89		return nil
90	}

46	func (l *removalLayout) record(path string, root *os.Root, info fs.FileInfo, listing bool) error {
47		if len(l.Directories)+len(l.Absent) >= removalLayoutLimit {
48			return errors.New("submodule removal layout exceeds inspection limit")
49		}
50		identity, err := gitx.DirectoryIdentity(path)
51		if err != nil {
52			return err
53		}
54		d := layoutDirectory{Identity: identity, Mode: uint32(info.Mode()), info: info}
55		if prior, ok := l.Directories[path]; ok {
56			if !os.SameFile(prior.info, info) {
57				return safefile.ErrChanged
58			}
59			d = prior
60		}
61		if listing {
62			file, err := root.Open(".")
63			if err != nil {
64				return err
65			}
66			names, readErr := file.Readdirnames(removalLayoutLimit + 1)
67			closeErr := file.Close()
68			if readErr != nil && !errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
69				return readErr
70			}
71			if closeErr != nil {
72				return closeErr
73			}
74			if len(names) > removalLayoutLimit {
75				return errors.New("submodule administration listing exceeds inspection limit")
76			}
77			sort.Strings(names)
78			d.Listing, d.Listed = names, true
79		}
80		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(path, info); err != nil {
81			return err
82		}
83		l.Directories[path] = d
84		return nil
85	}

87	// path observes a bounded component-by-component walk. Empty leaves cannot hide
88	// nested user directories, .git markers, ignored files, links or reparse points.
89	func (l *removalLayout) path(ctx context.Context, base, relative string, empty bool) error {
90		root, info, err := safefile.OpenRoot(base)
91		if err != nil {
92			return err
93		}
94		defer func() { root.Close() }()
95		if err := l.record(base, root, info, false); err != nil {
96			return err
97		}
98		parts := strings.Split(filepath.ToSlash(relative), "/")
99		if relative == "." {
100			parts = nil
101		}
102		if len(parts) > 64 {
103			return errors.New("submodule layout path exceeds inspection depth")
104		}
105		path := base
106		for _, name := range parts {
107			if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
108				return err
109			}
110			child, childInfo, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(root, name)
111			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
112				// A failed open alone is not an absence observation: prove the name
113				// really is missing relative to the same held ancestor.
114				if _, statErr := root.Lstat(name); !errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
115					return errors.Join(safefile.ErrChanged, statErr)
116				}
117				l.Absent[filepath.Join(path, name)] = true
118				return safefile.VerifyRoot(path, info)
119			}
120			if err != nil {
121				return err
122			}
123			if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(path, info); err != nil {
124				child.Close()
125				return err
126			}
127			root.Close()
128			root, info, path = child, childInfo, filepath.Join(path, name)
129			if err := l.record(path, root, info, false); err != nil {
130				return err
131			}
132		}
133		if empty {

138				return fmt.Errorf("uninitialized submodule %s contains retained data", relative)
139			}
140		}
141		return nil

144	func observeRemovalLayout(ctx context.Context, repo gitx.Repo, g gitx.SubmoduleGraph) (*removalLayout, error) {
145		l := &removalLayout{Directories: map[string]layoutDirectory{}, Absent: map[string]bool{}}

156			}

174	func (l *removalLayout) storage(ctx context.Context, parentPath, name string, known map[string]bool, depth int) error {
175		if err := context.Cause(ctx); err != nil {
176			return err
177		}
178		if depth > 64 {
179			return errors.New("submodule administration exceeds inspection depth")
180		}
181		parent, parentInfo, err := safefile.OpenRoot(parentPath)
182		if err != nil {
183			return err
184		}
185		defer parent.Close()
186		if err := l.record(parentPath, parent, parentInfo, false); err != nil {
187			return err
188		}
189		root, info, err := safefile.OpenChildRoot(parent, name)
190		path := filepath.Join(parentPath, name)
191		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
192			if _, statErr := parent.Lstat(name); !errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
193				return errors.Join(safefile.ErrChanged, statErr)
194			}
195			l.Absent[path] = true
196			return safefile.VerifyRoot(parentPath, parentInfo)
197		}
198		if err != nil {

200		}
201		defer root.Close()

203			return err
204		}
205		if known[path] {
206			// Leases are self-created coordination data, not layout changes. Other
207			// private Git entries remain listed and inspectPrivateState checks them.
208			d := l.Directories[path]

211				if entry != "dev-taskflow" && entry != ".dev-taskflow.lock" {
212					names = append(names, entry)

214			}
215			d.Listing = names
216			l.Directories[path] = d
217			return l.storage(ctx, path, "modules", known, depth+1)
218		}
219		l.scaffolds = append(l.scaffolds, path)

221			if entry == "HEAD" {

223			}
224			if err := l.storage(ctx, path, entry, known, depth+1); err != nil {

226			}
227		}
228		return safefile.VerifyChildRoot(parent, name, info)

244			mapped, best := path, ""

302	// components still carry their original exact identity/absence at the mapped
303	// location, including those inside a moved initialized parent.
304	func (p *Removal) verifyStagedLayout(ctx context.Context, moves []moveRecord) error {

327				return err
328			}
329			if !os.SameFile(expected.info, info) {

331				return safefile.ErrChanged
332			}
333			l := &removalLayout{Directories: map[string]layoutDirectory{}, Absent: map[string]bool{}}
334			err = l.record(mapped, root, info, expected.Listed)
335			root.Close()
336			if err != nil {

338			}
339			actual := l.Directories[mapped]

370	func (p *Removal) revalidateLayout(ctx context.Context, expected *removalLayout) error {
371		fresh, err := observeRemovalLayout(ctx, p.Repository, p.Graph)
372		if err != nil {

381	// PrunedDirectoriesError reports irreversible directory-only housekeeping before
382	// an outer removal failed. It never claims the worktree or task was removed.
383	type PrunedDirectoriesError struct {
384		Paths []string

388	func (e *PrunedDirectoriesError) Error() string {
389		return fmt.Sprintf("pruned empty submodule administration directories [%s]; outer cleanup incomplete: %v", strings.Join(e.Paths, ", "), e.Cause)
390	}
391	func (e *PrunedDirectoriesError) Unwrap() error { return e.Cause }

393	func (p *Removal) applyEmpty(ctx context.Context, check func(context.Context, string) error, removeOuter func() error) (err error) {
394		// This lane creates no proof repository, lease, journal or quarantine.
395		l, err := observeRemovalLayout(ctx, p.Repository, p.Graph)
396		if err != nil {
397			return err
398		}
399		if l.fingerprint() != p.LayoutFingerprint {
400			return errors.New("stale submodule removal layout")
401		}
402		var pruned []string
403		defer func() {
404			if err != nil && len(pruned) > 0 {
405				err = &PrunedDirectoriesError{Paths: append([]string(nil), pruned...), Cause: err}
406			}
407		}()
408		sort.Slice(l.scaffolds, func(i, j int) bool {
409			if len(l.scaffolds[i]) != len(l.scaffolds[j]) {
410				return len(l.scaffolds[i]) > len(l.scaffolds[j])
411			}
412			return l.scaffolds[i] < l.scaffolds[j]
413		})
414		for _, path := range l.scaffolds {
415			if err := p.revalidateLocal(ctx, l); err != nil {
416				return err
417			}
418			if check != nil {
419				if err := check(ctx, p.Graph.Root); err != nil {
420					return err
421				}
422			}
423			if err := p.revalidateLocal(ctx, l); err != nil {
424				return err
425			}
426			parentPath := filepath.Dir(path)
427			parent, info, err := safefile.OpenRoot(parentPath)
428			if err != nil {
429				return err
430			}
431			if !os.SameFile(info, l.Directories[parentPath].info) {
432				parent.Close()
433				return safefile.ErrChanged
434			}
435			err = safefile.RemoveEmptyChildDir(ctx, parent, filepath.Base(path), l.Directories[path].info)
436			parent.Close()
437			if err != nil {
438				return err
439			}
440			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(p.Repository.GitDir, path)
441			pruned = append(pruned, filepath.ToSlash(rel))
442			delete(l.Directories, path)
443			if path == filepath.Join(p.Repository.GitDir, "modules") {
444				l.Absent[path] = true
445			} else {
446				d := l.Directories[parentPath]
447				var names []string
448				for _, name := range d.Listing {
449					if name != filepath.Base(path) {
450						names = append(names, name)
451					}
452				}
453				d.Listing = names
454				l.Directories[parentPath] = d
455			}
456		}
457		// Unconditional even for zero initialized children and absent modules/.
458		if err := p.revalidateLocal(ctx, l); err != nil {
459			return err
460		}
461		if check != nil {
462			if err := check(ctx, p.Graph.Root); err != nil {
463				return err
464			}
465		}
466		if err := p.revalidateLocal(ctx, l); err != nil {
467			return err
468		}

21	// Removal is run-local authority, never a durable clean/remote-backed receipt.
22	// All filesystem changes are delayed until caller/runtime/task guards passed.
23	type Removal struct {
24		roots      map[string]os.FileInfo
25		Graph      gitx.SubmoduleGraph
26		Repository gitx.Repo
27		Workspace  Workspace
28		Revision   string
29		Config     config.Config
30		Merged     bool
31		remoteRefs map[string]string
32	
33		LayoutFingerprint string
34		layout            *removalLayout
35		initialized       []gitx.SubmoduleNode
36		cleanupConsent    bool
37		observed          bool
38		publication       bool
39		remoteVerified    bool
40	}
41	
42	// InitializedCount excludes safe empty gitlinks, which have no private clone to
43	// prove, lease or stage. The subset is fixed by the complete local observation.
44	func (p *Removal) InitializedCount() int {
45		if p == nil {
46			return 0
47		}
48		return len(p.initialized)
49	}

51	func InspectPublication(ctx context.Context, cfg config.Config, root string, merged bool) (*Removal, error) {
52		g, err := gitx.SubmodulesOf(ctx, root)
53		if err != nil {
54			return nil, err
55		}
56		if len(g.Nodes) == 0 {
57			return nil, nil
58		}
59		r, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, root)
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, err
62		}
63		st, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, root)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, err
66		}
67		w, revision, err := Load(cfg, r.GitCommonDir, st.Branch)
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, err
70		}
71		for _, n := range g.Nodes {
72			if !n.Initialized || n.Status.Dirty() || n.HEAD != n.Gitlink {
73				return nil, fmt.Errorf("submodule %s must be committed and match its gitlink before publishing/integrating the parent", n.Path)
74			}
75		}
76		return &Removal{Graph: g, Repository: r, Workspace: w, Revision: revision, Config: cfg, Merged: merged, remoteRefs: map[string]string{}, initialized: append([]gitx.SubmoduleNode(nil), g.Nodes...), observed: true, publication: true}, nil
77	}

79	// InspectRemoval is local only. Destructive adapters must call it even when
80	// Recursive is false: the flag authorizes disposal, not skipping inspection.
81	func InspectRemoval(ctx context.Context, cfg config.Config, root string, recursive, merged bool) (*Removal, error) {
82		g, err := gitx.SubmodulesOf(ctx, root)
83		if err != nil {
84			return nil, err
85		}
86		r, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, root)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, err
89		}
90		if len(g.Nodes) == 0 {
91			if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(r.GitDir, "modules")); errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
92				return nil, nil
93			} else if err != nil {
94				return nil, err
95			}
96		}
97		if !r.IsLinkedWorktree {
98			return nil, errors.New("recursive removal cannot remove a canonical checkout")
99		}
100		registered, err := gitx.ResolveRegisteredWorktree(ctx, root, r.Root)
101		if err != nil {
102			return nil, err
103		}
104		if !registered.IsLinkedWorktree() || registered.Worktree.Locked || registered.Worktree.Prunable {
105			return nil, errors.New("recursive removal requires an exact unlocked linked checkout")
106		}
107		w, revision, err := Load(cfg, r.GitCommonDir, registered.Worktree.Branch)
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		plan := &Removal{Graph: g, Repository: r, Workspace: w, Revision: revision, Config: cfg, Merged: merged, remoteRefs: map[string]string{}, cleanupConsent: recursive}
112		plan.layout, err = observeRemovalLayout(ctx, r, g)
113		if err != nil {
114			return plan, err // An incomplete observation is never execution authority.
115		}
116		plan.LayoutFingerprint = plan.layout.fingerprint()

118		for path, directory := range plan.layout.Directories {
119			plan.roots[path] = directory.info
120		}
121		for _, n := range g.Nodes {
122			if len(n.Blockers) > 0 {
123				return nil, fmt.Errorf("submodule %s blocks cleanup: %s", n.Path, strings.Join(n.Blockers, "; "))
124			}
125			if !n.Initialized {
126				if n.State != "uninitialized" {
127					return plan, fmt.Errorf("submodule %s has unknown checkout state", n.Path)
128				}
129				continue
130			}
131			plan.initialized = append(plan.initialized, n)
132			owned, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(r.GitDir, "modules"), n.GitDir)
133			if err != nil || !owned || n.GitDir != n.CommonDir {
134				return nil, fmt.Errorf("submodule %s has shared or externally owned Git storage", n.Path)
135			}
136			child := filepath.Join(g.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Path))
137			for _, path := range []string{child, n.GitDir} {
138				held, info, err := safefile.OpenRoot(path)
139				if err != nil {
140					return nil, err
141				}
142				held.Close()
143				plan.roots[path] = info
144			}
145			worktrees, err := gitx.Worktrees(ctx, child)
146			if err != nil {
147				return nil, err
148			}
149			if len(worktrees) != 1 {
150				return nil, fmt.Errorf("submodule %s still owns other worktrees", n.Path)
151			}
152			if err := inspectPrivateState(ctx, child, n.GitDir); err != nil {
153				return nil, fmt.Errorf("submodule %s: %w", n.Path, err)
154			}
155		}
156		if err := inspectRemovalParent(ctx, g.Root); err != nil {
157			return plan, err
158		}
159		plan.observed = true
160		if !recursive {
161			return plan, errors.New("submodules require an explicit --recursive cleanup plan; child repositories and empty administration directories are retained")
162		}
163		return plan, nil
164	}
165	
166	// Old gitlinks may leave independent repositories in modules/ after their
167	// paths disappear from the index. Every store being disposed must be in the
168	// observed graph; a clean current gitlink is not authority for orphan stores.
169	func inspectModuleStorage(root string, nodes []gitx.SubmoduleNode, originalRoot string) error {
170		known := map[string]bool{}
171		for _, n := range nodes {
172			if !n.Initialized {
173				continue
174			}
175			rel, err := filepath.Rel(originalRoot, n.GitDir)
176			if err != nil {
177				return err
178			}
179			known[filepath.Join(root, rel)] = true
180		}
181		l := &removalLayout{Directories: map[string]layoutDirectory{}, Absent: map[string]bool{}}
182		return l.storage(context.Background(), filepath.Dir(root), filepath.Base(root), known, 0)
183	}
184	
185	func inspectPrivateState(ctx context.Context, root, gitdir string) error {
186		index, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z")
187		if err != nil {
188			return err
189		}
190		gitlinks := map[string]bool{}
191		for _, record := range strings.Split(index, "\x00") {
192			meta, path, ok := strings.Cut(record, "\t")
193			if ok && strings.HasPrefix(meta, "160000 ") {
194				gitlinks[filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path))] = true
195			}
196		}
197		visited := 0
198		if err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
199			if err != nil {
200				return err
201			}
202			visited++
203			if visited > 500000 {
204				return errors.New("worktree inspection limit exceeded")
205			}
206			if path == root {
207				return nil
208			}
209			if gitlinks[path] && d.IsDir() {
210				return filepath.SkipDir
211			}
212			if strings.EqualFold(d.Name(), ".git") {
213				if filepath.Dir(path) != root {
214					return fmt.Errorf("nested repository %s requires independent preservation", filepath.Dir(path))
215				}
216				if d.IsDir() {
217					return filepath.SkipDir
218				}
219			}
220			return nil
221		}); err != nil {
222			return err
223		}
224		allowed := map[string]bool{"HEAD": true, "index": true, "config": true, "description": true, "objects": true, "refs": true, "logs": true, "hooks": true, "info": true, "packed-refs": true, "FETCH_HEAD": true, "ORIG_HEAD": true, "modules": true, "dev-taskflow": true, ".dev-taskflow.lock": true}
225		allowed["lfs"] = true
226		allowed["COMMIT_EDITMSG"] = true
227		if message, err := safefile.ReadRegular(ctx, filepath.Join(gitdir, "COMMIT_EDITMSG"), 1024*1024); err == nil {
228			committed, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "log", "-1", "--format=%B")
229			if err != nil {
230				return err
231			}
232			if strings.TrimSpace(string(message)) != strings.TrimSpace(committed) {
233				return errors.New("uncommitted commit-message draft requires preservation")
234			}
235		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
236			return err
237		}
238		if description, err := safefile.ReadRegular(ctx, filepath.Join(gitdir, "description"), 1024*1024); err == nil {
239			if strings.TrimSpace(string(description)) != "Unnamed repository; edit this file 'description' to name the repository." {
240				return errors.New("private repository description requires preservation")
241			}
242		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
243			return err
244		}
245		if err := filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(gitdir, "lfs"), func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
246			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
247				return nil
248			}
249			if err != nil {
250				return err
251			}
252			if !d.IsDir() {
253				return errors.New("LFS data requires independent recovery proof")
254			}
255			return nil
256		}); err != nil {
257			return err
258		}
259		entries, err := os.ReadDir(gitdir)
260		if err != nil {
261			return err
262		}
263		for _, entry := range entries {
264			if !allowed[entry.Name()] {
265				return fmt.Errorf("private Git data %s requires preservation", entry.Name())
266			}
267		}
268		infoEntries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(gitdir, "info"))
269		if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
270			return err
271		}
272		for _, entry := range infoEntries {
273			if entry.Name() != "exclude" {
274				return fmt.Errorf("private Git info/%s requires preservation", entry.Name())
275			}
276		}
277		if exclude, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(gitdir, "info", "exclude")); err == nil {
278			for _, line := range strings.Split(string(exclude), "\n") {
279				line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
280				if line != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
281					return errors.New("private Git exclude rules require preservation")
282				}
283			}
284		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
285			return err
286		}
287		for _, path := range []string{"shallow", "objects/info/alternates", "info/sparse-checkout", "rr-cache"} {
288			if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(gitdir, filepath.FromSlash(path))); err == nil {
289				return fmt.Errorf("%s requires independent preservation", path)
290			} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
291				return err
292			}
293		}
294		files, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "-v", "-z")
295		if err != nil {
296			return err
297		}
298		for _, rec := range strings.Split(files, "\x00") {
299			if rec != "" && (rec[0] == 'S' || (rec[0] >= 'a' && rec[0] <= 'z')) {
300				return errors.New("hidden index content requires independent inspection")
301			}
302		}
303		attrs, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "ls-files", "-z")
304		if err != nil {
305			return err
306		}
307		for _, p := range strings.Split(attrs, "\x00") {
308			if p == "" {
309				continue
310			}
311			a, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "check-attr", "filter", "working-tree-encoding", "--", p)
312			if err != nil {
313				return err
314			}
315			for _, line := range strings.Split(a, "\n") {
316				if !strings.HasSuffix(line, ": unspecified") && !strings.HasSuffix(line, ": unset") {
317					return errors.New("filtered or encoded working files require independent recovery proof")
318				}
319			}
320		}
321		hooks, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(gitdir, "hooks"))
322		if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
323			return err
324		}
325		for _, h := range hooks {
326			if !strings.HasSuffix(h.Name(), ".sample") {
327				return errors.New("custom repository hooks require preservation")
328			}
329		}
330		// A clone's normal configuration is reproducible. Arbitrary local config
331		// and includes may hold durable intent or credentials and are not disposed.
332		settings, err := gitx.Run(ctx, root, "config", "--local", "--name-only", "--list")
333		if err != nil {
334			return err
335		}
336		for _, key := range strings.Split(settings, "\n") {
337			switch key {
338			case "core.repositoryformatversion", "core.filemode", "core.bare", "core.logallrefupdates", "core.ignorecase", "core.precomposeunicode", "core.symlinks", "core.worktree", "remote.origin.url", "remote.origin.fetch", "extensions.objectformat":
339				continue
340			}
341			if strings.HasPrefix(key, "branch.") && (strings.HasSuffix(key, ".remote") || strings.HasSuffix(key, ".merge")) {
342				continue
343			}
344			if strings.HasPrefix(key, "submodule.") && (strings.HasSuffix(key, ".url") || strings.HasSuffix(key, ".active")) {
345				continue
346			}
347			return fmt.Errorf("local Git setting %s requires preservation", key)
348		}
349		return nil
350	}
351	
352	// VerifyRemote fetches into a fresh isolated bare repository. Reachability is
353	// proven against the remote's advertised refs, never local tracking refs or
354	// objects borrowed from the checkout about to be removed.
355	func (p *Removal) VerifyRemote(ctx context.Context) error {
356		if p == nil {
357			return nil
358		}
359		p.remoteVerified = false
360		p.remoteRefs = map[string]string{}
361		if !p.observed || (!p.publication && !p.cleanupConsent) {
362			return errors.New("submodule recovery requires a complete observation and explicit cleanup consent")
363		}
364		if !p.publication {
365			if err := p.revalidateLocal(ctx, p.layout); err != nil {
366				return err
367			}
368		}
369		var removedIdentities []os.FileInfo
370		for _, node := range p.initialized {
371			for _, path := range []string{filepath.Join(p.Graph.Root, filepath.FromSlash(node.Path)), node.GitDir, filepath.Join(p.Graph.Root, filepath.FromSlash(node.Path), ".git")} {
372				info, err := os.Stat(path)
373				if err != nil {
374					return err
375				}
376				removedIdentities = append(removedIdentities, info)
377			}
378		}
379		for _, n := range p.initialized {
380			child := filepath.Join(p.Graph.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Path))
381			url, err := gitx.Run(ctx, child, "remote", "get-url", "origin")
382			if err != nil {
383				return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s has no recovery origin", n.Path)
384			}
385			expected, err := gitx.SubmoduleSourceURL(ctx, filepath.Join(p.Graph.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Parent)), n.URL)
386			if err != nil || expected != url {
387				return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s recovery origin differs from its declared source", n.Path)
388			}
389			local, localErr := localRecoveryPath(child, url)
390			if localErr != nil {
391				return localErr
392			}
393			if local != "" {
394				info, err := os.Stat(local)
395				if err != nil {
396					return fmt.Errorf("recovery origin is unavailable: %w", err)
397				}
398				for _, removed := range removedIdentities {
399					if os.SameFile(info, removed) {
400						return errors.New("recovery origin depends on the workspace being removed")
401					}
402				}
403				for _, removedRoot := range []string{p.Graph.Root, p.Repository.GitDir} {
404					inside, err := pathx.Contains(removedRoot, local)
405					if err != nil || inside {
406						return errors.New("recovery origin depends on the workspace being removed")
407					}
408				}
409			}
410			before, err := gitx.Run(ctx, child, "ls-remote", "--refs", "origin")
411			if err != nil {
412				return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s recovery origin unavailable", n.Path)
413			}
414			proof, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "dev-submodule-proof-")
415			if err != nil {
416				return err
417			}
418			err = func() error {
419				defer os.RemoveAll(proof)
420				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, proof, "init", "--bare", "--quiet"); err != nil {
421					return err
422				}
423				if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, proof, "fetch", "--quiet", "--no-tags", "--no-write-fetch-head", "--", url, "+refs/*:refs/*"); err != nil {
424					return errors.New("could not fetch isolated recovery proof")
425				}
426				after, err := gitx.Run(ctx, child, "ls-remote", "--refs", "origin")
427				if err != nil || before != after {
428					return errors.New("recovery remote refs changed during proof")
429				}
430				objects, err := gitx.Run(ctx, proof, "rev-list", "--objects", "--all")
431				if err != nil {
432					return err
433				}
434				available := map[string]bool{}
435				for _, line := range strings.Split(objects, "\n") {
436					if f := strings.Fields(line); len(f) > 0 {
437						available[f[0]] = true
438					}
439				}
440				advertised := map[string]string{}
441				for _, line := range strings.Split(after, "\n") {
442					if f := strings.Fields(line); len(f) == 2 {
443						advertised[f[1]] = f[0]
444					}
445				}
446				refs, err := gitx.Run(ctx, child, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)")
447				if err != nil {
448					return err
449				}
450				for _, line := range strings.Split(refs, "\n") {
451					f := strings.Fields(line)
452					if len(f) != 2 {
453						continue
454					}
455					if strings.HasPrefix(f[0], "refs/remotes/") {
456						continue
457					}
458					if advertised[f[0]] == "" || !available[f[1]] {
459						return fmt.Errorf("local ref %s is not preserved by the recovery remote", f[0])
460					}
461				}
462				if !available[n.HEAD] || !available[n.Gitlink] {
463					return errors.New("HEAD or gitlink is not remotely reachable")
464				}
465				reflog, err := gitx.Run(ctx, child, "reflog", "show", "--all", "--format=%H")
466				if err != nil {
467					return err
468				}
469				for _, oid := range strings.Fields(reflog) {
470					if !available[oid] {
471						return errors.New("reflog retains a local-only commit")
472					}
473				}
474				unreachable, err := gitx.Run(ctx, child, "fsck", "--unreachable", "--no-reflogs", "--no-progress")
475				if err != nil {
476					return errors.New("object integrity inspection failed")
477				}
478				for _, line := range strings.Split(unreachable, "\n") {
479					f := strings.Fields(line)
480					if len(f) == 3 && (f[0] == "unreachable" || f[0] == "dangling") && !available[f[2]] {
481						return errors.New("unreachable local objects require preservation")
482					}
483				}
484				if p.Merged {
485					for _, m := range p.Workspace.Members {
486						if m.Path == n.Path {
487							base := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(m.Base, "refs/remotes/"), "origin/")
488							if !strings.HasPrefix(base, "refs/") {
489								base = "refs/heads/" + base
490							}
491							if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, proof, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", n.HEAD, base); err != nil {
492								return fmt.Errorf("member is not integrated into %s", base)
493							}
494						}
495					}
496				}
497				return nil
498			}()
499			if err != nil {
500				return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s: %w", n.Path, err)
501			}
502			p.remoteRefs[n.Path] = before
503		}
504		p.remoteVerified = true
505		return nil
506	}
507	
508	func localRecoveryPath(cwd, source string) (string, error) {
509		if strings.HasPrefix(source, "file://") {
510			u, err := url.Parse(source)
511			if err != nil {
512				return "", errors.New("invalid recovery file URL")
513			}
514			if u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" || u.User != nil {
515				return "", errors.New("ambiguous recovery file URL")
516			}
517			path := u.Path
518			if u.Host != "" && !strings.EqualFold(u.Host, "localhost") {
519				path = "//" + u.Host + path
520			}
521			if filepath.Separator == '\\' && len(path) > 2 && path[0] == '/' && path[2] == ':' {
522				path = path[1:]
523			}
524			return filepath.FromSlash(path), nil
525		}
526		if filepath.IsAbs(source) {
527			return source, nil
528		}
529		if !strings.Contains(source, ":") {
530			return filepath.Join(cwd, source), nil
531		}
532		return "", nil
533	}
534	
535	type moveRecord struct {
536		From  string `json:"from"`
537		To    string `json:"to"`
538		Empty bool   `json:"empty_placeholder"`
539	}
540	type removalJournal struct {
541		Version    int          `json:"version"`
542		Root       string       `json:"root"`
543		GitDir     string       `json:"git_dir"`
544		Repository string       `json:"repository"`
545		Branch     string       `json:"branch"`
546		Head       string       `json:"head"`
547		Moves      []moveRecord `json:"moves"`
548		Removed    bool         `json:"outer_removed"`
549	}
550	
551	// Apply stages child data reversibly, leaves empty gitlinks, and invokes the
552	// existing guarded non-force outer removal. A receipt is synced before every
553	// rename. Failed operations restore original paths only when still unclaimed.
554	func (p *Removal) Apply(ctx context.Context, check func(context.Context, string) error, removeOuter func() error) error {
555		if p == nil {
556			return removeOuter()
557		}
558		if !p.observed || !p.cleanupConsent || p.publication || p.layout == nil {
559			return errors.New("recursive removal requires a complete safe observation and explicit cleanup consent")
560		}
561		if !p.remoteVerified || len(p.remoteRefs) != len(p.initialized) {
562			return errors.New("recursive removal has no fresh remote proof")
563		}
564		for _, n := range p.initialized {
565			if _, ok := p.remoteRefs[n.Path]; !ok || n.CommonDir == "" {
566				return errors.New("recursive removal has an incomplete child proof or identity")
567			}
568		}
569		if len(p.initialized) == 0 {
570			return p.applyEmpty(ctx, check, removeOuter)
571		}
572		// Same lock namespace as taskflow. Parent is already locked by the caller.
573		nodes := append([]gitx.SubmoduleNode(nil), p.initialized...)
574		sort.Slice(nodes, func(i, j int) bool { return nodes[i].CommonDir < nodes[j].CommonDir })
575		var leases []*lockx.Lease
576		defer func() {
577			for i := len(leases) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
578				leases[i].Close()
579			}
580		}()
581		for _, n := range nodes {
582			lease, err := lockx.AcquireDir(ctx, filepath.Join(n.CommonDir, "dev-taskflow"), "submodule repository")
583			if err != nil {
584				return err
585			}
586			leases = append(leases, lease)
587		}
588		if err := p.revalidateLocal(ctx, p.layout); err != nil {
589			return err
590		}
591		for _, n := range nodes {
592			child := filepath.Join(p.Graph.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Path))
593			if check != nil {
594				if err := check(ctx, child); err != nil {
595					return err
596				}
597			}
598			refs, err := gitx.Run(ctx, child, "ls-remote", "--refs", "origin")
599			if err != nil || refs != p.remoteRefs[n.Path] {
600				return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s remote proof is stale", n.Path)
601			}
602			if err := inspectPrivateState(ctx, child, n.GitDir); err != nil {
603				return err
604			}
605		}
606		// Claims and empty-node layout are checked after remote/private-state reads
607		// too, immediately before the first local effect.
608		if check != nil {
609			if err := check(ctx, p.Graph.Root); err != nil {
610				return err
611			}
612		}
613		if err := p.revalidateLocal(ctx, p.layout); err != nil {
614			return err
615		}
616		area, err := os.MkdirTemp(filepath.Dir(p.Graph.Root), ".dev-submodule-retirement-")
617		if err != nil {
618			return err
619		}
620		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, p.Graph.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
621		if err != nil {
622			return err
623		}
624		journal := removalJournal{Version: 1, Root: p.Graph.Root, GitDir: p.Repository.GitDir, Repository: p.Repository.MainRoot, Branch: p.Workspace.Branch, Head: head}
625		journalPath := filepath.Join(area, "journal.json")
626		persist := func() error { return writeJSON(journalPath, journal) }
627		placeholders := map[string]os.FileInfo{}
628		rollback := func(cause error) error {
629			for i := len(journal.Moves) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
630				m := journal.Moves[i]
631				if _, err := os.Lstat(m.To); os.IsNotExist(err) {
632					continue
633				}
634				if _, err := os.Lstat(m.From); err == nil {
635					if !m.Empty {
636						return fmt.Errorf("%w; original path reused; inspect %s", cause, journalPath)
637					}
638					parent, _, err := safefile.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(m.From))
639					if err != nil {
640						return fmt.Errorf("%w; cannot restore; inspect %s", cause, journalPath)
641					}
642					err = safefile.RemoveEmptyChildDir(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), parent, filepath.Base(m.From), placeholders[m.From])
643					parent.Close()
644					if err != nil {
645						return fmt.Errorf("%w; cannot restore; inspect %s", cause, journalPath)
646					}
647				}
648				if err := os.Rename(m.To, m.From); err != nil {
649					return fmt.Errorf("%w; restore failed; inspect %s", cause, journalPath)
650				}
651			}
652			os.RemoveAll(area)
653			return cause
654		}
655		move := func(from, to string, empty bool) error {
656			if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(from, p.roots[from]); err != nil {
657				return err
658			}
659			journal.Moves = append(journal.Moves, moveRecord{From: from, To: to, Empty: empty})
660			if err := persist(); err != nil {
661				return err
662			}
663			if err := os.Rename(from, to); err != nil {
664				return err
665			}
666			if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(to, p.roots[from]); err != nil {
667				return err
668			}
669			if empty {
670				if err := os.Mkdir(from, 0755); err != nil {
671					return err
672				}
673				info, err := os.Lstat(from)
674				if err != nil {
675					return err
676				}
677				placeholders[from] = info
678			}
679			return nil
680		}
681		// Children leave first; parent moves retain their empty placeholders.
682		for i := len(p.initialized) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
683			n := p.initialized[i]
684			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
685				return rollback(err)
686			}
687			if err := move(filepath.Join(p.Graph.Root, filepath.FromSlash(n.Path)), filepath.Join(area, fmt.Sprintf("checkout-%d", i)), true); err != nil {
688				return rollback(err)
689			}
690		}
691		// Release file handles before moving private admin directories on Windows.
692		for i := len(leases) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
693			if err := leases[i].Close(); err != nil {
694				return rollback(err)
695			}
696		}
697		if err := move(filepath.Join(p.Repository.GitDir, "modules"), filepath.Join(area, "git-modules"), false); err != nil {
698			return rollback(err)
699		}
700		if err := inspectModuleStorage(filepath.Join(area, "git-modules"), p.Graph.Nodes, filepath.Join(p.Repository.GitDir, "modules")); err != nil {
701			return rollback(err)
702		}
703		if err := p.verifyStagedLayout(ctx, journal.Moves); err != nil {
704			return rollback(err)
705		}
706		if err := verifyStagedPlaceholders(ctx, placeholders, journal.Moves); err != nil {
707			return rollback(err)
708		}
709		if err := removeOuter(); err != nil {
710			return rollback(err)
711		}
712		journal.Removed = true
713		if err := persist(); err != nil {
714			return fmt.Errorf("outer removed; cleanup receipt retained at %s: %w", journalPath, err)
715		}
716		if err := os.RemoveAll(area); err != nil {
717			return fmt.Errorf("outer removed; private submodule data retained at %s: %w", journalPath, err)
718		}
719		return nil
720	}

34	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".json") }

36	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
37		if intent == nil {
38			return fmt.Errorf("create nil artifact intent")
39		}
40		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
41			candidate := *intent
42			if candidate.ID == "" {
43				candidate.ID = s.newID()
44			}
45			candidate.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
46			candidate.Status = Armed
47			now := s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
48			candidate.CreatedAt, candidate.UpdatedAt = now, now
49			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
50				return err
51			}
52			if _, err := os.Stat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
53				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s already exists", candidate.ID)
54			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
55				return err
56			}
57			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
58				return err
59			}
60			*intent = candidate
61			return nil
62		})
63	}

65	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Intent, error) {
66		if !idPattern.MatchString(id) {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent id %q", id)
68		}
69		file, err := os.Open(s.path(id))
70		if err != nil {
71			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
72				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s: %w", id, ErrIntentNotFound)
73			}
74			return nil, err
75		}
76		defer file.Close()
77		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
78		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
79		var intent Intent
80		if err := decoder.Decode(&intent); err != nil {
81			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
82		}
83		if err := ensureJSONEOF(decoder); err != nil {
84			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
85		}
86		if intent.ID != id {
87			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent filename %s disagrees with id %s", id, intent.ID)
88		}
89		if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {

96		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)

98			return nil, nil
99		}

101			return nil, err

111			}

113		}
114		sort.Slice(intents, func(i, j int) bool { return intents[i].CreatedAt.Before(intents[j].CreatedAt) })
115		return intents, nil

11	// Repo identifies one repository, independent of which worktree you are
12	// standing in. Two linked worktrees of the same clone share a Key.
13	type Repo struct {
14		// Root is the working-tree root of the checkout that was probed.
15		Root string
16		// GitDir is this checkout's administrative directory. A linked worktree has
17		// its own entry below the shared common directory.
18		GitDir string
19		// GitCommonDir is the shared .git directory — the same value for every
20		// worktree of a clone, which makes it the natural identity.
21		GitCommonDir string
22		// Name is the basename users recognise the repo by.
23		Name string
24		// IsLinkedWorktree reports whether Root is a linked worktree rather than
25		// the main checkout.
26		IsLinkedWorktree bool
27		// MainRoot is the main (non-linked) checkout of this clone.
28		MainRoot string
29		// Bare reports whether the main checkout is a bare repository.
30		Bare bool
31	}
32	
33	// Key is the stable identity of the clone, shared by all its worktrees.
34	func (r Repo) Key() string { return r.GitCommonDir }
35	
36	// Discover probes dir and reports the repository containing it.
37	func Discover(ctx context.Context, dir string) (Repo, error) {
38		// A single rev-parse call answers everything: batching avoids four
39		// process spawns per repo, which matters when scanning 39 of them.
40		out, err := run(ctx, dir,
41			"rev-parse",
42			"--path-format=absolute",
43			"--show-toplevel",
44			"--git-dir",
45			"--git-common-dir",
46			"--is-bare-repository",
47		)
48		if err != nil {
49			return Repo{}, err
50		}
51		f := lines(out)
52		r := Repo{}
53		// A bare repo has no toplevel, so git prints one fewer line.
54		switch len(f) {
55		case 4:
56			r.Root = f[0]
57			r.GitDir = f[1]
58			r.GitCommonDir = f[2]
59			r.Bare = f[3] == "true"
60		case 3:
61			r.GitDir = f[0]
62			r.GitCommonDir = f[1]
63			r.Bare = f[2] == "true"
64		default:
65			return Repo{}, ErrNotARepo
66		}
67	
68		// The main checkout is the parent of the common .git dir, except for a
69		// bare repo (where the common dir *is* the repo).
70		if r.Bare {
71			r.MainRoot = strings.TrimSuffix(r.GitCommonDir, string(filepath.Separator))
72		} else if r.GitDir == r.GitCommonDir {
73			// A normal checkout may use --separate-git-dir, so the common directory's
74			// parent is not necessarily the working-tree root.
75			r.MainRoot = r.Root
76		} else {
77			r.MainRoot = filepath.Dir(r.GitCommonDir)
78			// Absorbed submodules keep their repository below the superproject's
79			// modules directory. Its parent is metadata, not a checkout.
80			if configured, configErr := run(ctx, dir, "config", "--file", filepath.Join(r.GitCommonDir, "config"), "--get", "core.worktree"); configErr == nil && configured != "" {
81				if !filepath.IsAbs(configured) {
82					configured = filepath.Join(r.GitCommonDir, configured)
83				}
84				r.MainRoot = filepath.Clean(configured)
85			}
86			probe, probeErr := run(ctx, r.MainRoot, "rev-parse", "--path-format=absolute", "--show-toplevel", "--git-common-dir")
87			fields := lines(probe)
88			if probeErr != nil || len(fields) != 2 || !sameCanonicalPath(fields[1], r.GitCommonDir) {
89				return Repo{}, fmt.Errorf("cannot verify main checkout for Git common directory %s", r.GitCommonDir)
90			}
91			r.MainRoot = fields[0]
92		}
93		r.IsLinkedWorktree = r.Root != "" && r.GitDir != r.GitCommonDir
94		r.Name = filepath.Base(r.MainRoot)
95		if r.Bare {
96			// ".../foo/.bare" or ".../foo.git" should both read as "foo".
97			r.Name = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(r.MainRoot), ".git")
98			if strings.HasPrefix(r.Name, ".") {
99				r.Name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.MainRoot))
100			}
101		}
102		return r, nil
103	}
104	
105	// IsRepo reports whether dir is inside a git working tree, without the cost of
106	// a full Discover.
107	func IsRepo(ctx context.Context, dir string) bool {
108		_, err := run(ctx, dir, "rev-parse", "--git-dir")
109		return err == nil
110	}
111	
112	// DefaultBranch resolves the repository's default branch — origin/HEAD when the
113	// remote advertises it, else the first of main/master that exists locally.
114	// Returns "" when nothing can be determined, which callers must treat as
115	// "ask the user" rather than guessing.
116	func DefaultBranch(ctx context.Context, dir string) string {
117		if out, err := run(ctx, dir, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "refs/remotes/origin/HEAD"); err == nil {
118			if _, b, ok := strings.Cut(out, "/"); ok {
119				return b
120			}
121		}
122		for _, cand := range []string{"main", "master", "trunk", "develop"} {
123			if _, err := run(ctx, dir, "show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", "refs/heads/"+cand); err == nil {
124				return cand
125			}
126		}
127		return ""
128	}
129	
130	// Remote returns the push URL of the named remote ("origin" when empty).

1	// Package safefile provides held-root filesystem operations for untrusted
2	// relative paths. It keeps traversal relative to os.Root handles, rejects links
3	// and special files, revalidates filesystem identity, and detects observable
4	// source mutation while reading.
5	package safefile
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"fmt"
11		"io"

18	var (
19		// ErrChanged reports that a named root, child, or file no longer identifies
20		// the object observed by the caller.
21		ErrChanged = errors.New("filesystem object changed")
22		// ErrUnsafeType reports a symlink, reparse point, directory, or other
23		// non-regular object where a regular file was required.
24		ErrUnsafeType = errors.New("unsafe filesystem object type")
25		// ErrFileLimit reports a regular file whose bytes exceed the read policy.
26		ErrFileLimit = errors.New("file size limit exceeded")
27	)
28	
29	// OpenRoot opens path as a held os.Root and proves that the pre-open and
30	// post-open names identify the held directory. Symlinks and reparse points are
31	// rejected rather than followed.
32	func OpenRoot(path string) (*os.Root, fs.FileInfo, error) {
33		before, err := os.Lstat(path)
34		if err != nil {
35			return nil, nil, err
36		}
37		if unsafeLink(before) {
38			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is a symlink or reparse point: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
39		}
40		if !before.IsDir() {
41			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root is not a directory: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
42		}
43		root, err := os.OpenRoot(path)
44		if err != nil {
45			return nil, nil, err
46		}
47		held, err := root.Stat(".")
48		if err != nil {
49			_ = root.Close()
50			return nil, nil, err
51		}
52		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
53		if err != nil || unsafeLink(held) || unsafeLink(current) || !current.IsDir() ||
54			!os.SameFile(before, held) || !os.SameFile(current, held) {
55			_ = root.Close()
56			if err != nil {
57				return nil, nil, err
58			}
59			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("root changed while opening: %w", ErrChanged)
60		}
61		return root, held, nil
62	}

135	// ReadStableRegular reads one child file while proving that the directory name,
136	// opened descriptor, and final directory name all identify the expected regular
137	// file with unchanged observable metadata. maxBytes must be non-negative; zero
138	// means unbounded. Supplying the FileInfo from an earlier directory listing
139	// detects replacement or mutation between selection and opening.
140	func ReadStableRegular(ctx context.Context, root *os.Root, name string, expected fs.FileInfo, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, fs.FileInfo, error) {
141		if root == nil {
142			return nil, nil, errors.New("read stable file: nil root")
143		}
144		if maxBytes < 0 {
145			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("negative maximum file size: %w", ErrFileLimit)
146		}
147		if err := pathx.ValidatePortableComponent(name, CompiledMaxComponentBytes); err != nil {
148			return nil, nil, err
149		}
150		before, err := root.Lstat(name)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, nil, err
153		}
154		if expected == nil {
155			expected = before
156		}
157		if unsafeLink(before) || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
158			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is not a regular file: %w", ErrUnsafeType)
159		}
160		if !sameStableSourceState(expected, before) {
161			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source changed before opening file: %w", ErrChanged)
162		}
163		if maxBytes > 0 && before.Size() > maxBytes {
164			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("source is %d bytes; maximum is %d: %w", before.Size(), maxBytes, ErrFileLimit)
165		}
166	
167		file, err := openRegularForRead(root, name)
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, nil, err
170		}
171		defer file.Close()
172		opened, err := file.Stat()
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, nil, err
175		}

18	// SubmoduleNode describes one exact gitlink edge, relative to Graph.Root.
19	// Unknown is never represented as a clean initialized checkout.
20	type SubmoduleNode struct {
21		CheckoutIdentity string   `json:"checkout_identity,omitempty"`
22		GitIdentity      string   `json:"git_identity,omitempty"`
23		Path             string   `json:"path"`
24		Parent           string   `json:"parent"`
25		Name             string   `json:"name"`
26		URL              string   `json:"-"`
27		Gitlink          string   `json:"gitlink"`
28		HEAD             string   `json:"head,omitempty"`
29		Branch           string   `json:"branch,omitempty"`
30		GitDir           string   `json:"git_dir,omitempty"`
31		CommonDir        string   `json:"common_dir,omitempty"`
32		Initialized      bool     `json:"initialized"`
33		State            string   `json:"state"`
34		Status           Status   `json:"status"`
35		Ignored          int      `json:"ignored"`
36		Blockers         []string `json:"blockers,omitempty"`
37	}

39	type SubmoduleGraph struct {
40		RootIdentity string          `json:"root_identity"`
41		Root         string          `json:"root"`
42		Nodes        []SubmoduleNode `json:"submodules"`
43		Fingerprint  string          `json:"fingerprint"`

46	// SubmodulesOf never fetches and never descends across an unverified Git root.
47	func SubmodulesOf(ctx context.Context, dir string) (SubmoduleGraph, error) {
48		r, err := Discover(ctx, dir)
49		if err != nil {
50			return SubmoduleGraph{}, err
51		}
52		g := SubmoduleGraph{Root: r.Root, Nodes: []SubmoduleNode{}}
53		g.RootIdentity, err = submoduleDirectoryIdentity(r.Root)
54		if err != nil {
55			return g, err
56		}
57		seen := map[string]bool{}
58		var walk func(string, string, int) error
59		walk = func(root, parent string, depth int) error {
60			if depth > 32 || len(g.Nodes) > 1024 {

63			identity, err := Discover(ctx, root)

65				return err

67			if !sameCanonicalPath(identity.Root, root) {

69			}
70			if seen[identity.GitDir] {

72			}
73			seen[identity.GitDir] = true
74			entries, err := submoduleEntries(ctx, root)
75			if err != nil {

77			}
78			for _, entry := range entries {

92				if statErr == nil && (!info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0) {
93					return fmt.Errorf("submodule %s is not a regular directory", rel)
94				}
95				_, markerErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(child, ".git"))
96				if markerErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(markerErr) {
97					return gError(rel, markerErr)
98				}
99				if os.IsNotExist(markerErr) {
100					if statErr == nil {

105						if len(contents) != 0 {

119				if err != nil {
120					return err
121				}
122				n.GitIdentity, err = submoduleDirectoryIdentity(cr.GitDir)
123				if err != nil {

125				}
126				n.HEAD, err = run(ctx, child, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
127				if err != nil {
128					return gError(rel, err)
129				}
130				raw, err := run(ctx, child, "status", "--porcelain=v2", "--branch", "--untracked-files=all", "--ignore-submodules=none", "-z")
131				if err != nil {
132					return gError(rel, err)
133				}
134				n.Status = statusFromOutput(child, raw)
135				n.Branch = n.Status.Branch
136				ignored, err := run(ctx, child, "ls-files", "--others", "--ignored", "--exclude-standard", "-z")
137				if err != nil {
138					return gError(rel, err)
139				}
140				n.Ignored = nonEmptyNULRecords(ignored)
141				if n.HEAD != n.Gitlink {

144				if n.Status.Dirty() {

149				}
150				if operation, active, err := InProgress(child); err != nil {
151					return gError(rel, err)
152				} else if active {

154				}
155				if exists, err := RefState(ctx, child, "refs/stash"); err != nil {
156					return gError(rel, err)
157				} else if exists {

159				}
160				g.Nodes = append(g.Nodes, n)
161				if err := walk(child, rel, depth+1); err != nil {
162					return err
163				}
164			}
165			return nil
166		}
167		if err := walk(r.Root, "", 0); err != nil {

169		}

10	func submoduleDirectoryIdentity(path string) (string, error) {
11		p, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
12		if err != nil {
13			return "", err
14		}
15		h, err := windows.CreateFile(p, windows.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, windows.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS|windows.FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, 0)
16		if err != nil {
17			return "", err
18		}
19		defer windows.CloseHandle(h)
20		var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
21		if err := windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(h, &info); err != nil {
22			return "", err
23		}
24		if info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 || info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY == 0 {
25			return "", fmt.Errorf("unsafe submodule directory %s", path)
26		}
27		return fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%d", info.VolumeSerialNumber, info.FileIndexHigh, info.FileIndexLow), nil
28	}

21		if err != nil {
22			return err
23		}

27		}

29		if err != nil {
30			return err
31		}

35			return err
36		}
37		data, _, err := safefile.ReadStableRegular(ctx, held, "journal.json", info, 1024*1024)
38		held.Close()
39		if err != nil {
40			return err
41		}
42		area, err = pathx.Canonical(area)
43		if err != nil {
44			return err
45		}
46		if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(area, areaIdentity); err != nil {
47			return err
48		}
49		var j removalJournal
50		if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &j); err != nil {
51			return err
52		}
53		if j.Version != 1 || j.Root == "" || j.GitDir == "" || j.Repository == "" || j.Branch == "" || j.Head == "" {
54			return errors.New("incomplete removal journal")
55		}
56		if filepath.Dir(j.Root) != filepath.Dir(area) {
57			return errors.New("journal is not beside its recorded worktree")
58		}
59		r, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, j.Repository)
60		if err != nil {
61			return err
62		}
63		if inside, err := pathx.Contains(r.MainRoot, j.Root); err != nil || inside {
64			return errors.New("recovery target is inside the canonical repository")
65		}
66		if inside, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(r.GitCommonDir, "worktrees"), j.GitDir); err != nil || !inside {
67			return errors.New("journal Git directory is not private worktree metadata")
68		}
69		for _, m := range j.Moves {
70			if filepath.Dir(m.To) != area || (!strings.HasPrefix(filepath.Base(m.To), "checkout-") && filepath.Base(m.To) != "git-modules") {
71				return errors.New("journal contains an unsafe quarantine path")
72			}
73			inside, err := pathx.Contains(j.Root, m.From)
74			if err != nil {
75				return err
76			}
77			if m.From == j.Root || (!inside && m.From != filepath.Join(j.GitDir, "modules")) {

89			return errors.New("recover from outside the target worktree")
90		}
91		return gitx.WithLifecycleLock(ctx, r.GitCommonDir, func() error {
92			if check != nil {
93				if err := check(ctx, j.Root); err != nil {
94					return err
95				}
96			}
97			if _, err := os.Lstat(j.Root); os.IsNotExist(err) {

101				}

103					return err
104				}
105			} else if err != nil {
106				return err
107			}
108			current, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, j.Root)
109			if err != nil {
110				return err
111			}
112			head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, j.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
113			if err != nil {
114				return err
115			}
116			if !current.IsLinkedWorktree || current.GitDir != j.GitDir || head != j.Head {
117				return errors.New("original worktree identity was reused; quarantine retained")
118			}
119			for i := len(j.Moves) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
120				if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(area, areaIdentity); err != nil {
121					return err
122				}
123				m := j.Moves[i]
124				info, err := os.Lstat(m.To)
125				if os.IsNotExist(err) {
126					continue
127				}
128				if err != nil {
129					return err
130				}
131				if !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
132					return errors.New("quarantined directory identity changed")
133				}
134				if existing, err := os.Lstat(m.From); err == nil {
135					if !m.Empty || !existing.IsDir() || existing.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
136						return fmt.Errorf("restore path reused: %s; quarantine retained", m.From)
137					}
138					parent, _, err := safefile.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(m.From))
139					if err != nil {
140						return err
141					}
142					err = safefile.RemoveEmptyChildDir(ctx, parent, filepath.Base(m.From), existing)
143					parent.Close()
144					if err != nil {
145						return fmt.Errorf("restore path is not empty: %s; quarantine retained: %w", m.From, err)
146					}
147				} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {

149				}

155				return err
156			}
157			if err := safefile.VerifyRoot(area, areaIdentity); err != nil {
158				return err
159			}
160			return os.RemoveAll(area)
161		})
162	}
