723	type statusPath struct {
724		Path   string
725		Staged bool
726	}
727	
728	func statusPaths(ctx context.Context, repo string) ([]statusPath, error) {
729		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
730		if err != nil {
731			return nil, err
732		}
733		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
734		var paths []statusPath
735		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
736			entry := fields[i]
737			if len(entry) < 4 {
738				continue
739			}
740			code, path := entry[:2], filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:])
741			paths = append(paths, statusPath{Path: path, Staged: code[0] != ' ' && code[0] != '?'})
742			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
743				i++ // porcelain -z emits the source path as the next field.
744			}
745		}
746		return paths, nil
747	}
748	
749	func isRecognizedArtifact(path string) bool {
750		path = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./"))
751		for _, prefix := range []string{
752			".specstory/history/", ".claude/plans/", ".cursor/plans/", ".cursor/rules/",
753			".opencode/plans/", ".specify/", ".codex/",
754		} {
755			if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
756				return true
757			}
758		}
759		return path == ".specstory/statistics.json"
760	}
761	
762	func normalizePlans(root string, paths []string) ([]string, error) {
763		var out []string
764		for _, path := range paths {
765			if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
766				path = filepath.Join(root, path)
767			}
768			inside, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(root, ".claude", "plans"), path)
769			if err != nil || !inside {
770				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is outside .claude/plans", path)
771			}
772			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
773			if err != nil {
774				return nil, err
775			}
776			info, err := os.Stat(canonical)
777			if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
778				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is not a regular file", path)
779			}
780			out = append(out, canonical)
781		}
782		sort.Strings(out)
783		return out, nil
784	}
785	
786	func gitTracked(ctx context.Context, repo, path string) (bool, error) {
787		rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
788		if err != nil {
789			return false, err
790		}
791		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", "--", rel)
792		if err == nil {
793			return true, nil
794		}
795		var gitErr *gitx.Error
796		if errors.As(err, &gitErr) {
797			return false, nil
798		}
799		return false, err
800	}
801	
802	func ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx context.Context, repo string, allowed []string) error {
803		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z")
804		if err != nil {
805			return err
806		}
807		allow := make(map[string]bool, len(allowed))
808		for _, path := range allowed {
809			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
810			allow[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
811		}
812		for _, path := range strings.Split(out, "\x00") {
813			if path != "" && !allow[filepath.ToSlash(path)] {
814				return fmt.Errorf("index contains unrelated path %s", path)
815			}
816		}
817		return nil
818	}
819	
820	func stagedFilesMatch(ctx context.Context, repo string, paths []string) error {
821		for _, path := range paths {
822			rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
823			if err != nil {
824				return err
825			}
826			workingBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "hash-object", "--", rel)
827			if err != nil {
828				return err
829			}
830			stagedBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "rev-parse", ":"+filepath.ToSlash(rel))
831			if err != nil {
832				return err
833			}
834			if workingBlob != stagedBlob {
835				return fmt.Errorf("staged artifact %s no longer matches scanned working bytes", filepath.ToSlash(rel))
836			}
837		}
838		return nil
839	}
840	
841	func findReceipt(ctx context.Context, repo, intentID string) (string, bool) {
842		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "log", "-n", "100", "--format=%H%x00%B%x00")
843		if err != nil {
844			return "", false
845		}
846		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
847		for i := 0; i+1 < len(fields); i += 2 {
848			if strings.Contains(fields[i+1], "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intentID) {
849				return fields[i], true
850			}
851		}
852		return "", false
853	}

259					return nil
260				}
261				return (&artifact.Service{Store: artifactStore(app)}).ObserveSessionEnd(ctxOf(), runID, time.Now())
262			},
263		}
264		cmd.Flags().StringVar(&runID, "run-id", "", "outer wrapper run id")
265		return cmd
266	}
267	
268	func prepareTarget(app *App, args []string) (string, *task.Task, error) {
269		if len(args) == 1 {
270			expanded := config.Expand(args[0])
271			if info, err := os.Stat(expanded); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
272				return expanded, nil, nil
273			}
274			taskRecord, err := app.Tasks.Resolve(args[0])
275			if err != nil {
276				return "", nil, err
277			}
278			return checkoutOf(taskRecord), taskRecord, nil
279		}
280		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
281		if err != nil {
282			return "", nil, err
283		}
284		if taskRecord, taskErr := app.Tasks.FindByWorktree(cwd); taskErr == nil {
285			return checkoutOf(taskRecord), taskRecord, nil
286		}
287		return cwd, nil, nil
288	}
289	
290	func inferAgentSession(ctx context.Context, rt interface {
291		List(context.Context) ([]runtime.Session, error)
292	}, worktree string) (string, error) {
293		sessions, err := rt.List(ctx)
294		if err != nil {
295			return "", err
296		}
297		set := make(map[string]bool)
298		for _, session := range sessions {
299			if session.Covers(worktree) {
300				for _, id := range session.AgentSessions {
301					set[id] = true
302				}
303			}
304		}
305		if len(set) != 1 {
306			return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot infer one agent session for %s; pass --session provider:uuid", config.Contract(worktree))
307		}
308		for id := range set {
309			return id, nil
310		}
311		panic("unreachable")
312	}
313	
314	func scanAgentArtifacts(ctx context.Context, repo string, paths []string) error {
315		script := findArtifactScanner(repo)
316		if script == "" {
317			return fmt.Errorf("agent-history-hygiene scan-staged.sh not found")
318		}
319		redactor := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(script)), "assets", "redact_secrets.py")
320		if info, err := os.Stat(redactor); err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
321			return fmt.Errorf("agent-history-hygiene redactor not found")
322		}
323		parents := make(map[string]bool)
324		for _, path := range paths {
325			rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, filepath.Dir(path))
326			if err != nil || strings.HasPrefix(rel, "..") {
327				return fmt.Errorf("artifact path is outside repository")
328			}
329			parents[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
330		}
331		redactArgs := []string{redactor, "--fix", "--paths"}
332		for parent := range parents {
333			redactArgs = append(redactArgs, parent)
334		}
335		if err := runSanitized(ctx, repo, "python3", redactArgs...); err != nil {
336			return fmt.Errorf("artifact redactor failed: %w", err)
337		}
338		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, append([]string{"add", "--"}, paths...)...); err != nil {
339			return fmt.Errorf("restage redacted artifacts")
340		}
341		if err := runSanitized(ctx, repo, "bash", script); err != nil {
342			return fmt.Errorf("artifact scanner failed: %w", err)
343		}
344		return nil
345	}
346	
347	func runSanitized(ctx context.Context, dir, name string, args ...string) error {
348		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
349		cmd.Dir = dir
350		var output bytes.Buffer
351		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &output, &output
352		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
353			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
354			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) {
355				return fmt.Errorf("exit %d", exitErr.ExitCode())
356			}
357			return fmt.Errorf("execute %s", name)
358		}
359		return nil
360	}

362	func findArtifactScanner(repo string) string {
363		candidates := []string{
364			filepath.Join(repo, ".claude", "skills", "agent-history-hygiene", "scripts", "scan-staged.sh"),
365			filepath.Join(repo, ".agents", "skills", "agent-history-hygiene", "scripts", "scan-staged.sh"),
366			filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), ".agents", "skills", "agent-history-hygiene", "scripts", "scan-staged.sh"),
367		}
368		for _, candidate := range candidates {
369			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular() {
370				return candidate
371			}
372		}
373		return ""
374	}
375	
376	func shortOID(value string) string {
377		if len(value) > 12 {
378			return value[:12]
379		}
380		return value
381	}
382	
383	func ensureArtifactsFinalized(app *App, worktree string) error {
384		store := artifactStore(app)
385		intents, err := store.List()
386		if err != nil {
387			return err
388		}
389		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree)
390		if err != nil {
391			return err
392		}
393		proof, e := artifact.InspectHistoryReadiness(context.Background(), store, worktree)
394		if e != nil {
395			return e
396		}
397		if proof != nil && !proof.Ready {
398			return errors.New("ignored agent history still needs a verified external archive before integration or retirement")
399		}
400		for _, intent := range intents {
401			intentPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
402			if canonicalErr != nil || intentPath != canonical {
403				continue
404			}
405			if intent.Status == artifact.Discarded {
406				continue
407			}
408			if intent.Status != artifact.Finalized {
409				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent for %s is %s; finalize it, or discard it with `dev artifact discard %s`, before integration or retirement",
410					config.Contract(worktree), intent.Status, intent.ID)
411			}
412			reconciled, reconcileErr := (&artifact.Service{Store: store}).Finalize(context.Background(), artifact.FinalizeRequest{IntentID: intent.ID})
413			if reconcileErr != nil {
414				return reconcileErr
415			}
416			intent = *reconciled
417			if (intent.ArtifactCommit == "" && intent.ArchiveCommit == "") || !artifactCommitReachable(intent) {
418				return fmt.Errorf("artifact commit for %s is no longer reachable; restore or re-finalize intent %s before integration or retirement",
419					config.Contract(worktree), intent.ID)
420			}
421		}
422		return nil
423	}
424	
425	func artifactCommitReachable(intent artifact.Intent) bool {
426		return artifact.CommitReachable(context.Background(), intent)
427	}
428	
429	func artifactStatuses(app *App) (map[string]string, error) {
430		inspections, err := artifact.InspectWorktrees(context.Background(), artifactStore(app))
431		if err != nil {
432			return nil, err
433		}
434		statuses := make(map[string]string, len(inspections))
435		for path, inspection := range inspections {
436			statuses[path] = string(inspection.Status)
437		}
438		return statuses, nil
439	}
440	
441	func artifactStatusForPath(statuses map[string]string, path string) string {
442		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
443		if err != nil {
444			return ""
445		}
446		return statuses[canonical]
447	}
448	
449	func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
450		for _, value := range values {
451			if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
452				return value
453			}
454		}
455		return ""
456	}

51	func (m Model) startLocalLoad() tea.Cmd {
52		if m.actions.Local.Start == nil {
53			return nil
54		}
55		request := LocalLoadRequest{
56			CycleGeneration: m.localGeneration,
57			TasksGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTasks).generation,
58			ReposGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewRepos).generation,
59			TriesGeneration: m.viewLoad(ViewTries).generation,
60			ShowAllTries:    m.showAllTries,
61			ForceSizes:      m.forceSizeReload,
62		}
63		load := m.actions.Local.Start(m.localReadContext(), request)
64		load.Request = request
65		if load.ID == 0 || load.Results == nil {
66			return nil
67		}
68		return waitForLocal(load)
69	}

71	func waitForLocal(load LocalLoad) tea.Cmd {
72		return func() tea.Msg {
73			result, ok := <-load.Results
74			if !ok {
75				return localMsg{load: load, done: true}
76			}
77			return localMsg{load: load, result: result}
78		}
79	}

36	// FindTranscript selects exactly one SpecStory transcript by its anchored
37	// preamble session UUID. UUID mentions later in a transcript are never used.
38	func FindTranscript(worktree, provider, sessionID string) (Transcript, error) {
39		history := filepath.Join(worktree, ".specstory", "history")
40		entries, err := os.ReadDir(history)
41		if err != nil {
42			return Transcript{}, err
43		}
44		var matches []Transcript
45		for _, entry := range entries {
46			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
47				continue
48			}
49			path := filepath.Join(history, entry.Name())
50			inside, err := pathx.Contains(history, path)
51			if err != nil || !inside {
52				continue
53			}
54			gotProvider, gotSession, err := transcriptPreamble(path)
55			if err != nil || gotSession != sessionID || (provider != "" && gotProvider != provider) {
56				continue
57			}
58			matches = append(matches, Transcript{Path: path, Provider: gotProvider, SessionID: gotSession})
59		}
60		switch len(matches) {
61		case 1:
62			return matches[0], nil
63		case 0:
64			return Transcript{}, fmt.Errorf("no SpecStory transcript with preamble session %s:%s", provider, sessionID)
65		default:
66			return Transcript{}, fmt.Errorf("multiple SpecStory transcripts have preamble session %s:%s", provider, sessionID)
67		}
68	}
69	
70	// ReadTranscriptSession proves the bounded SpecStory preamble identity of one
71	// regular transcript file. Unlike legacy transcript lookup, ownership proof
72	// requires the generated marker, title, and a complete canonical session UUID
73	// before any body content. Symlinks and body/fenced UUID mentions never prove it.
74	func ReadTranscriptSession(path string) (provider, sessionID string, err error) {
75		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
76		if err != nil {
77			return "", "", err
78		}
79		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
80			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("SpecStory transcript is not a regular file")
81		}
82		file, err := os.Open(path)
83		if err != nil {
84			return "", "", err
85		}
86		defer file.Close()
87		opened, err := file.Stat()
88		if err != nil {
89			return "", "", err
90		}
91		if !os.SameFile(info, opened) {
92			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("SpecStory transcript changed while opening")
93		}
94		provider, sessionID, err = specStoryPreamble(file)
95		if err != nil {
96			return "", "", err
97		}
98		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
99		if err != nil {
100			return "", "", err
101		}
102		if !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(info, current) || info.Size() != current.Size() || !info.ModTime().Equal(current.ModTime()) {
103			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("SpecStory transcript changed while reading")
104		}
105		return provider, sessionID, nil
106	}
107	
108	func specStoryPreamble(reader io.Reader) (provider, sessionID string, err error) {
109		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(io.LimitReader(reader, 16<<10))
110		heading := false
111		for line := 0; line < 12 && scanner.Scan(); line++ {
112			text := scanner.Text()
113			if line == 0 {
114				if !specStoryGeneratedLine.MatchString(text) {
115					break
116				}
117				continue
118			}
119			if text == "" {
120				continue
121			}
122			if !heading {
123				if !strings.HasPrefix(text, "# ") || strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(text, "# ")) == "" {
124					break
125				}
126				heading = true
127				continue
128			}
129			match := specStorySessionLine.FindStringSubmatch(text)
130			if len(match) != 3 {
131				break // The first nonblank line after the title must be metadata, not body.
132			}
133			id, parseErr := uuid.Parse(match[2])
134			if parseErr != nil || id == uuid.Nil || !strings.EqualFold(id.String(), match[2]) {
135				break
136			}
137			return normalizeProvider(match[1]), id.String(), nil
138		}
139		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
140			return "", "", err
141		}
142		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("valid SpecStory session preamble not found")
143	}
144	
145	func transcriptPreamble(path string) (provider, sessionID string, err error) {
146		file, err := os.Open(path)
147		if err != nil {
148			return "", "", err
149		}
150		defer file.Close()
151		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(io.LimitReader(file, 16<<10))
152		for line := 0; scanner.Scan() && line < 12; line++ {
153			match := transcriptSessionLine.FindStringSubmatch(scanner.Text())
154			if len(match) != 3 {
155				continue
156			}
157			return normalizeProvider(match[1]), match[2], nil
158		}
159		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
160			return "", "", err
161		}
162		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("SpecStory session preamble not found")
163	}
164	
165	func normalizeProvider(label string) string {
166		label = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(label))
167		for _, provider := range []string{"claude", "codex", "cursor", "gemini", "antigravity", "deepseek", "droid"} {
168			if strings.Contains(label, provider) {
169				return provider
170			}
171		}
172		if first, _, ok := strings.Cut(label, " "); ok {
173			return first
174		}
175		return label
176	}
177	
178	// StableSnapshot requires the transcript bytes and metadata to remain unchanged
179	// across a settle interval.
180	func StableSnapshot(ctx context.Context, path string, settle time.Duration) (Snapshot, error) {
181		if settle <= 0 {
182			settle = 250 * time.Millisecond
183		}
184		first, err := snapshot(path)
185		if err != nil {
186			return Snapshot{}, err
187		}
188		select {
189		case <-ctx.Done():
190			return Snapshot{}, ctx.Err()
191		case <-time.After(settle):
192		}
193		second, err := snapshot(path)
194		if err != nil {
195			return Snapshot{}, err
196		}
197		if first.Size != second.Size || !first.ModTime.Equal(second.ModTime) || first.SHA256 != second.SHA256 {
198			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("transcript is still changing")
199		}
200		return second, nil
201	}
202	
203	func snapshot(path string) (Snapshot, error) {
204		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
205		if err != nil {
206			return Snapshot{}, err
207		}
208		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
209			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("transcript is not a regular file")
210		}

22	var ErrIntentNotFound = errors.New("artifact intent not found")
23	
24	// Store keeps one strict JSON intent per finalization handoff.
25	type Store struct {
26		Dir   string
27		clock func() time.Time
28		newID func() string
29	}
30	
31	func NewStore(dir string) *Store {
32		return &Store{Dir: dir, clock: time.Now, newID: randomID}
33	}
34	
35	func (s *Store) path(id string) string { return filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".json") }
36	
37	func (s *Store) Create(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
38		if intent == nil {
39			return fmt.Errorf("create nil artifact intent")
40		}
41		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
42			candidate := *intent
43			if candidate.ID == "" {
44				candidate.ID = s.newID()
45			}
46			candidate.SchemaVersion = SchemaVersion
47			candidate.Status = Armed
48			now := s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
49			candidate.CreatedAt, candidate.UpdatedAt = now, now
50			if err := candidate.Validate(); err != nil {
51				return err
52			}
53			if _, err := os.Stat(s.path(candidate.ID)); err == nil {
54				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s already exists", candidate.ID)
55			} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
56				return err
57			}
58			if err := s.write(candidate); err != nil {
59				return err
60			}
61			*intent = candidate
62			return nil
63		})
64	}
65	
66	func (s *Store) Get(id string) (*Intent, error) {
67		if !idPattern.MatchString(id) {
68			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid artifact intent id %q", id)
69		}
70		file, err := os.Open(s.path(id))
71		if err != nil {
72			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
73				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s: %w", id, ErrIntentNotFound)
74			}
75			return nil, err
76		}
77		defer file.Close()
78		decoder := json.NewDecoder(file)
79		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
80		var intent Intent
81		if err := decoder.Decode(&intent); err != nil {
82			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
83		}
84		if err := ensureJSONEOF(decoder); err != nil {
85			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode artifact intent %s: %w", id, err)
86		}
87		if intent.ID != id {
88			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact intent filename %s disagrees with id %s", id, intent.ID)
89		}
90		if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
91			return nil, err
92		}
93		return &intent, nil
94	}
95	
96	func (s *Store) List() ([]Intent, error) {
97		entries, err := os.ReadDir(s.Dir)
98		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
99			// Windows can report PATH_NOT_FOUND when the target or an ancestor
100			// is a file. Only genuine directory absence means an empty store.
101			missing, inspectErr := missingStoreDirectory(s.Dir)
102			if inspectErr != nil {
103				return nil, inspectErr
104			}
105			if missing {
106				return nil, nil
107			}
108		}
109		if err != nil {
110			return nil, err
111		}
112		var intents []Intent
113		for _, entry := range entries {
114			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json") {
115				continue
116			}
117			intent, err := s.Get(strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), ".json"))
118			if err != nil {
119				return nil, err
120			}
121			intents = append(intents, *intent)
122		}
123		sort.Slice(intents, func(i, j int) bool { return intents[i].CreatedAt.Before(intents[j].CreatedAt) })
124		return intents, nil
125	}
126	
127	func missingStoreDirectory(dir string) (bool, error) {
128		absolute, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
129		if err != nil {
130			return false, err
131		}
132		for probe := absolute; ; probe = filepath.Dir(probe) {
133			info, err := os.Lstat(probe)
134			if err == nil {
135				if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
136					info, err = os.Stat(probe)
137					if err != nil {
138						return false, err
139					}
140				}
141				if !info.IsDir() {
142					return false, &os.PathError{Op: "readdir", Path: dir, Err: syscall.ENOTDIR}
143				}
144				return probe != absolute, nil
145			}
146			if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) || filepath.Dir(probe) == probe {
147				return false, err
148			}
149		}
150	}
151	
152	func (s *Store) FindByRunID(runID string) (*Intent, error) {
153		intents, err := s.List()
154		if err != nil {

164	
165	func (s *Store) Update(ctx context.Context, id string, mutate func(*Intent) error) error {
166		if mutate == nil {
167			return fmt.Errorf("artifact update needs a mutation")
168		}
169		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "artifact intent", func() error {
170			intent, err := s.Get(id)
171			if err != nil {
172				return err
173			}
174			if err := mutate(intent); err != nil {
175				return err
176			}
177			intent.UpdatedAt = s.clock().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
178			if err := intent.Validate(); err != nil {
179				return err
180			}
181			return s.write(*intent)
182		})
183	}
184	
185	func (s *Store) write(intent Intent) error {
186		if err := os.MkdirAll(s.Dir, 0o700); err != nil {
187			return err

194		defer os.Remove(name)
195		if err := tmp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
196			tmp.Close()
197			return err
198		}
199		encoder := json.NewEncoder(tmp)
200		encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
201		if err := encoder.Encode(intent); err != nil {
202			tmp.Close()
203			return err
204		}
205		if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
206			tmp.Close()
207			return err
208		}
209		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
210			return err

212		return os.Rename(name, s.path(intent.ID))
213	}
214	
215	func ensureJSONEOF(decoder *json.Decoder) error {
216		var extra any
217		if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
218			return nil
219		} else if err != nil {
220			return err
221		}
222		return fmt.Errorf("multiple JSON values")
223	}
224	
225	func randomID() string {
226		var raw [12]byte
227		if _, err := rand.Read(raw[:]); err != nil {
228			return fmt.Sprintf("intent-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
229		}
230		return "intent-" + hex.EncodeToString(raw[:])

1	# Post-session finalization
2	
3	Use this runbook for the default SpecStory/Claude lifecycle, any finalizer
4	recovery, and every rebase/integration/retirement decision that follows it.
5	
6	## Hard boundary
7	
8	An active transcript recorder blocks:
9	
10	- `git commit` (including amend/fixup);
11	- `git pull --rebase`, `git rebase`, and update-base helpers;
12	- merge/cherry-pick/integration into another ref; and
13	- worktree, branch, or agent-session retirement.
14	
15	Required order:
16	
17	```text
18	recorder exits and the exact session is synced
19	  -> exact artifacts are staged/sanitized and the message is finalized
20	  -> one ordinary hook-enabled commit is proven
21	  -> only then may history/ref movement or retirement begin
22	```
23	
24	A commit draft, a queued request, a clean scan, or a manual commit command is not
25	proof of completion by itself.
26	
27	## Lifecycle diagram
28	
29	```text
30	shell parent
31	  |
32	  | run-specstory-session.sh --allow-commit claude
33	  v
34	running: foreground `specstory run claude`
35	  |
36	  | child stages feature paths only
37	  | explicit user commit authorization
38	  | queue-agent-commit.sh + exact selectors
39	  v
40	pending: inert metadata-only request (no transcript read/mutation/commit)
41	  |
42	  | child reports "finalization queued" and exits; no more repo operations
43	  v
44	child_exited (must be exit 0)
45	  |
46	  | one exact `specstory sync claude -s UUID --silent`
47	  | exact selector/path proof
48	  v
49	synced
50	  |
51	  | parent-held token authorizes one finalizer call
52	  | prove no writer + unchanged HEAD/ref/index tree
53	  | stage/sanitize exact artifacts in locked alternate index
54	  v
55	prepared ----------------------------+
56	  |                                    |
57	  | sanitation changed bytes           | message + provenance validation
58	  v                                    | handoff drafts
59	rotation_required                      v
60	  |                                  committing
61	  | rotate credential                  |
62	  | fresh manual authorization          | one ordinary `git commit -F`
63	  | + --rotation-confirmed              v
64	  +----------------------------------> done (exact commit proven)
65	
66	Any uncertain commit outcome remains `committing`: reconcile only, never retry.
67	```
68	
69	No request means `done/no_request`. A nonzero/signaled child or failed exact sync
70	does not enter finalization.
71	
72	## Authorization model
73	
74	Three separate facts are required:
75	
76	1. **Launcher capability:** `run-specstory-session.sh --allow-commit` lets the
77	   outer parent call the finalizer once after successful child exit and sync.
78	2. **User intent:** the child queues only after the user explicitly authorizes
79	   the commit. Launcher capability is not permission to infer that intent.
80	3. **Recovery authorization:** every manual finalizer invocation repeats
81	   `--allow-commit`. A stored request, journal, message, or draft is never commit
82	   authority.
83	
84	`queue-agent-commit.sh --commit` names the requested action; it does not execute
85	or independently authorize a commit. `--runner-token` belongs only to the outer
86	runner and must never be passed to the child.
87	
88	## Default commands
89	
90	### 1. Start in the intended worktree
91	
92	Create the worktree before the recorder. Then launch:
93	
94	```bash
95	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/run-specstory-session.sh \
96	  --allow-commit claude
97	```
98	
99	Pass SpecStory options only after `--`, for example:
100	
101	```bash
102	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/run-specstory-session.sh \
103	  --allow-commit claude -- --resume SESSION_UUID
104	```
105	
106	The child receives only `AGENT_HISTORY_REQUEST_PATH` and
107	`AGENT_HISTORY_RUN_ID`. Neither value authorizes finalization.
108	
109	### 2. Prepare exact inputs inside Claude
110	
111	Take the lowercase UUID from `/status`. Resolve an exact direct child of
112	`.specstory/history/`; if the UUID has aliases, supply the path as well. Decide
113	explicitly between one exact plan and no plan.
114	
115	```bash
116	SESSION_ID=01234567-89ab-4cde-8fab-0123456789ab
117	TRANSCRIPT='.specstory/history/2026-09-01_02-14-50Z.md'
118	PLAN='.claude/plans/exact-change.md'
119	
120	git add -- path/to/feature-a path/to/feature-b
121	```
122	
123	Stage only intended non-artifact feature paths. Do not stage the live transcript
124	or plan; do not use broad `git add -A`.
125	
126	### 3. Queue only after explicit user commit authorization
127	
128	The base message must be nonempty UTF-8 subject/body and must not already carry
129	`AI-Assisted-By`, `Agent-Transcript`, `Agent-Plan`, or
130	`Agent-History-Request`; the finalizer owns those trailers.
131	
132	```bash
133	MESSAGE_FILE="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/agent-commit-message.txt"
134	printf '%s\n' \
135	  'feat(scope): summarize the change' \
136	  '' \
137	  'Explain the reason for the change.' > "$MESSAGE_FILE"
138	
139	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/queue-agent-commit.sh \
140	  --commit \
141	  --session-id "$SESSION_ID" \
142	  --specstory-path "$TRANSCRIPT" \
143	  --plan "$PLAN" \
144	  --message-file "$MESSAGE_FILE"
145	```
146	
147	Use `--no-plan` instead of `--plan` only when no plan exists. Version 1 of the
148	post-session queue always requires a rendered SpecStory path.
149	
150	A successful response is one bounded JSON object with `status=queued`. An
151	identical second request is idempotent; a different request conflicts and the
152	first remains authoritative.
153	
154	After success:
155	
156	1. say **"finalization queued"**;
157	2. exit the Claude session; and
158	3. perform no more repository/index operations—not status, diff, staging,
159	   message editing, sync, finalizer, rebase, integration, or retirement.
160	
161	The queue captures the attached branch, HEAD object, and staged index tree. Any
162	later branch/index change makes it stale.
163	
164	## Why finalization waits for process exit
165	
166	### Normal pre-commit is unsafe during an active writer
167	
168	When staged files also have unstaged changes, pre-commit can stash the unstaged
169	patch, check out or rewrite the staged view for hooks, and restore the patch
170	afterward. An active recorder can append between those checkout/restore steps.
171	The restore may conflict, clobber a generation, or reintroduce bytes that a hook
172	just removed. Even without a mutating hook, the recorder can change content
173	after validation but before the commit object is created.
174	
175	Therefore:
176	
177	- `check-agent-artifact-secrets` is validation-only;
178	- generic mutating hooks/formatters exclude all agent/archive/install roots;
179	- no hook sanitizes or re-stages a working-tree transcript; and
180	- the post-session finalizer is the sole sanctioned mutator.
181	
182	### Why not a Stop hook, daemon, or live checkpoint
183	
184	- A Claude Stop hook runs before child/process and recorder quiescence are
185	  proven. It cannot establish the post-exit sync boundary.
186	- A detached `specstory watch` daemon outlives the agent and breaks the parent's
187	  recorder-lifetime proof.
188	- A live checkpoint necessarily snapshots a file that can still be appended and
189	  invites repeated pre-commit/stash races.
190	
191	The synchronous foreground wrapper is deliberate: the outer parent owns the
192	process group, forwards termination signals, waits for real exit, records proof,
193	then syncs and finalizes.
194	
195	## What the finalizer proves and changes
196	
197	On an initial authorized pass, the finalizer:
198	
199	1. validates private run state, request digest, per-worktree path, successful
200	   child exit, exact completed sync, and parent authorization;
201	2. rejects active Git operations, locks, changed branch/HEAD/index tree, unsafe
202	   paths, and an active/changing transcript writer;
203	3. revalidates the exact UUID + SpecStory path and exact plan policy;
204	4. calls `stage-agent-artifacts.sh --session-only ... --sanitize-index
205	   --materialize-sanitized`;
206	5. derives provenance from staged blobs, composes one canonical message, and
207	   validates it;
208	6. writes owned per-worktree handoff drafts;
209	7. calls one ordinary `git commit -F` with `SKIP` removed and all hooks enabled;
210	   and
211	8. proves the new commit's branch, single parent, tree, and unique
212	   `Agent-History-Request` trailer.
213	
214	Artifact staging runs under the real index lock against a copied alternate
215	index. `--sanitize-index` edits only exact selected stage-0 blobs, then requires
216	a clean post-check. `--materialize-sanitized` writes only those sanitized bytes
217	through Git checkout filters after proving the live clean hashes still match the
218	pre-sanitize blobs. The real index is atomically published only after success.
219	
220	## Redactor and scanner safety
221	
222	`redact_secrets.py --check-index` may inspect the canonical index or Git's
223	commit-time temporary index. `--fix-index` refuses mutation unless
224	`GIT_INDEX_FILE` explicitly names an existing, user-owned, nonsymlink,
225	noncanonical regular file; it also requires exact unique `--files` under the
226	configured artifact roots.
227	
228	Complete PEM/OpenVPN/PuTTY private-key records are replaced wholesale. A header
229	without a complete bounded record fails closed: partial redaction could leave
230	private material behind, so no index/worktree publication occurs.
231	
232	Public wrapper/finalizer output is scanner-safe:
233	
234	- raw gitleaks stdout/stderr is suppressed;
235	- `Secret` and `Match` never appear in `scan-staged.sh` JSONL, even with
236	  `--no-redact`;
237	- emitted fields are bounded/validated path, rule id, line, and commit marker;
238	- finalizer JSON reports status/ids only; and
239	- unsafe selectors and private hook/scanner diagnostics are not reflected.
240	
241	`--redact` on `scan-staged.sh` masks scanner report output only; it never changes
242	files or an index.
243	
244	### Local raw-object caveat
245	
246	The exact staging transaction may cause Git to write the original live blob to
247	the local object database before the alternate index entry is replaced by its
248	sanitized blob. The raw object is then unreachable and is not included in the
249	prepared commit, but it can remain locally until Git garbage collection. This
250	is not secure erasure and does not cover shell history, recorder storage,
251	backups, or prior clones. Rotation is mandatory whenever sanitation changed
252	bytes.
253	
254	## States
255	
256	| State | Meaning | Commit permitted? |
257	|---|---|---|
258	| `running` | foreground recorder/Claude child is active | No |
259	| `pending` | one inert exact request was queued | No |
260	| `child_exited` | child returned 0; sync not yet proven | No |
261	| `syncing` | one exact quiet sync is in progress | No |
262	| `synced` | exit 0 + exact sync/session proof recorded | Finalizer may prepare |
263	| `prepared` | exact sanitized tree and message proof retained | One freshly authorized finalizer recovery |
264	| `rotation_required` | sanitation changed bytes; commit was not attempted | Only after rotation + fresh two-flag confirmation |
265	| `committing` | a prior ordinary commit outcome may be uncertain | Reconcile only; never retry |
266	| `done` | no request, or exact commit object proven | History movement allowed only for proven commit |
267	| `failed` | lifecycle stopped before a safe/proven completion | Follow status-specific recovery |
268	
269	Private run directories are `0700`; request, journal, and owned messages are
270	`0600` under the current worktree's Git directory. A linked worktree cannot
271	consume another worktree's request.
272	
273	## Outcome contracts
274	
275	### Success
276	
277	`status=committed`, exit 0 means:
278	
279	- one ordinary commit returned success;
280	- all configured hooks ran normally;
281	- the exact parent/tree/ref and request trailer were proven; and
282	- the matching LazyGit pending draft was removed.
283	
284	`status=already_committed`, exit 0 means a later reconciliation re-proved the
285	recorded commit without another commit attempt. Only these proven outcomes open
286	the rebase/integration/retirement gate.
287	
288	### Rotation stop
289	
290	`status=rotation_required`, exit 10 means:
291	
292	- exact index and matching live artifacts were sanitized;
293	- prepared parent/tree and both drafts are ready;
294	- no commit or hook was attempted; and
295	- rotation is now required, including because of the unreachable-local-object
296	  caveat above.
297	
298	After rotation, resume exactly once with fresh manual authorization:
299	
300	```bash
301	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/finalize-agent-commit.sh \
302	  --request "$ABSOLUTE_REQUEST_PATH" \
303	  --allow-commit \
304	  --rotation-confirmed
305	```
306	
307	The recovery validates the retained tree and clean index; it does not re-stage.
308	The runner never supplies `--rotation-confirmed`.
309	
310	### Ordinary hook/commit failure
311	
312	`status=commit_failed`, exit 11 means HEAD and the expected prepared tree are
313	unchanged. The prepared snapshot and drafts remain. Fix the hook/dependency
314	without altering that snapshot, then issue one fresh, explicit recovery:
315	
316	```bash
317	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/finalize-agent-commit.sh \
318	  --request "$ABSOLUTE_REQUEST_PATH" \
319	  --allow-commit
320	```
321	
322	There is no automatic retry. If the index/HEAD changed, the status becomes
323	`commit_failed_snapshot_changed` or `stale_prepared_state`; retire that request
324	and queue a fresh run rather than retrying it.
325	
326	### Manual handoff
327	
328	The finalizer writes the complete composed message to both per-worktree Git
329	paths:
330	
331	- LazyGit reads `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT`;
332	- standard Git uses `COMMIT_EDITMSG`.
333	
334	Resolve them with `git rev-parse --git-path ...`; do not assume the primary
335	checkout's `.git/` path in a linked worktree. Foreign or user-edited drafts are
336	never overwritten.
337	
338	Prefer authorized finalizer recovery. If the user deliberately commits from a
339	handoff draft, that is a manual escape hatch outside the managed proof path. The
340	draft is recoverable input, not proof; verify the actual commit parent/tree,
341	hooks, canonical trailers, and `Agent-History-Request` before allowing any
342	history movement. A `prepared` journal does not certify a manual commit.
343	
344	## Exit codes
345	
346	### Queue
347	
348	| Exit | Contract |
349	|---:|---|
350	| 0 | request written, or identical request already exists |
351	| 1 | invalid/incomplete arguments |
352	| 2 | not in a Git worktree |
353	| 3 | dependency unavailable |
354	| 4 | selector/message validation failed |
355	| 5 | unsafe/stale state, no staged feature diff, or conflicting request |
356	| 6 | Git/lifecycle operation lock active |
357	
358	### Runner
359	
360	| Exit | Contract |
361	|---:|---|
362	| 0 | child succeeded; no automatic finalizer failed (may be no request or authorization-required) |
363	| 1–255 | nonzero child status preserved exactly |
364	| 2 | invalid runner arguments |
365	| 3 | dependency unavailable |
366	| 10 | finalizer stopped for rotation |
367	| 11 | ordinary commit failed; prepared snapshot/drafts retained |
368	| 21 | exact sync failed; no finalizer call |
369	| 22 | child process group remained live; request retained, no sync/finalizer |
370	| 23 | successful child exit could not be durably proven |
371	| 128+N | child terminated by signal N; request retained, no sync/finalizer |
372	
373	### Finalizer
374	
375	| Exit | Contract |
376	|---:|---|
377	| 0 | commit completed or already-completed commit re-proven |
378	| 1 | invalid arguments |
379	| 2 | not in a Git worktree |
380	| 3 | dependency unavailable |
381	| 4 | malformed/unsafe request or journal |
382	| 5 | authorization/path mismatch |
383	| 6 | stale Git state, active operation/lock, or missing lifecycle proof |
384	| 7 | exact selector, staging, scanner, metadata, or message validation failed |
385	| 8 | prior commit outcome unproven; reconciliation only, never retry |
386	| 9 | unrelated/edited draft would be overwritten |
387	| 10 | sanitation changed content; rotate and explicitly confirm recovery |
388	| 11 | ordinary commit failed; retry only when exact prepared snapshot is retained |
389	
390	## Recovery and no-retry table
391	
392	Every manual attempt requires fresh `--allow-commit`. Never loop on a finalizer
393	exit.
394	
395	| Status/symptom | Safe next action | Forbidden action |
396	|---|---|---|
397	| `authorization_required` after runner exit 0 | run finalizer once with request path + `--allow-commit` | treating request as authority |
398	| child nonzero/signal | fix cause; start a fresh wrapper and requeue | syncing/finalizing the unproven run |
399	| `sync_failed` | fix sync; start a fresh wrapper/run so sync proof is journaled; requeue | hand-editing journal or calling commit directly |
400	| `active_writer` / transient exact validation failure | stop writer, preserve branch/index, retry once with fresh authorization | staging while writer remains active |
401	| `stale_state` before preparation | restage intended feature paths and queue a new run | forcing old request over changed tree/ref |
402	| `draft_conflict` | preserve or deliberately remove the foreign draft, then recover with fresh authorization | overwriting a nonmatching draft |
403	| `rotation_required` | rotate; use fresh `--allow-commit --rotation-confirmed` | committing before rotation; re-staging raw artifacts |
404	| `commit_failed` with prepared snapshot retained | fix hook only; fresh `--allow-commit` | automatic retry or changing the prepared tree |
405	| `commit_failed_snapshot_changed` | inspect and queue a new request | retrying old request |
406	| exit 8 / state `committing` | invoke only for reconciliation or inspect exact HEAD/journal | another `git commit` |
407	| manual commit from draft | independently verify exact commit and hooks | calling draft existence “proven” |
408	
409	For state `committing`, a repeated finalizer invocation may only prove the exact
410	HEAD and return `already_committed`; it must never issue a second commit. If it
411	cannot prove the outcome, stop and inspect.
412	
413	## Rebase and history boundary
414	
415	Queue/finalization rejects merge, cherry-pick, revert, bisect, sequencer,
416	`rebase-merge`, `rebase-apply`, and index-lock state. This is both a consistency
417	gate and a history-safety gate: the queued request binds one attached branch,
418	parent, and index tree.
419	
420	A stale `REBASE_HEAD` file alone is **not** an active rebase and must not block a
421	valid finalization. Detect real rebase state via the actual per-worktree Git
422	state directories:
423	
424	```bash
425	git rev-parse --git-path rebase-merge
426	git rev-parse --git-path rebase-apply
427	```
428	
429	Do not run update-base, `pull --rebase`, merge/integration, or retirement merely
430	because the finalizer wrote drafts or returned a recoverable status. Wait for a
431	proven `committed`/`already_committed` result, then begin a separate ordinary Git
432	operation.
433	
434	## Cross-reference
435	
436	- [`pre-commit-redaction-stack.md`](./pre-commit-redaction-stack.md) — staged
437	  checker, sanitation, scanner output, and unpublished release pin.
438	- [`transcript-session-discovery.md`](./transcript-session-discovery.md) — exact
439	  UUID/path proof and alternate-index staging.
440	- [`specstory-native-redaction.md`](./specstory-native-redaction.md) — native
441	  redaction coverage and residual gaps.
442	- [`remediation.md`](./remediation.md) — rotate-first response when a credential
443	  was already committed or pushed.

145	func runRepoCloneWizard(app *App, flags repoBootstrapFlags) (repoWorkflowRequest, bool, bool, error) {

155	func promptRepoCloneReference(app *App, p *prompter) (string, error) {
156		manual := func() (string, error) {
157			return p.line("Git URL, path, or owner/name", "")
158		}
159		if !app.canPick() {
160			return manual()
161		}
162	
163		rows, ok, stale := cachedRemoteRows(app)
164		if !ok {
165			return manual()
166		}
167		items := make([]picker.Item, 0, len(rows)+1)
168		for _, row := range rows {
169			remote := row.Repo
170			if strings.TrimSpace(remote.CloneURL) == "" {
171				continue
172			}
173			var details []string
174			if remote.Visibility != "" {
175				details = append(details, strings.ToLower(remote.Visibility))
176			}
177			if remote.Archived {
178				details = append(details, "archived")
179			}
180			if remote.Description != "" {
181				details = append(details, truncate(remote.Description, 72))
182			}
183			items = append(items, picker.Item{
184				Value:       remote.CloneURL,
185				Label:       remote.Label(),
186				Description: strings.Join(details, " · "),
187			})
188		}
189		if len(items) == 0 {
190			return manual()
191		}
192		items = append(items, picker.Item{
193			Value:       manualCloneReference,
194			Label:       "Enter a URL, path, or owner/name manually…",
195			Description: "use a source not present in the cached forge inventory",
196		})
197		if stale {
198			app.warnf("remote cache is stale or incomplete; run `dev repo remote --refresh` to update picker candidates")
199		}
200		result, used, err := app.pick(ctxOf(), picker.Request{Prompt: "Repository to clone", Items: items})
201		if errors.Is(err, picker.ErrCanceled) {
202			return "", errPromptCanceled
203		}
204		if err != nil {
205			return "", err
206		}
207		if !used || result.Item.Value == manualCloneReference {
208			return manual()
209		}
210		return result.Item.Value, nil
211	}

213	func promptRepoCloneWizard(app *App, p *prompter, flags repoBootstrapFlags, ref string, offerSetup bool) (repoWorkflowRequest, bool, bool, error) {
214		name := repoNameFromRef(repo.RedactCloneRef(ref))
215		if name == "" {
216			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, fmt.Errorf("could not derive a repository name from %q", ref)
217		}
218		category, err := p.line("Category (optional)", flags.category)
219		if err != nil {
220			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
221		}
222		flags.category = category
223		defaultDestination, err := repoDestination(app.Cfg.Paths.ProjectRoot, flags.category, name, flags.path)
224		if err != nil {
225			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
226		}
227		destination, err := p.line("Destination", config.Contract(defaultDestination))
228		if err != nil {
229			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
230		}
231		flags.path = config.Expand(destination)
232		setup := flags.preset != ""
233		if flags.submodules == "" {
234			if _, statErr := os.Stat(filepath.Join(config.Expand(ref), ".gitmodules")); statErr == nil {
235				flags.submodules, err = p.choiceOf("Submodules", "configured", []string{"configured", "recursive", "none"}, map[string]string{"configured": "", "recursive": "recursive", "none": "none"})
236				if err != nil {
237					return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
238				}
239			}
240		}
241		if offerSetup && !setup {
242			setup, err = p.confirm("Apply a repository setup preset after cloning?", false)
243			if err != nil {
244				return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
245			}
246		}
247		flags.handoff, err = promptRepoHandoff(p, defaultString(flags.handoff, "cd"))
248		if err != nil {
249			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
250		}
251		request, err := buildCloneRepoRequest(app, ref, flags)
252		if err != nil {
253			return repoWorkflowRequest{}, false, false, err
254		}
255		fmt.Fprintln(p.out, "\n"+p.style.title("Summary"))
256		fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  source       %s\n", repo.RedactCloneRef(ref))
257		fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  submodules   %s (gitlink commits)\n", defaultString(request.Submodules, "configured"))
258		fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  destination  %s\n", config.Contract(request.Destination))
259		if request.Scaffold.Preset != "" {
260			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  setup        %s\n", request.Scaffold.Preset)
261		} else {
262			fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  setup        %t\n", setup)
263		}
264		fmt.Fprintf(p.out, "  handoff      %s\n", request.Handoff)
265		confirmed, err := p.confirm("Clone this repository?", true)
266		return request, setup, confirmed, err
267	}

157	func validateNewAsCloneFlags(flags repoBootstrapFlags) error {
158		if flags.template != "" || flags.templateRef != "" || flags.templateSubdir != "" {
159			return errors.New("--template flags create a fresh history and cannot be combined with a clone reference")
160		}
161		if flags.remote || flags.forge != "auto" || flags.namespace != "" || flags.visibility != "" ||
162			flags.public || !flags.private || !flags.push {
163			return errors.New("upstream-creation flags cannot be combined with a clone reference; the cloned remote is preserved")
164		}
165		return nil
166	}

174	reference opens a cache-backed repository picker, retains manual source entry,
175	and offers an idempotent scaffold after the clone. Opening the picker never

51	func Open(ctx context.Context, o Options) (*Service, error) {
52		repo, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, o.Root)
53		if err != nil {
54			return nil, errors.New("hygiene requires a Git checkout")
55		}
56		id, err := gitx.DirectoryIdentity(repo.GitCommonDir)
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, errors.New("cannot identify repository")
59		}
60		s := &Service{Root: repo.Root, CacheDir: o.CacheDir, Common: repo.GitCommonDir, RepoID: digest([]byte(id)), Global: o.GlobalPolicy, Policy: DefaultPolicy(), Engine: o.Engine, policyInputs: map[string]string{}, PublicOnly: o.PublicOnly}
61		state, e := pathx.Canonical(o.StateDir)
62		if e != nil {
63			return nil, errors.New("private hygiene state path unavailable")
64		}
65		s.Dir = filepath.Join(state, "hygiene", "repos", s.RepoID)
66		for parent := s.Dir; ; parent = filepath.Dir(parent) {
67			if _, e := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(parent, ".git")); e == nil {
68				return nil, errors.New("private hygiene state must be outside Git")
69			}
70			if filepath.Dir(parent) == parent {
71				break
72			}
73		}
74		if s.Engine == nil {
75			s.Engine = Gitleaks{}
76		}
77		for _, layer := range []struct {
78			label, path string
79			private     bool
80		}{{"global", o.GlobalPolicy, false}, {"repository", filepath.Join(s.Root, ".dev-cli", "hygiene.toml"), false}, {"local", filepath.Join(s.Dir, "policy.toml"), true}} {
81			if layer.path == "" || (o.PublicOnly && layer.label != "repository") {
82				continue
83			}
84			b, err := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, layer.path, 1<<20)
85			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
86				s.policyInputs[layer.path] = "absent"
87				continue
88			}
89			if err != nil {
90				return nil, errors.New("cannot read hygiene policy safely")
91			}
92			if layer.private {
93				info, e := os.Lstat(layer.path)
94				if e != nil {
95					return nil, e
96				}
97				if e = privatefile.Check(layer.path, info, false); e != nil {
98					return nil, errors.New("local hygiene policy is not private")
99				}
100			}
101			p, err := DecodePolicy(b)
102			if err != nil {
103				return nil, err
104			}
105			s.Policy = MergePolicy(s.Policy, p)
106			s.Sources = append(s.Sources, layer.label)
107			s.policyInputs[layer.path] = digest(b)
108		}
109		if o.Override.Secrets != "" || o.Override.Known != "" || o.Override.Generic != "" {
110			s.Policy = MergePolicy(s.Policy, o.Override)
111			s.Sources = append(s.Sources, "command")
112		}
113		for _, m := range []Mode{s.Policy.Secrets, s.Policy.Known, s.Policy.Generic} {
114			if !validMode(m) {
115				return nil, errors.New("invalid hygiene mode")
116			}
117		}
118		return s, nil
119	}
120	func (s *Service) checkInputs(ctx context.Context) error {
121		id, err := gitx.DirectoryIdentity(s.Common)
122		if err != nil || digest([]byte(id)) != s.RepoID {
123			return ErrStale
124		}
125		for p, want := range s.policyInputs {
126			b, err := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, p, 1<<20)
127			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) && want == "absent" {
128				continue
129			}
130			if err != nil || digest(b) != want {
131				return ErrStale
132			}
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136	func (s *Service) prepare(ctx context.Context) error {
137		if err := privatefile.EnsureDir(s.Dir); err != nil {
138			return err
139		}
140		return lockx.WithDir(ctx, s.Dir, "hygiene", func() error {
141			p := filepath.Join(s.Dir, "key")
142			b, err := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, p, 64)
143			if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
144				b = make([]byte, 32)
145				if _, err = rand.Read(b); err != nil {
146					return err
147				}
148				if err = configedit.WritePrivate(ctx, p, b, false); err != nil {
149					return errors.New("cannot create private hygiene key: " + feedback.Sanitize(err.Error()))
150				}
151			} else if err != nil {
152				return err
153			}
154			info, err := os.Lstat(p)
155			if err != nil || len(b) != 32 {
156				return errors.New("invalid private hygiene key")
157			}
158			if err = privatefile.Check(p, info, false); err != nil {
159				return err
160			}
161			s.key = b
162			return nil
163		})
164	}
165	func newID() string { return uuid.NewString() }
166	func safeRecordID(id string) bool {
167		_, err := uuid.Parse(id)
168		return err == nil && strings.ToLower(id) == id
169	}
170	func (s *Service) save(ctx context.Context, id string, v any) error {
171		if !safeRecordID(id) {
172			return errors.New("invalid hygiene record ID")
173		}
174		b, err := json.Marshal(v)
175		if err != nil || len(b) > MaxRecordBytes {
176			return errors.New("hygiene record exceeds byte limit")
177		}
178		if err = ctx.Err(); err != nil {
179			return err
180		}
181		return configedit.WritePrivate(ctx, filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".json"), b, true)
182	}
183	func (s *Service) load(ctx context.Context, id string, v any) error {
184		if !safeRecordID(id) {
185			return errors.New("invalid hygiene record ID")
186		}
187		p := filepath.Join(s.Dir, id+".json")
188		b, err := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, p, MaxRecordBytes)
189		if err != nil {
190			return errors.New("hygiene record unavailable")
191		}
192		info, err := os.Lstat(p)
193		if err != nil {
194			return err
195		}
196		if err = privatefile.Check(p, info, false); err != nil {
197			return err
198		}
199		if err = json.Unmarshal(b, v); err != nil {
200			return errors.New("invalid hygiene record")
201		}
202		return nil
203	}
204	func (s *Service) displayPath(p string) string {
205		out := filepath.ToSlash(p)
206		for _, r := range s.Policy.Rules {
207			if r.Kind == "literal" && r.Value != "" {
208				out = strings.ReplaceAll(out, r.Value, "[private]")
209			}
210		}
211		for _, r := range s.Policy.Rules {
212			if r.Kind == "cidr" {
213				c, e := compileRule(r)
214				if e == nil {
215					ranges := c.indices(filepath.ToSlash(p), []byte(out))
216					for i := len(ranges) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
217						m := ranges[i]
218						out = out[:m[0]] + "[private]" + out[m[1]:]
219					}
220				}
221			}
222		}
223		out = strings.ReplaceAll(out, "\n", "[newline]")
224		out = strings.ReplaceAll(out, "\r", "[return]")
225		out = strings.ReplaceAll(out, "\x1b", "[escape]")
226		return feedback.Sanitize(out)
227	}

1	package hygiene
2

12	
13		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/configedit"
14		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/lockx"
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/privatefile"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/safefile"
17	)
18	
19	const (
20		latestFile         = "latest.json"
21		latestLock         = "latest.lock"
22		maxLatestCheckouts = 256
23		latestAnyScope     = "any"
24	)
25	
26	// ErrNoStoredScan means no scan report was recorded for this checkout.
27	var ErrNoStoredScan = errors.New("no stored hygiene scan for this checkout; run dev hygiene scan or pass --rescan")
28	
29	// latestIndex points each checkout at its newest scan per scope. Linked
30	// worktrees share one hygiene state directory, so pointers are keyed by a
31	// private digest of the checkout root rather than the repository.
32	type latestIndex struct {
33		Version   int                             `json:"version"`
34		Checkouts map[string]map[string]latestRef `json:"checkouts"`
35	}
36	
37	type latestRef struct {
38		ID      string    `json:"id"`
39		Created time.Time `json:"created"`
40	}
41	
42	func (s *Service) checkoutKey() string { return keyedID(s.key, "checkout", s.Root) }
43	
44	// recordLatest is best effort: a lost update only makes `report` show an older
45	// scan, and must never fail the scan or its pre-commit hook.
46	func (s *Service) recordLatest(ctx context.Context, report Report) {
47		if report.Kind != "hygiene_scan" || !safeRecordID(report.ID) {
48			return
49		}
50		_ = lockx.WithFile(ctx, filepath.Join(s.Dir, latestLock), "hygiene latest scan", func() error {
51			index, err := s.readLatest(ctx)
52			if err != nil {
53				index = latestIndex{}
54			}
55			if index.Checkouts == nil {
56				index.Checkouts = map[string]map[string]latestRef{}
57			}
58			key := s.checkoutKey()
59			scopes := index.Checkouts[key]
60			if scopes == nil {
61				scopes = map[string]latestRef{}
62			}
63			ref := latestRef{ID: report.ID, Created: report.Created}
64			for _, scope := range []string{latestAnyScope, report.Scope} {
65				if current, ok := scopes[scope]; !ok || !current.Created.After(ref.Created) {
66					scopes[scope] = ref
67				}
68			}
69			index.Checkouts[key] = scopes
70			pruneLatest(&index)
71			index.Version = 1
72			data, err := json.Marshal(index)
73			if err != nil {
74				return err
75			}
76			return configedit.WritePrivate(ctx, filepath.Join(s.Dir, latestFile), data, true)
77		})
78	}
79	
80	func pruneLatest(index *latestIndex) {
81		if len(index.Checkouts) <= maxLatestCheckouts {
82			return
83		}
84		keys := make([]string, 0, len(index.Checkouts))
85		for key := range index.Checkouts {
86			keys = append(keys, key)
87		}
88		sort.Slice(keys, func(i, j int) bool {
89			return index.Checkouts[keys[i]][latestAnyScope].Created.After(index.Checkouts[keys[j]][latestAnyScope].Created)
90		})
91		for _, key := range keys[maxLatestCheckouts:] {
92			delete(index.Checkouts, key)
93		}
94	}
95	
96	func (s *Service) readLatest(ctx context.Context) (latestIndex, error) {
97		path := filepath.Join(s.Dir, latestFile)
98		data, err := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, path, 1<<20)
99		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
100			return latestIndex{}, nil
101		}
102		if err != nil {
103			return latestIndex{}, err
104		}
105		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
106		if err != nil {
107			return latestIndex{}, err
108		}
109		if err := privatefile.Check(path, info, false); err != nil {
110			return latestIndex{}, err
111		}
112		var index latestIndex
113		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &index); err != nil || index.Version != 1 {
114			return latestIndex{}, errors.New("invalid hygiene latest-scan index")
115		}
116		return index, nil
117	}
118	
119	// LatestReport returns this checkout's newest stored scan ID, optionally for
120	// one scope.
121	func (s *Service) LatestReport(ctx context.Context, scope string) (string, error) {
122		if err := s.prepare(ctx); err != nil {
123			return "", err
124		}
125		if scope == "" {
126			scope = latestAnyScope
127		}
128		index, err := s.readLatest(ctx)
129		if err != nil {
130			return "", err
131		}
132		ref, ok := index.Checkouts[s.checkoutKey()][scope]
133		if !ok || ref.ID == "" {
134			return "", ErrNoStoredScan
135		}
136		return ref.ID, nil
137	}

142	func dispositionRank(disposition string) int {
143		switch disposition {
144		case string(Block):
145			return 0
146		case string(Warn):
147			return 1
148		case "accepted":
149			return 2
150		default:
151			return 3
152		}
153	}
154	
155	func worseDisposition(current, next string) string {
156		if current == "" || dispositionRank(next) < dispositionRank(current) {
157			return next
158		}
159		return current
160	}

24	}

26	func (s *Service) LocateSession(ctx context.Context, session string) (string, error) {
27		if e := s.validateCapture(ctx); e != nil {
28			return "", e
29		}
30		if s.Policy.Source != "specstory" {
31			return "", errors.New("prepared sessions require SpecStory; use artifact archive --file for exported plans")
32		}
33		p, id, e := parseSession(session)
34		if e != nil {
35			return "", e
36		}
37		files, e := s.sources(ctx)
38		if e != nil {
39			return "", e
40		}
41		var paths []string
42		for _, file := range files {
43			path := s.capturePath(file)
44			provider, found, err := prefixIdentity(path)
45			if err == nil && provider == p && found == id {
46				paths = append(paths, path)
47			}
48		}
49		if len(paths) != 1 {
50			return "", errors.New("session does not identify one exact SpecStory transcript")
51		}
52		return paths[0], nil
53	}
54	
55	func (s *Service) CheckSessionPlan(ctx context.Context, id, session string) error {
56		p, e := s.load(ctx, id)
57		if e != nil {
58			return e
59		}
60		provider, sid, e := parseSession(session)

62			return e
63		}
64		if p.View.Kind != "artifact_archive" || p.Root != s.Root || p.Policy.ProjectID != s.Policy.ProjectID || len(p.Snapshots) != 1 || p.Snapshots[0].Provider != provider || p.Snapshots[0].SessionID != sid {
65			return errors.New("archive plan does not match the prepared session")
66		}
67		return nil

71		head, headErr := gitBytes(ctx, s.Root, nil, "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD")

73		if headErr != nil {

76			}

78			if e != nil || len(present) != 0 {
79				return "", headErr
80			}
81			head = []byte("unborn")
82		}
83		return digest([]byte(id + string(head) + string(branch))), nil
84	}

8	func mergeRepoProgress(previous, updates []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
9		rows := append([]RepoRow(nil), previous...)
10		for _, row := range updates {
11			found := false
12			for i, old := range rows {
13				if old.Repo.Path == row.Repo.Path {
14					if row.Pending == "loading" && old.Pending != "loading" {
15						found = true
16						break
17					}
18					if row.TopologyPending && !old.TopologyPending && old.Pending == "" {
19						row.Topology, row.TopologyErr, row.TopologyPending = old.Topology, old.TopologyErr, false
20					}
21					if row.Usage == nil {
22						row.Usage, row.SizeError = old.Usage, old.SizeError
23					}
24					rows[i] = row
25					found = true
26					break
27				}
28			}
29			if !found {
30				rows = append(rows, row)
31			}
32		}
33		return rows
34	}
35	
36	func (m Model) applyRepoProgress(result LocalResult) (Model, bool) {
37		state := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
38		if result.Generation != state.generation || m.repoProgressPhase == 3 {
39			return m, false
40		}
41		phase := 1
42		if result.Phase != "cache" {
43			phase = 2
44		}
45		if phase < m.repoProgressPhase {
46			return m, false
47		}
48		m.repoProgressPhase = phase
49		token := m.currentToken()
50		path := m.repoFocusPath()
51		m.repos = mergeRepoProgress(m.repos, result.Repos)
52		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].hasSnapshot = true
53		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
54		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].actionable = false
55		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceLive
56		if phase == 1 {
57			m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceCache
58		}
59		count := len(m.repos)
60		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRepos, Stage: perftrace.StageFirstEnrichment, Source: m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source, Freshness: perftrace.FreshnessStale, Generation: result.Generation, Rows: &count})
61		message := fmt.Sprintf("Refreshing local repositories… %d visible", count)
62		if phase == 1 && len(result.Repos) > 0 {
63			message = "Cached " + result.Repos[0].ObservedAt.Local().Format("Jan 2 15:04") + " · " + message
64		}
65		m.setViewStatus(ViewRepos, message)
66		m.restoreRepoFocus(token, path)
67		m.setAt(m.at())
68		return m, true
69	}
70	
71	func (m Model) repoFocusPath() string {
72		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
73			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
74				return checkout.Worktree.Path
75			}
76			return item.Repo.Repo.Path
77		}
78		return ""
79	}
80	func (m *Model) restoreRepoFocus(token selectionToken, path string) {
81		if m.selectToken(token) || m.view != ViewRepos || path == "" {
82			return
83		}
84		for i, item := range m.visibleRepoItems() {
85			candidate := item.Repo.Repo.Path
86			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
87				candidate = checkout.Worktree.Path
88			}
89			if candidate == path {
90				m.setAt(i)
91				return
92			}
93		}
94	}
95	
96	func completeRepoRows(previous, rows []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
97		merged := mergeRepoProgress(previous, rows)
98		out := make([]RepoRow, 0, len(rows))
99		for _, row := range rows {
100			for _, candidate := range merged {
101				if row.Repo.Path == candidate.Repo.Path {
102					out = append(out, candidate)
103					break
104				}
105			}
106		}
107		return out
108	}

46	func runGitBytes(ctx context.Context, root string, input []byte, isolated bool, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
47		base := []string{"-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", "-c", "core.longpaths=true", "-C", root}
48		if len(args) == 0 || args[0] != "config" {
49			base = append(base, "-c", "core.hooksPath="+os.DevNull)
50		}
51		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", append(base, args...)...)
52		if isolated {
53			cmd.Env = isolatedGitEnvironment()
54		}
55		cmd.Stdin = bytes.NewReader(input)
56		var stderr bytes.Buffer
57		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
58		out, err := cmd.Output()
59		if err != nil {
60			command := "read"
61			if len(args) > 0 {
62				switch args[0] {
63				case "hash-object", "update-index", "ls-files", "diff", "cat-file", "show", "ls-tree", "rev-list", "rev-parse", "symbolic-ref", "for-each-ref", "config":
64					command = args[0]
65				}
66			}
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("Git observation failed (%s: %s)", command, gitFailureReason(stderr.String()))
68		}
69		return out, nil
70	}

72	// Emit only fixed classifications. Git diagnostics can contain private paths,

74	func gitFailureReason(stderr string) string {
75		text := strings.ToLower(stderr)
76		switch {
77		case strings.Contains(text, "filename too long") || strings.Contains(text, "file name too long"):
78			return "path length"
79		case strings.Contains(text, "dubious ownership") || strings.Contains(text, "not owned"):
80			return "ownership"
81		case strings.Contains(text, "permission denied") || strings.Contains(text, "access is denied"):
82			return "permissions"
83		case strings.Contains(text, "index.lock"):
84			return "index lock"
85		case strings.Contains(text, "not a git repository") || strings.Contains(text, "cannot change to") || strings.Contains(text, "no such file"):
86			return "repository path unavailable"
87		default:
88			return "command failed"
89		}

16	func (h *hygieneCLI) reportCmd() *cobra.Command {
17		var (
18			reportID, scope, historyRange, by   string
19			dispositions, rules, categories     []string
20			paths, scanFiles                    []string
21			top                                 int
22			timeout                             time.Duration
23			rescan, audit, findings, showValues bool

25		cmd := &cobra.Command{
26			Use:   "report",
27			Short: "Summarize a scan by severity, rule and file",
28			Long: `Summarize one hygiene scan without printing every finding.
29	
30	By default the newest stored scan for this checkout is summarized without
31	scanning again; the pre-commit hook's staged scan is therefore available right
32	after a blocked commit. --scope selects the newest scan of that scope,
33	--report an exact report, and --rescan runs a fresh scan first (accepting
34	--range, --file, --timeout and --audit like dev hygiene scan).
35	
36	Groups are ordered by severity (block, warn, accepted), then occurrences and
37	findings. --top limits each group (0 shows all). Filters narrow the findings
38	before aggregation. --findings lists individual findings; --json emits the
39	hygiene_summary schema-v1 document for automation.
40	
41	--values shows masked distinct values per rule and implies --rescan unless
42	--report names a scan captured with values. Raw values and their context are
43	written only to a private review file; print its location with
44	dev hygiene review-path <report-id> and never paste it into chat, Git or CI.`,
45			Example: `  dev hygiene report
46	  dev hygiene report --scope staged --by rule --top 5 --findings
47	  dev hygiene report --rule privacy-email --values
48	  dev hygiene --json report --disposition block,warn`,
49			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
50			RunE: func(c *cobra.Command, _ []string) error {
51				ctx := c.Context()
52				if showValues && reportID == "" {
53					rescan = true
54				}
55				if reportID != "" && rescan {
56					return errors.New("--report summarizes a stored scan; it cannot be combined with --rescan")
57				}
58				if !rescan {
59					for _, name := range []string{"range", "file", "timeout", "audit"} {
60						if c.Flags().Changed(name) {
61							return fmt.Errorf("--%s requires --rescan", name)
62						}
63					}
64				}
65				s, err := h.service(ctx)
66				if err != nil {
67					return err
68				}

113	func splitFlagList(values []string) []string {
114		var out []string
115		for _, value := range values {
116			for _, part := range strings.Split(value, ",") {
117				if part = strings.TrimSpace(part); part != "" {
118					out = append(out, part)
119				}
120			}
121		}
122		return out
123	}
124	
125	func pluralNoun(n int, noun string) string {
126		if n == 1 {
127			return noun
128		}
129		if strings.HasSuffix(noun, "y") {
130			return strings.TrimSuffix(noun, "y") + "ies"
131		}
132		return noun + "s"
133	}
134	
135	func groupDigits(n int) string {
136		text := strconv.Itoa(n)
137		sign := ""
138		if strings.HasPrefix(text, "-") {
139			sign, text = "-", text[1:]
140		}
141		for i := len(text) - 3; i > 0; i -= 3 {
142			text = text[:i] + "," + text[i:]
143		}
144		return sign + text
145	}

147	func (h *hygieneCLI) dispositionCell(disposition string) string {
148		style := h.app.outStyle()
149		switch disposition {
150		case "block":
151			return style.danger(disposition)
152		case "warn":
153			return style.warning(disposition)
154		case "accepted":
155			return style.dim(disposition)
156		default:
157			return disposition
158		}
159	}

161	func (h *hygieneCLI) renderSummary(v hygiene.Summary) {
162		out, style := h.app.Out, h.app.outStyle()
163		shortID := v.ReportID
164		if len(shortID) > 8 {
165			shortID = shortID[:8] + "…"
166		}
167		fmt.Fprintf(out, "Hygiene %s · %s · report %s\n", v.Scope, v.Status, shortID)
168		fmt.Fprintf(out, "  findings %s (occ %s) · block %s · warn %s · accepted %s · gaps %s\n",
169			groupDigits(v.Totals.Findings), groupDigits(v.Totals.Occurrences), groupDigits(v.Totals.Blocked),
170			groupDigits(v.Totals.Warnings), groupDigits(v.Totals.Accepted), groupDigits(v.Totals.Gaps))
171		if !v.Rescanned {
172			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s\n", style.dim("stored scan from "+v.Created.Format(time.RFC3339)+"; source bytes were not rechecked"))
173		}
174		if !v.FileCountsComplete {
175			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s\n", style.warning("legacy report lacks exact file identities; file counts are lower bounds"))
176		}
177		var filters []string
178		for label, values := range map[string][]string{"disposition": v.Filters.Dispositions, "rule": v.Filters.Rules, "category": v.Filters.Categories, "path": v.Filters.Paths} {
179			if len(values) > 0 {
180				filters = append(filters, label+" "+feedback.Sanitize(strings.Join(values, ",")))
181			}
182		}
183		if len(filters) > 0 {
184			sort.Strings(filters)
185			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s\n", style.dim("filters: "+strings.Join(filters, " · ")))
186		}
187		if !v.PolicyCurrent {
188			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s\n", style.warning("policy changed since this scan; rescan before relying on dispositions"))
189		}
190		if !v.CheckoutCurrent {
191			fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s\n", style.warning("this report was scanned from another checkout"))
192		}
193		more := func(omitted int, noun string) {
194			if omitted > 0 {
195				fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s\n", style.dim(fmt.Sprintf("… %s more %s (--top 0 shows all)", groupDigits(omitted), pluralNoun(omitted, noun))))
196			}
197		}
198		heading := func(title string, ordered bool) {
199			if ordered && v.Top > 0 {
200				title = "TOP " + title
201			}
202			if ordered {
203				title += " (occurrences desc)"
204			}
205			fmt.Fprintf(out, "\n%s\n", style.header(title))
206		}
207	
208		if len(v.Severities) > 0 {
209			heading("BY SEVERITY", false)
210			for _, severity := range v.Severities {
211				detail := "0"
212				if severity.Findings > 0 {
213					detail = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s · %s occ", groupDigits(severity.Findings), pluralNoun(severity.Findings, "finding"), groupDigits(severity.Occurrences))
214				}
215				fmt.Fprintf(out, "  %s%s%s\n", h.dispositionCell(severity.Disposition), strings.Repeat(" ", max(1, 10-len(severity.Disposition))), detail)

179	}
180	func (s *Service) previewRules(ctx context.Context, rules []Rule, exceptions []Exception, overrides Policy, source, sourceDigest string) (Plan, error) {
181		target := filepath.Join(s.Dir, "policy.toml")
182		local := Policy{Version: 1}
183		if b, err := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, target, 1<<20); err == nil {
184			local, err = DecodePolicy(b)
185			if err != nil {
186				return Plan{}, err
187			}
188		} else if !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
189			return Plan{}, err
190		}
191		overrides.Version = 1
192		overrides.Rules = rules
193		overrides.Exceptions = exceptions
194		updated := MergePolicy(local, overrides)
195		data, err := policyBytes(updated)
196		if err != nil {
197			return Plan{}, err
198		}
199		if _, err = DecodePolicy(data); err != nil {
200			return Plan{}, err
201		}
202		p, err := s.newPlan(ctx, "hygiene_rules")
203		if err != nil {
204			return Plan{}, err
205		}
206		if err = s.addChange(ctx, &p, "local policy", target, data, 0); err != nil {
207			return Plan{}, err
208		}
209		p.ImportSource, p.ImportDigest = source, sourceDigest
210		effective := MergePolicy(s.Policy, overrides)
211		p.Plan.Policy = &effective
212		if err = s.savePlan(ctx, &p); err != nil {
213			return Plan{}, err
214		}
215		return p.Plan, nil
216	}
217	func (s *Service) PreviewAllow(ctx context.Context, reportID, findingID, reason string) (Plan, error) {
218		var r scanRecord
219		if err := s.load(ctx, reportID, &r); err != nil {
220			return Plan{}, err
221		}
222		if r.Report.RepoID != s.RepoID {
223			return Plan{}, ErrStale
224		}
225		found := false
226		for _, f := range r.Report.Findings {
227			found = found || f.ID == findingID
228		}
229		if !found {
230			return Plan{}, errors.New("finding does not belong to report")
231		}
232		return s.PreviewRules(ctx, nil, []Exception{{Finding: findingID, Reason: reason}}, Policy{Version: 1})
233	}

238	func (b *scanBuilder) add(rule, category, file, commit string, line int, value string, mode Mode, can bool) string {
239		if mode == Off {
240			return ""
241		}
242		id := keyedID(b.s.key, category, rule, file, commit, value)
243		disposition := string(mode)
244		for _, e := range b.s.Policy.Exceptions {
245			if b.record.Report.Audit {
246				break
247			}
248			if e.Finding == id {
249				disposition = "accepted"
250				break
251			}
252			if e.Rule == rule && pathMatches(e.Path, file) && e.Pattern != "" {
253				re, _ := regexp.Compile(e.Pattern)
254				if re != nil && re.MatchString(value) {
255					disposition = "accepted"
256					break
257				}
258			}
259		}
260		if i, ok := b.findings[id]; ok {
261			b.record.Report.Findings[i].Occurrences++
262			return id
263		}
264		if len(b.record.Report.Findings) >= 50000 {
265			b.gap(file, "finding_limit")
266			return ""
267		}
268		b.findings[id] = len(b.record.Report.Findings)
269		fileID := keyedID(b.s.key, "file", file)
270		if b.record.FilePaths == nil {
271			b.record.FilePaths = map[string]string{}
272		}
273		b.record.FilePaths[fileID] = file
274		b.record.Report.Findings = append(b.record.Report.Findings, Finding{
275			ID: id, Rule: b.s.displayPath(rule), Category: category, File: b.s.displayPath(file),
276			Line: line, Commit: commit, Occurrences: 1, Disposition: disposition,
277			CanRedact: can && disposition != "accepted", ValueID: keyedID(b.s.key, "value", category, rule, value), FileID: fileID,
278		})
279		return id
280	}
281	func (b *scanBuilder) native(file, commit string, data []byte, can bool) {
282		candidates := append([]compiledRule{}, b.compiled...)
283		if b.s.Policy.Generic != Off {
284			for _, r := range genericRules {
285				c, _ := compileRule(r)
286				candidates = append(candidates, c)

288		}
289		for i, c := range candidates {
290			category := "known"
291			mode := b.s.Policy.Known
292			if i >= len(b.compiled) {
293				category = "generic"
294				mode = b.s.Policy.Generic
295			}
296			if mode == Off {
297				continue
298			}
299			if c.rule.Action != "" {

321					}
322					b.record.Edits = append(b.record.Edits, edit{id, file, m[0], m[1], replacement})
323				}
324			}
325		}

424			}
