122	// InspectReadiness gathers artifact finalization evidence for one checkout,
123	// including intents whose exact checkout moved but stable Git identity matches.
124	// It never reconciles receipts, finalizes intents, or writes either
125	// source files or intent records. The returned inspection retains partial
126	// evidence and the same wrapped error returned separately to ordinary callers.
127	func InspectReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (ReadinessInspection, error) {
128		inspection := ReadinessInspection{}
129		if ctx == nil {
130			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a context")
131			inspection.ObservationError = err
132			return inspection, err
133		}
134		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
135			inspection.ObservationError = err
136			return inspection, err
137		}
138		if store == nil {
139			err := errors.New("artifact readiness inspection needs a store")
140			inspection.ObservationError = err
141			return inspection, err
142		}
143	
144		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(checkout)
145		if err != nil {
146			err = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness checkout: %w", err)
147			inspection.ObservationError = err
148			return inspection, err
149		}
150		inspection.Checkout = canonical
151	
152		intents, err := store.List()
153		if err != nil {
154			err = fmt.Errorf("list artifact intents: %w", err)
155			inspection.ObservationError = err
156			return inspection, err
157		}
158		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
159			inspection.ObservationError = err
160			return inspection, err
161		}
162	
163		matched := make([]Intent, 0, len(intents))
164		unmatched := make([]Intent, 0, len(intents))
165		for _, intent := range intents {
166			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
167				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, err)
168				break
169			}
170			intentCheckout, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
171			if canonicalErr != nil {
172				canonicalErr = fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s checkout: %w", intent.ID, canonicalErr)
173				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, canonicalErr)
174				continue
175			}
176			if intentCheckout == canonical {
177				matched = append(matched, intent)
178			} else {
179				unmatched = append(unmatched, intent)
180			}
181		}
182	
183		if len(unmatched) > 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil {
184			commonDir, available, identityErr := inspectReadinessCheckoutCommonDir(ctx, canonical)
185			if identityErr != nil {
186				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, identityErr)
187			} else if available {
188				movedCandidates := make([]Intent, 0, len(unmatched))
189				for _, intent := range unmatched {
190					intentCommon, commonErr := pathx.Canonical(intent.GitCommonDir)
191					if commonErr != nil {
192						inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError,
193							fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact intent %s Git common directory: %w", intent.ID, commonErr))
194						continue
195					}
196					if intentCommon == commonDir {
197						movedCandidates = append(movedCandidates, intent)
198					}
199				}
200				// A detached checkout is ambiguous only for moved candidates in
201				// the same repository, not intents proven to belong elsewhere.
202				if len(movedCandidates) > 0 {
203					branch, branchErr := inspectReadinessCheckoutBranch(ctx, canonical)
204					if branchErr != nil {
205						inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, branchErr)
206					} else {
207						for _, intent := range movedCandidates {
208							if intent.Branch == branch {
209								matched = append(matched, intent)
210							}
211						}
212					}
213				}
214			}
215		}
216	
217		for _, intent := range matched {
218			evidence, evidenceErr := inspectIntentReadiness(ctx, canonical, intent)
219			if evidenceErr != nil {
220				inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, evidenceErr)
221			}
222			inspection.Intents = append(inspection.Intents, evidence)
223		}
224	
225		history, historyErr := InspectHistoryReadiness(ctx, store, canonical)
226		inspection.History = history
227		if historyErr != nil {
228			inspection.ObservationError = joinReadinessError(inspection.ObservationError, historyErr)
229		}
230	
231		inspection.KnownEmpty = len(inspection.Intents) == 0 && inspection.ObservationError == nil
232		return inspection, inspection.ObservationError
233	}
234	
235	func inspectReadinessCheckoutCommonDir(ctx context.Context, checkout string) (string, bool, error) {
236		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, checkout)
237		if errors.Is(err, gitx.ErrNotARepo) {
238			return "", false, nil
239		}
240		if err != nil {
241			return "", false, fmt.Errorf("discover artifact readiness checkout identity: %w", err)
242		}
243		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
244		if err != nil {
245			return "", false, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact readiness Git common directory: %w", err)
246		}
247		return commonDir, true, nil
248	}
249	
250	func inspectReadinessCheckoutBranch(ctx context.Context, checkout string) (string, error) {
251		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
252		if err != nil {
253			return "", fmt.Errorf("observe artifact readiness checkout branch: %w", err)
254		}
255		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
256			return "", errors.New("artifact readiness checkout is detached; moved intent identity is ambiguous")
257		}
258		return status.Branch, nil
259	}
260	
261	func inspectIntentReadiness(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (IntentReadiness, error) {
262		evidence := IntentReadiness{Intent: intent, Finalized: intent.Status == Finalized}
263		var err error
264		switch intent.Status {
265		case Armed, Finalizing:
266			evidence.State = ReadinessPending
267		case Failed:
268			evidence.State = ReadinessFailed
269		case Discarded:
270			evidence.State = ReadinessDiscarded
271		case Finalized:
272			evidence.ReceiptReachable, err = receiptRemainsReachable(ctx, checkout, intent)
273			switch {
274			case err != nil:
275				err = fmt.Errorf("inspect artifact intent %s receipt: %w", intent.ID, err)
276				evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
277				evidence.ObservationError = err
278			case evidence.ReceiptReachable:
279				evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedReachable
280			default:
281				evidence.State = ReadinessFinalizedUnreachable
282			}
283		default:
284			// Store.List validates statuses, but fail closed if another Store
285			// implementation is introduced without preserving that contract.
286			err = fmt.Errorf("artifact intent %s has unrecognized status %q", intent.ID, intent.Status)
287			evidence.State = ReadinessObservationError
288			evidence.ObservationError = err
289		}
290		return evidence, err
291	}
292	
293	func receiptRemainsReachable(ctx context.Context, checkout string, intent Intent) (bool, error) {
294		if intent.Destination == "archive" {
295			h, e := agenthistory.Open(ctx, agenthistory.Options{Root: checkout, StateDir: intent.ArchiveStateDir})
296			if e != nil {
297				return false, e
298			}
299			commit, e := h.VerifyArchiveReceipt(ctx, intent.ArchivePlanID)
300			return e == nil && commit == intent.ArchiveCommit, e
301		}
302		if intent.ArtifactCommit == "" {
303			return false, nil
304		}
305		candidates := []struct {
306			dir string
307			ref string
308		}{
309			{checkout, "HEAD"},
310			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Branch},
311			{intent.RepoPath, intent.Base},
312		}
313		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(candidates))
314		var observationErr error
315		for _, candidate := range candidates {
316			if candidate.dir == "" || candidate.ref == "" {
317				continue
318			}
319			key := candidate.dir + "\x00" + candidate.ref
320			if seen[key] {
321				continue
322			}
323			seen[key] = true
324			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
325				return false, joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
326			}
327			if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, candidate.dir, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref); err == nil {
328				return true, nil
329			} else if !gitNotAncestor(err) {
330				observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr,
331					fmt.Errorf("check %s against %s in %s: %w", intent.ArtifactCommit, candidate.ref, candidate.dir, err))
332			}
333		}
334		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
335			observationErr = joinReadinessError(observationErr, err)
336		}
337		return false, observationErr
338	}
339	
340	func gitNotAncestor(err error) bool {
341		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
342		return errors.As(err, &exitErr) && exitErr.ExitCode() == 1
343	}
344	
345	func joinReadinessError(current, next error) error {
346		if current == nil {
347			return next
348		}
349		if next == nil {
350			return current
351		}
352		return errors.Join(current, next)
353	}
354	
355	func (s *Service) Prepare(ctx context.Context, request PrepareRequest) (*Intent, error) {
356		if s.Store == nil {
357			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
358		}
359		provider, sessionID, err := ParseSession(request.Session)
360		if err != nil {
361			return nil, err
362		}
363		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, request.Worktree)
364		if err != nil {
365			return nil, err
366		}
367		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, repository.Root)
368		if err != nil {
369			return nil, err
370		}
371		if status.Detached || status.Branch == "" {
372			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires a named branch")
373		}
374		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(repository.Root); err != nil {
375			return nil, err
376		} else if active {
377			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s in progress", operation)
378		}
379		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repository.Root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
380		if err != nil {
381			return nil, err
382		}
383		changes, err := statusPaths(ctx, repository.Root)
384		if err != nil {
385			return nil, err
386		}
387		var unrelated []string
388		for _, change := range changes {
389			if change.Staged {
390				return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation requires an empty index; staged path: %s", change.Path)
391			}
392			if !isRecognizedArtifact(change.Path) {
393				return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit product changes before prepare; dirty path: %s", change.Path)
394			}
395			unrelated = append(unrelated, change.Path)
396		}
397		var history *agenthistory.Service
398		if _, e := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(repository.Root, ".dev-cli", "artifacts.toml")); e == nil || !errors.Is(e, os.ErrNotExist) {
399			history, err = agenthistory.Open(ctx, agenthistory.Options{Root: repository.Root, StateDir: filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(s.Store.Dir))})
400			if err != nil {
401				return nil, err
402			}
403		}
404		archiveMode := history != nil && history.Policy.Mode == "archive"
405		var transcript Transcript
406		if archiveMode {
407			if len(request.Plans) > 0 {
408				return nil, fmt.Errorf("commit reviewed plans with product changes; archive prepared SpecStory sessions separately")
409			}
410			transcript.Path, err = history.LocateSession(ctx, request.Session)
411		} else {
412			transcript, err = FindTranscript(repository.Root, provider, sessionID)
413		}
414		if err != nil {
415			return nil, err
416		}
417		tracked := false
418		if !archiveMode {
419			tracked, err = gitTracked(ctx, repository.Root, transcript.Path)
420		}
421		if err != nil {
422			return nil, err
423		}
424		info, err := os.Stat(transcript.Path)
425		if err != nil {
426			return nil, err
427		}
428		limit := s.LargeLimit
429		if limit <= 0 {
430			limit = DefaultLargeLimit
431		}
432		if !archiveMode && !tracked && info.Size() > limit && !request.AllowLarge {
433			return nil, fmt.Errorf("untracked transcript is %d bytes; re-run with --allow-large after reviewing repository growth", info.Size())
434		}
435		plans, err := normalizePlans(repository.Root, request.Plans)
436		if err != nil {
437			return nil, err
438		}
439		runID := request.RunID
440		if runID == "" {
441			runID = os.Getenv("DEV_AGENT_RUN_ID")
442		}
443		if runID == "" {
444			runID = fmt.Sprintf("run-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
445		}
446		selected := make(map[string]bool, len(plans)+1)
447		relTranscript, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, transcript.Path)
448		selected[filepath.ToSlash(relTranscript)] = true
449		for _, plan := range plans {
450			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repository.Root, plan)
451			selected[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
452		}
453		filtered := unrelated[:0]
454		for _, path := range unrelated {
455			if !selected[path] {
456				filtered = append(filtered, path)
457			}
458		}
459		intent := &Intent{
460			RunID: runID, Provider: provider, SessionID: sessionID, TaskID: request.TaskID,
461			RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, GitCommonDir: repository.GitCommonDir,
462			WorktreePath: repository.Root, Branch: status.Branch, Base: request.Base,
463			Head: strings.TrimSpace(head), PlanPaths: plans, UnrelatedArtifacts: filtered, AllowLarge: request.AllowLarge,
464		}
465		if archiveMode {
466			intent.Destination = "archive"
467			intent.ArchiveStateDir = history.StateDir
468			intent.ArchivePolicy, err = history.PolicyFingerprint(ctx)
469			if err != nil {
470				return nil, err
471			}
472		}
473		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
474		if err != nil {
475			return nil, fmt.Errorf("canonicalize artifact repository lock identity: %w", err)
476		}
477		if s.beforeIntentCreate != nil {
478			s.beforeIntentCreate()
479		}
480		if err := lockx.WithDir(ctx, filepath.Join(commonDir, "dev-taskflow"), "taskflow repository", func() error {
481			if err := revalidatePreparedIntent(ctx, intent); err != nil {
482				return err
483			}
484			if archiveMode {
485				fresh, e := history.PolicyFingerprint(ctx)
486				if e != nil || fresh != intent.ArchivePolicy {
487					return agenthistory.ErrStale
488				}
489			}
490			return s.Store.Create(ctx, intent)
491		}); err != nil {
492			return nil, err
493		}
494		return intent, nil
495	}
496	
497	func revalidatePreparedIntent(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
498		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
499		if err != nil {
500			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout before arming intent: %w", err)
501		}
502		checkout, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
503		if err != nil {
504			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize revalidated artifact checkout: %w", err)
505		}
506		expectedCheckout, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
507		if err != nil {
508			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize prepared artifact checkout: %w", err)
509		}
510		commonDir, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
511		if err != nil {
512			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize revalidated artifact Git common directory: %w", err)
513		}
514		expectedCommon, err := pathx.Canonical(intent.GitCommonDir)
515		if err != nil {
516			return fmt.Errorf("canonicalize prepared artifact Git common directory: %w", err)
517		}
518		if checkout != expectedCheckout || commonDir != expectedCommon {
519			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout identity changed before intent creation")
520		}
521		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, checkout)
522		if err != nil {
523			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout status: %w", err)
524		}
525		if status.Detached || status.Branch != intent.Branch {
526			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout branch changed from %s to %s before intent creation", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
527		}
528		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(checkout); err != nil {
529			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact Git operation: %w", err)
530		} else if active {
531			return fmt.Errorf("artifact preparation refuses Git operation %s that started before intent creation", operation)
532		}
533		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
534		if err != nil {
535			return fmt.Errorf("revalidate artifact checkout HEAD: %w", err)
536		}
537		if strings.TrimSpace(head) != strings.TrimSpace(intent.Head) {
538			return fmt.Errorf("artifact checkout HEAD changed before intent creation")
539		}
540		return nil
541	}
542	
543	func (s *Service) ObserveSessionEnd(ctx context.Context, runID string, when time.Time) error {
544		intent, err := s.Store.FindByRunID(runID)
545		if err != nil {
546			return nil // SessionEnd without an armed intent is deliberately a no-op.
547		}
548		if when.IsZero() {
549			when = time.Now()
550		}
551		return s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
552			candidate.SessionEndedAt = when.UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
553			return nil
554		})
555	}
556	
557	func (s *Service) Finalize(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
558		if s.Store == nil {
559			return nil, fmt.Errorf("artifact service needs a store")
560		}
561		intent, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
562		if err != nil {
563			return nil, err
564		}
565		lockDir := filepath.Join(intent.GitCommonDir, "dev-artifact-finalize")
566		var finalized *Intent
567		err = catalog.NewStore(lockDir).WithLock(ctx, func() error {
568			current, err := s.resolveIntent(request)
569			if err != nil {
570				return err
571			}
572			finalized, err = s.finalizeLocked(ctx, request, current)
573			return err
574		})
575		return finalized, err
576	}
577	
578	func (s *Service) finalizeLocked(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest, intent *Intent) (*Intent, error) {
579		if intent.Destination == "archive" {
580			return s.finalizeArchive(ctx, request, intent)
581		}
582		if intent.Status == Finalized {
583			if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok && commit != intent.ArtifactCommit {
584				if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
585					return nil, err
586				}
587				return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
588			}
589			return intent, nil
590		}
591		if commit, ok := findReceipt(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent.ID); ok {
592			if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, intent.TranscriptPath, commit); err != nil {
593				return nil, err
594			}
595			return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
596		}
597		if s.ScanStaged == nil {
598			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scanner-missing", fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization requires a staged secret scanner"))
599		}
600		if err := s.revalidate(ctx, intent); err != nil {
601			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "git-drift", err)
602		}
603		if intent.SessionEndedAt.IsZero() && !request.WriterStopped {
604			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-unproven",
605				fmt.Errorf("finalization requires SessionEnd observation or explicit post-writer proof"))
606		}
607		transcript, err := FindTranscript(intent.WorktreePath, intent.Provider, intent.SessionID)
608		if err != nil {
609			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "transcript-missing", err)
610		}
611		if err := s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(candidate *Intent) error {
612			candidate.Status = Finalizing
613			candidate.TranscriptPath = transcript.Path
614			candidate.FailureCode = ""
615			return nil
616		}); err != nil {
617			return nil, err
618		}
619		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
620			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
621		}
622		paths := append([]string{transcript.Path}, intent.PlanPaths...)
623		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, nil); err != nil {
624			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-not-empty", err)
625		}
626		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"add", "--"}, paths...)...); err != nil {
627			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "stage-failed", err)
628		}
629		cleanup := func() {
630			_, _ = gitx.Run(context.Background(), intent.WorktreePath, append([]string{"reset", "--"}, paths...)...)
631		}
632		if err := s.ScanStaged(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
633			cleanup()
634			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "scan-failed", err)
635		}
636		if _, err := StableSnapshot(ctx, transcript.Path, request.Settle); err != nil {
637			cleanup()
638			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-active", err)
639		}
640		if err := ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
641			cleanup()
642			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
643		}
644		if err := stagedFilesMatch(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
645			cleanup()
646			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "index-drift", err)
647		}
648		message := fmt.Sprintf("chore: finalize %s agent session", intent.Provider)
649		trailers := fmt.Sprintf("Agent-Artifact-Session: %s:%s\nDev-Artifact-Intent: %s", intent.Provider, intent.SessionID, intent.ID)
650		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "commit", "-m", message, "-m", trailers); err != nil {
651			cleanup()
652			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "commit-failed", err)
653		}
654		commit, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
655		if err != nil {
656			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "receipt-failed", err)
657		}
658		if err := s.markFinalized(ctx, intent.ID, transcript.Path, commit); err != nil {
659			return nil, err
660		}
661		return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
662	}
663	
664	func (s *Service) resolveIntent(request FinalizeRequest) (*Intent, error) {
665		if request.IntentID != "" {
666			return s.Store.Get(request.IntentID)
667		}
668		if request.RunID != "" {
669			return s.Store.FindByRunID(request.RunID)
670		}
671		return nil, fmt.Errorf("finalize requires an intent or run id")
672	}
673	
674	func (s *Service) revalidate(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) error {
675		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
676		if err != nil {
677			return err
678		}
679		if repository.GitCommonDir != intent.GitCommonDir {
680			return fmt.Errorf("Git common-dir changed")
681		}
682		status, err := gitx.StatusOf(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
683		if err != nil {
684			return err
685		}
686		if status.Branch != intent.Branch || status.Detached {
687			return fmt.Errorf("branch changed from %s to %s", intent.Branch, status.Branch)
688		}
689		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(intent.WorktreePath); err != nil {
690			return err
691		} else if active {
692			return fmt.Errorf("Git operation %s is in progress", operation)
693		}
694		head, err := gitx.Run(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
695		if err != nil {
696			return err
697		}
698		if head != intent.Head {
699			return fmt.Errorf("HEAD changed from %s to %s", intent.Head, head)
700		}
701		return nil
702	}
703	
704	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, id, code string, cause error) error {
705		_ = s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
706			intent.Status = Failed
707			intent.FailureCode = code
708			return nil
709		})
710		return fmt.Errorf("artifact finalization %s: %w", code, cause)
711	}
712	
713	func (s *Service) markFinalized(ctx context.Context, id, transcript, commit string) error {
714		return s.Store.Update(ctx, id, func(intent *Intent) error {
715			intent.Status = Finalized
716			intent.TranscriptPath = transcript
717			intent.ArtifactCommit = commit
718			intent.FailureCode = ""
719			return nil
720		})
721	}
722	
723	type statusPath struct {
724		Path   string
725		Staged bool
726	}
727	
728	func statusPaths(ctx context.Context, repo string) ([]statusPath, error) {
729		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")
730		if err != nil {
731			return nil, err
732		}
733		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
734		var paths []statusPath
735		for i := 0; i < len(fields); i++ {
736			entry := fields[i]
737			if len(entry) < 4 {
738				continue
739			}
740			code, path := entry[:2], filepath.ToSlash(entry[3:])
741			paths = append(paths, statusPath{Path: path, Staged: code[0] != ' ' && code[0] != '?'})
742			if code[0] == 'R' || code[0] == 'C' {
743				i++ // porcelain -z emits the source path as the next field.
744			}
745		}
746		return paths, nil
747	}
748	
749	func isRecognizedArtifact(path string) bool {
750		path = filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./"))
751		for _, prefix := range []string{
752			".specstory/history/", ".claude/plans/", ".cursor/plans/", ".cursor/rules/",
753			".opencode/plans/", ".specify/", ".codex/",
754		} {
755			if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
756				return true
757			}
758		}
759		return path == ".specstory/statistics.json"
760	}
761	
762	func normalizePlans(root string, paths []string) ([]string, error) {
763		var out []string
764		for _, path := range paths {
765			if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
766				path = filepath.Join(root, path)
767			}
768			inside, err := pathx.Contains(filepath.Join(root, ".claude", "plans"), path)
769			if err != nil || !inside {
770				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is outside .claude/plans", path)
771			}
772			canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(path)
773			if err != nil {
774				return nil, err
775			}
776			info, err := os.Stat(canonical)
777			if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
778				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plan %s is not a regular file", path)
779			}
780			out = append(out, canonical)
781		}
782		sort.Strings(out)
783		return out, nil
784	}
785	
786	func gitTracked(ctx context.Context, repo, path string) (bool, error) {
787		rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
788		if err != nil {
789			return false, err
790		}
791		_, err = gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "ls-files", "--error-unmatch", "--", rel)
792		if err == nil {
793			return true, nil
794		}
795		var gitErr *gitx.Error
796		if errors.As(err, &gitErr) {
797			return false, nil
798		}
799		return false, err
800	}
801	
802	func ensureOnlyAllowedIndex(ctx context.Context, repo string, allowed []string) error {
803		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z")
804		if err != nil {
805			return err
806		}
807		allow := make(map[string]bool, len(allowed))
808		for _, path := range allowed {
809			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
810			allow[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
811		}
812		for _, path := range strings.Split(out, "\x00") {
813			if path != "" && !allow[filepath.ToSlash(path)] {
814				return fmt.Errorf("index contains unrelated path %s", path)
815			}
816		}
817		return nil
818	}
819	
820	func stagedFilesMatch(ctx context.Context, repo string, paths []string) error {
821		for _, path := range paths {
822			rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, path)
823			if err != nil {
824				return err
825			}
826			workingBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "hash-object", "--", rel)
827			if err != nil {
828				return err
829			}
830			stagedBlob, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "rev-parse", ":"+filepath.ToSlash(rel))
831			if err != nil {
832				return err
833			}
834			if workingBlob != stagedBlob {
835				return fmt.Errorf("staged artifact %s no longer matches scanned working bytes", filepath.ToSlash(rel))
836			}
837		}
838		return nil
839	}
840	
841	func findReceipt(ctx context.Context, repo, intentID string) (string, bool) {
842		out, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, "log", "-n", "100", "--format=%H%x00%B%x00")
843		if err != nil {
844			return "", false
845		}
846		fields := strings.Split(out, "\x00")
847		for i := 0; i+1 < len(fields); i += 2 {
848			if strings.Contains(fields[i+1], "Dev-Artifact-Intent: "+intentID) {
849				return fields[i], true
850			}
851		}
852		return "", false
853	}
854
```

```text
1	---
2	name: agent-history-hygiene
3	description: Commit SpecStory transcripts and Claude/Cursor/OpenCode/Codex plans with feature diffs, derive staged `AI-Assisted-By` plus transcript/plan trailers, prevent secret leaks, and ignore SpecStory machine-local state. Use when asked to commit/save/stage agent sessions, record cross-harness provenance, bootstrap pre-commit, fix `.specstory/statistics.json` churn, scrub a transcript, or remediate accidental secret commits/pushes with rotate-first discipline.
4	---
5	
6	# agent-history-hygiene
7	
8	Keep agent transcripts and plan files in the commit that records their feature,
9	without leaking secrets or mutating a file while its recorder is active.
10	
11	Surfaces, separated by purpose:
12	
13	| Surface | Question it answers |
14	|---|---|
15	| `run-specstory-session.sh` | "How do I prove the recorder exited before finalization?" |
16	| `queue-agent-commit.sh` | "How do I queue this exact authorized commit without touching live history?" |
17	| `finalize-agent-commit.sh` | "How is the exact post-session snapshot sanitized and committed?" |
18	| `find-session.sh` | "Which transcript / plan file is my current session?" |
19	| `stage-agent-artifacts.sh` | "Which exact agent files belong in the prepared index?" |
20	| `agent-commit-metadata.sh` | "Which provenance trailers belong in the commit?" |
21	| `bootstrap-project.sh` | "How do I install validation-only hooks?" |
22	| `scan-staged.sh` | "Is the effective staged index clean?" |
23	| `probe-specstory-redaction.py` | "What does SpecStory redact natively?" |
24	
25	## Core invariants
26	
27	1. **Commit the transcript and plan with the feature they produced.** Never
28	   ignore `.specstory/history/` or silently drop dirty agent artifacts from the
29	   review trail.
30	2. **SpecStory state is not review history.** Ignore only
31	   `.specstory/.project.json` and `.specstory/statistics.json`; both are
32	   machine-local/regenerable.
33	3. **Quiescence comes before Git history movement.** An active recorder blocks
34	   commit, `pull --rebase`, rebase/update-base, integration, and worktree/session
35	   retirement. Required order:
36	
37	   ```text
38	   recorder quiescence
39	     -> exact artifact + message finalization
40	     -> ordinary hook-enabled commit proven
41	     -> history/ref movement or retirement
42	   ```
43	
44	4. **Provenance comes from the staged snapshot.** Use exact session, transcript,
45	   and plan selectors; never point a trailer at an unstaged artifact or guess an
46	   unknown model.
47	5. **Rotate at the provider before any Git rewrite.** Redaction prevents new
48	   reachability; it does not revoke a credential or erase every local copy.
49	6. **Never use plain `git push --force` as leak remediation.** It can destroy
50	   teammate work and does not remove bytes from existing clones/caches.
51	7. **Shipped files must be scanner-safe.** `npx skills add` installs this whole
52	   directory under a consumer's scan scope. Never embed a literal private-key
53	   header; build it at test runtime or use synthetic placeholders. Enforced by
54	   `tests/test_shipped_file_hygiene.py`.
55	
56	## When to use
57	
58	Use this skill when:
59	
60	- the user asks to commit/save a SpecStory session, transcript, or plan;
61	- dirty `.specstory/history/*.md`, `.claude/plans/*.md`,
62	  `.cursor/plans/*.md`, or another configured artifact accompanies a feature;
63	- `.specstory/.project.json` or `statistics.json` keeps churning;
64	- the user asks to install pre-commit/gitleaks for agent artifacts;
65	- a scanner finds a secret in an agent artifact; or
66	- a credential was committed or pushed—read
67	  [`references/remediation.md`](references/remediation.md) before any rewrite.
68	
69	Do not use it when the user explicitly wants agent history excluded, or when no
70	agent artifacts exist. If a leak is already on shared `main`/release, do not
71	suggest rewriting that branch; use the remediation runbook.
72	
73	## Default lifecycle: queue now, finalize after exit
74	
75	Read
76	[`references/post-session-finalization.md`](references/post-session-finalization.md)
77	before running or recovering this lifecycle. It defines every state, exit code,
78	recovery action, and no-retry boundary.
79	
80	### 1. Launch the synchronous wrapper
81	
82	From the intended worktree, before starting Claude:
83	
84	```bash
85	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/run-specstory-session.sh \
86	  --allow-commit claude
87	```
88	
89	`--allow-commit` gives the **outer parent** a one-run finalizer capability. It
90	does not let the child infer user consent. The agent still waits for explicit
91	commit authorization before queueing.
92	
93	Do not replace the wrapper with a Stop hook, detached watcher/daemon, or live
94	checkpoint. A Stop hook runs before process/recorder quiescence is proven; a
95	daemon separates recorder lifetime from the session; a live checkpoint commits
96	while the file can still change.
97	
98	### 2. Work normally; stage only feature paths
99	
100	Take the canonical lowercase UUID from Claude `/status`. Resolve the exact
101	SpecStory path and plan policy; if one UUID has multiple rendered aliases, pass
102	both UUID and path to disambiguate.
103	
104	```bash
105	SESSION_ID=01234567-89ab-4cde-8fab-0123456789ab
106	TRANSCRIPT='.specstory/history/2026-09-01_02-14-50Z.md'
107	PLAN='.claude/plans/exact-change.md'
108	
109	git add -- path/to/feature-a path/to/feature-b
110	```
111	
112	Do **not** stage the live transcript or plan. The finalizer owns exact artifact
113	staging and sanitation after SpecStory exits.
114	
115	### 3. After explicit user commit authorization, queue once
116	
117	Create a UTF-8 base subject/body without lifecycle-managed trailers, then queue
118	with exact selectors:
119	
120	```bash
121	MESSAGE_FILE="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/agent-commit-message.txt"
122	printf '%s\n' \
123	  'feat(scope): summarize the change' \
124	  '' \
125	  'Explain why the change is needed.' > "$MESSAGE_FILE"
126	
127	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/queue-agent-commit.sh \
128	  --commit \
129	  --session-id "$SESSION_ID" \
130	  --specstory-path "$TRANSCRIPT" \
131	  --plan "$PLAN" \
132	  --message-file "$MESSAGE_FILE"
133	# Use --no-plan instead of --plan only when no plan exists.
134	```
135	
136	The queue copies only the base message into private per-worktree state. It does
137	not read, stage, scan, redact, or commit the live transcript.
138	
139	On `status=queued`, report **"finalization queued"** and exit the agent session.
140	Perform no further repository/index operation—not even `git status`, a diff, a
141	message edit, sync, or a finalizer call.
142	
143	### 4. Let the outer runner finish
144	
145	Only after child exit `0`, the runner:
146	
147	1. records lifecycle proof;
148	2. runs one exact quiet `specstory sync claude -s UUID --silent`;
149	3. re-proves the exact session/path;
150	4. calls the finalizer with its parent-held token;
151	5. stages and sanitizes exact artifacts in a locked alternate index;
152	6. derives canonical trailers, writes private handoff drafts, and calls one
153	   ordinary `git commit -F` with normal hooks enabled; and
154	7. proves the resulting parent, tree, branch, and
155	   `Agent-History-Request` trailer.
156	
157	Normal pre-commit execution is unsafe while a writer is active: when unstaged
158	changes exist, pre-commit can stash them, check out/modify staged content, then
159	restore the stash. That checkout/restore sequence can race a recorder and
160	clobber, conflict with, or reintroduce bytes. Therefore the pre-commit checker is
161	validation-only; the quiescent finalizer is the sole sanctioned mutator.
162	
163	## Finalization outcomes
164	
165	- **Success (`committed` / exit 0):** an ordinary hook-enabled commit is proven.
166	  Only now may rebase/update-base, integration, or retirement proceed.
167	- **Sanitation (`rotation_required` / exit 10):** exact index and live artifacts
168	  are sanitized, drafts are ready, no commit was attempted. Rotate first, then
169	  resume with fresh `--allow-commit --rotation-confirmed`; recovery does not
170	  restage.
171	- **Hook/commit failure (`commit_failed` / exit 11):** HEAD is unchanged and the
172	  exact prepared tree plus drafts remain. Fix the hook without changing that
173	  snapshot, then make one explicit recovery call with fresh `--allow-commit`.
174	  There is no automatic retry.
175	- **Uncertain outcome (exit 8):** reconcile only. Never issue another commit
176	  automatically; prove the exact HEAD or escalate for inspection.
177	- **Manual handoff:** LazyGit reads per-worktree
178	  `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT`; standard Git uses per-worktree `COMMIT_EDITMSG`.
179	  A draft makes recovery possible but is not proof that a commit happened.
180	
181	An actual rebase is identified by Git's state directories (`rebase-merge` or
182	`rebase-apply`), not by a stale `REBASE_HEAD` file alone. Other active operation
183	markers and `index.lock` also block queue/finalization.
184	
185	## Bootstrap a repository
186	
187	Read
188	[`references/pre-commit-redaction-stack.md`](references/pre-commit-redaction-stack.md)
189	before bootstrap or migration.
190	
191	> **Current hook release:** `ahh-v2.0.1` is the immutable published pin used by
192	> the checked-in template and hook migration target. Fresh bootstrap also pins
193	> gitleaks v8.30.1 and installs the scoped Sourcegraph/Git-OID false-positive
194	> fix. Updating only the ahh tag does not rewrite an existing root
195	> `.gitleaks.toml`; follow the rollout steps in the reference for existing repos.
196	
197	```bash
198	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/bootstrap-project.sh \
199	  --install-hook
200	pre-commit run --all-files
201	```
202	
203	Bootstrap installs:
204	
205	- a validation-only staged-index checker plus gitleaks;
206	- precise nested SpecStory state ignores, keeping `history/` visible;
207	- generic hygiene hooks whose mutators exclude every agent/archive/install root:
208	  `.agents`, `.claude`, `.codex`, `.cursor`, `.opencode`, `.specify`,
209	  `.specstory`; and
210	- optionally a validation-only `prepare-commit-msg` exact-selector gate.
211	
212	Security checkers retain coverage of those roots. Excluding only `.specstory`
213	from whitespace/EOF/formatters is insufficient: `.agents/skills/` contains
214	installed vendored code, and `.claude/skills/` may symlink to it.
215	
216	For old `ahh-v1.1.0` or exact local-redactor layouts, the post-release migration
217	is transactional and fail-closed:
218	
219	```bash
220	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/bootstrap-project.sh --migrate
221	```
222	
223	It preserves compatible sibling hooks/options, validates a candidate before
224	publishing, and refuses ambiguous/customized legacy commands.
225	
226	## Post-leak remediation
227	
228	When a scan finds a real credential, or the user says it was committed/pushed:
229	
230	1. stop any reflexive force-push;
231	2. read [`references/remediation.md`](references/remediation.md) end-to-end;
232	3. rotate at the provider regardless of blast radius; and
233	4. only then choose the least disruptive Git action from the runbook.
234	
235	## Gotchas
236	
237	- `.gitignore` does not untrack existing state. Use
238	  `bootstrap-project.sh --untrack-specstory-state`; never broaden the ignore to
239	  `.specstory/`.
240	- SpecStory >= 2.4.0 redacts on write but has context/rule gaps. Keep native
241	  redaction enabled and retain the finalizer check. Read
242	  [`references/specstory-native-redaction.md`](references/specstory-native-redaction.md)
243	  before changing placeholders or coverage.
244	- SpecStory 2.10 is checkout-path scoped, not branch scoped. Create the worktree
245	  first, then start one wrapper/session per change stream. `EnterWorktree` does
246	  not rebind an existing recorder.
247	- Exact discovery rejects incomplete JSONL, aliases, symlinks, unsafe bytes, and
248	  cross-worktree identity. Read
249	  [`references/transcript-session-discovery.md`](references/transcript-session-discovery.md)
250	  when resolution is empty or ambiguous.
251	- `plansDirectory` may be ignored at project scope in some Claude Code versions.
252	  Verify where the plan landed; user-level `"plansDirectory":
253	  "./.claude/plans"` is the recommended default.
254	- `pre-commit install` is per clone. CI is a second chance, not the last gate.
255	- `--install-hook` requires `core.hooksPath` genuinely unset. Empty, relative,
256	  global, or custom values are refused; integrate the validation-only gate in
257	  the configured hook directory yourself.
258	- `gitleaks protect` is deprecated. Use `gitleaks git --staged` or
259	  `gitleaks dir`.
260	- Rotate oversized sessions instead of raising the 2 MiB transcript allowance.
261	
262	## Available scripts
263	
264	- **`run-specstory-session.sh [--allow-commit] claude [-- OPTIONS...]`** — owns
265	  the foreground process group, preserves child/signal status, performs one
266	  post-exit exact sync, and optionally invokes one finalizer.
267	- **`queue-agent-commit.sh --commit --session-id UUID --specstory-path PATH
268	  (--plan PATH|--no-plan) --message-file PATH`** — writes one strict,
269	  metadata-only, per-worktree request; identical repeats are idempotent.
270	- **`finalize-agent-commit.sh --request ABSOLUTE_PATH
271	  (--allow-commit|--runner-token TOKEN) [--rotation-confirmed]`** — validates
272	  lifecycle/snapshot proof, prepares exact sanitized artifacts and drafts,
273	  executes one ordinary commit, and reconciles uncertain state without retry.
274	- **`find-session.sh (--session-id UUID|--specstory-path PATH|--newest)
275	  [--format specstory|claude|both] [--json]`** — exact checkout/session proof;
276	  `--newest` is heuristic compatibility only.
277	- **`stage-agent-artifacts.sh ...`** — exact or broad atomic staging.
278	  `--sanitize-index` sanitizes selected blobs in the locked alternate index;
279	  `--materialize-sanitized` safely writes those exact sanitized bytes back after
280	  generation checks; `--check-staged` never mutates.
281	- **`agent-commit-metadata.sh [--harness NAME --model NAME]
282	  [--format trailers|json]`** — derives canonical provenance from staged blobs.
283	- **`scan-staged.sh [--redact|--no-redact] [--config PATH] [--verbose]`** —
284	  validates the effective index; emits only bounded secret-free JSON findings
285	  and suppresses raw scanner output.
286	- **`probe-specstory-redaction.py [--json] [--keep] [--dry-run]`** — measures
287	  native coverage; exit 30 when SpecStory is absent.
288	- **`bootstrap-project.sh [--migrate] [--install-hook]
289	  [--untrack-specstory-state] [--force] [--dry-run]`** — installs/migrates the
290	  validation stack; remember the unpublished-v2.0.0 blocker above.
291	
292	## Bundled assets
293	
294	- `assets/artifact-dirs.txt` — canonical artifact directory set.
295	- `assets/pre-commit-config.yaml.template` — validation-only checker, gitleaks,
296	  and generic hygiene with full archive/install-root mutator exclusions.
297	- `assets/gitleaks.toml.template` — custom rules and scoped example allowlists.
298	- `assets/redact_secrets.py` — staged-index checker/sanitizer. `--check-index`
299	  accepts canonical or temporary commit indexes; `--fix-index` requires an
300	  explicit user-owned noncanonical `GIT_INDEX_FILE` and exact `--files`.
301	
302	## Reference files
303	
304	- [`references/post-session-finalization.md`](references/post-session-finalization.md)
305	  — load before queueing, finalizing, recovery, rebase, integration, or

21	var specStoryGeneratedLine = regexp.MustCompile(`^<!-- Generated by SpecStory, Markdown v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ -->$`)
22	var specStorySessionLine = regexp.MustCompile(`^<!-- ([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9 -]*) Session ([0-9a-fA-F-]+) \([^<>\r\n]+\) -->$`)

36	// FindTranscript selects exactly one SpecStory transcript by its anchored
37	// preamble session UUID. UUID mentions later in a transcript are never used.
38	func FindTranscript(worktree, provider, sessionID string) (Transcript, error) {
39		history := filepath.Join(worktree, ".specstory", "history")
40		entries, err := os.ReadDir(history)
41		if err != nil {
42			return Transcript{}, err
43		}
44		var matches []Transcript
45		for _, entry := range entries {
46			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
47				continue
48			}
49			path := filepath.Join(history, entry.Name())
50			inside, err := pathx.Contains(history, path)
51			if err != nil || !inside {
52				continue
53			}
54			gotProvider, gotSession, err := transcriptPreamble(path)
55			if err != nil || gotSession != sessionID || (provider != "" && gotProvider != provider) {
56				continue
57			}
58			matches = append(matches, Transcript{Path: path, Provider: gotProvider, SessionID: gotSession})
59		}
60		switch len(matches) {
61		case 1:
62			return matches[0], nil
63		case 0:
64			return Transcript{}, fmt.Errorf("no SpecStory transcript with preamble session %s:%s", provider, sessionID)
65		default:
66			return Transcript{}, fmt.Errorf("multiple SpecStory transcripts have preamble session %s:%s", provider, sessionID)
67		}
68	}
69	
70	// ReadTranscriptSession proves the bounded SpecStory preamble identity of one
71	// regular transcript file. Unlike legacy transcript lookup, ownership proof
72	// requires the generated marker, title, and a complete canonical session UUID
73	// before any body content. Symlinks and body/fenced UUID mentions never prove it.
74	func ReadTranscriptSession(path string) (provider, sessionID string, err error) {
75		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
76		if err != nil {
77			return "", "", err
78		}
79		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
80			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("SpecStory transcript is not a regular file")
81		}
82		file, err := os.Open(path)
83		if err != nil {
84			return "", "", err
85		}
86		defer file.Close()
87		opened, err := file.Stat()
88		if err != nil {
89			return "", "", err
90		}
91		if !os.SameFile(info, opened) {
92			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("SpecStory transcript changed while opening")
93		}
94		provider, sessionID, err = specStoryPreamble(file)
95		if err != nil {
96			return "", "", err
97		}
98		current, err := os.Lstat(path)
99		if err != nil {
100			return "", "", err
101		}
102		if !current.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(info, current) || info.Size() != current.Size() || !info.ModTime().Equal(current.ModTime()) {
103			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("SpecStory transcript changed while reading")
104		}
105		return provider, sessionID, nil
106	}

108	func specStoryPreamble(reader io.Reader) (provider, sessionID string, err error) {
109		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(io.LimitReader(reader, 16<<10))
110		heading := false
111		for line := 0; line < 12 && scanner.Scan(); line++ {
112			text := scanner.Text()
113			if line == 0 {
114				if !specStoryGeneratedLine.MatchString(text) {
115					break
116				}
117				continue
118			}
119			if text == "" {
120				continue
121			}
122			if !heading {
123				if !strings.HasPrefix(text, "# ") || strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(text, "# ")) == "" {
124					break
125				}
126				heading = true
127				continue
128			}
129			match := specStorySessionLine.FindStringSubmatch(text)
130			if len(match) != 3 {
131				break // The first nonblank line after the title must be metadata, not body.
132			}
133			id, parseErr := uuid.Parse(match[2])
134			if parseErr != nil || id == uuid.Nil || !strings.EqualFold(id.String(), match[2]) {
135				break
136			}
137			return normalizeProvider(match[1]), id.String(), nil
138		}
139		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
140			return "", "", err
141		}
142		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("valid SpecStory session preamble not found")
143	}
144	
145	func transcriptPreamble(path string) (provider, sessionID string, err error) {
146		file, err := os.Open(path)
147		if err != nil {
148			return "", "", err
149		}
150		defer file.Close()
151		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(io.LimitReader(file, 16<<10))
152		for line := 0; scanner.Scan() && line < 12; line++ {
153			match := transcriptSessionLine.FindStringSubmatch(scanner.Text())
154			if len(match) != 3 {
155				continue
156			}
157			return normalizeProvider(match[1]), match[2], nil
158		}
159		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
160			return "", "", err
161		}
162		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("SpecStory session preamble not found")
163	}

165	func normalizeProvider(label string) string {
166		label = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(label))
167		for _, provider := range []string{"claude", "codex", "cursor", "gemini", "antigravity", "deepseek", "droid"} {
168			if strings.Contains(label, provider) {
169				return provider
170			}
171		}
172		if first, _, ok := strings.Cut(label, " "); ok {
173			return first
174		}
175		return label
176	}

178	// StableSnapshot requires the transcript bytes and metadata to remain unchanged
179	// across a settle interval.
180	func StableSnapshot(ctx context.Context, path string, settle time.Duration) (Snapshot, error) {
181		if settle <= 0 {
182			settle = 250 * time.Millisecond
183		}
184		first, err := snapshot(path)
185		if err != nil {
186			return Snapshot{}, err
187		}
188		select {
189		case <-ctx.Done():
190			return Snapshot{}, ctx.Err()
191		case <-time.After(settle):
192		}
193		second, err := snapshot(path)
194		if err != nil {
195			return Snapshot{}, err
196		}
197		if first.Size != second.Size || !first.ModTime.Equal(second.ModTime) || first.SHA256 != second.SHA256 {
198			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("transcript is still changing")
199		}
200		return second, nil
201	}
202	
203	func snapshot(path string) (Snapshot, error) {
204		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
205		if err != nil {
206			return Snapshot{}, err
207		}
208		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
209			return Snapshot{}, fmt.Errorf("transcript is not a regular file")
210		}
211		file, err := os.Open(path)
212		if err != nil {
213			return Snapshot{}, err
214		}
215		defer file.Close()
216		hash := sha256.New()
217		if _, err := io.Copy(hash, file); err != nil {
218			return Snapshot{}, err
219		}
220		return Snapshot{Size: info.Size(), ModTime: info.ModTime(), SHA256: hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil))}, nil
221	}

14	func (s *Service) finalizeArchive(ctx context.Context, request FinalizeRequest, intent *Intent) (*Intent, error) {
15		h, err := agenthistory.Open(ctx, agenthistory.Options{Root: intent.WorktreePath, StateDir: intent.ArchiveStateDir, GlobalHygiene: filepath.Join(config.ConfigHome(), "dev", "hygiene.toml")})
16		if err != nil {
17			return nil, err
18		}
19		if intent.Status == Finalized {
20			commit, e := h.VerifyArchiveReceipt(ctx, intent.ArchivePlanID)
21			if e != nil || commit != intent.ArchiveCommit {
22				return nil, errors.New("finalized archive receipt is unavailable")
23			}
24			return intent, nil
25		}
26		if err = s.revalidate(ctx, intent); err != nil {
27			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "git-drift", err)
28		}
29		policy, err := h.PolicyFingerprint(ctx)
30		if err != nil || policy != intent.ArchivePolicy {
31			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "policy-drift", errors.New("archive policy changed after preparation"))
32		}
33		if intent.SessionEndedAt.IsZero() && !request.WriterStopped {
34			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-unproven", errors.New("archive finalization requires post-writer proof"))
35		}
36		planID := intent.ArchivePlanID
37		if request.ArchivePlanID != "" {
38			if planID != "" && planID != request.ArchivePlanID {
39				return nil, errors.New("this intent already has an archive plan; inspect its receipt before replacing the handoff")
40			}
41			planID = request.ArchivePlanID
42		}
43		if planID == "" {
44			if h.Binding.Protection == "redact" {
45				return nil, fmt.Errorf("preview and review `dev artifact archive --session %s:%s`, then finalize with --archive-plan <id>", intent.Provider, intent.SessionID)
46			}
47			p, e := h.PreviewArchive(ctx, agenthistory.ArchiveOptions{Session: intent.Provider + ":" + intent.SessionID})
48			if e != nil {
49				return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "archive-preview", e)
50			}
51			planID = p.ID
52		}
53		if err = h.CheckSessionPlan(ctx, planID, intent.Provider+":"+intent.SessionID); err != nil {
54			return nil, err
55		}
56		if err = s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(current *Intent) error { current.ArchivePlanID = planID; current.Status = Finalizing; return nil }); err != nil {
57			return nil, err
58		}
59		result, err := h.ApplyArchive(ctx, planID, agenthistory.ApplyOptions{WriterStopped: true, Guard: request.Guard})
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "archive-apply", err)
62		}
63		path, err := h.LocateSession(ctx, intent.Provider+":"+intent.SessionID)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "archive-source", err)
66		}
67		if err = s.Store.Update(ctx, intent.ID, func(current *Intent) error {
68			current.Status = Finalized
69			current.ArchivePlanID = planID
70			current.ArchiveCommit = result.ArchiveCommit
71			current.TranscriptPath = path
72			current.FailureCode = ""
73			return nil
74		}); err != nil {
75			return nil, err
76		}
77		return s.Store.Get(intent.ID)
78	}

82	func InspectHistoryReadiness(ctx context.Context, store *Store, checkout string) (*agenthistory.Readiness, error) {
83		if ctx == nil || store == nil {

85		}
86		if _, e := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(checkout, ".dev-cli", "artifacts.toml")); errors.Is(e, os.ErrNotExist) {
87			return nil, nil
88		}
89		h, e := agenthistory.Open(ctx, agenthistory.Options{Root: checkout, StateDir: filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(store.Dir))})

92		}

12		if e != nil {
13			return "", e
14		}
15		b, e := configedit.InspectToken(ctx, s.bindingPath())

18		}

22		}

26	func (s *Service) LocateSession(ctx context.Context, session string) (string, error) {
27		if e := s.validateCapture(ctx); e != nil {
28			return "", e
29		}
30		if s.Policy.Source != "specstory" {
31			return "", errors.New("prepared sessions require SpecStory; use artifact archive --file for exported plans")
32		}
33		p, id, e := parseSession(session)
34		if e != nil {
35			return "", e
36		}
37		files, e := s.sources(ctx)
38		if e != nil {
39			return "", e
40		}
41		var paths []string
42		for _, file := range files {
43			path := s.capturePath(file)
44			provider, found, err := prefixIdentity(path)
45			if err == nil && provider == p && found == id {
46				paths = append(paths, path)
47			}
48		}
49		if len(paths) != 1 {
50			return "", errors.New("session does not identify one exact SpecStory transcript")
51		}
52		return paths[0], nil
53	}
54	
55	func (s *Service) CheckSessionPlan(ctx context.Context, id, session string) error {
56		p, e := s.load(ctx, id)
57		if e != nil {
58			return e
59		}
60		provider, sid, e := parseSession(session)
61		if e != nil {
62			return e
63		}
64		if p.View.Kind != "artifact_archive" || p.Root != s.Root || p.Policy.ProjectID != s.Policy.ProjectID || len(p.Snapshots) != 1 || p.Snapshots[0].Provider != provider || p.Snapshots[0].SessionID != sid {
65			return errors.New("archive plan does not match the prepared session")
66		}
67		return nil
68	}

1	# Post-session finalization
2	
3	Use this runbook for the default SpecStory/Claude lifecycle, any finalizer
4	recovery, and every rebase/integration/retirement decision that follows it.
5	
6	## Hard boundary
7	
8	An active transcript recorder blocks:
9	
10	- `git commit` (including amend/fixup);
11	- `git pull --rebase`, `git rebase`, and update-base helpers;
12	- merge/cherry-pick/integration into another ref; and
13	- worktree, branch, or agent-session retirement.
14	
15	Required order:
16	
17	```text
18	recorder exits and the exact session is synced
19	  -> exact artifacts are staged/sanitized and the message is finalized
20	  -> one ordinary hook-enabled commit is proven
21	  -> only then may history/ref movement or retirement begin
22	```
23	
24	A commit draft, a queued request, a clean scan, or a manual commit command is not
25	proof of completion by itself.
26	
27	## Lifecycle diagram
28	
29	```text
30	shell parent
31	  |
32	  | run-specstory-session.sh --allow-commit claude
33	  v
34	running: foreground `specstory run claude`
35	  |
36	  | child stages feature paths only
37	  | explicit user commit authorization
38	  | queue-agent-commit.sh + exact selectors
39	  v
40	pending: inert metadata-only request (no transcript read/mutation/commit)
41	  |
42	  | child reports "finalization queued" and exits; no more repo operations
43	  v
44	child_exited (must be exit 0)
45	  |
46	  | one exact `specstory sync claude -s UUID --silent`
47	  | exact selector/path proof
48	  v
49	synced
50	  |
51	  | parent-held token authorizes one finalizer call
52	  | prove no writer + unchanged HEAD/ref/index tree
53	  | stage/sanitize exact artifacts in locked alternate index
54	  v
55	prepared ----------------------------+
56	  |                                    |
57	  | sanitation changed bytes           | message + provenance validation
58	  v                                    | handoff drafts
59	rotation_required                      v
60	  |                                  committing
61	  | rotate credential                  |
62	  | fresh manual authorization          | one ordinary `git commit -F`
63	  | + --rotation-confirmed              v
64	  +----------------------------------> done (exact commit proven)
65	
66	Any uncertain commit outcome remains `committing`: reconcile only, never retry.
67	```
68	
69	No request means `done/no_request`. A nonzero/signaled child or failed exact sync
70	does not enter finalization.
71	
72	## Authorization model
73	
74	Three separate facts are required:
75	
76	1. **Launcher capability:** `run-specstory-session.sh --allow-commit` lets the
77	   outer parent call the finalizer once after successful child exit and sync.
78	2. **User intent:** the child queues only after the user explicitly authorizes
79	   the commit. Launcher capability is not permission to infer that intent.
80	3. **Recovery authorization:** every manual finalizer invocation repeats
81	   `--allow-commit`. A stored request, journal, message, or draft is never commit
82	   authority.
83	
84	`queue-agent-commit.sh --commit` names the requested action; it does not execute
85	or independently authorize a commit. `--runner-token` belongs only to the outer
86	runner and must never be passed to the child.
87	
88	## Default commands
89	
90	### 1. Start in the intended worktree
91	
92	Create the worktree before the recorder. Then launch:
93	
94	```bash
95	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/run-specstory-session.sh \
96	  --allow-commit claude
97	```
98	
99	Pass SpecStory options only after `--`, for example:
100	
101	```bash
102	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/run-specstory-session.sh \
103	  --allow-commit claude -- --resume SESSION_UUID
104	```
105	
106	The child receives only `AGENT_HISTORY_REQUEST_PATH` and
107	`AGENT_HISTORY_RUN_ID`. Neither value authorizes finalization.
108	
109	### 2. Prepare exact inputs inside Claude
110	
111	Take the lowercase UUID from `/status`. Resolve an exact direct child of
112	`.specstory/history/`; if the UUID has aliases, supply the path as well. Decide
113	explicitly between one exact plan and no plan.
114	
115	```bash
116	SESSION_ID=01234567-89ab-4cde-8fab-0123456789ab
117	TRANSCRIPT='.specstory/history/2026-09-01_02-14-50Z.md'
118	PLAN='.claude/plans/exact-change.md'
119	
120	git add -- path/to/feature-a path/to/feature-b
121	```
122	
123	Stage only intended non-artifact feature paths. Do not stage the live transcript
124	or plan; do not use broad `git add -A`.
125	
126	### 3. Queue only after explicit user commit authorization
127	
128	The base message must be nonempty UTF-8 subject/body and must not already carry
129	`AI-Assisted-By`, `Agent-Transcript`, `Agent-Plan`, or
130	`Agent-History-Request`; the finalizer owns those trailers.
131	
132	```bash
133	MESSAGE_FILE="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/agent-commit-message.txt"
134	printf '%s\n' \
135	  'feat(scope): summarize the change' \
136	  '' \
137	  'Explain the reason for the change.' > "$MESSAGE_FILE"
138	
139	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/queue-agent-commit.sh \
140	  --commit \
141	  --session-id "$SESSION_ID" \
142	  --specstory-path "$TRANSCRIPT" \
143	  --plan "$PLAN" \
144	  --message-file "$MESSAGE_FILE"
145	```
146	
147	Use `--no-plan` instead of `--plan` only when no plan exists. Version 1 of the
148	post-session queue always requires a rendered SpecStory path.
149	
150	A successful response is one bounded JSON object with `status=queued`. An
151	identical second request is idempotent; a different request conflicts and the
152	first remains authoritative.
153	
154	After success:
155	
156	1. say **"finalization queued"**;
157	2. exit the Claude session; and
158	3. perform no more repository/index operations—not status, diff, staging,
159	   message editing, sync, finalizer, rebase, integration, or retirement.
160	
161	The queue captures the attached branch, HEAD object, and staged index tree. Any
162	later branch/index change makes it stale.
163	
164	## Why finalization waits for process exit
165	
166	### Normal pre-commit is unsafe during an active writer
167	
168	When staged files also have unstaged changes, pre-commit can stash the unstaged
169	patch, check out or rewrite the staged view for hooks, and restore the patch
170	afterward. An active recorder can append between those checkout/restore steps.
171	The restore may conflict, clobber a generation, or reintroduce bytes that a hook
172	just removed. Even without a mutating hook, the recorder can change content
173	after validation but before the commit object is created.
174	
175	Therefore:
176	
177	- `check-agent-artifact-secrets` is validation-only;
178	- generic mutating hooks/formatters exclude all agent/archive/install roots;
179	- no hook sanitizes or re-stages a working-tree transcript; and
180	- the post-session finalizer is the sole sanctioned mutator.
181	
182	### Why not a Stop hook, daemon, or live checkpoint
183	
184	- A Claude Stop hook runs before child/process and recorder quiescence are
185	  proven. It cannot establish the post-exit sync boundary.
186	- A detached `specstory watch` daemon outlives the agent and breaks the parent's
187	  recorder-lifetime proof.
188	- A live checkpoint necessarily snapshots a file that can still be appended and
189	  invites repeated pre-commit/stash races.
190	
191	The synchronous foreground wrapper is deliberate: the outer parent owns the
192	process group, forwards termination signals, waits for real exit, records proof,
193	then syncs and finalizes.
194	
195	## What the finalizer proves and changes
196	
197	On an initial authorized pass, the finalizer:
198	
199	1. validates private run state, request digest, per-worktree path, successful
200	   child exit, exact completed sync, and parent authorization;
201	2. rejects active Git operations, locks, changed branch/HEAD/index tree, unsafe
202	   paths, and an active/changing transcript writer;
203	3. revalidates the exact UUID + SpecStory path and exact plan policy;
204	4. calls `stage-agent-artifacts.sh --session-only ... --sanitize-index
205	   --materialize-sanitized`;
206	5. derives provenance from staged blobs, composes one canonical message, and
207	   validates it;
208	6. writes owned per-worktree handoff drafts;
209	7. calls one ordinary `git commit -F` with `SKIP` removed and all hooks enabled;
210	   and
211	8. proves the new commit's branch, single parent, tree, and unique
212	   `Agent-History-Request` trailer.
213	
214	Artifact staging runs under the real index lock against a copied alternate
215	index. `--sanitize-index` edits only exact selected stage-0 blobs, then requires
216	a clean post-check. `--materialize-sanitized` writes only those sanitized bytes
217	through Git checkout filters after proving the live clean hashes still match the
218	pre-sanitize blobs. The real index is atomically published only after success.
219	
220	## Redactor and scanner safety
221	
222	`redact_secrets.py --check-index` may inspect the canonical index or Git's
223	commit-time temporary index. `--fix-index` refuses mutation unless
224	`GIT_INDEX_FILE` explicitly names an existing, user-owned, nonsymlink,
225	noncanonical regular file; it also requires exact unique `--files` under the
226	configured artifact roots.
227	
228	Complete PEM/OpenVPN/PuTTY private-key records are replaced wholesale. A header
229	without a complete bounded record fails closed: partial redaction could leave
230	private material behind, so no index/worktree publication occurs.
231	
232	Public wrapper/finalizer output is scanner-safe:
233	
234	- raw gitleaks stdout/stderr is suppressed;
235	- `Secret` and `Match` never appear in `scan-staged.sh` JSONL, even with
236	  `--no-redact`;
237	- emitted fields are bounded/validated path, rule id, line, and commit marker;
238	- finalizer JSON reports status/ids only; and
239	- unsafe selectors and private hook/scanner diagnostics are not reflected.
240	
241	`--redact` on `scan-staged.sh` masks scanner report output only; it never changes
242	files or an index.
243	
244	### Local raw-object caveat
245	
246	The exact staging transaction may cause Git to write the original live blob to
247	the local object database before the alternate index entry is replaced by its
248	sanitized blob. The raw object is then unreachable and is not included in the
249	prepared commit, but it can remain locally until Git garbage collection. This
250	is not secure erasure and does not cover shell history, recorder storage,
251	backups, or prior clones. Rotation is mandatory whenever sanitation changed
252	bytes.
253	
254	## States
255	
256	| State | Meaning | Commit permitted? |
257	|---|---|---|
258	| `running` | foreground recorder/Claude child is active | No |
259	| `pending` | one inert exact request was queued | No |
260	| `child_exited` | child returned 0; sync not yet proven | No |
261	| `syncing` | one exact quiet sync is in progress | No |
262	| `synced` | exit 0 + exact sync/session proof recorded | Finalizer may prepare |
263	| `prepared` | exact sanitized tree and message proof retained | One freshly authorized finalizer recovery |
264	| `rotation_required` | sanitation changed bytes; commit was not attempted | Only after rotation + fresh two-flag confirmation |
265	| `committing` | a prior ordinary commit outcome may be uncertain | Reconcile only; never retry |
266	| `done` | no request, or exact commit object proven | History movement allowed only for proven commit |
267	| `failed` | lifecycle stopped before a safe/proven completion | Follow status-specific recovery |
268	
269	Private run directories are `0700`; request, journal, and owned messages are
270	`0600` under the current worktree's Git directory. A linked worktree cannot
271	consume another worktree's request.
272	
273	## Outcome contracts
274	
275	### Success
276	
277	`status=committed`, exit 0 means:
278	
279	- one ordinary commit returned success;
280	- all configured hooks ran normally;
281	- the exact parent/tree/ref and request trailer were proven; and
282	- the matching LazyGit pending draft was removed.
283	
284	`status=already_committed`, exit 0 means a later reconciliation re-proved the
285	recorded commit without another commit attempt. Only these proven outcomes open
286	the rebase/integration/retirement gate.
287	
288	### Rotation stop
289	
290	`status=rotation_required`, exit 10 means:
291	
292	- exact index and matching live artifacts were sanitized;
293	- prepared parent/tree and both drafts are ready;
294	- no commit or hook was attempted; and
295	- rotation is now required, including because of the unreachable-local-object
296	  caveat above.
297	
298	After rotation, resume exactly once with fresh manual authorization:
299	
300	```bash
301	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/finalize-agent-commit.sh \
302	  --request "$ABSOLUTE_REQUEST_PATH" \
303	  --allow-commit \
304	  --rotation-confirmed
305	```
306	
307	The recovery validates the retained tree and clean index; it does not re-stage.
308	The runner never supplies `--rotation-confirmed`.
309	
310	### Ordinary hook/commit failure
311	
312	`status=commit_failed`, exit 11 means HEAD and the expected prepared tree are
313	unchanged. The prepared snapshot and drafts remain. Fix the hook/dependency
314	without altering that snapshot, then issue one fresh, explicit recovery:
315	
316	```bash
317	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/finalize-agent-commit.sh \
318	  --request "$ABSOLUTE_REQUEST_PATH" \
319	  --allow-commit
320	```
321	
322	There is no automatic retry. If the index/HEAD changed, the status becomes
323	`commit_failed_snapshot_changed` or `stale_prepared_state`; retire that request
324	and queue a fresh run rather than retrying it.
325	
326	### Manual handoff
327	
328	The finalizer writes the complete composed message to both per-worktree Git
329	paths:
330	
331	- LazyGit reads `LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT`;
332	- standard Git uses `COMMIT_EDITMSG`.
333	
334	Resolve them with `git rev-parse --git-path ...`; do not assume the primary
335	checkout's `.git/` path in a linked worktree. Foreign or user-edited drafts are
336	never overwritten.
337	
338	Prefer authorized finalizer recovery. If the user deliberately commits from a
339	handoff draft, that is a manual escape hatch outside the managed proof path. The
340	draft is recoverable input, not proof; verify the actual commit parent/tree,
341	hooks, canonical trailers, and `Agent-History-Request` before allowing any
342	history movement. A `prepared` journal does not certify a manual commit.
343	
344	## Exit codes
345	
346	### Queue
347	
348	| Exit | Contract |
349	|---:|---|
350	| 0 | request written, or identical request already exists |
351	| 1 | invalid/incomplete arguments |
352	| 2 | not in a Git worktree |
353	| 3 | dependency unavailable |
354	| 4 | selector/message validation failed |
355	| 5 | unsafe/stale state, no staged feature diff, or conflicting request |
356	| 6 | Git/lifecycle operation lock active |
357	
358	### Runner
359	
360	| Exit | Contract |
361	|---:|---|
362	| 0 | child succeeded; no automatic finalizer failed (may be no request or authorization-required) |
363	| 1–255 | nonzero child status preserved exactly |
364	| 2 | invalid runner arguments |
365	| 3 | dependency unavailable |
366	| 10 | finalizer stopped for rotation |
367	| 11 | ordinary commit failed; prepared snapshot/drafts retained |
368	| 21 | exact sync failed; no finalizer call |
369	| 22 | child process group remained live; request retained, no sync/finalizer |
370	| 23 | successful child exit could not be durably proven |
371	| 128+N | child terminated by signal N; request retained, no sync/finalizer |
372	
373	### Finalizer
374	
375	| Exit | Contract |
376	|---:|---|
377	| 0 | commit completed or already-completed commit re-proven |
378	| 1 | invalid arguments |
379	| 2 | not in a Git worktree |
380	| 3 | dependency unavailable |
381	| 4 | malformed/unsafe request or journal |
382	| 5 | authorization/path mismatch |
383	| 6 | stale Git state, active operation/lock, or missing lifecycle proof |
384	| 7 | exact selector, staging, scanner, metadata, or message validation failed |
385	| 8 | prior commit outcome unproven; reconciliation only, never retry |
386	| 9 | unrelated/edited draft would be overwritten |
387	| 10 | sanitation changed content; rotate and explicitly confirm recovery |
388	| 11 | ordinary commit failed; retry only when exact prepared snapshot is retained |
389	
390	## Recovery and no-retry table
391	
392	Every manual attempt requires fresh `--allow-commit`. Never loop on a finalizer
393	exit.
394	
395	| Status/symptom | Safe next action | Forbidden action |
396	|---|---|---|
397	| `authorization_required` after runner exit 0 | run finalizer once with request path + `--allow-commit` | treating request as authority |
398	| child nonzero/signal | fix cause; start a fresh wrapper and requeue | syncing/finalizing the unproven run |
399	| `sync_failed` | fix sync; start a fresh wrapper/run so sync proof is journaled; requeue | hand-editing journal or calling commit directly |
400	| `active_writer` / transient exact validation failure | stop writer, preserve branch/index, retry once with fresh authorization | staging while writer remains active |
401	| `stale_state` before preparation | restage intended feature paths and queue a new run | forcing old request over changed tree/ref |
402	| `draft_conflict` | preserve or deliberately remove the foreign draft, then recover with fresh authorization | overwriting a nonmatching draft |
403	| `rotation_required` | rotate; use fresh `--allow-commit --rotation-confirmed` | committing before rotation; re-staging raw artifacts |
404	| `commit_failed` with prepared snapshot retained | fix hook only; fresh `--allow-commit` | automatic retry or changing the prepared tree |
405	| `commit_failed_snapshot_changed` | inspect and queue a new request | retrying old request |
406	| exit 8 / state `committing` | invoke only for reconciliation or inspect exact HEAD/journal | another `git commit` |
407	| manual commit from draft | independently verify exact commit and hooks | calling draft existence “proven” |
408	
409	For state `committing`, a repeated finalizer invocation may only prove the exact
410	HEAD and return `already_committed`; it must never issue a second commit. If it
411	cannot prove the outcome, stop and inspect.
412	
413	## Rebase and history boundary
414	
415	Queue/finalization rejects merge, cherry-pick, revert, bisect, sequencer,
416	`rebase-merge`, `rebase-apply`, and index-lock state. This is both a consistency
417	gate and a history-safety gate: the queued request binds one attached branch,
418	parent, and index tree.
419	
420	A stale `REBASE_HEAD` file alone is **not** an active rebase and must not block a
421	valid finalization. Detect real rebase state via the actual per-worktree Git
422	state directories:
423	
424	```bash
425	git rev-parse --git-path rebase-merge
426	git rev-parse --git-path rebase-apply
427	```
428	
429	Do not run update-base, `pull --rebase`, merge/integration, or retirement merely
430	because the finalizer wrote drafts or returned a recoverable status. Wait for a
431	proven `committed`/`already_committed` result, then begin a separate ordinary Git
432	operation.
433	
434	## Cross-reference
435	
436	- [`pre-commit-redaction-stack.md`](./pre-commit-redaction-stack.md) — staged
437	  checker, sanitation, scanner output, and unpublished release pin.
438	- [`transcript-session-discovery.md`](./transcript-session-discovery.md) — exact
439	  UUID/path proof and alternate-index staging.
440	- [`specstory-native-redaction.md`](./specstory-native-redaction.md) — native
441	  redaction coverage and residual gaps.
442	- [`remediation.md`](./remediation.md) — rotate-first response when a credential
443	  was already committed or pushed.
444

290	func inferAgentSession(ctx context.Context, rt interface {
291		List(context.Context) ([]runtime.Session, error)
292	}, worktree string) (string, error) {

314	func scanAgentArtifacts(ctx context.Context, repo string, paths []string) error {
315		script := findArtifactScanner(repo)
316		if script == "" {
317			return fmt.Errorf("agent-history-hygiene scan-staged.sh not found")
318		}
319		redactor := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(script)), "assets", "redact_secrets.py")
320		if info, err := os.Stat(redactor); err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
321			return fmt.Errorf("agent-history-hygiene redactor not found")
322		}
323		parents := make(map[string]bool)
324		for _, path := range paths {
325			rel, err := filepath.Rel(repo, filepath.Dir(path))
326			if err != nil || strings.HasPrefix(rel, "..") {
327				return fmt.Errorf("artifact path is outside repository")
328			}
329			parents[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = true
330		}
331		redactArgs := []string{redactor, "--fix", "--paths"}
332		for parent := range parents {
333			redactArgs = append(redactArgs, parent)
334		}
335		if err := runSanitized(ctx, repo, "python3", redactArgs...); err != nil {
336			return fmt.Errorf("artifact redactor failed: %w", err)
337		}
338		if _, err := gitx.Run(ctx, repo, append([]string{"add", "--"}, paths...)...); err != nil {
339			return fmt.Errorf("restage redacted artifacts")
340		}
341		if err := runSanitized(ctx, repo, "bash", script); err != nil {
342			return fmt.Errorf("artifact scanner failed: %w", err)
343		}
344		return nil
345	}
346	
347	func runSanitized(ctx context.Context, dir, name string, args ...string) error {
348		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
349		cmd.Dir = dir
350		var output bytes.Buffer
351		cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &output, &output
352		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
353			var exitErr *exec.ExitError
354			if errors.As(err, &exitErr) {
355				return fmt.Errorf("exit %d", exitErr.ExitCode())
356			}
357			return fmt.Errorf("execute %s", name)
358		}
359		return nil
360	}

362	func findArtifactScanner(repo string) string {
363		candidates := []string{
364			filepath.Join(repo, ".claude", "skills", "agent-history-hygiene", "scripts", "scan-staged.sh"),
365			filepath.Join(repo, ".agents", "skills", "agent-history-hygiene", "scripts", "scan-staged.sh"),
366			filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), ".agents", "skills", "agent-history-hygiene", "scripts", "scan-staged.sh"),
367		}
368		for _, candidate := range candidates {
369			if info, err := os.Stat(candidate); err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular() {
370				return candidate
371			}
372		}
373		return ""
374	}

383	func ensureArtifactsFinalized(app *App, worktree string) error {
384		store := artifactStore(app)
385		intents, err := store.List()
386		if err != nil {
387			return err
388		}
389		canonical, err := pathx.Canonical(worktree)
390		if err != nil {
391			return err
392		}
393		proof, e := artifact.InspectHistoryReadiness(context.Background(), store, worktree)
394		if e != nil {
395			return e
396		}
397		if proof != nil && !proof.Ready {
398			return errors.New("ignored agent history still needs a verified external archive before integration or retirement")
399		}
400		for _, intent := range intents {
401			intentPath, canonicalErr := pathx.Canonical(intent.WorktreePath)
402			if canonicalErr != nil || intentPath != canonical {
403				continue
404			}
405			if intent.Status == artifact.Discarded {
406				continue
407			}
408			if intent.Status != artifact.Finalized {
409				return fmt.Errorf("artifact intent for %s is %s; finalize it, or discard it with `dev artifact discard %s`, before integration or retirement",
410					config.Contract(worktree), intent.Status, intent.ID)
411			}
412			reconciled, reconcileErr := (&artifact.Service{Store: store}).Finalize(context.Background(), artifact.FinalizeRequest{IntentID: intent.ID})
413			if reconcileErr != nil {
414				return reconcileErr
415			}
416			intent = *reconciled
417			if (intent.ArtifactCommit == "" && intent.ArchiveCommit == "") || !artifactCommitReachable(intent) {
418				return fmt.Errorf("artifact commit for %s is no longer reachable; restore or re-finalize intent %s before integration or retirement",
419					config.Contract(worktree), intent.ID)
420			}
421		}
422		return nil
423	}

427	}

25	var preamble = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^<!-- ([^<\r\n]+?) Session ([0-9a-fA-F-]+) \(`)
26	
27	func sessionIdentity(data []byte) (string, string, error) {
28		if len(data) > 16<<10 {
29			data = data[:16<<10]
30		}
31		m := preamble.FindSubmatch(data)
32		if len(m) != 3 {
33			return "", "", errors.New("SpecStory session preamble not found")
34		}
35		provider := strings.ToLower(strings.Fields(string(m[1]))[0])
36		id := strings.ToLower(string(m[2]))
37		if !component.MatchString(provider) || !validID(id) {
38			return "", "", errors.New("invalid SpecStory session identity")
39		}
40		return provider, id, nil
41	}
42	func parseSession(s string) (string, string, error) {
43		p, id, ok := strings.Cut(s, ":")
44		if !ok || !component.MatchString(p) || !validID(id) {
45			return "", "", errors.New("session must be provider:uuid")
46		}
47		return p, id, nil
48	}
