50	func (s *Service) capturePath(logical string) string {
51		if s.Policy.Capture == "external" && strings.HasPrefix(logical, ".specstory/history/") {
52			return filepath.Join(s.Binding.CaptureDir, filepath.FromSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(logical, ".specstory/history/")))
53		}
54		return filepath.Join(s.Root, filepath.FromSlash(logical))
55	}
56	func (s *Service) sources(ctx context.Context) ([]string, error) {
57		var files []string
58		seen := map[string]bool{}
59		for _, configured := range s.Policy.Paths {
60			root := filepath.Join(s.Root, filepath.FromSlash(configured))
61			if s.Policy.Capture == "external" {
62				if configured != ".specstory/history" || s.Binding.CaptureDir == "" {
63					return nil, errors.New("external capture binding is unavailable")
64				}
65				root = s.Binding.CaptureDir
66			}
67			err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
68				if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) && path == root {
69					return nil
70				}
71				if err != nil {
72					return errors.New("artifact source directory unavailable")
73				}
74				if e := ctx.Err(); e != nil {
75					return e
76				}
77				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
78					return errors.New("artifact source contains a symlink; select regular files")
79				}
80				if entry.IsDir() {
81					if strings.Count(strings.TrimPrefix(path, root), string(filepath.Separator)) > 32 {
82						return errors.New("artifact directory depth exceeds limit")
83					}
84					return nil
85				}
86				if !entry.Type().IsRegular() {
87					return errors.New("artifact source contains a special file")
88				}
89				if s.Policy.Source == "specstory" && !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".md") {
90					return nil
91				}
92				rel, e := filepath.Rel(root, path)
93				if e != nil {
94					return e
95				}
96				logical := configured
97				if rel != "." {
98					logical = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(configured, rel))
99				}
100				if !relative(logical) {
101					return errors.New("unsafe artifact source name")
102				}
103				if !seen[logical] {
104					files = append(files, logical)
105					seen[logical] = true
106				}
107				if len(files) > 10000 {
108					return errors.New("artifact inventory exceeds 10000 files; select narrower policy paths")
109				}
110				return nil
111			})
112			if err != nil {
113				return nil, err
114			}
115		}
116		sort.Strings(files)
117		return files, nil
118	}

120	// Prefix reads only select candidates. Full source identity and bytes are
121	// checked independently before a candidate can become an archive plan.
122	func prefixIdentity(path string) (string, string, error) {
123		real, e := filepath.EvalSymlinks(path)
124		if e != nil || real != path {
125			return "", "", errors.New("noncanonical transcript")
126		}
127		f, _, e := safefile.OpenRegular(path)
128		if e != nil {
129			return "", "", e
130		}
131		defer f.Close()
132		b, e := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(f, 16<<10))
133		if e != nil {
134			return "", "", e
135		}
136		return sessionIdentity(b)
137	}

139	func (s *Service) PreviewArchive(ctx context.Context, o ArchiveOptions) (Plan, error) {
140		p, err := s.newPlan(ctx, "artifact_archive")
141		if err != nil {
142			return p.View, err
143		}
144		if !s.Configured || s.Policy.Mode != "archive" {
145			return p.View, errors.New("configure archive mode before preserving snapshots")
146		}
147		if err = s.validateCapture(ctx); err != nil {
148			return p.View, err
149		}
150		archive, err := archiveCheckout(ctx, s.Root, s.Binding.Archive)
151		if err != nil {
152			return p.View, err
153		}
154		p.View.Archive = archive
155		p.View.RequiresWriterStopped = true
156		p.ArchiveToken, p.ArchiveHead, p.ArchiveIndex, err = checkoutToken(ctx, archive)
157		if err != nil {
158			return p.View, err
159		}
160		if err = cleanArchive(ctx, archive); err != nil {
161			return p.View, err
162		}
163		files, err := s.sources(ctx)
164		if err != nil {
165			return p.View, err
166		}
167		selected := map[string]bool{}
168		for _, f := range o.Files {
169			if !relative(f) {
170				return p.View, errors.New("select source-relative artifact files")
171			}
172			selected[f] = true
173		}
174		if len(selected) == 0 && o.Session == "" {
175			return p.View, errors.New("select --session or exact --file paths")
176		}
177		wantProvider, wantID := "", ""
178		if o.Session != "" {
179			wantProvider, wantID, err = parseSession(o.Session)
180			if err != nil {
181				return p.View, err
182			}
183		}
184		var chosen []string
185		for _, logical := range files {
186			if len(selected) > 0 && !selected[logical] {
187				continue
188			}
189			if o.Session != "" {
190				provider, id, e := prefixIdentity(s.capturePath(logical))
191				if e != nil || provider != wantProvider || id != wantID {
192					continue
193				}
194			}
195			chosen = append(chosen, logical)
196			delete(selected, logical)
197		}
198		if len(selected) > 0 {
199			return p.View, errors.New("a selected file is outside the configured artifact scope")
200		}
201		if len(chosen) > MaxFiles {
202			return p.View, errors.New("archive at most 256 files per plan")
203		}
204		if len(chosen) == 0 || o.Session != "" && len(chosen) != 1 {
205			return p.View, errors.New("session/file selection must identify an unambiguous existing source")
206		}
207		if o.Timeout <= 0 {
208			o.Timeout = 20 * time.Minute
209		}
210		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, o.Timeout)
211		defer cancel()
212		for n, logical := range chosen {
213			path := s.capturePath(logical)
214			token, e := configedit.InspectToken(ctx, path)
215			if e != nil {
216				return p.View, errors.New("artifact source is unavailable, changing, unsafe or over 128 MiB")
217			}
218			data, e := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, path, MaxFileBytes)
219			if e != nil {
220				return p.View, errors.New("cannot take stable artifact snapshot")
221			}
222			provider, id := "files", uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte(s.Policy.ProjectID+"\x00"+logical)).String()
223			if s.Policy.Source == "specstory" {
224				provider, id, e = sessionIdentity(data)
225				if e != nil {
226					return p.View, e
227				}
228				if o.Session != "" && (provider != wantProvider || id != wantID) {
229					return p.View, ErrStale
230				}
231			}
232			item := snapshot{Path: path, Logical: logical, Token: token, Digest: hash(data), Provider: provider, SessionID: id, Payload: fmt.Sprintf("snapshot-%03d", n)}
233			if e = configedit.WritePrivate(ctx, filepath.Join(s.planDir(p.View.ID), item.Payload+".original"), data, false); e != nil {
234				return p.View, e
235			}
236			summary := FileSummary{File: logical, Bytes: int64(len(data)), Digest: s.opaque(item.Digest), Scan: "not-scanned"}
237			if s.Binding.Protection != "off" {
238				h, e := s.protector(ctx)
239				if e != nil {
240					return p.View, e
241				}
242				r, e := h.InspectSnapshot(ctx, logical, data, s.Binding.Protection == "redact")
243				if r.Report.ID != "" {
244					p.View.Reports = append(p.View.Reports, r.Report)
245				}
246				if e != nil {
247					p.View.Status = "blocked"
248					return p.View, e
249				}
250				data = r.Data
251				item.ScanInputs = r.InputDigest
252				summary.Scan = r.Report.Status
253				summary.Replacements = r.Replacements
254				summary.Cached = r.Cached
255			}
256			item.DesiredDigest = hash(data)
257			if e = configedit.WritePrivate(ctx, filepath.Join(s.planDir(p.View.ID), item.Payload), data, false); e != nil {
258				return p.View, e
259			}
260			fresh, e := configedit.InspectToken(ctx, path)
261			if e != nil || fresh != token {
262				return p.View, ErrStale
263			}
264			p.Snapshots = append(p.Snapshots, item)
265			p.View.Files = append(p.View.Files, summary)
266		}
267		if err = s.current(ctx, p); err != nil {
268			return p.View, err
269		}
270		p.AttributesToken, err = checkArchiveAttributes(ctx, archive, p, false)
271		if err != nil {
272			return p.View, err
273		}
274		p.View.ReviewDir = s.planDir(p.View.ID)
275		p.View.Notices = append(p.View.Notices, "Apply creates an archive commit. Original files and the source index stay unchanged; no push occurs.", "Review payloads privately; .original files contain the unmodified input and never enter the archive automatically.")
276		p.View.Notices = append(p.View.Notices, "The project archive receives .gitattributes disabling text/ident conversion for owned snapshots and records. Custom content filters are refused, never bypassed.")
277		if err = s.save(ctx, &p); err != nil {
278			return p.View, err
279		}
280		return p.View, nil
281	}

283	func cleanArchive(ctx context.Context, root string) error {
284		status, e := gitText(ctx, root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all")
285		if e != nil || status != "" {
286			return errors.New("archive checkout and index must be clean")
287		}
288		return nil

291	func (s *Service) validateSnapshots(ctx context.Context, p planRecord) error {
292		if err := s.current(ctx, p); err != nil {
293			return err
294		}
295		for _, snapshot := range p.Snapshots {
296			token, err := configedit.InspectToken(ctx, snapshot.Path)
297			if err != nil || token != snapshot.Token {
298				return ErrStale
299			}
300			data, e := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, filepath.Join(s.planDir(p.View.ID), snapshot.Payload), MaxFileBytes)
301			if e != nil || hash(data) != snapshot.DesiredDigest {
302				return errors.New("archive proposal content changed")
303			}
304			if snapshot.ScanInputs != "" {
305				h, e := s.protector(ctx)
306				if e != nil {
307					return e
308				}
309				inputs, e := h.SnapshotInputs(ctx)
310				if e != nil || inputs != snapshot.ScanInputs {
311					return ErrStale
312				}
313			}
314		}
315		return nil
316	}

14	// while the recorder has moved to another location. Native CLI overrides remain
15	// outside dev's invocation boundary and are never inferred from cached sessions.
16	func (s *Service) captureFingerprint(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
17		if s.Policy.Source != "specstory" {
18			return "not-specstory", nil
19		}
20		path := filepath.Join(s.Root, ".specstory", "cli", "config.toml")
21		data, e := readOptional(ctx, path)
22		if e != nil {
23			return "", errors.New("native SpecStory config unavailable")
24		}
25		return hash(data), nil
26	}

28	func (s *Service) validateCapture(ctx context.Context) error {
29		if s.Policy.Capture == "external" {
30			data, e := readOptional(ctx, filepath.Join(s.Root, ".specstory", "cli", "config.toml"))
31			if e != nil {
32				return errors.New("native SpecStory config unavailable")
33			}
34			var native struct {
35				Local struct {
36					Output  string `toml:"output_dir"`
37					Enabled *bool  `toml:"enabled"`
38				} `toml:"local_sync"`
39			}
40			if _, e := toml.Decode(string(data), &native); e != nil {
41				return errors.New("invalid SpecStory capture config")
42			}
43			if native.Local.Enabled != nil && !*native.Local.Enabled {
44				return errors.New("managed local capture was disabled; review capture policy")
45			}
46			actual := config.Expand(native.Local.Output)
47			if !filepath.IsAbs(actual) {
48				actual = filepath.Join(s.Root, actual)
49			}
50			if native.Local.Output == "" || filepath.Clean(actual) != s.Binding.CaptureDir {
51				return errors.New("SpecStory output_dir no longer matches this checkout's capture binding; run setup")
52			}
53		}
54		return nil
55	}

174	func (h *hygieneCLI) guard(ctx context.Context, root string, paths []string) error {
175		runtime := h.app.Runtime()
176		if runtime == nil || runtime.Name() == "none" {
177			return nil
178		}
179		observation, err := rt.InspectOccupancy(ctx, runtime, root, rt.OccupancyOptions{CallerWorkspaceID: os.Getenv("HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID"), CallerPaneID: os.Getenv("HERDR_PANE_ID")})
180		if err != nil || observation.SessionList.Err != nil || observation.AgentActivityList.Err != nil || observation.CurrentPane.Err != nil || observation.SessionCoverageErr != nil {
181			return errors.New("cannot verify checkout writer occupancy")
182		}
183		targets := make([]hygiene.WriterTarget, 0, len(paths))
184		for _, p := range paths {
185			rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, p)
186			if err != nil {
187				return errors.New("cannot identify artifact path for writer checks")
188			}
189			rel = filepath.ToSlash(rel)
190			target := hygiene.WriterTarget{Artifact: hygiene.IsArtifactPath(rel)}
191			if target.Artifact && specStoryTranscriptPath(rel) {
192				if _, session, readErr := artifact.ReadTranscriptSession(p); readErr == nil {
193					target.Session = session
194				}
195			}
196			targets = append(targets, target)
197		}
198		agents := make([]hygiene.WriterAgent, 0, len(observation.Agents))
199		for _, a := range observation.Agents {
200			session := a.Activity.Session
201			if session == "" && a.IsCaller && !observation.AgentActivityList.Supported {
202				// Only backends without an exact agent inventory fall back to panes.
203				session = callerPaneAgentSession(observation)
204			}
205			agents = append(agents, hygiene.WriterAgent{Caller: a.IsCaller, Blocking: a.Blocking, Session: session})
206		}
207		return hygiene.CheckWriters(agents, targets, h.app.allowSharedCheckout)
208	}
209	
210	// specStoryTranscriptPath limits preamble ownership proof to SpecStory history
211	// Markdown; plans and other artifacts never prove a different session.
212	func specStoryTranscriptPath(rel string) bool {
213		parts := strings.Split(rel, "/")
214		if len(parts) < 3 || !strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(parts[len(parts)-1]), ".md") {
215			return false
216		}
217		return strings.EqualFold(parts[len(parts)-3], ".specstory") && strings.EqualFold(parts[len(parts)-2], "history")
218	}
219	
220	func callerPaneAgentSession(observation rt.Occupancy) string {
221		if observation.CallerPaneID == "" {
222			return ""
223		}
224		for _, session := range observation.Sessions {
225			for _, pane := range session.Panes {
226				if pane.ID == observation.CallerPaneID {
227					return pane.AgentSession
228				}
229			}
230		}
231		return ""
232	}
233	func (h *hygieneCLI) apply(ctx context.Context, s *hygiene.Service, id string, yes, writerStopped bool, expectedKind string) error {
234		p, err := s.ReadPlan(ctx, id)
235		if err != nil {
236			return err
237		}
238		if p.Kind != expectedKind {
239			return errors.New("plan kind does not match this command")
240		}
241		if !yes {
242			if !h.app.interactive() {
243				return errors.New("review the saved plan, then use --apply --plan ID --yes")
244			}
245			if err = h.output(p, nil); err != nil {
246				return err
247			}
248			ok, e := newPrompter(h.app).confirm("Apply this hygiene plan?", false)
249			if e != nil {

422	func helpHighlight(text, query string) string {
423		terms := strings.Fields(query)
424		if len(terms) == 0 {
425			return text
426		}
427		for i := range terms {
428			terms[i] = regexp.QuoteMeta(terms[i])
429		}
430		re, err := regexp.Compile("(?i)" + strings.Join(terms, "|"))
431		if err != nil {
432			return text
433		}
434		return re.ReplaceAllStringFunc(ansi.Strip(text), func(s string) string { return styleSelected.Render(s) })
435	}

587		} else {
588			chosen = matches[len(matches)-1]
589			for i := len(matches) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
590				if matches[i] < loc.scroll {
591					chosen = matches[i]
592					break
593				}
594			}
595		}
596		loc.scroll = chosen
597		m.setHelpLocation(loc)
598	}

600	func (m Model) focusHelpSearch() (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
601		loc := m.helpLocation()
602		m.help.input = textinput.New()
603		m.help.input.Prompt = "/ "
604		m.help.input.CharLimit = 200
605		m.help.input.SetValue(loc.query)
606		m.help.editing = true
607		return m, m.help.input.Focus()
608	}
609	
610	func (m Model) updateHelp(message tea.KeyMsg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
611		loc := m.helpLocation()
612		key := message.String()
613		if m.help.editing {
614			switch key {
615			case "esc":
616				m.help.editing = false
617				m.help.input.Blur()
618				return m, nil
619			case "enter":
620				m.help.editing = false
621				m.help.input.Blur()
622				if loc.screen == helpTopicScreen {
623					loc.scroll = -1
624					m.setHelpLocation(loc)
625					m.helpFindNext(1)
626				}
627				return m, nil
628			}
629			var cmd tea.Cmd
630			m.help.input, cmd = m.help.input.Update(message)
631			loc.query = m.help.input.Value()
632			loc.scroll, loc.index, loc.xOffset = 0, 0, 0
633			m.setHelpLocation(loc)
634			if loc.screen != helpTopicScreen {
635				m.selectFirstHelpTarget()
636			}
637			return m, cmd
638		}
639		switch key {
640		case "?", "q":
641			m.overlay = overlayState{}
642		case "esc":
643			if loc.query != "" {
644				loc.query = ""
645				loc.scroll, loc.index = 0, 0
646				m.setHelpLocation(loc)
647			} else {
648				m.helpBack()
649			}
650		case "1", "2", "3":
651			m.setHelpSection(helpSection(key[0] - '1'))
652		case "tab":
653			m.setHelpSection((m.help.section + 1) % 3)
654		case "shift+tab":
655			m.setHelpSection((m.help.section + 2) % 3)
656		case "v":
657			if loc.screen == helpScopeScreen {
658				m.helpBack()
659			} else {
660				m.pushHelpLocation(helpLocation{screen: helpScopeScreen})
661			}
662		case "f":
663			m.popupExpanded = !m.popupExpanded
664		case "/":
665			return m.focusHelpSearch()
666		case "down", "j":
667			if loc.screen == helpTopicScreen || loc.screen == helpEntryScreen {
668				m.helpScroll(1)
669			} else {
670				m.helpMove(1)
671			}
672		case "up", "k":
673			if loc.screen == helpTopicScreen || loc.screen == helpEntryScreen {
674				m.helpScroll(-1)
675			} else {
676				m.helpMove(-1)
677			}
678		case "pgdown", "ctrl+d":
679			m.helpScroll(max(1, m.helpLayout().visible/2))
680		case "pgup", "ctrl+u":
681			m.helpScroll(-max(1, m.helpLayout().visible/2))
682		case "home", "g":
683			loc.scroll, loc.index = 0, 0
684			m.setHelpLocation(loc)
685		case "end", "G":
686			f := m.helpLayout()
687			loc.scroll = max(0, f.total-f.visible)
688			loc.index = max(0, f.total-1)
689			m.setHelpLocation(loc)
690		case "left", "h":
691			loc.xOffset = max(0, loc.xOffset-8)
692			m.setHelpLocation(loc)
693		case "right", "l":
694			w, _ := m.popupContentSize()
695			widest := 0
696			for _, r := range m.helpLayout().rows {
697				widest = max(widest, lipgloss.Width(r.text))
698			}
699			loc.xOffset = min(max(0, widest-w), loc.xOffset+8)
700			m.setHelpLocation(loc)
701		case "n":
702			if loc.screen == helpTopicScreen {
703				m.helpFindNext(1)
704			}
705		case "N":
706			if loc.screen == helpTopicScreen {
707				m.helpFindNext(-1)
708			}
709		case "enter":
710			f := m.helpLayout()
711			if loc.index < len(f.rows) {
712				return m.helpActivate(f.rows[loc.index].target)
713			}
714		default:
715			if message.Type == tea.KeyRunes && strings.HasPrefix(key, "/") {
716				next, cmd := m.focusHelpSearch()
717				m = next.(Model)
718				loc.query = strings.TrimPrefix(key, "/")
719				m.help.input.SetValue(loc.query)
720				loc.scroll, loc.index = 0, 0
721				m.setHelpLocation(loc)
722				m.selectFirstHelpTarget()
723				return m, cmd
724			}
725		}
726		return m, nil
727	}
728	
729	func (m Model) updateHelpMouse(event tea.MouseEvent) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
730		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelDown {
731			m.helpScroll(mouseWheelRows)
732			return m, nil
733		}
734		if event.Button == tea.MouseButtonWheelUp {
735			m.helpScroll(-mouseWheelRows)
736			return m, nil
737		}
738		if event.Button != tea.MouseButtonLeft || event.Action != tea.MouseActionPress {
739			return m, nil
740		}
741		f := m.helpLayout()
742		loc := m.helpLocation()
743		_, height := m.popupContentSize()
744		if event.Y == height-1 && loc.screen == helpTopicScreen {
745			width, _ := m.popupContentSize()
746			line := popupFit(helpFooterLine(f, loc), width)
747			for _, control := range []struct {
748				label string
749				key   tea.KeyType
750			}{{"[←]", tea.KeyLeft}, {"[→]", tea.KeyRight}} {
751				if i := strings.Index(line, control.label); i >= 0 {
752					x := lipgloss.Width(line[:i])
753					if event.X >= x && event.X < x+3 {
754						return m.updateHelp(tea.KeyMsg{Type: control.key})
755					}
756				}
757			}
758			return m, nil
759		}
760		if event.Y == 0 {
761			starts := []int{0, 10, 21}
762			ends := []int{8, 19, 31}
763			for i := range starts {
764				if event.X >= starts[i] && event.X < ends[i] {
765					m.setHelpSection(helpSection(i))
766					return m, nil
767				}
768			}
769		}
770		if event.Y == f.scopeY {
771			if loc.screen != helpHome {
772				m.helpBack()
773			} else {
774				m.pushHelpLocation(helpLocation{screen: helpScopeScreen})
775			}
776			return m, nil
777		}
778		if event.Y == f.searchY {
779			return m.focusHelpSearch()
780		}
781		start := min(max(0, loc.scroll), max(0, f.total-f.visible))
782		n := start + event.Y - f.contentY
783		if event.Y >= f.contentY && event.Y < f.contentY+f.visible && n < len(f.rows) {
784			loc.index = n
785			m.setHelpLocation(loc)
786			return m.helpActivate(f.rows[n].target)
787		}
788		return m, nil
789	}

The v1 lifecycle already separates queueing, alternate-index sanitation, and the frozen ordinary commit path, so I’m preserving that engine rather than adding a competing one. The v2 adapter contract is now sent to the native owner; I’m tracing where durable evidence must be inserted before any source or index publication.

22	
23	Exact session-only options:

14	
15	Run `specstory run claude` synchronously on the foreground TTY. The child gets
16	only AGENT_HISTORY_REQUEST_PATH and AGENT_HISTORY_RUN_ID as lifecycle context.
17	An agent may queue one inert request; it cannot authorize or run the finalizer.
18	
19	Required:
20	  claude                Explicit provider position (recommended).
21	  --provider claude     Equivalent flag form. Version 1 supports Claude only.
22	
23	Options:
24	  --allow-commit        Parent authorization for one automatic finalizer call,
25	                        only after the SpecStory child exits normally with 0,
26	                        its process group is empty, one exact quiet sync succeeds,
27	                        and a request exists.
28	  --                    Pass every remaining argument to `specstory run claude`.
29	  --help, -h            Show this help and exit.
30	
31	Noninteractive examples:
32	  run-specstory-session.sh claude -- --resume SESSION_UUID
33	  run-specstory-session.sh --allow-commit claude -- --no-cloud-sync
34	
35	Without --allow-commit, a successful queued run is synced and retained, and
36	exits 0 with status=authorization_required. The run succeeded; only the commit
37	is outstanding. Read `status`, not just the exit code, before treating history
38	as committed. Finish explicitly with `finalize-agent-commit.sh --allow-commit`.
39	
40	Exit codes:
41	  0       child succeeded: no request was queued, finalization completed, or a
42	          queued request awaits explicit finalization (status=authorization_required)
43	  1-255   nonzero child status is preserved exactly
44	  2       invalid runner arguments

47	  11      ordinary commit failed; prepared snapshot and drafts retained
48	  21      exact SpecStory sync failed; request retained
49	  22      child process group remained live; request retained, no sync/finalizer
50	  23      lifecycle proof could not be persisted

53	}

374		scope := strings.ToUpper(m.help.view.String())

376			scope = "All views"
377		}

380		f := helpFrame{header: []string{strings.Join(tabs, "  "), "View: [" + scope + " ▾]  · v"}, scopeY: 1, searchY: 2}
381		label := "/ Search TUI help…"
382		if m.help.section == helpManual {
383			label = "/ Search manual…"
384		}
385		if loc.screen == helpTopicScreen {
386			label = "/ Find in article…"
387		}
388		if m.help.editing {
389			input := m.help.input
390			input.Width = max(1, w-3)
391			label = input.View()
392		} else if loc.query != "" {
393			label = "/ " + loc.query
394		}
395		f.header = append(f.header, label, "")
396		if loc.screen != helpHome {
397			f.header[1] = "[Back]  " + scope
398			if loc.screen == helpTopicScreen {
399				f.header[1] = "[Back]  CLI: dev help"
400				if loc.topic != "@workflow" {
401					f.header[1] += " " + loc.topic
402				}
403			}
404		}
405		f.contentY = len(f.header)
406		f.visible = max(1, h-f.contentY-1)
407		f.rows = m.helpRows(w)
408		f.total = len(f.rows)
409		f.footer = "j/k scroll · / search · v view · f expand · Esc back"
410		if loc.screen == helpHome {
411			f.footer = "j/k choose · Enter details · / search · Esc close"
412		}
413		if loc.screen == helpTopicScreen {
414			f.footer = "[←] [→] · j/k scroll · n/N match · Esc back"
415		}
416		if m.help.editing {
417			f.footer = "Enter search · Esc stop editing; Esc again clears"
418		}
419		return f
420	}

149	
150	// send feeds a sequence of key presses through Update, running any command the
151	// model returns so the action callbacks actually fire — that is what makes
152	// these tests exercise the real key bindings rather than the model's fields.
153	func send(m tui.Model, msgs ...tea.Msg) tui.Model {
154		var cur tea.Model = m
155		for _, msg := range msgs {
156			var cmd tea.Cmd
157			cur, cmd = cur.Update(msg)
158			// Follow the command chain, so an action's resulting message (and the
159			// reload it triggers) is applied too. Commands that do not return
160			// promptly are the cursor's blink timers; running those would make the
161			// suite sleep for half a second per keystroke.
162			for i := 0; cmd != nil && i < 8; i++ {
163				out, ok := runQuickly(cmd)
164				if !ok || out == nil {
165					break
166				}
167				if _, isBatch := out.(tea.BatchMsg); isBatch {
168					break
169				}
170				cur, cmd = cur.Update(out)
171			}
172		}
173		return cur.(tui.Model)
174	}
175	
176	// runQuickly executes a command, giving up on anything that blocks — which in
177	// practice means the cursor blink timers.
178	func runQuickly(cmd tea.Cmd) (tea.Msg, bool) {
179		done := make(chan tea.Msg, 1)
180		go func() { done <- cmd() }()
181		select {
182		case msg := <-done:
183			return msg, true
184		case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
185			return nil, false
186		}
187	}
188	
189	func updateOnce(m tui.Model, msg tea.Msg) (tui.Model, tea.Cmd) {
190		updated, cmd := m.Update(msg)
191		return updated.(tui.Model), cmd
192	}
193	
194	func applyQuickCommand(t *testing.T, m tui.Model, cmd tea.Cmd) (tui.Model, tea.Cmd) {
195		t.Helper()
196		if cmd == nil {
197			t.Fatal("expected command")
198		}
199		msg, ok := runQuickly(cmd)
200		if !ok {
201			t.Fatal("command did not return promptly")
202		}
203		return updateOnce(m, msg)
204	}

206	func commandBatch(t *testing.T, cmd tea.Cmd) tea.BatchMsg {
207		t.Helper()
208		if cmd == nil {
209			t.Fatal("expected command batch")
210		}
211		msg, ok := runQuickly(cmd)
212		if !ok {
213			t.Fatal("command batch did not return promptly")
214		}
215		batch, ok := msg.(tea.BatchMsg)
216		if !ok {
217			t.Fatalf("command returned %T, want tea.BatchMsg", msg)
218		}
219		return batch
220	}

145			}

149		}

21			if e != nil || commit != intent.ArchiveCommit {
22				return nil, errors.New("finalized archive receipt is unavailable")
23			}
24			return intent, nil
25		}
26		if err = s.revalidate(ctx, intent); err != nil {
27			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "git-drift", err)
28		}
29		policy, err := h.PolicyFingerprint(ctx)
30		if err != nil || policy != intent.ArchivePolicy {

32		}

34			return nil, s.fail(ctx, intent.ID, "writer-unproven", errors.New("archive finalization requires post-writer proof"))
35		}
36		planID := intent.ArchivePlanID

38			if planID != "" && planID != request.ArchivePlanID {
39				return nil, errors.New("this intent already has an archive plan; inspect its receipt before replacing the handoff")
40			}
41			planID = request.ArchivePlanID

43		if planID == "" {

283	def classify(markdown: str, class_name: str, context: str, token: str) -> dict:
284	    """Determine whether `token` survived redaction in the given block."""
285	    marker = f"[class:{class_name}:{context}]"
286	    idx = markdown.find(marker)
287	    block = ""
288	    if idx >= 0:
289	        # The block runs until the next marker or the next section separator.
290	        rest = markdown[idx + len(marker):]
291	        stop = rest.find("[class:")
292	        block = rest if stop < 0 else rest[:stop]
293	
294	    present = token in block if block else token in markdown
295	    placeholders = _PLACEHOLDER_RE.findall(block)
296	    return {
297	        "present": present,
298	        "placeholders": sorted(set(placeholders)),
299	        "block_found": idx >= 0,
300	    }

298	        flags |= os.O_NOFOLLOW

301	        os.fchmod(descriptor, mode)
302	        offset = 0
303	        while offset < len(data):

8	func mergeRepoProgress(previous, updates []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
9		rows := append([]RepoRow(nil), previous...)
10		for _, row := range updates {
11			found := false
12			for i, old := range rows {
13				if old.Repo.Path == row.Repo.Path {
14					if row.Pending == "loading" && old.Pending != "loading" {
15						found = true
16						break
17					}
18					if row.TopologyPending && !old.TopologyPending && old.Pending == "" {
19						row.Topology, row.TopologyErr, row.TopologyPending = old.Topology, old.TopologyErr, false
20					}
21					if row.Usage == nil {
22						row.Usage, row.SizeError = old.Usage, old.SizeError
23					}
24					rows[i] = row
25					found = true
26					break
27				}
28			}
29			if !found {
30				rows = append(rows, row)
31			}
32		}
33		return rows
34	}

36	func (m Model) applyRepoProgress(result LocalResult) (Model, bool) {
37		state := m.viewLoad(ViewRepos)
38		if result.Generation != state.generation || m.repoProgressPhase == 3 {
39			return m, false
40		}
41		phase := 1
42		if result.Phase != "cache" {
43			phase = 2
44		}
45		if phase < m.repoProgressPhase {
46			return m, false
47		}
48		m.repoProgressPhase = phase
49		token := m.currentToken()
50		path := m.repoFocusPath()
51		m.repos = mergeRepoProgress(m.repos, result.Repos)
52		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].hasSnapshot = true
53		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].freshness = perftrace.FreshnessStale
54		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].actionable = false
55		m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceLive
56		if phase == 1 {
57			m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source = perftrace.SourceCache
58		}
59		count := len(m.repos)
60		m.trace.Mark(perftrace.TUIViewSnapshotAccepted, perftrace.Fields{View: perftrace.ViewRepos, Stage: perftrace.StageFirstEnrichment, Source: m.loads[int(ViewRepos)].source, Freshness: perftrace.FreshnessStale, Generation: result.Generation, Rows: &count})
61		message := fmt.Sprintf("Refreshing local repositories… %d visible", count)
62		if phase == 1 && len(result.Repos) > 0 {
63			message = "Cached " + result.Repos[0].ObservedAt.Local().Format("Jan 2 15:04") + " · " + message
64		}
65		m.setViewStatus(ViewRepos, message)
66		m.restoreRepoFocus(token, path)
67		m.setAt(m.at())
68		return m, true
69	}

71	func (m Model) repoFocusPath() string {
72		if item, ok := m.currentRepoItem(); ok {
73			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
74				return checkout.Worktree.Path
75			}
76			return item.Repo.Repo.Path
77		}
78		return ""
79	}
80	func (m *Model) restoreRepoFocus(token selectionToken, path string) {
81		if m.selectToken(token) || m.view != ViewRepos || path == "" {
82			return
83		}
84		for i, item := range m.visibleRepoItems() {
85			candidate := item.Repo.Repo.Path
86			if checkout, child := item.checkout(); child {
87				candidate = checkout.Worktree.Path
88			}
89			if candidate == path {
90				m.setAt(i)
91				return
92			}
93		}
94	}

96	func completeRepoRows(previous, rows []RepoRow) []RepoRow {
97		merged := mergeRepoProgress(previous, rows)
98		out := make([]RepoRow, 0, len(rows))
99		for _, row := range rows {
100			for _, candidate := range merged {
101				if row.Repo.Path == candidate.Repo.Path {
102					out = append(out, candidate)
103					break
104				}
105			}
106		}
107		return out

"""Versioned evidence for the existing post-session transaction; no commit engine.

All raw beforeimages and transformation inputs live only in private run state.
The importing lifecycle module supplies ``p`` to share its strict primitives.
"""
import base64
import contextlib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import selectors
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import time

p = None
CAPABILITIES = ["inspect_v2", "authentic_context_v2", "queue_idempotent_v2",
                "sanitation_receipt_v2", "review_v2", "exact_export_v2", "no_cloud_v2"]
MAX_SOURCE = 8 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_RECEIPT = 64 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_FINDINGS = 4096
JOURNAL_FIELDS = {"helper_revision", "revision", "cloud_sync", "wrapper", "child_pid",
                  "group_quiescent", "freshness", "receipt_revision", "publication_revision",
                  "review_revision", "review_status", "native_tool"}
REVIEW_STATES = {"not_required", "unresolved", "reviewed_noncredential",
                 "credential_rotation_required", "stale"}
DISPOSITIONS = {"unresolved", "reviewed_noncredential", "credential_rotation_required"}


def fail(code="evidence_unproven", exit_code=7):
    raise p.LifecycleError(code, "versioned evidence could not be proven", exit_code,
                           "inspect_private_run_state_without_retrying")


def digest(value):
    return p.sha256_bytes(p.canonical_json_bytes(value))


def read_generation(path, limit=MAX_SOURCE, private=False):
    if os.path.realpath(path) != path:
        fail("unsafe_source")
    before = os.lstat(path)
    if private and stat.S_IMODE(before.st_mode) != 0o600:
        fail("unsafe_mode")
    data = p.read_stable_owned_regular(path, limit)
    after = os.lstat(path)
    if data is None or p.file_generation(before) != p.file_generation(after):
        fail("source_changed")
    return data, {"path": path, "generation": list(p.file_generation(after)),
                  "sha256": p.sha256_bytes(data)}


def native_tool(path):
    path = os.path.realpath(path)
    info = os.stat(path)
    if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or not os.access(path, os.X_OK):
        fail("unsupported_tool")
    # Tools can be system-owned. Identity and full digest, never execute a
    # version command just to inspect capabilities.
    with open(path, "rb") as stream:
        hasher = hashlib.sha256()
        while True:
            chunk = stream.read(1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            hasher.update(chunk)
    if p.file_generation(info) != p.file_generation(os.stat(path)):
        fail("tool_changed")
    return {"path": path, "generation": list(p.file_generation(info)),
            "sha256": hasher.hexdigest()}


def helper_revision(script_dir):
    names = ["_post_session.py", "_post_session_v2.py", "run-specstory-session.sh",
             "queue-agent-commit.sh", "finalize-agent-commit.sh", "stage-agent-artifacts.sh",
             "find-session.sh", "scan-staged.sh", "agent-commit-metadata.sh",
             "../assets/redact_secrets.py", "../assets/artifact-dirs.txt",
             "../assets/gitleaks.toml.template", "../../git-workflow/scripts/check-commit-msg.sh"]
    entries = []
    for name in names:
        path = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(script_dir, name))
        data, _identity = read_generation(path, 2 * MAX_SOURCE)
        entries.append([name, p.sha256_bytes(data)])
    return digest(entries)


def process_identity(pid):
    if type(pid) is not int or pid <= 1:
        fail("requires_wrapper", 5)
    proc = subprocess.run(["ps", "-p", str(pid), "-o", "pid=,ppid=,pgid=,lstart="],
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=False,
                          env=dict(os.environ, LC_ALL="C"))
    fields = proc.stdout.decode("ascii", "strict").strip().split(None, 3)
    if proc.returncode or len(fields) != 4 or not all(x.isdigit() for x in fields[:3]):
        fail("requires_wrapper", 5)
    return {"pid": int(fields[0]), "ppid": int(fields[1]), "pgid": int(fields[2]),
            "started": fields[3]}


def authentic_context(journal):
    try:
        if journal["schema_version"] != 2 or journal["state"] not in ("running", "pending"):
            return False
        meta = journal["v2"]
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_HISTORY_RUN_ID") != journal["run_id"] or \
                os.environ.get("AGENT_HISTORY_REQUEST_PATH") != journal["request_path"]:
            return False
        wrapper = process_identity(meta["wrapper"]["pid"])
        if wrapper != meta["wrapper"] or type(meta["child_pid"]) is not int:
            return False
        current = process_identity(os.getpid())
        child_seen = False
        for _ in range(128):
            if current["pid"] == meta["child_pid"]:
                child_seen = current["pgid"] == meta["child_pid"]
            if current["pid"] == wrapper["pid"]:
                return child_seen
            if current["ppid"] <= 1:
                return False
            current = process_identity(current["ppid"])
    except (p.LifecycleError, OSError, ValueError):
        pass
    return False


def initial_metadata(script_dir, cloud_sync, specstory):
    return {"helper_revision": helper_revision(script_dir), "revision": 1,
            "cloud_sync": cloud_sync, "wrapper": process_identity(os.getpid()),
            "child_pid": None, "group_quiescent": None, "freshness": None,
            "receipt_revision": None, "publication_revision": None,
            "review_revision": None, "review_status": "not_required",
            "native_tool": native_tool(specstory)}


def validate_metadata(meta):
    if not isinstance(meta, dict) or set(meta) != JOURNAL_FIELDS:
        fail("invalid_state", 4)
    p.validate_sha256(meta["helper_revision"])
    if type(meta["revision"]) is not int or meta["revision"] < 1 or \
            type(meta["cloud_sync"]) is not bool or \
            meta["review_status"] not in REVIEW_STATES:
        fail("invalid_state", 4)
    if meta["group_quiescent"] is not None and type(meta["group_quiescent"]) is not bool:
        fail("invalid_state", 4)
    if meta["child_pid"] is not None and (type(meta["child_pid"]) is not int or meta["child_pid"] <= 1):
        fail("invalid_state", 4)
    for key in ("receipt_revision", "publication_revision", "review_revision"):
        p.validate_sha256(meta[key], allow_none=True)
    wrapper = meta["wrapper"]
    if not isinstance(wrapper, dict) or set(wrapper) != {"pid", "ppid", "pgid", "started"}:
        fail("invalid_state", 4)
    for key in ("pid", "ppid", "pgid"):
        if type(wrapper[key]) is not int or wrapper[key] < 1:
            fail("invalid_state", 4)
    p.safe_text(wrapper["started"])
    validate_identity(meta["native_tool"])
    fresh = meta["freshness"]
    if fresh is not None:
        if not isinstance(fresh, dict) or set(fresh) != {"source", "alias", "export_sha256", "tool", "complete"}:
            fail("invalid_state", 4)
        for key in ("source", "alias", "tool"):
            validate_identity(fresh[key])
        p.validate_sha256(fresh["export_sha256"])
        if fresh["complete"] is not True or fresh["export_sha256"] != fresh["alias"]["sha256"]:
            fail("invalid_state", 4)


def validate_identity(value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"path", "generation", "sha256"}:
        fail("invalid_evidence", 4)
    p.validate_absolute_path(value["path"])
    p.validate_sha256(value["sha256"])
    if not isinstance(value["generation"], list) or len(value["generation"]) != 7 or \
            any(type(x) is not int for x in value["generation"]):
        fail("invalid_evidence", 4)


def update(path, journal, **changes):
    meta = dict(journal["v2"])
    meta.update(changes)
    return p.update_journal(path, journal, v2=meta)


def bounded_command(command, root, limit, destination=None):
    """Bounded private capture; neither provider output nor errors reach logs."""
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=root, env=p.git_environment(),
                               stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                               start_new_session=True)
    data = bytearray()
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 90
    selector = selectors.DefaultSelector()
    selector.register(process.stdout, selectors.EVENT_READ)
    try:
        while selector.get_map():
            if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                fail("freshness_unproven")
            for key, _mask in selector.select(0.2):
                chunk = os.read(key.fileobj.fileno(), min(65536, limit + 1 - len(data)))
                if not chunk:
                    selector.unregister(key.fileobj)
                    break
                data.extend(chunk)
                if len(data) > limit:
                    fail("freshness_unproven")
        if process.wait(timeout=max(0.1, deadline - time.monotonic())) != 0:
            fail("freshness_unproven")
        if destination is not None:
            immutable_write(destination, bytes(data))
        return bytes(data)
    finally:
        selector.close()
        process.stdout.close()
        if process.poll() is None:
            with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
                os.killpg(process.pid, 9)
            process.wait()


def native_flags(tool, root, cloud_sync):
    sync_help = bounded_command([tool, "sync", "--help"], root, 128 * 1024)
    run_help = bounded_command([tool, "run", "--help"], root, 128 * 1024)
    required = [b"--print", b"--silent", b"--no-cloud-sync", b"--no-stats",
                b"--no-usage-analytics", b"--no-version-check"]
    if any(flag not in sync_help for flag in required) or \
            any(flag not in run_help for flag in required[2:]):
        fail("unsupported_native_export", 3)
    flags = ["--no-stats", "--no-usage-analytics", "--no-version-check"]
    if not cloud_sync:
        flags.append("--no-cloud-sync")
    return flags


def validate_forwarded(forwarded, cloud_sync):
    # Output/policy/config overrides would make run and exact export disagree.
    blocked = {"--config-dir", "--output-dir", "--only-cloud-sync", "--only-stats",
               "--no-redact-secrets", "--local-time-zone", "--print", "--telemetry-endpoint"}
    for item in forwarded:
        flag = item.split("=", 1)[0]
        if flag in blocked or (flag == "--no-cloud-sync" and "=" in item):
            fail("unsupported_run_option", 2)
    if cloud_sync and "--no-cloud-sync" in forwarded:
        fail("conflicting_cloud_choice", 2)


def capture_source(script_dir, root, request):
    fields = p.run_find_session(script_dir, root, request)
    path = fields.get("claude_jsonl_path") or fields.get("claude_path")
    if not path:
        fail("freshness_unproven")
    p.reject_active_writer(path)
    _data, identity = read_generation(path)
    return identity


def prove_export(script_dir, root, request, journal, source_before, flags):
    tool = journal["v2"]["native_tool"]
    if native_tool(tool["path"]) != tool:
        fail("tool_changed")
    if capture_source(script_dir, root, request) != source_before:
        fail("freshness_unproven")
    candidate_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(request["request_path"]), "exact-export.md")
    # Print is a read-only export even when the explicitly selected run permits
    # cloud sync. It never repeats the publication-bearing normal sync.
    export_flags = list(flags)
    if "--no-cloud-sync" not in export_flags:
        export_flags.append("--no-cloud-sync")
    candidate = bounded_command([tool["path"], "sync", request["provider"], "-s",
                                 request["session_id"], "--print", "--silent"] + export_flags,
                                root, MAX_SOURCE, candidate_path)
    p.run_find_session(script_dir, root, request)
    alias_data, alias = read_generation(os.path.join(root, request["specstory_path"]))
    if candidate != alias_data or not candidate.startswith(b"<!-- Generated by SpecStory, Markdown "):
        fail("freshness_unproven")
    source_after = capture_source(script_dir, root, request)
    if source_after != source_before or native_tool(tool["path"]) != tool:
        fail("freshness_unproven")
    return {"source": source_before, "alias": alias, "export_sha256": p.sha256_bytes(candidate),
            "tool": tool, "complete": True}


def reprove_freshness(script_dir, root, request, journal, prepared=False):
    meta = journal["v2"]
    fresh = meta["freshness"]
    if not fresh or meta["group_quiescent"] is not True or \
            meta["helper_revision"] != helper_revision(script_dir):
        fail("freshness_unproven")
    if capture_source(script_dir, root, request) != fresh["source"] or \
            native_tool(fresh["tool"]["path"]) != fresh["tool"]:
        fail("freshness_unproven")
    if not prepared:
        _data, alias = read_generation(os.path.join(root, request["specstory_path"]))
        if alias != fresh["alias"]:
            fail("freshness_unproven")


def immutable_write(path, data):
    """No-replace, fsynced private publication. Existing receipts never change."""
    parent = os.path.dirname(path)
    p.assert_private_dir(parent)
    if os.path.lexists(path):
        fail("evidence_already_exists")
    temporary = os.path.join(parent, ".evidence-" + os.urandom(12).hex())
    try:
        p.atomic_write(temporary, data)
        os.link(temporary, path, follow_symlinks=False)
        p.fsync_directory(parent)
    finally:
        with contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def load_private(path, maximum=MAX_RECEIPT):
    raw, identity = read_generation(path, maximum, private=True)
    # The ordinary protocol remains bounded to 128 KiB. Evidence has its own
    # explicit larger bound because it contains full PRIVATE beforeimages.
    try:
        value = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=p._unique_object,
                           parse_constant=p._reject_constant)
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
        fail("invalid_evidence", 4)
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or p.canonical_json_bytes(value) != raw:
        fail("invalid_evidence", 4)
    return value, identity["sha256"]


def encode(data):
    return base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")


def decode(value):
    try:
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            fail("invalid_evidence")
        return base64.b64decode(value, validate=True)
    except ValueError:
        fail("invalid_evidence")


def occurrence_offsets(data, value):
    if not value:
        fail("incomplete_finding")
    result = []
    start = 0
    while True:
        offset = data.find(value, start)
        if offset < 0:
            return result
        result.append([offset, offset + len(value)])
        if len(result) > MAX_FINDINGS:
            fail("incomplete_finding")
        start = offset + 1


def prepare_receipt(request_path, redactor, audit, selected, traces, coverage):
    root, git_dir = p.discover_repository()
    _id, run_dir, journal_path, journal, request, revision = p.parse_request_for_finalize(request_path, root, git_dir)
    if journal["schema_version"] != 2 or journal["state"] != "synced" or not p.request_lifecycle_is_proven(journal, request):
        fail("invalid_evidence")
    if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(run_dir, "finalize.lock")):
        fail("lifecycle_unproven")
    reprove_freshness(os.path.dirname(__file__), root, request, journal)
    exact = [request["specstory_path"]] + ([request["plan_path"]] if request["plan_policy"] == "path" else [])
    if list(selected) != exact:
        fail("selector_mismatch")
    records = []
    entries = {entry.path: entry for entry in audit.entries}
    count = 0
    for path in selected:
        before = entries[path]
        after = redactor._load_index_blob(path)
        source, identity = read_generation(os.path.join(root, path))
        clean = redactor._run_git(["hash-object", "--path=" + path, "--stdin"], source).strip().decode("ascii")
        if clean != before.oid or before.mode != after.mode:
            fail("source_changed")
        findings = []
        for finding in audit.findings_by_path.get(path, []):
            raw = redactor._encode_content(finding.get("Secret", ""))
            offsets = occurrence_offsets(before.data, raw)
            if not offsets or raw in after.data:
                fail("incomplete_finding")
            findings.append({"kind": "scanner", "rule": redactor._safe_rule_id(finding.get("RuleID")),
                             "value": encode(raw), "occurrences": offsets})
        analysis = redactor.analyze_private_key_content(redactor._decode_content(before.data))
        text = redactor._decode_content(before.data)
        if analysis.incomplete_headers:
            fail("incomplete_finding")
        for item in analysis.complete_ranges + analysis.isolated_header_ranges:
            raw = redactor._encode_content(text[item.start:item.end])
            start = len(redactor._encode_content(text[:item.start]))
            findings.append({"kind": "structure", "rule": "private-key-structure", "value": encode(raw),
                             "occurrences": [[start, start + len(raw)]]})
        # IDs are opaque run-bound values, never hashes of a bare credential.
        for finding in findings:
            count += 1
            if count > MAX_FINDINGS:
                fail("incomplete_finding")
            finding["id"] = digest([revision, path, before.oid, count, finding])
        records.append({"path": path, "mode": before.mode, "pre_oid": before.oid,
                        "post_oid": after.oid, "before_blob": encode(before.data),
                        "after_sha256": p.sha256_bytes(after.data), "source_before": encode(source),
                        "source_identity": identity, "steps": traces[path], "findings": findings})
    prepared_tree = redactor._run_git(["write-tree"]).strip().decode("ascii")
    receipt = {"schema_version": 2, "request_revision": revision, "request": request,
               "journal_revision": digest(journal), "prepared_tree": prepared_tree,
               "helper_revision": helper_revision(os.path.dirname(__file__)),
               "policy": read_generation(journal["gitleaks_config_path"], private=True)[1],
               "scanner": native_tool(shutil.which("gitleaks")), "git": native_tool(shutil.which("git")),
               "freshness": journal["v2"]["freshness"], "artifacts": records,
               "coverage": coverage, "complete": True}
    validate_receipt(receipt, redactor)
    raw = p.canonical_json_bytes(receipt)
    if len(raw) > MAX_RECEIPT:
        fail("incomplete_evidence")
    immutable_write(os.path.join(run_dir, "sanitation.json"), raw)
    # This durable journal transition is also before source/index publication.
    # If it fails, the receipt remains diagnostic evidence, never retry authority.
    update(journal_path, journal, receipt_revision=p.sha256_bytes(raw),
           review_status="unresolved" if count else "not_required")


def validate_receipt(receipt, redactor):
    required = {"schema_version", "request_revision", "request", "journal_revision", "prepared_tree",
                "helper_revision", "policy", "scanner", "git", "freshness", "artifacts", "coverage", "complete"}
    if set(receipt) != required or receipt["schema_version"] != 2 or receipt["complete"] is not True:
        fail("incomplete_evidence")
    p.validate_request(receipt["request"])
    if digest(receipt["request"]) != receipt["request_revision"] or not receipt["coverage"]:
        fail("incomplete_evidence")
    ids = set()
    for record in receipt["artifacts"]:
        if set(record) != {"path", "mode", "pre_oid", "post_oid", "before_blob", "after_sha256",
                           "source_before", "source_identity", "steps", "findings"}:
            fail("incomplete_evidence")
        before = decode(record["before_blob"])
        data = before
        origins = list(range(len(before)))
        removed = set()
        for step in record["steps"]:
            if set(step) != {"start", "end", "before", "after"}:
                fail("incomplete_evidence")
            start, end = step["start"], step["end"]
            if type(start) is not int or type(end) is not int or not 0 <= start < end <= len(data):
                fail("incomplete_evidence")
            if data[start:end] != decode(step["before"]):
                fail("incomplete_evidence")
            replacement = decode(step["after"])
            removed.update(x for x in origins[start:end] if x is not None)
            origins[start:end] = [None] * len(replacement)
            data = data[:start] + replacement + data[end:]
        if p.sha256_bytes(data) != record["after_sha256"]:
            fail("incomplete_evidence")
        covered = set()
        for finding in record["findings"]:
            if set(finding) != {"id", "kind", "rule", "value", "occurrences"} or finding["id"] in ids:
                fail("incomplete_evidence")
            ids.add(finding["id"])
            p.validate_sha256(finding["id"])
            value = decode(finding["value"])
            if not value or value in data or not finding["occurrences"]:
                fail("incomplete_evidence")
            expected = occurrence_offsets(before, value)
            if finding["kind"] == "scanner" and finding["occurrences"] != expected:
                fail("incomplete_evidence")
            for start, end in finding["occurrences"]:
                if [start, end] not in expected or not set(range(start, end)) <= removed:
                    fail("incomplete_evidence")
                covered.update(range(start, end))
        if removed != covered:
            fail("incomplete_evidence")
        for key, raw in (("pre_oid", before), ("post_oid", data)):
            actual = redactor._run_git(["hash-object", "--stdin", "--no-filters"], raw).strip().decode("ascii")
            if actual != record[key]:
                fail("incomplete_evidence")
        source = decode(record["source_before"])
        validate_identity(record["source_identity"])
        if p.sha256_bytes(source) != record["source_identity"]["sha256"]:
            fail("incomplete_evidence")
    return ids


def redactor_module(root, config, index_file=None):
    import importlib.util
    path = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "../assets/redact_secrets.py"))
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_receipt_redactor", path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    module._prepare_repository(config)
    if index_file:
        module.GIT_ENVIRONMENT["GIT_INDEX_FILE"] = index_file
    return module


def record_publication(root, request, journal_path, journal):
    run_dir = os.path.dirname(request["request_path"])
    receipt, revision = load_private(os.path.join(run_dir, "sanitation.json"))
    if revision != journal["v2"]["receipt_revision"] or p.index_tree(root) != receipt["prepared_tree"]:
        fail("publication_unproven")
    sources = []
    for record in receipt["artifacts"]:
        _data, identity = read_generation(os.path.join(root, record["path"]))
        sources.append(identity)
    publication = {"schema_version": 2, "receipt_revision": revision,
                   "prepared_tree": receipt["prepared_tree"], "sources": sources}
    raw = p.canonical_json_bytes(publication)
    immutable_write(os.path.join(run_dir, "publication.json"), raw)
    return update(journal_path, journal, publication_revision=p.sha256_bytes(raw))


def reprove_receipt(script_dir, root, request, journal, *, committed=False):
    run_dir = os.path.dirname(request["request_path"])
    receipt, revision = load_private(os.path.join(run_dir, "sanitation.json"))
    publication, publication_revision = load_private(os.path.join(run_dir, "publication.json"))
    if revision != journal["v2"]["receipt_revision"] or \
            publication_revision != journal["v2"]["publication_revision"] or \
            receipt["request"] != request or receipt["helper_revision"] != helper_revision(script_dir) or \
            receipt["prepared_tree"] != journal["expected_commit_tree"] or \
            publication.get("receipt_revision") != revision or \
            publication.get("prepared_tree") != receipt["prepared_tree"]:
        fail("stale_receipt")
    if read_generation(journal["gitleaks_config_path"], private=True)[1] != receipt["policy"] or \
            native_tool(shutil.which("gitleaks")) != receipt["scanner"] or \
            native_tool(shutil.which("git")) != receipt["git"]:
        fail("stale_receipt")
    redactor = redactor_module(root, journal["gitleaks_config_path"])
    validate_receipt(receipt, redactor)
    if not committed:
        reprove_freshness(script_dir, root, request, journal, prepared=True)
        for identity in publication["sources"]:
            if read_generation(identity["path"])[1] != identity:
                fail("stale_receipt")
        p.validate_prepared_snapshot(root, request, journal, p.load_artifact_dirs(script_dir))
    return receipt, revision


def review_decisions(path, receipt, revision, journal):
    if os.path.realpath(path) != path:
        fail("unsafe_review")
    p.assert_private_dir(os.path.dirname(path))
    value, review_revision = load_private(path, p.MAX_JSON_BYTES)
    if set(value) != {"schema_version", "request_revision", "receipt_revision", "prepared_tree", "decisions"} or \
            value["schema_version"] != 2 or value["request_revision"] != receipt["request_revision"] or \
            value["receipt_revision"] != revision or value["prepared_tree"] != receipt["prepared_tree"]:
        fail("stale_review")
    ids = {f["id"] for record in receipt["artifacts"] for f in record["findings"]}
    if not isinstance(value["decisions"], list) or len(value["decisions"]) != len(ids):
        fail("incomplete_review")
    seen = set()
    states = set()
    for decision in value["decisions"]:
        if not isinstance(decision, dict) or set(decision) != {"finding_id", "disposition", "reason"}:
            fail("incomplete_review")
        finding = decision["finding_id"]
        if finding not in ids or finding in seen or decision["disposition"] not in DISPOSITIONS:
            fail("incomplete_review")
        p.safe_text(decision["reason"])
        if not decision["reason"].strip() or len(decision["reason"]) > 2048:
            fail("incomplete_review")
        seen.add(finding)
        states.add(decision["disposition"])
    status = "unresolved" if "unresolved" in states else (
        "credential_rotation_required" if "credential_rotation_required" in states else "reviewed_noncredential")
    return value, review_revision, status


def apply_review(arguments, root, request, journal_path, journal):
    receipt, revision = reprove_receipt(arguments.script_dir, root, request, journal)
    run_dir = os.path.dirname(request["request_path"])
    if arguments.review_file:
        if not arguments.allow_commit or journal["state"] != "rotation_required":
            fail("invalid_authorization", 5)
        value, review_revision, status = review_decisions(arguments.review_file, receipt, revision, journal)
        if status == "unresolved":
            fail("unresolved_review", 10)
        if status == "credential_rotation_required" and not arguments.rotation_confirmed:
            fail("rotation_confirmation_required", 10)
        if status == "reviewed_noncredential" and arguments.rotation_confirmed:
            fail("invalid_authorization", 5)
        # An approved exact receipt is retained immutably; this is NOT a future
        # policy allowlist and contains no claim that sanitation rotated a key.
        immutable_write(os.path.join(run_dir, "review-" + review_revision + ".json"), p.canonical_json_bytes(value))
        journal = update(journal_path, journal, review_revision=review_revision, review_status=status)
    elif journal["v2"]["review_revision"]:
        path = os.path.join(run_dir, "review-" + journal["v2"]["review_revision"] + ".json")
        _value, review_revision, status = review_decisions(path, receipt, revision, journal)
        if review_revision != journal["v2"]["review_revision"] or status != journal["v2"]["review_status"]:
            fail("stale_review")
    return journal


def preview(arguments, root, git_dir, journal, request):
    if journal["schema_version"] != 2:
        fail("legacy_review_unsupported", 4)
    receipt, revision = reprove_receipt(arguments.script_dir, root, request, journal,
                                        committed=journal["state"] in ("done", "committing"))
    findings = []
    for record in receipt["artifacts"]:
        for item in record["findings"]:
            # Do not echo arbitrary scanner rule IDs: a hostile rule can itself
            # contain a full raw value. Kind + opaque IDs are sufficient review metadata.
            findings.append({"finding_id": item["id"], "path": record["path"],
                             "kind": item["kind"], "masked_value": "[REDACTED]",
                             "occurrence_count": len(item["occurrences"]), "complete": True})
    p.emit({"schema_version": 2, "protocol_version": 2, "status": "review_preview",
            "request_revision": receipt["request_revision"], "receipt_revision": revision,
            "prepared_tree": receipt["prepared_tree"], "review_status": journal["v2"]["review_status"],
            "reviewable": journal["state"] == "rotation_required", "findings": findings,
            "private_receipt_path": os.path.join(os.path.dirname(request["request_path"]), "sanitation.json"),
            "private_review_path": os.path.join(os.path.dirname(request["request_path"]), "review.json"),
            "commit_attempted": False})
    return 0


def capabilities(arguments):
    p.emit({"schema_version": 2, "protocol_version": 2, "status": "supported",
            "helper_revision": helper_revision(arguments.script_dir), "capabilities": CAPABILITIES})
    return 0


def inspect(arguments):
    root, git_dir = p.discover_repository()
    request_path = arguments.request or os.environ.get("AGENT_HISTORY_REQUEST_PATH", "")
    if not request_path:
        fail("requires_wrapper", 5)
    run_dir, journal_path, journal = p.validate_run_layout(request_path, root, git_dir)
    request = None
    request_revision = None
    if os.path.lexists(request_path):
        _id, _dir, _path, journal, request, request_revision = p.parse_request_for_finalize(request_path, root, git_dir)
    authentic = authentic_context(journal)
    if arguments.context and not authentic:
        fail("requires_wrapper", 5)
    protocol = journal["schema_version"]
    fresh, review, proven = "unproven", "not_required", False
    if protocol == 2:
        review = journal["v2"]["review_status"]
        if journal["v2"]["freshness"]:
            try:
                reprove_freshness(arguments.script_dir, root, request, journal,
                                  prepared=journal["staging_ready"])
                fresh = "proven"
            except (p.LifecycleError, OSError):
                fresh = "stale"
        if journal["staging_ready"]:
            try:
                reprove_receipt(arguments.script_dir, root, request, journal, committed=journal["state"] == "done")
                if journal["state"] == "done":
                    proven = p.commit_matches_request(root, journal["commit_oid"], request, journal, require_trailer=True)
            except (p.LifecycleError, OSError):
                review = "stale"
    result = {"schema_version": 2, "protocol_version": protocol,
              "helper_revision": helper_revision(arguments.script_dir),
              "capabilities": CAPABILITIES if protocol == 2 else [],
              "status": "inspected" if protocol == 2 else "legacy_v1", "run_id": journal["run_id"],
              "request_path": request_path, "request_id": request["request_id"] if request else None,
              "request_revision": request_revision, "journal_revision": digest(journal),
              "state": journal["state"], "worktree_root": root, "git_dir": git_dir,
              "head_ref": request["head_ref"] if request else None, "head_oid": request["head_oid"] if request else None,
              "input_index_tree": request["index_tree"] if request else None,
              "message_sha256": request["base_message_sha256"] if request else None,
              "prepared_tree": journal["expected_commit_tree"], "commit_oid": journal["commit_oid"],
              "child_exit_code": journal["child_exit_code"], "child_signal": journal["child_signal"],
              "group_quiescent": journal["v2"]["group_quiescent"] if protocol == 2 else None,
              "sync_status": "proven" if journal["sync_succeeded"] else (
                  "failed" if journal["state"] == "failed" and journal["sync_attempted"] else (
                  "pending" if journal["sync_attempted"] else "not_started")),
              "freshness_status": fresh, "review_status": review, "authentic_context": authentic,
              "receipt_revision": journal["v2"]["receipt_revision"] if protocol == 2 else None,
              "commit_proven": proven}
    for key in ("provider", "session_id", "specstory_path", "plan_policy", "plan_path"):
        result[key] = request[key] if request else None
    # No cache/index refresh, lock, scanner, draft cleanup, or journal mutation.
    if digest(p.read_canonical_json(journal_path, "journal", p.validate_journal)[0]) != result["journal_revision"]:
        fail("stale_inspection", 6)
    p.emit(result)
    return 0
