2	
3	Clones initialize submodules recursively at gitlinks by default. `--submodules=none` and global/project `[submodules].init` control acquisition independently of setup presets. Initialization failure retains the clone and prevents runtime handoff. See `submodules.md`.
4	
5	`dev repo new`, `repo clone`, and `repo setup` share one scaffold pipeline. A
6	plain name creates a new repository. A clear Git URL, local Git path, or
7	`owner/name` passed to either `repo new` or its `create` alias routes to clone
8	automatically, preserving source history and its remote. Template and
9	upstream-creation flags conflict with that route; use explicit `repo clone`
10	whenever callers should state acquisition unambiguously.
11	
12	```bash
13	dev repo new                              # interactive
14	dev repo create api                       # minimal, script-friendly
15	dev repo new api --template owner/starter --check-in=stage
16	dev repo clone owner/api                  # optional setup after clone
17	dev repo setup . --preset agent-ready --check-in=stage
18	```
19	
20	The interactive default is `agent-ready`; explicit `repo new NAME` remains
21	`minimal`. Its canonical `AGENTS.md` starter explicitly labels bootstrap status
22	incomplete, supplies safe repository-wide and handoff rules, and leaves unknown
23	purpose, commands, architecture, and invariants as TODOs rather than inventing
24	project facts. Use `--dry-run` before a custom preset and `--json` for
25	automation. Dry-run does not mutate the target repository. JSON never prompts,
26	changes directory, or activates a runtime; automation supplies the required
27	name/ref and an explicit setup preset.
28	
29	`repo setup` repeat-safely merges native initializers and preset files. Custom
30	hooks and skill setup remain responsible for their own idempotency.
31	
32	The no-argument create/setup wizards keep the common path short. After preset
33	selection they ask `Customize preset ... options?` once. Answering no accepts
34	the resolved preset and skips its detailed template, typed-input,
35	README/gitignore/license, Claude plans, AGENTS, skill and catalog questions.
36	The gate defaults to yes when the command line already selected a customization
37	or a required typed input has no default. This changes prompt volume, not preset
38	resolution: supplied flags still participate in the final plan.
39	
40	On a real terminal, every shared wizard text field uses an inline editor.
41	Cursor keys, Home/End, Backspace and Delete edit the current text rather than
42	being decoded as literal `^[[C`/`^[[D` bytes. Esc and Ctrl-C cancel. Bracketed
43	defaults remain hints accepted by Enter rather than text silently inserted into
44	the field. Non-TTY and piped callers retain deterministic line-based input.

46	## Repository selection
47	
48	Bare `dev repo clone` uses the existing private forge cache as a candidate list.
49	It passes the selected provider's exact clone URL into the normal acquisition
50	flow, supports stale/incomplete cache with a warning, and never refreshes the
51	network merely because the picker opened. Manual URL, path, and `owner/name`
52	entry remains available; a missing or source-mismatched cache goes directly to
53	that prompt.
54	
55	Outside a checkout, bare `dev start` uses fast live repository discovery for
56	its picker and performs a full resolve after selection. Inside a repository it
57	keeps the immediate current-repository default without scanning all roots. `[picker].command` is one direct argv vector,
58	defaulting to `fzf`; no shell evaluates it. A missing executable falls back to
59	the built-in Bubble Tea selector, while `command = []` forces that backend.
60	Compatible external selectors read lines on stdin and return one unchanged line
61	on stdout. See the repository `contrib/` directory for Television and fzf
62	composition over `dev repo remote --cached --json`.

64	## Template snapshots
65	
66	Only `repo new` accepts a starter tree:
67	
68	```bash
69	dev repo new api --template ./starters/service
70	dev repo new api --template owner/starter --template-ref v2 \
71	  --template-subdir services/go
72	```
73	
74	`--template` accepts a local directory, Git URL, or forge shorthand.
75	`--template-ref` selects an exact branch, tag, or commit;
76	`--template-subdir` promotes one relative directory to the new repository root.
77	A preset may provide `template`, `template_ref`, and `template_subdir`, and an
78	explicit `--template=none` disables that preset source.
79	
80	This is intentionally not clone semantics. dev takes a content snapshot and
81	then initializes a fresh repository, so source commits, remotes, branches and
82	all `.git` metadata stay behind. Source selection is:
83	
84	- A local Git worktree without `--template-ref` uses its current tracked files
85	  plus untracked files selected by Git's standard excludes. Ignored files are
86	  omitted, so build output and locally ignored secrets are not accidentally
87	  copied.
88	- A non-Git local directory uses its complete current regular-file tree.
89	- A local Git source with a ref, or a remote Git source, uses the tree at the
90	  resolved commit.
91	
92	Use `repo clone` when source history and its remote should survive. Credential
93	userinfo embedded in an HTTP(S) or similar URL is available to Git for the
94	fetch but is redacted anywhere dev renders, returns, or wraps that source.
95	
96	Preparation finishes before destination mutation. The snapshot owns stable
97	copies of file bytes, modes and empty directories; a local source changing
98	during the read fails closed. Parent traversal, absolute subdirectories,
99	symlinks, special files and reserved `.git` paths are rejected. Snapshot and

104	Application requires a newly initialized repository containing only Git

107	so preset file generation skips collisions instead of overwriting the selected
108	starter; native merge initializers may still merge their specific safe
109	settings.

111	`--dry-run` never creates the target, but preparing a remote template may still

118	## Check-in disposition
119	
120	Repository acquisition, generated content, and Git check-in are separate
121	decisions:
122	
123	```bash
124	dev repo new api --check-in=commit
125	dev repo new api --check-in=stage --message "chore: initial commit"
126	dev repo setup . --preset agent-ready --check-in=none
127	```
128	
129	`--check-in` accepts:
130	
131	- `auto`: for a new repository, use preset `initial_check_in`; legacy
132	  `initial_commit=true|false` maps to `commit|none`. Clone/setup preserve
133	  existing history and otherwise resolve `auto` to `none`.
134	- `commit`: run `git add -A`, create the commit, and then run `after_commit`
135	  skill/hook phases.
136	- `stage`: run `git add -A` after files, selected skills, built-in setup and
137	  `before_commit` hooks, but leave the commit for the user. `after_commit` does
138	  not run.
139	- `none`: leave generated changes unstaged.
140	
141	`repo setup --commit` remains a compatibility alias for
142	`--check-in=commit`; combining it with `stage` or `none` is an error. The
143	`--message` value applies to both committed and staged-for-review outcomes.
144	Project config can seed an existing-repository wizard with
145	`[repo.setup] check_in = "stage"`; it cannot set both `check_in` and the legacy
146	`commit` boolean.
147	
148	Stage mode seeds `<worktree-git-dir>/LAZYGIT_PENDING_COMMIT` with the suggested
149	message. Lazygit's lowercase `c` reads this private per-worktree draft and
150	clears it after a successful commit. It is deliberately best effort:

152	- Git's `.git/COMMIT_EDITMSG` and `commit.template` are different mechanisms;
153	  lazygit's `c` does not use them.
154	- Lazygit's uppercase `C` editor path and other Git clients are not promised to
155	  read the draft. From lowercase `c`, switching to the editor preserves the
156	  already loaded text.
157	- A pre-existing different draft is user state, so dev leaves it untouched and
158	  warns instead of replacing it.
159	- Failure to create or sync this optional draft is also only a warning. The
160	  successfully staged index remains the result; enter the displayed message
161	  manually rather than rerunning setup.
162	
163	Creating an upstream from `repo setup` requires `commit`. A newly created
164	upstream can only be pushed after `commit`, while `stage` cannot be combined

166	local stage-for-review. `start` also requires a clean committed setup; use

170	
171	Global presets live in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dev/scaffolds.toml`. A target repo may
172	override portable setup behavior with `.dev-cli/config.toml` and
173	`.dev-cli/scaffolds.toml`. It cannot change host paths, runtime, state, forge

349	MCP reads static declarations for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and
350	OpenCode. It preserves file/scope rows and exact Claude local project keys instead
351	of guessing a generally effective configuration; only Claude's documented
352	user/project/local/managed project approvals are resolved. An absolute
353	`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` relocates Claude user sources. Configured/enabled/disabled
354	never means connected or healthy. Provider-specific environment reference names
355	and finite OAuth facts remain, while values, raw arguments, URL
356	credentials/path/query/fragment, and indirect file content are discarded before
357	rows enter the model. The scanner never runs a server, helper, URL, or agent MCP
358	command. Filters include `repo:`,
359	`agent:`, `scope:`, `transport:`, `managed:`, and `state:`; `r` only rereads
360	static files. Press `e` to open the selected declaration's `ConfigPath`; the `y`
361	menu copies its path (`p`), sanitized declaration (`s`), or the entire raw file
362	(`f`). Raw copy is a local regular-file read capped at 1 MiB and performs no
363	network access, but it can put credentials and other declarations from that file
364	into the system clipboard. Rows and structured output remain sanitized. `e`
365	edits a private working copy, revalidates the observed source immediately before
366	atomic replacement, and preserves the working copy when it detects a conflict.
367	
368	## External tools
369	
370	```bash
371	dev tui tools
372	```
373	
374	Configured tools run through `$SHELL` in the selected checkout while the alternate screen is suspended. `interactive = true` uses `$SHELL -lic` so local aliases/functions can resolve; use a real executable on `PATH` when the binding must be portable. Availability probes run in a bounded background load after the first view; rendering never starts a login shell, and unresolved bindings fail closed.
375	
376	```toml
377	[[tui.tools]]
378	key = "L"
379	name = "lazygit"
380	run = "lazygit"
381	```
382	
383	Keys are case-sensitive and cannot shadow globally owned dashboard bindings. `A` remains configurable for compatibility, but the SKILLS/MCP scope toggle takes precedence on those views. Returning from an editor can reload most config; switching runtime backend requires restarting the TUI.
384	
385	## Inventory an existing machine
386	
387	Start with a report:
388	
389	```bash
390	dev bootstrap ~/code /mnt/work
391	dev bootstrap ~/code --json
392	```
393	
394	The scanner identifies canonical checkouts, linked worktrees, bare repositories, and symlink aliases, then deduplicates them by Git identity.
395	
396	The recommended organization layer is a non-destructive symlink index:
397	
398	```bash
399	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat
400	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat --apply
401	```
402	
403	Physical moves are a separate, stricter mode. A move plan blocks dirty repositories, linked worktrees, live sessions/current working directories, aliases that would break, occupied destinations, and cross-filesystem renames. If any row is blocked, apply moves none.
404	
405	## Adopt work already in flight
406	
407	Bootstrap answers **where repositories are**. Adoption answers **which existing branches, worktrees, and sessions are active work**:
408	
409	```bash
410	dev adopt
411	dev adopt --apply
412	```
413	
414	Adopt reports by default and only writes task entries after `--apply` plus confirmation. It does not move, rename, or delete checkouts, and it excludes recognized harness-ephemeral worktrees.

434	
435	Use [dashboard lifecycle actions](dashboard-actions.md) for task finish/resume/retire/recovery, full start wizards, Trash disposal and repository browser actions. `Ctrl+O` opens the selected row menu; TASKS `a` shows completed tasks.

437	## Dashboard navigation and organizer entry
438	
439	Enter opens a repository/task row or starts FLEET host navigation. Space expands or collapses REPOS/FLEET trees; flat lists leave Space unused. REPOS/TRY `Ctrl+O` offers organization of the
440	current item, filtered results, or all local work; multi-selection belongs to the
441	independent triage screen. `1–7` selects TASKS, REPOS, FLEET, TRY, REMOTE, SKILLS,
442	and MCP respectively. TASKS state filters live in its action menu (`a` still
443	shows done tasks). Click a data column for ascending → descending → default
444	ordering; FLEET HOST groups machines. Sorting is local to each view/session and
445	uses the current snapshot, with unknown values last. The footer keeps two lines
446	of primary actions and navigation; tools, state filters and sorting are in
447	`Ctrl+O`, and `?` opens contextual Keys/Guide/Manual help. Existing custom tool bindings for `4–7`
448	need reassignment; `x`/Ctrl+A are no longer reserved dashboard selection keys.
449	
450	Triage uses grouped repo/Try checkboxes, mouse selection, and Ctrl+A all/none
451	within the filtered scope. Results preserve failures when returning to the
452	dashboard. Git synchronization diagnostics retain a category, exit code, bounded
453	redacted output and a next step; old receipts cannot recover discarded reasons.
454	Retries require a new preview. Authentication, fetch and rebase are never
455	silently performed as error recovery. See [local triage](local-triage.md).
456	
457	
458	## Progressive loading, searchable actions and yearly activity
459	
460	REPOS first reads a dated presentation cache, then publishes discovery and Git
461	observations incrementally. A slow runtime does not hold back repository rows.
462	Pending/cached rows grant no action authority. Only complete discovery removes
463	missing rows; failures retain stale/unknown evidence. `r` remains local refresh;
464	`dev cache clear repos` removes the snapshot. SIZE retains its separate cache.
465	
466	Ctrl+O menus and submenus support `/` filtering, arrows and Enter; Escape clears
467	search before closing. `H` displays saved stats, then automatically backfills the
468	selected repository's full local Git history. Unchanged refs reuse a checkpoint.
469	Calendar years run oldest first, with wheel/arrows, PgUp/PgDn and Home/End
470	scrolling; narrow screens split into week segments. `r` refreshes and `b` forces
471	backfill without fetching. Git activity is still a 20-minute estimate per
472	non-merge commit.
473	
474	The REPOS/SKILLS action menu opens the independent
475	[Skills management wizard](skills-management.md) for scopes, selection, checks
476	and reviewed mutations; it is not another dashboard tab.
477	
478	
479	### Local loading measurement
480	
481	A 60-repository isolated fixture, three runs per case on macOS with Go 1.26.4,
482	measured the following medians. These are trace acceptance times, not terminal
483	rasterization; all live Git reads still finish in the background.
484	
485	| Case | First repository data | Complete local snapshot |
486	|---|---:|---:|
487	| Previous dashboard | 3,896 ms | 3,896 ms |
488	| New, no presentation cache | 14 ms | 3,911 ms |
489	| New, presentation cache | 15 ms | 2,819 ms |
490	
491	The first display no longer waits for a full scan. Full-scan duration remains
492	sensitive to filesystem/process load; this change does not claim cached Git
493	facts are current. Recovery details are loaded for the focused repository, and
494	completed rows become available while other repositories are still loading.
495	
496	## SSH connection view
497	
498	The eighth tab keeps one machine row, with Space expanding its SSH profiles.
499	Configured connections come first, ordered by the most recent local `dev ssh
500	connect` or dashboard connection attempt; unrecorded profiles follow by alias.
501	CONNECTION, ENDPOINT, SOURCES, CHECK and USED share aligned display widths.
502	Narrow terminals hide supplementary columns; details retain full source names,
503	identity state, timestamps and per-profile results. Column sorting and filtering
504	preserve selection, including when a discovery update regroups a profile.
505	
506	`c` stays inside the dashboard: choose Tailscale, or a LAN interface, explicit
507	IPv4 range and ports. LAN defaults to port 22 and retains the 256-address,
508	16-port and 30-second limits. Progress includes completed endpoints and found
509	candidates. Cancel keeps collected observations. The list then shows **this
510	discovery**, so an old filter cannot hide the results; return to all connections
511	without losing the previous filter. Cache write failures retain the observations
512	for this session and offer recovery guidance. A missing SSH config, registry,
513	fzf or optional provider does not prevent LAN discovery.
514	
515	Enter on an unconfigured candidate opens a native setup form with its selected
516	endpoint. Review alias, remote user, port and authentication. Configuration-only
517	is the default; Fleet and Herdr are independent opt-in destinations. Preview
518	includes first-time SSH initialization and explicit machine bindings. Native
519	SSH/key and Herdr interactions receive the terminal only after review. Returning
520	to the dashboard shows each completed, failed or unknown stage and selects the
521	new profile. Completed configuration survives a later authentication/provider
522	failure. A changed LAN scope requires renewed discovery/review.
523	
524	Choice fields show every option with the current one bracketed, such as
525	`config · existing · [key]`; ←/→ or Space cycle them. Enter or Space on **Key**
526	opens a picker of file-backed local keys, **+ Generate a new key** and a manual
527	path; Esc returns to the form, and picking a key selects key authentication.
528	**+ Generate a new key** opens a short form for the new key path and an optional
529	comment before returning to the form. Keys from present Bitwarden, 1Password or
530	Secretive agents and a validated `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` are listed too. Agent-only choices
531	retain the exact fingerprint and socket; unavailable providers show guidance.
532	Security-key generation also exposes the type, provider, resident handle,
533	verify-required and application options. Review shows the native touch/PIN flow
534	and possible retained hardware effects; automatic Secure Enclave creation remains unavailable.
535	Vault choices use a separate creation review before returning to SSH setup. The
536	result retains item receipts if the later SSH form is canceled; Bitwarden desktop
537	handoff shows newly visible agent keys rather than claiming vault-item creation.
538	
539	`Ctrl+O` on a row with LAN or Tailscale candidates offers **set up this discovered
540	target…**, a form prefilled from that observation, including a matching profile's
541	user. On a configured profile it offers **set up / install an SSH key…**: choose the
542	exact profile when several exist, pick a key, set Remote OS and optional
543	Fleet/Herdr, then review. Connection settings are not editable. A foreign alias
544	receives only the public key; a managed alias also records the key as its
545	IdentityFile, shown in the review.
546	
547	`p` offers quick network tests or full SSH verification for a profile, machine,
548	or filtered profile set. Review the exact targets before starting. DNS/route,
549	Ping, TCP, SSH banner, handshake, host-key, authentication and session observations
550	remain separate; Ping failure does not gate SSH. Proxy paths are not bypassed by
551	direct probes. Up to four profiles run together, each bounded to 30 seconds;
552	Ping has two seconds and an SSH attempt fifteen. Cancellation retains finished
553	results. A network-only success is not successful authentication.
554	
555	Usage and tests are separate private durable records under
556	`paths.state_dir/ssh/activity/`. Testing never updates USED. Usage records actual
557	process starts, including failed attempts, and covers only local dev-mediated
558	connections; no shell history is imported. Test results retain profile revision,
559	observation time and available route context. Old results are historical evidence,
560	not live connectivity or deletion authority; clearing discovery cache preserves
561	activity records.
562	
563	The first frame reads local data and cache. While this view is active,
564	`[tui.ssh].background_refresh = true` refreshes missing or expired Tailscale
565	observations, at most once per five minutes with a five-second query limit.
566	Failures keep dated observations. Disable it for cache-only viewing. `r` reloads
567	local state; LAN scanning and SSH tests always require an explicit action.
568	`Ctrl+O` also opens problems and suggested actions, even on an empty list.

571	
572	REPOS → Ctrl+O offers hygiene setup for the current or filtered repositories.
573	Choose repositories and prepared plans, inspect retained hooks, then confirm.
574	This configures ordinary commits, without installing an agent skill.
575	SKILLS → Ctrl+O → remove skills in this scope opens the shared management wizard with
576	skill and agent multi-selection. Ownership, shared consumers and finalizer

123	可點擊的確認／取消。較長的預覽可在文字上使用滾輪或 PgUp/PgDn 捲動。
124	只追加所選欄位，保留註解、項目順序與省略欄位繼承的預設值；避免重複加入，
125	不自動合併或刪除既有項目。儲存後重新載入本機清單並選取新加入的 repo。
126	掃描失敗或不完整維持未知，不會直接當成未納管提示加入。
127	
128	自動寫入使用 macOS/Linux 的 guarded file backend，保留 metadata，並在
129	`$XDG_DATA_HOME/dev/config-recovery` 保存私有復原紀錄。設定檔被同時編輯或
130	repo 身分改變時拒絕套用舊預覽。Symlink 設定檔、不支援的 TOML 格式或平台
131	會提供手動修改內容與設定編輯器入口。若儲存成功但重載失敗，會分別回報。
132	
133	## 常用 actions
134	
135	### TASKS
136	
137	```text
138	enter/o   開啟選取的 task
139	p         park warm 並輸入 next action
140	c         編輯 next action
141	n/N       quick-add／瀏覽 repository notes
142	ctrl+o    task state filters
143	```
144	
145	COLD worktree task 必須透過 `dev resume` 重建；TUI 不會用 generic open action 靜默重建。若 worktree 已遺失或不再由 Git 註冊，必須先執行 `dev sweep`，讓它在 resume 或 reap 前回報需要 salvage 的 agent artifacts。Enter 不會開啟只剩 artifacts 的 abandoned directory。Terminal 寬度至少 97 cells 時，TASKS table 會顯示 display-width-aware `REPO` column；更窄時保留原 columns，並在 detail 顯示 repo/path。
146	
147	### REPOS
148	
149	```text
150	enter/o   ad-hoc open，不建立 task
151	n         透過 clone-aware `repo new` wizard 建立 repository
152	a/N       quick-add／瀏覽 repository notes
153	space     展開 linked worktrees
154	m         編輯 repository tags/summary
155	d         追蹤目前 branch 的 direct work
156	s         啟動 isolated work：branch + worktree + provisioning + runtime
157	H         開啟 repository activity heatmap
158	y         開啟 copy/context actions
159	```
160	
161	展開後會顯示每個 linked worktree，包括 harness-owned `(ephemeral)` 與未受管理的 `(external)` checkout。LIVE column 將 runtime activity 與 task state 分開。
162	
163	REPOS 為空時仍可按 `n`。Dashboard 會 suspend 到
164	`dev repo new --handoff stay`，保留 config/scaffold overrides，成功後重新載入
165	local TASKS/REPOS/TRY state；TUI 不會另外維護一套縮減版 repository creator。
166	
167	`dev repo context [repo]` 會輸出 TUI copy menu 相同的 agent-ready Markdown context，包含 paths、Git/worktree/runtime facts 與 tasks。`--json` 加入 schema-v1 evidence/readiness contract；只有 `--refresh` 會 live-probe optional forge 與 configured fleet sources。
168	
169	### 獨立 Repository Flow
170	
171	```text
172	dev flow [repo]         依 cwd 或明確 repo 開啟 canonical repository
173	j/k 或 Up/Down          選 surface row
174	h/l 或 Left/Right       選 action
175	Enter                   只建立 plan
176	r                       只更新 local facts
177	R                       明確選 fetch refs、query review 或 both
178	```
179	
180	Flow 的 `CANONICAL`、`MANAGED`、`UNMANAGED`、`HARNESS`、`TASK-ONLY` 與 `CONFLICT` rows 各有不同 action set。只有 READY plan 經 `y` 或 exact typed token 的第二次 confirmation 後才 Apply；沒有 generic force、dirty discard、`--close-unknown`、`--assume-no-runtime` 或 shared-writer override。Runtime `none` 顯示為 unobserved，不會被解讀成已證明沒有 session。Result 會保留 partial step ledger，Apply 後再 fresh local reload。
181	
182	### TRY 與 REMOTE
183	
184	TRY 管理低成本 experiment、可逆 archive/restore、mark 與 graduation。Archive 是整理，不是 deletion 或 disk reclamation。
185	
186	REMOTE 延遲載入，因此 startup 不等待 network。Private XDG cache 會在 first
187	view 後 decode，並保存完整 paginated inventory；fresh rows 不需要 network，
188	stale rows 仍可搜尋並在背景 refresh。Oversized／malformed payload，以及
189	fingerprint 屬於其他 configured GH/GL host 或 Azure target 的 cache 都會被忽略。
190	GitLab 使用 explicit `GITLAB_HOST`／`GLAB_HOST`（預設 `gitlab.com`），不從 cwd
191	推測 host；成功但為空的 inventory 會清除舊 rows。Enter 開啟既有 local clone。
192	對尚未 clone 的 repository，`c` 會確認受限於 `project_root` 的 destination；
193	`enter` 執行 clone 並留在 dashboard，`o` 則在 clone 後開啟。若 `project_root`
194	超出 configured REPOS discovery roots/depth，會在 mutation 前拒絕。Git clone 與
195	local-only、generation-guarded REPOS refresh 期間，row 與 status 會持續顯示 animated
196	marker；`q`／Ctrl-C 會要求取消，但不會拋棄 in-flight result。Snapshot 接受後，REMOTE
197	會標成 `repo`，REPOS 也能立即搜尋。若 Git 失敗後留下 destination，REMOTE 會把
198	exact path 標成 `inspect`，不會自動刪除或提供誤導性的 retry。`r` 才會
199	強制更新 forge inventories。使用 `/vis:private` 可精確過濾 visibility。只有 REMOTE row
200	能解析到 local clone 時才能使用 notes。TRY 保留 lowercase `n` 建立新 Try，不會改成
201	repository note。
202	
203	### CLI repository pickers
204	
205	Bare `dev repo clone` 會對既有 private forge cache 開啟 picker。它使用各 provider
206	的 exact clone URL，絕不 implicit refresh network，並保留 manual URL/path/`owner/name`
207	選項。Stale 或 incomplete cache 仍可選，但會顯示 warning；cache 必須明確 populate
208	或 replace：
209	
210	```bash
211	dev repo remote --refresh
212	dev repo clone
213	```
214	
215	在 checkout 外，bare `dev start` 使用相同 picker UI 選 fast live local discovery
216	的結果，之後才 full resolve 選定 repository 並規劃 task。在 repository 內則保留
217	immediate current-repository default，不掃描所有 configured roots。Default external selector 是 `fzf`；
218	executable 缺少時 fallback 到 built-in Bubble Tea list，`[picker] command = []` 會
219	強制使用 built-in。相容 external command 從 stdin 讀 candidates，並須在 stdout
220	原樣回傳一行。Non-TTY caller 保留 line prompt，絕不收到 picker UI。
221	
222	Repository 的 `contrib/television/dev-remote-repos.toml` 與
223	`contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash` 會組合相同 public source，不建立另一份 inventory：
224	
225	```bash
226	dev repo remote --refresh                 # 只在明確要求時 populate／refresh
227	ref="$(tv dev-remote-repos)" && [ -n "$ref" ] && dev repo clone "$ref"
228	source contrib/fzf/dev-repo-clone.bash
229	dev-repo-clone-fzf
230	```
231	
232	兩個 external recipe 都需要 `jq`、只讀 `dev repo remote --cached --json`，並將
233	一個 quoted clone URL 傳給 `dev repo clone`。它們是供 copy 或 symlink 的範例；
234	dev 不會修改 Television、shell 或 chezmoi config。
235	
236	### FLEET
237	
238	FLEET 採遠端主機樹。本機預設隱藏；按 `a` 或使用選單，才在最後以收合狀態
239	顯示並重用 REPOS。隱藏時搜尋與 coverage 都排除本機。Repos 尚在載入時，
240	主機列與動作仍可用。Space 展開／收合主機，Enter／`o` 導覽至主機或 repo；
241	Ctrl+O／右鍵開啟選單。
242	HERDR 欄由共享的本機 catalog 查詢呈現登錄／啟用狀態，與 SSH snapshot 分開。
243	Enable／disable／remove 操作精確 profile，遠端 sessions 保留；多筆先用 picker
244	選取。r 更新選取主機及 catalog metadata。有效快取持續可搜尋並標示時間與範圍。
245	
246	初始畫面後五秒或提早進入 FLEET 時，開始一次性的缺少／過期快取預熱，不跳出
247	密碼提示。設定 [tui.fleet] background_refresh = false 可保留純手動更新。
248	搜尋包含收合主機的已知 repos，暫時展開匹配項，不額外觸發 SSH。詳見
249	[主機樹與 Herdr 動作](remote-fleet.zh-TW.md#dashboard-host-tree)。
250	
251	## Repository quick notes
252	
253	在 TASKS，lowercase `n` 開啟單行 quick-add prompt。REPOS 將 `n` 保留給 new
254	repository，並以 `a` quick-add note；兩個 view 都用 uppercase `N` 開啟選取
255	repository 的 notes overlay。Child worktree 會透過 catalog identity 解析到同一個 canonical repository。
256	
257	```text
258	j/k       移動
259	/         搜尋 body、tags 與 repository
260	Enter     展開或收合 Markdown body
261	a or n    新增另一則 note
262	e         用 VISUAL/EDITOR 編輯 body
263	d         進入確認；y 才刪除
264	Esc       不改資料並返回
265	```
266	
267	可選的 REPOS column `notes` 顯示數量。Table 寬度有限，因此預設不啟用。Notes 存在時，repository detail 顯示數量與最新 preview；task 能解析到已載入 repository row 時，task detail 才會顯示。
268	
269	不使用 TUI 也能操作同一份 source of truth：
270	
271	```bash
272	dev note add "try event subscription" --repo api --tag idea
273	dev note list api
274	dev note search "event subscription" --repo api
275	dev note show <id-or-prefix>
276	dev note edit <id-or-prefix>
277	dev note delete <id-or-prefix>       # 會確認
278	dev note path api
279	dev note reindex
280	```
281	
282	Note ID prefix 必須唯一，且至少八個字元。
283	
284	Configured `paths.state_dir/notes` 下的 Markdown 是 durable data；`$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dev/notes.db` 只是可重建的 search index。精確 flags 請見[命令與設定 reference](../reference/commands-config.md)中的完整 generated command reference。
285	
286	SKILLS 與 MCP 都會等目前 REPOS generation 被接受後才延遲載入。在 Git 內，兩者只掃描
287	exact startup checkout 加 global/user sources，符合從該處啟動 agent 實際會讀到的內容，
288	不再混入無關 projects。在 Git 外，startup context 保留 cross-repository inventory，掃描
289	所有 accepted REPOS targets 加 ordinary startup directory。Uppercase `A` 會在本次 TUI
290	session 讓兩個 view 共用 context/all-repositories scope；切換時先清掉舊 scope rows，再以
291	generation guard reload，而未顯示的另一個 capability view 仍維持 lazy。Refresh 時會保留
292	可用 rows；warning-only partial inventory 仍維持 fresh，且 visible capability view 會在
293	REPOS recovery 後自動繼續載入。
294	
295	SKILLS 直接讀取 versioned `skills@1.5.23` 77-agent path registry 與 lock files；
296	不會執行 Node、`skills`、npm、`npx`、agent detector 或 project code。同名
297	project/global/repository rows 保持分開。Presence 與 embedded `dev-cli` integrity
298	是 local facts；update state 則是獨立的 lock-recorded upstream comparison。`c`
299	是明確且 grouped 的 Git source check；`a` 開啟 upstream interactive installer；
300	`u` 先確認，再於該 row 的 checkout 更新選取且受 lock 管理的 skill。Check 直接
301	hash Git object bytes，不建立 checkout；依 locale 排序的 non-ASCII folder hash
302	維持 unverifiable。Mutation 需要直接安裝的 `skills` executable，會跳過
303	repository-local npm shim、拒絕 source-less lock，並在 cooperating `dev` processes
304	之間 serialized。Filters 包含 `repo:`、`scope:`、`agent:`、`update:`、
305	`presence:` 與 `integrity:`。按 `e` 會開啟 row 的 primary installed `SKILL.md`（missing row
306	則開 lock file）；`y` menu 可複製 file path (`p`)、safe summary (`s`)、sanitized
307	source URL (`u`) 或整份 raw file (`f`)。
308	
309	MCP 會讀取 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 與 OpenCode 的 static
310	declarations。它保留 file/scope rows 與 exact Claude local project key，不猜測
311	一般化的 effective config；只有 Claude documented user/project/local/managed
312	project approvals 會被解析。Absolute `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 會搬移 Claude user
313	sources。Configured/enabled/disabled 不代表 connected 或 healthy。Provider-specific
314	environment reference names 與有限 OAuth facts 會保留；其 values、raw arguments、
315	URL credentials/path/query/fragment 與 indirect file content 都會在 row 進入 model
316	前被丟棄。Scanner 不會執行 server、helper、URL 或 agent MCP command。Filters 包含 `repo:`、`agent:`、`scope:`、`transport:`、
317	`managed:` 與 `state:`；`r` 只重讀 static files。按 `e` 會開啟 selected declaration
318	的 `ConfigPath`；`y` menu 可複製 path (`p`)、sanitized declaration (`s`) 或整份 raw
319	file (`f`)。Raw copy 只讀 local regular file、上限 1 MiB 且不使用 network，但可能把
320	同檔的 credentials 與其他 declarations 放進 system clipboard；rows 與 structured
321	output 仍維持 sanitized。`e` 會編輯 private working copy，在 atomic replacement
322	前立即 revalidate observed source，並在偵測到 conflict 時保留 working copy。
323	
324	## External tools
325	
326	```bash
327	dev tui tools
328	```
329	
330	設定的 tool 會在暫停 alternate screen 後，透過 `$SHELL` 於選取 checkout 執行。`interactive = true` 使用 `$SHELL -lic`，讓 local aliases/functions 能解析；跨機器需要 portability 時應使用 `PATH` 中的真實 executable。Availability probe 會在 first view 後以 bounded background load 執行；rendering 不會啟動 login shell，尚未解析的 binding 會 fail closed。
331	
332	```toml
333	[[tui.tools]]
334	key = "L"
335	name = "lazygit"
336	run = "lazygit"
337	```
338	
339	Key 區分大小寫，且不能覆蓋 globally owned dashboard binding。為相容既有設定，`A` 仍可配置，但在 SKILLS/MCP view 會優先執行 scope toggle。離開 editor 後可 reload 多數 config；更換 runtime backend 需要重啟 TUI。
340	
341	Configured tool 是刻意保留的 escape hatch：它在選取 checkout 執行任意 configured command，不會自動繼承 `dev flow` 的 PlanID、conditions、agent occupancy 或 revalidation guards。Raw Git／forge command 也是同樣邊界；operator 必須自行確認其 safety。
342	
343	## Inventory 現有機器
344	
345	先產生 report：
346	
347	```bash
348	dev bootstrap ~/code /mnt/work
349	dev bootstrap ~/code --json
350	```
351	
352	Scanner 會辨識 canonical checkout、linked worktree、bare repository 與 symlink alias，再依 Git identity 去重。
353	
354	建議的 organization layer 是 non-destructive symlink index：
355	
356	```bash
357	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat
358	dev bootstrap ~/code --index ~/Projects --layout flat --apply
359	```
360	
361	Physical move 是另一個更嚴格的 mode。Move plan 會阻擋 dirty repository、linked worktree、live session/current working directory、會損壞的 alias、occupied destination 與 cross-filesystem rename；任一 row blocked 時，apply 不會移動任何 repository。
362	
363	## Adopt 進行中的工作
364	
365	Bootstrap 回答 **repository 在哪裡**；adoption 回答 **哪些既有 branch、worktree 與 session 正在工作**：
366	
367	```bash
368	dev adopt
369	dev adopt --apply
370	```
371	
372	Adopt 預設只回報；只有 `--apply` 加確認後才寫 task entry。它不會移動、改名或刪除 checkout，也會排除已辨識的 harness-ephemeral worktree。

391	## Dashboard 生命週期新增功能
392	
393	[Dashboard 生命週期操作](dashboard-actions.md) 說明 task 完成／恢復／retire／recovery、完整 start wizard、Trash 與 repository browser actions。`Ctrl+O` 開啟所選 row 的選單；TASKS 的 `a` 只顯示已完成 tasks。
394	
395	## Dashboard 導覽與整理入口
396	
397	Dashboard Enter 開啟 repository／task 列或進入 FLEET 主機導覽；Space 展開／收合 REPOS／FLEET 樹，平面列表不使用 Space。REPOS／TRY 的 `Ctrl+O` 提供整理目前項目、篩選結果或全部本地工作，多選集中在獨立 triage。`1–7` 依序切換 TASKS、REPOS、FLEET、TRY、REMOTE、SKILLS、MCP。TASKS 狀態篩選移到 action menu，`a` 仍顯示 done。點資料欄標題循環升序 → 降序 → 預設，例如 FLEET 的 HOST 可按主機聚集。排序只操作當前快照、每頁獨立保留於 session，未知值置底。Footer 只保留兩行主要操作與導覽，工具／狀態篩選／排序放進 `Ctrl+O`，`?` 開啟目前分頁的 Keys／Guide／Manual。既有 `4–7` 自訂工具需改綁；`x`／Ctrl+A 不再是 dashboard 選取保留鍵。
398	
399	Triage 用 repo／Try 群組 checkbox，支援滑鼠與 Ctrl+A 全選／取消篩選結果。返回 dashboard 時保留失敗摘要。Git 同步診斷包含類別、exit code、截長且遮罩的輸出與下一步；舊 receipt 無法還原已丟棄的原因。重試必須重新 preview，不會暗中登入、fetch 或 rebase。詳見[本地整理](local-triage.md)。
400	
401	
402	## 載入、選單搜尋與多年活動
403	
404	REPOS 先讀取附時間的顯示 cache，再逐批加入 discovery 與 Git observations。
405	Runtime 較慢時，其他 repo 資料仍會出現；pending／cached rows 不提供操作授權。
406	完整 discovery 才移除消失項目，失敗保留 stale／unknown。`r` 保持本地 refresh；
407	`dev cache clear repos` 可清除快照，SIZE 沿用其獨立 cache。
408	
409	Ctrl+O 選單與子選單支援 `/` 篩選、方向鍵及 Enter；Esc 先清除搜尋，再關閉。
410	`H` 先顯示 stats，再自動補齊所選 repo 的完整本地 Git 歷史，refs 未變時使用
411	checkpoint。每年一張圖，由最早年份往下排列，支援滾輪、上下鍵、PgUp/PgDn、
412	Home/End；窄畫面按週分段。`r` 更新，`b` 強制 backfill，不 fetch。
413	Git 活動仍是每個非 merge commit 估算 20 分鐘。
414	
415	REPOS／SKILLS 的 action menu 可開啟獨立
416	[Skills 管理 wizard](skills-management.zh-TW.md)，提供 scopes、多選、檢查與預覽，
417	不增加大頁籤。
418	
419	
420	### 本地載入測量
421	
422	macOS、Go 1.26.4、60-repository 隔離 fixture，各情境跑三次的中位數如下。
423	時間取自 trace 接受資料的時刻，不是 terminal 完成繪製的時刻；Git 仍在背景更新。
424	
425	| 情境 | 首批 repository 資料 | 完整本地 snapshot |
426	|---|---:|---:|
427	| 原 dashboard | 3,896 ms | 3,896 ms |
428	| 新版，無顯示 cache | 14 ms | 3,911 ms |
429	| 新版，有顯示 cache | 15 ms | 2,819 ms |
430	
431	首批顯示不再等待完整掃描；完整掃描仍受檔案系統與程序負載影響，不把 cached Git
432	事實視為即時狀態。Recovery 詳情在選到 repo 時讀取；已完成觀察的 rows 可先操作，
433	其他 repo 繼續載入。
434	
435	## SSH connection view
436	
437	第八個頁籤以每台機器為父列，Space 展開各 SSH profile。已配置連線優先，

46	retirement separately removes eligible execution state and keeps the branch by

61	## Dispose of a Try
62	
63	```bash
64	dev tries delete <ref> --dry-run
65	dev tries delete <ref>
66	dev tries delete <id> --permanent --confirm-delete <id>
67	```
68	
69	`rm` is an alias for `delete`. The default moves the selected folder to macOS
70	Trash, Linux GIO Trash, or Windows Recycle Bin. Missing helpers, unsupported
71	volumes or failures never cause a permanent-delete fallback.
72	Linux removal also requires kernel/filesystem support for statx mount identity,
73	so bind mounts cannot be mistaken for owned child directories. Trash, like archive,
74	still occupies disk space until the bytes are deleted. Helpers are not installed
75	automatically. On macOS 15+ the system `trash --stopOnError` utility is preferred;
76	older systems use Foundation through JXA without out-pointer bridging.
77	
78	Permanent disposal is a separate choice requiring `DELETE <exact-id>` in the
79	interactive prompt or `--permanent --confirm-delete <id>` in scripts. `--yes`
80	alone approves only Trash. `--json` never prompts; `--dry-run` never deletes.
81	The preview covers ignored/untracked files and all local Git storage, including
82	branches, tags and stash. No remote backup has been verified.
83	
84	Only independent, cataloged, local active/deprecated Tries can be disposed of,
85	including archived folders. Task claims, live runtime, cwd, nested repositories,
86	linked/shared Git, mount boundaries and unsafe paths block removal. Unknown
87	runtime coverage requires a separate `--assume-no-runtime` acknowledgement;
88	this does not override an observed live session.
89	
90	Catalog ID, phase, metadata and other-host locations remain. The local location
91	becomes `evicted` with additive `removal_id`/`removal_method` fields. Durable
92	operation JSON is stored in `try-removals` beside assets; this is not cache or a
93	verified backup receipt. Interrupted operations stay indeterminate and never
94	retry deletion automatically. A recorded successful removal may finish an
95	interrupted catalog update during reconciliation.

98	
99	First restore the original directory using the OS Trash UI, then reassociate it
100	before editing its contents:
101	
102	```bash

104	```
105	
106	The TRY history action provides the same path prompt. dev verifies the retained
107	filesystem identity and content inventory, restoring the same catalog ID.
108	It does not search Trash or recover permanently discarded bytes. Existing archive
109	restoration still uses `dev tries restore <ref> [--to <path>]`.

112	
113	```bash
114	dev browse
115	dev repo browse api --remote origin
116	dev browse --print
117	dev repo context
118	```
119	
120	With no argument, browse resolves the current repository, including a linked
121	worktree. It chooses current branch upstream, then origin, then the sole remote;
122	otherwise interactive use asks and scripts require `--remote`. `--print` only
123	prints an HTTPS URL and never prompts or opens a browser. Resolution uses local
124	Git, never fetch or a forge query. Unsupported hosts/SSH aliases are not guessed.
125	
126	TASKS, REPOS, Git-backed TRY and REMOTE have browser actions. These keep the
127	dashboard open. `repo context` remains the detailed information report; browse
128	opens the repository homepage rather than a branch/file-specific page.
129

131	an unchanged original/restored folder; it never retries deletion. A folder put
132	back into its original archive path remains archived and can then use ordinary
133	`tries restore` to become visible again.

163	## Issues and suggested actions
164	
165	Every page's `Ctrl+O` menu includes **issues / suggested actions**, including an
166	empty list. Start with this page or switch to all pages. The list includes known
167	inventory and row problems and recent operation failures; it does not visit or
168	probe unopened pages. Selecting an issue shows its full diagnostic, source,
169	recovery advice, and a copy action. Long issue lists are paginated and full
170	messages remain available in the scrollable diagnostic view.
171	
172	The recovery coverage is explicit:
173	
174	| Source | Findings retained | Suggested action and completion check |
175	| --- | --- | --- |
176	| TASKS | Inventory/Git failures, missing checkout and lifecycle blockers | Recheck local task observations; inspect and recover the exact task through the existing sweep workflow. A changed task revision requires a new review. |
177	| REPOS | Repository identity, worktree, runtime, task, Git topology and disk-usage failures | Recheck the repository inventory; open the exact item's source/actions where it is still present. Organization retains its existing preview. |
178	| FLEET | Host observation, connection, trust/version and Herdr failures | Inspect the host's native actions; local recheck reads cache. Authentication and live host refresh remain explicit host actions. |
179	| TRY | Runtime/Git/disk failures, missing folder and unfinished moves | Recheck local Try state; review the exact Try in the existing organizer/recovery workflow. Never repeat a move or deletion automatically. |
180	| REMOTE | Inventory/provider and clone/open failures | Read cached observations, inspect retained clone results, and use the provider's login or explicit refresh. If no forge CLI is installed, review installation options. |
181	| SKILLS | Native lock/file diagnostic codes and paths, integrity and update failures | Read/copy the full diagnostic, open its exact source file, or use the selected skill's management actions. A successful native reload removes resolved diagnostics. |
182	| MCP | Native source/config diagnostics and declaration coverage codes | Open the exact diagnostic source or declaration actions, then reload static declarations. No server is started by issue inspection. |
183	| SSH | Registry/SSH permissions, missing tools, failed/partial sources, discovery/test/setup failures | Review exact permission repairs, source details or installation options; local recheck retains independently usable profiles. Discovery does not prove authentication. |
184	| Shared operations | Notes, stats, clipboard, editor/config saves and partial workflow receipts | Preserve full errors/receipts and copy guidance; reread observations without repeating the operation. Notes Markdown and stats databases remain durable. |
185	
186	Issue inspection only checks local dependencies and metadata. Unknown error
187	text never becomes a shell command. A recovery action prepares a concrete preview
188	before **run this reviewed action in the foreground** becomes available. Closing
189	the preview does not run it. Operation failures may describe partial success;
190	completed steps are retained and no automatic retry is started.
191	
192	Registry permission findings include the exact path, owner, current mode and
193	expected conditions. Missing registry state is normal. On supported Unix systems,
194	repair can only tighten the listed current-user-owned paths after revalidating
195	the complete inspected metadata. Symlinks, hardlinks, other owners and changes
196	since review block apply. Repairs never recurse or change ownership. Windows
197	registry ACL repair provides manual guidance until a verified repair backend is
198	available. Existing SSH permission repair uses its own guarded service.
199	
200	Dependency options support reviewed Homebrew packages on macOS, apt packages on
201	Debian/Ubuntu, and exact WinGet package IDs on Windows. The preview includes the

205	manager, or preaccept terms. The executable is checked afterwards, with an
206	OpenSSH capability query for `ssh`; authentication and service startup remain
207	separate. Installation cancellation/failure is not retried.

76	archived folders。Task claims、live runtime、cwd、nested repositories、
77	linked／shared Git、mount boundaries 與不安全路徑都會阻擋刪除。Runtime coverage
78	未知時，需要另外明示 `--assume-no-runtime`；不能覆蓋已觀察到的 live session。
79	
80	Catalog ID、phase、metadata 與其他主機位置保留。本機 location 成為 `evicted`，
81	並增加 `removal_id`／`removal_method`。Durable operation JSON 存於 assets 旁的
82	`try-removals`，不是 cache，也不是 verified backup receipt。中斷的操作保持
83	indeterminate，不會自動重試刪除；若已記錄成功移除，reconciliation 可完成尚未
84	寫入的 catalog update。
85	
86	## 從系統垃圾桶還原
87	
88	先透過 OS Trash UI 還原原資料夾，再於修改內容前重新關聯：
89	
90	```bash
91	dev tries restore <ref> --from <restored-path>
92	```
93	
94	TRY history 中的操作也提供相同 path prompt。Dev 驗證原 filesystem identity 與
95	content inventory，恢復相同 catalog ID；不搜尋垃圾桶，也不能救回永久丟棄的
96	bytes。原本的 archive restore 仍使用 `dev tries restore <ref> [--to <path>]`。
97	
98	## 開啟 repository 首頁
99	
100	```bash
101	dev browse
102	dev repo browse api --remote origin
103	dev browse --print
104	dev repo context
105	```
106	
107	不帶參數時，browse 解析目前 repository，也支援 linked worktree。Remote 依序
108	選目前 branch upstream、origin、唯一 remote；仍有歧義時互動選擇，scripts 必須
109	指定 `--remote`。`--print` 只印出 HTTPS URL，不提示輸入或開啟瀏覽器。解析只讀
110	local Git，不 fetch 或查詢 forge，也不猜測未知 host／SSH alias。
111	
112	TASKS、REPOS、Git-backed TRY 與 REMOTE 都有 browser actions，開啟後留在
113	Dashboard。詳細資訊仍使用 `repo context`；browse 開 repository 首頁，不定位
114	特定 branch 或 file。
115	
116	Trash 操作中斷後，`restore --from` 可明確重新關聯未變更的原資料夾或已還原
117	資料夾，不會重試刪除。若系統將資料夾放回原 archive path，location 仍為
118	archived；之後再用一般 `tries restore` 回到可見位置。
119	
120	## Dashboard 導覽與整理入口
121	
122	Dashboard Enter 開啟 repository／task 列或進入 FLEET 主機導覽；Space 展開／收合 REPOS／FLEET 樹，平面列表不使用 Space。REPOS／TRY 的 `Ctrl+O` 提供整理目前項目、篩選結果或全部本地工作，多選集中在獨立 triage。`1–7` 依序切換 TASKS、REPOS、FLEET、TRY、REMOTE、SKILLS、MCP。TASKS 狀態篩選移到 action menu，`a` 仍顯示 done。點資料欄標題循環升序 → 降序 → 預設，例如 FLEET 的 HOST 可按主機聚集。排序只操作當前快照、每頁獨立保留於 session，未知值置底。Footer 只保留兩行主要操作與導覽，工具／狀態篩選／排序放進 `Ctrl+O`，`?` 開啟目前分頁的 Keys／Guide／Manual。既有 `4–7` 自訂工具需改綁；`x`／Ctrl+A 不再是 dashboard 選取保留鍵。
123	
124	Triage 用 repo／Try 群組 checkbox，支援滑鼠與 Ctrl+A 全選／取消篩選結果。返回 dashboard 時保留失敗摘要。Git 同步診斷包含類別、exit code、截長且遮罩的輸出與下一步；舊 receipt 無法還原已丟棄的原因。重試必須重新 preview，不會暗中登入、fetch 或 rebase。詳見[本地整理](local-triage.md)。
125	
126	
127	Ctrl+O 的 `/` 只篩選目前選單，方向鍵移動，Enter 執行；Esc 先清除搜尋。
128	REPOS 可管理目前或篩選範圍的 skills，SKILLS 可選單一 skill、project 或 global。
129	這些入口使用 [dev skill manage](skills-management.zh-TW.md) wizard；更新先檢查
130	並預覽，experimental restore／sync 僅限單 project。
131	
132	
133	## 問題與建議動作
134	
135	八個頁面的 `Ctrl+O` 選單都有 **issues / suggested actions**，空清單也能開啟。
136	預設查看目前頁面，也可切到全部頁面；內容包含已知 inventory／列內問題與近期
137	操作失敗，不會為此造訪或探測尚未開啟的頁面。選取問題可看完整診斷、來源、
138	處理建議並複製文字。問題清單支援分頁，完整訊息另有可捲動的詳情視窗。
139	
140	各來源的問題處理對照如下：
141	
142	| 來源 | 保留的問題 | 建議動作與完成判定 |
143	| --- | --- | --- |
144	| TASKS | Inventory／Git 失敗、checkout 遺失與生命週期阻擋 | 重讀本機 task 觀測；透過既有 sweep 流程檢查及恢復確切 task。Task revision 改變時必須重新審閱。 |
145	| REPOS | Repository 身分、worktree、runtime、task、Git topology 與磁碟用量失敗 | 重讀 repository inventory；來源仍存在時開啟確切項目的動作。整理流程保留既有預覽。 |
146	| FLEET | Host 觀測、連線、信任／版本與 Herdr 失敗 | 查看該 host 的原生動作；本機重查讀取 cache。驗證與即時刷新仍是明確的 host 操作。 |
147	| TRY | Runtime／Git／磁碟失敗、資料夾遺失與未完成移動 | 重讀本機 Try 狀態；在既有整理／恢復流程審閱確切 Try。不自動重跑移動或刪除。 |
148	| REMOTE | Inventory／provider 與 clone／open 失敗 | 讀取 cache、查看保留的 clone 結果，使用 provider 登入或明確刷新。沒有 forge CLI 時可審閱安裝選項。 |
149	| SKILLS | 原生 lock／file 診斷碼與路徑、完整性與更新失敗 | 查看／複製完整診斷、開啟確切來源檔或進入該 skill 的管理動作。成功重讀原生來源後移除已解決診斷。 |
150	| MCP | 原生來源／設定診斷與 declaration coverage 代碼 | 開啟診斷指向的確切來源或 declaration 動作，再重讀靜態宣告。檢查問題不會啟動 server。 |
151	| SSH | Registry／SSH 權限、缺少工具、來源失敗／部分完成與 discovery／測試／setup 失敗 | 審阅確切權限修復、來源詳情或安裝選項；重查仍保留可獨立使用的 profiles。Discovery 不代表驗證成功。 |
152	| 共用操作 | Notes、stats、剪貼簿、editor／config 儲存與部分完成 receipts | 保留完整錯誤／receipts 並提供複製指引；重讀觀測不重跑操作。Notes Markdown 與 stats 資料庫仍是持久資料。 |
153	
154	問題檢查只讀本機依賴與 metadata，不把未知錯誤文字轉成 shell 命令。修復先產生
155	具體預覽，使用者選擇 **run this reviewed action in the foreground** 後才執行。
156	關閉預覽不執行；部分成功保留已完成步驟，不自動重試。
157	
158	Registry 權限問題顯示確切路徑、owner、目前 mode 與預期條件；尚無 registry
159	是正常狀態。支援的 Unix 平台只對列出的目前使用者擁有路徑收緊權限，套用前
160	重新驗證完整檢查範圍的 metadata。Symlink、hardlink、其他 owner 或審閱後變更
161	會阻擋套用；不遞迴處理、不改 ownership。Windows registry ACL 修復在有經驗證
162	的後端前提供人工指引；SSH 權限使用既有的 guarded service。
163	
164	依賴安裝支援 macOS Homebrew、Debian／Ubuntu apt，以及 Windows 的精確 WinGet
165	package ID。預覽列出套件、已解析的命令與官方指引。未支援的工具／平台或缺少
166	package manager 時只提供指引。前景安裝保留原生提示，不新增套件來源、不安裝
167	manager、不預先接受條款。完成後檢查執行檔，`ssh` 另檢查 OpenSSH capability；
168	驗證與服務啟動分開處理。取消或失敗不自動重試。
169

87	func coCommitMessage(ctx context.Context, root, path string) (string, string, error) {
88		if path == "" {
89			return "", "", coCommitFailure("message_required", "provide_base_message_file")
90		}
91		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
92			path = filepath.Join(root, path)
93		}
94		parent, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(filepath.Dir(path))
95		if err != nil || parent != filepath.Dir(path) || filepath.Clean(path) != path {
96			return "", "", coCommitFailure("unsafe_message_path", "provide_regular_base_message_file")
97		}
98		data, err := safefile.ReadStablePath(ctx, path, 256<<10)
99		if err != nil || len(bytes.TrimSpace(data)) == 0 || !utf8.Valid(data) {
100			return "", "", coCommitFailure("invalid_message", "provide_utf8_base_message")
101		}
102		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
103			key, _, found := strings.Cut(line, ":")
104			if !found {
105				continue
106			}
107			switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(key)) {
108			case "ai-assisted-by", "agent-transcript", "agent-plan", "agent-history-request":
109				return "", "", coCommitFailure("managed_message_trailer", "let_canonical_finalizer_derive_provenance")
110			}
111		}
112		digest := sha256.Sum256(data)
113		return path, hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
114	}
115	
116	func coCommitFeatureIndex(ctx context.Context, root string) (string, error) {
117		paths, err := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, root, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z")
118		if err != nil || paths == "" {
119			return "", coCommitFailure("feature_index_required", "stage_only_reviewed_feature_paths")
120		}
121		for _, path := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(paths, "\x00"), "\x00") {
122			if isRecognizedArtifact(path) {
123				return "", coCommitFailure("artifact_already_staged", "preserve_index_then_prepare_feature_only_selection")
124			}
125		}
126		unmerged, err := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, root, "ls-files", "--unmerged", "-z")
127		if err != nil || unmerged != "" {
128			return "", coCommitFailure("unmerged_index", "resolve_git_operation")
129		}
130		entries, err := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, root, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z")
131		if err != nil {
132			return "", coCommitFailure("index_unavailable", "inspect_checkout")
133		}
134		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(entries))
135		return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
136	}
137	
138	func verifyCoCommitRequestLocation(observation CoCommitObservation, root, gitDir string) error {
139		if observation.WorktreeRoot != root || observation.GitDir != gitDir || observation.RequestID != observation.RunID || !canonicalSessionID(observation.RequestID) || observation.RequestPath != coCommitRequestPath(gitDir, observation.RequestID) {
140			return coCommitFailure("request_identity_mismatch", "inspect_existing_request_do_not_retry")
141		}
142		if !coCommitDigest.MatchString(observation.RequestRevision) || !coCommitDigest.MatchString(observation.MessageSHA256) || !coCommitOID.MatchString(observation.HeadOID) || !coCommitOID.MatchString(observation.InputIndexTree) || !strings.HasPrefix(observation.HeadRef, "refs/heads/") || strings.ContainsAny(observation.HeadRef, "\x00\r\n") {
143			return coCommitFailure("request_identity_incomplete", "inspect_existing_request_do_not_retry")
144		}
145		return nil
146	}
147	
148	// PrepareCoCommit queues once in a real wrapper context, or repairs only the
149	// binding of an explicitly selected already-queued run. No source/index writes
150	// are performed by this adapter; the canonical queue owns its inert request.
151	func (s *Service) PrepareCoCommit(ctx context.Context, request CoCommitPrepareRequest) (*CoCommitResult, error) {
152		if s.Store == nil {
153			return nil, errors.New("artifact service needs a store")
154		}
155		if _, err := coCommitEnvironment(); err != nil {
156			return nil, err
157		}
158		provider, sessionID, err := ParseSession(request.Session)
159		if err != nil || provider != "claude" || !canonicalSessionID(sessionID) {
160			return nil, coCommitFailure("unsupported_session", "select_exact_supported_provider_session")
161		}
162		if request.SpecStoryPath == "" || (request.Plan == "") == !request.NoPlan {
163			return nil, coCommitFailure("explicit_selection_required", "select_transcript_and_one_plan_or_no_plan")
164		}
165		repository, err := gitx.Discover(ctx, request.Worktree)
166		if err != nil {
167			return nil, coCommitFailure("git_identity_unavailable", "inspect_checkout")
168		}
169		root, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.Root)
170		if err != nil {
171			return nil, err
172		}
173		if operation, active, err := gitx.InProgress(root); err != nil || active {
174			_ = operation
175			return nil, coCommitFailure("git_operation_active", "finish_git_operation")
176		}
177		if _, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(root, ".dev-cli", "artifacts.toml")); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
178			history, openErr := agenthistory.Open(ctx, agenthistory.Options{Root: root, StateDir: filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(s.Store.Dir))})
179			if openErr != nil {
180				return nil, coCommitFailure("artifact_policy_unavailable", "inspect_artifact_policy")
181			}
182			if history.Policy.Mode == "archive" {
183				return nil, coCommitFailure("incompatible_archive_policy", "use_archive_handoff")
184			}
185		}
186		transcript, err := SelectTranscript(root, request.SpecStoryPath, provider, sessionID)
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, coCommitFailure("transcript_selection_invalid", "review_exact_transcript_selection")
189		}
190		info, err := os.Lstat(transcript.Path)
191		if err != nil {
192			return nil, err
193		}
194		tracked, err := gitTracked(ctx, root, transcript.Path)
195		if err != nil {
196			return nil, err
197		}
198		limit := s.LargeLimit
199		if limit <= 0 {
200			limit = DefaultLargeLimit
201		}
202		if !tracked && info.Size() > limit && !request.AllowLarge {
203			return nil, coCommitFailure("large_transcript_review_required", "review_growth_then_use_allow_large")
204		}
205		transcriptRelative, err := coCommitRelative(root, transcript.Path)
206		if err != nil {
207			return nil, err
208		}
209		var plans []string
210		planRelative, planPolicy := "", "none"
211		if !request.NoPlan {
212			plans, err = normalizePlans(root, []string{request.Plan})
213			if err != nil {
214				return nil, coCommitFailure("plan_selection_invalid", "review_exact_plan_selection")
215			}
216			planRelative, err = coCommitRelative(root, plans[0])
217			if err != nil {
218				return nil, err
219			}
220			planPolicy = "path"
221		}
222		messagePath, messageDigest, err := coCommitMessage(ctx, root, request.MessageFile)
223		if err != nil {
224			return nil, err
225		}
226		gitDir, err := coCommitGitDir(ctx, root)
227		if err != nil {
228			return nil, err
229		}
230		helper, err := resolveCoCommitHelper(ctx, root, request.HelperDir)
231		if err != nil {
232			return nil, err
233		}
234		var observation CoCommitObservation
235		queued := false
236		if request.RunID != "" {
237			if !canonicalSessionID(request.RunID) {
238				return nil, coCommitFailure("invalid_run_selection", "select_existing_canonical_run")
239			}
240			observation, err = helper.inspect(ctx, coCommitRequestPath(gitDir, request.RunID), false)
241		} else {
242			if os.Getenv("AGENT_HISTORY_REQUEST_PATH") == "" || !canonicalSessionID(os.Getenv("AGENT_HISTORY_RUN_ID")) {
243				return nil, coCommitFailure("requires_wrapper", "start_real_wrapper_with_explicit_approval")
244			}
245			observation, err = helper.inspect(ctx, "", true)
246			if err == nil && observation.RequestID == "" {
247				if observation.GitDir != gitDir || observation.RequestPath != coCommitRequestPath(gitDir, observation.RunID) || observation.State != "running" {
248					return nil, coCommitFailure("wrapper_context_mismatch", "inspect_real_wrapper_context")
249				}
250				beforeIndex, indexErr := coCommitFeatureIndex(ctx, root)
251				if indexErr != nil {
252					return nil, indexErr
253				}
254				args := []string{"--session-id", sessionID, "--specstory-path", transcriptRelative, "--message-file", messagePath}
255				if request.NoPlan {
256					args = append(args, "--no-plan")
257				} else {
258					args = append(args, "--plan", planRelative)
259				}
260				var reply struct {
261					Status string `json:"status"`
262				}
263				if queueErr := helper.call(ctx, "queue", args, &reply); queueErr != nil {
264					return newCoCommitResult("queue_outcome_unproven", observation.RunID, "inspect_existing_request_do_not_requeue"), queueErr
265				}
266				queued = true
267				if reply.Status != "queued" {
268					return newCoCommitResult("queue_outcome_unproven", observation.RunID, "inspect_existing_request_do_not_requeue"), coCommitFailure("queue_outcome_unproven", "inspect_existing_request_do_not_requeue")
269				}
270				requestPath := observation.RequestPath
271				observation, err = helper.inspect(ctx, requestPath, false)
272				if err == nil {
273					afterIndex, indexErr := coCommitFeatureIndex(ctx, root)
274					if indexErr != nil || beforeIndex != afterIndex {
275						err = coCommitFailure("index_changed_during_queue", "preserve_request_and_exit_agent")
276					}
277				}
278			}
279		}
280		partial := newCoCommitResult("queued_but_not_bound", observation.RunID, "exit_agent_then_repair_exact_binding")
281		if err != nil {
282			if queued {
283				return partial, err
284			}
285			return nil, err
286		}
287		if err := verifyCoCommitRequestLocation(observation, root, gitDir); err != nil {
288			return partial, err
289		}
290		if observation.Provider != provider || observation.SessionID != sessionID || observation.SpecStoryPath != transcriptRelative || observation.PlanPolicy != planPolicy || observation.PlanPath != planRelative || observation.MessageSHA256 != messageDigest {
291			return partial, coCommitFailure("queued_selection_mismatch", "inspect_existing_request_do_not_requeue")
292		}
293		binding := helper.binding
294		binding.RequestPath, binding.RequestID, binding.RequestRevision = observation.RequestPath, observation.RequestID, observation.RequestRevision
295		binding.InputIndexTree, binding.MessageSHA256, binding.PlanPolicy = observation.InputIndexTree, observation.MessageSHA256, observation.PlanPolicy
296		intent := &Intent{
297			ID: "co-" + observation.RequestID, RunID: observation.RunID, Provider: provider, SessionID: sessionID,
298			TaskID: request.TaskID, RepoPath: repository.MainRoot, GitCommonDir: repository.GitCommonDir,
299			WorktreePath: root, Branch: strings.TrimPrefix(observation.HeadRef, "refs/heads/"), Base: request.Base,
300			Head: observation.HeadOID, PlanPaths: plans, SpecStoryPath: transcript.Path, AllowLarge: request.AllowLarge,
301			Destination: "co-commit", CoCommit: &binding,
302		}
303		common, err := pathx.Canonical(repository.GitCommonDir)
304		if err != nil {
305			return partial, err
306		}
307		var record *Record
308		err = lockx.WithDir(ctx, filepath.Join(common, "dev-artifact-bind"), "co-commit binding", func() error {
309			existing, err := s.Store.GetRecord(intent.ID)
310			if err == nil {
311				if err := coCommitBindingMatches(existing.Intent, observation); err != nil || existing.Intent.CoCommit.HelperToken != binding.HelperToken || existing.Intent.CoCommit.PythonToken != binding.PythonToken {
312					return coCommitFailure("binding_conflict", "inspect_existing_native_binding")
313				}
314				record = existing
315				return nil
316			}
317			if !errors.Is(err, ErrIntentNotFound) {
318				return err
319			}
320			if err := coCommitCurrentRequest(ctx, intent, observation); err != nil {
321				return err
322			}
323			if err := s.Store.Create(ctx, intent); err != nil {
324				return err
325			}
326			record, err = s.Store.GetRecord(intent.ID)
327			return err
328		})
329		if err != nil {
330			return partial, &CoCommitError{Code: "queued_but_not_bound", RequestID: observation.RequestID, NextAction: "exit_agent_then_repair_exact_binding", MayHaveRun: true}
331		}
332		result := newCoCommitResult("queued", observation.RequestID, "report_finalization_queued_then_exit_agent")
333		if request.RunID != "" {
334			result.Status, result.NextAction = "bound", "inspect_helper_status_before_finalization"
335		}
336		result.Intent, result.Revision, result.Observation = record.Intent, record.Revision, &observation
337		return result, nil
338	}
339	
340	func coCommitBindingMatches(intent *Intent, observation CoCommitObservation) error {
341		if intent == nil || intent.Destination != "co-commit" || intent.CoCommit == nil || intent.CoCommit.validate() != nil {
342			return coCommitFailure("invalid_binding", "inspect_native_binding")
343		}
344		b := intent.CoCommit
345		if observation.HelperRevision != b.HelperRevision || observation.RequestID != b.RequestID || observation.RequestPath != b.RequestPath || observation.RequestRevision != b.RequestRevision || observation.WorktreeRoot != intent.WorktreePath || observation.HeadRef != "refs/heads/"+intent.Branch || observation.HeadOID != intent.Head || observation.InputIndexTree != b.InputIndexTree || observation.Provider != intent.Provider || observation.SessionID != intent.SessionID || observation.MessageSHA256 != b.MessageSHA256 || observation.PlanPolicy != b.PlanPolicy {
346			return coCommitFailure("request_changed", "inspect_existing_request_do_not_retry")
347		}
348		transcript, err := coCommitRelative(intent.WorktreePath, intent.SpecStoryPath)
349		if err != nil || observation.SpecStoryPath != transcript {
350			return coCommitFailure("selector_changed", "inspect_existing_request_do_not_retry")
351		}
352		plan := ""
353		if b.PlanPolicy == "path" {
354			if len(intent.PlanPaths) != 1 {
355				return coCommitFailure("invalid_plan_binding", "inspect_native_binding")
356			}
357			plan, err = coCommitRelative(intent.WorktreePath, intent.PlanPaths[0])
358			if err != nil {
359				return err
360			}
361		} else if len(intent.PlanPaths) != 0 {
362			return coCommitFailure("invalid_plan_binding", "inspect_native_binding")
363		}
364		if observation.PlanPath != plan {
365			return coCommitFailure("plan_changed", "inspect_existing_request_do_not_retry")
366		}
367		return nil
368	}
369	
370	func coCommitCurrentRequest(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent, observation CoCommitObservation) error {
371		if err := coCommitBindingMatches(intent, observation); err != nil {
372			return err
373		}
374		gitDir, err := coCommitGitDir(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
375		if err != nil {
376			return err
377		}
378		if err := verifyCoCommitRequestLocation(observation, intent.WorktreePath, gitDir); err != nil {
379			return err
380		}
381		if observation.CommitProven {
382			return verifyCoCommitObject(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent, observation, true)
383		}
384		head, err := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
385		if err != nil || head != intent.Head {
386			return coCommitFailure("head_changed", "preserve_snapshot_and_inspect")
387		}
388		ref, err := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "symbolic-ref", "HEAD")
389		if err != nil || ref != "refs/heads/"+intent.Branch {
390			return coCommitFailure("ref_changed", "preserve_snapshot_and_inspect")
391		}
392		tree := observation.InputIndexTree
393		if observation.PreparedTree != "" {
394			if !coCommitOID.MatchString(observation.PreparedTree) {
395				return coCommitFailure("invalid_prepared_tree", "inspect_existing_request_do_not_retry")
396			}
397			tree = observation.PreparedTree
398		}
399		if _, err := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, "diff", "--cached", "--quiet", tree, "--"); err != nil {
400			return coCommitFailure("prepared_index_changed", "preserve_snapshot_and_inspect")
401		}
402		return nil
403	}
404	
405	// ObserveCoCommit reads canonical proof and verifies the Git object independently.
406	// It does not repair native status, stage files, scan, sync or contact remotes.
407	func ObserveCoCommit(ctx context.Context, intent *Intent) (CoCommitObservation, error) {
408		var observation CoCommitObservation
409		helper, err := boundCoCommitHelper(ctx, intent)
410		if err != nil {
411			return observation, err
412		}
413		observation, err = helper.inspect(ctx, intent.CoCommit.RequestPath, false)
414		if err != nil {
415			return observation, err
416		}
417		if err = coCommitBindingMatches(intent, observation); err != nil {
418			return observation, err
419		}
420		gitDir, err := coCommitGitDir(ctx, intent.WorktreePath)
421		if err != nil {
422			return observation, err
423		}
424		if err = verifyCoCommitRequestLocation(observation, intent.WorktreePath, gitDir); err != nil {
425			return observation, err
426		}
427		if observation.CommitProven {
428			err = verifyCoCommitObject(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent, observation, false)
429		}
430		return observation, err
431	}
432	
433	func coCommitPostWriter(observation CoCommitObservation) bool {
434		return observation.ChildExitCode != nil && *observation.ChildExitCode == 0 && observation.ChildSignal == nil && observation.GroupQuiescent != nil && *observation.GroupQuiescent && observation.SyncStatus == "proven" && observation.FreshnessStatus == "proven"
435	}
436	
437	func verifyCoCommitObject(ctx context.Context, root string, intent *Intent, observation CoCommitObservation, requireHead bool) error {
438		if !observation.CommitProven || observation.State != "done" || !coCommitPostWriter(observation) || !coCommitOID.MatchString(observation.CommitOID) || !coCommitOID.MatchString(observation.PreparedTree) {
439			return coCommitFailure("commit_unproven", "reconcile_canonical_receipt_only")
440		}
441		if requireHead {
442			head, err := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
443			if err != nil || head != observation.CommitOID {
444				return coCommitFailure("commit_head_changed", "reconcile_canonical_receipt_only")
445			}
446		}
447		metadata, err := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, root, "show", "-s", "--format=%T%n%P", observation.CommitOID)
448		if err != nil || metadata != observation.PreparedTree+"\n"+intent.Head {
449			return coCommitFailure("commit_identity_mismatch", "reconcile_canonical_receipt_only")
450		}
451		object, err := gitx.RunReadOnly(ctx, root, "cat-file", "commit", observation.CommitOID)
452		if err != nil || len(object) > 512<<10 {
453			return coCommitFailure("commit_message_unavailable", "reconcile_canonical_receipt_only")
454		}
455		_, message, found := strings.Cut(object, "\n\n")
456		if !found {
457			return coCommitFailure("commit_message_invalid", "reconcile_canonical_receipt_only")
458		}
459		count := 0
460		for _, line := range strings.Split(message, "\n") {
461			if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(line), "agent-history-request:") {
462				if line != "Agent-History-Request: "+intent.CoCommit.RequestID {
463					return coCommitFailure("commit_request_mismatch", "reconcile_canonical_receipt_only")
464				}
465				count++
466			}
467		}
468		if count != 1 {
469			return coCommitFailure("commit_request_mismatch", "reconcile_canonical_receipt_only")
470		}
471		return nil
472	}
473	
474	// FinalizeCoCommit delegates exactly one authorized attempt. A committed helper
475	// outcome whose native persistence fails is repaired only by reconciliation.
476	func (s *Service) FinalizeCoCommit(ctx context.Context, request CoCommitFinalizeRequest) (*CoCommitResult, error) {
477		if !request.AllowCommit {
478			return nil, coCommitFailure("authorization_required", "review_exact_run_then_allow_commit")
479		}
480		if s.Store == nil {
481			return nil, errors.New("artifact service needs a store")
482		}
483		record, err := s.Store.GetRecord(request.IntentID)
484		if err != nil {
485			return nil, err
486		}
487		if request.Revision != "" && request.Revision != record.Revision {
488			return nil, ErrStaleRevision
489		}
490		if record.Intent.Destination != "co-commit" {
491			return nil, coCommitFailure("not_co_commit", "use_existing_artifact_finalizer")
492		}
493		common, err := pathx.Canonical(record.Intent.GitCommonDir)
494		if err != nil {
495			return nil, err
496		}
497		var result *CoCommitResult
498		err = lockx.WithDir(ctx, filepath.Join(common, "dev-artifact-finalize"), "co-commit finalization", func() error {
499			current, err := s.Store.GetRecord(request.IntentID)
500			if err != nil {
501				return err
502			}
503			if current.Revision != record.Revision {
504				return ErrStaleRevision
505			}
506			intent := current.Intent
507			helper, err := boundCoCommitHelper(ctx, intent)
508			if err != nil {
509				return err
510			}
511			observation, err := helper.inspect(ctx, intent.CoCommit.RequestPath, false)
512			if err != nil {
513				return err
514			}
515			if err := coCommitCurrentRequest(ctx, intent, observation); err != nil {
516				return err
517			}
518			if !coCommitPostWriter(observation) {
519				return coCommitFailure("writer_or_sync_unproven", "finish_real_wrapper_before_finalization")
520			}
521			if !observation.CommitProven {
522				if request.Guard == nil {
523					return coCommitFailure("writer_guard_missing", "use_guarded_external_finalizer")
524				}
525				paths := append([]string{intent.SpecStoryPath}, intent.PlanPaths...)
526				if err := request.Guard(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, paths); err != nil {
527					return err
528				}
529				current, err = s.Store.UpdateIfRevision(ctx, intent.ID, current.Revision, func(candidate *Intent) error {
530					candidate.Status = Finalizing
531					candidate.FailureCode = ""
532					return nil
533				})
534				if err != nil {
535					return err
536				}
537				args := []string{"--request", intent.CoCommit.RequestPath, "--allow-commit"}
538				if request.ReviewFile != "" {
539					args = append(args, "--review-file", request.ReviewFile)
540				}
541				if request.RotationConfirmed {
542					args = append(args, "--rotation-confirmed")
543				}
544				var reply map[string]any
545				invokeErr := helper.call(ctx, "finalize", args, &reply)
546				observation, err = helper.inspect(ctx, intent.CoCommit.RequestPath, false)
547				if err != nil {
548					result = newCoCommitResult("finalization_outcome_unproven", intent.CoCommit.RequestID, "inspect_canonical_run_do_not_retry")
549					return &CoCommitError{Code: "finalization_outcome_unproven", RequestID: intent.CoCommit.RequestID, NextAction: "inspect_canonical_run_do_not_retry", MayHaveRun: true}
550				}
551				if err := coCommitBindingMatches(intent, observation); err != nil {
552					return err
553				}
554				if !observation.CommitProven {
555					result = newCoCommitResult(observation.State, intent.CoCommit.RequestID, "review_canonical_run_no_automatic_retry")
556					result.Intent, result.Revision, result.Observation = current.Intent, current.Revision, &observation
557					if invokeErr != nil {
558						return invokeErr
559					}
560					return coCommitFailure("commit_unproven", "reconcile_canonical_receipt_only")
561				}
562			}
563			if err := verifyCoCommitObject(ctx, intent.WorktreePath, intent, observation, true); err != nil {
564				return err
565			}
566			updated, err := s.Store.UpdateIfRevision(ctx, intent.ID, current.Revision, func(candidate *Intent) error {
567				candidate.Status = Finalized
568				candidate.ArtifactCommit = observation.CommitOID
569				candidate.TranscriptPath = candidate.SpecStoryPath
570				candidate.FailureCode = ""

    assert all("--no-cloud-sync" in row for row in events)
    assert "--print" in events[-1] and "--no-stats" in events[-1]
    assert c.finalize("--allow-commit").returncode == 0
    assert c.git("rev-list", "--count", "HEAD").strip() == b"2"
    c.git("-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "commit", "--allow-empty", "-qm", "later")
    result = c.call("inspect", "--request", c.request, "--json")
    value = json.loads(result.stdout)
    assert value["commit_proven"] is True
    assert value["composed_message_sha256"] and value["normalized_message_sha256"]


def test_complete_private_receipt_preview_and_fixture_review(lifecycle):
    c = lifecycle
    result = c.start(allow=True, secret=SECRET_A + " repeated " + SECRET_A)
    assert result.returncode == 10, (result.stdout, result.stderr)
    assert SECRET_A.encode() not in result.stdout + result.stderr
    receipt_path = c.run_dir / "sanitation.json"
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_bytes())
    artifact = receipt["artifacts"][0]
    assert SECRET_A.encode() in base64.b64decode(artifact["source_before"])
    assert artifact["pre_oid"] != artifact["post_oid"]
    assert len(artifact["findings"][0]["occurrences"]) == 2
    assert any(row["path"] == "product.txt" for row in receipt["coverage"])
    assert receipt_path.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o600
    before = {path: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns) for path in c.run_dir.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
    index_before = (c.repo / ".git/index").read_bytes()
    result = c.preview()
    assert result.returncode == 0, (result.stdout, result.stderr)
    assert SECRET_A.encode() not in result.stdout + result.stderr
    assert before == {path: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns) for path in c.run_dir.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
    assert index_before == (c.repo / ".git/index").read_bytes()
    review = c.decisions(["reviewed_noncredential"])
    assert c.finalize("--review-file", review).returncode == 5
    result = c.finalize("--allow-commit", "--review-file", review)
    assert result.returncode == 0, (result.stdout, result.stderr)
    assert SECRET_A.encode() not in c.git("show", "HEAD:.specstory/history/session.md")
    assert c.journal()["v2"]["review_status"] == "reviewed_noncredential"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("dispositions,rotation,expected", [
    (["reviewed_noncredential", "unresolved"], False, "unresolved_review"),
    (["reviewed_noncredential", "credential_rotation_required"], False, "rotation_confirmation_required"),
    (["reviewed_noncredential", "credential_rotation_required"], True, "committed"),
])
def test_mixed_reviews(lifecycle, dispositions, rotation, expected):
    c = lifecycle
    assert c.start(allow=True, secret=SECRET_A + " " + SECRET_B).returncode == 10
    review = c.decisions(dispositions)
    args = ["--allow-commit", "--review-file", review]
    if rotation:
        args.append("--rotation-confirmed")
    result = c.finalize(*args)
    assert json.loads(result.stdout)["status"] == expected, (result.stdout, result.stderr)
    if expected != "committed":
        assert c.git("rev-list", "--count", "HEAD").strip() == b"1"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["stale-alias", "source-during-sync", "source-during-export", "bad-export"])
def test_exact_export_rejects_stale_or_unsupported_without_sanitation(lifecycle, mode):
    c = lifecycle
    initial_index = (c.repo / ".git/index").read_bytes()
    result = c.start(allow=True, mode=mode, secret=SECRET_A)
    assert result.returncode != 0
    assert c.journal()["sync_succeeded"] is False
    assert not (c.run_dir / "sanitation.json").exists()
    assert initial_index == (c.repo / ".git/index").read_bytes()
    assert SECRET_A in (c.repo / ".specstory/history/session.md").read_text()
    if mode == "stale-alias":
        assert (c.repo / ".specstory/history/other-alias.md").exists()


def test_explicit_cloud_choice_never_cloud_exports(lifecycle):
    c = lifecycle
    result = c.start(cloud=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0, (result.stdout, result.stderr)
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(c.env["TEST_EVENTS"]).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert "--no-cloud-sync" not in events[0]
    assert "--no-cloud-sync" not in events[1]
    assert "--no-cloud-sync" in events[2]

def test_product_finding_blocks_all_publication(lifecycle):
    c = lifecycle
    (c.repo / "product.txt").write_text(SECRET_B)
    c.git("add", "product.txt")
    initial = (c.repo / ".git/index").read_bytes()
    result = c.start(allow=True, secret=SECRET_A)
    assert result.returncode == 7, (result.stdout, result.stderr)
    assert (c.repo / ".git/index").read_bytes() == initial
    assert SECRET_A in (c.repo / ".specstory/history/session.md").read_text()
    assert not (c.run_dir / "sanitation.json").exists()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["index", "source", "receipt", "review", "policy", "tool"])
def test_stale_replay_cannot_release_rotation(lifecycle, mutation):
    c = lifecycle
    assert c.start(allow=True, secret=SECRET_A).returncode == 10
    review = c.decisions(["reviewed_noncredential"])
    if mutation == "index":
        (c.repo / "product.txt").write_text("different\n")
        c.git("add", "product.txt")
    elif mutation == "source":
        path = c.repo / ".specstory/history/session.md"
        path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b"changed\n")
    elif mutation == "receipt":
        path = c.run_dir / "sanitation.json"
        value = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
        value["artifacts"][0]["steps"] = []
        private_write(path, canonical(value))
    elif mutation == "review":
        value = json.loads(review.read_bytes())
        value["receipt_revision"] = "0" * 64
        private_write(review, canonical(value))
    elif mutation == "policy":
        path = c.run_dir / "gitleaks.toml"
        path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b"\n# changed\n")
    else:
        path = c.bin / "gitleaks"
        path.write_text(path.read_text() + "\n# tool changed\n")
    result = c.finalize("--allow-commit", "--review-file", review)
    assert result.returncode != 0, result.stdout
    assert c.git("rev-list", "--count", "HEAD").strip() == b"1"


def test_v1_parser_refuses_added_v2_authority(lifecycle):
    p = load_helper()
    root = str(lifecycle.repo)
    run_id, run_dir, request, journal_path, token = p.initialize_run(root, str(lifecycle.repo / ".git"))
    value, _raw = p.read_canonical_json(journal_path, "journal", p.validate_journal)
    assert value["schema_version"] == 1
    value["v2"] = {}
    with pytest.raises(p.LifecycleError):
        p.validate_journal(value)

def test_native_specstory_exact_print_is_readonly_and_byte_identical(tmp_path):
    native = shutil.which("specstory")
    if not native:
        pytest.skip("native SpecStory is not installed; native compatibility NOT verified")
    root = (tmp_path / "synthetic-project").resolve()
    root.mkdir()
    home = (tmp_path / "isolated-home").resolve()
    home.mkdir()
    environment = {"PATH": os.environ["PATH"], "HOME": str(home), "TMPDIR": str(tmp_path),
                   "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": str(home / "config"), "XDG_CACHE_HOME": str(home / "cache"),
                   "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": "/dev/null", "GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM": "/dev/null"}
    # Keep telemetry off explicitly without inheriting any real provider state.
    environment.update(OTEL_SDK_DISABLED="true", DO_NOT_TRACK="1")
    p = load_helper()
    probe_path = SCRIPTS / "probe-specstory-redaction.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("synthetic_specstory_probe", probe_path)
    probe = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(probe)
    old_home = os.environ.get("HOME")
    os.environ["HOME"] = str(home)
    try:
        source, session = probe.build_session(root, [])
    finally:
        if old_home is None:
            os.environ.pop("HOME", None)
        else:
            os.environ["HOME"] = old_home
    before = source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mtime_ns
    help_result = run([native, "sync", "--help"], root, environment)
    for flag in (b"--print", b"--no-cloud-sync", b"--no-stats", b"--silent"):
        assert flag in help_result.stdout
    flags = ["--silent", "--no-cloud-sync", "--no-stats", "--no-usage-analytics", "--no-version-check"]
    run([native, "sync", "claude", "-s", session, *flags], root, environment)
    aliases = list((root / ".specstory/history").glob("*.md"))
    assert len(aliases) == 1
    filesystem = {path: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns)
                  for parent in (root, home) for path in parent.rglob("*") if path.is_file()}
    export = run([native, "sync", "claude", "-s", session, "--print", *flags], root, environment)
    assert export.stdout == aliases[0].read_bytes()
    assert export.stdout.startswith(b"<!-- Generated by SpecStory, Markdown ")
    assert session.encode() in export.stdout
    assert (source.read_bytes(), source.stat().st_mtime_ns) == before
    assert filesystem == {path: (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns)
                          for parent in (root, home) for path in parent.rglob("*") if path.is_file()}
    assert not (root / ".specstory/statistics.json").exists()
