1	# Changelog
2	
3	All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.
4	
5	The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and releases use [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
6	
7	## [Unreleased]
8	
9	## [0.2.40] - 2026-09-19
10	
11	### Added
12	
13	- `dev wt open --no-focus` opens or reuses an existing checkout's runtime surface
14	  without switching focus or issuing a shell directory handoff. It reports the
15	  actual branch, path and runtime handle; it does not create a worktree, provision
16	  files, adopt a task or launch an agent. Bundled guidance now calls for making
17	  durable agent worktrees visible and reporting their locations immediately.
18	- `dev prepare --specstory-path` selects and persists one exact SpecStory
19	  transcript by provider, UUID and capture scope, including archive handoffs.
20	  Ambiguous discovery still refuses to guess. Native finalization now rechecks
21	  writer/source guards and exact intent revisions with locked compare-and-update
22	  transactions; `--revision` can bind an external finalizer to a reviewed record.
23	- Explicit `dev prepare --closeout co-commit` delegates a feature-only staged
24	  snapshot and selected transcript/plan to a compatible canonical v2 helper.
25	  It requires a real wrapper launched without automatic commit approval, retains
26	  the canonical queue acknowledgement, and never launches or closes an agent.
27	  External `artifact finalize --allow-commit` prepares without committing,
28	  revalidates native guards and both revisions, then permits one commit-capable
29	  call. Uncertain outcomes reconcile only; partial bindings never blindly requeue.
30	  Read-only review previews and schema-1 `co_commit_handoff` / `artifact_handoffs`
31	  JSON keep persisted intent separate from helper observations. The separately
32	  maintained helper is not bundled or installed automatically; native Windows
33	  co-commit remains unsupported.
34	
35	### Fixed
36	
37	- Compact release source archives also exclude Claude, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode
38	  plan directories, not just SpecStory history. Git retains the selected evidence;
39	  the source-archive gate verifies these exclusions and the real native build.
40	- REPOS `n` and the new-repository action now open the clone-aware wizard while
41	  selected-row observations are pending or the filtered list is empty. Active
42	  clones still block; wizard confirmation and fresh destination checks remain.
43	- Dashboard local filters and help index/result searches accept Up/Down while
44	  typing without moving the text cursor or leaving the input. Enter still keeps
45	  the query/selection and exits filtering without opening; ordinary list Enter,
46	  article search/scroll and Notes search retain their existing behavior.
47	
48	## [0.2.39] - 2026-09-17
49	
50	### Added
51	
52	- `dev hygiene report` summarizes the newest stored scan for the current
53	  checkout without scanning again (so the pre-commit hook's staged scan is
54	  readable right after a blocked commit), or `--report ID` / `--rescan`.
55	  Findings are grouped by severity, rule, file and category, ordered by
56	  disposition then occurrences, with `--top`, `--disposition`, `--rule`,
57	  `--category`, `--path` filters and a `--findings` drill-down. `--json` emits
58	  the new `hygiene_summary` schema-v1 document. `--values` shows masked
59	  distinct values per rule; raw values and their context go only to a private
60	  review file whose location `dev hygiene review-path <report-id>` prints.
61	  Scan findings gain additive keyed `value_id` and `file_id` fields, keeping
62	  private filenames distinct even when their displayed labels match. Stored
63	  summaries show the scan date without claiming current source freshness;
64	  legacy file counts are explicitly marked as lower bounds. Value capture is
65	  byte-bounded and skipped samples are visible; a failed values sidecar retains
66	  a partial scan receipt. Invalid path globs fail before scanning, and filter
67	  metadata is policy-masked.
68	- `dev retire --base <ref>` overrides the containment target used to prove a
69	  DONE task or linked worktree is integrated: a local branch, a remote-tracking
70	  branch such as `origin/main`, or a commit. `dev sweep --base` forwards the
71	  same override to DONE tasks, and `--merged-worktrees` proves managed tasks
72	  against the base it already verified. After `dev done --merged --base-ref`,
73	  cleanup hints and the cleanup wizard carry that ref forward.
74	
75	### Fixed
76	
77	- Artifact readiness no longer lets unrelated repositories' intent records
78	  block a detached checkout. Repository identity is filtered before branch
79	  identity is required for moved intents; relevant pending, ambiguous or
80	  unreadable records still block cleanup. Windows non-directory store errors
81	  are no longer mistaken for an absent store. Submodule artifact observation
82	  errors retain their specific cause instead of only reporting unfinished artifacts.
83	- Recursive worktree cleanup can locally prove never-initialized submodules
84	  empty without downloading or publishing children. Exact empty module
85	  administration is revalidated and pruned with directory-only operations before
86	  ordinary no-force Git removal. Retained child stores, orphan data, ignored
87	  files, links and ownership claims remain blockers. Mixed initialized/empty
88	  graphs retain recovery proofs and rollback for real child repositories, and
89	  interrupted empty-directory pruning reports partial effects. Native path
90	  spellings share bookkeeping keys on Windows without relaxing physical identity
91	  checks. `--recursive` remains required; alternates and squash-ancestry
92	  protections are unchanged.
93	- Guarded file replacements on macOS no longer fail with a metadata round-trip
94	  error when the source file was written by another application. The kernel
95	  assigns `com.apple.provenance` to each new file and ignores attempts to copy
96	  it, so hygiene redaction, encoding repair and recovery, and `dev ssh init`
97	  now leave that one tag to the kernel while still requiring every other
98	  extended attribute to survive and still detecting a changed source. Apply and
99	  recovery errors now keep their underlying cause instead of only pointing at
100	  the private receipt.
101	- `dev sweep --apply --yes` (including `--merged-worktrees`) now completes a
102	  batch in one pass. A reviewed retirement or removal plan is bound only to the
103	  worktrees that share its branch or path, so removing an unrelated sibling
104	  earlier in the batch no longer turns every remaining plan stale. A new
105	  checkout of the same branch, or a lock or HEAD change on the target, still
106	  invalidates the plan.
107	- Retirement and contained worktree removal no longer refuse a base recorded as
108	  a commit or remote-tracking ref (for example `base = "b509448"` from
109	  `dev start --base <commit>`) with "local base ref refs/heads/… does not
110	  exist". Bases resolve as a local branch, then a remote-tracking branch, then a
111	  commit, and apply re-resolves the same input. A recorded fork-point commit is
112	  never replaced by the default branch: when it cannot prove integration, the
113	  plan stays blocked and names `--base <branch>`.
114	- An agent can now repair or redact another session's stopped SpecStory
115	  transcript from its own pane. The artifact writer guard previously blocked

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only remote release verification; all downloads live in private temporary storage."""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import urllib.request
import zipfile

REPO = "daviddwlee84/dev-cli"
VERSION = "v0.2.40"
TARGETS = ("darwin_arm64", "darwin_amd64", "linux_amd64", "linux_arm64", "windows_amd64", "windows_arm64")
PLAN_ROOTS = (".claude/plans", ".codex/plans", ".cursor/plans", ".opencode/plans", ".specstory")

def run(*args, cwd=None):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, cwd=cwd, text=True).strip()

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.file_digest(path.open("rb"), "sha256").hexdigest()

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--commit", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--repo-root", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", args.commit)
    release = json.loads(run("gh", "api", f"repos/{REPO}/releases/tags/{VERSION}"))
    assert release["tag_name"] == VERSION and not release["draft"] and not release["prerelease"]
    archives = {f"dev-cli_{VERSION}_{target}." + ("zip" if target.startswith("windows") else "tar.gz") for target in TARGETS}
    source_name = f"dev-cli_{VERSION}_source.tar.gz"
    expected = archives | {source_name, "SHA256SUMS"}
    assert {a["name"] for a in release["assets"]} == expected
    assert all(a["state"] == "uploaded" for a in release["assets"])
    remote = run("git", "-C", args.repo_root, "ls-remote", "--tags", "origin", f"refs/tags/{VERSION}^{{}}")
    assert remote.split()[0] == args.commit
    result = {"version": VERSION, "commit": args.commit, "release": release["html_url"]}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="verify-downloads-", dir=Path(__file__).parent) as temporary:
        root = Path(temporary)
        subprocess.run(["gh", "release", "download", VERSION, "--repo", REPO, "--dir", str(root)], check=True)
        sums = {}
        for line in (root / "SHA256SUMS").read_text().splitlines():
            match = re.fullmatch(r"([0-9a-f]{64})  (\S+)", line)
            assert match and match[2] not in sums
            sums[match[2]] = match[1]
        assert set(sums) == archives | {source_name}
        for name, checksum in sums.items():
            assert sha(root / name) == checksum, name
        for asset in release["assets"]:
            if asset.get("digest"):
                assert asset["digest"] == "sha256:" + sha(root / asset["name"])
        result["assets_verified"] = len(expected)
        result["archive_checksums_verified"] = len(sums)
        binaries = []
        for target in TARGETS:
            target_os, target_arch = target.split("_")
            filename = "dev.exe" if target_os == "windows" else "dev"
            archive = root / (f"dev-cli_{VERSION}_{target}." + ("zip" if target_os == "windows" else "tar.gz"))
            directory = root / target
            directory.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            binary = directory / filename
            if target_os == "windows":
                with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
                    assert bundle.namelist() == [filename]
                    binary.write_bytes(bundle.read(filename))
            else:
                with tarfile.open(archive) as bundle:
                    assert bundle.getnames() == [filename]
                    binary.write_bytes(bundle.extractfile(filename).read())
            binary.chmod(0o700)
            metadata = run("go", "version", "-m", str(binary))
            assert f"GOOS={target_os}" in metadata and f"GOARCH={target_arch}" in metadata
            assert "github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/cli.Version=" + VERSION in metadata
            native_arch = {"x86_64": "amd64", "aarch64": "arm64"}.get(platform.machine(), platform.machine())
            executed = sys.platform == target_os and native_arch == target_arch
            if executed:
                assert run(str(binary), "--version") == "dev version " + VERSION
                assert "--no-focus" in run(str(binary), "wt", "open", "--help")
            binaries.append({"target": target, "metadata_verified": True, "executed_natively": executed})
        result["binaries"] = binaries
        source = root / "source"
        source.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        with tarfile.open(root / source_name) as bundle:
            assert bundle.pax_headers.get("comment") == args.commit
            names = set(bundle.getnames())
            assert not any(name == prefix or name.startswith(prefix + "/") for name in names for prefix in PLAN_ROOTS)
            assert {"go.mod", "go.sum", "cmd/dev/main.go", "internal/skill/dev-cli/SKILL.md"} <= names
            bundle.extractall(source, filter="data")
        source_binary = root / "dev-from-source"
        subprocess.run(["go", "build", "-ldflags", "-X github.com/daviddwlee84/dev-cli/internal/cli.Version=" + VERSION, "-o", str(source_binary), "./cmd/dev"], cwd=source, check=True)
        assert run(str(source_binary), "--version") == "dev version " + VERSION
        result["source"] = {"commit_verified": True, "history_and_plans_excluded": True, "build": "passed"}
        formula_meta = json.loads(run("gh", "api", "repos/daviddwlee84/homebrew-tap/contents/Formula/dev-cli.rb"))
        formula = base64.b64decode(formula_meta["content"]).decode()
        url = re.search(r'^  url "([^"]+)"$', formula, re.M)[1]
        expected_url = f"https://github.com/{REPO}/archive/refs/tags/{VERSION}.tar.gz"
        assert url == expected_url
        formula_hash = re.search(r'^  sha256 "([0-9a-f]{64})"$', formula, re.M)[1]
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=120) as response:
            actual_hash = hashlib.sha256(response.read()).hexdigest()
        assert actual_hash == formula_hash
        template = (source / "packaging/homebrew/dev-cli.rb.tmpl").read_text()
        assert formula == template.replace("@VERSION@", VERSION[1:]).replace("@SHA256@", formula_hash)
        result["homebrew"] = {"formula_blob": formula_meta["sha"], "version_and_source_checksum_verified": True}
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
